name: Anushasana Parva

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shamo bahuvidhAkAraH sUkShma uktaH pitAmaha |
na cha me hRRidaye shAntirasti kRRitvedamIdRRisham
shlokas.2:
asminnarthe bahuvidhA shAntiruktA tvayAnagha |
svakRRite kA nu shAntiH syAchChamAdbahuvidhAdapi
shlokas.3:
sharAchitasharIraM hi tIvravraNamudIkShya cha |
shamaM nopalabhe vIra duShkRRitAnyeva chintayan
shlokas.4:
rudhireNAvasiktA~NgaM prasravantaM yathAchalam |
tvAM dRRiShTvA puruShavyAghra sIde varShAsvivAmbujam
shlokas.5:
ataH kaShTataraM kiM nu matkRRite yatpitAmahaH |
imAmavasthAM gamitaH pratyamitrai raNAjire
tathaivAnye nRRipatayaH sahaputrAH sabAndhavAH
shlokas.6:
vayaM hi dhArtarAShTrAshcha kAlamanyuvashAnugAH |
kRRitvedaM ninditaM karma prApsyAmaH kAM gatiM nRRipa
shlokas.7:
ahaM tava hyantakaraH suhRRidvadhakarastathA |
na shAntimadhigachChAmi pashya.nstvAM duHkhitaM kShitau
shlokas.8:
bhIShma uvAcha||
paratantraM kathaM hetumAtmAnamanupashyasi |
karmaNyasminmahAbhAga sUkShmaM hyetadatIndriyam
shlokas.9:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
sa.nvAdaM mRRityugautamyoH kAlalubdhakapannagaiH
shlokas.10:
gautamI nAma kaunteya sthavirA shamasa.nyutA |
sarpeNa daShTaM svaM putramapashyadgatachetanam
shlokas.11:
atha taM snAyupAshena baddhvA sarpamamarShitaH |
lubdhako.arjunako nAma gautamyAH samupAnayat
shlokas.12:
tAM chAbravIdayaM te sa putrahA pannagAdhamaH |
brUhi kShipraM mahAbhAge vadhyatAM kena hetunA
shlokas.13:
agnau prakShipyatAmeSha chChidyatAM khaNDasho.api vA |
na hyayaM bAlahA pApashchiraM jIvitumarhati
shlokas.14:
gautamyuvAcha||
visRRijainamabuddhistvaM na vadhyo.arjunaka tvayA |
ko hyAtmAnaM guruM kuryAtprAptavye sati chintayan
shlokas.15:
plavante dharmalaghavo loke.ambhasi yathA plavAH |
majjanti pApaguravaH shastraM skannamivodake
shlokas.16:
na chAmRRityurbhavitA vai hate.asmi;nko vAtyayaH syAdahate.asmi~njanasya |
asyotsarge prANayuktasya janto;rmRRityorlokaM ko nu gachChedanantam
shlokas.17:
lubdhaka uvAcha||
jAnAmyevaM neha guNAguNaj~nAH; sarve niyuktA guravo vai bhavanti |
svasthasyaite tUpadeshA bhavanti; tasmAtkShudraM sarpamenaM haniShye
shlokas.18:
samIpsantaH kAlayogaM tyajanti; sadyaH shuchaM tvarthavidastyajanti |
shreyaH kShayaH shochatAM nityasho hi; tasmAttyAjyaM jahi shokaM hate.asmin
shlokas.19:
gautamyuvAcha||
na chaivArtirvidyate.asmadvidhAnAM; dharmArAmaH satataM sajjano hi |
nityAyasto bAlajano na chAsti; dharmo hyeSha prabhavAmyasya nAham
shlokas.20:
na brAhmaNAnAM kopo.asti kutaH kopAchcha yAtanA |
mArdavAtkShamyatAM sAdho muchyatAmeSha pannagaH
shlokas.21:
lubdhaka uvAcha||
hatvA lAbhaH shreya evAvyayaM syA;tsadyo lAbho balavadbhiH prashastaH |
kAlAllAbho yastu sadyo bhaveta; hate shreyaH kutsite tvIdRRishe syAt
shlokas.22:
gautamyuvAcha||
kArthaprAptirgRRihya shatruM nihatya; kA vA shAntiH prApya shatruM namuktvA |
kasmAtsaumya bhujage na kShameyaM; mokShaM vA kiM kAraNaM nAsya kuryAm
shlokas.23:
lubdhaka uvAcha||
asmAdekasmAdbahavo rakShitavyA; naiko bahubhyo gautami rakShitavyaH |
kRRitAgasaM dharmavidastyajanti; sarIsRRipaM pApamimaM jahi tvam
shlokas.24:
gautamyuvAcha||
nAsminhate pannage putrako me; samprApsyate lubdhaka jIvitaM vai |
guNaM chAnyaM nAsya vadhe prapashye; tasmAtsarpaM lubdhaka mu~ncha jIvam
shlokas.25:
lubdhaka uvAcha||
vRRitraM hatvA devarATshreShThabhAgvai; yaj~naM hatvA bhAgamavApa chaiva |
shUlI devo devavRRittaM kuru tvaM; kShipraM sarpaM jahi mA bhUdvisha~NkA
shlokas.26:
bhIShma uvAcha||
asakRRitprochyamAnApi gautamI bhujagaM prati |
lubdhakena mahAbhAgA pApe naivAkaronmatim
shlokas.27:
IShaduchChvasamAnastu kRRichChrAtsa.nstabhya pannagaH |
utsasarja giraM mandAM mAnuShIM pAshapIDitaH
shlokas.28:
ko nvarjunaka doSho.atra vidyate mama bAlisha |
asvatantraM hi mAM mRRityurvivashaM yadachUchudat
shlokas.29:
tasyAyaM vachanAddaShTo na kopena na kAmyayA |
tasya tatkilbiShaM lubdha vidyate yadi kilbiSham
shlokas.30:
lubdhaka uvAcha||
yadyanyavashagenedaM kRRitaM te pannagAshubham |
kAraNaM vai tvamapyatra tasmAttvamapi kilbiShI
shlokas.31:
mRRitpAtrasya kriyAyAM hi daNDachakrAdayo yathA |
kAraNatve prakalpyante tathA tvamapi pannaga
shlokas.32:
kilbiShI chApi me vadhyaH kilbiShI chAsi pannaga |
AtmAnaM kAraNaM hyatra tvamAkhyAsi bhuja~Ngama
shlokas.33:
sarpa uvAcha||
sarva ete hyasvavashA daNDachakrAdayo yathA |
tathAhamapi tasmAnme naiSha heturmatastava
shlokas.34:
atha vA matametatte te.apyanyonyaprayojakAH |
kAryakAraNasa.ndeho bhavatyanyonyachodanAt
shlokas.35:
evaM sati na doSho me nAsmi vadhyo na kilbiShI |
kilbiShaM samavAye syAnmanyase yadi kilbiSham
shlokas.36:
lubdhaka uvAcha||
kAraNaM yadi na syAdvai na kartA syAstvamapyuta |
vinAshe kAraNaM tvaM cha tasmAdvadhyo.asi me mataH
shlokas.37:
asatyapi kRRite kArye neha pannaga lipyate |
tasmAnnAtraiva hetuH syAdvadhyaH kiM bahu bhAShase
shlokas.38:
sarpa uvAcha||
kAryAbhAve kriyA na syAtsatyasatyapi kAraNe |
tasmAttvamasminhetau me vAchyo heturvisheShataH
shlokas.39:
yadyahaM kAraNatvena mato lubdhaka tattvataH |
anyaH prayoge syAdatra kilbiShI jantunAshane
shlokas.40:
lubdhaka uvAcha||
vadhyastvaM mama durbuddhe bAlaghAtI nRRisha.nsakRRit |
bhAShase kiM bahu punarvadhyaH sanpannagAdhama
shlokas.41:
sarpa uvAcha||
yathA havIMShi juhvAnA makhe vai lubdhakartvijaH |
na phalaM prApnuvantyatra paraloke tathA hyaham
shlokas.42:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tathA bruvati tasmi.nstu pannage mRRityuchodite |
AjagAma tato mRRityuH pannagaM chAbravIdidam
shlokas.43:
kAlenAhaM praNuditaH pannaga tvAmachUchudam |
vinAshaheturnAsya tvamahaM vA prANinaH shishoH
shlokas.44:
yathA vAyurjaladharAnvikarShati tatastataH |
tadvajjaladavatsarpa kAlasyAhaM vashAnugaH
shlokas.45:
sAttvikA rAjasAshchaiva tAmasA ye cha kechana |
bhAvAH kAlAtmakAH sarve pravartante hi jantuShu
shlokas.46:
ja~NgamAH sthAvarAshchaiva divi vA yadi vA bhuvi |
sarve kAlAtmakAH sarpa kAlAtmakamidaM jagat
shlokas.47:
pravRRittayashcha yA loke tathaiva cha nivRRittayaH |
tAsAM vikRRitayo yAshcha sarvaM kAlAtmakaM smRRitam
shlokas.48:
AdityashchandramA viShNurApo vAyuH shatakratuH |
agniH khaM pRRithivI mitra oShadhyo vasavastathA
shlokas.49:
saritaH sAgarAshchaiva bhAvAbhAvau cha pannaga |
sarve kAlena sRRijyante hriyante cha tathA punaH
shlokas.50:
evaM j~nAtvA kathaM mAM tvaM sadoShaM sarpa manyase |
atha chaiva~Ngate doSho mayi tvamapi doShavAn
shlokas.51:
sarpa uvAcha||
nirdoShaM doShavantaM vA na tvA mRRityo bravImyaham |
tvayAhaM chodita iti bravImyetAvadeva tu
shlokas.52:
yadi kAle tu doSho.asti yadi tatrApi neShyate |
doSho naiva parIkShyo me na hyatrAdhikRRitA vayam
shlokas.53:
nirmokShastvasya doShasya mayA kAryo yathA tathA |
mRRityo vidoShaH syAmeva yathA tanme prayojanam
shlokas.54:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sarpo.athArjunakaM prAha shrutaM te mRRityubhAShitam |
nAnAgasaM mAM pAshena santApayitumarhasi
shlokas.55:
lubdhaka uvAcha||
mRRityoH shrutaM me vachanaM tava chaiva bhuja~Ngama |
naiva tAvadvidoShatvaM bhavati tvayi pannaga
shlokas.56:
mRRityustvaM chaiva heturhi jantorasya vinAshane |
ubhayaM kAraNaM manye na kAraNamakAraNam
shlokas.57:
dhi~NmRRityuM cha durAtmAnaM krUraM duHkhakaraM satAm |
tvAM chaivAhaM vadhiShyAmi pApaM pApasya kAraNam
shlokas.58:
mRRityuruvAcha||
vivashau kAlavashagAvAvAM taddiShTakAriNau |
nAvAM doSheNa gantavyau yadi samyakprapashyasi
shlokas.59:
lubdhaka uvAcha||
yuvAmubhau kAlavashau yadi vai mRRityupannagau |
harShakrodhau kathaM syAtAmetadichChAmi veditum
shlokas.60:
mRRityuruvAcha||
yAH kAshchidiha cheShTAH syuH sarvAH kAlaprachoditAH |
pUrvamevaitaduktaM hi mayA lubdhaka kAlataH
shlokas.61:
tasmAdubhau kAlavashAvAvAM taddiShTakAriNau |
nAvAM doSheNa gantavyau tvayA lubdhaka karhichit
shlokas.62:
bhIShma uvAcha||
athopagamya kAlastu tasmindharmArthasa.nshaye |
abravItpannagaM mRRityuM lubdhamarjunakaM cha tam
shlokas.63:
kAla uvAcha||
naivAhaM nApyayaM mRRityurnAyaM lubdhaka pannagaH |
kilbiShI jantumaraNe na vayaM hi prayojakAH
shlokas.64:
akarodyadayaM karma tanno.arjunaka chodakam |
praNAshaheturnAnyo.asya vadhyate.ayaM svakarmaNA
shlokas.65:
yadanena kRRitaM karma tenAyaM nidhanaM gataH |
vinAshahetuH karmAsya sarve karmavashA vayam
shlokas.66:
karmadAyAdavA.NllokaH karmasambandhalakShaNaH |
karmANi chodayantIha yathAnyonyaM tathA vayam
shlokas.67:
yathA mRRitpiNDataH kartA kurute yadyadichChati |
evamAtmakRRitaM karma mAnavaH pratipadyate
shlokas.68:
yathA ChAyAtapau nityaM susambaddhau nirantaram |
tathA karma cha kartA cha sambaddhAvAtmakarmabhiH
shlokas.69:
evaM nAhaM na vai mRRityurna sarpo na tathA bhavAn |
na cheyaM brAhmaNI vRRiddhA shishurevAtra kAraNam
shlokas.70:
tasmi.nstathA bruvANe tu brAhmaNI gautamI nRRipa |
svakarmapratyayA.NllokAnmatvArjunakamabravIt
shlokas.71:
naiva kAlo na bhujago na mRRityuriha kAraNam |
svakarmabhirayaM bAlaH kAlena nidhanaM gataH
shlokas.72:
mayA cha tatkRRitaM karma yenAyaM me mRRitaH sutaH |
yAtu kAlastathA mRRityurmu~nchArjunaka pannagam
shlokas.73:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato yathAgataM jagmurmRRityuH kAlo.atha pannagaH |
abhUdviroSho.arjunako vishokA chaiva gautamI
shlokas.74:
etachChrutvA shamaM gachCha mA bhUshchintAparo nRRipa |
svakarmapratyayA.NllokA.nstrInviddhi manujarShabha
shlokas.75:
na tu tvayA kRRitaM pArtha nApi duryodhanena vai |
kAlena tatkRRitaM viddhi vihatA yena pArthivAH
shlokas.76:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityetadvachanaM shrutvA babhUva vigatajvaraH |
yudhiShThiro mahAtejAH paprachChedaM cha dharmavit

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmaha mahAprAj~na sarvashAstravishArada |
shrutaM me mahadAkhyAnamidaM matimatAM vara
shlokas.2:
bhUyastu shrotumichChAmi dharmArthasahitaM nRRipa |
kathyamAnaM tvayA ki~nchittanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.3:
kena mRRityurgRRihasthena dharmamAshritya nirjitaH |
ityetatsarvamAchakShva tattvena mama pArthiva
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
yathA mRRityurgRRihasthena dharmamAshritya nirjitaH
shlokas.5:
manoH prajApate rAjannikShvAkurabhavatsutaH |
tasya putrashataM jaj~ne nRRipateH sUryavarchasaH
shlokas.6:
dashamastasya putrastu dashAshvo nAma bhArata |
mAhiShmatyAmabhUdrAjA dharmAtmA satyavikramaH
shlokas.7:
dashAshvasya sutastvAsIdrAjA paramadhArmikaH |
satye tapasi dAne cha yasya nityaM rataM manaH
shlokas.8:
madirAshva iti khyAtaH pRRithivyAM pRRithivIpatiH |
dhanurvede cha vede cha nirato yo.abhavatsadA
shlokas.9:
madirAshvasya putrastu dyutimAnnAma pArthivaH |
mahAbhAgo mahAtejA mahAsattvo mahAbalaH
shlokas.10:
putro dyutimatastvAsItsuvIro nAma pArthivaH |
dharmAtmA koshavA.nshchApi devarAja ivAparaH
shlokas.11:
suvIrasya tu putro.abhUtsarvasa~NgrAmadurjayaH |
durjayetyabhivikhyAtaH sarvashAstravishAradaH
shlokas.12:
durjayasyendravapuShaH putro.agnisadRRishadyutiH |
duryodhano nAma mahAnrAjAsIdrAjasattama
shlokas.13:
tasyendrasamavIryasya sa~NgrAmeShvanivartinaH |
viShayashcha prabhAvashcha tulyamevAbhyavartata
shlokas.14:
ratnairdhanaishcha pashubhiH sasyaishchApi pRRithagvidhaiH |
nagaraM viShayashchAsya pratipUrNaM tadAbhavat
shlokas.15:
na tasya viShaye chAbhUtkRRipaNo nApi durgataH |
vyAdhito vA kRRisho vApi tasminnAbhUnnaraH kvachit
shlokas.16:
sudakShiNo madhuravAganasUyurjitendriyaH |
dharmAtmA chAnRRisha.nsashcha vikrAnto.athAvikatthanaH
shlokas.17:
yajvA vadAnyo medhAvI brahmaNyaH satyasa~NgaraH |
na chAvamantA dAtA cha vedavedA~NgapAragaH
shlokas.18:
taM narmadA devanadI puNyA shItajalA shivA |
chakame puruShashreShThaM svena bhAvena bhArata
shlokas.19:
tasya jaj~ne tadA nadyAM kanyA rAjIvalochanA |
nAmnA sudarshanA rAjanrUpeNa cha sudarshanA
shlokas.20:
tAdRRigrUpA na nArIShu bhUtapUrvA yudhiShThira |
duryodhanasutA yAdRRigabhavadvaravarNinI
shlokas.21:
tAmagnishchakame sAkShAdrAjakanyAM sudarshanAm |
bhUtvA cha brAhmaNaH sAkShAdvarayAmAsa taM nRRipam
shlokas.22:
daridrashchAsavarNashcha mamAyamiti pArthivaH |
na ditsati sutAM tasmai tAM viprAya sudarshanAm
shlokas.23:
tato.asya vitate yaj~ne naShTo.abhUddhavyavAhanaH |
tato duryodhano rAjA vAkyamAhartvijastadA
shlokas.24:
duShkRRitaM mama kiM nu syAdbhavatAM vA dvijarShabhAH |
yena nAshaM jagAmAgniH kRRitaM kupuruSheShviva
shlokas.25:
na hyalpaM duShkRRitaM no.asti yenAgnirnAshamAgataH |
bhavatAM vAtha vA mahyaM tattvenaitadvimRRishyatAm
shlokas.26:
etadrAj~no vachaH shrutvA viprAste bharatarShabha |
niyatA vAgyatAshchaiva pAvakaM sharaNaM yayuH
shlokas.27:
tAndarshayAmAsa tadA bhagavAnhavyavAhanaH |
svaM rUpaM dIptimatkRRitvA sharadarkasamadyutiH
shlokas.28:
tato mahAtmA tAnAha dahano brAhmaNarShabhAn |
varayAmyAtmano.arthAya duryodhanasutAmiti
shlokas.29:
tataste kAlyamutthAya tasmai rAj~ne nyavedayan |
brAhmaNA vismitAH sarve yaduktaM chitrabhAnunA
shlokas.30:
tataH sa rAjA tachChrutvA vachanaM brahmavAdinAm |
avApya paramaM harShaM tatheti prAha buddhimAn
shlokas.31:
prAyAchata nRRipaH shulkaM bhagavantaM vibhAvasum |
nityaM sAMnidhyamiha te chitrabhAno bhavediti
tamAha bhagavAnagnirevamastviti pArthivam
shlokas.32:
tataH sAMnidhyamadhyApi mAhiShmatyAM vibhAvasoH |
dRRiShTaM hi sahadevena disho vijayatA tadA
shlokas.33:
tatastAM samala~NkRRitya kanyAmahatavAsasam |
dadau duryodhano rAjA pAvakAya mahAtmane
shlokas.34:
pratijagrAha chAgnistAM rAjaputrIM sudarshanAm |
vidhinA vedadRRiShTena vasordhArAmivAdhvare
shlokas.35:
tasyA rUpeNa shIlena kulena vapuShA shriyA |
abhavatprItimAnagnirgarbhaM tasyAM samAdadhe
shlokas.36:
tasyAM samabhavatputro nAmnAgneyaH sudarshanaH |
shishurevAdhyagAtsarvaM sa cha brahma sanAtanam
shlokas.37:
athaughavAnnAma nRRipo nRRigasyAsItpitAmahaH |
tasyApyoghavatI kanyA putrashchaugharatho.abhavat
shlokas.38:
tAmoghavAndadau tasmai svayamoghavatIM sutAm |
sudarshanAya viduShe bhAryArthe devarUpiNIm
shlokas.39:
sa gRRihasthAshramaratastayA saha sudarshanaH |
kurukShetre.avasadrAjannoghavatyA samanvitaH
shlokas.40:
gRRihasthashchAvajeShyAmi mRRityumityeva sa prabho |
pratij~nAmakaroddhImAndIptatejA vishAM pate
shlokas.41:
tAmathaughavatIM rAjansa pAvakasuto.abravIt |
atitheH pratikUlaM te na kartavyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.42:
yena yena cha tuShyeta nityameva tvayAtithiH |
apyAtmanaH pradAnena na te kAryA vichAraNA
shlokas.43:
etadvrataM mama sadA hRRidi samparivartate |
gRRihasthAnAM hi sushroNi nAtithervidyate param
shlokas.44:
pramANaM yadi vAmoru vachaste mama shobhane |
idaM vachanamavyagrA hRRidi tvaM dhArayeH sadA
shlokas.45:
niShkrAnte mayi kalyANi tathA saMnihite.anaghe |
nAtithiste.avamantavyaH pramANaM yadyahaM tava
shlokas.46:
tamabravIdoghavatI yatA mUrdhni kRRitA~njaliH |
na me tvadvachanAtki~nchidakartavyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.47:
jigIShamANaM tu gRRihe tadA mRRityuH sudarshanam |
pRRiShThato.anvagamadrAjanrandhrAnveShI tadA sadA
shlokas.48:
idhmArthaM tu gate tasminnagniputre sudarshane |
atithirbrAhmaNaH shrImA.nstAmAhaughavatIM tadA
shlokas.49:
AtithyaM dattamichChAmi tvayAdya varavarNini |
pramANaM yadi dharmaste gRRihasthAshramasaMmataH
shlokas.50:
ityuktA tena vipreNa rAjaputrI yashasvinI |
vidhinA pratijagrAha vedoktena vishAM pate
shlokas.51:
AsanaM chaiva pAdyaM cha tasmai dattvA dvijAtaye |
provAchaughavatI vipraM kenArthaH kiM dadAmi te
shlokas.52:
tAmabravIttato vipro rAjaputrIM sudarshanAm |
tvayA mamArthaH kalyANi nirvisha~Nke tadAchara
shlokas.53:
yadi pramANaM dharmaste gRRihasthAshramasaMmataH |
pradAnenAtmano rAj~ni kartumarhasi me priyam
shlokas.54:
tathA sa~nChandyamAno.anyairIpsitairnRRipakanyayA |
nAnyamAtmapradAnAtsa tasyA vavre varaM dvijaH
shlokas.55:
sA tu rAjasutA smRRitvA bharturvachanamAditaH |
tatheti lajjamAnA sA tamuvAcha dvijarShabham
shlokas.56:
tato rahaH sa viprarShiH sA chaivopavivesha ha |
sa.nsmRRitya bharturvachanaM gRRihasthAshramakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.57:
athedhmAnsamupAdAya sa pAvakirupAgamat |
mRRityunA raudrabhAvena nityaM bandhurivAnvitaH
shlokas.58:
tatastvAshramamAgamya sa pAvakasutastadA |
tAmAjuhAvaughavatIM kvAsi yAteti chAsakRRit
shlokas.59:
tasmai prativachaH sA tu bhartre na pradadau tadA |
karAbhyAM tena vipreNa spRRiShTA bhartRRivratA satI
shlokas.60:
uchChiShTAsmIti manvAnA lajjitA bhartureva cha |
tUShNImbhUtAbhavatsAdhvI na chovAchAtha ki~nchana
shlokas.61:
atha tAM punarevedaM provAcha sa sudarshanaH |
kva sA sAdhvI kva sA yAtA garIyaH kimato mama
shlokas.62:
pativratA satyashIlA nityaM chaivArjave ratA |
kathaM na pratyudetyadya smayamAnA yathA purA
shlokas.63:
uTajasthastu taM vipraH pratyuvAcha sudarshanam |
atithiM viddhi samprAptaM pAvake brAhmaNaM cha mAm
shlokas.64:
anayA ChandyamAno.ahaM bhAryayA tava sattama |
taistairatithisatkArairArjave.asyA dRRiDhaM manaH
shlokas.65:
anena vidhinA seyaM mAmarchati shubhAnanA |
anurUpaM yadatrAdya tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.66:
kUTamudgarahastastu mRRityustaM vai samanvayAt |
hInapratij~namatrainaM vadhiShyAmIti chintayan
shlokas.67:
sudarshanastu manasA karmaNA chakShuShA girA |
tyakterShyastyaktamanyushcha smayamAno.abravIdidam
shlokas.68:
surataM te.astu viprAgrya prItirhi paramA mama |
gRRihasthasya hi dharmo.agryaH samprAptAtithipUjanam
shlokas.69:
atithiH pUjito yasya gRRihasthasya tu gachChati |
nAnyastasmAtparo dharma iti prAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.70:
prANA hi mama dArAshcha yachchAnyadvidyate vasu |
atithibhyo mayA deyamiti me vratamAhitam
shlokas.71:
niHsa.ndigdhaM mayA vAkyametatte samudAhRRitam |
tenAhaM vipra satyena svayamAtmAnamAlabhe
shlokas.72:
pRRithivI vAyurAkAshamApo jyotishcha pa~nchamam |
buddhirAtmA manaH kAlo dishashchaiva guNA dasha
shlokas.73:
nityamete hi pashyanti dehinAM dehasa.nshritAH |
sukRRitaM duShkRRitaM chApi karma dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.74:
yathaiShA nAnRRitA vANI mayAdya samudAhRRitA |
tena satyena mAM devAH pAlayantu dahantu vA
shlokas.75:
tato nAdaH samabhavaddikShu sarvAsu bhArata |
asakRRitsatyamityeva naitanmithyeti sarvashaH
shlokas.76:
uTajAttu tatastasmAnnishchakrAma sa vai dvijaH |
vapuShA khaM cha bhUmiM cha vyApya vAyurivodyataH
shlokas.77:
svareNa vipraH shaikSheNa trI.NllokAnanunAdayan |
uvAcha chainaM dharmaj~naM pUrvamAmantrya nAmataH
shlokas.78:
dharmo.ahamasmi bhadraM te jij~nAsArthaM tavAnagha |
prAptaH satyaM cha te j~nAtvA prItirme paramA tvayi
shlokas.79:
vijitashcha tvayA mRRityuryo.ayaM tvAmanugachChati |
randhrAnveShI tava sadA tvayA dhRRityA vashIkRRitaH
shlokas.80:
na chAsti shaktistrailokye kasyachitpuruShottama |
pativratAmimAM sAdhvIM tavodvIkShitumapyuta
shlokas.81:
rakShitA tvadguNaireShA pativrataguNaistathA |
adhRRiShyA yadiyaM brUyAttathA tannAnyathA bhavet
shlokas.82:
eShA hi tapasA svena sa.nyuktA brahmavAdinI |
pAvanArthaM cha lokasya sarichChreShThA bhaviShyati
shlokas.83:
ardhenaughavatI nAma tvAmardhenAnuyAsyati |
sharIreNa mahAbhAgA yogo hyasyA vashe sthitaH
shlokas.84:
anayA saha lokA.nshcha gantAsi tapasArjitAn |
yatra nAvRRittimabhyeti shAshvatA.nstAnsanAtanAn
shlokas.85:
anena chaiva dehena lokA.nstvamabhipatsyase |
nirjitashcha tvayA mRRityuraishvaryaM cha tavottamam
shlokas.86:
pa~ncha bhUtAnyatikrAntaH svavIryAchcha manobhavaH |
gRRihasthadharmeNAnena kAmakrodhau cha te jitau
shlokas.87:
sneho rAgashcha tandrI cha moho drohashcha kevalaH |
tava shushrUShayA rAjanrAjaputryA vinirjitAH
shlokas.88:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shuklAnAM tu sahasreNa vAjinAM rathamuttamam |
yuktaM pragRRihya bhagavAnvyavasAyo jagAma tam
shlokas.89:
mRRityurAtmA cha lokAshcha jitA bhUtAni pa~ncha cha |
buddhiH kAlo mano vyoma kAmakrodhau tathaiva cha
shlokas.90:
tasmAdgRRihAshramasthasya nAnyaddaivatamasti vai |
RRite.atithiM naravyAghra manasaitadvichAraya
shlokas.91:
atithiH pUjito yasya dhyAyate manasA shubham |
na tatkratushatenApi tulyamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.92:
pAtraM tvatithimAsAdya shIlADhyaM yo na pUjayet |
sa dattvA sukRRitaM tasya kShapayeta hyanarchitaH
shlokas.93:
etatte kathitaM putra mayAkhyAnamanuttamam |
yathA hi vijito mRRityurgRRihasthena purAbhavat
shlokas.95:
ya idaM kathayedvidvAnahanyahani bhArata |
sudarshanasya charitaM puNyA.NllokAnavApnuyAt

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
brAhmaNyaM yadi duShprApaM tribhirvarNairnarAdhipa |
kathaM prAptaM mahArAja kShatriyeNa mahAtmanA
shlokas.2:
vishvAmitreNa dharmAtmanbrAhmaNatvaM nararShabha |
shrotumichChAmi tattvena tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
tena hyamitavIryeNa vasiShThasya mahAtmanaH |
hataM putrashataM sadyastapasA prapitAmaha
shlokas.4:
yAtudhAnAshcha bahavo rAkShasAstigmatejasaH |
manyunAviShTadehena sRRiShTAH kAlAntakopamAH
shlokas.5:
mahAnkushikava.nshashcha brahmarShishatasa~NkulaH |
sthApito naraloke.asminvidvAnbrAhmaNasa.nstutaH
shlokas.6:
RRichIkasyAtmajashchaiva shunaHshepo mahAtapAH |
vimokShito mahAsatrAtpashutAmabhyupAgataH
shlokas.7:
harishchandrakratau devA.nstoShayitvAtmatejasA |
putratAmanusamprApto vishvAmitrasya dhImataH
shlokas.8:
nAbhivAdayate jyeShThaM devarAtaM narAdhipa |
putrAH pa~nchashatAshchApi shaptAH shvapachatAM gatAH
shlokas.9:
trisha~Nkurbandhusantyakta ikShvAkuH prItipUrvakam |
avAkShirA divaM nIto dakShiNAmAshrito disham
shlokas.10:
vishvAmitrasya vipulA nadI rAjarShisevitA |
kaushikIti shivA puNyA brahmarShigaNasevitA
shlokas.11:
tapovighnakarI chaiva pa~nchachUDA susaMmatA |
rambhA nAmApsarAH shApAdyasya shailatvamAgatA
shlokas.12:
tathaivAsya bhayAdbaddhvA vasiShThaH salile purA |
AtmAnaM majjayAmAsa vipAshaH punarutthitaH
shlokas.13:
tadAprabhRRiti puNyA hi vipAshAbhUnmahAnadI |
vikhyAtA karmaNA tena vasiShThasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.14:
vAgbhishcha bhagavAnyena devasenAgragaH prabhuH |
stutaH prItamanAshchAsIchChApAchchainamamochayat
shlokas.15:
dhruvasyauttAnapAdasya brahmarShINAM tathaiva cha |
madhye jvalati yo nityamudIchImAshrito disham
shlokas.16:
tasyaitAni cha karmANi tathAnyAni cha kaurava |
kShatriyasyetyato jAtamidaM kautUhalaM mama
shlokas.17:
kimetaditi tattvena prabrUhi bharatarShabha |
dehAntaramanAsAdya kathaM sa brAhmaNo.abhavat
shlokas.18:
etattattvena me rAjansarvamAkhyAtumarhasi |
mata~Ngasya yathAtattvaM tathaivaitadbravIhi me
shlokas.19:
sthAne mata~Ngo brAhmaNyaM nAlabhadbharatarShabha |
chaNDAlayonau jAto hi kathaM brAhmaNyamApnuyAt

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shrUyatAM pArtha tattvena vishvAmitro yathA purA |
brAhmaNatvaM gatastAta brahmarShitvaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.2:
bharatasyAnvaye chaivAjamIDho nAma pArthivaH |
babhUva bharatashreShTha yajvA dharmabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.3:
tasya putro mahAnAsIjjahnurnAma nareshvaraH |
duhitRRitvamanuprAptA ga~NgA yasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.4:
tasyAtmajastulyaguNaH sindhudvIpo mahAyashAH |
sindhudvIpAchcha rAjarShirbalAkAshvo mahAbalaH
shlokas.5:
vallabhastasya tanayaH sAkShAddharma ivAparaH |
kushikastasya tanayaH sahasrAkShasamadyutiH
shlokas.6:
kushikasyAtmajaH shrImAngAdhirnAma janeshvaraH |
aputraH sa mahAbAhurvanavAsamudAvasat
shlokas.7:
kanyA jaj~ne sutA tasya vane nivasataH sataH |
nAmnA satyavatI nAma rUpeNApratimA bhuvi
shlokas.8:
tAM vavre bhArgavaH shrImA.nshchyavanasyAtmajaH prabhuH |
RRichIka iti vikhyAto vipule tapasi sthitaH
shlokas.9:
sa tAM na pradadau tasmai RRichIkAya mahAtmane |
daridra iti matvA vai gAdhiH shatrunibarhaNaH
shlokas.10:
pratyAkhyAya punaryAntamabravIdrAjasattamaH |
shulkaM pradIyatAM mahyaM tato vetsyasi me sutAm
shlokas.11:
RRichIka uvAcha||
kiM prayachChAmi rAjendra tubhyaM shulkamahaM nRRipa |
duhiturbrUhyasa.nsakto mAtrAbhUtte vichAraNA
shlokas.12:
gAdhiruvAcha||
chandrarashmiprakAshAnAM hayAnAM vAtaraMhasAm |
ekataH shyAmakarNAnAM sahasraM dehi bhArgava
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH sa bhRRigushArdUlashchyavanasyAtmajaH prabhuH |
abravIdvaruNaM devamAdityaM patimambhasAm
shlokas.14:
ekataH shyAmakarNAnAM hayAnAM chandravarchasAm |
sahasraM vAtavegAnAM bhikShe tvAM devasattama
shlokas.15:
tatheti varuNo deva Adityo bhRRigusattamam |
uvAcha yatra te ChandastatrotthAsyanti vAjinaH
shlokas.16:
dhyAtamAtre RRichIkena hayAnAM chandravarchasAm |
ga~NgAjalAtsamuttasthau sahasraM vipulaujasAm
shlokas.17:
adUre kanyakubjasya ga~NgAyAstIramuttamam |
ashvatIrthaM tadadyApi mAnavAH parichakShate
shlokas.18:
tattadA gAdhaye tAta sahasraM vAjinAM shubham |
RRichIkaH pradadau prItaH shulkArthaM japatAM varaH
shlokas.19:
tataH sa vismito rAjA gAdhiH shApabhayena cha |
dadau tAM samala~NkRRitya kanyAM bhRRigusutAya vai
shlokas.20:
jagrAha pANiM vidhinA tasya brahmarShisattamaH |
sA cha taM patimAsAdya paraM harShamavApa ha
shlokas.21:
sa tutoSha cha viprarShistasyA vRRittena bhArata |
ChandayAmAsa chaivainAM vareNa varavarNinIm
shlokas.22:
mAtre tatsarvamAchakhyau sA kanyA rAjasattamam |
atha tAmabravInmAtA sutAM ki~nchidavA~NmukhIm
shlokas.23:
mamApi putri bhartA te prasAdaM kartumarhati |
apatyasya pradAnena samarthaH sa mahAtapAH
shlokas.24:
tataH sA tvaritaM gatvA tatsarvaM pratyavedayat |
mAtushchikIrShitaM rAjannRRichIkastAmathAbravIt
shlokas.25:
guNavantamapatyaM vai tvaM cha sA janayiShyathaH |
jananyAstava kalyANi mA bhUdvai praNayo.anyathA
shlokas.26:
tava chaiva guNashlAghI putra utpatsyate shubhe |
asmadva.nshakaraH shrImA.nstava bhrAtA cha va.nshakRRit
shlokas.27:
RRitusnAtA cha sAshvatthaM tvaM cha vRRikShamudumbaram |
pariShvajethAH kalyANi tata iShTamavApsyathaH
shlokas.28:
charudvayamidaM chaiva mantrapUtaM shuchismite |
tvaM cha sA chopayu~njIthAM tataH putrAvavApsyathaH
shlokas.29:
tataH satyavatI hRRiShTA mAtaraM pratyabhAShata |
yadRRichIkena kathitaM tachchAchakhyau charudvayam
shlokas.30:
tAmuvAcha tato mAtA sutAM satyavatIM tadA |
putri mUrdhnA prapannAyAH kuruShva vachanaM mama
shlokas.31:
bhartrA ya eSha dattaste charurmantrapuraskRRitaH |
etaM prayachCha mahyaM tvaM madIyaM tvaM gRRihANa cha
shlokas.32:
vyatyAsaM vRRikShayoshchApi karavAva shuchismite |
yadi pramANaM vachanaM mama mAturanindite
shlokas.33:
vyaktaM bhagavatA chAtra kRRitamevaM bhaviShyati |
tato me tvachcharau bhAvaH pAdape cha sumadhyame
kathaM vishiShTo bhrAtA te bhavedityeva chintaya
shlokas.34:
tathA cha kRRitavatyau te mAtA satyavatI cha sA |
atha garbhAvanuprApte ubhe te vai yudhiShThira
shlokas.35:
dRRiShTvA garbhamanuprAptAM bhAryAM sa cha mahAnRRiShiH |
uvAcha tAM satyavatIM durmanA bhRRigusattamaH
shlokas.36:
vyatyAsenopayuktaste charurvyaktaM bhaviShyati |
vyatyAsaH pAdape chApi suvyaktaM te kRRitaH shubhe
shlokas.37:
mayA hi vishvaM yadbrahma tvachcharau saMniveshitam |
kShatravIryaM cha sakalaM charau tasyA niveshitam
shlokas.38:
trilokavikhyAtaguNaM tvaM vipraM janayiShyasi |
sA cha kShatraM vishiShTaM vai tata etatkRRitaM mayA
shlokas.39:
vyatyAsastu kRRito yasmAttvayA mAtrA tathaiva cha |
tasmAtsA brAhmaNashreShThaM mAtA te janayiShyati
shlokas.40:
kShatriyaM tUgrakarmANaM tvaM bhadre janayiShyasi |
na hi te tatkRRitaM sAdhu mAtRRisnehena bhAmini
shlokas.41:
sA shrutvA shokasantaptA papAta varavarNinI |
bhUmau satyavatI rAja.nshChinneva ruchirA latA
shlokas.42:
pratilabhya cha sA sa~nj~nAM shirasA praNipatya cha |
uvAcha bhAryA bhartAraM gAdheyI brAhmaNarShabham
shlokas.43:
prasAdayantyAM bhAryAyAM mayi brahmavidAM vara |
prasAdaM kuru viprarShe na me syAtkShatriyaH sutaH
shlokas.44:
kAmaM mamograkarmA vai pautro bhavitumarhati |
na tu me syAtsuto brahmanneSha me dIyatAM varaH
shlokas.45:
evamastviti hovAcha svAM bhAryAM sumahAtapAH |
tataH sA janayAmAsa jamadagniM sutaM shubham
shlokas.46:
vishvAmitraM chAjanayadgAdherbhAryA yashasvinI |
RRiSheH prabhAvAdrAjendra brahmarShiM brahmavAdinam
shlokas.47:
tato brAhmaNatAM yAto vishvAmitro mahAtapAH |
kShatriyaH so.apyatha tathA brahmava.nshasya kArakaH
shlokas.48:
tasya putrA mahAtmAno brahmava.nshavivardhanAH |
tapasvino brahmavido gotrakartAra eva cha
shlokas.49:
madhuchChandashcha bhagavAndevarAtashcha vIryavAn |
akShINashcha shakuntashcha babhruH kAlapathastathA
shlokas.50:
yAj~navalkyashcha vikhyAtastathA sthUNo mahAvrataH |
ulUko yamadUtashcha tatharShiH saindhavAyanaH
shlokas.51:
karNaja~Nghashcha bhagavAngAlavashcha mahAnRRiShiH |
RRiShirvajrastathAkhyAtaH shAla~NkAyana eva cha
shlokas.52:
lAlATyo nAradashchaiva tathA kUrchamukhaH smRRitaH |
vAdulirmusalashchaiva rakShogrIvastathaiva cha
shlokas.53:
a~Nghriko naikabhRRichchaiva shilAyUpaH sitaH shuchiH |
chakrako mArutantavyo vAtaghno.athAshvalAyanaH
shlokas.54:
shyAmAyano.atha gArgyashcha jAbAliH sushrutastathA |
kArIShiratha sa.nshrutyaH parapauravatantavaH
shlokas.55:
mahAnRRiShishcha kapilastatharShistArakAyanaH |
tathaiva chopagahanastatharShishchArjunAyanaH
shlokas.56:
mArgamitrirhiraNyAkSho ja~NghArirbabhruvAhanaH |
sUtirvibhUtiH sUtashcha sura~Ngashcha tathaiva hi
shlokas.57:
ArAddhirnAmayashchaiva chAmpeyojjayanau tathA |
navatanturbakanakhaH shayonaratireva cha
shlokas.58:
shayoruhashchArumatsyaH shirIShI chAtha gArdabhiH |
ujjayoniradApekShI nAradI cha mahAnRRiShiH
vishvAmitrAtmajAH sarve munayo brahmavAdinaH
shlokas.59:
tannaiSha kShatriyo rAjanvishvAmitro mahAtapAH |
RRichIkenAhitaM brahma parametadyudhiShThira
shlokas.60:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM tattvena bharatarShabha |
vishvAmitrasya vai janma somasUryAgnitejasaH
shlokas.61:
yatra yatra cha sa.ndeho bhUyaste rAjasattama |
tatra tatra cha mAM brUhi chChettAsmi tava sa.nshayAn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AnRRisha.nsasya dharmasya guNAnbhaktajanasya cha |
shrotumichChAmi kArtsnyena tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
viShaye kAshirAjasya grAmAnniShkramya lubdhakaH |
saviShaM kANDamAdAya mRRigayAmAsa vai mRRigam
shlokas.3:
tatra chAmiShalubdhena lubdhakena mahAvane |
avidUre mRRigaM dRRiShTvA bANaH pratisamAhitaH
shlokas.4:
tena durvAritAstreNa nimittachapaleShuNA |
mahAnvanatarurviddho mRRigaM tatra jighA.nsatA
shlokas.5:
sa tIkShNaviShadigdhena shareNAtibalAtkRRitaH |
utsRRijya phalapatrANi pAdapaH shoShamAgataH
shlokas.6:
tasminvRRikShe tathAbhUte koTareShu chiroShitaH |
na jahAti shuko vAsaM tasya bhaktyA vanaspateH
shlokas.7:
niShprachAro nirAhAro glAnaH shithilavAgapi |
kRRitaj~naH saha vRRikSheNa dharmAtmA sa vyashuShyata
shlokas.8:
tamudAraM mahAsattvamatimAnuShacheShTitam |
samaduHkhasukhaM j~nAtvA vismitaH pAkashAsanaH
shlokas.9:
tatashchintAmupagataH shakraH kathamayaM dvijaH |
tiryagyonAvasambhAvyamAnRRisha.nsyaM samAsthitaH
shlokas.10:
atha vA nAtra chitraM hItyabhavadvAsavasya tu |
prANinAmiha sarveShAM sarvaM sarvatra dRRishyate
shlokas.11:
tato brAhmaNaveSheNa mAnuShaM rUpamAsthitaH |
avatIrya mahIM shakrastaM pakShiNamuvAcha ha
shlokas.12:
shuka bhoH pakShiNAM shreShTha dAkSheyI suprajAstvayA |
pRRichChe tvA shuShkametaM vai kasmAnna tyajasi drumam
shlokas.13:
atha pRRiShTaH shukaH prAha mUrdhnA samabhivAdya tam |
svAgataM devarAjAya vij~nAtastapasA mayA
shlokas.14:
tato dashashatAkSheNa sAdhu sAdhviti bhAShitam |
aho vij~nAnamityevaM tapasA pUjitastataH
shlokas.15:
tamevaM shubhakarmANaM shukaM paramadhArmikam |
vijAnannapi tAM prAptiM paprachCha balasUdanaH
shlokas.16:
niShpatramaphalaM shuShkamasharaNyaM patatriNAm |
kimarthaM sevase vRRikShaM yadA mahadidaM vanam
shlokas.17:
anye.api bahavo vRRikShAH patrasa~nChannakoTarAH |
shubhAH paryAptasa~nchArA vidyante.asminmahAvane
shlokas.18:
gatAyuShamasAmarthyaM kShINasAraM hatashriyam |
vimRRishya praj~nayA dhIra jahImaM hyasthiraM drumam
shlokas.19:
tadupashrutya dharmAtmA shukaH shakreNa bhAShitam |
sudIrghamabhiniHshvasya dIno vAkyamuvAcha ha
shlokas.20:
anatikramaNIyAni daivatAni shachIpate |
yatrAbhavastatra bhavastannibodha surAdhipa
shlokas.21:
asminnahaM drume jAtaH sAdhubhishcha guNairyutaH |
bAlabhAve cha sa~NguptaH shatrubhishcha na dharShitaH
shlokas.22:
kimanukroshavaiphalyamutpAdayasi me.anagha |
AnRRisha.nsye.anuraktasya bhaktasyAnugatasya cha
shlokas.23:
anukrosho hi sAdhUnAM sumahaddharmalakShaNam |
anukroshashcha sAdhUnAM sadA prItiM prayachChati
shlokas.24:
tvameva daivataiH sarvaiH pRRichChyase dharmasa.nshayAn |
atastvaM deva devAnAmAdhipatye pratiShThitaH
shlokas.25:
nArhasi tvaM sahasrAkSha tyAjayitveha bhaktitaH |
samarthamupajIvyemaM tyajeyaM kathamadya vai
shlokas.26:
tasya vAkyena saumyena harShitaH pAkashAsanaH |
shukaM provAcha dharmaj~namAnRRisha.nsyena toShitaH
shlokas.27:
varaM vRRiNIShveti tadA sa cha vavre varaM shukaH |
AnRRisha.nsyaparo nityaM tasya vRRikShasya sambhavam
shlokas.28:
viditvA cha dRRiDhAM shakrastAM shuke shIlasampadam |
prItaH kShipramatho vRRikShamamRRitenAvasiktavAn
shlokas.29:
tataH phalAni patrANi shAkhAshchApi manoramAH |
shukasya dRRiDhabhaktitvAchChrImattvaM chApa sa drumaH
shlokas.30:
shukashcha karmaNA tena AnRRisha.nsyakRRitena ha |
AyuSho.ante mahArAja prApa shakrasalokatAm
shlokas.31:
evameva manuShyendra bhaktimantaM samAshritaH |
sarvArthasiddhiM labhate shukaM prApya yathA drumaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmaha mahAprAj~na sarvashAstravishArada |
daive puruShakAre cha kiM svichChreShThataraM bhavet
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
vasiShThasya cha sa.nvAdaM brahmaNashcha yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
daivamAnuShayoH kiM svitkarmaNoH shreShThamityuta |
purA vasiShTho bhagavAnpitAmahamapRRichChata
shlokas.4:
tataH padmodbhavo rAjandevadevaH pitAmahaH |
uvAcha madhuraM vAkyamarthavaddhetubhUShitam
shlokas.5:
nAbIjaM jAyate ki~nchinna bIjena vinA phalam |
bIjAdbIjaM prabhavati bIjAdeva phalaM smRRitam
shlokas.6:
yAdRRishaM vapate bIjaM kShetramAsAdya karShakaH |
sukRRite duShkRRite vApi tAdRRishaM labhate phalam
shlokas.7:
yathA bIjaM vinA kShetramuptaM bhavati niShphalam |
tathA puruShakAreNa vinA daivaM na sidhyati
shlokas.8:
kShetraM puruShakArastu daivaM bIjamudAhRRitam |
kShetrabIjasamAyogAttataH sasyaM samRRidhyate
shlokas.9:
karmaNaH phalanirvRRittiM svayamashnAti kArakaH |
pratyakShaM dRRishyate loke kRRitasyApyakRRitasya cha
shlokas.10:
shubhena karmaNA saukhyaM duHkhaM pApena karmaNA |
kRRitaM sarvatra labhate nAkRRitaM bhujyate kvachit
shlokas.11:
kRRitI sarvatra labhate pratiShThAM bhAgyavikShataH |
akRRitI labhate bhraShTaH kShate kShArAvasechanam
shlokas.12:
tapasA rUpasaubhAgyaM ratnAni vividhAni cha |
prApyate karmaNA sarvaM na daivAdakRRitAtmanA
shlokas.13:
tathA svargashcha bhogashcha niShThA yA cha manIShitA |
sarvaM puruShakAreNa kRRitenehopapadyate
shlokas.14:
jyotIMShi tridashA nAgA yakShAshchandrArkamArutAH |
sarve puruShakAreNa mAnuShyAddevatAM gatAH
shlokas.15:
artho vA mitravargo vA aishvaryaM vA kulAnvitam |
shrIshchApi durlabhA bhoktuM tathaivAkRRitakarmabhiH
shlokas.16:
shauchena labhate vipraH kShatriyo vikrameNa cha |
vaishyaH puruShakAreNa shUdraH shushrUShayA shriyam
shlokas.17:
nAdAtAraM bhajantyarthA na klIbaM nApi niShkriyam |
nAkarmashIlaM nAshUraM tathA naivAtapasvinam
shlokas.18:
yena lokAstrayaH sRRiShTA daityAH sarvAshcha devatAH |
sa eSha bhagavAnviShNuH samudre tapyate tapaH
shlokas.19:
svaM chetkarmaphalaM na syAtsarvamevAphalaM bhavet |
loko daivaM samAlambya udAsIno bhavenna tu
shlokas.20:
akRRitvA mAnuShaM karma yo daivamanuvartate |
vRRithA shrAmyati samprApya patiM klIbamivA~NganA
shlokas.21:
na tathA mAnuShe loke bhayamasti shubhAshubhe |
yathA tridashaloke hi bhayamalpena jAyate
shlokas.22:
kRRitaH puruShakArastu daivamevAnuvartate |
na daivamakRRite ki~nchitkasyachiddAtumarhati
shlokas.23:
yadA sthAnAnyanityAni dRRishyante daivateShvapi |
kathaM karma vinA daivaM sthAsyate sthApayiShyati
shlokas.24:
na daivatAni loke.asminvyApAraM yAnti kasyachit |
vyAsa~NgaM janayantyugramAtmAbhibhavasha~NkayA
shlokas.25:
RRiShINAM devatAnAM cha sadA bhavati vigrahaH |
kasya vAchA hyadaivaM syAdyato daivaM pravartate
shlokas.26:
kathaM chAsya samutpattiryathA daivaM pravartate |
evaM tridashaloke.api prApyante bahavashChalAH
shlokas.27:
Atmaiva hyAtmano bandhurAtmaiva ripurAtmanaH |
Atmaiva chAtmanaH sAkShI kRRitasyApyakRRitasya cha
shlokas.28:
kRRitaM cha vikRRitaM ki~nchitkRRite karmaNi sidhyati |
sukRRite duShkRRitaM karma na yathArthaM prapadyate
shlokas.29:
devAnAM sharaNaM puNyaM sarvaM puNyairavApyate |
puNyashIlaM naraM prApya kiM daivaM prakariShyati
shlokas.30:
purA yayAtirvibhraShTashchyAvitaH patitaH kShitau |
punarAropitaH svargaM dauhitraiH puNyakarmabhiH
shlokas.31:
purUravAshcha rAjarShirdvijairabhihitaH purA |
aila ityabhivikhyAtaH svargaM prApto mahIpatiH
shlokas.32:
ashvamedhAdibhiryaj~naiH satkRRitaH kosalAdhipaH |
maharShishApAtsaudAsaH puruShAdatvamAgataH
shlokas.33:
ashvatthAmA cha rAmashcha muniputrau dhanurdharau |
na gachChataH svargalokaM sukRRiteneha karmaNA
shlokas.34:
vasuryaj~nashatairiShTvA dvitIya iva vAsavaH |
mithyAbhidhAnenaikena rasAtalatalaM gataH
shlokas.35:
balirvairochanirbaddho dharmapAshena daivataiH |
viShNoH puruShakAreNa pAtAlashayanaH kRRitaH
shlokas.36:
shakrasyodasya charaNaM prasthito janamejayaH |
dvijastrINAM vadhaM kRRitvA kiM daivena na vAritaH
shlokas.37:
aj~nAnAdbrAhmaNaM hatvA spRRiShTo bAlavadhena cha |
vaishampAyanaviprarShiH kiM daivena nivAritaH
shlokas.38:
gopradAnena mithyA cha brAhmaNebhyo mahAmakhe |
purA nRRigashcha rAjarShiH kRRikalAsatvamAgataH
shlokas.39:
dhundhumArashcha rAjarShiH satreShveva jarAM gataH |
prItidAyaM parityajya suShvApa sa girivraje
shlokas.40:
pANDavAnAM hRRitaM rAjyaM dhArtarAShTrairmahAbalaiH |
punaH pratyAhRRitaM chaiva na daivAdbhujasa.nshrayAt
shlokas.41:
taponiyamasa.nyuktA munayaH sa.nshitavratAH |
kiM te daivabalAchChApamutsRRijante na karmaNA
shlokas.42:
pApamutsRRijate loke sarvaM prApya sudurlabham |
lobhamohasamApannaM na daivaM trAyate naram
shlokas.43:
yathAgniH pavanoddhUtaH sUkShmo.api bhavate mahAn |
tathA karmasamAyuktaM daivaM sAdhu vivardhate
shlokas.44:
yathA tailakShayAddIpaH pramlAnimupagachChati |
tathA karmakShayAddaivaM pramlAnimupagachChati
shlokas.45:
vipulamapi dhanaughaM prApya bhogAnstriyo vA; puruSha iha na shaktaH karmahIno.api bhoktum |
sunihitamapi chArthaM daivatai rakShyamANaM; vyayaguNamapi sAdhuM karmaNA sa.nshrayante
shlokas.46:
bhavati manujalokAddevaloko vishiShTo; bahutarasusamRRiddhyA mAnuShANAM gRRihANi |
pitRRivanabhavanAbhaM dRRishyate chAmarANAM; na cha phalati vikarmA jIvalokena daivam
shlokas.47:
vyapanayati vimArgaM nAsti daive prabhutvaM; gurumiva kRRitamagryaM karma sa.nyAti daivam |
anupahatamadInaM kAmakAreNa daivaM; nayati puruShakAraH sa~nchitastatra tatra
shlokas.48:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM mayA vai munisattama |
phalaM puruShakArasya sadA sa.ndRRishya tattvataH
shlokas.49:
abhyutthAnena daivasya samArabdhena karmaNA |
vidhinA karmaNA chaiva svargamArgamavApnuyAt

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
karmaNAM me samastAnAM shubhAnAM bharatarShabha |
phalAni mahatAM shreShTha prabrUhi paripRRichChataH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rahasyaM yadRRiShINAM tu tachChRRiNuShva yudhiShThira |
yA gatiH prApyate yena pretyabhAve chirepsitA
shlokas.3:
yena yena sharIreNa yadyatkarma karoti yaH |
tena tena sharIreNa tattatphalamupAshnute
shlokas.4:
yasyAM yasyAmavasthAyAM yatkaroti shubhAshubham |
tasyAM tasyAmavasthAyAM bhu~Nkte janmani janmani
shlokas.5:
na nashyati kRRitaM karma sadA pa~nchendriyairiha |
te hyasya sAkShiNo nityaM ShaShTha AtmA tathaiva cha
shlokas.6:
chakShurdadyAnmano dadyAdvAchaM dadyAchcha sUnRRitAm |
anuvrajedupAsIta sa yaj~naH pa~nchadakShiNaH
shlokas.7:
yo dadyAdaparikliShTamannamadhvani vartate |
shrAntAyAdRRiShTapUrvAya tasya puNyaphalaM mahat
shlokas.8:
sthaNDile shayamAnAnAM gRRihANi shayanAni cha |
chIravalkalasa.nvIte vAsA.nsyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.9:
vAhanAsanayAnAni yogAtmani tapodhane |
agnInupashayAnasya rAjapauruShamuchyate
shlokas.10:
rasAnAM pratisaMhAre saubhAgyamanugachChati |
AmiShapratisaMhAre pashUnputrA.nshcha vindati
shlokas.11:
avAkShirAstu yo lambedudavAsaM cha yo vaset |
satataM chaikashAyI yaH sa labhetepsitAM gatim
shlokas.12:
pAdyamAsanamevAtha dIpamannaM pratishrayam |
dadyAdatithipUjArthaM sa yaj~naH pa~nchadakShiNaH
shlokas.13:
vIrAsanaM vIrashayyAM vIrasthAnamupAsataH |
akShayAstasya vai lokAH sarvakAmagamAstathA
shlokas.14:
dhanaM labheta dAnena maunenAj~nAM vishAM pate |
upabhogA.nshcha tapasA brahmacharyeNa jIvitam
shlokas.15:
rUpamaishvaryamArogyamahi.nsAphalamashnute |
phalamUlAshinAM rAjyaM svargaH parNAshinAM tathA
shlokas.16:
prAyopaveshanAdrAjyaM sarvatra sukhamuchyate |
svargaM satyena labhate dIkShayA kulamuttamam
shlokas.17:
gavADhyaH shAkadIkShAyAM svargagAmI tRRiNAshanaH |
striyastriShavaNaM snAtvA vAyuM pItvA kratuM labhet
shlokas.18:
salilAshI bhavedyashcha sadAgniH sa.nskRRito dvijaH |
maruM sAdhayato rAjyaM nAkapRRiShThamanAshake
shlokas.19:
upavAsaM cha dIkShAM cha abhiShekaM cha pArthiva |
kRRitvA dvAdashavarShANi vIrasthAnAdvishiShyate
shlokas.20:
adhItya sarvavedAnvai sadyo duHkhAtpramuchyate |
mAnasaM hi charandharmaM svargalokamavApnuyAt
shlokas.21:
yA dustyajA durmatibhiryA na jIryati jIryataH |
yo.asau prANAntiko rogastAM tRRiShNAM tyajataH sukham
shlokas.22:
yathA dhenusahasreShu vatso vindati mAtaram |
evaM pUrvakRRitaM karma kartAramanugachChati
shlokas.23:
achodyamAnAni yathA puShpANi cha phalAni cha |
svakAlaM nAtivartante tathA karma purAkRRitam
shlokas.24:
jIryanti jIryataH keshA dantA jIryanti jIryataH |
chakShuHshrotre cha jIryete tRRiShNaikA tu na jIryate
shlokas.25:
yena prINAti pitaraM tena prItaH prajApatiH |
prINAti mAtaraM yena pRRithivI tena pUjitA
yena prINAtyupAdhyAyaM tena syAdbrahma pUjitam
shlokas.26:
sarve tasyAdRRitA dharmA yasyaite traya AdRRitAH |
anAdRRitAstu yasyaite sarvAstasyAphalAH kriyAH
shlokas.27:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhIShmasya tadvachaH shrutvA vismitAH kurupu~NgavAH |
AsanprahRRiShTamanasaH prItimanto.abhava.nstadA
shlokas.28:
yanmantre bhavati vRRithA prayujyamAne; yatsome bhavati vRRithAbhiShUyamANe |
yachchAgnau bhavati vRRithAbhihUyamAne; tatsarvaM bhavati vRRithAbhidhIyamAne
shlokas.29:
ityetadRRiShiNA proktamuktavAnasmi yadvibho |
shubhAshubhaphalaprAptau kimataH shrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ke pUjyAH ke namaskAryAH kAnnamasyasi bhArata |
etanme sarvamAchakShva yeShAM spRRihayase nRRipa
shlokas.2:
uttamApadgatasyApi yatra te vartate manaH |
manuShyaloke sarvasminyadamutreha chApyuta
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
spRRihayAmi dvijAtInAM yeShAM brahma paraM dhanam |
yeShAM svapratyayaH svargastapaHsvAdhyAyasAdhanaH
shlokas.4:
yeShAM vRRiddhAshcha bAlAshcha pitRRipaitAmahIM dhuram |
udvahanti na sIdanti teShAM vai spRRihayAmyaham
shlokas.5:
vidyAsvabhivinItAnAM dAntAnAM mRRidubhAShiNAm |
shrutavRRittopapannAnAM sadAkSharavidAM satAm
shlokas.6:
sa.nsatsu vadatAM yeShAM ha.nsAnAmiva sa~NghashaH |
ma~NgalyarUpA ruchirA divyajImUtaniHsvanAH
shlokas.7:
samyaguchchAritA vAchaH shrUyante hi yudhiShThira |
shushrUShamANe nRRipatau pretya cheha sukhAvahAH
shlokas.8:
ye chApi teShAM shrotAraH sadA sadasi saMmatAH |
vij~nAnaguNasampannAsteShAM cha spRRihayAmyaham
shlokas.9:
susa.nskRRitAni prayatAH shuchIni guNavanti cha |
dadatyannAni tRRiptyarthaM brAhmaNebhyo yudhiShThira
ye chApi satataM rAja.nsteShAM cha spRRihayAmyaham
shlokas.10:
shakyaM hyevAhave yoddhuM na dAtumanasUyitam |
shUrA vIrAshcha shatashaH santi loke yudhiShThira
teShAM sa~NkhyAyamAnAnAM dAnashUro vishiShyate
shlokas.11:
dhanyaH syAM yadyahaM bhUyaH saumya brAhmaNako.api vA |
kule jAto dharmagatistapovidyAparAyaNaH
shlokas.12:
na me tvattaH priyataro loke.asminpANDunandana |
tvattashcha me priyatarA brAhmaNA bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
yathA mama priyatarAstvatto viprAH kurUdvaha |
tena satyena gachCheyaM lokAnyatra sa shantanuH
shlokas.14:
na me pitA priyataro brAhmaNebhyastathAbhavat |
na me pituH pitA vApi ye chAnye.api suhRRijjanAH
shlokas.15:
na hi me vRRijinaM ki~nchidvidyate brAhmaNeShviha |
aNu vA yadi vA sthUlaM viditaM sAdhukarmabhiH
shlokas.16:
karmaNA manasA vApi vAchA vApi parantapa |
yanme kRRitaM brAhmaNeShu tenAdya na tapAmyaham
shlokas.17:
brahmaNya iti mAmAhustayA vAchAsmi toShitaH |
etadeva pavitrebhyaH sarvebhyaH paramaM smRRitam
shlokas.18:
pashyAmi lokAnamalA~nChuchInbrAhmaNayAyinaH |
teShu me tAta gantavyamahnAya cha chirAya cha
shlokas.19:
yathA patyAshrayo dharmaH strINAM loke yudhiShThira |
sa devaH sA gatirnAnyA kShatriyasya tathA dvijAH
shlokas.20:
kShatriyaH shatavarShI cha dashavarShI cha brAhmaNaH |
pitAputrau cha vij~neyau tayorhi brAhmaNaH pitA
shlokas.21:
nArI tu patyabhAve vai devaraM kurute patim |
pRRithivI brAhmaNAlAbhe kShatriyaM kurute patim
shlokas.22:
putravachcha tato rakShyA upAsyA guruvachcha te |
agnivachchopacharyA vai brAhmaNAH kurusattama
shlokas.23:
RRijUnsataH satyashIlAnsarvabhUtahite ratAn |
AshIviShAniva kruddhAndvijAnupacharetsadA
shlokas.24:
tejasastapasashchaiva nityaM bibhyedyudhiShThira |
ubhe chaite parityAjye tejashchaiva tapastathA
shlokas.25:
vyavasAyastayoH shIghramubhayoreva vidyate |
hanyuH kruddhA mahArAja brAhmaNA ye tapasvinaH
shlokas.26:
bhUyaH syAdubhayaM dattaM brAhmaNAdyadakopanAt |
kuryAdubhayataHsheShaM dattasheShaM na sheShayet
shlokas.27:
daNDapANiryathA goShu pAlo nityaM sthiro bhavet |
brAhmaNAnbrahma cha tathA kShatriyaH paripAlayet
shlokas.28:
piteva putrAnrakShethA brAhmaNAnbrahmatejasaH |
gRRihe chaiShAmavekShethAH kachchidastIha jIvanam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
brAhmaNAnAM tu ye loke pratishrutya pitAmaha |
na prayachChanti mohAtte ke bhavanti mahAmate
shlokas.2:
etanme tattvato brUhi dharmaM dharmabhRRitAM vara |
pratishrutya durAtmAno na prayachChanti ye narAH
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yo na dadyAtpratishrutya svalpaM vA yadi vA bahu |
AshAstasya hatAH sarvAH klIbasyeva prajAphalam
shlokas.4:
yAM rAtriM jAyate pApo yAM cha rAtriM vinashyati |
etasminnantare yadyatsukRRitaM tasya bhArata
yachcha tasya hutaM ki~nchitsarvaM tasyopahanyate
shlokas.5:
atraitadvachanaM prAhurdharmashAstravido janAH |
nishamya bharatashreShTha buddhyA paramayuktayA
shlokas.6:
api chodAharantImaM dharmashAstravido janAH |
ashvAnAM shyAmakarNAnAM sahasreNa sa muchyate
shlokas.7:
atraivodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
sRRigAlasya cha sa.nvAdaM vAnarasya cha bhArata
shlokas.8:
tau sakhAyau purA hyAstAM mAnuShatve parantapa |
anyAM yoniM samApannau sArgAlIM vAnarIM tathA
shlokas.9:
tataH parAsUnkhAdantaM sRRigAlaM vAnaro.abravIt |
shmashAnamadhye samprekShya pUrvajAtimanusmaran
shlokas.10:
kiM tvayA pApakaM karma kRRitaM pUrvaM sudAruNam |
yastvaM shmashAne mRRitakAnpUtikAnatsi kutsitAn
shlokas.11:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha sRRigAlo vAnaraM tadA |
brAhmaNasya pratishrutya na mayA tadupAkRRitam
shlokas.12:
tatkRRite pApikAM yonimApanno.asmi plava~Ngama |
tasmAdeva.nvidhaM bhakShyaM bhakShayAmi bubhukShitaH
shlokas.13:
ityetadbruvato rAjanbrAhmaNasya mayA shrutam |
kathAM kathayataH puNyAM dharmaj~nasya purAtanIm
shlokas.14:
shrutaM chApi mayA bhUyaH kRRiShNasyApi vishAM pate |
kathAM kathayataH pUrvaM brAhmaNaM prati pANDava
shlokas.15:
evameva cha mAM nityaM brAhmaNAH sa.ndishanti vai |
pratishrutya bhaveddeyaM nAshA kAryA hi brAhmaNaiH
shlokas.16:
brAhmaNo hyAshayA pUrvaM kRRitayA pRRithivIpate |
susamiddho yathA dIptaH pAvakastadvidhaH smRRitaH
shlokas.17:
yaM nirIkSheta sa~Nkruddha AshayA pUrvajAtayA |
pradaheta hi taM rAjankakShamakShayyabhugyathA
shlokas.18:
sa eva hi yadA tuShTo vachasA pratinandati |
bhavatyagadasa~NkAsho viShaye tasya bhArata
shlokas.19:
putrAnpautrAnpashU.nshchaiva bAndhavAnsachivA.nstathA |
puraM janapadaM chaiva shAntiriShTeva puShyati
shlokas.20:
etaddhi paramaM tejo brAhmaNasyeha dRRishyate |
sahasrakiraNasyeva saviturdharaNItale
shlokas.21:
tasmAddAtavyameveha pratishrutya yudhiShThira |
yadIchChechChobhanAM jAtiM prAptuM bharatasattama
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNasya hi dattena dhruvaM svargo hyanuttamaH |
shakyaM prAptuM visheSheNa dAnaM hi mahatI kriyA
shlokas.23:
ito dattena jIvanti devatAH pitarastathA |
tasmAddAnAni deyAni brAhmaNebhyo vijAnatA
shlokas.24:
mahaddhi bharatashreShTha brAhmaNastIrthamuchyate |
velAyAM na tu kasyA~nchidgachChedvipro hyapUjitaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mitrasauhRRidabhAvena upadeshaM karoti yaH |
jAtyAvarasya rAjarShe doShastasya bhavenna vA
shlokas.2:
etadichChAmi tattvena vyAkhyAtuM vai pitAmaha |
sUkShmA gatirhi dharmasya yatra muhyanti mAnavAH
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShyAmi shRRiNu rAjanyathAgamam |
RRiShINAM vadatAM pUrvaM shrutamAsIdyathA mayA
shlokas.4:
upadesho na kartavyo jAtihInasya kasyachit |
upadeshe mahAndoSha upAdhyAyasya bhAShyate
shlokas.5:
nidarshanamidaM rAja~nshRRiNu me bharatarShabha |
duruktavachane rAjanyathA pUrvaM yudhiShThira
brahmAshramapade vRRittaM pArshve himavataH shubhe
shlokas.6:
tatrAshramapadaM puNyaM nAnAvRRikShagaNAyutam |
bahugulmalatAkIrNaM mRRigadvijaniShevitam
shlokas.7:
siddhachAraNasa~NghuShTaM ramyaM puShpitakAnanam |
vratibhirbahubhiH kIrNaM tApasairupashobhitam
shlokas.8:
brAhmaNaishcha mahAbhAgaiH sUryajvalanasaMnibhaiH |
niyamavratasampannaiH samAkIrNaM tapasvibhiH
dIkShitairbharatashreShTha yatAhAraiH kRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.9:
vedAdhyayanaghoShaishcha nAditaM bharatarShabha |
vAlakhilyaishcha bahubhiryatibhishcha niShevitam
shlokas.10:
tatra kashchitsamutsAhaM kRRitvA shUdro dayAnvitaH |
Agato hyAshramapadaM pUjitashcha tapasvibhiH
shlokas.11:
tA.nstu dRRiShTvA munigaNAndevakalpAnmahaujasaH |
vahato vividhA dIkShAH samprahRRiShyata bhArata
shlokas.12:
athAsya buddhirabhavattapasye bharatarShabha |
tato.abravItkulapatiM pAdau sa~NgRRihya bhArata
shlokas.13:
bhavatprasAdAdichChAmi dharmaM chartuM dvijarShabha |
tanmAM tvaM bhagavanvaktuM pravrAjayitumarhasi
shlokas.14:
varNAvaro.ahaM bhagava~nshUdro jAtyAsmi sattama |
shushrUShAM kartumichChAmi prapannAya prasIda me
shlokas.15:
kulapatiruvAcha||
na shakyamiha shUdreNa li~NgamAshritya vartitum |
AsyatAM yadi te buddhiH shushrUShAnirato bhava
shlokas.16:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktastu muninA sa shUdro.achintayannRRipa |
kathamatra mayA kAryaM shraddhA dharme parA cha me
vij~nAtamevaM bhavatu kariShye priyamAtmanaH
shlokas.17:
gatvAshramapadAddUramuTajaM kRRitavA.nstu saH |
tatra vediM cha bhUmiM cha devatAyatanAni cha
niveshya bharatashreShTha niyamastho.abhavatsukham
shlokas.18:
abhiShekA.nshcha niyamAndevatAyataneShu cha |
baliM cha kRRitvA hutvA cha devatAM chApyapUjayat
shlokas.19:
sa~NkalpaniyamopetaH phalAhAro jitendriyaH |
nityaM saMnihitAbhishcha oShadhIbhiH phalaistathA
shlokas.20:
atithInpUjayAmAsa yathAvatsamupAgatAn |
evaM hi sumahAnkAlo vyatyakrAmatsa tasya vai
shlokas.21:
athAsya munirAgachChatsa~NgatyA vai tamAshramam |
sampUjya svAgatenarShiM vidhivatparyatoShayat
shlokas.22:
anukUlAH kathAH kRRitvA yathAvatparyapRRichChata |
RRiShiH paramatejasvI dharmAtmA sa.nyatendriyaH
shlokas.23:
evaM sa bahushastasya shUdrasya bharatarShabha |
so.agachChadAshramamRRiShiH shUdraM draShTuM nararShabha
shlokas.24:
atha taM tApasaM shUdraH so.abravIdbharatarShabha |
pitRRikAryaM kariShyAmi tatra me.anugrahaM kuru
shlokas.25:
bADhamityeva taM vipra uvAcha bharatarShabha |
shuchirbhUtvA sa shUdrastu tasyarSheH pAdyamAnayat
shlokas.26:
atha darbhA.nshcha vanyAshcha oShadhIrbharatarShabha |
pavitramAsanaM chaiva bRRisIM cha samupAnayat
shlokas.27:
atha dakShiNamAvRRitya bRRisIM paramashIrShikAm |
kRRitAmanyAyato dRRiShTvA tatastamRRiShirabravIt
shlokas.28:
kuruShvaitAM pUrvashIrShAM bhava choda~NmukhaH shuchiH |
sa cha tatkRRitavA~nshUdraH sarvaM yadRRiShirabravIt
shlokas.29:
yathopadiShTaM medhAvI darbhAdI.nstAnyathAtatham |
havyakavyavidhiM kRRitsnamuktaM tena tapasvinA
shlokas.30:
RRiShiNA pitRRikArye cha sa cha dharmapathe sthitaH |
pitRRikArye kRRite chApi visRRiShTaH sa jagAma ha
shlokas.31:
atha dIrghasya kAlasya sa tapya~nshUdratApasaH |
vane pa~nchatvamagamatsukRRitena cha tena vai
ajAyata mahArAjarAjava.nshe mahAdyutiH
shlokas.32:
tathaiva sa RRiShistAta kAladharmamavApya ha |
purohitakule vipra AjAto bharatarShabha
shlokas.33:
evaM tau tatra sambhUtAvubhau shUdramunI tadA |
krameNa vardhitau chApi vidyAsu kushalAvubhau
shlokas.34:
atharvavede vede cha babhUvarShiH sunishchitaH |
kalpaprayoge chotpanne jyotiShe cha paraM gataH
sakhye chApi parA prItistayoshchApi vyavardhata
shlokas.35:
pitaryuparate chApi kRRitashauchaH sa bhArata |
abhiShiktaH prakRRitibhI rAjaputraH sa pArthivaH
abhiShiktena sa RRiShirabhiShiktaH purohitaH
shlokas.36:
sa taM purodhAya sukhamavasadbharatarShabha |
rAjyaM shashAsa dharmeNa prajAshcha paripAlayan
shlokas.37:
puNyAhavAchane nityaM dharmakAryeShu chAsakRRit |
utsmayanprAhasachchApi dRRiShTvA rAjA purohitam
evaM sa bahusho rAjanpurodhasamupAhasat
shlokas.38:
lakShayitvA purodhAstu bahushastaM narAdhipam |
utsmayantaM cha satataM dRRiShTvAsau manyumAnabhUt
shlokas.39:
atha shUnye purodhAstu saha rAj~nA samAgataH |
kathAbhiranukUlAbhI rAjAnamabhirAmayat
shlokas.40:
tato.abravInnarendraM sa purodhA bharatarShabha |
varamichChAmyahaM tvekaM tvayA dattaM mahAdyute
shlokas.41:
rAjovAcha||
varANAM te shataM dadyAM kimutaikaM dvijottama |
snehAchcha bahumAnAchcha nAstyadeyaM hi me tava
shlokas.42:
purohita uvAcha||
ekaM vai varamichChAmi yadi tuShTo.asi pArthiva |
yaddadAsi mahArAja satyaM tadvada mAnRRitam
shlokas.43:
bhIShma uvAcha||
bADhamityeva taM rAjA pratyuvAcha yudhiShThira |
yadi j~nAsyAmi vakShyAmi ajAnanna tu sa.nvade
shlokas.44:
purohita uvAcha||
puNyAhavAchane nityaM dharmakRRityeShu chAsakRRit |
shAntihomeShu cha sadA kiM tvaM hasasi vIkShya mAm
shlokas.45:
savrIDaM vai bhavati hi mano me hasatA tvayA |
kAmayA shApito rAjannAnyathA vaktumarhasi
shlokas.46:
bhAvyaM hi kAraNenAtra na te hAsyamakAraNam |
kautUhalaM me subhRRishaM tattvena kathayasva me
shlokas.47:
rAjovAcha||
evamukte tvayA vipra yadavAchyaM bhavedapi |
avashyameva vaktavyaM shRRiNuShvaikamanA dvija
shlokas.48:
pUrvadehe yathA vRRittaM tannibodha dvijottama |
jAtiM smarAmyahaM brahmannavadhAnena me shRRiNu
shlokas.49:
shUdro.ahamabhavaM pUrvaM tApaso bhRRishasa.nyutaH |
RRiShirugratapAstvaM cha tadAbhUrdvijasattama
shlokas.50:
prIyatA hi tadA brahmanmamAnugrahabuddhinA |
pitRRikArye tvayA pUrvamupadeshaH kRRito.anagha
bRRisyAM darbheShu havye cha kavye cha munisattama
shlokas.51:
etena karmadoSheNa purodhAstvamajAyathAH |
ahaM rAjA cha viprendra pashya kAlasya paryayam
matkRRite hyupadeshena tvayA prAptamidaM phalam
shlokas.52:
etasmAtkAraNAdbrahmanprahase tvAM dvijottama |
na tvAM paribhavanbrahmanprahasAmi gururbhavAn
shlokas.53:
viparyayeNa me manyustena santapyate manaH |
jAtiM smarAmyahaM tubhyamatastvAM prahasAmi vai
shlokas.54:
evaM tavograM hi tapa upadeshena nAshitam |
purohitatvamutsRRijya yatasva tvaM punarbhave
shlokas.55:
itastvamadhamAmanyAM mA yoniM prApsyase dvija |
gRRihyatAM draviNaM vipra pUtAtmA bhava sattama
shlokas.56:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato visRRiShTo rAj~nA tu vipro dAnAnyanekashaH |
brAhmaNebhyo dadau vittaM bhUmiM grAmA.nshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.57:
kRRichChrANi chIrtvA cha tato yathoktAni dvijottamaH |
tIrthAni chAbhigatvA vai dAnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.58:
dattvA gAshchaiva viprANAM pUtAtmA so.abhavaddvijaH |
tameva chAshramaM gatvA chachAra vipulaM tapaH
shlokas.59:
tataH siddhiM parAM prApto brAhmaNo rAjasattama |
saMmatashchAbhavatteShAmAshrame.a.ashramavAsinAm
shlokas.60:
evaM prApto mahatkRRichChramRRiShiH sa nRRipasattama |
brAhmaNena na vaktavyaM tasmAdvarNAvare jane
shlokas.61:
varjayedupadeshaM cha sadaiva brAhmaNo nRRipa |
upadeshaM hi kurvANo dvijaH kRRichChramavApnuyAt
shlokas.62:
eShitavyaM sadA vAchA nRRipeNa dvijasattamAt |
na pravaktavyamiha hi ki~nchidvarNAvare jane
shlokas.63:
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyAstrayo varNA dvijAtayaH |
eteShu kathayanrAjanbrAhmaNo na praduShyati
shlokas.64:
tasmAtsadbhirna vaktavyaM kasyachitki~nchidagrataH |
sUkShmA gatirhi dharmasya durj~neyA hyakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.65:
tasmAnmaunAni munayo dIkShAM kurvanti chAdRRitAH |
duruktasya bhayAdrAjannAnubhAShanti ki~nchana
shlokas.66:
dhArmikA guNasampannAH satyArjavaparAyaNAH |
duruktavAchAbhihatAH prApnuvantIha duShkRRitam
shlokas.67:
upadesho na kartavyaH kadAchidapi kasyachit |
upadeshAddhi tatpApaM brAhmaNaH samavApnuyAt
shlokas.68:
vimRRishya tasmAtprAj~nena vaktavyaM dharmamichChatA |
satyAnRRitena hi kRRita upadesho hinasti vai
shlokas.69:
vaktavyamiha pRRiShTena vinishchitya viparyayam |
sa chopadeshaH kartavyo yena dharmamavApnuyAt
shlokas.70:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtamupadeshe kRRite sati |
mahAnklesho hi bhavati tasmAnnopadishetkvachit

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kIdRRishe puruShe tAta strIShu vA bharatarShabha |
shrIH padmA vasate nityaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShyAmi yathAdRRiShTaM yathAshrutam |
rukmiNI devakIputrasaMnidhau paryapRRichChata
shlokas.3:
nArAyaNasyA~NkagatAM jvalantIM; dRRiShTvA shriyaM padmasamAnavaktrAm |
kautUhalAdvismitachArunetrA; paprachCha mAtA makaradhvajasya
shlokas.4:
kAnIha bhUtAnyupasevase tvaM; santiShThatI kAni na sevase tvam |
tAni trilokeshvarabhUtakAnte; tattvena me brUhi maharShikanye
shlokas.5:
evaM tadA shrIrabhibhAShyamANA; devyA samakShaM garuDadhvajasya |
uvAcha vAkyaM madhurAbhidhAnaM; manoharaM chandramukhI prasannA
shlokas.6:
vasAmi satye subhage pragalbhe; dakShe nare karmaNi vartamAne |
nAkarmashIle puruShe vasAmi; na nAstike sA~Nkarike kRRitaghne
na bhinnavRRitte na nRRisha.nsavRRitte; na chApi chaure na guruShvasUye
shlokas.7:
ye chAlpatejobalasattvasArA; hRRiShyanti kupyanti cha yatra tatra |
na devi tiShThAmi tathAvidheShu; nareShu sa.nsuptamanoratheShu
shlokas.8:
yashchAtmani prArthayate na kiM chi;dyashcha svabhAvopahatAntarAtmA |
teShvalpasantoSharateShu nityaM; nareShu nAhaM nivasAmi devi
shlokas.9:
vasAmi dharmashIleShu dharmaj~neShu mahAtmasu |
vRRiddhaseviShu dAnteShu sattvaj~neShu mahAtmasu
shlokas.10:
strIShu kShAntAsu dAntAsu devadvijaparAsu cha |
vasAmi satyashIlAsu svabhAvaniratAsu cha
shlokas.11:
prakIrNabhANDAmanavekShyakAriNIM; sadA cha bhartuH pratikUlavAdinIm |
parasya veshmAbhiratAmalajjA;meva.nvidhAM strIM parivarjayAmi
shlokas.12:
lolAmachokShAmavalehinIM cha; vyapetadhairyAM kalahapriyAM cha |
nidrAbhibhUtAM satataM shayAnA;meva.nvidhAM strIM parivarjayAmi
shlokas.13:
satyAsu nityaM priyadarshanAsu; saubhAgyayuktAsu guNAnvitAsu |
vasAmi nArIShu pativratAsu; kalyANashIlAsu vibhUShitAsu
shlokas.14:
yAneShu kanyAsu vibhUShaNeShu; yaj~neShu megheShu cha vRRiShTimatsu |
vasAmi phullAsu cha padminIShu; nakShatravIthIShu cha shAradIShu
shlokas.15:
shaileShu goShTheShu tathA vaneShu; saraHsu phullotpalapa~NkajeShu |
nadIShu ha.nsasvananAditAsu; krau~nchAvaghuShTasvarashobhitAsu
shlokas.16:
vistIrNakUlahradashobhitAsu; tapasvisiddhadvijasevitAsu |
vasAmi nityaM subahUdakAsu; siMhairgajaishchAkulitodakAsu
matte gaje govRRiShabhe narendre; siMhAsane satpuruShe cha nityam
shlokas.17:
yasmingRRihe hUyate havyavAho; gobrAhmaNashchArchyate devatAshcha |
kAle cha puShpairbalayaH kriyante; tasmingRRihe nityamupaimi vAsam
shlokas.18:
svAdhyAyanityeShu dvijeShu nityaM; kShatre cha dharmAbhirate sadaiva |
vaishye cha kRRiShyAbhirate vasAmi; shUdre cha shushrUShaNanityayukte
shlokas.19:
nArAyaNe tvekamanA vasAmi; sarveNa bhAvena sharIrabhUtA |
tasminhi dharmaH sumahAnniviShTo; brahmaNyatA chAtra tathA priyatvam
shlokas.20:
nAhaM sharIreNa vasAmi devi; naivaM mayA shakyamihAbhidhAtum |
yasmi.nstu bhAvena vasAmi pu.nsi; sa vardhate dharmayashorthakAmaiH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
strIpu.nsayoH samprayoge sparshaH kasyAdhiko bhavet |
etanme sa.nshayaM rAjanyathAvadvaktumarhasi
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
bha~NgAshvanena shakrasya yathA vairamabhUtpurA
shlokas.3:
purA bha~NgAshvano nAma rAjarShiratidhArmikaH |
aputraH sa naravyAghra putrArthaM yaj~namAharat
shlokas.4:
agniShTuM nAma rAjarShirindradviShTaM mahAbalaH |
prAyashchitteShu martyAnAM putrakAmasya cheShyate
shlokas.5:
indro j~nAtvA tu taM yaj~naM mahAbhAgaH sureshvaraH |
antaraM tasya rAjarSheranvichChanniyatAtmanaH
shlokas.6:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya mRRigayAmaTato nRRipa |
idamantaramityeva shakro nRRipamamohayat
shlokas.7:
ekAshvena cha rAjarShirbhrAnta indreNa mohitaH |
na disho.avindata nRRipaH kShutpipAsArditastadA
shlokas.8:
itashchetashcha vai dhAva~nshramatRRiShNArdito nRRipaH |
saro.apashyatsuruchiraM pUrNaM paramavAriNA
so.avagAhya sarastAta pAyayAmAsa vAjinam
shlokas.9:
atha pItodakaM so.ashvaM vRRikShe baddhvA nRRipottamaH |
avagAhya tataH snAto rAjA strItvamavApa ha
shlokas.10:
AtmAnaM strIkRRitaM dRRiShTvA vrIDito nRRipasattamaH |
chintAnugatasarvAtmA vyAkulendriyachetanaH
shlokas.11:
ArohiShye kathaM tvashvaM kathaM yAsyAmi vai puram |
agniShTuM nAma iShTaM me putrANAM shatamaurasam
shlokas.12:
jAtaM mahAbalAnAM vai tAnpravakShyAmi kiM tvaham |
dAreShu chAsmadIyeShu paurajAnapadeShu cha
shlokas.13:
mRRidutvaM cha tanutvaM cha viklavatvaM tathaiva cha |
strIguNA RRiShibhiH proktA dharmatattvArthadarshibhiH
vyAyAmaH karkashatvaM cha vIryaM cha puruShe guNAH
shlokas.14:
pauruShaM vipranaShTaM me strItvaM kenApi me.abhavat |
strIbhAvAtkathamashvaM tu punarAroDhumutsahe
shlokas.15:
mahatA tvatha khedena AruhyAshvaM narAdhipaH |
punarAyAtpuraM tAta strIbhUto nRRipasattama
shlokas.16:
putrA dArAshcha bhRRityAshcha paurajAnapadAshcha te |
kiM nvidaM tviti vij~nAya vismayaM paramaM gatAH
shlokas.17:
athovAcha sa rAjarShiH strIbhUto vadatAM varaH |
mRRigayAmasmi niryAto balaiH parivRRito dRRiDham
udbhrAntaH prAvishaM ghorAmaTavIM daivamohitaH
shlokas.18:
aTavyAM cha sughorAyAM tRRiShNArto naShTachetanaH |
saraH suruchiraprakhyamapashyaM pakShibhirvRRitam
shlokas.19:
tatrAvagADhaH strIbhUto vyaktaM daivAnna sa.nshayaH |
atRRipta iva putrANAM dArANAM cha dhanasya cha
shlokas.20:
uvAcha putrA.nshcha tataH strIbhUtaH pArthivottamaH |
samprItyA bhujyatAM rAjyaM vanaM yAsyAmi putrakAH
abhiShichya sa putrANAM shataM rAjA vanaM gataH
shlokas.21:
tAmAshrame striyaM tAta tApaso.abhyavapadyata |
tApasenAsya putrANAmAshrame.apyabhavachChatam
shlokas.22:
atha sA tAnsutAngRRihya pUrvaputrAnabhAShata |
puruShatve sutA yUyaM strItve cheme shataM sutAH
shlokas.23:
ekatra bhujyatAM rAjyaM bhrAtRRibhAvena putrakAH |
sahitA bhrAtaraste.atha rAjyaM bubhujire tadA
shlokas.24:
tAndRRiShTvA bhrAtRRibhAvena bhu~njAnAnrAjyamuttamam |
chintayAmAsa devendro manyunAbhipariplutaH
upakAro.asya rAjarSheH kRRito nApakRRitaM mayA
shlokas.25:
tato brAhmaNarUpeNa devarAjaH shatakratuH |
bhedayAmAsa tAngatvA nagaraM vai nRRipAtmajAn
shlokas.26:
bhrAtR^INAM nAsti saubhrAtraM ye.apyekasya pituH sutAH |
rAjyahetorvivaditAH kashyapasya surAsurAH
shlokas.27:
yUyaM bha~NgAshvanApatyAstApasasyetare sutAH |
kashyapasya surAshchaiva asurAshcha sutAstathA
yuShmAkaM paitRRikaM rAjyaM bhujyate tApasAtmajaiH
shlokas.28:
indreNa bheditAste tu yuddhe.anyonyamapAtayan |
tachChrutvA tApasI chApi santaptA praruroda ha
shlokas.29:
brAhmaNachChadmanAbhyetya tAmindro.athAnvapRRichChata |
kena duHkhena santaptA rodiShi tvaM varAnane
shlokas.30:
brAhmaNaM tu tato dRRiShTvA sA strI karuNamabravIt |
putrANAM dve shate brahmankAlena vinipAtite
shlokas.31:
ahaM rAjAbhavaM vipra tatra putrashataM mayA |
samutpannaM surUpANAM vikrAntAnAM dvijottama
shlokas.32:
kadAchinmRRigayAM yAta udbhrAnto gahane vane |
avagADhashcha sarasi strIbhUto brAhmaNottama
putrAnrAjye pratiShThApya vanamasmi tato gataH
shlokas.33:
striyAshcha me putrashataM tApasena mahAtmanA |
Ashrame janitaM brahmannItAste nagaraM mayA
shlokas.34:
teShAM cha vairamutpannaM kAlayogena vai dvija |
etachChochAmi viprendra daivenAbhipariplutA
shlokas.35:
indrastAM duHkhitAM dRRiShTvA abravItparuShaM vachaH |
purA suduHsahaM bhadre mama duHkhaM tvayA kRRitam
shlokas.36:
indradviShTena yajatA mAmanAdRRitya durmate |
indro.ahamasmi durbuddhe vairaM te yAtitaM mayA
shlokas.37:
indraM tu dRRiShTvA rAjarShiH pAdayoH shirasA gataH |
prasIda tridashashreShTha putrakAmena sa kratuH
iShTastridashashArdUla tatra me kShantumarhasi
shlokas.38:
praNipAtena tasyendraH parituShTo varaM dadau |
putrA vai katame rAja~njIvantu tava sha.nsa me
strIbhUtasya hi ye jAtAH puruShasyAtha ye.abhavan
shlokas.39:
tApasI tu tataH shakramuvAcha prayatA~njaliH |
strIbhUtasya hi ye jAtAste me jIvantu vAsava
shlokas.40:
indrastu vismito hRRiShTaH striyaM paprachCha tAM punaH |
puruShotpAditA ye te kathaM dveShyAH sutAstava
shlokas.41:
strIbhUtasya hi ye jAtAH snehastebhyo.adhikaH katham |
kAraNaM shrotumichChAmi tanme vaktumihArhasi
shlokas.42:
stryuvAcha||
striyAstvabhyadhikaH sneho na tathA puruShasya vai |
tasmAtte shakra jIvantu ye jAtAH strIkRRitasya vai
shlokas.43:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamukte tatastvindraH prIto vAkyamuvAcha ha |
sarva eveha jIvantu putrAste satyavAdini
shlokas.44:
varaM cha vRRiNu rAjendra yaM tvamichChasi suvrata |
puruShatvamatha strItvaM matto yadabhikA~NkShasi
shlokas.46:
stryuvAcha||
strItvameva vRRiNe shakra prasanne tvayi vAsava |
evamuktastu devendrastAM striyaM pratyuvAcha ha |
puruShatvaM kathaM tyaktvA strItvaM rochayase vibho
shlokas.47:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha strIbhUto rAjasattamaH |
striyAH puruShasa.nyoge prItirabhyadhikA sadA
etasmAtkAraNAchChakra strItvameva vRRiNomyaham
shlokas.48:
rame chaivAdhikaM strItve satyaM vai devasattama |
strIbhAvena hi tuShTo.asmi gamyatAM tridashAdhipa
shlokas.49:
evamastviti choktvA tAmApRRichChya tridivaM gataH |
evaM striyA mahArAja adhikA prItiruchyate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM kartavyaM manuShyeNa lokayAtrAhitArthinA |
kathaM vai lokayAtrAM tu ki.nshIlashcha samAcharet
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kAyena trividhaM karma vAchA chApi chaturvidham |
manasA trividhaM chaiva dasha karmapathA.nstyajet
shlokas.3:
prANAtipAtaM stainyaM cha paradAramathApi cha |
trINi pApAni kAyena sarvataH parivarjayet
shlokas.4:
asatpralApaM pAruShyaM paishunyamanRRitaM tathA |
chatvAri vAchA rAjendra na jalpennAnuchintayet
shlokas.5:
anabhidhyA parasveShu sarvasattveShu sauhRRidam |
karmaNAM phalamastIti trividhaM manasA charet
shlokas.6:
tasmAdvAkkAyamanasA nAcharedashubhaM naraH |
shubhAshubhAnyAcharanhi tasya tasyAshnute phalam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmaheshAya vibho nAmAnyAchakShva shambhave |
babhrave vishvamAyAya mahAbhAgyaM cha tattvataH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
surAsuraguro deva viShNo tvaM vaktumarhasi |
shivAya vishvarUpAya yanmAM pRRichChadyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.3:
nAmnAM sahasraM devasya taNDinA brahmayoninA |
niveditaM brahmaloke brahmaNo yatpurAbhavat
shlokas.4:
dvaipAyanaprabhRRitayastathaiveme tapodhanAH |
RRiShayaH suvratA dAntAH shRRiNvantu gadatastava
shlokas.5:
dhruvAya nandine hotre goptre vishvasRRije.agnaye |
mahAbhAgyaM vibho brUhi muNDine.atha kapardine
shlokas.7:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
na gatiH karmaNAM shakyA vettumIshasya tattvataH |
hiraNyagarbhapramukhA devAH sendrA maharShayaH |
na viduryasya nidhanamAdiM vA sUkShmadarshinaH
sa kathaM naramAtreNa shakyo j~nAtuM satAM gatiH
shlokas.8:
tasyAhamasuraghnasya kA.nshchidbhagavato guNAn |
bhavatAM kIrtayiShyAmi vrateshAya yathAtatham
shlokas.9:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tu bhagavAnguNA.nstasya mahAtmanaH |
upaspRRishya shuchirbhUtvA kathayAmAsa dhImataH
shlokas.10:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
shushrUShadhvaM brAhmaNendrAstvaM cha tAta yudhiShThira |
tvaM chApageya nAmAni nishAmaya jagatpateH
shlokas.11:
yadavAptaM cha me pUrvaM sAmbahetoH suduShkaram |
yathA cha bhagavAndRRiShTo mayA pUrvaM samAdhinA
shlokas.12:
shambare nihate pUrvaM raukmiNeyena dhImatA |
atIte dvAdashe varShe jAmbavatyabravIddhi mAm
shlokas.13:
pradyumnachArudeShNAdInrukmiNyA vIkShya putrakAn |
putrArthinI mAmupetya vAkyamAha yudhiShThira
shlokas.14:
shUraM balavatAM shreShThaM kAntarUpamakalmaSham |
AtmatulyaM mama sutaM prayachChAchyuta mAchiram
shlokas.15:
na hi te.aprApyamastIha triShu lokeShu ki~nchana |
lokAnsRRijestvamaparAnichChanyadukulodvaha
shlokas.16:
tvayA dvAdasha varShANi vAyubhUtena shuShyatA |
ArAdhya pashubhartAraM rukmiNyA janitAH sutAH
shlokas.17:
chArudeShNaH suchArushcha chAruveSho yashodharaH |
chArushravAshchAruyashAH pradyumnaH shambhureva cha
shlokas.18:
yathA te janitAH putrA rukmiNyAshchAruvikramAH |
tathA mamApi tanayaM prayachCha balashAlinam
shlokas.19:
ityevaM chodito devyA tAmavochaM sumadhyamAm |
anujAnIhi mAM rAj~ni kariShye vachanaM tava
sA cha mAmabravIdgachCha vijayAya shivAya cha
shlokas.20:
brahmA shivaH kAshyapashcha nadyo devA manonugAH |
kShetrauShadhyo yaj~navAhAchChandA.nsyRRiShigaNA dharA
shlokas.21:
samudrA dakShiNA stobhA RRikShANi pitaro grahAH |
devapatnyo devakanyA devamAtara eva cha
shlokas.22:
manvantarANi gAvashcha chandramAH savitA hariH |
sAvitrI brahmavidyA cha RRitavo vatsarAH kShapAH
shlokas.23:
kShaNA lavA muhUrtAshcha nimeShA yugaparyayAH |
rakShantu sarvatra gataM tvAM yAdava sukhAvaham
ariShTaM gachCha panthAnamapramatto bhavAnagha
shlokas.24:
evaM kRRitasvastyayanastayAhaM; tAmabhyanuj~nAya kapIndraputrIm |
pituH samIpe narasattamasya; mAtushcha rAj~nashcha tathAhukasya
shlokas.25:
tamarthamAvedya yadabravInmAM; vidyAdharendrasya sutA bhRRishArtA |
tAnabhyanuj~nAya tadAtiduHkhA;dgadaM tathaivAtibalaM cha rAmam
shlokas.26:
prApyAnuj~nAM gurujanAdahaM tArkShyamachintayam |
so.avahaddhimavantaM mAM prApya chainaM vyasarjayam
shlokas.27:
tatrAhamadbhutAnbhAvAnapashyaM girisattame |
kShetraM cha tapasAM shreShThaM pashyAmyAshramamuttamam
shlokas.28:
divyaM vaiyAghrapadyasya upamanyormahAtmanaH |
pUjitaM devagandharvairbrAhmyA lakShmyA samanvitam
shlokas.29:
dhavakakubhakadambanArikelaiH; kurabakaketakajambupATalAbhiH |
vaTavaruNakavatsanAbhabilvaiH; saralakapitthapriyAlasAlatAlaiH
shlokas.30:
badarIkundapunnAgairashokAmrAtimuktakaiH |
bhallAtakairmadhUkaishcha champakaiH panasaistathA
shlokas.31:
vanyairbahuvidhairvRRikShaiH phalapuShpapradairyutam |
puShpagulmalatAkIrNaM kadalIShaNDashobhitam
shlokas.32:
nAnAshakunisambhojyaiH phalairvRRikShairala~NkRRitam |
yathAsthAnavinikShiptairbhUShitaM vanarAjibhiH
shlokas.33:
ruruvAraNashArdUlasiMhadvIpisamAkulam |
kura~NgabarhiNAkIrNaM mArjArabhujagAvRRitam
pUgaishcha mRRigajAtInAM mahiSharkShaniShevitam
shlokas.34:
nAnApuShparajomishro gajadAnAdhivAsitaH |
divyastrIgItabahulo mAruto.atra sukho vavau
shlokas.35:
dhArAninAdairvihagapraNAdaiH; shubhaistathA bRRiMhitaiH ku~njarANAm |
gItaistathA kiMnarANAmudAraiH; shubhaiH svanaiH sAmagAnAM cha vIra
shlokas.36:
achintyaM manasApyanyaiH sarobhiH samala~NkRRitam |
vishAlaishchAgnisharaNairbhUShitaM kushasa.nvRRitam
shlokas.37:
vibhUShitaM puNyapavitratoyayA; sadA cha juShTaM nRRipa jahnukanyayA |
mahAtmabhirdharmabhRRitAM variShThai;rmaharShibhirbhUShitamagnikalpaiH
shlokas.38:
vAyvAhArairambupairjapyanityaiH; samprakShAlairyatibhirdhyAnanityaiH |
dhUmAshanairUShmapaiH kShIrapaishcha; vibhUShitaM brAhmaNendraiH samantAt
shlokas.39:
gochAriNo.athAshmakuTTA dantolUkhalinastathA |
marIchipAH phenapAshcha tathaiva mRRigachAriNaH
shlokas.40:
suduHkhAnniyamA.nstA.nstAnvahataH sutaponvitAn |
pashyannutphullanayanaH praveShTumupachakrame
shlokas.41:
supUjitaM devagaNairmahAtmabhiH; shivAdibhirbhArata puNyakarmabhiH |
rarAja tachchAshramamaNDalaM sadA; divIva rAjanravimaNDalaM yathA
shlokas.42:
krIDanti sarpairnakulA mRRigairvyAghrAshcha mitravat |
prabhAvAddIptatapasaH saMnikarShaguNAnvitAH
shlokas.43:
tatrAshramapade shreShThe sarvabhUtamanorame |
sevite dvijashArdUlairvedavedA~NgapAragaiH
shlokas.44:
nAnAniyamavikhyAtairRRiShibhishcha mahAtmabhiH |
pravishanneva chApashyaM jaTAchIradharaM prabhum
shlokas.45:
tejasA tapasA chaiva dIpyamAnaM yathAnalam |
shiShyamadhyagataM shAntaM yuvAnaM brAhmaNarShabham
shirasA vandamAnaM mAmupamanyurabhAShata
shlokas.46:
svAgataM puNDarIkAkSha saphalAni tapA.nsi naH |
yatpUjyaH pUjayasi no draShTavyo draShTumichChasi
shlokas.47:
tamahaM prA~njalirbhUtvA mRRigapakShiShvathAgniShu |
dharme cha shiShyavarge cha samapRRichChamanAmayam
shlokas.48:
tato mAM bhagavAnAha sAmnA paramavalgunA |
lapsyase tanayaM kRRiShNa Atmatulyamasa.nshayam
shlokas.49:
tapaH sumahadAsthAya toShayeshAnamIshvaram |
iha devaH sapatnIkaH samAkrIDatyadhokShaja
shlokas.50:
ihaiva devatAshreShThaM devAH sarShigaNAH purA |
tapasA brahmacharyeNa satyena cha damena cha
toShayitvA shubhAnkAmAnprApnuva.nste janArdana
shlokas.51:
tejasAM tapasAM chaiva nidhiH sa bhagavAniha |
shubhAshubhAnvitAnbhAvAnvisRRijansa~NkShipannapi
Aste devyA sahAchintyo yaM prArthayasi shatruhan
shlokas.52:
hiraNyakashipuryo.abhUddAnavo merukampanaH |
tena sarvAmaraishvaryaM sharvAtprAptaM samArbudam
shlokas.53:
tasyaiva putrapravaro mandaro nAma vishrutaH |
mahAdevavarAchChakraM varShArbudamayodhayat
shlokas.54:
viShNoshchakraM cha tadghoraM vajramAkhaNDalasya cha |
shIrNaM purAbhavattAta grahasyA~NgeShu keshava
shlokas.55:
ardyamAnAshcha vibudhA graheNa subalIyasA |
shivadattavarA~njaghnurasurendrAnsurA bhRRisham
shlokas.56:
tuShTo vidyutprabhasyApi trilokeshvaratAmadAt |
shataM varShasahasrANAM sarvalokeshvaro.abhavat
mamaivAnucharo nityaM bhavitAsIti chAbravIt
shlokas.57:
tathA putrasahasrANAmayutaM cha dadau prabhuH |
kushadvIpaM cha sa dadau rAjyena bhagavAnajaH
shlokas.58:
tathA shatamukho nAma dhAtrA sRRiShTo mahAsuraH |
yena varShashataM sAgramAtmamA.nsairhuto.analaH
taM prAha bhagavA.nstuShTaH kiM karomIti sha~NkaraH
shlokas.59:
taM vai shatamukhaH prAha yogo bhavatu me.adbhutaH |
balaM cha daivatashreShTha shAshvataM samprayachCha me
shlokas.60:
svAyambhuvaH kratushchApi putrArthamabhavatpurA |
Avishya yogenAtmAnaM trINi varShashatAnyapi
shlokas.61:
tasya devo.adadatputrAnsahasraM kratusaMmitAn |
yogeshvaraM devagItaM vettha kRRiShNa na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.62:
vAlakhilyA maghavatA avaj~nAtAH purA kila |
taiH kruddhairbhagavAnrudrastapasA toShito hyabhUt
shlokas.63:
tA.nshchApi daivatashreShThaH prAha prIto jagatpatiH |
suparNaM somahartAraM tapasotpAdayiShyatha
shlokas.64:
mahAdevasya roShAchcha Apo naShTAH purAbhavan |
tAshcha saptakapAlena devairanyAH pravartitAH
shlokas.65:
atrerbhAryApi bhartAraM santyajya brahmavAdinI |
nAhaM tasya munerbhUyo vashagA syAM katha~nchana
ityuktvA sA mahAdevamagachChachCharaNaM kila
shlokas.66:
nirAhArA bhayAdatrestrINi varShashatAnyapi |
asheta musaleShveva prasAdArthaM bhavasya sA
shlokas.67:
tAmabravIddhasandevo bhavitA vai sutastava |
va.nshe tavaiva nAmnA tu khyAtiM yAsyati chepsitAm
shlokas.68:
shAkalyaH sa.nshitAtmA vai nava varShashatAnyapi |
ArAdhayAmAsa bhavaM manoyaj~nena keshava
shlokas.69:
taM chAha bhagavA.nstuShTo granthakAro bhaviShyasi |
vatsAkShayA cha te kIrtistrailokye vai bhaviShyati
akShayaM cha kulaM te.astu maharShibhirala~NkRRitam
shlokas.70:
sAvarNishchApi vikhyAta RRiShirAsItkRRite yuge |
iha tena tapastaptaM ShaShTiM varShashatAnyatha
shlokas.71:
tamAha bhagavAnrudraH sAkShAttuShTo.asmi te.anagha |
granthakRRillokavikhyAto bhavitAsyajarAmaraH
shlokas.72:
mayApi cha yathA dRRiShTo devadevaH purA vibhuH |
sAkShAtpashupatistAta tachchApi shRRiNu mAdhava
shlokas.73:
yadarthaM cha mahAdevaH prayatena mayA purA |
ArAdhito mahAtejAstachchApi shRRiNu vistaram
shlokas.74:
yadavAptaM cha me pUrvaM devadevAnmaheshvarAt |
tatsarvamakhilenAdya kathayiShyAmi te.anagha
shlokas.75:
purA kRRitayuge tAta RRiShirAsInmahAyashAH |
vyAghrapAda iti khyAto vedavedA~NgapAragaH
tasyAhamabhavaM putro dhaumyashchApi mamAnujaH
shlokas.76:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya dhaumyena saha mAdhava |
AgachChamAshramaM krIDanmunInAM bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.77:
tatrApi cha mayA dRRiShTA duhyamAnA payasvinI |
lakShitaM cha mayA kShIraM svAduto hyamRRitopamam
shlokas.78:
tataH piShTaM samAloDya toyena saha mAdhava |
AvayoH kShIramityeva pAnArthamupanIyate
shlokas.79:
atha gavyaM payastAta kadAchitprAshitaM mayA |
tataH piShTarasaM tAta na me prItimudAvahat
shlokas.80:
tato.ahamabruvaM bAlyAjjananImAtmanastadA |
kShIrodanasamAyuktaM bhojanaM cha prayachCha me
shlokas.81:
tato mAmabravInmAtA duHkhashokasamanvitA |
putrasnehAtpariShvajya mUrdhni chAghrAya mAdhava
shlokas.82:
kutaH kShIrodanaM vatsa munInAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
vane nivasatAM nityaM kandamUlaphalAshinAm
shlokas.83:
aprasAdya virUpAkShaM varadaM sthANumavyayam |
kutaH kShIrodanaM vatsa sukhAni vasanAni cha
shlokas.84:
taM prapadya sadA vatsa sarvabhAvena sha~Nkaram |
tatprasAdAchcha kAmebhyaH phalaM prApsyasi putraka
shlokas.85:
jananyAstadvachaH shrutvA tadAprabhRRiti shatruhan |
mama bhaktirmahAdeve naiShThikI samapadyata
shlokas.86:
tato.ahaM tapa AsthAya toShayAmAsa sha~Nkaram |
divyaM varShasahasraM tu pAdA~NguShThAgraviShThitaH
shlokas.87:
ekaM varShashataM chaiva phalAhArastadAbhavam |
dvitIyaM shIrNaparNAshI tRRitIyaM chAmbubhojanaH
shatAni sapta chaivAhaM vAyubhakShastadAbhavam
shlokas.88:
tataH prIto mahAdevaH sarvalokeshvaraH prabhuH |
shakrarUpaM sa kRRitvA tu sarvairdevagaNairvRRitaH
sahasrAkShastadA bhUtvA vajrapANirmahAyashAH
shlokas.89:
sudhAvadAtaM raktAkShaM stabdhakarNaM madotkaTam |
AveShTitakaraM raudraM chaturdaMShTraM mahAgajam
shlokas.90:
samAsthitashcha bhagavAndIpyamAnaH svatejasA |
AjagAma kirITI tu hArakeyUrabhUShitaH
shlokas.92:
tato mAmAha devendraH prItaste.ahaM dvijottama |
varaM vRRiNIShva mattastvaM yatte manasi vartate
shlokas.93:
shakrasya tu vachaH shrutvA nAhaM prItamanAbhavam |
abruvaM cha tadA kRRiShNa devarAjamidaM vachaH
shlokas.94:
nAhaM tvatto varaM kA~NkShe nAnyasmAdapi daivatAt |
mahAdevAdRRite saumya satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.95:
pashupativachanAdbhavAmi sadyaH; kRRimiratha vA tarurapyanekashAkhaH |
apashupativaraprasAdajA me; tribhuvanarAjyavibhUtirapyaniShTA
shlokas.96:
api kITaH pata~Ngo vA bhaveyaM sha~NkarAj~nayA |
na tu shakra tvayA dattaM trailokyamapi kAmaye
shlokas.98:
divasakarashashA~NkavahnidIptaM; tribhuvanasAramapAramAdyamekam |
ajaramamaramaprasAdya rudraM; jagati pumAniha ko labheta shAntim
shlokas.99:
shakra uvAcha||
kaH punastava heturvai Ishe kAraNakAraNe |
yena devAdRRite.anyasmAtprasAdaM nAbhikA~NkShasi
shlokas.100:
upamanyuruvAcha||
hetubhirvA kimanyaiste IshaH kAraNakAraNam |
na shushruma yadanyasya li~Ngamabhyarchyate suraiH
shlokas.101:
kasyAnyasya suraiH sarvairli~NgaM muktvA maheshvaram |
archyate.architapUrvaM vA brUhi yadyasti te shrutiH
shlokas.102:
yasya brahmA cha viShNushcha tvaM chApi saha daivataiH |
archayadhvaM sadA li~NgaM tasmAchChreShThatamo hi saH
shlokas.103:
tasmAdvaramahaM kA~NkShe nidhanaM vApi kaushika |
gachCha vA tiShTha vA shakra yatheShTaM balasUdana
shlokas.104:
kAmameSha varo me.astu shApo vApi maheshvarAt |
na chAnyAM devatAM kA~NkShe sarvakAmaphalAnyapi
shlokas.105:
evamuktvA tu devendraM duHkhAdAkulitendriyaH |
na prasIdati me rudraH kimetaditi chintayan
athApashyaM kShaNenaiva tamevairAvataM punaH
shlokas.107:
kRRiShNapuchChaM mahAkAyaM madhupi~Ngalalochanam |
jAmbUnadena dAmnA cha sarvataH samala~NkRRitam
shlokas.108:
raktAkShaM sumahAnAsaM sukarNaM sukaTItaTam |
supArshvaM vipulaskandhaM surUpaM chArudarshanam
shlokas.109:
kakudaM tasya chAbhAti skandhamApUrya viShThitam |
tuShAragirikUTAbhaM sitAbhrashikharopamam
shlokas.110:
tamAsthitashcha bhagavAndevadevaH sahomayA |
ashobhata mahAdevaH paurNamAsyAmivoDurAT
shlokas.111:
tasya tejobhavo vahniH sameghaH stanayitnumAn |
sahasramiva sUryANAM sarvamAvRRitya tiShThati
shlokas.112:
IshvaraH sumahAtejAH sa.nvartaka ivAnalaH |
yugAnte sarvabhUtAni didhakShuriva chodyataH
shlokas.113:
tejasA tu tadA vyApte durnirIkShye samantataH |
punarudvignahRRidayaH kimetaditi chintayam
shlokas.114:
muhUrtamiva tattejo vyApya sarvA disho dasha |
prashAntaM cha kShaNenaiva devadevasya mAyayA
shlokas.115:
athApashyaM sthitaM sthANuM bhagavantaM maheshvaram |
saurabheyagataM saumyaM vidhUmamiva pAvakam
sahitaM chArusarvA~NgyA pArvatyA parameshvaram
shlokas.116:
nIlakaNThaM mahAtmAnamasaktaM tejasAM nidhim |
aShTAdashabhujaM sthANuM sarvAbharaNabhUShitam
shlokas.119:
bAlendumukuTaM pANDuM sharachchandramivoditam |
tribhirnetraiH kRRitoddyotaM tribhiH sUryairivoditaiH
shlokas.120:
ashobhata cha devasya mAlA gAtre sitaprabhe |
jAtarUpamayaiH padmairgrathitA ratnabhUShitA
shlokas.121:
mUrtimanti tathAstrANi sarvatejomayAni cha |
mayA dRRiShTAni govinda bhavasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.122:
indrAyudhasahasrAbhaM dhanustasya mahAtmanaH |
pinAkamiti vikhyAtaM sa cha vai pannago mahAn
shlokas.123:
saptashIrSho mahAkAyastIkShNadaMShTro viSholbaNaH |
jyAveShTitamahAgrIvaH sthitaH puruShavigrahaH
shlokas.124:
sharashcha sUryasa~NkAshaH kAlAnalasamadyutiH |
yattadastraM mahAghoraM divyaM pAshupataM mahat
shlokas.128:
yena tattripuraM dagdhvA kShaNAdbhasmIkRRitaM purA |
shareNaikena govinda mahAdevena lIlayA
shlokas.129:
nirdadAha jagatkRRitsnaM trailokyaM sacharAcharam |
maheshvarabhujotsRRiShTaM nimeShArdhAnna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.130:
nAvadhyo yasya loke.asminbrahmaviShNusureShvapi |
tadahaM dRRiShTavA.nstAta AshcharyAdbhutamuttamam
shlokas.131:
guhyamastraM paraM chApi tattulyAdhikameva vA |
yattachChUlamiti khyAtaM sarvalokeShu shUlinaH
shlokas.132:
dArayedyanmahIM kRRitsnAM shoShayedvA mahodadhim |
saMharedvA jagatkRRitsnaM visRRiShTaM shUlapANinA
shlokas.133:
yauvanAshvo hato yena mAndhAtA sabalaH purA |
chakravartI mahAtejAstrilokavijayI nRRipaH
shlokas.134:
mahAbalo mahAvIryaH shakratulyaparAkramaH |
karasthenaiva govinda lavaNasyeha rakShasaH
shlokas.135:
tachChUlamatitIkShNAgraM subhImaM lomaharShaNam |
trishikhAM bhrukuTIM kRRitvA tarjamAnamiva sthitam
shlokas.136:
vidhUmaM sArchiShaM kRRiShNaM kAlasUryamivoditam |
sarpahastamanirdeshyaM pAshahastamivAntakam
dRRiShTavAnasmi govinda tadastraM rudrasaMnidhau
shlokas.137:
parashustIkShNadhArashcha datto rAmasya yaH purA |
mahAdevena tuShTena kShatriyANAM kShaya~NkaraH
kArtavIryo hato yena chakravartI mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.138:
triHsaptakRRitvaH pRRithivI yena niHkShatriyA kRRitA |
jAmadagnyena govinda rAmeNAkliShTakarmaNA
shlokas.140:
asa~NkhyeyAni chAstrANi tasya divyAni dhImataH |
prAdhAnyato mayaitAni kIrtitAni tavAnagha
shlokas.141:
savyadeshe tu devasya brahmA lokapitAmahaH |
divyaM vimAnamAsthAya ha.nsayuktaM manojavam
shlokas.142:
vAmapArshvagatashchaiva tathA nArAyaNaH sthitaH |
vainateyaM samAsthAya sha~NkhachakragadAdharaH
shlokas.143:
skando mayUramAsthAya sthito devyAH samIpataH |
shaktiM kaNThe samAdAya dvitIya iva pAvakaH
shlokas.144:
purastAchchaiva devasya nandiM pashyAmyavasthitam |
shUlaM viShTabhya tiShThantaM dvitIyamiva sha~Nkaram
shlokas.145:
svAyambhuvAdyA manavo bhRRigvAdyA RRiShayastathA |
