shakrAdyA devatAshchaiva sarva eva samabhyayuH
shlokas.146:
te.abhivAdya mahAtmAnaM parivArya samantataH |
astuvanvividhaiH stotrairmahAdevaM surAstadA
shlokas.147:
brahmA bhavaM tadA stunvanrathantaramudIrayan |
jyeShThasAmnA cha deveshaM jagau nArAyaNastadA
gRRiNa~nshakraH paraM brahma shatarudrIyamuttamam
shlokas.148:
brahmA nArAyaNashchaiva devarAjashcha kaushikaH |
ashobhanta mahAtmAnastrayastraya ivAgnayaH
shlokas.149:
teShAM madhyagato devo rarAja bhagavA~nshivaH |
sharadghanavinirmuktaH pariviShTa ivA.nshumAn
tato.ahamastuvaM devaM stavenAnena suvratam
shlokas.150:
namo devAdhidevAya mahAdevAya vai namaH |
shakrAya shakrarUpAya shakraveShadharAya cha
shlokas.151:
namaste vajrahastAya pi~NgalAyAruNAya cha |
pinAkapANaye nityaM khaDgashUladharAya cha
shlokas.152:
namaste kRRiShNavAsAya kRRiShNaku~nchitamUrdhaje |
kRRiShNAjinottarIyAya kRRiShNAShTamiratAya cha
shlokas.153:
shuklavarNAya shuklAya shuklAmbaradharAya cha |
shuklabhasmAvaliptAya shuklakarmaratAya cha
shlokas.154:
tvaM brahmA sarvadevAnAM rudrANAM nIlalohitaH |
AtmA cha sarvabhUtAnAM sA~Nkhye puruSha uchyase
shlokas.155:
RRiShabhastvaM pavitrANAM yoginAM niShkalaH shivaH |
AshramANAM gRRihasthastvamIshvarANAM maheshvaraH
kuberaH sarvayakShANAM kratUnAM viShNuruchyase
shlokas.156:
parvatAnAM mahAmerurnakShatrANAM cha chandramAH |
vasiShThastvamRRiShINAM cha grahANAM sUrya uchyase
shlokas.157:
AraNyAnAM pashUnAM cha siMhastvaM parameshvaraH |
grAmyANAM govRRiShashchAsi bhagavA.NllokapUjitaH
shlokas.158:
AdityAnAM bhavAnviShNurvasUnAM chaiva pAvakaH |
pakShiNAM vainateyashcha ananto bhujageShu cha
shlokas.159:
sAmavedashcha vedAnAM yajuShAM shatarudriyam |
sanatkumAro yogInAM sA~NkhyAnAM kapilo hyasi
shlokas.160:
shakro.asi marutAM deva pitR^INAM dharmarADasi |
brahmalokashcha lokAnAM gatInAM mokSha uchyase
shlokas.161:
kShIrodaH sAgarANAM cha shailAnAM himavAngiriH |
varNAnAM brAhmaNashchAsi viprANAM dIkShito dvijaH
Adistvamasi lokAnAM saMhartA kAla eva cha
shlokas.162:
yachchAnyadapi lokeShu sattvaM tejodhikaM smRRitam |
tatsarvaM bhagavAneva iti me nishchitA matiH
shlokas.163:
namaste bhagavandeva namaste bhaktavatsala |
yogeshvara namaste.astu namaste vishvasambhava
shlokas.164:
prasIda mama bhaktasya dInasya kRRipaNasya cha |
anaishvaryeNa yuktasya gatirbhava sanAtana
shlokas.165:
yaM chAparAdhaM kRRitavAnaj~nAnAtparameshvara |
madbhakta iti devesha tatsarvaM kShantumarhasi
shlokas.166:
mohitashchAsmi devesha tubhyaM rUpaviparyayAt |
tena nArghyaM mayA dattaM pAdyaM chApi sureshvara
shlokas.167:
evaM stutvAhamIshAnaM pAdyamarghyaM cha bhaktitaH |
kRRitA~njalipuTo bhUtvA sarvaM tasmai nyavedayam
shlokas.168:
tataH shItAmbusa.nyuktA divyagandhasamanvitA |
puShpavRRiShTiH shubhA tAta papAta mama mUrdhani
shlokas.169:
dundubhishcha tato divyastADito devaki~NkaraiH |
vavau cha mArutaH puNyaH shuchigandhaH sukhAvahaH
shlokas.170:
tataH prIto mahAdevaH sapatnIko vRRiShadhvajaH |
abravIttridashA.nstatra harShayanniva mAM tadA
shlokas.171:
pashyadhvaM tridashAH sarve upamanyormahAtmanaH |
mayi bhaktiM parAM divyAmekabhAvAdavasthitAm
shlokas.172:
evamuktAstataH kRRiShNa surAste shUlapANinA |
UchuH prA~njalayaH sarve namaskRRitvA vRRiShadhvajam
shlokas.173:
bhagavandevadevesha lokanAtha jagatpate |
labhatAM sarvakAmebhyaH phalaM tvatto dvijottamaH
shlokas.174:
evamuktastataH sharvaH surairbrahmAdibhistathA |
Aha mAM bhagavAnIshaH prahasanniva sha~NkaraH
shlokas.175:
vatsopamanyo prIto.asmi pashya mAM munipu~Ngava |
dRRiDhabhakto.asi viprarShe mayA jij~nAsito hyasi
shlokas.176:
anayA chaiva bhaktyA te atyarthaM prItimAnaham |
tasmAtsarvAndadAmyadya kAmA.nstava yathepshitAn
shlokas.177:
evamuktasya chaivAtha mahAdevena me vibho |
harShAdashrUNyavartanta lomaharShashcha jAyate
shlokas.178:
abruvaM cha tadA devaM harShagadgadayA girA |
jAnubhyAmavaniM gatvA praNamya cha punaH punaH
shlokas.179:
adya jAto hyahaM deva adya me saphalaM tapaH |
yanme sAkShAnmahAdevaH prasannastiShThate.agrataH
shlokas.180:
yaM na pashyanti chArAdhya devA hyamitavikramam |
tamahaM dRRiShTavAndevaM ko.anyo dhanyataro mayA
shlokas.181:
evaM dhyAyanti vidvA.nsaH paraM tattvaM sanAtanam |
ShaDvi.nshakamiti khyAtaM yatparAtparamakSharam
shlokas.182:
sa eSha bhagavAndevaH sarvatattvAdiravyayaH |
sarvatattvavidhAnaj~naH pradhAnapuruSheshvaraH
shlokas.183:
yo.asRRijaddakShiNAda~NgAdbrahmANaM lokasambhavam |
vAmapArshvAttathA viShNuM lokarakShArthamIshvaraH
yugAnte chaiva samprApte rudrama~NgAtsRRijatprabhuH
shlokas.184:
sa rudraH saMharankRRitsnaM jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam |
kAlo bhUtvA mahAtejAH sa.nvartaka ivAnalaH
shlokas.185:
eSha devo mahAdevo jagatsRRiShTvA charAcharam |
kalpAnte chaiva sarveShAM smRRitimAkShipya tiShThati
shlokas.186:
sarvagaH sarvabhUtAtmA sarvabhUtabhavodbhavaH |
Aste sarvagato nityamadRRishyaH sarvadaivataiH
shlokas.187:
yadi deyo varo mahyaM yadi tuShTashcha me prabhuH |
bhaktirbhavatu me nityaM shAshvatI tvayi sha~Nkara
shlokas.188:
atItAnAgataM chaiva vartamAnaM cha yadvibho |
jAnIyAmiti me buddhistvatprasAdAtsurottama
shlokas.189:
kShIrodanaM cha bhu~njIyAmakShayaM saha bAndhavaiH |
Ashrame cha sadA mahyaM sAMnidhyaM paramastu te
shlokas.190:
evamuktaH sa mAM prAha bhagavA.NllokapUjitaH |
maheshvaro mahAtejAshcharAcharaguruH prabhuH
shlokas.191:
ajarashchAmarashchaiva bhava duHkhavivarjitaH |
shIlavAnguNasampannaH sarvaj~naH priyadarshanaH
shlokas.192:
akShayaM yauvanaM te.astu tejashchaivAnalopamam |
kShIrodaH sAgarashchaiva yatra yatrechChase mune
shlokas.193:
tatra te bhavitA kAmaM sAMnidhyaM payaso nidheH |
kShIrodanaM cha bhu~NkShva tvamamRRitena samanvitam
shlokas.194:
bandhubhiH sahitaH kalpaM tato mAmupayAsyasi |
sAMnidhyamAshrame nityaM kariShyAmi dvijottama
shlokas.195:
tiShTha vatsa yathAkAmaM notkaNThAM kartumarhasi |
smRRitaH smRRitashcha te vipra sadA dAsyAmi darshanam
shlokas.196:
evamuktvA sa bhagavAnsUryakoTisamaprabhaH |
mameshAno varaM dattvA tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.197:
evaM dRRiShTo mayA kRRiShNa devadevaH samAdhinA |
tadavAptaM cha me sarvaM yaduktaM tena dhImatA
shlokas.198:
pratyakShaM chaiva te kRRiShNa pashya siddhAnvyavasthitAn |
RRiShInvidyAdharAnyakShAngandharvApsarasastathA

shlokas.1:
upamanyuruvAcha||
etAnsahasrashashchAnyAnsamanudhyAtavAnharaH |
kasmAtprasAdaM bhagavAnna kuryAttava mAdhava
shlokas.2:
tvAdRRishena hi devAnAM shlAghanIyaH samAgamaH |
brahmaNyenAnRRisha.nsena shraddadhAnena chApyuta
japyaM cha te pradAsyAmi yena drakShyasi sha~Nkaram
shlokas.3:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
abruvaM tamahaM brahma.nstvatprasAdAnmahAmune |
drakShye ditijasa~NghAnAM mardanaM tridasheshvaram
shlokas.4:
dine.aShTame cha vipreNa dIkShito.ahaM yathAvidhi |
daNDI muNDI kushI chIrI ghRRitAkto mekhalI tathA
shlokas.5:
mAsamekaM phalAhAro dvitIyaM salilAshanaH |
tRRitIyaM cha chaturthaM cha pa~nchamaM chAnilAshanaH
shlokas.6:
ekapAdena tiShTha.nshcha UrdhvabAhuratandritaH |
tejaH sUryasahasrasya apashyaM divi bhArata
shlokas.7:
tasya madhyagataM chApi tejasaH pANDunandana |
indrAyudhapinaddhA~NgaM vidyunmAlAgavAkShakam
nIlashailachayaprakhyaM balAkAbhUShitaM ghanam
shlokas.8:
tamAsthitashcha bhagavAndevyA saha mahAdyutiH |
tapasA tejasA kAntyA dIptayA saha bhAryayA
shlokas.9:
rarAja bhagavA.nstatra devyA saha maheshvaraH |
somena sahitaH sUryo yathA meghasthitastathA
shlokas.10:
saMhRRiShTaromA kaunteya vismayotphullalochanaH |
apashyaM devasa~NghAnAM gatimArtiharaM haram
shlokas.11:
kirITinaM gadinaM shUlapANiM; vyAghrAjinaM jaTilaM daNDapANim |
pinAkinaM vajriNaM tIkShNadaMShTraM; shubhA~NgadaM vyAlayaj~nopavItam
shlokas.12:
divyAM mAlAmurasAnekavarNAM; samudvahantaM gulphadeshAvalambAm |
chandraM yathA pariviShTaM sasandhyaM; varShAtyaye tadvadapashyamenam
shlokas.13:
pramathAnAM gaNaishchaiva samantAtparivAritam |
sharadIva suduShprekShyaM pariviShTaM divAkaram
shlokas.14:
ekAdasha tathA chainaM rudrANAM vRRiShavAhanam |
astuvanniyatAtmAnaH karmabhiH shubhakarmiNam
shlokas.15:
AdityA vasavaH sAdhyA vishvedevAstathAshvinau |
vishvAbhiH stutibhirdevaM vishvadevaM samastuvan
shlokas.16:
shatakratushcha bhagavAnviShNushchAditinandanau |
brahmA rathantaraM sAma Irayanti bhavAntike
shlokas.17:
yogIshvarAH subahavo yogadaM pitaraM gurum |
brahmarShayashcha sasutAstathA devarShayashcha vai
shlokas.18:
pRRithivI chAntarikShaM cha nakShatrANi grahAstathA |
mAsArdhamAsA RRitavo rAtryaH sa.nvatsarAH kShaNAH
shlokas.19:
muhUrtAshcha nimeShAshcha tathaiva yugaparyayAH |
divyA rAjannamasyanti vidyAH sarvA dishastathA
shlokas.20:
sanatkumAro vedAshcha itihAsAstathaiva cha |
marIchira~NgirA atriH pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH
shlokas.21:
manavaH saptasomashcha atharvA sabRRihaspatiH |
bhRRigurdakShaH kashyapashcha vasiShThaH kAshya eva cha
shlokas.22:
ChandA.nsi dIkShA yaj~nAshcha dakShiNAH pAvako haviH |
yaj~nopagAni dravyANi mUrtimanti yudhiShThira
shlokas.23:
prajAnAM patayaH sarve saritaH pannagA nagAH |
devAnAM mAtaraH sarvA devapatnyaH sakanyakAH
shlokas.24:
sahasrANi munInAM cha ayutAnyarbudAni cha |
namasyanti prabhuM shAntaM parvatAH sAgarA dishaH
shlokas.25:
gandharvApsarasashchaiva gItavAditrakovidAH |
divyatAnena gAyantaH stuvanti bhavamadbhutam
vidyAdharA dAnavAshcha guhyakA rAkShasAstathA
shlokas.26:
sarvANi chaiva bhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha |
namasyanti mahArAja vA~NmanaHkarmabhirvibhum
purastAdviShThitaH sharvo mamAsIttridasheshvaraH
shlokas.27:
purastAdviShThitaM dRRiShTvA mameshAnaM cha bhArata |
saprajApatishakrAntaM jaganmAmabhyudaikShata
shlokas.28:
IkShituM cha mahAdevaM na me shaktirabhUttadA |
tato mAmabravIddevaH pashya kRRiShNa vadasva cha
shlokas.29:
shirasA vandite deve devI prItA umAbhavat |
tato.ahamastuvaM sthANuM stutaM brahmAdibhiH suraiH
shlokas.30:
namo.astu te shAshvata sarvayone; brahmAdhipaM tvAmRRiShayo vadanti |
tapashcha sattvaM cha rajastamashcha; tvAmeva satyaM cha vadanti santaH
shlokas.31:
tvaM vai brahmA cha rudrashcha varuNo.agnirmanurbhavaH |
dhAtA tvaShTA vidhAtA cha tvaM prabhuH sarvatomukhaH
shlokas.32:
tvatto jAtAni bhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha |
tvamAdiH sarvabhUtAnAM saMhArashcha tvameva hi
shlokas.33:
ye chendriyArthAshcha manashcha kRRitsnaM; ye vAyavaH sapta tathaiva chAgniH |
ye vA divisthA devatAshchApi pu.nsAM; tasmAtparaM tvAmRRiShayo vadanti
shlokas.34:
vedA yaj~nAshcha somashcha dakShiNA pAvako haviH |
yaj~nopagaM cha yatki~nchidbhagavA.nstadasa.nshayam
shlokas.35:
iShTaM dattamadhItaM cha vratAni niyamAshcha ye |
hrIH kIrtiH shrIrdyutistuShTiH siddhishchaiva tvadarpaNA
shlokas.36:
kAmaH krodho bhayaM lobho madaH stambho.atha matsaraH |
Adhayo vyAdhayashchaiva bhagava.nstanayAstava
shlokas.37:
kRRitirvikAraH pralayaH pradhAnaM prabhavo.avyayaH |
manasaH paramA yoniH svabhAvashchApi shAshvataH
avyaktaH pAvana vibho sahasrA.nsho hiraNmayaH
shlokas.38:
AdirguNAnAM sarveShAM bhavAnvai jIvanAshrayaH |
mahAnAtmA matirbrahmA vishvaH shambhuH svayambhuvaH
shlokas.39:
buddhiH praj~nopalabdhishcha sa.nvitkhyAtirdhRRitiH smRRitiH |
paryAyavAchakaiH shabdairmahAnAtmA vibhAvyase
shlokas.40:
tvAM buddhvA brAhmaNo vidvAnna pramohaM nigachChati |
hRRidayaM sarvabhUtAnAM kShetraj~nastvamRRiShiShTutaH
shlokas.41:
sarvataHpANipAdastvaM sarvatokShishiromukhaH |
sarvataHshrutimA.Nlloke sarvamAvRRitya tiShThasi
shlokas.42:
phalaM tvamasi tigmA.nsho nimeShAdiShu karmasu |
tvaM vai prabhArchiH puruShaH sarvasya hRRidi sa.nsthitaH
aNimA laghimA prAptirIshAno jyotiravyayaH
shlokas.43:
tvayi buddhirmatirlokAH prapannAH sa.nshritAshcha ye |
dhyAnino nityayogAshcha satyasandhA jitendriyAH
shlokas.44:
yastvAM dhruvaM vedayate guhAshayaM; prabhuM purANaM puruShaM vishvarUpam |
hiraNmayaM buddhimatAM parAM gatiM; sa buddhimAnbuddhimatItya tiShThati
shlokas.45:
viditvA sapta sUkShmANi ShaDa~NgaM tvAM cha mUrtitaH |
pradhAnavidhiyogasthastvAmeva vishate budhaH
shlokas.46:
evamukte mayA pArtha bhave chArtivinAshane |
charAcharaM jagatsarvaM siMhanAdamathAkarot
shlokas.47:
saviprasa~NghAshcha surAsurAshcha; nAgAH pishAchAH pitaro vayA.nsi |
rakShogaNA bhUtagaNAshcha sarve; maharShayashchaiva tathA praNemuH
shlokas.48:
mama mUrdhni cha divyAnAM kusumAnAM sugandhinAm |
rAshayo nipatanti sma vAyushcha susukho vavau
shlokas.49:
nirIkShya bhagavAndevImumAM mAM cha jagaddhitaH |
shatakratuM chAbhivIkShya svayaM mAmAha sha~NkaraH
shlokas.50:
vidmaH kRRiShNa parAM bhaktimasmAsu tava shatruhan |
kriyatAmAtmanaH shreyaH prItirhi paramA tvayi
shlokas.51:
vRRiNIShvAShTau varAnkRRiShNa dAtAsmi tava sattama |
brUhi yAdavashArdUla yAnichChasi sudurlabhAn

shlokas.1:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
mUrdhnA nipatya niyatastejaHsaMnichaye tataH |
paramaM harShamAgamya bhagavantamathAbruvam
shlokas.2:
dharme dRRiDhatvaM yudhi shatrughAtaM; yashastathAgryaM paramaM balaM cha |
yogapriyatvaM tava saMnikarShaM; vRRiNe sutAnAM cha shataM shatAni
shlokas.4:
evamastviti tadvAkyaM mayoktaH prAha sha~NkaraH |
tato mAM jagato mAtA dharaNI sarvapAvanI |
uvAchomA praNihitA sharvANI tapasAM nidhiH
shlokas.5:
datto bhagavatA putraH sAmbo nAma tavAnagha |
matto.apyaShTau varAniShTAngRRihANa tvaM dadAmi te
praNamya shirasA sA cha mayoktA pANDunandana
shlokas.6:
dvijeShvakopaM pitRRitaH prasAdaM; shataM sutAnAmupabhogaM paraM cha |
kule prItiM mAtRRitashcha prasAdaM; shamaprAptiM pravRRiNe chApi dAkShyam
shlokas.7:
devyuvAcha||
evaM bhaviShyatyamaraprabhAva; nAhaM mRRiShA jAtu vade kadAchit |
bhAryAsahasrANi cha ShoDashaiva; tAsu priyatvaM cha tathAkShayatvam
shlokas.8:
prItiM chAgryAM bAndhavAnAM sakAshA;ddadAmi te vapuShaH kAmyatAM cha |
bhokShyante vai saptatirvai shatAni; gRRihe tubhyamatithInAM cha nityam
shlokas.9:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
evaM dattvA varAndevo mama devI cha bhArata |
antarhitaH kShaNe tasminsagaNo bhImapUrvaja
shlokas.10:
etadatyadbhutaM sarvaM brAhmaNAyAtitejase |
upamanyave mayA kRRitsnamAkhyAtaM kauravottama
shlokas.11:
namaskRRitvA tu sa prAha devadevAya suvrata |
nAsti sharvasamo dAne nAsti sharvasamo raNe
nAsti sharvasamo devo nAsti sharvasamA gatiH
shlokas.12:
RRiShirAsItkRRite tAta taNDirityeva vishrutaH |
dasha varShasahasrANi tena devaH samAdhinA
ArAdhito.abhUdbhaktena tasyodarkaM nishAmaya
shlokas.13:
sa dRRiShTavAnmahAdevamastauShIchcha stavairvibhum |
pavitrANAM pavitrastvaM gatirgatimatAM vara
atyugraM tejasAM tejastapasAM paramaM tapaH
shlokas.14:
vishvAvasuhiraNyAkShapuruhUtanamaskRRita |
bhUrikalyANada vibho purusatya namo.astu te
shlokas.15:
jAtImaraNabhIrUNAM yatInAM yatatAM vibho |
nirvANada sahasrA.nsho namaste.astu sukhAshraya
shlokas.16:
brahmA shatakraturviShNurvishvedevA maharShayaH |
na vidustvAM tu tattvena kuto vetsyAmahe vayam
shlokas.17:
tvattaH pravartate kAlastvayi kAlashcha lIyate |
kAlAkhyaH puruShAkhyashcha brahmAkhyashcha tvameva hi
shlokas.18:
tanavaste smRRitAstisraH purANaj~naiH surarShibhiH |
adhipauruShamadhyAtmamadhibhUtAdhidaivatam
adhilokyAdhivij~nAnamadhiyaj~nastvameva hi
shlokas.19:
tvAM viditvAtmadehasthaM durvidaM daivatairapi |
vidvA.nso yAnti nirmuktAH paraM bhAvamanAmayam
shlokas.20:
anichChatastava vibho janmamRRityuranekataH |
dvAraM tvaM svargamokShANAmAkSheptA tvaM dadAsi cha
shlokas.21:
tvameva mokShaH svargashcha kAmaH krodhastvameva hi |
sattvaM rajastamashchaiva adhashchordhvaM tvameva hi
shlokas.22:
brahmA viShNushcha rudrashcha skandendrau savitA yamaH |
varuNendU manurdhAtA vidhAtA tvaM dhaneshvaraH
shlokas.23:
bhUrvAyurjyotirApashcha vAgbuddhistvaM matirmanaH |
karma satyAnRRite chobhe tvamevAsti cha nAsti cha
shlokas.24:
indriyANIndriyArthAshcha tatparaM prakRRiterdhruvam |
vishvAvishvaparo bhAvashchintyAchintyastvameva hi
shlokas.25:
yachchaitatparamaM brahma yachcha tatparamaM padam |
yA gatiH sA~NkhyayogAnAM sa bhavAnnAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.26:
nUnamadya kRRitArthAH sma nUnaM prAptAH satAM gatim |
yAM gatiM prApnuvantIha j~nAnanirmalabuddhayaH
shlokas.27:
aho mUDhAH sma suchiramimaM kAlamachetasaH |
yanna vidmaH paraM devaM shAshvataM yaM vidurbudhAH
shlokas.28:
so.ayamAsAditaH sAkShAdbahubhirjanmabhirmayA |
bhaktAnugrahakRRiddevo yaM j~nAtvAmRRitamashnute
shlokas.29:
devAsuramanuShyANAM yachcha guhyaM sanAtanam |
guhAyAM nihitaM brahma durvij~neyaM surairapi
shlokas.30:
sa eSha bhagavAndevaH sarvakRRitsarvatomukhaH |
sarvAtmA sarvadarshI cha sarvagaH sarvaveditA
shlokas.31:
prANakRRitprANabhRRitprANI prANadaH prANinAM gatiH |
dehakRRiddehabhRRiddehI dehabhugdehinAM gatiH
shlokas.32:
adhyAtmagatiniShThAnAM dhyAninAmAtmavedinAm |
apunarmArakAmAnAM yA gatiH so.ayamIshvaraH
shlokas.33:
ayaM cha sarvabhUtAnAM shubhAshubhagatipradaH |
ayaM cha janmamaraNe vidadhyAtsarvajantuShu
shlokas.34:
ayaM cha siddhikAmAnAmRRiShINAM siddhidaH prabhuH |
ayaM cha mokShakAmAnAM dvijAnAM mokShadaH prabhuH
shlokas.35:
bhUrAdyAnsarvabhuvanAnutpAdya sadivaukasaH |
vibharti devastanubhiraShTAbhishcha dadAti cha
shlokas.36:
ataH pravartate sarvamasminsarvaM pratiShThitam |
asmi.nshcha pralayaM yAti ayamekaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.37:
ayaM sa satyakAmAnAM satyalokaH paraH satAm |
apavargashcha muktAnAM kaivalyaM chAtmavAdinAm
shlokas.38:
ayaM brahmAdibhiH siddhairguhAyAM gopitaH prabhuH |
devAsuramanuShyANAM na prakAsho bhavediti
shlokas.39:
taM tvAM devAsuranarAstattvena na vidurbhavam |
mohitAH khalvanenaiva hRRichChayena praveshitAH
shlokas.40:
ye chainaM samprapadyante bhaktiyogena bhArata |
teShAmevAtmanAtmAnaM darshayatyeSha hRRichChayaH
shlokas.41:
yaM j~nAtvA na punarjanma maraNaM chApi vidyate |
yaM viditvA paraM vedyaM veditavyaM na vidyate
shlokas.42:
yaM labdhvA paramaM lAbhaM manyate nAdhikaM punaH |
prANasUkShmAM parAM prAptimAgachChatyakShayAvahAm
shlokas.43:
yaM sA~NkhyA guNatattvaj~nAH sA~NkhyashAstravishAradAH |
sUkShmaj~nAnaratAH pUrvaM j~nAtvA muchyanti bandhanaiH
shlokas.44:
yaM cha vedavido vedyaM vedAnteShu pratiShThitam |
prANAyAmaparA nityaM yaM vishanti japanti cha
shlokas.45:
ayaM sa devayAnAnAmAdityo dvAramuchyate |
ayaM cha pitRRiyAnAnAM chandramA dvAramuchyate
shlokas.46:
eSha kAlagatishchitrA sa.nvatsarayugAdiShu |
bhAvAbhAvau tadAtve cha ayane dakShiNottare
shlokas.47:
evaM prajApatiH pUrvamArAdhya bahubhiH stavaiH |
varayAmAsa putratve nIlalohitasa~nj~nitam
shlokas.48:
RRigbhiryamanusha.nsanti tantre karmaNi bahvRRichaH |
yajurbhiryaM tridhA vedyaM juhvatyadhvaryavo.adhvare
shlokas.49:
sAmabhiryaM cha gAyanti sAmagAH shuddhabuddhayaH |
yaj~nasya paramA yoniH patishchAyaM paraH smRRitaH
shlokas.50:
rAtryahaHshrotranayanaH pakShamAsashirobhujaH |
RRituvIryastapodhairyo hyabdaguhyorupAdavAn
shlokas.51:
mRRityuryamo hutAshashcha kAlaH saMhAravegavAn |
kAlasya paramA yoniH kAlashchAyaM sanAtanaH
shlokas.52:
chandrAdityau sanakShatrau sagrahau saha vAyunA |
dhruvaH saptarShayashchaiva bhuvanAH sapta eva cha
shlokas.53:
pradhAnaM mahadavyaktaM visheShAntaM savaikRRitam |
brahmAdi stambaparyantaM bhUtAdi sadasachcha yat
shlokas.54:
aShTau prakRRitayashchaiva prakRRitibhyashcha yatparam |
asya devasya yadbhAgaM kRRitsnaM samparivartate
shlokas.55:
etatparamamAnandaM yattachChAshvatameva cha |
eShA gatirviraktAnAmeSha bhAvaH paraH satAm
shlokas.56:
etatpadamanudvignametadbrahma sanAtanam |
shAstravedA~NgaviduShAmetaddhyAnaM paraM padam
shlokas.57:
iyaM sA paramA kAShThA iyaM sA paramA kalA |
iyaM sA paramA siddhiriyaM sA paramA gatiH
shlokas.58:
iyaM sA paramA shAntiriyaM sA nirvRRitiH parA |
yaM prApya kRRitakRRityAH sma ityamanyanta vedhasaH
shlokas.59:
iyaM tuShTiriyaM siddhiriyaM shrutiriyaM smRRitiH |
adhyAtmagatiniShThAnAM viduShAM prAptiravyayA
shlokas.60:
yajatAM yaj~nakAmAnAM yaj~nairvipuladakShiNaiH |
yA gatirdaivatairdivyA sA gatistvaM sanAtana
shlokas.61:
japyahomavrataiH kRRichChrairniyamairdehapAtanaiH |
tapyatAM yA gatirdeva vairAje sA gatirbhavAn
shlokas.62:
karmanyAsakRRitAnAM cha viraktAnAM tatastataH |
yA gatirbrahmabhavane sA gatistvaM sanAtana
shlokas.63:
apunarmArakAmAnAM vairAgye vartatAM pare |
vikRRitInAM layAnAM cha sA gatistvaM sanAtana
shlokas.64:
j~nAnavij~nAnaniShThAnAM nirupAkhyA nira~njanA |
kaivalyA yA gatirdeva paramA sA gatirbhavAn
shlokas.65:
vedashAstrapurANoktAH pa~nchaitA gatayaH smRRitAH |
tvatprasAdAddhi labhyante na labhyante.anyathA vibho
shlokas.66:
iti taNDistapoyogAttuShTAveshAnamavyayam |
jagau cha paramaM brahma yatpurA lokakRRijjagau
shlokas.67:
brahmA shatakraturviShNurvishvedevA maharShayaH |
na vidustvAmiti tatastuShTaH provAcha taM shivaH
shlokas.68:
akShayashchAvyayashchaiva bhavitA duHkhavarjitaH |
yashasvI tejasA yukto divyaj~nAnasamanvitaH
shlokas.69:
RRiShINAmabhigamyashcha sUtrakartA sutastava |
matprasAdAddvijashreShTha bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.70:
kaM vA kAmaM dadAmyadya brUhi yadvatsa kA~NkShase |
prA~njaliH sa uvAchedaM tvayi bhaktirdRRiDhAstu me
shlokas.71:
evaM dattvA varaM devo vandyamAnaH surarShibhiH |
stUyamAnashcha vibudhaistatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.72:
antarhite bhagavati sAnuge yAdaveshvara |
RRiShirAshramamAgamya mamaitatproktavAniha
shlokas.73:
yAni cha prathitAnyAdau taNDirAkhyAtavAnmama |
nAmAni mAnavashreShTha tAni tvaM shRRiNu siddhaye
shlokas.74:
dasha nAmasahasrANi vedeShvAha pitAmahaH |
sharvasya shAstreShu tathA dasha nAmashatAni vai
shlokas.75:
guhyAnImAni nAmAni taNDirbhagavato.achyuta |
devaprasAdAddevesha purA prAha mahAtmane

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
tataH sa prayato bhUtvA mama tAta yudhiShThira |
prA~njaliH prAha viprarShirnAmasaMhAramAditaH
shlokas.2:
upamanyuruvAcha||
brahmaproktairRRiShiproktairvedavedA~NgasambhavaiH |
sarvalokeShu vikhyAtaiH sthANuM stoShyAmi nAmabhiH
shlokas.3:
mahadbhirvihitaiH satyaiH siddhaiH sarvArthasAdhakaiH |
RRiShiNA taNDinA bhaktyA kRRitairdevakRRitAtmanA
shlokas.4:
yathoktairlokavikhyAtairmunibhistattvadarshibhiH |
pravaraM prathamaM svargyaM sarvabhUtahitaM shubham
shrutaiH sarvatra jagati brahmalokAvatAritaiH
shlokas.5:
yattadrahasyaM paramaM brahmaproktaM sanAtanam |
vakShye yadukulashreShTha shRRiNuShvAvahito mama
shlokas.6:
paratvena bhavaM devaM bhaktastvaM parameshvaram |
tena te shrAvayiShyAmi yattadbrahma sanAtanam
shlokas.7:
na shakyaM vistarAtkRRitsnaM vaktuM sharvasya kenachit |
yuktenApi vibhUtInAmapi varShashatairapi
shlokas.8:
yasyAdirmadhyamantashcha surairapi na gamyate |
kastasya shaknuyAdvaktuM guNAnkArtsnyena mAdhava
shlokas.9:
kiM tu devasya mahataH sa~NkShiptArthapadAkSharam |
shaktitashcharitaM vakShye prasAdAttasya chaiva hi
shlokas.10:
aprApyeha tato.anuj~nAM na shakyaH stotumIshvaraH |
yadA tenAbhyanuj~nAtaH stuvatyeva sadA bhavam
shlokas.11:
anAdinidhanasyAhaM sarvayonermahAtmanaH |
nAmnAM ka~nchitsamuddeshaM vakShye hyavyaktayoninaH
shlokas.12:
varadasya vareNyasya vishvarUpasya dhImataH |
shRRiNu nAmasamuddeshaM yaduktaM padmayoninA
shlokas.13:
dasha nAmasahasrANi yAnyAha prapitAmahaH |
tAni nirmathya manasA dadhno ghRRitamivoddhRRitam
shlokas.14:
gireH sAraM yathA hema puShpAtsAraM yathA madhu |
ghRRitAtsAraM yathA maNDastathaitatsAramuddhRRitam
shlokas.15:
sarvapApmApahamidaM chaturvedasamanvitam |
prayatnenAdhigantavyaM dhAryaM cha prayatAtmanA
shAntikaM pauShTikaM chaiva rakShoghnaM pAvanaM mahat
shlokas.16:
idaM bhaktAya dAtavyaM shraddadhAnAstikAya cha |
nAshraddadhAnarUpAya nAstikAyAjitAtmane
shlokas.17:
yashchAbhyasUyate devaM bhUtAtmAnaM pinAkinam |
sa kRRiShNa narakaM yAti saha pUrvaiH sahAnugaiH
shlokas.18:
idaM dhyAnamidaM yogamidaM dhyeyamanuttamam |
idaM japyamidaM j~nAnaM rahasyamidamuttamam
idaM j~nAtvAntakAle.api gachCheddhi paramAM gatim
shlokas.19:
pavitraM ma~NgalaM puNyaM kalyANamidamuttamam |
nigadiShye mahAbAho stavAnAmuttamaM stavam
shlokas.20:
idaM brahmA purA kRRitvA sarvalokapitAmahaH |
sarvastavAnAM divyAnAM rAjatve samakalpayat
shlokas.21:
tadAprabhRRiti chaivAyamIshvarasya mahAtmanaH |
stavarAjeti vikhyAto jagatyamarapUjitaH
brahmalokAdayaM chaiva stavarAjo.avatAritaH
shlokas.22:
yasmAttaNDiH purA prAha tena taNDikRRito.abhavat |
svargAchchaivAtra bhUlokaM taNDinA hyavatAritaH
shlokas.23:
sarvama~Ngalama~NgalyaM sarvapApapraNAshanam |
nigadiShye mahAbAho stavAnAmuttamaM stavam
shlokas.24:
brahmaNAmapi yadbrahma parANAmapi yatparam |
tejasAmapi yattejastapasAmapi yattapaH
shlokas.25:
shAntInAmapi yA shAntirdyutInAmapi yA dyutiH |
dAntAnAmapi yo dAnto dhImatAmapi yA cha dhIH
shlokas.26:
devAnAmapi yo devo munInAmapi yo muniH |
yaj~nAnAmapi yo yaj~naH shivAnAmapi yaH shivaH
shlokas.27:
rudrANAmapi yo rudraH prabhuH prabhavatAmapi |
yoginAmapi yo yogI kAraNAnAM cha kAraNam
shlokas.28:
yato lokAH sambhavanti na bhavanti yataH punaH |
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtasya harasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.29:
aShTottarasahasraM tu nAmnAM sharvasya me shRRiNu |
yachChrutvA manujashreShTha sarvAnkAmAnavApsyasi
shlokas.30:
sthiraH sthANuH prabhurbhAnuH pravaro varado varaH |
sarvAtmA sarvavikhyAtaH sarvaH sarvakaro bhavaH
shlokas.31:
jaTI charmI shikhaNDI cha sarvA~NgaH sarvabhAvanaH |
harishcha hariNAkShashcha sarvabhUtaharaH prabhuH
shlokas.32:
pravRRittishcha nivRRittishcha niyataH shAshvato dhruvaH |
shmashAnachArI bhagavAnkhacharo gocharo.ardanaH
shlokas.33:
abhivAdyo mahAkarmA tapasvI bhUtabhAvanaH |
unmattaveshaprachChannaH sarvalokaprajApatiH
shlokas.34:
mahArUpo mahAkAyaH sarvarUpo mahAyashAH |
mahAtmA sarvabhUtashcha virUpo vAmano manuH
shlokas.35:
lokapAlo.antarhitAtmA prasAdo hayagardabhiH |
pavitrashcha mahA.nshchaiva niyamo niyamAshrayaH
shlokas.36:
sarvakarmA svayambhUshcha AdirAdikaro nidhiH |
sahasrAkSho virUpAkShaH somo nakShatrasAdhakaH
shlokas.37:
chandrasUryagatiH keturgraho grahapatirvaraH |
adriradryAlayaH kartA mRRigabANArpaNo.anaghaH
shlokas.38:
mahAtapA ghoratapA adIno dInasAdhakaH |
sa.nvatsarakaro mantraH pramANaM paramaM tapaH
shlokas.39:
yogI yojyo mahAbIjo mahAretA mahAtapAH |
suvarNaretAH sarvaj~naH subIjo vRRiShavAhanaH
shlokas.40:
dashabAhustvanimiSho nIlakaNTha umApatiH |
vishvarUpaH svaya.nshreShTho balavIro balo gaNaH
shlokas.41:
gaNakartA gaNapatirdigvAsAH kAmya eva cha |
pavitraM paramaM mantraH sarvabhAvakaro haraH
shlokas.42:
kamaNDaludharo dhanvI bANahastaH kapAlavAn |
ashanI shataghnI khaDgI paTTishI chAyudhI mahAn
shlokas.43:
sruvahastaH surUpashcha tejastejaskaro nidhiH |
uShNIShI cha suvaktrashcha udagro vinatastathA
shlokas.44:
dIrghashcha harikeshashcha sutIrthaH kRRiShNa eva cha |
sRRigAlarUpaH sarvArtho muNDaH kuNDI kamaNDaluH
shlokas.45:
ajashcha mRRigarUpashcha gandhadhArI kapardyapi |
UrdhvaretA Urdhvali~Nga UrdhvashAyI nabhastalaH
shlokas.46:
trijaTashchIravAsAshcha rudraH senApatirvibhuH |
ahashcharo.atha naktaM cha tigmamanyuH suvarchasaH
shlokas.47:
gajahA daityahA loko lokadhAtA guNAkaraH |
siMhashArdUlarUpashcha ArdracharmAmbarAvRRitaH
shlokas.48:
kAlayogI mahAnAdaH sarvavAsashchatuShpathaH |
nishAcharaH pretachArI bhUtachArI maheshvaraH
shlokas.49:
bahubhUto bahudhanaH sarvAdhAro.amito gatiH |
nRRityapriyo nityanarto nartakaH sarvalAsakaH
shlokas.50:
ghoro mahAtapAH pAsho nityo giricharo nabhaH |
sahasrahasto vijayo vyavasAyo hyaninditaH
shlokas.51:
amarShaNo marShaNAtmA yaj~nahA kAmanAshanaH |
dakShayaj~nApahArI cha susaho madhyamastathA
shlokas.52:
tejopahArI balahA mudito.artho jito varaH |
gambhIraghoSho gambhIro gambhIrabalavAhanaH
shlokas.53:
nyagrodharUpo nyagrodho vRRikShakarNasthitirvibhuH |
tIkShNatApashcha haryashvaH sahAyaH karmakAlavit
shlokas.54:
viShNuprasAdito yaj~naH samudro vaDavAmukhaH |
hutAshanasahAyashcha prashAntAtmA hutAshanaH
shlokas.55:
ugratejA mahAtejA jayo vijayakAlavit |
jyotiShAmayanaM siddhiH sandhirvigraha eva cha
shlokas.56:
shikhI daNDI jaTI jvAlI mUrtijo mUrdhago balI |
vaiNavI paNavI tAlI kAlaH kAlakaTa~NkaTaH
shlokas.57:
nakShatravigrahavidhirguNavRRiddhirlayo.agamaH |
prajApatirdishAbAhurvibhAgaH sarvatomukhaH
shlokas.58:
vimochanaH suragaNo hiraNyakavachodbhavaH |
meDhrajo balachArI cha mahAchArI stutastathA
shlokas.59:
sarvatUryaninAdI cha sarvavAdyaparigrahaH |
vyAlarUpo bilAvAsI hemamAlI tara~Ngavit
shlokas.60:
tridashastrikAladhRRikkarmasarvabandhavimochanaH |
bandhanastvasurendrANAM yudhi shatruvinAshanaH
shlokas.61:
sA~NkhyaprasAdo durvAsAH sarvasAdhuniShevitaH |
praskandano vibhAgashcha atulyo yaj~nabhAgavit
shlokas.62:
sarvAvAsaH sarvachArI durvAsA vAsavo.amaraH |
hemo hemakaro yaj~naH sarvadhArI dharottamaH
shlokas.63:
lohitAkSho mahAkShashcha vijayAkSho vishAradaH |
sa~Ngraho nigrahaH kartA sarpachIranivAsanaH
shlokas.64:
mukhyo.amukhyashcha dehashcha deharddhiH sarvakAmadaH |
sarvakAlaprasAdashcha subalo balarUpadhRRik
shlokas.65:
AkAshanidhirUpashcha nipAtI uragaH khagaH |
raudrarUpoM.ashurAdityo vasurashmiH suvarchasI
shlokas.66:
vasuvego mahAvego manovego nishAcharaH |
sarvAvAsI shriyAvAsI upadeshakaro haraH
shlokas.67:
munirAtmapatirloke sambhojyashcha sahasradaH |
pakShI cha pakShirUpI cha atidIpto vishAM patiH
shlokas.68:
unmAdo madanAkAro arthArthakararomashaH |
vAmadevashcha vAmashcha prAgdakShiNyashcha vAmanaH
shlokas.69:
siddhayogApahArI cha siddhaH sarvArthasAdhakaH |
bhikShushcha bhikShurUpashcha viShANI mRRiduravyayaH
shlokas.70:
mahAseno vishAkhashcha ShaShTibhAgo gavAM patiH |
vajrahastashcha viShkambhI chamUstambhana eva cha
shlokas.71:
RRiturRRitukaraH kAlo madhurmadhukaro.achalaH |
vAnaspatyo vAjaseno nityamAshramapUjitaH
shlokas.72:
brahmachArI lokachArI sarvachArI suchAravit |
IshAna IshvaraH kAlo nishAchArI pinAkadhRRik
shlokas.73:
nandIshvarashcha nandI cha nandano nandivardhanaH |
bhagasyAkShinihantA cha kAlo brahmavidAM varaH
shlokas.74:
chaturmukho mahAli~NgashchAruli~Ngastathaiva cha |
li~NgAdhyakShaH surAdhyakSho lokAdhyakSho yugAvahaH
shlokas.75:
bIjAdhyakSho bIjakartA adhyAtmAnugato balaH |
itihAsakaraH kalpo gautamo.atha jaleshvaraH
shlokas.76:
dambho hyadambho vaidambho vashyo vashyakaraH kaviH |
lokakartA pashupatirmahAkartA mahauShadhiH
shlokas.77:
akSharaM paramaM brahma balavA~nshakra eva cha |
nItirhyanItiH shuddhAtmA shuddho mAnyo manogatiH
shlokas.78:
bahuprasAdaH svapano darpaNo.atha tvamitrajit |
vedakAraH sUtrakAro vidvAnsamaramardanaH
shlokas.79:
mahAmeghanivAsI cha mahAghoro vashIkaraH |
agnijvAlo mahAjvAlo atidhUmro huto haviH
shlokas.80:
vRRiShaNaH sha~Nkaro nityo varchasvI dhUmaketanaH |
nIlastathA~Ngalubdhashcha shobhano niravagrahaH
shlokas.81:
svastidaH svastibhAvashcha bhAgI bhAgakaro laghuH |
utsa~Ngashcha mahA~Ngashcha mahAgarbhaH paro yuvA
shlokas.82:
kRRiShNavarNaH suvarNashcha indriyaH sarvadehinAm |
mahApAdo mahAhasto mahAkAyo mahAyashAH
shlokas.83:
mahAmUrdhA mahAmAtro mahAnetro digAlayaH |
mahAdanto mahAkarNo mahAmeDhro mahAhanuH
shlokas.84:
mahAnAso mahAkamburmahAgrIvaH shmashAnadhRRik |
mahAvakShA mahorasko antarAtmA mRRigAlayaH
shlokas.85:
lambano lambitoShThashcha mahAmAyaH payonidhiH |
mahAdanto mahAdaMShTro mahAjihvo mahAmukhaH
shlokas.86:
mahAnakho mahAromA mahAkesho mahAjaTaH |
asapatnaH prasAdashcha pratyayo girisAdhanaH
shlokas.87:
snehano.asnehanashchaiva ajitashcha mahAmuniH |
vRRikShAkAro vRRikShaketuranalo vAyuvAhanaH
shlokas.88:
maNDalI merudhAmA cha devadAnavadarpahA |
atharvashIrShaH sAmAsya RRiksahasrAmitekShaNaH
shlokas.89:
yajuHpAdabhujo guhyaH prakAsho ja~NgamastathA |
amoghArthaH prasAdashcha abhigamyaH sudarshanaH
shlokas.90:
upahArapriyaH sharvaH kanakaH kA~nchanaH sthiraH |
nAbhirnandikaro bhAvyaH puShkarasthapatiH sthiraH
shlokas.91:
dvAdashastrAsanashchAdyo yaj~no yaj~nasamAhitaH |
naktaM kalishcha kAlashcha makaraH kAlapUjitaH
shlokas.92:
sagaNo gaNakArashcha bhUtabhAvanasArathiH |
bhasmashAyI bhasmagoptA bhasmabhUtastarurgaNaH
shlokas.93:
agaNashchaiva lopashcha mahAtmA sarvapUjitaH |
sha~Nkustrisha~NkuH sampannaH shuchirbhUtaniShevitaH
shlokas.94:
AshramasthaH kapotastho vishvakarmA patirvaraH |
shAkho vishAkhastAmroShTho hyambujAlaH sunishchayaH
shlokas.95:
kapilo.akapilaH shUra Ayushchaiva paro.aparaH |
gandharvo hyaditistArkShyaH suvij~neyaH susArathiH
shlokas.96:
parashvadhAyudho deva arthakArI subAndhavaH |
tumbavINI mahAkopa UrdhvaretA jaleshayaH
shlokas.97:
ugro va.nshakaro va.nsho va.nshanAdo hyaninditaH |
sarvA~NgarUpo mAyAvI suhRRido hyanilo.analaH
shlokas.98:
bandhano bandhakartA cha subandhanavimochanaH |
sa yaj~nAriH sa kAmArirmahAdaMShTro mahAyudhaH
shlokas.99:
bAhustvaninditaH sharvaH sha~NkaraH sha~Nkaro.adhanaH |
amaresho mahAdevo vishvadevaH surArihA
shlokas.100:
ahirbudhno nirRRitishcha chekitAno haristathA |
ajaikapAchcha kApAlI trisha~NkurajitaH shivaH
shlokas.101:
dhanvantarirdhUmaketuH skando vaishravaNastathA |
dhAtA shakrashcha viShNushcha mitrastvaShTA dhruvo dharaH
shlokas.102:
prabhAvaH sarvago vAyuraryamA savitA raviH |
udagrashcha vidhAtA cha mAndhAtA bhUtabhAvanaH
shlokas.103:
ratitIrthashcha vAgmI cha sarvakAmaguNAvahaH |
padmagarbho mahAgarbhashchandravaktro manoramaH
shlokas.104:
balavA.nshchopashAntashcha purANaH puNyacha~nchurI |
kurukartA kAlarUpI kurubhUto maheshvaraH
shlokas.105:
sarvAshayo darbhashAyI sarveShAM prANinAM patiH |
devadevamukho.asaktaH sadasatsarvaratnavit
shlokas.106:
kailAsashikharAvAsI himavadgirisa.nshrayaH |
kUlahArI kUlakartA bahuvidyo bahupradaH
shlokas.107:
vaNijo vardhano vRRikSho nakulashchandanashChadaH |
sAragrIvo mahAjatruralolashcha mahauShadhaH
shlokas.108:
siddhArthakArI siddhArthashChandovyAkaraNottaraH |
siMhanAdaH siMhadaMShTraH siMhagaH siMhavAhanaH
shlokas.109:
prabhAvAtmA jagatkAlastAlo lokahitastaruH |
sAra~Ngo navachakrA~NgaH ketumAlI sabhAvanaH
shlokas.110:
bhUtAlayo bhUtapatirahorAtramaninditaH |
vAhitA sarvabhUtAnAM nilayashcha vibhurbhavaH
shlokas.111:
amoghaH sa.nyato hyashvo bhojanaH prANadhAraNaH |
dhRRitimAnmatimAndakShaH satkRRitashcha yugAdhipaH
shlokas.112:
gopAlirgopatirgrAmo gocharmavasano haraH |
hiraNyabAhushcha tathA guhApAlaH praveshinAm
shlokas.113:
pratiShThAyI mahAharSho jitakAmo jitendriyaH |
gandhArashcha surAlashcha tapaHkarmaratirdhanuH
shlokas.115:
AvedanIya AveshaH sarvagandhasukhAvahaH |
toraNastAraNo vAyuH paridhAvati chaikataH
shlokas.116:
sa.nyogo vardhano vRRiddho mahAvRRiddho gaNAdhipaH |
nitya AtmasahAyashcha devAsurapatiH patiH
shlokas.117:
yuktashcha yuktabAhushcha dvividhashcha suparvaNaH |
AShADhashcha suShADhashcha dhruvo harihaNo haraH
shlokas.118:
vapurAvartamAnebhyo vasushreShTho mahApathaH |
shirohArI vimarShashcha sarvalakShaNabhUShitaH
shlokas.119:
akShashcha rathayogI cha sarvayogI mahAbalaH |
samAmnAyo.asamAmnAyastIrthadevo mahArathaH
shlokas.120:
nirjIvo jIvano mantraH shubhAkSho bahukarkashaH |
ratnaprabhUto raktA~Ngo mahArNavanipAnavit
shlokas.121:
mUlo vishAlo hyamRRito vyaktAvyaktastaponidhiH |
ArohaNo nirohashcha shailahArI mahAtapAH
shlokas.122:
senAkalpo mahAkalpo yugAyugakaro hariH |
yugarUpo mahArUpaH pavano gahano nagaH
shlokas.123:
nyAyanirvApaNaH pAdaH paNDito hyachalopamaH |
bahumAlo mahAmAlaH sumAlo bahulochanaH
shlokas.124:
vistAro lavaNaH kUpaH kusumaH saphalodayaH |
vRRiShabho vRRiShabhA~NkA~Ngo maNibilvo jaTAdharaH
shlokas.125:
indurvisargaH sumukhaH suraH sarvAyudhaH sahaH |
nivedanaH sudhAjAtaH sugandhAro mahAdhanuH
shlokas.126:
gandhamAlI cha bhagavAnutthAnaH sarvakarmaNAm |
manthAno bahulo bAhuH sakalaH sarvalochanaH
shlokas.127:
tarastAlI karastAlI UrdhvasaMhanano vahaH |
ChatraM suchChatro vikhyAtaH sarvalokAshrayo mahAn
shlokas.128:
muNDo virUpo vikRRito daNDimuNDo vikurvaNaH |
haryakShaH kakubho vajrI dIptajihvaH sahasrapAt
shlokas.129:
sahasramUrdhA devendraH sarvadevamayo guruH |
sahasrabAhuH sarvA~NgaH sharaNyaH sarvalokakRRit
shlokas.130:
pavitraM trimadhurmantraH kaniShThaH kRRiShNapi~NgalaH |
brahmadaNDavinirmAtA shataghnI shatapAshadhRRik
shlokas.131:
padmagarbho mahAgarbho brahmagarbho jalodbhavaH |
gabhastirbrahmakRRidbrahmA brahmavidbrAhmaNo gatiH
shlokas.132:
anantarUpo naikAtmA tigmatejAH svayambhuvaH |
UrdhvagAtmA pashupatirvAtaraMhA manojavaH
shlokas.133:
chandanI padmamAlAgryaH surabhyuttaraNo naraH |
karNikAramahAsragvI nIlamauliH pinAkadhRRik
shlokas.134:
umApatirumAkAnto jAhnavIdhRRigumAdhavaH |
varo varAho varado vareshaH sumahAsvanaH
shlokas.135:
mahAprasAdo damanaH shatruhA shvetapi~NgalaH |
prItAtmA prayatAtmA cha sa.nyatAtmA pradhAnadhRRik
shlokas.136:
sarvapArshvasutastArkShyo dharmasAdhAraNo varaH |
charAcharAtmA sUkShmAtmA suvRRiSho govRRiSheshvaraH
shlokas.137:
sAdhyarShirvasurAdityo vivasvAnsavitA mRRiDaH |
vyAsaH sarvasya sa~NkShepo vistaraH paryayo nayaH
shlokas.138:
RRituH sa.nvatsaro mAsaH pakShaH sa~NkhyAsamApanaH |
kalA kAShThA lavo mAtrA muhUrto.ahaH kShapAH kShaNAH
shlokas.139:
vishvakShetraM prajAbIjaM li~NgamAdyastvaninditaH |
sadasadvyaktamavyaktaM pitA mAtA pitAmahaH
shlokas.140:
svargadvAraM prajAdvAraM mokShadvAraM triviShTapam |
nirvANaM hlAdanaM chaiva brahmalokaH parA gatiH
shlokas.144:
sarvadevamayo.achintyo devatAtmAtmasambhavaH |
udbhidastrikramo vaidyo virajo virajombaraH
shlokas.145:
IDyo hastI suravyAghro devasiMho nararShabhaH |
vibudhAgravaraH shreShThaH sarvadevottamottamaH
shlokas.146:
prayuktaH shobhano vajra IshAnaH prabhuravyayaH |
guruH kAnto nijaH sargaH pavitraH sarvavAhanaH
shlokas.147:
shRRi~NgI shRRi~Ngapriyo babhrU rAjarAjo nirAmayaH |
abhirAmaH suragaNo virAmaH sarvasAdhanaH
shlokas.148:
lalATAkSho vishvadeho hariNo brahmavarchasaH |
sthAvarANAM patishchaiva niyamendriyavardhanaH
shlokas.149:
siddhArthaH sarvabhUtArtho.achintyaH satyavrataH shuchiH |
vratAdhipaH paraM brahma muktAnAM paramA gatiH
shlokas.150:
vimukto muktatejAshcha shrImA~nshrIvardhano jagat |
yathApradhAnaM bhagavAniti bhaktyA stuto mayA
shlokas.151:
yaM na brahmAdayo devA viduryaM na maharShayaH |
taM stavyamarchyaM vandyaM cha kaH stoShyati jagatpatim
shlokas.152:
bhaktimeva puraskRRitya mayA yaj~napatirvasuH |
tato.abhyanuj~nAM prApyaiva stuto matimatAM varaH
shlokas.153:
shivamebhiH stuvandevaM nAmabhiH puShTivardhanaiH |
nityayuktaH shuchirbhUtvA prApnotyAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.154:
etaddhi paramaM brahma svayaM gItaM svayambhuvA |
RRiShayashchaiva devAshcha stuvantyetena tatparam
shlokas.155:
stUyamAno mahAdevaH prIyate chAtmanAmabhiH |
bhaktAnukampI bhagavAnAtmasa.nsthAnkaroti tAn
shlokas.156:
tathaiva cha manuShyeShu ye manuShyAH pradhAnataH |
AstikAH shraddadhAnAshcha bahubhirjanmabhiH stavaiH
shlokas.157:
jAgratashcha svapantashcha vrajantaH pathi sa.nsthitAH |
stuvanti stUyamAnAshcha tuShyanti cha ramanti cha
janmakoTisahasreShu nAnAsa.nsArayoniShu
shlokas.158:
jantorvishuddhapApasya bhave bhaktiH prajAyate |
utpannA cha bhave bhaktirananyA sarvabhAvataH
shlokas.159:
kAraNaM bhAvitaM tasya sarvamuktasya sarvataH |
etaddeveShu duShprApaM manuShyeShu na labhyate
shlokas.160:
nirvighnA nishchalA rudre bhaktiravyabhichAriNI |
tasyaiva cha prasAdena bhaktirutpadyate nRRiNAm
yayA yAnti parAM siddhiM tadbhAvagatachetasaH
shlokas.161:
ye sarvabhAvopagatAH paratvenAbhavannarAH |
prapannavatsalo devaH sa.nsArAttAnsamuddharet
shlokas.162:
evamanye na kurvanti devAH sa.nsAramochanam |
manuShyANAM mahAdevAdanyatrApi tapobalAt
shlokas.163:
iti tenendrakalpena bhagavAnsadasatpatiH |
kRRittivAsAH stutaH kRRiShNa taNDinA shuddhabuddhinA
shlokas.164:
stavametaM bhagavato brahmA svayamadhArayat |
brahmA provAcha shakrAya shakraH provAcha mRRityave
shlokas.165:
mRRityuH provAcha rudrANAM rudrebhyastaNDimAgamat |
mahatA tapasA prAptastaNDinA brahmasadmani
shlokas.166:
taNDiH provAcha shukrAya gautamAyAha bhArgavaH |
vaivasvatAya manave gautamaH prAha mAdhava
shlokas.167:
nArAyaNAya sAdhyAya manuriShTAya dhImate |
yamAya prAha bhagavAnsAdhyo nArAyaNo.achyutaH
shlokas.168:
nAchiketAya bhagavAnAha vaivasvato yamaH |
mArkaNDeyAya vArShNeya nAchiketo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.169:
mArkaNDeyAnmayA prAptaM niyamena janArdana |
tavApyahamamitraghna stavaM dadmyadya vishrutam
svargyamArogyamAyuShyaM dhanyaM balyaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.170:
na tasya vighnaM kurvanti dAnavA yakSharAkShasAH |
pishAchA yAtudhAnAshcha guhyakA bhujagA api
shlokas.171:
yaH paTheta shuchirbhUtvA brahmachArI jitendriyaH |
abhagnayogo varShaM tu so.ashvamedhaphalaM labhet

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
mahAyogI tataH prAha kRRiShNadvaipAyano muniH |
paThasva putra bhadraM te prIyatAM te maheshvaraH
shlokas.2:
purA putra mayA merau tapyatA paramaM tapaH |
putrahetormahArAja stava eSho.anukIrtitaH
shlokas.3:
labdhavAnasmi tAnkAmAnahaM vai pANDunandana |
tathA tvamapi sharvAddhi sarvAnkAmAnavApsyasi
shlokas.4:
chatuHshIrShastataH prAha shakrasya dayitaH sakhA |
AlambAyana ityeva vishrutaH karuNAtmakaH
shlokas.5:
mayA gokarNamAsAdya tapastaptvA shataM samAH |
ayonijAnAM dAntAnAM dharmaj~nAnAM suvarchasAm
shlokas.6:
ajarANAmaduHkhAnAM shatavarShasahasriNAm |
labdhaM putrashataM sharvAtpurA pANDunRRipAtmaja
shlokas.7:
vAlmIkishchApi bhagavAnyudhiShThiramabhAShata |
vivAde sAmni munibhirbrahmaghno vai bhavAniti
uktaH kShaNena chAviShTastenAdharmeNa bhArata
shlokas.8:
so.ahamIshAnamanaghamastauShaM sharaNaM gataH |
muktashchAsmyavashaH pApAttato duHkhavinAshanaH
Aha mAM tripuraghno vai yashaste.agryaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.9:
jAmadagnyashcha kaunteyamAha dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
RRiShimadhye sthitastAta tapanniva vibhAvasuH
shlokas.10:
pitRRivipravadhenAhamArto vai pANDavAgraja |
shuchirbhUtvA mahAdevaM gatavA~nsharaNaM nRRipa
shlokas.11:
nAmabhishchAstuvaM devaM tatastuShTo.abhavadbhavaH |
parashuM cha dadau devo divyAnyastrANi chaiva me
shlokas.12:
pApaM na bhavitA te.adya ajeyashcha bhaviShyasi |
na te prabhavitA mRRityuryashasvI cha bhaviShyasi
shlokas.13:
Aha mAM bhagavAnevaM shikhaNDI shivavigrahaH |
yadavAptaM cha me sarvaM prasAdAttasya dhImataH
shlokas.14:
asito devalashchaiva prAha pANDusutaM nRRipam |
shApAchChakrasya kaunteya chito dharmo.anashanmama
tanme dharmaM yashashchAgryamAyushchaivAdadadbhavaH
shlokas.15:
RRiShirgRRitsamado nAma shakrasya dayitaH sakhA |
prAhAjamIDhaM bhagavAnbRRihaspatisamadyutiH
shlokas.16:
vasiShTho nAma bhagavA.nshchAkShuShasya manoH sutaH |
shatakratorachintyasya satre varShasahasrike
vartamAne.abravIdvAkyaM sAmni hyuchchArite mayA
shlokas.17:
rathantaraM dvijashreShTha na samyagiti vartate |
samIkShasva punarbuddhyA harShaM tyaktvA dvijottama
ayaj~navAhinaM pApamakArShIstvaM sudurmate
shlokas.18:
evamuktvA mahAkrodhAtprAha ruShTaH punarvachaH |
praj~nayA rahito duHkhI nityaM bhIto vanecharaH
dasha varShasahasrANi dashAShTau cha shatAni cha
shlokas.19:
naShTapAnIyayavase mRRigairanyaishcha varjite |
ayaj~nIyadrume deshe rurusiMhaniShevite
bhavitA tvaM mRRigaH krUro mahAduHkhasamanvitaH
shlokas.20:
tasya vAkyasya nidhane pArtha jAto hyahaM mRRigaH |
tato mAM sharaNaM prAptaM prAha yogI maheshvaraH
shlokas.21:
ajarashchAmarashchaiva bhavitA duHkhavarjitaH |
sAmyaM samastu te saukhyaM yuvayorvardhatAM kratuH
shlokas.22:
anugrahAnevameSha karoti bhagavAnvibhuH |
paraM dhAtA vidhAtA cha sukhaduHkhe cha sarvadA
shlokas.23:
achintya eSha bhagavAnkarmaNA manasA girA |
na me tAta yudhishreShTha vidyayA paNDitaH samaH
shlokas.24:
jaigIShavya uvAcha||
mamAShTaguNamaishvaryaM dattaM bhagavatA purA |
yatnenAlpena balinA vArANasyAM yudhiShThira
shlokas.25:
gArgya uvAcha||
chatuHShaShTya~NgamadadAtkAlaj~nAnaM mamAdbhutam |
sarasvatyAstaTe tuShTo manoyaj~nena pANDava
shlokas.26:
tulyaM mama sahasraM tu sutAnAM brahmavAdinAm |
Ayushchaiva saputrasya sa.nvatsarashatAyutam
shlokas.27:
parAshara uvAcha||
prasAdyAhaM purA sharvaM manasAchintayaM nRRipa |
mahAtapA mahAtejA mahAyogI mahAyashAH
vedavyAsaH shriyAvAso brahmaNyaH karuNAtmakaH
shlokas.28:
api nAmepsitaH putro mama syAdvai maheshvarAt |
iti matvA hRRidi mataM prAha mAM surasattamaH
shlokas.29:
mayi sambhavatastasya phalAtkRRiShNo bhaviShyati |
sAvarNasya manoH sarge saptarShishcha bhaviShyati
shlokas.30:
vedAnAM cha sa vai vyastA kuruva.nshakarastathA |
itihAsasya kartA cha putraste jagato hitaH
shlokas.31:
bhaviShyati mahendrasya dayitaH sa mahAmuniH |
ajarashchAmarashchaiva parAshara sutastava
shlokas.32:
evamuktvA sa bhagavA.nstatraivAntaradhIyata |
yudhiShThira mahAyogI vIryavAnakShayo.avyayaH
shlokas.33:
mANDavya uvAcha||
achaurashchaurasha~NkAyAM shUle bhinno hyahaM yadA |
tatrasthena stuto devaH prAha mAM vai maheshvaraH
shlokas.34:
mokShaM prApsyasi shUlAchcha jIviShyasi samArbudam |
rujA shUlakRRitA chaiva na te vipra bhaviShyati
AdhibhirvyAdhibhishchaiva varjitastvaM bhaviShyasi
shlokas.35:
pAdAchchaturthAtsambhUta AtmA yasmAnmune tava |
tvaM bhaviShyasyanupamo janma vai saphalaM kuru
shlokas.36:
tIrthAbhiShekaM saphalaM tvamavighnena chApsyasi |
svargaM chaivAkShayaM vipra vidadhAmi tavorjitam
shlokas.37:
evamuktvA tu bhagavAnvareNyo vRRiShavAhanaH |
maheshvaro mahArAja kRRittivAsA mahAdyutiH
sagaNo daivatashreShThastatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.38:
gAlava uvAcha||
vishvAmitrAbhyanuj~nAto hyahaM pitaramAgataH |
abravInmAM tato mAtA duHkhitA rudatI bhRRisham
shlokas.39:
kaushikenAbhyanuj~nAtaM putraM vedavibhUShitam |
na tAta taruNaM dAntaM pitA tvAM pashyate.anagha
shlokas.40:
shrutvA jananyA vachanaM nirAsho gurudarshane |
niyatAtmA mahAdevamapashyaM so.abravIchcha mAm
shlokas.41:
pitA mAtA cha te tvaM cha putra mRRityuvivarjitAH |
bhaviShyatha visha kShipraM draShTAsi pitaraM kShaye
shlokas.42:
anuj~nAto bhagavatA gRRihaM gatvA yudhiShThira |
apashyaM pitaraM tAta iShTiM kRRitvA viniHsRRitam
shlokas.43:
upaspRRishya gRRihItvedhmaM kushA.nshcha sharaNAdgurUn |
tAnvisRRijya cha mAM prAha pitA sAsrAvilekShaNaH
shlokas.44:
praNamantaM pariShvajya mUrdhni chAghrAya pANDava |
diShTyA dRRiShTo.asi me putra kRRitavidya ihAgataH
shlokas.45:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etAnyatyadbhutAnyeva karmANyatha mahAtmanaH |
proktAni munibhiH shrutvA vismayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.46:
tataH kRRiShNo.abravIdvAkyaM punarmatimatAM varaH |
yudhiShThiraM dharmanityaM puruhUtamiveshvaraH
shlokas.47:
AdityachandrAvanilAnalau cha; dyaurbhUmirApo vasavo.atha vishve |
dhAtAryamA shukrabRRihaspatI cha; rudrAH sasAdhyA varuNo vittagopaH
shlokas.48:
brahmA shakro mAruto brahma satyaM; vedA yaj~nA dakShiNA vedavAhAH |
somo yaShTA yachcha havyaM havishcha; rakShA dIkShA niyamA ye cha kechit
shlokas.49:
svAhA vaShaDbrAhmaNAH saurabheyA; dharmaM chakraM kAlachakraM charaM cha |
yasho damo buddhimatI sthitishcha; shubhAshubhaM munayashchaiva sapta
shlokas.50:
agryA buddhirmanasA darshane cha; sparshe siddhiH karmaNAM yA cha siddhiH |
gaNA devAnAmUShmapAH somapAshcha; lekhAH suyAmAstuShitA brahmakAyAH
shlokas.51:
AbhAsvarA gandhapA dRRiShTipAshcha; vAchA viruddhAshcha manoviruddhAH |
shuddhAshcha nirvANaratAshcha devAH; sparshAshanA darshapA AjyapAshcha
shlokas.52:
chintAgatA ye cha deveShu mukhyA; ye chApyanye devatAshchAjamIDha |
suparNagandharvapishAchadAnavA; yakShAstathA pannagAshchAraNAshcha
shlokas.53:
sUkShmaM sthUlaM mRRidu yachchApyasUkShmaM; sukhaM duHkhaM sukhaduHkhAntaraM cha |
sA~NkhyaM yogaM yatparANAM paraM cha; sharvAjjAtaM viddhi yatkIrtitaM me
shlokas.54:
tatsambhUtA bhUtakRRito vareNyAH; sarve devA bhuvanasyAsya gopAH |
AvishyemAM dharaNIM ye.abhyarakSha;npurAtanIM tasya devasya sRRiShTim
shlokas.55:
vichinvantaM manasA toShTuvImi; ki~nchittattvaM prANahetornato.asmi |
dadAtu devaH sa varAniheShTA;nabhiShTuto naH prabhuravyayaH sadA
shlokas.56:
imaM stavaM saMniyamyendriyANi; shuchirbhUtvA yaH puruShaH paTheta |
abhagnayogo niyato.abdamekaM; sa prApnuyAdashvamedhe phalaM yat
shlokas.57:
vedAnkRRitsnAnbrAhmaNaH prApnuyAchcha; jayedrAjA pRRithivIM chApi kRRitsnAm |
vaishyo lAbhaM prApnuyAnnaipuNaM cha; shUdro gatiM pretya tathA sukhaM cha
shlokas.58:
stavarAjamimaM kRRitvA rudrAya dadhire manaH |
sarvadoShApahaM puNyaM pavitraM cha yashasvinam
shlokas.59:
yAvantyasya sharIreShu romakUpANi bhArata |
tAvadvarShasahasrANi svarge vasati mAnavaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadidaM sahadharmeti prochyate bharatarShabha |
pANigrahaNakAle tu strINAmetatkathaM smRRitam
shlokas.2:
ArSha eSha bhaveddharmaH prAjApatyo.atha vAsuraH |
yadetatsahadharmeti pUrvamuktaM maharShibhiH
shlokas.3:
sa.ndehaH sumahAneSha viruddha iti me matiH |
iha yaH sahadharmo vai pretyAyaM vihitaH kva nu
shlokas.4:
svarge mRRitAnAM bhavati sahadharmaH pitAmaha |
pUrvamekastu mriyate kva chaikastiShThate vada
shlokas.5:
nAnAkarmaphalopetA nAnAkarmanivAsinaH |
nAnAnirayaniShThAntA mAnuShA bahavo yadA
shlokas.6:
anRRitAH striya ityevaM sUtrakAro vyavasyati |
yadAnRRitAH striyastAta sahadharmaH kutaH smRRitaH
shlokas.7:
anRRitAH striya ityevaM vedeShvapi hi paThyate |
dharmo.ayaM paurvikI sa~nj~nA upachAraH kriyAvidhiH
shlokas.8:
gahvaraM pratibhAtyetanmama chintayato.anisham |
niHsa.ndehamidaM sarvaM pitAmaha yathA shrutiH
shlokas.9:
yadetadyAdRRishaM chaitadyathA chaitatpravartitam |
nikhilena mahAprAj~na bhavAnetadbravItu me
shlokas.10:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
aShTAvakrasya sa.nvAdaM dishayA saha bhArata
shlokas.11:
niveShTukAmastu purA aShTAvakro mahAtapAH |
RRiSheratha vadAnyasya kanyAM vavre mahAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
suprabhAM nAma vai nAmnA rUpeNApratimAM bhuvi |
guNaprabarhAM shIlena sAdhvIM chAritrashobhanAm
shlokas.13:
sA tasya dRRiShTvaiva mano jahAra shubhalochanA |
vanarAjI yathA chitrA vasante kusumAchitA
shlokas.14:
RRiShistamAha deyA me sutA tubhyaM shRRiNuShva me |
gachCha tAvaddishaM puNyAmuttarAM drakShyase tataH
shlokas.15:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
kiM draShTavyaM mayA tatra vaktumarhati me bhavAn |
tathedAnIM mayA kAryaM yathA vakShyati mAM bhavAn
shlokas.16:
vadAnya uvAcha||
dhanadaM samatikramya himavantaM tathaiva cha |
rudrasyAyatanaM dRRiShTvA siddhachAraNasevitam
shlokas.17:
prahRRiShTaiH pArShadairjuShTaM nRRityadbhirvividhAnanaiH |
divyA~NgarAgaiH paishAchairvanyairnAnAvidhaistathA
shlokas.18:
pANitAlasatAlaishcha shamyAtAlaiH samaistathA |
samprahRRiShTaiH pranRRityadbhiH sharvastatra niShevyate
shlokas.19:
iShTaM kila girau sthAnaM taddivyamanushushruma |
nityaM saMnihito devastathA pAriShadAH shubhAH
shlokas.20:
tatra devyA tapastaptaM sha~NkarArthaM sudushcharam |
atastadiShTaM devasya tathomAyA iti shrutiH
shlokas.21:
tatra kUpo mahAnpArshve devasyottaratastathA |
RRitavaH kAlarAtrishcha ye divyA ye cha mAnuShAH
shlokas.22:
sarve devamupAsante rUpiNaH kila tatra ha |
tadatikramya bhavanaM tvayA yAtavyameva hi
shlokas.23:
tato nIlaM vanoddeshaM drakShyase meghasaMnibham |
ramaNIyaM manogrAhi tatra drakShyasi vai striyam
shlokas.24:
tapasvinIM mahAbhAgAM vRRiddhAM dIkShAmanuShThitAm |
draShTavyA sA tvayA tatra sampUjyA chaiva yatnataH
shlokas.25:
tAM dRRiShTvA vinivRRittastvaM tataH pANiM grahIShyasi |
yadyeSha samayaH satyaH sAdhyatAM tatra gamyatAm

shlokas.1:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
tathAstu sAdhayiShyAmi tatra yAsyAmyasa.nshayam |
yatra tvaM vadase sAdho bhavAnbhavatu satyavAk
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato.agachChatsa bhagavAnuttarAmuttamAM disham |
himavantaM girishreShThaM siddhachAraNasevitam
shlokas.3:
sa gatvA dvijashArdUlo himavantaM mahAgirim |
abhyagachChannadIM puNyAM bAhudAM dharmadAyinIm
shlokas.4:
ashoke vimale tIrthe snAtvA tarpya cha devatAH |
tatra vAsAya shayane kaushye sukhamuvAsa ha
shlokas.5:
tato rAtryAM vyatItAyAM prAtarutthAya sa dvijaH |
snAtvA prAdushchakArAgniM hutvA chaiva vidhAnataH
shlokas.6:
rudrANIkUpamAsAdya hrade tatra samAshvasat |
vishrAntashcha samutthAya kailAsamabhito yayau
shlokas.7:
so.apashyatkA~nchanadvAraM dIpyamAnamiva shriyA |
mandAkinIM cha nalinIM dhanadasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.8:
atha te rAkShasAH sarve ye.abhirakShanti padminIm |
pratyutthitA bhagavantaM maNibhadrapurogamAH
shlokas.9:
sa tAnpratyarchayAmAsa rAkShasAnbhImavikramAn |
nivedayata mAM kShipraM dhanadAyeti chAbravIt
shlokas.10:
te rAkShasAstadA rAjanbhagavantamathAbruvan |
asau vaishravaNo rAjA svayamAyAti te.antikam
shlokas.11:
vidito bhagavAnasya kAryamAgamane cha yat |
pashyainaM tvaM mahAbhAgaM jvalantamiva tejasA
shlokas.12:
tato vaishravaNo.abhyetya aShTAvakramaninditam |
vidhivatkushalaM pRRiShTvA tato brahmarShimabravIt
shlokas.13:
sukhaM prApto bhavAnkachchitkiM vA mattashchikIrShasi |
brUhi sarvaM kariShyAmi yanmAM tvaM vakShyasi dvija
shlokas.14:
bhavanaM pravisha tvaM me yathAkAmaM dvijottama |
satkRRitaH kRRitakAryashcha bhavAnyAsyatyavighnataH
shlokas.15:
prAvishadbhavanaM svaM vai gRRihItvA taM dvijottamam |
AsanaM svaM dadau chaiva pAdyamarghyaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.16:
athopaviShTayostatra maNibhadrapurogamAH |
niShedustatra kauberA yakShagandharvarAkShasAH
shlokas.17:
tatasteShAM niShaNNAnAM dhanado vAkyamabravIt |
bhavachChandaM samAj~nAya nRRityerannapsarogaNAH
shlokas.18:
AtithyaM paramaM kAryaM shushrUShA bhavatastathA |
sa.nvartatAmityuvAcha munirmadhurayA girA
shlokas.19:
athorvarA mishrakeshI rambhA chaivorvashI tathA |
alambusA ghRRitAchI cha chitrA chitrA~NgadA ruchiH
shlokas.20:
manoharA sukeshI cha sumukhI hAsinI prabhA |
vidyutA prashamA dAntA vidyotA ratireva cha
shlokas.21:
etAshchAnyAshcha vai bahvyaH pranRRittApsarasaH shubhAH |
avAdaya.nshcha gandharvA vAdyAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.22:
atha pravRRitte gAndharve divye RRiShirupAvasat |
divyaM sa.nvatsaraM tatra ramanvai sumahAtapAH
shlokas.23:
tato vaishravaNo rAjA bhagavantamuvAcha ha |
sAgraH sa.nvatsaro yAtastava vipreha pashyataH
shlokas.24:
hAryo.ayaM viShayo brahmangAndharvo nAma nAmataH |
Chandato vartatAM vipra yathA vadati vA bhavAn
shlokas.25:
atithiH pUjanIyastvamidaM cha bhavato gRRiham |
sarvamAj~nApyatAmAshu paravanto vayaM tvayi
shlokas.26:
atha vaishravaNaM prIto bhagavAnpratyabhAShata |
archito.asmi yathAnyAyaM gamiShyAmi dhaneshvara
shlokas.27:
prIto.asmi sadRRishaM chaiva tava sarvaM dhanAdhipa |
tava prasAdAdbhagavanmaharSheshcha mahAtmanaH
niyogAdadya yAsyAmi vRRiddhimAnRRiddhimAnbhava
shlokas.28:
atha niShkramya bhagavAnprayayAvuttarAmukhaH |
kailAsaM mandaraM haimaM sarvAnanuchachAra ha
shlokas.29:
tAnatItya mahAshailAnkairAtaM sthAnamuttamam |
pradakShiNaM tatashchakre prayataH shirasA naman
dharaNImavatIryAtha pUtAtmAsau tadAbhavat
shlokas.30:
sa taM pradakShiNaM kRRitvA triH shailaM chottarAmukhaH |
samena bhUmibhAgena yayau prItipuraskRRitaH
shlokas.31:
tato.aparaM vanoddeshaM ramaNIyamapashyata |
sarvartubhirmUlaphalaiH pakShibhishcha samanvitam
ramaNIyairvanoddeshaistatra tatra vibhUShitam
shlokas.32:
tatrAshramapadaM divyaM dadarsha bhagavAnatha |
shailA.nshcha vividhAkArAnkA~nchanAnratnabhUShitAn
maNibhUmau niviShTAshcha puShkariNyastathaiva cha
shlokas.33:
anyAnyapi suramyANi dadarsha subahUnyatha |
bhRRishaM tasya mano reme maharSherbhAvitAtmanaH
shlokas.34:
sa tatra kA~nchanaM divyaM sarvaratnamayaM gRRiham |
dadarshAdbhutasa~NkAshaM dhanadasya gRRihAdvaram
shlokas.35:
mahAnto yatra vividhAH prAsAdAH parvatopamAH |
vimAnAni cha ramyANi ratnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.36:
mandArapuShpaiH sa~NkIrNA tathA mandAkinI nadI |
svayamprabhAshcha maNayo vajrairbhUmishcha bhUShitA
shlokas.37:
nAnAvidhaishcha bhavanairvichitramaNitoraNaiH |
muktAjAlaparikShiptairmaNiratnavibhUShitaiH
manodRRiShTiharai ramyaiH sarvataH sa.nvRRitaM shubhaiH
shlokas.38:
RRiShiH samantato.apashyattatra tatra manoramam |
tato.abhavattasya chintA kva me vAso bhavediti
shlokas.39:
atha dvAraM samabhito gatvA sthitvA tato.abravIt |
atithiM mAmanuprAptamanujAnantu ye.atra vai
shlokas.40:
atha kanyAparivRRitA gRRihAttasmAdviniHsRRitAH |
nAnArUpAH sapta vibho kanyAH sarvA manoharAH
shlokas.41:
yAM yAmapashyatkanyAM sa sA sA tasya mano.aharat |
nAshaknuvaddhArayituM mano.athAsyAvasIdati
shlokas.42:
tato dhRRitiH samutpannA tasya viprasya dhImataH |
atha taM pramadAH prAhurbhagavAnpravishatviti
shlokas.43:
sa cha tAsAM surUpANAM tasyaiva bhavanasya cha |
kautUhalasamAviShTaH pravivesha gRRihaM dvijaH
shlokas.44:
tatrApashyajjarAyuktAmarajombaradhAriNIm |
vRRiddhAM parya~NkamAsInAM sarvAbharaNabhUShitAm
shlokas.45:
svastIti chAtha tenoktA sA strI pratyavadattadA |
pratyutthAya cha taM vipramAsyatAmityuvAcha ha
shlokas.46:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
sarvAH svAnAlayAnyAntu ekA mAmupatiShThatu |
supraj~nAtA suprashAntA sheShA gachChantu chChandataH
shlokas.47:
tataH pradakShiNIkRRitya kanyAstAstamRRiShiM tadA |
nirAkrAmangRRihAttasmAtsA vRRiddhAtha vyatiShThata
shlokas.48:
atha tAM sa.nvishanprAha shayane bhAsvare tadA |
tvayApi supyatAM bhadre rajanI hyativartate
shlokas.49:
sa.nlApAttena vipreNa tathA sA tatra bhAShitA |
dvitIye shayane divye sa.nvivesha mahAprabhe
shlokas.50:
atha sA vepamAnA~NgI nimittaM shItajaM tadA |
vyapadishya maharShervai shayanaM chAdhyarohata
shlokas.51:
svAgataM svAgatenAstu bhagavA.nstAmabhAShata |
sopAgUhadbhujAbhyAM tu RRiShiM prItyA nararShabha
shlokas.52:
nirvikAramRRiShiM chApi kAShThakuDyopamaM tadA |
duHkhitA prekShya sa~njalpamakArShIdRRiShiNA saha
shlokas.53:
brahmanna kAmakAro.asti strINAM puruShato dhRRitiH |
kAmena mohitA chAhaM tvAM bhajantIM bhajasva mAm
shlokas.54:
prahRRiShTo bhava viprarShe samAgachCha mayA saha |
upagUha cha mAM vipra kAmArtAhaM bhRRishaM tvayi
shlokas.55:
etaddhi tava dharmAtma.nstapasaH pUjyate phalam |
prArthitaM darshanAdeva bhajamAnAM bhajasva mAm
shlokas.56:
sadma chedaM vanaM chedaM yachchAnyadapi pashyasi |
prabhutvaM tava sarvatra mayi chaiva na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.57:
sarvAnkAmAnvidhAsyAmi ramasva sahito mayA |
ramaNIye vane vipra sarvakAmaphalaprade
shlokas.58:
tvadvashAhaM bhaviShyAmi ra.nsyase cha mayA saha |
sarvAnkAmAnupAshnAno ye divyA ye cha mAnuShAH
shlokas.59:
nAtaH paraM hi nArINAM kAryaM ki~nchana vidyate |
yathA puruShasa.nsargaH parametaddhi naH phalam
shlokas.60:
AtmachChandena vartante nAryo manmathachoditAH |
na cha dahyanti gachChantyaH sutaptairapi pA.nsubhiH
shlokas.61:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
paradArAnahaM bhadre na gachCheyaM katha~nchana |
dUShitaM dharmashAstreShu paradArAbhimarshanam
shlokas.62:
bhadre niveShTukAmaM mAM viddhi satyena vai shape |
viShayeShvanabhij~no.ahaM dharmArthaM kila santatiH
shlokas.63:
evaM lokAngamiShyAmi putrairiti na sa.nshayaH |
bhadre dharmaM vijAnIShva j~nAtvA choparamasva ha
shlokas.64:
stryuvAcha||
nAnilo.agnirna varuNo na chAnye tridashA dvija |
priyAH strINAM yathA kAmo ratishIlA hi yoShitaH
shlokas.65:
sahasraikA yatA nArI prApnotIha kadAchana |
tathA shatasahasreShu yadi kAchitpativratA
shlokas.66:
naitA jAnanti pitaraM na kulaM na cha mAtaram |
na bhrAtR^Inna cha bhartAraM na putrAnna cha devarAn
shlokas.67:
lIlAyantyaH kulaM ghnanti kUlAnIva saridvarAH |
doShA.nshcha mandAnmandAsu prajApatirabhAShata
shlokas.68:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH sa RRiShirekAgrastAM striyaM pratyabhAShata |
AsyatAM ruchiraM ChandaH kiM vA kAryaM bravIhi me
shlokas.69:
sA strI provAcha bhagavandrakShyase deshakAlataH |
vasa tAvanmahAprAj~na kRRitakRRityo gamiShyasi
shlokas.70:
brahmarShistAmathovAcha sa tatheti yudhiShThira |
vatsye.ahaM yAvadutsAho bhavatyA nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.71:
atharShirabhisamprekShya striyaM tAM jarayAnvitAm |
chintAM paramikAM bheje santapta iva chAbhavat
shlokas.72:
yadyada~NgaM hi so.apashyattasyA viprarShabhastadA |
nAramattatra tatrAsya dRRiShTI rUpaparAjitA
shlokas.73:
devateyaM gRRihasyAsya shApAnnUnaM virUpitA |
asyAshcha kAraNaM vettuM na yuktaM sahasA mayA
shlokas.74:
iti chintAviShaktasya tamarthaM j~nAtumichChataH |
vyagamattadahaHsheShaM manasA vyAkulena tu
shlokas.75:
atha sA strI tadovAcha bhagavanpashya vai raveH |
rUpaM sandhyAbhrasa.nyuktaM kimupasthApyatAM tava
shlokas.76:
sa uvAcha tadA tAM strIM snAnodakamihAnaya |
upAsiShye tataH sandhyAM vAgyato niyatendriyaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atha sA strI tamuktvA tu vipramevaM bhavatviti |
tailaM divyamupAdAya snAnashATImupAnayat
shlokas.2:
anuj~nAtA cha muninA sA strI tena mahAtmanA |
athAsya tailenA~NgAni sarvANyevAbhyamRRikShayat
shlokas.3:
shanaishchotsAditastatra snAnashAlAmupAgamat |
bhadrAsanaM tatashchitraM RRiShiranvAvishannavam
shlokas.4:
athopaviShTashcha yadA tasminbhadrAsane tadA |
snApayAmAsa shanakaistamRRiShiM sukhahastavat
divyaM cha vidhivachchakre sopachAraM munestadA
shlokas.5:
sa tena susukhoShNena tasyA hastasukhena cha |
vyatItAM rajanIM kRRitsnAM nAjAnAtsa mahAvrataH
shlokas.6:
tata utthAya sa munistadA paramavismitaH |
pUrvasyAM dishi sUryaM cha so.apashyaduditaM divi
shlokas.7:
tasya buddhiriyaM kiM nu mohastattvamidaM bhavet |
athopAsya sahasrA.nshuM kiM karomItyuvAcha tAm
shlokas.8:
sA chAmRRitarasaprakhyamRRiSherannamupAharat |
tasya svAdutayAnnasya na prabhUtaM chakAra saH
vyagamachchApyahaHsheShaM tataH sandhyAgamatpunaH
shlokas.9:
atha strI bhagavantaM sA supyatAmityachodayat |
tatra vai shayane divye tasya tasyAshcha kalpite
shlokas.10:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
na bhadre paradAreShu mano me samprasajjati |
uttiShTha bhadre bhadraM te svapa vai viramasva cha
shlokas.11:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sA tadA tena vipreNa tathA dhRRityA nivartitA |
svatantrAsmItyuvAchainaM na dharmachChalamasti te
shlokas.12:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
nAsti svatantratA strINAmasvatantrA hi yoShitaH |
prajApatimataM hyetanna strI svAtantryamarhati
shlokas.13:
stryuvAcha||
bAdhate maithunaM vipra mama bhaktiM cha pashya vai |
adharmaM prApsyase vipra yanmAM tvaM nAbhinandasi
shlokas.14:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
haranti doShajAtAni naraM jAtaM yathechChakam |
prabhavAmi sadA dhRRityA bhadre svaM shayanaM vraja
shlokas.15:
stryuvAcha||
shirasA praName vipra prasAdaM kartumarhasi |
bhUmau nipatamAnAyAH sharaNaM bhava me.anagha
shlokas.16:
yadi vA doShajAtaM tvaM paradAreShu pashyasi |
AtmAnaM sparshayAmyadya pANiM gRRihNIShva me dvija
shlokas.17:
na doSho bhavitA chaiva satyenaitadbravImyaham |
svatantrAM mAM vijAnIhi yo.adharmaH so.astu vai mayi
shlokas.18:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
svatantrA tvaM kathaM bhadre brUhi kAraNamatra vai |
nAsti loke hi kAchitstrI yA vai svAtantryamarhati
shlokas.19:
pitA rakShati kaumAre bhartA rakShati yauvane |
putrAshcha sthavirIbhAve na strI svAtantryamarhati
shlokas.20:
stryuvAcha||
kaumAraM brahmacharyaM me kanyaivAsmi na sa.nshayaH |
kuru mA vimatiM vipra shraddhAM vijahi mA mama
shlokas.21:
aShTAvakra uvAcha||
yathA mama tathA tubhyaM yathA tava tathA mama |
jij~nAseyamRRiShestasya vighnaH satyaM nu kiM bhavet
shlokas.22:
AshcharyaM paramaM hIdaM kiM nu shreyo hi me bhavet |
divyAbharaNavastrA hi kanyeyaM mAmupasthitA
shlokas.23:
kiM tvasyAH paramaM rUpaM jIrNamAsItkathaM punaH |
kanyArUpamihAdyaiva kimihAtrottaraM bhavet
shlokas.24:
yathA paraM shaktidhRRiterna vyutthAsye katha~nchana |
na rochaye hi vyutthAnaM dhRRityaivaM sAdhayAmyaham

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
na bibheti kathaM sA strI shApasya paramadyuteH |
kathaM nivRRitto bhagavA.nstadbhavAnprabravItu me
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
aShTAvakro.anvapRRichChattAM rUpaM vikuruShe katham |
na chAnRRitaM te vaktavyaM brUhi brAhmaNakAmyayA
shlokas.3:
stryuvAcha||
dyAvApRRithivImAtraiShA kAmyA brAhmaNasattama |
shRRiNuShvAvahitaH sarvaM yadidaM satyavikrama
shlokas.4:
uttarAM mAM dishaM viddhi dRRiShTaM strIchApalaM cha te |
avyutthAnena te lokA jitAH satyaparAkrama
shlokas.5:
jij~nAseyaM prayuktA me sthirIkartuM tavAnagha |
sthavirANAmapi strINAM bAdhate maithunajvaraH
shlokas.6:
tuShTaH pitAmahaste.adya tathA devAH savAsavAH |
sa tvaM yena cha kAryeNa samprApto bhagavAniha
shlokas.7:
preShitastena vipreNa kanyApitrA dvijarShabha |
tavopadeshaM kartuM vai tachcha sarvaM kRRitaM mayA
shlokas.8:
kShemI gamiShyasi gRRihA~nshramashcha na bhaviShyati |
kanyAM prApsyasi tAM vipra putriNI cha bhaviShyati
shlokas.9:
kAmyayA pRRiShTavA.nstvaM mAM tato vyAhRRitamuttaram |
anatikramaNIyaiShA kRRitsnairlokaistribhiH sadA
shlokas.10:
gachChasva sukRRitaM kRRitvA kiM vAnyachChrotumichChasi |
yAvadbravImi viprarShe aShTAvakra yathAtatham
shlokas.11:
RRiShiNA prasAditA chAsmi tava hetordvijarShabha |
tasya saMmAnanArthaM me tvayi vAkyaM prabhAShitam
shlokas.12:
shrutvA tu vachanaM tasyAH sa vipraH prA~njaliH sthitaH |
anuj~nAtastayA chApi svagRRihaM punarAvrajat
shlokas.13:
gRRihamAgamya vishrAntaH svajanaM pratipUjya cha |
abhyagachChata taM vipraM nyAyataH kurunandana
shlokas.14:
pRRiShTashcha tena vipreNa dRRiShTaM tvetannidarshanam |
prAha vipraM tadA vipraH suprItenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.15:
bhavatAhamanuj~nAtaH prasthito gandhamAdanam |
tasya chottarato deshe dRRiShTaM taddaivataM mahat
shlokas.16:
tayA chAhamanuj~nAto bhavA.nshchApi prakIrtitaH |
shrAvitashchApi tadvAkyaM gRRihamabhyAgataH prabho
shlokas.17:
tamuvAcha tato vipraH pratigRRihNIShva me sutAm |
nakShatratithisa.nyoge pAtraM hi paramaM bhavAn
shlokas.18:
bhIShma uvAcha||
aShTAvakrastathetyuktvA pratigRRihya cha tAM prabho |
kanyAM paramadharmAtmA prItimA.nshchAbhavattadA
shlokas.19:
kanyAM tAM pratigRRihyaiva bhAryAM paramashobhanAm |
uvAsa muditastatra Ashrame sve gatajvaraH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kimAhurbharatashreShTha pAtraM viprAH sanAtanam |
brAhmaNaM li~NginaM chaiva brAhmaNaM vApyali~Nginam
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
svavRRittimabhipannAya li~Ngine vetarAya vA |
deyamAhurmahArAja ubhAvetau tapasvinau
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shraddhayA parayA pUto yaH prayachCheddvijAtaye |
havyaM kavyaM tathA dAnaM ko doShaH syAtpitAmaha
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shraddhApUto narastAta durdAnto.api na sa.nshayaH |
pUto bhavati sarvatra kiM punastvaM mahIpate
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
na brAhmaNaM parIkSheta daiveShu satataM naraH |
kavyapradAne tu budhAH parIkShyaM brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
na brAhmaNaH sAdhayate havyaM daivAtprasidhyati |
devaprasAdAdijyante yajamAnA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.7:
brAhmaNA bharatashreShTha satataM brahmavAdinaH |
mArkaNDeyaH purA prAha iha lokeShu buddhimAn
shlokas.8:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
apUrvo.apyatha vA vidvAnsambandhI vAtha yo bhavet |
tapasvI yaj~nashIlo vA kathaM pAtraM bhavettu saH
shlokas.9:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kulInaH karmakRRidvaidyastathA chApyAnRRisha.nsyavAn |
hrImAnRRijuH satyavAdI pAtraM pUrve cha te trayaH
shlokas.10:
tatredaM shRRiNu me pArtha chaturNAM tejasAM matam |
pRRithivyAH kAshyapasyAgnermArkaNDeyasya chaiva hi
shlokas.11:
pRRithivyuvAcha||
yathA mahArNave kShiptaH kShipraM loShTo vinashyati |
tathA dushcharitaM sarvaM trayyAvRRittyA vinashyati
shlokas.12:
kAshyapa uvAcha||
sarve cha vedAH saha ShaDbhira~NgaiH; sA~NkhyaM purANaM cha kule cha janma |
naitAni sarvANi gatirbhavanti; shIlavyapetasya narasya rAjan
shlokas.13:
agniruvAcha||
adhIyAnaH paNDitaM manyamAno; yo vidyayA hanti yashaH pareShAm |
brahmansa tenAcharate brahmahatyAM; lokAstasya hyantavanto bhavanti
shlokas.14:
mArkaNDeya uvAcha||
ashvamedhasahasraM cha satyaM cha tulayA dhRRitam |
nAbhijAnAmi yadyasya satyasyArdhamavApnuyAt
shlokas.15:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktvA te jagmurAshu chatvAro.amitatejasaH |
pRRithivI kAshyapo.agnishcha prakRRiShTAyushcha bhArgavaH
shlokas.16:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadidaM brAhmaNA loke vratino bhu~njate haviH |
bhuktaM brAhmaNakAmAya kathaM tatsukRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.17:
bhIShma uvAcha||
AdiShTino ye rAjendra brAhmaNA vedapAragAH |
bhu~njate brahmakAmAya vrataluptA bhavanti te
shlokas.18:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
anekAntaM bahudvAraM dharmamAhurmanIShiNaH |
kiM nishchitaM bhavettatra tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.19:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ahi.nsA satyamakrodha AnRRisha.nsyaM damastathA |
ArjavaM chaiva rAjendra nishchitaM dharmalakShaNam
shlokas.20:
ye tu dharmaM prasha.nsantashcharanti pRRithivImimAm |
anAcharantastaddharmaM sa~Nkare niratAH prabho
shlokas.21:
tebhyo ratnaM hiraNyaM vA gAmashvAnvA dadAti yaH |
dasha varShANi viShThAM sa bhu~Nkte nirayamAshritaH
shlokas.22:
medAnAM pulkasAnAM cha tathaivAntAvasAyinAm |
kRRitaM karmAkRRitaM chApi rAgamohena jalpatAm
shlokas.23:
vaishvadevaM cha ye mUDhA viprAya brahmachAriNe |
dadatIha na rAjendra te lokAnbhu~njate.ashubhAn
shlokas.24:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM paraM brahmacharyasya kiM paraM dharmalakShaNam |
kiM cha shreShThatamaM shauchaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.25:
bhIShma uvAcha||
brahmacharyaM paraM tAta madhumA.nsasya varjanam |
maryAdAyAM sthito dharmaH shamaH shauchasya lakShaNam
shlokas.26:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kasminkAle chareddharmaM kasminkAle.arthamAcharet |
kasminkAle sukhI cha syAttanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.27:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kAlyamarthaM niSheveta tato dharmamanantaram |
pashchAtkAmaM niSheveta na cha gachChetprasa~NgitAm
shlokas.28:
brAhmaNA.nshchAbhimanyeta gurU.nshchApyabhipUjayet |
sarvabhUtAnulomashcha mRRidushIlaH priya.nvadaH
shlokas.29:
adhikAre yadanRRitaM rAjagAmi cha paishunam |
guroshchAlIkakaraNaM samaM tadbrahmahatyayA
shlokas.30:
praharenna narendreShu na gAM hanyAttathaiva cha |
bhrUNahatyAsamaM chaitadubhayaM yo niShevate
shlokas.31:
nAgniM parityajejjAtu na cha vedAnparityajet |
na cha brAhmaNamAkroshetsamaM tadbrahmahatyayA
shlokas.32:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kIdRRishAH sAdhavo viprAH kebhyo dattaM mahAphalam |
kIdRRishAnAM cha bhoktavyaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.33:
bhIShma uvAcha||
akrodhanA dharmaparAH satyanityA dame ratAH |
tAdRRishAH sAdhavo viprAstebhyo dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.34:
amAninaH sarvasahA dRRiShTArthA vijitendriyAH |
sarvabhUtahitA maitrAstebhyo dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.35:
alubdhAH shuchayo vaidyA hrImantaH satyavAdinaH |
svakarmaniratA ye cha tebhyo dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.36:
sA~NgA.nshcha chaturo vedAnyo.adhIyIta dvijarShabhaH |
ShaDbhyo nivRRittaH karmabhyastaM pAtramRRiShayo viduH
shlokas.37:
ye tveva~NguNajAtIyAstebhyo dattaM mahAphalam |
sahasraguNamApnoti guNArhAya pradAyakaH
shlokas.38:
praj~nAshrutAbhyAM vRRittena shIlena cha samanvitaH |
tArayeta kulaM kRRitsnameko.apIha dvijarShabhaH
shlokas.39:
gAmashvaM vittamannaM vA tadvidhe pratipAdayet |
dravyANi chAnyAni tathA pretyabhAve na shochati
shlokas.40:
tArayeta kulaM kRRitsnameko.apIha dvijottamaH |
kima~Nga punarekaM vai tasmAtpAtraM samAcharet
shlokas.41:
nishamya cha guNopetaM brAhmaNaM sAdhusaMmatam |
dUrAdAnAyayetkRRitye sarvatashchAbhipUjayet

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrAddhakAle cha daive cha dharme chApi pitAmaha |
ichChAmIha tvayAkhyAtaM vihitaM yatsurarShibhiH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
daivaM pUrvAhNike kuryAdaparAhNe tu paitRRikam |
ma~NgalAchArasampannaH kRRitashauchaH prayatnavAn
shlokas.3:
manuShyANAM tu madhyAhne pradadyAdupapattitaH |
kAlahInaM tu yaddAnaM taM bhAgaM rakShasAM viduH
shlokas.4:
la~NghitaM chAvalIDhaM cha kalipUrvaM cha yatkRRitam |
rajasvalAbhirdRRiShTaM cha taM bhAgaM rakShasAM viduH
shlokas.5:
avaghuShTaM cha yadbhuktamavratena cha bhArata |
parAmRRiShTaM shunA chaiva taM bhAgaM rakShasAM viduH
shlokas.6:
keshakITAvapatitaM kShutaM shvabhiravekShitam |
ruditaM chAvadhUtaM cha taM bhAgaM rakShasAM viduH
shlokas.7:
niro~NkAreNa yadbhuktaM sashastreNa cha bhArata |
durAtmanA cha yadbhuktaM taM bhAgaM rakShasAM viduH
shlokas.8:
parochChiShTaM cha yadbhuktaM paribhuktaM cha yadbhavet |
daive pitrye cha satataM taM bhAgaM rakShasAM viduH
shlokas.9:
garhitaM ninditaM chaiva pariviShTaM samanyunA |
daivaM vApyatha vA paitryaM taM bhAgaM rakShasAM viduH
shlokas.10:
mantrahInaM kriyAhInaM yachChrAddhaM pariviShyate |
tribhirvarNairnarashreShTha taM bhAgaM rakShasAM viduH
shlokas.11:
AjyAhutiM vinA chaiva yatki~nchitpariviShyate |
durAchAraishcha yadbhuktaM taM bhAgaM rakShasAM viduH
shlokas.12:
ye bhAgA rakShasAM proktAsta uktA bharatarShabha |
ata UrdhvaM visargasya parIkShAM brAhmaNe shRRiNu
shlokas.13:
yAvantaH patitA viprA jaDonmattAstathaiva cha |
daive vApyatha vA pitrye rAjannArhanti ketanam
shlokas.14:
shvitrI kuShThI cha klIbashcha tathA yakShmahatashcha yaH |
apasmArI cha yashchAndho rAjannArhanti satkRRitim
shlokas.15:
chikitsakA devalakA vRRithAniyamadhAriNaH |
somavikrayiNashchaiva shrAddhe nArhanti ketanam
shlokas.16:
gAyanA nartakAshchaiva plavakA vAdakAstathA |
kathakA yodhakAshchaiva rAjannArhanti ketanam
shlokas.17:
hotAro vRRiShalAnAM cha vRRiShalAdhyApakAstathA |
tathA vRRiShalashiShyAshcha rAjannArhanti ketanam
shlokas.18:
anuyoktA cha yo vipro anuyuktashcha bhArata |
nArhatastAvapi shrAddhaM brahmavikrayiNau hi tau
shlokas.19:
agraNIryaH kRRitaH pUrvaM varNAvaraparigrahaH |
brAhmaNaH sarvavidyo.api rAjannArhati ketanam
shlokas.20:
anagnayashcha ye viprA mRRitaniryAtakAshcha ye |
stenAshcha patitAshchaiva rAjannArhanti ketanam
shlokas.21:
aparij~nAtapUrvAshcha gaNapUrvAshcha bhArata |
putrikApUrvaputrAshcha shrAddhe nArhanti ketanam
shlokas.22:
RRiNakartA cha yo rAjanyashcha vArdhuShiko dvijaH |
prANivikrayavRRittishcha rAjannArhanti ketanam
shlokas.23:
strIpUrvAH kANDapRRiShThAshcha yAvanto bharatarShabha |
ajapA brAhmaNAshchaiva shrAddhe nArhanti ketanam
shlokas.24:
shrAddhe daive cha nirdiShTA brAhmaNA bharatarShabha |
dAtuH pratigrahItushcha shRRiNuShvAnugrahaM punaH
shlokas.25:
chIrNavratA guNairyuktA bhaveyurye.api karShakAH |
sAvitrIj~nAH kriyAvantaste rAjanketanakShamAH
shlokas.26:
kShAtradharmiNamapyAjau ketayetkulajaM dvijam |
na tveva vaNijaM tAta shrAddheShu parikalpayet
shlokas.27:
agnihotrI cha yo vipro grAmavAsI cha yo bhavet |
astenashchAtithij~nashcha sa rAjanketanakShamaH
shlokas.28:
sAvitrIM japate yastu trikAlaM bharatarShabha |
bhikShAvRRittiH kriyAvA.nshcha sa rAjanketanakShamaH
shlokas.29:
uditAstamito yashcha tathaivAstamitoditaH |
ahi.nsrashchAlpadoShashcha sa rAjanketanakShamaH
shlokas.30:
akalkako hyatarkashcha brAhmaNo bharatarShabha |
sasa~nj~no bhaikShyavRRittishcha sa rAjanketanakShamaH
shlokas.31:
avratI kitavaH stenaH prANivikrayyatho vaNik |
pashchAchcha pItavAnsomaM sa rAjanketanakShamaH
shlokas.32:
arjayitvA dhanaM pUrvaM dAruNaiH kRRiShikarmabhiH |
bhavetsarvAtithiH pashchAtsa rAjanketanakShamaH
shlokas.33:
brahmavikrayanirdiShTaM striyA yachchArjitaM dhanam |
adeyaM pitRRidevebhyo yachcha klaibyAdupArjitam
shlokas.34:
kriyamANe.apavarge tu yo dvijo bharatarShabha |
na vyAharati yadyuktaM tasyAdharmo gavAnRRitam
shlokas.35:
shrAddhasya brAhmaNaH kAlaH prAptaM dadhi ghRRitaM tathA |
somakShayashcha mA.nsaM cha yadAraNyaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.36:
shrAddhApavarge viprasya svadhA vai svaditA bhavet |
kShatriyasyApyatho brUyAtprIyantAM pitarastviti
shlokas.37:
apavarge tu vaishyasya shrAddhakarmaNi bhArata |
akShayyamabhidhAtavyaM svasti shUdrasya bhArata
shlokas.38:
puNyAhavAchanaM daive brAhmaNasya vidhIyate |
etadeva niro~NkAraM kShatriyasya vidhIyate
vaishyasya chaiva vaktavyaM prIyantAM devatA iti
shlokas.39:
karmaNAmAnupUrvIM cha vidhipUrvakRRitaM shRRiNu |
jAtakarmAdikAnsarvA.nstriShu varNeShu bhArata
brahmakShatre hi mantroktA vaishyasya cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.40:
viprasya rashanA mau~njI maurvI rAjanyagAminI |
bAlvajItyeva vaishyasya dharma eSha yudhiShThira
shlokas.41:
dAtuH pratigrahItushcha dharmAdharmAvimau shRRiNu |
brAhmaNasyAnRRite.adharmaH proktaH pAtakasa~nj~nitaH
chaturguNaH kShatriyasya vaishyasyAShTaguNaH smRRitaH
shlokas.42:
nAnyatra brAhmaNo.ashnIyAtpUrvaM vipreNa ketitaH |
yavIyAnpashuhi.nsAyAM tulyadharmo bhavetsa hi
shlokas.43:
atha rAjanyavaishyAbhyAM yadyashnIyAttu ketitaH |
yavIyAnpashuhi.nsAyAM bhAgArdhaM samavApnuyAt
shlokas.44:
daivaM vApyatha vA pitryaM yo.ashnIyAdbrAhmaNAdiShu |
asnAto brAhmaNo rAja.nstasyAdharmo gavAnRRitam
shlokas.45:
Ashaucho brAhmaNo rAjanyo.ashnIyAdbrAhmaNAdiShu |
j~nAnapUrvamatho lobhAttasyAdharmo gavAnRRitam
shlokas.46:
annenAnnaM cha yo lipsetkarmArthaM chaiva bhArata |
Amantrayati rAjendra tasyAdharmo.anRRitaM smRRitam
shlokas.47:
avedavratachAritrAstribhirvarNairyudhiShThira |
mantravatpariviShyante teShvadharmo gavAnRRitam
shlokas.48:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitryaM vApyatha vA daivaM dIyate yatpitAmaha |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM dattaM yeShu mahAphalam
shlokas.49:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yeShAM dArAH pratIkShante suvRRiShTimiva karShakAH |
uchCheShaparisheShaM hi tAnbhojaya yudhiShThira
shlokas.50:
chAritraniyatA rAjanye kRRishAH kRRishavRRittayaH |
arthinashchopagachChanti teShu dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.51:
tadbhaktAstadgRRihA rAja.nstaddhanAstadapAshrayAH |
arthinashcha bhavantyarthe teShu dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.52:
taskarebhyaH parebhyo vA ye bhayArtA yudhiShThira |
arthino bhoktumichChanti teShu dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.53:
akalkakasya viprasya bhaikShotkarakRRitAtmanaH |
baTavo yasya bhikShanti tebhyo dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.54:
hRRitasvA hRRitadArAshcha ye viprA deshasamplave |
arthArthamabhigachChanti tebhyo dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.55:
vratino niyamasthAshcha ye viprAH shrutasaMmatAH |
tatsamAptyarthamichChanti teShu dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.56:
avyutkrAntAshcha dharmeShu pAShaNDasamayeShu cha |
kRRishaprANAH kRRishadhanAsteShu dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.57:
kRRitasarvasvaharaNA nirdoShAH prabhaviShNubhiH |
spRRihayanti cha bhuktAnnaM teShu dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.58:
tapasvinastaponiShThAsteShAM bhaikShacharAshcha ye |
arthinaH ki~nchidichChanti teShu dattaM mahAphalam
shlokas.59:
mahAphalavidhirdAne shrutaste bharatarShabha |
nirayaM yena gachChanti svargaM chaiva hi tachChRRiNu
shlokas.60:
gurvarthaM vAbhayArthaM vA varjayitvA yudhiShThira |
ye.anRRitaM kathayanti sma te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.61:
paradArAbhihartAraH paradArAbhimarshinaH |
paradAraprayoktAraste vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.62:
ye parasvApahartAraH parasvAnAM cha nAshakAH |
sUchakAshcha pareShAM ye te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.63:
prapANAM cha sabhAnAM cha sa~NkramANAM cha bhArata |
agArANAM cha bhettAro narA nirayagAminaH
shlokas.64:
anAthAM pramadAM bAlAM vRRiddhAM bhItAM tapasvinIm |
va~nchayanti narA ye cha te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.65:
vRRittichChedaM gRRihachChedaM dArachChedaM cha bhArata |
mitrachChedaM tathAshAyAste vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.66:
sUchakAH sandhibhettAraH paravRRittyupajIvakAH |
akRRitaj~nAshcha mitrANAM te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.67:
pAShaNDA dUShakAshchaiva samayAnAM cha dUShakAH |
ye pratyavasitAshchaiva te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.68:
kRRitAshaM kRRitanirveshaM kRRitabhaktaM kRRitashramam |
bhedairye vyapakarShanti te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.69:
paryashnanti cha ye dArAnagnibhRRityAtithI.nstathA |
utsannapitRRidevejyAste vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.70:
vedavikrayiNashchaiva vedAnAM chaiva dUShakAH |
vedAnAM lekhakAshchaiva te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.71:
chAturAshramyabAhyAshcha shrutibAhyAshcha ye narAH |
vikarmabhishcha jIvanti te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.72:
keshavikrayikA rAjanviShavikrayikAshcha ye |
kShIravikrayikAshchaiva te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.73:
brAhmaNAnAM gavAM chaiva kanyAnAM cha yudhiShThira |
ye.antaraM yAnti kAryeShu te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.74:
shastravikrayakAshchaiva kartArashcha yudhiShThira |
shalyAnAM dhanuShAM chaiva te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.75:
shalyairvA sha~NkubhirvApi shvabhrairvA bharatarShabha |
ye mArgamanurundhanti te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.76:
upAdhyAyA.nshcha bhRRityA.nshcha bhaktA.nshcha bharatarShabha |
ye tyajantyasamarthA.nstA.nste vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.77:
aprAptadamakAshchaiva nAsAnAM vedhakAstathA |
bandhakAshcha pashUnAM ye te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.79:
kShAntAndAntA.nstathA prAj~nAndIrghakAlaM sahoShitAn |
tyajanti kRRitakRRityA ye te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.80:
bAlAnAmatha vRRiddhAnAM dAsAnAM chaiva ye narAH |
adattvA bhakShayantyagre te vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.81:
ete pUrvarShibhirdRRiShTAH proktA nirayagAminaH |
bhAginaH svargalokasya vakShyAmi bharatarShabha
shlokas.82:
sarveShveva tu kAryeShu daivapUrveShu bhArata |
hanti putrAnpashUnkRRitsnAnbrAhmaNAtikramaH kRRitaH
shlokas.83:
dAnena tapasA chaiva satyena cha yudhiShThira |
ye dharmamanuvartante te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.84:
shushrUShAbhistapobhishcha shrutamAdAya bhArata |
ye pratigrahaniHsnehAste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.86:
kShamAvantashcha dhIrAshcha dharmakAryeShu chotthitAH |
ma~NgalAchArayuktAshcha te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.87:
nivRRittA madhumA.nsebhyaH paradArebhya eva cha |
nivRRittAshchaiva madyebhyaste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.88:
AshramANAM cha kartAraH kulAnAM chaiva bhArata |
deshAnAM nagarANAM cha te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.89:
vastrAbharaNadAtAro bhakShapAnAnnadAstathA |
kuTumbAnAM cha dAtAraste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.90:
sarvahi.nsAnivRRittAshcha narAH sarvasahAshcha ye |
sarvasyAshrayabhUtAshcha te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.91:
mAtaraM pitaraM chaiva shushrUShanti jitendriyAH |
bhrAtR^INAM chaiva sasnehAste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.92:
ADhyAshcha balavantashcha yauvanasthAshcha bhArata |
ye vai jitendriyA dhIrAste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.93:
aparAddheShu sasnehA mRRidavo mitravatsalAH |
ArAdhanasukhAshchApi te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.94:
sahasrapariveShTArastathaiva cha sahasradAH |
trAtArashcha sahasrANAM puruShAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.95:
suvarNasya cha dAtAro gavAM cha bharatarShabha |
yAnAnAM vAhanAnAM cha te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.96:
vaivAhikAnAM kanyAnAM preShyANAM cha yudhiShThira |
dAtAro vAsasAM chaiva te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.97:
vihArAvasathodyAnakUpArAmasabhApradAH |
vaprANAM chaiva kartAraste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.98:
niveshanAnAM kShetrANAM vasatInAM cha bhArata |
dAtAraH prArthitAnAM cha te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.99:
rasAnAmatha bIjAnAM dhAnyAnAM cha yudhiShThira |
svayamutpAdya dAtAraH puruShAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.100:
yasminkasminkule jAtA bahuputrAH shatAyuShaH |
sAnukroshA jitakrodhAH puruShAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.101:
etaduktamamutrArthaM daivaM pitryaM cha bhArata |
dharmAdharmau cha dAnasya yathA pUrvarShibhiH kRRitau

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
idaM me tattvato rAjanvaktumarhasi bhArata |
ahi.nsayitvA keneha brahmahatyA vidhIyate
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vyAsamAmantrya rAjendra purA yatpRRiShTavAnaham |
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi tadihaikamanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.3:
chaturthastvaM vasiShThasya tattvamAkhyAhi me mune |
ahi.nsayitvA keneha brahmahatyA vidhIyate
shlokas.4:
iti pRRiShTo mahArAja parAsharasharIrajaH |
abravInnipuNo dharme niHsa.nshayamanuttamam
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNaM svayamAhUya bhikShArthe kRRishavRRittinam |
brUyAnnAstIti yaH pashchAttaM vidyAdbrahmaghAtinam
shlokas.6:
madhyasthasyeha viprasya yo.anUchAnasya bhArata |
vRRittiM harati durbuddhistaM vidyAdbrahmaghAtinam
shlokas.7:
gokulasya tRRiShArtasya jalArthe vasudhAdhipa |
utpAdayati yo vighnaM taM vidyAdbrahmaghAtinam
shlokas.8:
yaH pravRRittAM shrutiM samyakShAstraM vA munibhiH kRRitam |
dUShayatyanabhij~nAya taM vidyAdbrahmaghAtinam
shlokas.9:
