AtmajAM rUpasampannAM mahatIM sadRRishe vare |
na prayachChati yaH kanyAM taM vidyAdbrahmaghAtinam
shlokas.10:
adharmanirato mUDho mithyA yo vai dvijAtiShu |
dadyAnmarmAtigaM shokaM taM vidyAdbrahmaghAtinam
shlokas.11:
chakShuShA viprahInasya pa~Ngulasya jaDasya vA |
hareta yo vai sarvasvaM taM vidyAdbrahmaghAtinam
shlokas.12:
Ashrame vA vane vA yo grAme vA yadi vA pure |
agniM samutsRRijenmohAttaM vidyAdbrahmaghAtinam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tIrthAnAM darshanaM shreyaH snAnaM cha bharatarShabha |
shravaNaM cha mahAprAj~na shrotumichChAmi tattvataH
shlokas.2:
pRRithivyAM yAni tIrthAni puNyAni bharatarShabha |
vaktumarhasi me tAni shrotAsmi niyataH prabho
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
imama~NgirasA proktaM tIrthava.nshaM mahAdyute |
shrotumarhasi bhadraM te prApsyase dharmamuttamam
shlokas.4:
tapovanagataM vipramabhigamya mahAmunim |
paprachChA~NgirasaM vIra gautamaH sa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.5:
asti me bhagavankashchittIrthebhyo dharmasa.nshayaH |
tatsarvaM shrotumichChAmi tanme sha.nsa mahAmune
shlokas.6:
upaspRRishya phalaM kiM syAtteShu tIrtheShu vai mune |
pretyabhAve mahAprAj~na tadyathAsti tathA vada
shlokas.7:
a~NgirA uvAcha||
saptAhaM chandrabhAgAM vai vitastAmUrmimAlinIm |
vigAhya vai nirAhAro nirmamo munivadbhavet
shlokas.8:
kAshmIramaNDale nadyo yAH patanti mahAnadam |
tA nadIH sindhumAsAdya shIlavAnsvargamApnuyAt
shlokas.9:
puShkaraM cha prabhAsaM cha naimiShaM sAgarodakam |
devikAmindramArgaM cha svarNabinduM vigAhya cha
vibodhyate vimAnasthaH so.apsarobhirabhiShTutaH
shlokas.10:
hiraNyabinduM vikShobhya prayatashchAbhivAdya tam |
kusheshayaM cha devatvaM pUyate tasya kilbiSham
shlokas.11:
indratoyAM samAsAdya gandhamAdanasaMnidhau |
karatoyAM kura~NgeShu trirAtropoShito naraH
ashvamedhamavApnoti vigAhya niyataH shuchiH
shlokas.12:
ga~NgAdvAre kushAvarte bilvake nemiparvate |
tathA kanakhale snAtvA dhUtapApmA divaM vrajet
shlokas.13:
apAM hrada upaspRRishya vAjapeyaphalaM labhet |
brahmachArI jitakrodhaH satyasandhastvahi.nsakaH
shlokas.14:
yatra bhAgIrathI ga~NgA bhajate dishamuttarAm |
maheshvarasya niShThAne yo narastvabhiShichyate
ekamAsaM nirAhAraH svayaM pashyati devatAH
shlokas.15:
saptaga~Nge triga~Nge cha indramArge cha tarpayan |
sudhAM vai labhate bhoktuM yo naro jAyate punaH
shlokas.16:
mahAshrama upaspRRishya yo.agnihotraparaH shuchiH |
ekamAsaM nirAhAraH siddhiM mAsena sa vrajet
shlokas.17:
mahAhrada upaspRRishya bhRRigutu~Nge tvalolupaH |
trirAtropoShito bhUtvA muchyate brahmahatyayA
shlokas.18:
kanyAkUpa upaspRRishya balAkAyAM kRRitodakaH |
deveShu kIrtiM labhate yashasA cha virAjate
shlokas.19:
deshakAla upaspRRishya tathA sundarikAhrade |
ashvibhyAM rUpavarchasyaM pretya vai labhate naraH
shlokas.20:
mahAga~NgAmupaspRRishya kRRittikA~NgArake tathA |
pakShamekaM nirAhAraH svargamApnoti nirmalaH
shlokas.21:
vaimAnika upaspRRishya ki~NkiNIkAshrame tathA |
nivAse.apsarasAM divye kAmachArI mahIyate
shlokas.22:
kAlikAshramamAsAdya vipAshAyAM kRRitodakaH |
brahmachArI jitakrodhastrirAtrAnmuchyate bhavAt
shlokas.23:
Ashrame kRRittikAnAM tu snAtvA yastarpayetpitR^In |
toShayitvA mahAdevaM nirmalaH svargamApnuyAt
shlokas.24:
mahApura upaspRRishya trirAtropoShito naraH |
trasAnAM sthAvarANAM cha dvipadAnAM bhayaM tyajet
shlokas.25:
devadAruvane snAtvA dhUtapApmA kRRitodakaH |
devalokamavApnoti saptarAtroShitaH shuchiH
shlokas.26:
kaushante cha kushastambe droNasharmapade tathA |
ApaHprapatane snAtaH sevyate so.apsarogaNaiH
shlokas.27:
chitrakUTe janasthAne tathA mandAkinIjale |
vigAhya vai nirAhAro rAjalakShmIM nigachChati
shlokas.28:
shyAmAyAstvAshramaM gatvA uShya chaivAbhiShichya cha |
trI.nstrirAtrAnsa sandhAya gandharvanagare vaset
shlokas.29:
ramaNyAM cha upaspRRishya tathA vai gandhatArike |
ekamAsaM nirAhArastvantardhAnaphalaM labhet
shlokas.30:
kaushikIdvAramAsAdya vAyubhakShastvalolupaH |
ekavi.nshatirAtreNa svargamArohate naraH
shlokas.31:
mata~NgavApyAM yaH snAyAdekarAtreNa sidhyati |
vigAhati hyanAlambamandhakaM vai sanAtanam
shlokas.32:
naimiShe svargatIrthe cha upaspRRishya jitendriyaH |
phalaM puruShamedhasya labhenmAsaM kRRitodakaH
shlokas.33:
ga~NgAhrada upaspRRishya tathA chaivotpalAvane |
ashvamedhamavApnoti tatra mAsaM kRRitodakaH
shlokas.34:
ga~NgAyamunayostIrthe tathA kAla~njare girau |
ShaShTihrada upaspRRishya dAnaM nAnyadvishiShyate
shlokas.35:
dasha tIrthasahasrANi tisraH koTyastathAparAH |
samAgachChanti mAghyAM tu prayAge bharatarShabha
shlokas.36:
mAghamAsaM prayAge tu niyataH sa.nshitavrataH |
snAtvA tu bharatashreShTha nirmalaH svargamApnuyAt
shlokas.37:
marudgaNa upaspRRishya pitR^INAmAshrame shuchiH |
vaivasvatasya tIrthe cha tIrthabhUto bhavennaraH
shlokas.38:
tathA brahmashiro gatvA bhAgIrathyAM kRRitodakaH |
ekamAsaM nirAhAraH somalokamavApnuyAt
shlokas.39:
kapotake naraH snAtvA aShTAvakre kRRitodakaH |
dvAdashAhaM nirAhAro naramedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.40:
mu~njapRRiShThaM gayAM chaiva nirRRitiM devaparvatam |
tRRitIyAM krau~nchapAdIM cha brahmahatyA vishudhyati
shlokas.41:
kalashyAM vApyupaspRRishya vedyAM cha bahushojalAm |
agneH pure naraH snAtvA vishAlAyAM kRRitodakaH
devahrada upaspRRishya brahmabhUto virAjate
shlokas.42:
purApavartanaM nandAM mahAnandAM cha sevya vai |
nandane sevyate dAntastvapsarobhirahi.nsakaH
shlokas.43:
urvashIkRRittikAyoge gatvA yaH susamAhitaH |
lauhitye vidhivatsnAtvA puNDarIkaphalaM labhet
shlokas.44:
rAmahrada upaspRRishya vishAlAyAM kRRitodakaH |
dvAdashAhaM nirAhAraH kalmaShAdvipramuchyate
shlokas.45:
mahAhrada upaspRRishya shuddhena manasA naraH |
ekamAsaM nirAhAro jamadagnigatiM labhet
shlokas.46:
vindhye santApya chAtmAnaM satyasandhastvahi.nsakaH |
ShaNmAsaM padamAsthAya mAsenaikena shudhyati
shlokas.47:
narmadAyAmupaspRRishya tathA sUrpArakodake |
ekapakShaM nirAhAro rAjaputro vidhIyate
shlokas.48:
jambUmArge tribhirmAsaiH sa.nyataH susamAhitaH |
ahorAtreNa chaikena siddhiM samadhigachChati
shlokas.49:
kokAmukhe vigAhyApo gatvA chaNDAlikAshramam |
shAkabhakShashchIravAsAH kumArIrvindate dasha
shlokas.50:
vaivasvatasya sadanaM na sa gachChetkadAchana |
yasya kanyAhrade vAso devalokaM sa gachChati
shlokas.51:
prabhAse tvekarAtreNa amAvAsyAM samAhitaH |
sidhyate.atra mahAbAho yo naro jAyate punaH
shlokas.52:
ujjAnaka upaspRRishya ArShTiSheNasya chAshrame |
pi~NgAyAshchAshrame snAtvA sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.53:
kulyAyAM samupaspRRishya japtvA chaivAghamarShaNam |
ashvamedhamavApnoti trirAtropoShitaH shuchiH
shlokas.54:
piNDAraka upaspRRishya ekarAtroShito naraH |
agniShTomamavApnoti prabhAtAM sharvarIM shuchiH
shlokas.55:
tathA brahmasaro gatvA dharmAraNyopashobhitam |
puNDarIkamavApnoti prabhAtAM sharvarIM shuchiH
shlokas.56:
mainAke parvate snAtvA tathA sandhyAmupAsya cha |
kAmaM jitvA cha vai mAsaM sarvamedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.57:
vikhyAto himavAnpuNyaH sha~Nkarashvashuro giriH |
AkaraH sarvaratnAnAM siddhachAraNasevitaH
shlokas.58:
sharIramutsRRijettatra vidhipUrvamanAshake |
adhruvaM jIvitaM j~nAtvA yo vai vedAntago dvijaH
shlokas.59:
abhyarchya devatAstatra namaskRRitya munI.nstathA |
tataH siddho divaM gachChedbrahmalokaM sanAtanam
shlokas.60:
kAmaM krodhaM cha lobhaM cha yo jitvA tIrthamAvaset |
na tena ki~nchinna prAptaM tIrthAbhigamanAdbhavet
shlokas.61:
yAnyagamyAni tIrthAni durgANi viShamANi cha |
manasA tAni gamyAni sarvatIrthasamAsataH
shlokas.62:
idaM medhyamidaM dhanyamidaM svargyamidaM sukham |
idaM rahasyaM devAnAmAplAvyAnAM cha pAvanam
shlokas.63:
idaM dadyAddvijAtInAM sAdhUnAmAtmajasya vA |
suhRRidAM cha japetkarNe shiShyasyAnugatasya vA
shlokas.64:
dattavAngautamasyedama~NgirA vai mahAtapAH |
gurubhiH samanuj~nAtaH kAshyapena cha dhImatA
shlokas.65:
maharShINAmidaM japyaM pAvanAnAM tathottamam |
japa.nshchAbhyutthitaH shashvannirmalaH svargamApnuyAt
shlokas.66:
idaM yashchApi shRRiNuyAdrahasyaM tva~Ngiromatam |
uttame cha kule janma labhejjAtiM cha sa.nsmaret

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bRRihaspatisamaM buddhyA kShamayA brahmaNaH samam |
parAkrame shakrasamamAdityasamatejasam
shlokas.2:
gA~NgeyamarjunenAjau nihataM bhUrivarchasam |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito.anyaishcha paryupAste yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.3:
shayAnaM vIrashayane kAlAkA~NkShiNamachyutam |
AjagmurbharatashreShThaM draShTukAmA maharShayaH
shlokas.4:
atrirvasiShTho.atha bhRRiguH pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH |
a~NgirA gautamo.agastyaH sumatiH svAyurAtmavAn
shlokas.5:
vishvAmitraH sthUlashirAH sa.nvartaH pramatirdamaH |
ushanA bRRihaspatirvyAsashchyavanaH kAshyapo dhruvaH
shlokas.6:
durvAsA jamadagnishcha mArkaNDeyo.atha gAlavaH |
bharadvAjashcha raibhyashcha yavakrItastritastathA
shlokas.7:
sthUlAkShaH shakalAkShashcha kaNvo medhAtithiH kRRishaH |
nAradaH parvatashchaiva sudhanvAthaikato dvitaH
shlokas.8:
nitambhUrbhuvano dhaumyaH shatAnando.akRRitavraNaH |
jAmadagnyastathA rAmaH kAmyashchetyevamAdayaH
samAgatA mahAtmAno bhIShmaM draShTuM maharShayaH
shlokas.9:
teShAM mahAtmanAM pUjAmAgatAnAM yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahitashchakre yathAvadanupUrvashaH
shlokas.10:
te pUjitAH sukhAsInAH kathAshchakrurmaharShayaH |
bhIShmAshritAH sumadhurAH sarvendriyamanoharAH
shlokas.11:
bhIShmasteShAM kathAH shrutvA RRiShINAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
mene divisthamAtmAnaM tuShTyA paramayA yutaH
shlokas.12:
tataste bhIShmamAmantrya pANDavA.nshcha maharShayaH |
antardhAnaM gatAH sarve sarveShAmeva pashyatAm
shlokas.13:
tAnRRiShInsumahAbhAgAnantardhAnagatAnapi |
pANDavAstuShTuvuH sarve praNemushcha muhurmuhuH
shlokas.14:
prasannamanasaH sarve gA~NgeyaM kurusattamAH |
upatasthuryathodyantamAdityaM mantrakovidAH
shlokas.15:
prabhAvAttapasasteShAmRRiShINAM vIkShya pANDavAH |
prakAshanto dishaH sarvA vismayaM paramaM yayuH
shlokas.16:
mahAbhAgyaM paraM teShAmRRiShINAmanuchintya te |
pANDavAH saha bhIShmeNa kathAshchakrustadAshrayAH
shlokas.17:
kathAnte shirasA pAdau spRRiShTvA bhIShmasya pANDavaH |
dharmyaM dharmasutaH prashnaM paryapRRichChadyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.18:
ke deshAH ke janapadA AshramAH ke cha parvatAH |
prakRRiShTAH puNyataH kAshcha j~neyA nadyaH pitAmaha
shlokas.19:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
shilo~nChavRRitteH sa.nvAdaM siddhasya cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.20:
imAM kashchitparikramya pRRithivIM shailabhUShitAm |
asakRRiddvipadAM shreShThaH shreShThasya gRRihamedhinaH
shlokas.21:
shilavRRittergRRihaM prAptaH sa tena vidhinArchitaH |
kRRitakRRitya upAtiShThatsiddhaM tamatithiM tadA
shlokas.22:
tau sametya mahAtmAnau sukhAsInau kathAH shubhAH |
chakraturvedasambaddhAstachCheShakRRitalakShaNAH
shlokas.23:
shilavRRittiH kathAnte tu siddhamAmantrya yatnataH |
prashnaM paprachCha medhAvI yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi
shlokas.24:
shilavRRittiruvAcha||
ke deshAH ke janapadAH ke.a.ashramAH ke cha parvatAH |
prakRRiShTAH puNyataH kAshcha j~neyA nadyastaduchyatAm
shlokas.25:
siddha uvAcha||
te deshAste janapadAste.a.ashramAste cha parvatAH |
yeShAM bhAgIrathI ga~NgA madhyenaiti saridvarA
shlokas.26:
tapasA brahmacharyeNa yaj~naistyAgena vA punaH |
gatiM tAM na labhejjanturga~NgAM sa.nsevya yAM labhet
shlokas.27:
spRRiShTAni yeShAM gA~NgeyaistoyairgAtrANi dehinAm |
nyastAni na punasteShAM tyAgaH svargAdvidhIyate
shlokas.28:
sarvANi yeShAM gA~NgeyaistoyaiH kRRityAni dehinAm |
gAM tyaktvA mAnavA vipra divi tiShThanti te.achalAH
shlokas.29:
pUrve vayasi karmANi kRRitvA pApAni ye narAH |
pashchAdga~NgAM niShevante te.api yAntyuttamAM gatim
shlokas.30:
snAtAnAM shuchibhistoyairgA~NgeyaiH prayatAtmanAm |
vyuShTirbhavati yA pu.nsAM na sA kratushatairapi
shlokas.31:
yAvadasthi manuShyasya ga~NgAtoyeShu tiShThati |
tAvadvarShasahasrANi svargaM prApya mahIyate
shlokas.32:
apahatya tamastIvraM yathA bhAtyudaye raviH |
tathApahatya pApmAnaM bhAti ga~NgAjalokShitaH
shlokas.33:
visomA iva sharvaryo vipuShpAstaravo yathA |
tadvaddeshA dishashchaiva hInA ga~NgAjalaiH shubhaiH
shlokas.34:
varNAshramA yathA sarve svadharmaj~nAnavarjitAH |
kratavashcha yathAsomAstathA ga~NgAM vinA jagat
shlokas.35:
yathA hInaM nabho.arkeNa bhUH shailaiH khaM cha vAyunA |
tathA deshA dishashchaiva ga~NgAhInA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.36:
triShu lokeShu ye kechitprANinaH sarva eva te |
tarpyamANAH parAM tRRiptiM yAnti ga~NgAjalaiH shubhaiH
shlokas.37:
yastu sUryeNa niShTaptaM gA~NgeyaM pibate jalam |
gavAM nirhAranirmuktAdyAvakAttadvishiShyate
shlokas.38:
induvratasahasraM tu charedyaH kAyashodhanam |
pibedyashchApi ga~NgAmbhaH samau syAtAM na vA samau
shlokas.39:
tiShThedyugasahasraM tu pAdenaikena yaH pumAn |
mAsamekaM tu ga~NgAyAM samau syAtAM na vA samau
shlokas.40:
lambetAvAkShirA yastu yugAnAmayutaM pumAn |
tiShThedyatheShTaM yashchApi ga~NgAyAM sa vishiShyate
shlokas.41:
agnau prAptaM pradhUyeta yathA tUlaM dvijottama |
tathA ga~NgAvagADhasya sarvaM pApaM pradhUyate
shlokas.42:
bhUtAnAmiha sarveShAM duHkhopahatachetasAm |
gatimanveShamANAnAM na ga~NgAsadRRishI gatiH
shlokas.43:
bhavanti nirviShAH sarpA yathA tArkShyasya darshanAt |
ga~NgAyA darshanAttadvatsarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.44:
apratiShThAshcha ye kechidadharmasharaNAshcha ye |
teShAM pratiShThA ga~Ngeha sharaNaM sharma varma cha
shlokas.45:
prakRRiShTairashubhairgrastAnanekaiH puruShAdhamAn |
patato narake ga~NgA sa.nshritAnpretya tArayet
shlokas.46:
te sa.nvibhaktA munibhirnUnaM devaiH savAsavaiH |
ye.abhigachChanti satataM ga~NgAmabhigatAM suraiH
shlokas.47:
vinayAchArahInAshcha ashivAshcha narAdhamAH |
te bhavanti shivA vipra ye vai ga~NgAM samAshritAH
shlokas.48:
yathA surANAmamRRitaM pitR^INAM cha yathA svadhA |
sudhA yathA cha nAgAnAM tathA ga~NgAjalaM nRRiNAm
shlokas.49:
upAsate yathA bAlA mAtaraM kShudhayArditAH |
shreyaskAmAstathA ga~NgAmupAsantIha dehinaH
shlokas.50:
svAyambhuvaM yathA sthAnaM sarveShAM shreShThamuchyate |
snAtAnAM saritAM shreShThA ga~NgA tadvadihochyate
shlokas.51:
yathopajIvinAM dhenurdevAdInAM dharA smRRitA |
tathopajIvinAM ga~NgA sarvaprANabhRRitAmiha
shlokas.52:
devAH somArkasa.nsthAni yathA satrAdibhirmakhaiH |
amRRitAnyupajIvanti tathA ga~NgAjalaM narAH
shlokas.53:
jAhnavIpulinotthAbhiH sikatAbhiH samukShitaH |
manyate puruSho.a.atmAnaM diviShThamiva shobhitam
shlokas.54:
jAhnavItIrasambhUtAM mRRidaM mUrdhnA bibharti yaH |
bibharti rUpaM so.arkasya tamonAshAtsunirmalam
shlokas.55:
ga~Ngormibhiratho digdhaH puruShaM pavano yadA |
spRRishate so.api pApmAnaM sadya evApamArjati
shlokas.56:
vyasanairabhitaptasya narasya vinashiShyataH |
ga~NgAdarshanajA prItirvyasanAnyapakarShati
shlokas.57:
ha.nsArAvaiH kokaravai ravairanyaishcha pakShiNAm |
paspardha ga~NgA gandharvAnpulinaishcha shilochchayAn
shlokas.58:
ha.nsAdibhiH subahubhirvividhaiH pakShibhirvRRitAm |
ga~NgAM gokulasambAdhAM dRRiShTvA svargo.api vismRRitaH
shlokas.59:
na sA prItirdiviShThasya sarvakAmAnupAshnataH |
abhavadyA parA prItirga~NgAyAH puline nRRiNAm
shlokas.60:
vA~NmanaHkarmajairgrastaH pApairapi pumAniha |
vIkShya ga~NgAM bhavetpUtastatra me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.61:
saptAvarAnsapta parAnpitR^I.nstebhyashcha ye pare |
pumA.nstArayate ga~NgAM vIkShya spRRiShTvAvagAhya cha
shlokas.62:
shrutAbhilaShitA dRRiShTA spRRiShTA pItAvagAhitA |
ga~NgA tArayate nR^INAmubhau va.nshau visheShataH
shlokas.63:
darshanAtsparshanAtpAnAttathA ga~Ngeti kIrtanAt |
punAtyapuNyAnpuruShA~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.64:
ya ichChetsaphalaM janma jIvitaM shrutameva cha |
sa pitR^I.nstarpayedga~NgAmabhigamya surA.nstathA
shlokas.65:
na sutairna cha vittena karmaNA na cha tatphalam |
prApnuyAtpuruSho.atyantaM ga~NgAM prApya yadApnuyAt
shlokas.66:
jAtyandhairiha tulyAste mRRitaiH pa~Ngubhireva cha |
samarthA ye na pashyanti ga~NgAM puNyajalAM shivAm
shlokas.67:
bhUtabhavyabhaviShyaj~nairmaharShibhirupasthitAm |
devaiH sendraishcha ko ga~NgAM nopaseveta mAnavaH
shlokas.68:
vAnaprasthairgRRihasthaishcha yatibhirbrahmachAribhiH |
vidyAvadbhiH shritAM ga~NgAM pumAnko nAma nAshrayet
shlokas.69:
utkrAmadbhishcha yaH prANaiH prayataH shiShTasaMmataH |
chintayenmanasA ga~NgAM sa gatiM paramAM labhet
shlokas.70:
na bhayebhyo bhayaM tasya na pApebhyo na rAjataH |
A dehapatanAdga~NgAmupAste yaH pumAniha
shlokas.71:
gaganAdyAM mahApuNyAM patantIM vai maheshvaraH |
dadhAra shirasA devIM tAmeva divi sevate
shlokas.72:
ala~NkRRitAstrayo lokAH pathibhirvimalaistribhiH |
yastu tasyA jalaM sevetkRRitakRRityaH pumAnbhavet
shlokas.73:
divi jyotiryathAdityaH pitR^INAM chaiva chandramAH |
deveshashcha yathA nR^INAM ga~Ngeha saritAM tathA
shlokas.74:
mAtrA pitrA sutairdArairviyuktasya dhanena vA |
na bhaveddhi tathA duHkhaM yathA ga~NgAviyogajam
shlokas.75:
nAraNyairneShTaviShayairna sutairna dhanAgamaiH |
tathA prasAdo bhavati ga~NgAM vIkShya yathA nRRiNAm
shlokas.76:
pUrNaminduM yathA dRRiShTvA nRRiNAM dRRiShTiH prasIdati |
ga~NgAM tripathagAM dRRiShTvA tathA dRRiShTiH prasIdati
shlokas.77:
tadbhAvastadgatamanAstanniShThastatparAyaNaH |
ga~NgAM yo.anugato bhaktyA sa tasyAH priyatAM vrajet
shlokas.78:
bhUHsthaiH khasthairdiviShThaishcha bhUtairuchchAvachairapi |
ga~NgA vigAhyA satatametatkAryatamaM satAm
shlokas.79:
triShu lokeShu puNyatvAdga~NgAyAH prathitaM yashaH |
yatputrAnsagarasyaiShA bhasmAkhyAnanayaddivam
shlokas.81:
payasvinIM ghRRitinImatyudArAM; samRRiddhinIM veginIM durvigAhyAm |
ga~NgAM gatvA yaiH sharIraM visRRiShTaM; gatA dhIrAste vibudhaiH samatvam
shlokas.82:
andhA~njaDAndravyahInA.nshcha ga~NgA; yashasvinI bRRihatI vishvarUpA |
devaiH sendrairmunibhirmAnavaishcha; niShevitA sarvakAmairyunakti
shlokas.83:
UrjAvatIM madhumatIM mahApuNyAM trivartmagAm |
trilokagoptrIM ye ga~NgAM sa.nshritAste divaM gatAH
shlokas.84:
yo vatsyati drakShyati vApi martya;stasmai prayachChanti sukhAni devAH |
tadbhAvitAH sparshane darshane ya;stasmai devA gatimiShTAM dishanti
shlokas.85:
dakShAM pRRithvIM bRRihatIM viprakRRiShTAM; shivAmRRitAM surasAM suprasannAm |
vibhAvarIM sarvabhUtapratiShThAM; ga~NgAM gatA ye tridivaM gatAste
shlokas.86:
khyAtiryasyAH khaM divaM gAM cha nityaM; purA disho vidishashchAvatasthe |
tasyA jalaM sevya saridvarAyA; martyAH sarve kRRitakRRityA bhavanti
shlokas.87:
iyaM ga~Ngeti niyataM pratiShThA; guhasya rukmasya cha garbhayoShA |
prAtastrimArgA ghRRitavahA vipApmA; ga~NgAvatIrNA viyato vishvatoyA
shlokas.88:
sutAvanIdhrasya harasya bhAryA; divo bhuvashchApi kakShyAnurUpA |
bhavyA pRRithivyA bhAvinI bhAti rAja;nga~NgA lokAnAM puNyadA vai trayANAm
shlokas.89:
madhupravAhA ghRRitarAgoddhRRitAbhi;rmahormibhiH shobhitA brAhmaNaishcha |
divashchyutA shirasAttA bhavena; ga~NgAvanIdhrAstridivasya mAlA
shlokas.90:
yonirvariShThA virajA vitanvI; shuShmA irA vArivahA yashodA |
vishvAvatI chAkRRitiriShTiriddhA; ga~NgokShitAnAM bhuvanasya panthAH
shlokas.91:
kShAntyA mahyA gopane dhAraNe cha; dIptyA kRRishAnostapanasya chaiva |
tulyA ga~NgA saMmatA brAhmaNAnAM; guhasya brahmaNyatayA cha nityam
shlokas.92:
RRiShiShTutAM viShNupadIM purANIM; supuNyatoyAM manasApi loke |
sarvAtmanA jAhnavIM ye prapannA;ste brahmaNaH sadanaM samprayAtAH
shlokas.93:
lokAnimAnnayati yA jananIva putrA;nsarvAtmanA sarvaguNopapannA |
svasthAnamiShTamiha brAhmamabhIpsamAnai;rga~NgA sadaivAtmavashairupAsyA
shlokas.94:
usrAM juShTAM miShatIM vishvatoyA;mirAM vajrIM revatIM bhUdharANAm |
shiShTAshrayAmamRRitAM brahmakAntAM; ga~NgAM shrayedAtmavAnsiddhikAmaH
shlokas.95:
prasAdya devAnsavibhUnsamastA;nbhagIrathastapasogreNa ga~NgAm |
gAmAnayattAmabhigamya shashva;npumAnbhayaM neha nAmutra vidyAt
shlokas.96:
udAhRRitaH sarvathA te guNAnAM; mayaikadeshaH prasamIkShya buddhyA |
shaktirna me kAchidihAsti vaktuM; guNAnsarvAnparimAtuM tathaiva
shlokas.97:
meroH samudrasya cha sarvaratnaiH; sa~NkhyopalAnAmudakasya vApi |
vaktuM shakyaM neha ga~NgAjalAnAM; guNAkhyAnaM parimAtuM tathaiva
shlokas.98:
tasmAdimAnparayA shraddhayoktA;nguNAnsarvA~njAhnavIjA.nstathaiva |
bhajedvAchA manasA karmaNA cha; bhaktyA yuktaH parayA shraddadhAnaH
shlokas.99:
lokAnimA.nstrInyashasA vitatya; siddhiM prApya mahatIM tAM durApAm |
ga~NgAkRRitAnachireNaiva lokA;nyatheShTamiShTAnvichariShyasi tvam
shlokas.100:
tava mama cha guNairmahAnubhAvA; juShatu matiM satataM svadharmayuktaiH |
abhigatajanavatsalA hi ga~NgA; bhajati yunakti sukhaishcha bhaktimantam
shlokas.101:
bhIShma uvAcha||
iti paramamatirguNAnanekA;~nshilarataye tripathAnuyogarUpAn |
bahuvidhamanushAsya tathyarUpA;ngaganatalaM dyutimAnvivesha siddhaH
shlokas.102:
shilavRRittistu siddhasya vAkyaiH sambodhitastadA |
ga~NgAmupAsya vidhivatsiddhiM prAptaH sudurlabhAm
shlokas.103:
tasmAttvamapi kaunteya bhaktyA paramayA yutaH |
ga~NgAmabhyehi satataM prApsyase siddhimuttamAm
shlokas.104:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvetihAsaM bhIShmoktaM ga~NgAyAH stavasa.nyutam |
yudhiShThiraH parAM prItimagachChadbhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.105:
itihAsamimaM puNyaM shRRiNuyAdyaH paTheta vA |
ga~NgAyAH stavasa.nyuktaM sa muchyetsarvakilbiShaiH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
praj~nAshrutAbhyAM vRRittena shIlena cha yathA bhavAn |
guNaiH samuditaH sarvairvayasA cha samanvitaH
tasmAdbhavantaM pRRichChAmi dharmaM dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.2:
kShatriyo yadi vA vaishyaH shUdro vA rAjasattama |
brAhmaNyaM prApnuyAtkena tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.3:
tapasA vA sumahatA karmaNA vA shrutena vA |
brAhmaNyamatha chedichChettanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
brAhmaNyaM tAta duShprApaM varNaiH kShatrAdibhistribhiH |
paraM hi sarvabhUtAnAM sthAnametadyudhiShThira
shlokas.5:
bahvIstu sa.nsaranyonIrjAyamAnaH punaH punaH |
paryAye tAta kasmi.nshchidbrAhmaNo nAma jAyate
shlokas.6:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
mata~Ngasya cha sa.nvAdaM gardabhyAshcha yudhiShThira
shlokas.7:
dvijAteH kasyachittAta tulyavarNaH sutaH prabhuH |
mata~Ngo nAma nAmnAbhUtsarvaiH samudito guNaiH
shlokas.8:
sa yaj~nakAraH kaunteya pitrA sRRiShTaH parantapa |
prAyAdgardabhayuktena rathenehAshugAminA
shlokas.9:
sa bAlaM gardabhaM rAjanvahantaM mAturantike |
niravidhyatpratodena nAsikAyAM punaH punaH
shlokas.10:
taM tu tIvravraNaM dRRiShTvA gardabhI putragRRiddhinI |
uvAcha mA shuchaH putra chaNDAlastvAdhitiShThati
shlokas.11:
brAhmaNe dAruNaM nAsti maitro brAhmaNa uchyate |
AchAryaH sarvabhUtAnAM shAstA kiM prahariShyati
shlokas.12:
ayaM tu pApaprakRRitirbAle na kurute dayAm |
svayoniM mAnayatyeSha bhAvo bhAvaM nigachChati
shlokas.13:
etachChrutvA mata~Ngastu dAruNaM rAsabhIvachaH |
avatIrya rathAttUrNaM rAsabhIM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.14:
brUhi rAsabhi kalyANi mAtA me yena dUShitA |
kathaM mAM vetsi chaNDAlaM kShipraM rAsabhi sha.nsa me
shlokas.15:
kena jAto.asmi chaNDAlo brAhmaNyaM yena me.anashat |
tattvenaitanmahAprAj~ne brUhi sarvamasheShataH
shlokas.16:
gardabhyuvAcha||
brAhmaNyAM vRRiShalena tvaM mattAyAM nApitena ha |
jAtastvamasi chaNDAlo brAhmaNyaM tena te.anashat
shlokas.17:
evamukto mata~Ngastu pratyupAyAdgRRihaM prati |
tamAgatamabhiprekShya pitA vAkyamathAbravIt
shlokas.18:
mayA tvaM yaj~nasa.nsiddhau niyukto gurukarmaNi |
kasmAtpratinivRRitto.asi kachchinna kushalaM tava
shlokas.19:
mata~Nga uvAcha||
ayoniragryayonirvA yaH syAtsa kushalI bhavet |
kushalaM tu kutastasya yasyeyaM jananI pitaH
shlokas.20:
brAhmaNyAM vRRiShalAjjAtaM pitarvedayatIha mAm |
amAnuShI gardabhIyaM tasmAttapsye tapo mahat
shlokas.21:
evamuktvA sa pitaraM pratasthe kRRitanishchayaH |
tato gatvA mahAraNyamatapyata mahattapaH
shlokas.22:
tataH santApayAmAsa vibudhA.nstapasAnvitaH |
mata~NgaH susukhaM prepsuH sthAnaM sucharitAdapi
shlokas.23:
taM tathA tapasA yuktamuvAcha harivAhanaH |
mata~Nga tapyase kiM tvaM bhogAnutsRRijya mAnuShAn
shlokas.24:
varaM dadAni te hanta vRRiNIShva tvaM yadichChasi |
yachchApyavApyamanyatte sarvaM prabrUhi mAchiram
shlokas.25:
mata~Nga uvAcha||
brAhmaNyaM kAmayAno.ahamidamArabdhavA.nstapaH |
gachCheyaM tadavApyeha vara eSha vRRito mayA
shlokas.26:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM tamuvAcha pura.ndaraH |
brAhmaNyaM prArthayAnastvamaprApyamakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.27:
shreShThaM yatsarvabhUteShu tapo yannAtivartate |
tadagryaM prArthayAnastvamachirAdvinashiShyasi
shlokas.28:
devatAsuramartyeShu yatpavitraM paraM smRRitam |
chaNDAlayonau jAtena na tatprApyaM katha~nchana

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamukto mata~Ngastu sa.nshitAtmA yatavrataH |
atiShThadekapAdena varShANAM shatamachyuta
shlokas.2:
tamuvAcha tataH shakraH punareva mahAyashAH |
mata~Nga paramaM sthAnaM prArthayannatidurlabham
shlokas.3:
mA kRRithAH sAhasaM putra naiSha dharmapathastava |
aprApyaM prArthayAno hi nachirAdvinashiShyasi
shlokas.4:
mata~Nga paramaM sthAnaM vAryamANo mayA sakRRit |
chikIrShasyeva tapasA sarvathA na bhaviShyasi
shlokas.5:
tiryagyonigataH sarvo mAnuShyaM yadi gachChati |
sa jAyate pulkaso vA chaNDAlo vA kadAchana
shlokas.6:
pu.nshchalaH pApayonirvA yaH kashchidiha lakShyate |
sa tasyAmeva suchiraM mata~Nga parivartate
shlokas.7:
tato dashaguNe kAle labhate shUdratAmapi |
shUdrayonAvapi tato bahushaH parivartate
shlokas.8:
tatastri.nshadguNe kAle labhate vaishyatAmapi |
vaishyatAyAM chiraM kAlaM tatraiva parivartate
shlokas.9:
tataH ShaShTiguNe kAle rAjanyo nAma jAyate |
rAjanyatve chiraM kAlaM tatraiva parivartate
shlokas.10:
tataH ShaShTiguNe kAle labhate brahmabandhutAm |
brahmabandhushchiraM kAlaM tatraiva parivartate
shlokas.11:
tatastu dvishate kAle labhate kANDapRRiShThatAm |
kANDapRRiShThashchiraM kAlaM tatraiva parivartate
shlokas.12:
tatastu trishate kAle labhate dvijatAmapi |
tAM cha prApya chiraM kAlaM tatraiva parivartate
shlokas.13:
tatashchatuHshate kAle shrotriyo nAma jAyate |
shrotriyatve chiraM kAlaM tatraiva parivartate
shlokas.14:
tadaiva krodhaharShau cha kAmadveShau cha putraka |
atimAnAtivAdau tamAvishanti dvijAdhamam
shlokas.15:
tA.nshchejjayati shatrUnsa tadA prApnoti sadgatim |
atha te vai jayantyenaM tAlAgrAdiva pAtyate
shlokas.16:
mata~Nga sampradhAryaitadyadahaM tvAmachUchudam |
vRRiNIShva kAmamanyaM tvaM brAhmaNyaM hi sudurlabham

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamukto mata~Ngastu bhRRishaM shokaparAyaNaH |
atiShThata gayAM gatvA so.a~NguShThena shataM samAH
shlokas.2:
suduShkaraM vahanyogaM kRRisho dhamanisantataH |
tvagasthibhUto dharmAtmA sa papAteti naH shrutam
shlokas.3:
taM patantamabhidrutya parijagrAha vAsavaH |
varANAmIshvaro dAtA sarvabhUtahite rataH
shlokas.4:
shakra uvAcha||
mata~Nga brAhmaNatvaM te sa.nvRRitaM paripanthibhiH |
pUjayansukhamApnoti duHkhamApnotyapUjayan
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNe sarvabhUtAnAM yogakShemaH samAhitaH |
brAhmaNebhyo.anutRRipyanti pitaro devatAstathA
shlokas.6:
brAhmaNaH sarvabhUtAnAM mata~Nga para uchyate |
brAhmaNaH kurute taddhi yathA yadyachcha vA~nChati
shlokas.7:
bahvIstu sa.nsaranyonIrjAyamAnaH punaH punaH |
paryAye tAta kasmi.nshchidbrAhmaNyamiha vindati
shlokas.8:
mata~Nga uvAcha||
kiM mAM tudasi duHkhArtaM mRRitaM mArayase cha mAm |
taM tu shochAmi yo labdhvA brAhmaNyaM na bubhUShate
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNyaM yadi duShprApaM tribhirvarNaiH shatakrato |
sudurlabhaM tadAvApya nAnutiShThanti mAnavAH
shlokas.10:
yaH pApebhyaH pApatamasteShAmadhama eva saH |
brAhmaNyaM yo.avajAnIte dhanaM labdhveva durlabham
shlokas.11:
duShprApaM khalu vipratvaM prAptaM duranupAlanam |
duravApamavApyaitannAnutiShThanti mAnavAH
shlokas.12:
ekArAmo hyahaM shakra nirdva.ndvo niShparigrahaH |
ahi.nsAdamadAnasthaH kathaM nArhAmi vipratAm
shlokas.13:
yathAkAmavihArI syAM kAmarUpI viha~NgamaH |
brahmakShatrAvirodhena pUjAM cha prApnuyAmaham
yathA mamAkShayA kIrtirbhavechchApi pura.ndara
shlokas.15:
indra uvAcha||
Chandodeva iti khyAtaH strINAM pUjyo bhaviShyasi |
bhIShma uvAcha||
evaM tasmai varaM dattvA vAsavo.antaradhIyata |
prANA.nstyaktvA mata~Ngo.api prApa tatsthAnamuttamam
shlokas.16:
evametatparaM sthAnaM brAhmaNyaM nAma bhArata |
tachcha duShprApamiha vai mahendravachanaM yathA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrutaM me mahadAkhyAnametatkurukulodvaha |
suduShprApaM bravIShi tvaM brAhmaNyaM vadatAM vara
shlokas.2:
vishvAmitreNa cha purA brAhmaNyaM prAptamityuta |
shrUyate vadase tachcha duShprApamiti sattama
shlokas.3:
vItahavyashcha rAjarShiH shruto me vipratAM gataH |
tadeva tAvadgA~Ngeya shrotumichChAmyahaM vibho
shlokas.4:
sa kena karmaNA prApto brAhmaNyaM rAjasattama |
vareNa tapasA vApi tanme vyAkhyAtumarhati
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanyathA rAjA vItahavyo mahAyashAH |
kShatriyaH sanpunaH prApto brAhmaNyaM lokasatkRRitam
shlokas.6:
manormahAtmanastAta prajAdharmeNa shAsataH |
babhUva putro dharmAtmA sharyAtiriti vishrutaH
shlokas.7:
tasyAnvavAye dvau rAjanrAjAnau sambabhUvatuH |
hehayastAlaja~Nghashcha vatseShu jayatAM vara
shlokas.8:
hehayasya tu putrANAM dashasu strIShu bhArata |
shataM babhUva prakhyAtaM shUrANAmanivartinAm
shlokas.9:
tulyarUpaprabhAvANAM viduShAM yuddhashAlinAm |
dhanurvede cha vede cha sarvatraiva kRRitashramAH
shlokas.10:
kAshiShvapi nRRipo rAjandivodAsapitAmahaH |
haryashva iti vikhyAto babhUva jayatAM varaH
shlokas.11:
sa vItahavyadAyAdairAgatya puruSharShabha |
ga~NgAyamunayormadhye sa~NgrAme vinipAtitaH
shlokas.12:
taM tu hatvA naravaraM hehayAste mahArathAH |
pratijagmuH purIM ramyAM vatsAnAmakutobhayAH
shlokas.13:
haryashvasya tu dAyAdaH kAshirAjo.abhyaShichyata |
sudevo devasa~NkAshaH sAkShAddharma ivAparaH
shlokas.14:
sa pAlayanneva mahIM dharmAtmA kAshinandanaH |
tairvItahavyairAgatya yudhi sarvairvinirjitaH
shlokas.15:
tamapyAjau vinirjitya pratijagmuryathAgatam |
saudevistvatha kAshIsho divodAso.abhyaShichyata
shlokas.16:
divodAsastu vij~nAya vIryaM teShAM mahAtmanAm |
vArANasIM mahAtejA nirmame shakrashAsanAt
shlokas.17:
viprakShatriyasambAdhAM vaishyashUdrasamAkulAm |
naikadravyochchayavatIM samRRiddhavipaNApaNAm
shlokas.18:
ga~NgAyA uttare kUle vaprAnte rAjasattama |
gomatyA dakShiNe chaiva shakrasyevAmarAvatIm
shlokas.19:
tatra taM rAjashArdUlaM nivasantaM mahIpatim |
Agatya hehayA bhUyaH paryadhAvanta bhArata
shlokas.20:
sa niShpatya dadau yuddhaM tebhyo rAjA mahAbalaH |
devAsurasamaM ghoraM divodAso mahAdyutiH
shlokas.21:
sa tu yuddhe mahArAja dinAnAM dashatIrdasha |
hatavAhanabhUyiShThastato dainyamupAgamat
shlokas.22:
hatayodhastato rAjankShINakoshashcha bhUmipaH |
divodAsaH purIM hitvA palAyanaparo.abhavat
shlokas.23:
sa tvAshramamupAgamya bharadvAjasya dhImataH |
jagAma sharaNaM rAjA kRRitA~njalirari.ndama
shlokas.24:
rAjovAcha||
bhagavanvaitahavyairme yuddhe va.nshaH praNAshitaH |
ahamekaH paridyUno bhavantaM sharaNaM gataH
shlokas.25:
shiShyasnehena bhagavansa mAM rakShitumarhasi |
niHsheSho hi kRRito va.nsho mama taiH pApakarmabhiH
shlokas.26:
tamuvAcha mahAbhAgo bharadvAjaH pratApavAn |
na bhetavyaM na bhetavyaM saudeva vyetu te bhayam
shlokas.27:
ahamiShTiM karomyadya putrArthaM te vishAM pate |
vaitahavyasahasrANi yathA tvaM prasahiShyasi
shlokas.28:
tata iShTiM chakArarShistasya vai putrakAmikIm |
athAsya tanayo jaj~ne pratardana iti shrutaH
shlokas.29:
sa jAtamAtro vavRRidhe samAH sadyastrayodasha |
vedaM chAdhijage kRRitsnaM dhanurvedaM cha bhArata
shlokas.30:
yogena cha samAviShTo bharadvAjena dhImatA |
tejo laukyaM sa sa~NgRRihya tasmindeshe samAvishat
shlokas.31:
tataH sa kavachI dhanvI bANI dIpta ivAnalaH |
prayayau sa dhanurdhunvanvivarShuriva toyadaH
shlokas.32:
taM dRRiShTvA paramaM harShaM sudevatanayo yayau |
mene cha manasA dagdhAnvaitahavyAnsa pArthivaH
shlokas.33:
tatastaM yauvarAjyena sthApayitvA pratardanam |
kRRitakRRityaM tadAtmAnaM sa rAjA abhyanandata
shlokas.34:
tatastu vaitahavyAnAM vadhAya sa mahIpatiH |
putraM prasthApayAmAsa pratardanamari.ndamam
shlokas.35:
sarathaH sa tu santIrya ga~NgAmAshu parAkramI |
prayayau vItahavyAnAM purIM parapura~njayaH
shlokas.36:
vaitahavyAstu sa.nshrutya rathaghoShaM samuddhatam |
niryayurnagarAkArai rathaiH pararathArujaiH
shlokas.37:
niShkramya te naravyAghrA da.nshitAshchitrayodhinaH |
pratardanaM samAjaghnuH sharavarShairudAyudhAH
shlokas.38:
astraishcha vividhAkArai rathaughaishcha yudhiShThira |
abhyavarShanta rAjAnaM himavantamivAmbudAH
shlokas.39:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya teShAM rAjA pratardanaH |
jaghAna tAnmahAtejA vajrAnalasamaiH sharaiH
shlokas.40:
kRRittottamA~NgAste rAjanbhallaiH shatasahasrashaH |
apatanrudhirArdrA~NgA nikRRittA iva ki.nshukAH
shlokas.41:
hateShu teShu sarveShu vItahavyaH suteShvatha |
prAdravannagaraM hitvA bhRRigorAshramamapyuta
shlokas.42:
yayau bhRRiguM cha sharaNaM vItahavyo narAdhipaH |
abhayaM cha dadau tasmai rAj~ne rAjanbhRRigustathA
tato dadAvAsanaM cha tasmai shiShyo bhRRigostadA
shlokas.43:
athAnupadamevAshu tatrAgachChatpratardanaH |
sa prApya chAshramapadaM divodAsAtmajo.abravIt
shlokas.44:
bho bhoH ke.atrAshrame santi bhRRigoH shiShyA mahAtmanaH |
draShTumichChe munimahaM tasyAchakShata mAmiti
shlokas.45:
sa taM viditvA tu bhRRigurnishchakrAmAshramAttadA |
pUjayAmAsa cha tato vidhinA parameNa ha
shlokas.46:
uvAcha chainaM rAjendra kiM kAryamiti pArthivam |
sa chovAcha nRRipastasmai yadAgamanakAraNam
shlokas.47:
ayaM brahmannito rAjA vItahavyo visarjyatAm |
asya putrairhi me brahmankRRitsno va.nshaH praNAshitaH
utsAditashcha viShayaH kAshInAM ratnasa~nchayaH
shlokas.48:
etasya vIryadRRiptasya hataM putrashataM mayA |
asyedAnIM vadhAdbrahmanbhaviShyAmyanRRiNaH pituH
shlokas.49:
tamuvAcha kRRipAviShTo bhRRigurdharmabhRRitAM varaH |
nehAsti kShatriyaH kashchitsarve hIme dvijAtayaH
shlokas.50:
evaM tu vachanaM shrutvA bhRRigostathyaM pratardanaH |
pAdAvupaspRRishya shanaiH prahasanvAkyamabravIt
shlokas.51:
evamapyasmi bhagavankRRitakRRityo na sa.nshayaH |
yadeSha rAjA vIryeNa svajAtiM tyAjito mayA
shlokas.52:
anujAnIhi mAM brahmandhyAyasva cha shivena mAm |
tyAjito hi mayA jAtimeSha rAjA bhRRigUdvaha
shlokas.53:
tatastenAbhyanuj~nAto yayau rAjA pratardanaH |
yathAgataM mahArAja muktvA viShamivoragaH
shlokas.54:
bhRRigorvachanamAtreNa sa cha brahmarShitAM gataH |
vItahavyo mahArAja brahmavAditvameva cha
shlokas.55:
tasya gRRitsamadaH putro rUpeNendra ivAparaH |
shakrastvamiti yo daityairnigRRihItaH kilAbhavat
shlokas.56:
RRigvede vartate chAgryA shrutiratra vishAM pate |
yatra gRRitsamado brahmanbrAhmaNaiH sa mahIyate
shlokas.57:
sa brahmachArI viprarShiH shrImAngRRitsamado.abhavat |
putro gRRitsamadasyApi suchetA abhavaddvijaH
shlokas.58:
varchAH sutejasaH putro vihavyastasya chAtmajaH |
vihavyasya tu putrastu vitatyastasya chAtmajaH
shlokas.59:
vitatyasya sutaH satyaH santaH satyasya chAtmajaH |
shravAstasya sutashcharShiH shravasashchAbhavattamaH
shlokas.60:
tamasashcha prakAsho.abhUttanayo dvijasattamaH |
prakAshasya cha vAgindro babhUva jayatAM varaH
shlokas.61:
tasyAtmajashcha pramatirvedavedA~NgapAragaH |
ghRRitAchyAM tasya putrastu rururnAmodapadyata
shlokas.62:
pramadvarAyAM tu ruroH putraH samudapadyata |
shunako nAma viprarShiryasya putro.atha shaunakaH
shlokas.63:
evaM vipratvamagamadvItahavyo narAdhipaH |
bhRRigoH prasAdAdrAjendra kShatriyaH kShatriyarShabha
shlokas.64:
tathaiva kathito va.nsho mayA gArtsamadastava |
vistareNa mahArAja kimanyadanupRRichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ke pUjyAH ke namaskAryA mAnavairbharatarShabha |
vistareNa tadAchakShva na hi tRRipyAmi kathyatAm
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
nAradasya cha sa.nvAdaM vAsudevasya chobhayoH
shlokas.3:
nAradaM prA~njaliM dRRiShTvA pUjayAnaM dvijarShabhAn |
keshavaH paripaprachCha bhagavankAnnamasyasi
shlokas.4:
bahumAnaH paraH keShu bhavato yAnnamasyasi |
shakyaM chechChrotumichChAmi brUhyetaddharmavittama
shlokas.5:
nArada uvAcha||
shRRiNu govinda yAnetAnpUjayAmyarimardana |
tvatto.anyaH kaH pumA.Nlloke shrotumetadihArhati
shlokas.6:
varuNaM vAyumAdityaM parjanyaM jAtavedasam |
sthANuM skandaM tathA lakShmIM viShNuM brahmANameva cha
shlokas.7:
vAchaspatiM chandramasamapaH pRRithvIM sarasvatIm |
satataM ye namasyanti tAnnamasyAmyahaM vibho
shlokas.8:
tapodhanAnvedavido nityaM vedaparAyaNAn |
mahArhAnvRRiShNishArdUla sadA sampUjayAmyaham
shlokas.9:
abhuktvA devakAryANi kurvate ye.avikatthanAH |
santuShTAshcha kShamAyuktAstAnnamasyAmyahaM vibho
shlokas.10:
samyagdadati ye cheShTAnkShAntA dAntA jitendriyAH |
sasyaM dhanaM kShitiM gAshcha tAnnamasyAmi yAdava
shlokas.11:
ye te tapasi vartante vane mUlaphalAshanAH |
asa~nchayAH kriyAvantastAnnamasyAmi yAdava
shlokas.12:
ye bhRRityabharaNe saktAH satataM chAtithipriyAH |
bhu~njante devasheShANi tAnnamasyAmi yAdava
shlokas.13:
ye vedaM prApya durdharShA vAgmino brahmavAdinaH |
yAjanAdhyApane yuktA nityaM tAnpUjayAmyaham
shlokas.14:
prasannahRRidayAshchaiva sarvasattveShu nityashaH |
A pRRiShThatApAtsvAdhyAye yuktAstAnpUjayAmyaham
shlokas.15:
guruprasAde svAdhyAye yatante ye sthiravratAH |
shushrUShavo.anasUyantastAnnamasyAmi yAdava
shlokas.16:
suvratA munayo ye cha brahmaNyAH satyasa~NgarAH |
voDhAro havyakavyAnAM tAnnamasyAmi yAdava
shlokas.17:
bhaikShyacharyAsu niratAH kRRishA gurukulAshrayAH |
niHsukhA nirdhanA ye cha tAnnamasyAmi yAdava
shlokas.18:
nirmamA niShpratidva.ndvA nirhrIkA niShprayojanAH |
ahi.nsAniratA ye cha ye cha satyavratA narAH
dAntAH shamaparAshchaiva tAnnamasyAmi keshava
shlokas.19:
devatAtithipUjAyAM prasaktA gRRihamedhinaH |
kapotavRRittayo nityaM tAnnamasyAmi yAdava
shlokas.20:
yeShAM trivargaH kRRityeShu vartate nopahIyate |
shiShTAchArapravRRittAshcha tAnnamasyAmyahaM sadA
shlokas.21:
brAhmaNAstriShu lokeShu ye trivargamanuShThitAH |
alolupAH puNyashIlAstAnnamasyAmi keshava
shlokas.22:
abbhakShA vAyubhakShAshcha sudhAbhakShAshcha ye sadA |
vrataishcha vividhairyuktAstAnnamasyAmi mAdhava
shlokas.23:
ayonInagniyonI.nshcha brahmayonI.nstathaiva cha |
sarvabhUtAtmayonI.nshcha tAnnamasyAmyahaM dvijAn
shlokas.24:
nityametAnnamasyAmi kRRiShNa lokakarAnRRiShIn |
lokajyeShThA~nj~nAnaniShThA.nstamoghnA.NllokabhAskarAn
shlokas.25:
tasmAttvamapi vArShNeya dvijAnpUjaya nityadA |
pUjitAH pUjanArhA hi sukhaM dAsyanti te.anagha
shlokas.26:
asmi.Nlloke sadA hyete paratra cha sukhapradAH |
ta ete mAnyamAnA vai pradAsyanti sukhaM tava
shlokas.27:
ye sarvAtithayo nityaM goShu cha brAhmaNeShu cha |
nityaM satye cha niratA durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.28:
nityaM shamaparA ye cha tathA ye chAnasUyakAH |
nityaM svAdhyAyino ye cha durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.29:
sarvAndevAnnamasyanti ye chaikaM devamAshritAH |
shraddadhAnAshcha dAntAshcha durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.30:
tathaiva viprapravarAnnamaskRRitya yatavratAn |
bhavanti ye dAnaratA durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.31:
agnInAdhAya vidhivatprayatA dhArayanti ye |
prAptAH somAhutiM chaiva durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.32:
mAtApitrorguruShu cha samyagvartanti ye sadA |
yathA tvaM vRRiShNishArdUletyuktvaivaM virarAma saH
shlokas.33:
tasmAttvamapi kaunteya pitRRidevadvijAtithIn |
samyakpUjaya yena tvaM gatimiShTAmavApsyasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM rAj~naH sarvakRRityAnAM garIyaH syAtpitAmaha |
kiM kurvankarma nRRipatirubhau lokau samashnute
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etadrAj~naH kRRityatamamabhiShiktasya bhArata |
brAhmaNAnAmanuShThAnamatyantaM sukhamichChatA
shrotriyAnbrAhmaNAnvRRiddhAnnityamevAbhipUjayet
shlokas.3:
paurajAnapadA.nshchApi brAhmaNA.nshcha bahushrutAn |
sAntvena bhogadAnena namaskAraistathArchayet
shlokas.4:
etatkRRityatamaM rAj~no nityameveti lakShayet |
yathAtmAnaM yathA putrA.nstathaitAnparipAlayet
shlokas.5:
ye chApyeShAM pUjyatamAstAndRRiDhaM pratipUjayet |
teShu shAnteShu tadrAShTraM sarvameva virAjate
shlokas.6:
te pUjyAste namaskAryAste rakShyAH pitaro yathA |
teShveva yAtrA lokasya bhUtAnAmiva vAsave
shlokas.7:
abhichArairupAyaishcha daheyurapi tejasA |
niHsheShaM kupitAH kuryurugrAH satyaparAkramAH
shlokas.8:
nAntameShAM prapashyAmi na dishashchApyapAvRRitAH |
kupitAH samudIkShante dAveShvagnishikhA iva
shlokas.9:
vidyanteShAM sAhasikA guNAsteShAmatIva hi |
kUpA iva tRRiNachChannA vishuddhA dyaurivApare
shlokas.10:
prasahyakAriNaH kechitkArpAsamRRidavo.apare |
santi chaiShAmatishaThAstathAnye.atitapasvinaH
shlokas.11:
kRRiShigorakShyamapyanye bhaikShamanye.apyanuShThitAH |
chorAshchAnye.anRRitAshchAnye tathAnye naTanartakAH
shlokas.12:
sarvakarmasu dRRishyante prashAnteShvitareShu cha |
vividhAchArayuktAshcha brAhmaNA bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
nAnAkarmasu yuktAnAM bahukarmopajIvinAm |
dharmaj~nAnAM satAM teShAM nityamevAnukIrtayet
shlokas.14:
pitR^INAM devatAnAM cha manuShyoragarakShasAm |
purohitA mahAbhAgA brAhmaNA vai narAdhipa
shlokas.15:
naite devairna pitRRibhirna gandharvairna rAkShasaiH |
nAsurairna pishAchaishcha shakyA jetuM dvijAtayaH
shlokas.16:
adaivaM daivataM kuryurdaivataM chApyadaivatam |
yamichCheyuH sa rAjA syAdyaM dviShyuH sa parAbhavet
shlokas.17:
parivAdaM cha ye kuryurbrAhmaNAnAmachetasaH |
nindAprasha.nsAkushalAH kIrtyakIrtiparAvarAH
parikupyanti te rAjansatataM dviShatAM dvijAH
shlokas.18:
brAhmaNA yaM prasha.nsanti puruShaH sa pravardhate |
brAhmaNairyaH parAkruShTaH parAbhUyAtkShaNAddhi saH
shlokas.19:
shakA yavanakAmbojAstAstAH kShatriyajAtayaH |
vRRiShalatvaM parigatA brAhmaNAnAmadarshanAt
shlokas.20:
dramiLAshcha kali~NgAshcha pulindAshchApyushInarAH |
kaulAH sarpA mAhiShakAstAstAH kShatriyajAtayaH
shlokas.21:
vRRiShalatvaM parigatA brAhmaNAnAmadarshanAt |
shreyAnparAjayastebhyo na jayo jayatAM vara
shlokas.22:
yastu sarvamidaM hanyAdbrAhmaNaM cha na tatsamam |
brahmavadhyA mahAndoSha ityAhuH paramarShayaH
shlokas.23:
parivAdo dvijAtInAM na shrotavyaH katha~nchana |
AsItAdhomukhastUShNIM samutthAya vrajeta vA
shlokas.24:
na sa jAto janiShyo vA pRRithivyAmiha kashchana |
yo brAhmaNavirodhena sukhaM jIvitumutsahet
shlokas.25:
durgraho muShTinA vAyurduHsparshaH pANinA shashI |
durdharA pRRithivI mUrdhnA durjayA brAhmaNA bhuvi

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
brAhmaNAneva satataM bhRRishaM sampratipUjayet |
ete hi somarAjAna IshvarAH sukhaduHkhayoH
shlokas.2:
ete bhogairala~NkArairanyaishchaiva kimichChakaiH |
sadA pUjyA namaskAryA rakShyAshcha pitRRivannRRipaiH
ato rAShTrasya shAntirhi bhUtAnAmiva vAsavAt
shlokas.3:
jAyatAM brahmavarchasvI rAShTre vai brAhmaNaH shuchiH |
mahArathashcha rAjanya eShTavyaH shatrutApanaH
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNaM jAtisampannaM dharmaj~naM sa.nshitavratam |
vAsayeta gRRihe rAjanna tasmAtparamasti vai
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNebhyo havirdattaM pratigRRihNanti devatAH |
pitaraH sarvabhUtAnAM naitebhyo vidyate param
shlokas.6:
AdityashchandramA vAyurbhUmirApo.ambaraM dishaH |
sarve brAhmaNamAvishya sadAnnamupabhu~njate
shlokas.7:
na tasyAshnanti pitaro yasya viprA na bhu~njate |
devAshchApyasya nAshnanti pApasya brAhmaNadviShaH
shlokas.8:
brAhmaNeShu tu tuShTeShu prIyante pitaraH sadA |
tathaiva devatA rAjannAtra kAryA vichAraNA
shlokas.9:
tathaiva te.api prIyante yeShAM bhavati taddhaviH |
na cha pretya vinashyanti gachChanti paramAM gatim
shlokas.10:
yena yenaiva haviShA brAhmaNA.nstarpayennaraH |
tena tenaiva prIyante pitaro devatAstathA
shlokas.11:
brAhmaNAdeva tadbhUtaM prabhavanti yataH prajAH |
yatashchAyaM prabhavati pretya yatra cha gachChati
shlokas.12:
vedaiSha mArgaM svargasya tathaiva narakasya cha |
AgatAnAgate chobhe brAhmaNo dvipadAM varaH
brAhmaNo bharatashreShTha svadharmaM veda medhayA
shlokas.13:
ye chainamanuvartante te na yAnti parAbhavam |
na te pretya vinashyanti gachChanti na parAbhavam
shlokas.14:
ye brAhmaNamukhAtprAptaM pratigRRihNanti vai vachaH |
kRRitAtmAno mahAtmAnaste na yAnti parAbhavam
shlokas.15:
kShatriyANAM pratapatAM tejasA cha balena cha |
brAhmaNeShveva shAmyanti tejA.nsi cha balAni cha
shlokas.16:
bhRRigavo.ajaya.nstAlaja~NghAnnIpAna~Ngiraso.ajayan |
bharadvAjo vaitahavyAnailA.nshcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.17:
chitrAyudhA.nshchApyajayannete kRRiShNAjinadhvajAH |
prakShipyAtha cha kumbhAnvai pAragAminamArabhet
shlokas.18:
yatki~nchitkathyate loke shrUyate pashyate.api vA |
sarvaM tadbrAhmaNeShveva gUDho.agniriva dAruShu
shlokas.19:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
sa.nvAdaM vAsudevasya pRRithvyAshcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.20:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
mAtaraM sarvabhUtAnAM pRRichChe tvA sa.nshayaM shubhe |
kena svitkarmaNA pApaM vyapohati naro gRRihI
shlokas.21:
pRRithivyuvAcha||
brAhmaNAneva seveta pavitraM hyetaduttamam |
brAhmaNAnsevamAnasya rajaH sarvaM praNashyati
shlokas.22:
ato bhUtirataH kIrtirato buddhiH prajAyate |
apareShAM pareShAM cha parebhyashchaiva ye pare
shlokas.23:
brAhmaNA yaM prasha.nsanti puruShaH sa pravardhate |
atha yo brAhmaNAkruShTaH parAbhavati so.achirAt
shlokas.24:
yathA mahArNave kShipta AmaloShTo vinashyati |
tathA dushcharitaM karma parAbhAvAya kalpate
shlokas.25:
pashya chandre kRRitaM lakShma samudre lavaNodakam |
tathA bhagasahasreNa mahendraM parichihnitam
shlokas.26:
teShAmeva prabhAvena sahasranayano hyasau |
shatakratuH samabhavatpashya mAdhava yAdRRisham
shlokas.27:
ichChanbhUtiM cha kIrtiM cha lokA.nshcha madhusUdana |
brAhmaNAnumate tiShThetpuruShaH shuchirAtmavAn
shlokas.28:
ityetadvachanaM shrutvA medinyA madhusUdanaH |
sAdhu sAdhvityathetyuktvA medinIM pratyapUjayat
shlokas.29:
etAM shrutvopamAM pArtha prayato brAhmaNarShabhAn |
satataM pUjayethAstvaM tataH shreyo.abhipatsyase

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
janmanaiva mahAbhAgo brAhmaNo nAma jAyate |
namasyaH sarvabhUtAnAmatithiH prasRRitAgrabhuk
shlokas.2:
sarvAnnaH suhRRidastAta brAhmaNAH sumanomukhAH |
gIrbhirma~NgalayuktAbhiranudhyAyanti pUjitAH
shlokas.3:
sarvAnno dviShatastAta brAhmaNA jAtamanyavaH |
gIrbhirdAruNayuktAbhirabhihanyurapUjitAH
shlokas.4:
atra gAthA brahmagItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH |
sRRiShTvA dvijAtIndhAtA hi yathApUrvaM samAdadhat
shlokas.5:
na vo.anyadiha kartavyaM ki~nchidUrdhvaM yathAvidhi |
guptA gopAyata brahma shreyo vastena shobhanam
shlokas.6:
svameva kurvatAM karma shrIrvo brAhmI bhaviShyati |
pramANaM sarvabhUtAnAM pragrahaM cha gamiShyatha
shlokas.7:
na shaudraM karma kartavyaM brAhmaNena vipashchitA |
shaudraM hi kurvataH karma dharmaH samuparudhyate
shlokas.8:
shrIshcha buddhishcha tejashcha vibhUtishcha pratApinI |
svAdhyAyenaiva mAhAtmyaM vimalaM pratipatsyatha
shlokas.9:
hutvA chAhavanIyasthaM mahAbhAgye pratiShThitAH |
agrabhojyAH prasUtInAM shriyA brAhmyAnukalpitAH
shlokas.10:
shraddhayA parayA yuktA hyanabhidrohalabdhayA |
damasvAdhyAyaniratAH sarvAnkAmAnavApsyatha
shlokas.11:
yachchaiva mAnuShe loke yachcha deveShu ki~nchana |
sarvaM tattapasA sAdhyaM j~nAnena vinayena cha
shlokas.12:
ityetA brahmagItAste samAkhyAtA mayAnagha |
viprAnukampArthamidaM tena proktaM hi dhImatA
shlokas.13:
bhUyasteShAM balaM manye yathA rAj~nastapasvinaH |
durAsadAshcha chaNDAshcha rabhasAH kShiprakAriNaH
shlokas.14:
santyeShAM siMhasattvAshcha vyAghrasattvAstathApare |
varAhamRRigasattvAshcha gajasattvAstathApare
shlokas.15:
karpAsamRRidavaH kechittathAnye makaraspRRishaH |
vibhAShyaghAtinaH kechittathA chakShurhaNo.apare
shlokas.16:
santi chAshIviShanibhAH santi mandAstathApare |
vividhAnIha vRRittAni brAhmaNAnAM yudhiShThira
shlokas.17:
mekalA dramiDAH kAshAH pauNDrAH kollagirAstathA |
shauNDikA daradA darvAshchaurAH shabarabarbarAH
shlokas.18:
kirAtA yavanAshchaiva tAstAH kShatriyajAtayaH |
vRRiShalatvamanuprAptA brAhmaNAnAmadarshanAt
shlokas.19:
brAhmaNAnAM paribhavAdasurAH salileshayAH |
brAhmaNAnAM prasAdAchcha devAH svarganivAsinaH
shlokas.20:
ashakyaM spraShTumAkAshamachAlyo himavAngiriH |
avAryA setunA ga~NgA durjayA brAhmaNA bhuvi
shlokas.21:
na brAhmaNavirodhena shakyA shAstuM vasundharA |
brAhmaNA hi mahAtmAno devAnAmapi devatAH
shlokas.22:
tAnpUjayasva satataM dAnena paricharyayA |
yadIchChasi mahIM bhoktumimAM sAgaramekhalAm
shlokas.23:
pratigraheNa tejo hi viprANAM shAmyate.anagha |
pratigrahaM ye nechCheyuste.api rakShyAstvayAnagha

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
shakrashambarasa.nvAdaM tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.2:
shakro hyaj~nAtarUpeNa jaTI bhUtvA rajoruNaH |
virUpaM rUpamAsthAya prashnaM paprachCha shambaram
shlokas.3:
kena shambara vRRittena svajAtyAnadhitiShThasi |
shreShThaM tvAM kena manyante tanme prabrUhi pRRichChataH
shlokas.4:
shambara uvAcha||
nAsUyAmi sadA viprAnbrahmANaM cha pitAmaham |
shAstrANi vadato viprAnsaMmanyAmi yathAsukham
shlokas.5:
shrutvA cha nAvajAnAmi nAparAdhyAmi karhichit |
abhyarchyAnanupRRichChAmi pAdau gRRihNAmi dhImatAm
shlokas.6:
te vishrabdhAH prabhAShante sa.nyachChanti cha mAM sadA |
pramatteShvapramatto.asmi sadA supteShu jAgRRimi
shlokas.7:
te mA shAstrapathe yuktaM brahmaNyamanasUyakam |
samAsi~nchanti shAstAraH kShaudraM madhviva makShikAH
shlokas.8:
yachcha bhAShanti te tuShTAstattadgRRihNAmi medhayA |
samAdhimAtmano nityamanulomamachintayan
shlokas.9:
so.ahaM vAgagrasRRiShTAnAM rasAnAmavalehakaH |
svajAtyAnadhitiShThAmi nakShatrANIva chandramAH
shlokas.10:
etatpRRithivyAmamRRitametachchakShuranuttamam |
yadbrAhmaNamukhAchChAstramiha shrutvA pravartate
shlokas.11:
etatkAraNamAj~nAya dRRiShTvA devAsuraM purA |
yuddhaM pitA me hRRiShTAtmA vismitaH pratyapadyata
shlokas.12:
dRRiShTvA cha brAhmaNAnAM tu mahimAnaM mahAtmanAm |
paryapRRichChatkathamime siddhA iti nishAkaram
shlokas.13:
soma uvAcha||
brAhmaNAstapasA sarve sidhyante vAgbalAH sadA |
bhujavIryA hi rAjAno vAgastrAshcha dvijAtayaH
shlokas.14:
pravasanvApyadhIyIta bahvIrdurvasatIrvasan |
nirmanyurapi nirmAno yatiH syAtsamadarshanaH
shlokas.15:
api chejjAtisampannaH sarvAnvedAnpiturgRRihe |
shlAghamAna ivAdhIyedgrAmya ityeva taM viduH
shlokas.16:
bhUmiretau nigirati sarpo bilashayAniva |
rAjAnaM chApyayoddhAraM brAhmaNaM chApravAsinam
shlokas.17:
atimAnaH shriyaM hanti puruShasyAlpamedhasaH |
garbheNa duShyate kanyA gRRihavAsena cha dvijaH
shlokas.18:
ityetanme pitA shrutvA somAdadbhutadarshanAt |
brAhmaNAnpUjayAmAsa tathaivAhaM mahAvratAn
shlokas.19:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shrutvaitadvachanaM shakro dAnavendramukhAchchyutam |
dvijAnsampUjayAmAsa mahendratvamavApa cha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
apUrvaM vA bhavetpAtramatha vApi chiroShitam |
dUrAdabhyAgataM vApi kiM pAtraM syAtpitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kriyA bhavati keShA~nchidupA.nshuvratamuttamam |
yo yo yAcheta yatki~nchitsarvaM dadyAma ityuta
shlokas.3:
apIDayanbhRRityavargamityevamanushushruma |
pIDayanbhRRityavargaM hi AtmAnamapakarShati
shlokas.4:
apUrvaM vApi yatpAtraM yachchApi syAchchiroShitam |
dUrAdabhyAgataM chApi tatpAtraM cha vidurbudhAH
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
apIDayA cha bhRRityAnAM dharmasyAhi.nsayA tathA |
pAtraM vidyAma tattvena yasmai dattaM na santapet
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
RRitvikpurohitAchAryAH shiShyAH sambandhibAndhavAH |
sarve pUjyAshcha mAnyAshcha shrutavRRittopasaMhitAH
shlokas.7:
ato.anyathA vartamAnAH sarve nArhanti satkriyAm |
tasmAnnityaM parIkSheta puruShAnpraNidhAya vai
shlokas.8:
akrodhaH satyavachanamahi.nsA dama Arjavam |
adroho nAtimAnashcha hrIstitikShA tapaH shamaH
shlokas.9:
yasminnetAni dRRishyante na chAkAryANi bhArata |
bhAvato viniviShTAni tatpAtraM mAnamarhati
shlokas.10:
tathA chiroShitaM chApi sampratyAgatameva cha |
apUrvaM chaiva pUrvaM cha tatpAtraM mAnamarhati
shlokas.11:
aprAmANyaM cha vedAnAM shAstrANAM chAtila~Nghanam |
sarvatra chAnavasthAnametannAshanamAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
bhavetpaNDitamAnI yo brAhmaNo vedanindakaH |
AnvIkShikIM tarkavidyAmanurakto nirarthikAm
shlokas.13:
hetuvAdAnbruvansatsu vijetAhetuvAdikaH |
AkroShTA chAtivaktA cha brAhmaNAnAM sadaiva hi
shlokas.14:
sarvAbhisha~NkI mUDhashcha bAlaH kaTukavAgapi |
boddhavyastAdRRishastAta narashvAnaM hi taM viduH
shlokas.15:
yathA shvA bhaShituM chaiva hantuM chaivAvasRRijyate |
evaM sambhAShaNArthAya sarvashAstravadhAya cha
alpashrutAH kutarkAshcha dRRiShTAH spRRiShTAH kupaNDitAH
shlokas.16:
shrutismRRitItihAsAdipurANAraNyavedinaH |
anurundhyAdbahuj~nA.nshcha sAraj~nA.nshchaiva paNDitAn
shlokas.17:
lokayAtrA cha draShTavyA dharmashchAtmahitAni cha |
evaM naro vartamAnaH shAshvatIredhate samAH
shlokas.18:
RRiNamunmuchya devAnAmRRiShINAM cha tathaiva cha |
pitR^INAmatha viprANAmatithInAM cha pa~nchamam
shlokas.19:
paryAyeNa vishuddhena sunirNiktena karmaNA |
evaM gRRihasthaH karmANi kurvandharmAnna hIyate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
strINAM svabhAvamichChAmi shrotuM bharatasattama |
striyo hi mUlaM doShANAM laghuchittAH pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
nAradasya cha sa.nvAdaM pu.nshchalyA pa~nchachUDayA
shlokas.3:
lokAnanucharandhImAndevarShirnAradaH purA |
dadarshApsarasaM brAhmIM pa~nchachUDAmaninditAm
shlokas.4:
tAM dRRiShTvA chArusarvA~NgIM paprachChApsarasaM muniH |
sa.nshayo hRRidi me kashchittanme brUhi sumadhyame
shlokas.5:
evamuktA tu sA vipraM pratyuvAchAtha nAradam |
viShaye sati vakShyAmi samarthAM manyase cha mAm
shlokas.6:
nArada uvAcha||
na tvAmaviShaye bhadre niyokShyAmi katha~nchana |
strINAM svabhAvamichChAmi tvattaH shrotuM varAnane
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vachastasya devarSherapsarottamA |
pratyuvAcha na shakShyAmi strI satI nindituM striyaH
shlokas.8:
viditAste striyo yAshcha yAdRRishAshcha svabhAvataH |
na mAmarhasi devarShe niyoktuM prashna IdRRishe
shlokas.9:
tAmuvAcha sa devarShiH satyaM vada sumadhyame |
mRRiShAvAde bhaveddoShaH satye doSho na vidyate
shlokas.10:
ityuktA sA kRRitamatirabhavachchAruhAsinI |
strIdoShA~nshAshvatAnsatyAnbhAShituM samprachakrame
shlokas.11:
pa~nchachUDovAcha||
kulInA rUpavatyashcha nAthavatyashcha yoShitaH |
maryAdAsu na tiShThanti sa doShaH strIShu nArada
shlokas.12:
na strIbhyaH ki~nchidanyadvai pApIyastaramasti vai |
striyo hi mUlaM doShANAM tathA tvamapi vettha ha
shlokas.13:
samAj~nAtAnRRiddhimataH pratirUpAnvashe sthitAn |
patInantaramAsAdya nAlaM nAryaH pratIkShitum
shlokas.14:
asaddharmastvayaM strINAmasmAkaM bhavati prabho |
pApIyaso narAnyadvai lajjAM tyaktvA bhajAmahe
shlokas.15:
striyaM hi yaH prArthayate saMnikarShaM cha gachChati |
IShachcha kurute sevAM tamevechChanti yoShitaH
shlokas.16:
anarthitvAnmanuShyANAM bhayAtparijanasya cha |
maryAdAyAmamaryAdAH striyastiShThanti bhartRRiShu
shlokas.17:
nAsAM kashchidagamyo.asti nAsAM vayasi sa.nsthitiH |
virUpaM rUpavantaM vA pumAnityeva bhu~njate
shlokas.18:
na bhayAnnApyanukroshAnnArthahetoH katha~nchana |
na j~nAtikulasambandhAtstriyastiShThanti bhartRRiShu
shlokas.19:
yauvane vartamAnAnAM mRRiShTAbharaNavAsasAm |
nArINAM svairavRRittAnAM spRRihayanti kulastriyaH
shlokas.20:
yAshcha shashvadbahumatA rakShyante dayitAH striyaH |
api tAH samprasajjante kubjAndhajaDavAmanaiH
shlokas.21:
pa~NguShvapi cha devarShe ye chAnye kutsitA narAH |
strINAmagamyo loke.asminnAsti kashchinmahAmune
shlokas.22:
yadi pu.nsAM gatirbrahma katha~nchinnopapadyate |
apyanyonyaM pravartante na hi tiShThanti bhartRRiShu
shlokas.23:
alAbhAtpuruShANAM hi bhayAtparijanasya cha |
vadhabandhabhayAchchApi svayaM guptA bhavanti tAH
shlokas.24:
chalasvabhAvA duHsevyA durgrAhyA bhAvatastathA |
prAj~nasya puruShasyeha yathA vAchastathA striyaH
shlokas.25:
nAgnistRRipyati kAShThAnAM nApagAnAM mahodadhiH |
nAntakaH sarvabhUtAnAM na pu.nsAM vAmalochanAH
shlokas.26:
idamanyachcha devarShe rahasyaM sarvayoShitAm |
dRRiShTvaiva puruShaM hRRidyaM yoniH praklidyate striyaH
shlokas.27:
kAmAnAmapi dAtAraM kartAraM mAnasAntvayoH |
rakShitAraM na mRRiShyanti bhartAraM paramaM striyaH
shlokas.28:
na kAmabhogAnbahulAnnAla~NkArArthasa~nchayAn |
tathaiva bahu manyante yathA ratyAmanugraham
shlokas.29:
antakaH shamano mRRityuH pAtAlaM vaDavAmukham |
kShuradhArA viShaM sarpo vahnirityekataH striyaH
shlokas.30:
yatashcha bhUtAni mahAnti pa~ncha; yatashcha lokA vihitA vidhAtrA |
yataH pumA.nsaH pramadAshcha nirmitA;stadaiva doShAH pramadAsu nArada

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ime vai mAnavA loke strIShu sajjantyabhIkShNashaH |
mohena paramAviShTA daivAdiShTena pArthiva
striyashcha puruSheShveva pratyakShaM lokasAkShikam
shlokas.2:
atra me sa.nshayastIvro hRRidi samparivartate |
kathamAsAM narAH sa~NgaM kurvate kurunandana
striyo vA teShu rajyante virajyante.atha vA punaH
shlokas.3:
iti tAH puruShavyAghra kathaM shakyAH sma rakShitum |
pramadAH puruSheNeha tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.4:
etA hi mayamAyAbhirva~nchayantIha mAnavAn |
na chAsAM muchyate kashchitpuruSho hastamAgataH
gAvo navatRRiNAnIva gRRihNantyeva navAnnavAn
shlokas.5:
shambarasya cha yA mAyA yA mAyA namucherapi |
baleH kumbhInaseshchaiva sarvAstA yoShito viduH
shlokas.6:
hasantaM prahasantyetA rudantaM prarudanti cha |
apriyaM priyavAkyaishcha gRRihNate kAlayogataH
shlokas.7:
ushanA veda yachChAstraM yachcha veda bRRihaspatiH |
strIbuddhyA na vishiShyete tAH sma rakShyAH kathaM naraiH
shlokas.8:
anRRitaM satyamityAhuH satyaM chApi tathAnRRitam |
iti yAstAH kathaM vIra sa.nrakShyAH puruShairiha
shlokas.9:
strINAM buddhyupaniShkarShAdarthashAstrANi shatruhan |
bRRihaspatiprabhRRitibhirmanye sadbhiH kRRitAni vai
shlokas.10:
sampUjyamAnAH puruShairvikurvanti mano nRRiShu |
apAstAshcha tathA rAjanvikurvanti manaH striyaH
shlokas.11:
kastAH shakto rakShituM syAditi me sa.nshayo mahAn |
tanme brUhi mahAbAho kurUNAM va.nshavardhana
shlokas.12:
yadi shakyA kurushreShTha rakShA tAsAM katha~nchana |
kartuM vA kRRitapUrvA vA tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evametanmahAbAho nAtra mithyAsti ki~nchana |
yathA bravIShi kauravya nArIM prati janAdhipa
shlokas.2:
atra te vartayiShyAmi itihAsaM purAtanam |
yathA rakShA kRRitA pUrvaM vipulena mahAtmanA
shlokas.3:
pramadAshcha yathA sRRiShTA brahmaNA bharatarShabha |
yadarthaM tachcha te tAta pravakShye vasudhAdhipa
shlokas.4:
na hi strIbhya paraM putra pApIyaH ki~nchidasti vai |
agnirhi pramadA dIpto mAyAshcha mayajA vibho
kShuradhArA viShaM sarpo mRRityurityekataH striyaH
shlokas.5:
imAH prajA mahAbAho dhArmikA iti naH shrutam |
svayaM gachChanti devatvaM tato devAniyAdbhayam
shlokas.6:
athAbhyagachChandevAste pitAmahamari.ndama |
nivedya mAnasaM chApi tUShNImAsannavA~NmukhAH
shlokas.7:
teShAmantargataM j~nAtvA devAnAM sa pitAmahaH |
mAnavAnAM pramohArthaM kRRityA nAryo.asRRijatprabhuH
shlokas.8:
pUrvasarge tu kaunteya sAdhvyo nArya ihAbhavan |
asAdhvyastu samutpannA kRRityA sargAtprajApateH
shlokas.9:
tAbhyaH kAmAnyathAkAmaM prAdAddhi sa pitAmahaH |
tAH kAmalubdhAH pramadAH prAmathnanta narA.nstadA
shlokas.10:
krodhaM kAmasya deveshaH sahAyaM chAsRRijatprabhuH |
asajjanta prajAH sarvAH kAmakrodhavashaM gatAH
shlokas.11:
na cha strINAM kriyA kAchiditi dharmo vyavasthitaH |
nirindriyA amantrAshcha striyo.anRRitamiti shrutiH
shlokas.12:
shayyAsanamala~NkAramannapAnamanAryatAm |
durvAgbhAvaM ratiM chaiva dadau strIbhyaH prajApatiH
shlokas.13:
na tAsAM rakShaNaM kartuM shakyaM pu.nsA katha~nchana |
api vishvakRRitA tAta kutastu puruShairiha
shlokas.14:
vAchA vA vadhabandhairvA kleshairvA vividhaistathA |
na shakyA rakShituM nAryastA hi nityamasa.nyatAH
shlokas.15:
idaM tu puruShavyAghra purastAchChrutavAnaham |
yathA rakShA kRRitA pUrvaM vipulena gurustriyaH
shlokas.16:
RRiShirAsInmahAbhAgo devasharmeti vishrutaH |
tasya bhAryA ruchirnAma rUpeNAsadRRishI bhuvi
shlokas.17:
tasya rUpeNa saMmattA devagandharvadAnavAH |
visheShatastu rAjendra vRRitrahA pAkashAsanaH
shlokas.18:
nArINAM charitaj~nashcha devasharmA mahAmuniH |
yathAshakti yathotsAhaM bhAryAM tAmabhyarakShata
shlokas.19:
pura.ndaraM cha jAnIte parastrIkAmachAriNam |
tasmAdyatnena bhAryAyA rakShaNaM sa chakAra ha
shlokas.20:
sa kadAchidRRiShistAta yaj~naM kartumanAstadA |
bhAryAsa.nrakShaNaM kAryaM kathaM syAdityachintayat
shlokas.21:
rakShAvidhAnaM manasA sa vichintya mahAtapAH |
AhUya dayitaM shiShyaM vipulaM prAha bhArgavam
shlokas.22:
yaj~nakAro gamiShyAmi ruchiM chemAM sureshvaraH |
putra prArthayate nityaM tAM rakShasva yathAbalam
shlokas.23:
apramattena te bhAvyaM sadA prati pura.ndaram |
sa hi rUpANi kurute vividhAni bhRRigUdvaha
shlokas.24:
ityukto vipulastena tapasvI niyatendriyaH |
sadaivogratapA rAjannagnyarkasadRRishadyutiH
shlokas.25:
dharmaj~naH satyavAdI cha tatheti pratyabhAShata |
punashchedaM mahArAja paprachCha prathitaM gurum
shlokas.26:
kAni rUpANi shakrasya bhavantyAgachChato mune |
vapustejashcha kIdRRigvai tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.27:
tataH sa bhagavA.nstasmai vipulAya mahAtmane |
AchachakShe yathAtattvaM mAyAM shakrasya bhArata
shlokas.28:
bahumAyaH sa viprarShe balahA pAkashAsanaH |
tA.nstAnvikurute bhAvAnbahUnatha muhurmuhuH
shlokas.29:
kirITI vajrabhRRiddhanvI mukuTI baddhakuNDalaH |
bhavatyatha muhUrtena chaNDAlasamadarshanaH
shlokas.30:
shikhI jaTI chIravAsAH punarbhavati putraka |
bRRihachCharIrashcha punaH pIvaro.atha punaH kRRishaH
shlokas.31:
gauraM shyAmaM cha kRRiShNaM cha varNaM vikurute punaH |
virUpo rUpavA.nshchaiva yuvA vRRiddhastathaiva cha
shlokas.32:
prAj~no jaDashcha mUkashcha hrasvo dIrghastathaiva cha |
brAhmaNaH kShatriyashchaiva vaishyaH shUdrastathaiva cha
pratilomAnulomashcha bhavatyatha shatakratuH
shlokas.33:
shukavAyasarUpI cha ha.nsakokilarUpavAn |
siMhavyAghragajAnAM cha rUpaM dhArayate punaH
shlokas.34:
daivaM daityamatho rAj~nAM vapurdhArayate.api cha |
sukRRisho vAyubhagnA~NgaH shakunirvikRRitastathA
shlokas.35:
chatuShpAdbahurUpashcha punarbhavati bAlishaH |
makShikAmashakAdInAM vapurdhArayate.api cha
shlokas.36:
na shakyamasya grahaNaM kartuM vipula kenachit |
api vishvakRRitA tAta yena sRRiShTamidaM jagat
shlokas.37:
punarantarhitaH shakro dRRishyate j~nAnachakShuShA |
vAyubhUtashcha sa punardevarAjo bhavatyuta
shlokas.38:
evaM rUpANi satataM kurute pAkashAsanaH |
tasmAdvipula yatnena rakShemAM tanumadhyamAm
shlokas.39:
yathA ruchiM nAvaliheddevendro bhRRigusattama |
kratAvupahitaM nyastaM haviH shveva durAtmavAn
shlokas.40:
evamAkhyAya sa muniryaj~nakAro.agamattadA |
devasharmA mahAbhAgastato bharatasattama
shlokas.41:
vipulastu vachaH shrutvA guroshchintAparo.abhavat |
rakShAM cha paramAM chakre devarAjAnmahAbalAt
shlokas.42:
kiM nu shakyaM mayA kartuM gurudArAbhirakShaNe |
mAyAvI hi surendro.asau durdharShashchApi vIryavAn
shlokas.43:
nApidhAyAshramaM shakyo rakShituM pAkashAsanaH |
uTajaM vA tathA hyasya nAnAvidhasarUpatA
shlokas.44:
vAyurUpeNa vA shakro gurupatnIM pradharShayet |
tasmAdimAM sampravishya ruchiM sthAsye.ahamadya vai
shlokas.45:
atha vA pauruSheNeyamashakyA rakShituM mayA |
bahurUpo hi bhagavA~nChrUyate harivAhanaH
shlokas.46:
so.ahaM yogabalAdenAM rakShiShye pAkashAsanAt |
gAtrANi gAtrairasyAhaM sampravekShye.abhirakShitum
shlokas.47:
yadyuchChiShTAmimAM patnIM ruchiM pashyeta me guruH |
shapsyatyasa.nshayaM kopAddivyaj~nAno mahAtapAH
shlokas.48:
na cheyaM rakShituM shakyA yathAnyA pramadA nRRibhiH |
mAyAvI hi surendro.asAvaho prApto.asmi sa.nshayam
shlokas.49:
avashyakaraNIyaM hi guroriha hi shAsanam |
yadi tvetadahaM kuryAmAshcharyaM syAtkRRitaM mayA
shlokas.50:
yogenAnupravishyeha gurupatnyAH kalevaram |
nirmuktasya rajorUpAnnAparAdho bhavenmama
shlokas.51:
yathA hi shUnyAM pathikaH sabhAmadhyAvasetpathi |
tathAdyAvAsayiShyAmi gurupatnyAH kalevaram
shlokas.52:
asaktaH padmapatrastho jalabinduryathA chalaH |
evameva sharIre.asyA nivatsyAmi samAhitaH
shlokas.53:
ityevaM dharmamAlokya vedavedA.nshcha sarvashaH |
tapashcha vipulaM dRRiShTvA gurorAtmana eva cha
shlokas.54:
iti nishchitya manasA rakShAM prati sa bhArgavaH |
AtiShThatparamaM yatnaM yathA tachChRRiNu pArthiva
shlokas.55:
gurupatnImupAsIno vipulaH sa mahAtapAH |
upAsInAmanindyA~NgIM kathAbhiH samalobhayat
shlokas.56:
netrAbhyAM netrayorasyA rashmInsa.nyojya rashmibhiH |
vivesha vipulaH kAyamAkAshaM pavano yathA
shlokas.57:
lakShaNaM lakShaNenaiva vadanaM vadanena cha |
avicheShTannatiShThadvai ChAyevAntargato muniH
shlokas.58:
tato viShTabhya vipulo gurupatnyAH kalevaram |
uvAsa rakShaNe yukto na cha sA tamabudhyata
shlokas.59:
yaM kAlaM nAgato rAjangurustasya mahAtmanaH |
kratuM samApya svagRRihaM taM kAlaM so.abhyarakShata

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH kadAchiddevendro divyarUpavapurdharaH |
idamantaramityevaM tato.abhyAgAdathAshramam
shlokas.2:
rUpamapratimaM kRRitvA lobhanIyaM janAdhipa |
darshanIyatamo bhUtvA pravivesha tamAshramam
shlokas.3:
sa dadarsha tamAsInaM vipulasya kalevaram |
nishcheShTaM stabdhanayanaM yathAlekhyagataM tathA
shlokas.4:
ruchiM cha ruchirApA~NgIM pInashroNipayodharAm |
padmapatravishAlAkShIM sampUrNendunibhAnanAm
shlokas.5:
sA tamAlokya sahasA pratyutthAtumiyeSha ha |
rUpeNa vismitA ko.asItyatha vaktumihechChatI
shlokas.6:
utthAtukAmApi satI vyatiShThadvipulena sA |
nigRRihItA manuShyendra na shashAka vicheShTitum
shlokas.7:
tAmAbabhAShe devendraH sAmnA paramavalgunA |
tvadarthamAgataM viddhi devendraM mAM shuchismite
shlokas.8:
klishyamAnamana~Ngena tvatsa~Nkalpodbhavena vai |
tatparyApnuhi mAM subhru purA kAlo.ativartate
shlokas.9:
tameva.nvAdinaM shakraM shushrAva vipulo muniH |
gurupatnyAH sharIrastho dadarsha cha surAdhipam
shlokas.10:
na shashAka cha sA rAjanpratyutthAtumaninditA |
vaktuM cha nAshakadrAjanviShTabdhA vipulena sA
shlokas.11:
AkAraM gurupatnyAstu vij~nAya sa bhRRigUdvahaH |
nijagrAha mahAtejA yogena balavatprabho
babandha yogabandhaishcha tasyAH sarvendriyANi saH
shlokas.12:
tAM nirvikArAM dRRiShTvA tu punareva shachIpatiH |
uvAcha vrIDito rAja.nstAM yogabalamohitAm
shlokas.13:
ehyehIti tataH sA taM prativaktumiyeSha cha |
sa tAM vAchaM guroH patnyA vipulaH paryavartayat
shlokas.14:
bhoH kimAgamane kRRityamiti tasyAshcha niHsRRitA |
vaktrAchChashA~NkapratimAdvANI sa.nskArabhUShitA
shlokas.15:
vrIDitA sA tu tadvAkyamuktvA paravashA tadA |
pura.ndarashcha santrasto babhUva vimanAstadA
shlokas.16:
sa tadvaikRRitamAlakShya devarAjo vishAM pate |
avaikShata sahasrAkShastadA divyena chakShuShA
shlokas.17:
dadarsha cha muniM tasyAH sharIrAntaragocharam |
pratibimbamivAdarshe gurupatnyAH sharIragam
shlokas.18:
sa taM ghoreNa tapasA yuktaM dRRiShTvA pura.ndaraH |
prAvepata susantrastaH shApabhItastadA vibho
shlokas.19:
vimuchya gurupatnIM tu vipulaH sumahAtapAH |
svaM kalevaramAvishya shakraM bhItamathAbravIt
shlokas.20:
ajitendriya pApAtmankAmAtmaka pura.ndara |
na chiraM pUjayiShyanti devAstvAM mAnuShAstathA
shlokas.21:
kiM nu tadvismRRitaM shakra na tanmanasi te sthitam |
gautamenAsi yanmukto bhagA~NkaparichihnitaH
shlokas.22:
jAne tvAM bAlishamatimakRRitAtmAnamasthiram |
mayeyaM rakShyate mUDha gachCha pApa yathAgatam
shlokas.23:
nAhaM tvAmadya mUDhAtmandaheyaM hi svatejasA |
kRRipAyamANastu na te dagdhumichChAmi vAsava
shlokas.24:
sa cha ghoratapA dhImAngururme pApachetasam |
dRRiShTvA tvAM nirdahedadya krodhadIptena chakShuShA
shlokas.25:
naivaM tu shakra kartavyaM punarmAnyAshcha te dvijAH |
mA gamaH sasutAmAtyo.atyayaM brahmabalArditaH
shlokas.26:
amaro.asmIti yadbuddhimetAmAsthAya vartase |
mAvama.nsthA na tapasAmasAdhyaM nAma ki~nchana
shlokas.27:
tachChrutvA vachanaM shakro vipulasya mahAtmanaH |
aki~nchiduktvA vrIDitastatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.28:
muhUrtayAte shakre tu devasharmA mahAtapAH |
kRRitvA yaj~naM yathAkAmamAjagAma svamAshramam
shlokas.29:
Agate.atha gurau rAjanvipulaH priyakarmakRRit |
rakShitAM gurave bhAryAM nyavedayadaninditAm
shlokas.30:
abhivAdya cha shAntAtmA sa guruM guruvatsalaH |
vipulaH paryupAtiShThadyathApUrvamasha~NkitaH
shlokas.31:
vishrAntAya tatastasmai sahAsInAya bhAryayA |
nivedayAmAsa tadA vipulaH shakrakarma tat
shlokas.32:
tachChrutvA sa munistuShTo vipulasya pratApavAn |
babhUva shIlavRRittAbhyAM tapasA niyamena cha
shlokas.33:
vipulasya gurau vRRittiM bhaktimAtmani cha prabhuH |
dharme cha sthiratAM dRRiShTvA sAdhu sAdhvityuvAcha ha
shlokas.34:
pratinandya cha dharmAtmA shiShyaM dharmaparAyaNam |
vareNa chChandayAmAsa sa tasmAdguruvatsalaH
anuj~nAtashcha guruNA chachArAnuttamaM tapaH
shlokas.35:
tathaiva devasharmApi sabhAryaH sa mahAtapAH |
nirbhayo balavRRitraghnAchchachAra vijane vane

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vipulastvakarottIvraM tapaH kRRitvA gurorvachaH |
tapoyuktamathAtmAnamamanyata cha vIryavAn
shlokas.2:
sa tena karmaNA spardhanpRRithivIM pRRithivIpate |
chachAra gatabhIH prIto labdhakIrtirvaro nRRiShu
shlokas.3:
ubhau lokau jitau chApi tathaivAmanyata prabhuH |
karmaNA tena kauravya tapasA vipulena cha
shlokas.4:
atha kAle vyatikrAnte kasmi.nshchitkurunandana |
ruchyA bhaginyA dAnaM vai babhUva dhanadhAnyavat
shlokas.5:
etasminneva kAle tu divyA kAchidvarA~NganA |
bibhratI paramaM rUpaM jagAmAtha vihAyasA
shlokas.6:
tasyAH sharIrAtpuShpANi patitAni mahItale |
tasyAshramasyAvidUre divyagandhAni bhArata
shlokas.7:
tAnyagRRihNAttato rAjanruchirnalinalochanA |
tadA nimantrakastasyA a~NgebhyaH kShipramAgamat
shlokas.8:
tasyA hi bhaginI tAta jyeShThA nAmnA prabhAvatI |
bhAryA chitrarathasyAtha babhUvA~Ngeshvarasya vai
shlokas.9:
pinahya tAni puShpANi kesheShu varavarNinI |
AmantritA tato.agachChadruchira~NgapatergRRihAn
shlokas.10:
puShpANi tAni dRRiShTvAtha tadA~NgendravarA~NganA |
bhaginIM chodayAmAsa puShpArthe chArulochanA
shlokas.11:
sA bhartre sarvamAchaShTa ruchiH suruchirAnanA |
bhaginyA bhAShitaM sarvamRRiShistachchAbhyanandata
shlokas.12:
tato vipulamAnAyya devasharmA mahAtapAH |
puShpArthe chodayAmAsa gachCha gachCheti bhArata
shlokas.13:
vipulastu gurorvAkyamavichArya mahAtapAH |
sa tathetyabravIdrAja.nstaM cha deshaM jagAma ha
shlokas.14:
yasmindeshe tu tAnyAsanpatitAni nabhastalAt |
amlAnAnyapi tatrAsankusumAnyaparANyapi
shlokas.15:
tataH sa tAni jagrAha divyAni ruchirANi cha |
prAptAni svena tapasA divyagandhAni bhArata
shlokas.16:
samprApya tAni prItAtmA gurorvachanakArakaH |
tato jagAma tUrNaM cha champAM champakamAlinIm
shlokas.17:
sa vane vijane tAta dadarsha mithunaM nRRiNAm |
chakravatparivartantaM gRRihItvA pANinA karam
shlokas.18:
tatraikastUrNamagamattatpade parivartayan |
ekastu na tathA rAja.nshchakratuH kalahaM tataH
shlokas.19:
tvaM shIghraM gachChasItyeko.abravInneti tathAparaH |
neti neti cha tau tAta parasparamathochatuH
shlokas.20:
tayorvispardhatorevaM shapatho.ayamabhUttadA |
manasoddishya vipulaM tato vAkyamathochatuH
shlokas.21:
AvayoranRRitaM prAha yastasyAtha dvijasya vai |
vipulasya pare loke yA gatiH sA bhavediti
shlokas.22:
etachChrutvA tu vipulo viShaNNavadano.abhavat |
evaM tIvratapAshchAhaM kaShTashchAyaM parigrahaH
shlokas.23:
mithunasyAsya kiM me syAtkRRitaM pApaM yato gatiH |
aniShTA sarvabhUtAnAM kIrtitAnena me.adya vai
shlokas.24:
evaM sa~nchintayanneva vipulo rAjasattama |
avA~Nmukho nyastashirA dadhyau duShkRRitamAtmanaH
shlokas.25:
tataH ShaDanyAnpuruShAnakShaiH kA~nchanarAjataiH |
apashyaddIvyamAnAnvai lobhaharShAnvitA.nstathA
shlokas.26:
kurvataH shapathaM taM vai yaH kRRito mithunena vai |
vipulaM vai samuddishya te.api vAkyamathAbruvan
shlokas.27:
yo lobhamAsthAyAsmAkaM viShamaM kartumutsahet |
vipulasya pare loke yA gatistAmavApnuyAt
shlokas.28:
etachChrutvA tu vipulo nApashyaddharmasa~Nkaram |
janmaprabhRRiti kauravya kRRitapUrvamathAtmanaH
shlokas.29:
sa pradadhyau tadA rAjannagnAvagnirivAhitaH |
dahyamAnena manasA shApaM shrutvA tathAvidham
shlokas.30:
tasya chintayatastAta bahvyo dinanishA yayuH |
idamAsInmanasi cha ruchyA rakShaNakAritam
shlokas.31:
lakShaNaM lakShaNenaiva vadanaM vadanena cha |
vidhAya na mayA choktaM satyametadgurostadA
shlokas.32:
etadAtmani kauravya duShkRRitaM vipulastadA |
amanyata mahAbhAga tathA tachcha na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.33:
sa champAM nagarImetya puShpANi gurave dadau |
pUjayAmAsa cha guruM vidhivatsa gurupriyaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tamAgatamabhiprekShya shiShyaM vAkyamathAbravIt |
devasharmA mahAtejA yattachChRRiNu narAdhipa
shlokas.2:
devasharmovAcha||
kiM te vipula dRRiShTaM vai tasminnadya mahAvane |
te tvA jAnanti nipuNa AtmA cha ruchireva cha
shlokas.3:
vipula uvAcha||
brahmarShe mithunaM kiM tatke cha te puruShA vibho |
ye mAM jAnanti tattvena tA.nshcha me vaktumarhasi
shlokas.4:
devasharmovAcha||
yadvai tanmithunaM brahmannahorAtraM hi viddhi tat |
chakravatparivarteta tatte jAnAti duShkRRitam
shlokas.5:
ye cha te puruShA vipra akShairdIvyanti hRRiShTavat |
RRitU.nstAnabhijAnIhi te te jAnanti duShkRRitam
shlokas.6:
na mAM kashchidvijAnIta iti kRRitvA na vishvaset |
naro rahasi pApAtmA pApakaM karma vai dvija
shlokas.7:
kurvANaM hi naraM karma pApaM rahasi sarvadA |
pashyanti RRitavashchApi tathA dinanishe.apyuta
shlokas.8:
te tvAM harShasmitaM dRRiShTvA guroH karmAnivedakam |
smArayantastathA prAhuste yathA shrutavAnbhavAn
shlokas.9:
ahorAtraM vijAnAti RRitavashchApi nityashaH |
puruShe pApakaM karma shubhaM vA shubhakarmaNaH
shlokas.10:
tattvayA mama yatkarma vyabhichArAdbhayAtmakam |
nAkhyAtamiti jAnantaste tvAmAhustathA dvija
shlokas.11:
te chaiva hi bhaveyuste lokAH pApakRRito yathA |
kRRitvA nAchakShataH karma mama yachcha tvayA kRRitam
shlokas.12:
tathA shakyA cha durvRRittA rakShituM pramadA dvija |
na cha tvaM kRRitavAnki~nchidAgaH prIto.asmi tena te
shlokas.13:
yadi tvahaM tvA durvRRittamadrAkShaM dvijasattama |
shapeyaM tvAmahaM krodhAnna me.atrAsti vichAraNA
shlokas.14:
sajjanti puruShe nAryaH pu.nsAM so.arthashcha puShkalaH |
anyathA rakShataH shApo.abhaviShyatte gatishcha sA
shlokas.15:
rakShitA sA tvayA putra mama chApi niveditA |
ahaM te prItimA.nstAta svasti svargaM gamiShyasi
shlokas.16:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktvA vipulaM prIto devasharmA mahAnRRiShiH |
mumoda svargamAsthAya sahabhAryaH sashiShyakaH
shlokas.17:
idamAkhyAtavA.nshchApi mamAkhyAnaM mahAmuniH |
mArkaNDeyaH purA rAjanga~NgAkUle kathAntare
shlokas.18:
tasmAdbravImi pArtha tvA striyaH sarvAH sadaiva cha |
ubhayaM dRRishyate tAsu satataM sAdhvasAdhu cha
shlokas.19:
striyaH sAdhvyo mahAbhAgAH saMmatA lokamAtaraH |
dhArayanti mahIM rAjannimAM savanakAnanAm
shlokas.20:
asAdhvyashchApi durvRRittAH kulaghnyaH pApanishchayAH |
vij~neyA lakShaNairduShTaiH svagAtrasahajairnRRipa
shlokas.21:
evametAsu rakShA vai shakyA kartuM mahAtmabhiH |
anyathA rAjashArdUla na shakyA rakShituM striyaH
shlokas.22:
etA hi manujavyAghra tIkShNAstIkShNaparAkramAH |
nAsAmasti priyo nAma maithune sa~Ngame nRRibhiH
shlokas.23:
etAH kRRityAshcha kAryAshcha kRRitAshcha bharatarShabha |
na chaikasminramantyetAH puruShe pANDunandana
shlokas.24:
nAsu sneho nRRibhiH kAryastathaiverShyA janeshvara |
khedamAsthAya bhu~njIta dharmamAsthAya chaiva hi
shlokas.25:
vihanyetAnyathA kurvannaraH kauravanandana |
sarvathA rAjashArdUla yuktiH sarvatra pUjyate
shlokas.26:
tenaikena tu rakShA vai vipulena kRRitA striyAH |
nAnyaH shakto nRRiloke.asminrakShituM nRRipa yoShitaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yanmUlaM sarvadharmANAM prajanasya gRRihasya cha |
pitRRidevAtithInAM cha tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ayaM hi sarvadharmANAM dharmashchintyatamo mataH |
kIdRRishAya pradeyA syAtkanyeti vasudhAdhipa
shlokas.3:
shIlavRRitte samAj~nAya vidyAM yoniM cha karma cha |
adbhireva pradAtavyA kanyA guNavate vare
brAhmaNAnAM satAmeSha dharmo nityaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.4:
AvAhyamAvahedevaM yo dadyAdanukUlataH |
shiShTAnAM kShatriyANAM cha dharma eSha sanAtanaH
shlokas.5:
AtmAbhipretamutsRRijya kanyAbhipreta eva yaH |
abhipretA cha yA yasya tasmai deyA yudhiShThira
gAndharvamiti taM dharmaM prAhurdharmavido janAH
shlokas.6:
dhanena bahunA krItvA sampralobhya cha bAndhavAn |
asurANAM nRRipaitaM vai dharmamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.7:
hatvA ChittvA cha shIrShANi rudatAM rudatIM gRRihAt |
prasahya haraNaM tAta rAkShasaM dharmalakShaNam
shlokas.8:
pa~nchAnAM tu trayo dharmyA dvAvadharmyau yudhiShThira |
paishAcha Asurashchaiva na kartavyau katha~nchana
shlokas.9:
brAhmaH kShAtro.atha gAndharva ete dharmyA nararShabha |
pRRithagvA yadi vA mishrAH kartavyA nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.10:
tisro bhAryA brAhmaNasya dve bhArye kShatriyasya tu |
vaishyaH svajAtiM vindeta tAsvapatyaM samaM bhavet
shlokas.11:
brAhmaNI tu bhavejjyeShThA kShatriyA kShatriyasya tu |
ratyarthamapi shUdrA syAnnetyAhurapare janAH
shlokas.12:
apatyajanma shUdrAyAM na prasha.nsanti sAdhavaH |
shUdrAyAM janayanvipraH prAyashchittI vidhIyate
shlokas.13:
tri.nshadvarSho dashavarShAM bhAryAM vindeta nagnikAm |
ekavi.nshativarSho vA saptavarShAmavApnuyAt
shlokas.14:
yasyAstu na bhavedbhrAtA pitA vA bharatarShabha |
nopayachCheta tAM jAtu putrikAdharmiNI hi sA
shlokas.15:
trINi varShANyudIkSheta kanyA RRitumatI satI |
chaturthe tvatha samprApte svayaM bhartAramarjayet
shlokas.16:
prajano hIyate tasyA ratishcha bharatarShabha |
ato.anyathA vartamAnA bhavedvAchyA prajApateH
shlokas.17:
asapiNDA cha yA mAturasagotrA cha yA pituH |
ityetAmanugachCheta taM dharmaM manurabravIt
shlokas.18:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shulkamanyena dattaM syAddadAnItyAha chAparaH |
balAdanyaH prabhASheta dhanamanyaH pradarshayet
shlokas.19:
pANigrahItA tvanyaH syAtkasya kanyA pitAmaha |
tattvaM jij~nAsamAnAnAM chakShurbhavatu no bhavAn
shlokas.20:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yatki~nchitkarma mAnuShyaM sa.nsthAnAya prakRRiShyate |
mantravanmantritaM tasya mRRiShAvAdastu pAtakaH
shlokas.21:
bhAryApatyRRitvigAchAryAH shiShyopAdhyAya eva cha |
mRRiShokte daNDamarhanti netyAhurapare janAH
shlokas.22:
na hyakAmena sa.nvAdaM manurevaM prasha.nsati |
ayashasyamadharmyaM cha yanmRRiShA dharmakopanam
shlokas.23:
naikAntadoSha ekasmi.nstaddAnaM nopalabhyate |
dharmato yAM prayachChanti yAM cha krINanti bhArata
shlokas.24:
bandhubhiH samanuj~nAto mantrahomau prayojayet |
tathA sidhyanti te mantrA nAdattAyAH katha~nchana
shlokas.25:
yastvatra mantrasamayo bhAryApatyormithaH kRRitaH |
tamevAhurgarIyA.nsaM yashchAsau j~nAtibhiH kRRitaH
shlokas.26:
devadattAM patirbhAryAM vetti dharmasya shAsanAt |
sA daivIM mAnuShIM vAchamanRRitAM paryudasyati
shlokas.27:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kanyAyAM prAptashulkAyAM jyAyA.nshchedAvrajedvaraH |
dharmakAmArthasampanno vAchyamatrAnRRitaM na vA
shlokas.28:
tasminnubhayato doShe kurva~nChreyaH samAcharet |
ayaM naH sarvadharmANAM dharmashchintyatamo mataH
shlokas.29:
tattvaM jij~nAsamAnAnAM chakShurbhavatu no bhavAn |
tadetatsarvamAchakShva na hi tRRipyAmi kathyatAm
shlokas.30:
bhIShma uvAcha||
na vai niShThAkaraM shulkaM j~nAtvAsIttena nAhRRitam |
na hi shulkaparAH santaH kanyAM dadati karhichit
shlokas.31:
anyairguNairupetaM tu shulkaM yAchanti bAndhavAH |
ala~NkRRitvA vahasveti yo dadyAdanukUlataH
shlokas.32:
tachcha tAM cha dadAtyeva na shulkaM vikrayo na saH |
pratigRRihya bhaveddeyameSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.33:
dAsyAmi bhavate kanyAmiti pUrvaM nabhAShitam |
ye chaivAhurye cha nAhurye chAvashyaM vadantyuta
shlokas.34:
tasmAdA grahaNAtpANeryAchayanti parasparam |
kanyAvaraH purA datto marudbhiriti naH shrutam
shlokas.35:
nAniShTAya pradAtavyA kanyA ityRRiShichoditam |
tanmUlaM kAmamUlasya prajanasyeti me matiH
shlokas.36:
samIkShya cha bahUndoShAnsa.nvAsAdvidviShANayoH |
yathA niShThAkaraM shulkaM na jAtvAsIttathA shRRiNu
shlokas.37:
ahaM vichitravIryAya dve kanye samudAvaham |
jitvA cha mAgadhAnsarvAnkAshInatha cha kosalAn
gRRihItapANirekAsItprAptashulkAparAbhavat
shlokas.38:
pANau gRRihItA tatraiva visRRijyA iti me pitA |
abravIditarAM kanyAmAvahatsa tu kauravaH
shlokas.39:
apyanyAmanupaprachCha sha~NkamAnaH piturvachaH |
atIva hyasya dharmepsA piturme.abhyadhikAbhavat
shlokas.40:
tato.ahamabruvaM rAjannAchArepsuridaM vachaH |
AchAraM tattvato vettumichChAmIti punaH punaH
shlokas.41:
tato mayaivamukte tu vAkye dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
pitA mama mahArAja bAhlIko vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.42:
yadi vaH shulkato niShThA na pANigrahaNaM tathA |
lAjAntaramupAsIta prAptashulkA patiM vRRitam
shlokas.43:
na hi dharmavidaH prAhuH pramANaM vAkyataH smRRitam |
yeShAM vai shulkato niShThA na pANigrahaNAttathA
shlokas.44:
prasiddhaM bhAShitaM dAne teShAM pratyasanaM punaH |
ye manyante krayaM shulkaM na te dharmavido janAH
shlokas.45:
na chaitebhyaH pradAtavyA na voDhavyA tathAvidhA |
na hyeva bhAryA kretavyA na vikreyA katha~nchana
shlokas.46:
ye cha krINanti dAsIvadye cha vikrINate janAH |
bhavetteShAM tathA niShThA lubdhAnAM pApachetasAm
shlokas.47:
asmindharme satyavantaM paryapRRichChanta vai janAH |
kanyAyAH prAptashulkAyAH shulkadaH prashamaM gataH
shlokas.48:
pANigrahItA chAnyaH syAdatra no dharmasa.nshayaH |
tannashChindhi mahAprAj~na tvaM hi vai prAj~nasaMmataH
tattvaM jij~nAsamAnAnAM chakShurbhavatu no bhavAn
shlokas.49:
tAnevaM bruvataH sarvAnsatyavAnvAkyamabravIt |
yatreShTaM tatra deyA syAnnAtra kAryA vichAraNA
kurvate jIvato.apyevaM mRRite naivAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.50:
devaraM pravishetkanyA tapyedvApi mahattapaH |
tamevAnuvratA bhUtvA pANigrAhasya nAma sA
shlokas.51:
likhantyeva tu keShA~nchidapareShAM shanairapi |
iti ye sa.nvadantyatra ta etaM nishchayaM viduH
shlokas.52:
tatpANigrahaNAtpUrvamuttaraM yatra vartate |
sarvama~NgalamantraM vai mRRiShAvAdastu pAtakaH
shlokas.53:
pANigrahaNamantrANAM niShThA syAtsaptame pade |
pANigrAhasya bhAryA syAdyasya chAdbhiH pradIyate
shlokas.54:
anukUlAmanuva.nshAM bhrAtrA dattAmupAgnikAm |
parikramya yathAnyAyaM bhAryAM vindeddvijottamaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kanyAyAH prAptashulkAyAH patishchennAsti kashchana |
tatra kA pratipattiH syAttanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yAputrakasyApyarikthasya pratipatsA tadA bhavet |
atha chetsAharechChulkaM krItA shulkapradasya sA |
tasyArthe.apatyamIheta yena nyAyena shaknuyAt
shlokas.5:
na tasyA mantravatkAryaM kashchitkurvIta ki~nchana |
svayaM vRRiteti sAvitrI pitrA vai pratyapadyata |
tattasyAnye prasha.nsanti dharmaj~nA netare janAH
shlokas.6:
etattu nApare chakrurna pare jAtu sAdhavaH |
sAdhUnAM punarAchAro garIyo dharmalakShaNam
shlokas.7:
asminneva prakaraNe sukraturvAkyamabravIt |
naptA videharAjasya janakasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.8:
asadAcharite mArge kathaM syAdanukIrtanam |
anuprashnaH sa.nshayo vA satAmetadupAlabhet
shlokas.9:
asadeva hi dharmasya pramAdo dharma AsuraH |
nAnushushruma jAtvetAmimAM pUrveShu janmasu
shlokas.10:
bhAryApatyorhi sambandhaH strIpu.nsostulya eva saH |
ratiH sAdhAraNo dharma iti chAha sa pArthivaH
shlokas.11:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
atha kena pramANena pu.nsAmAdIyate dhanam |
putravaddhi pitustasya kanyA bhavitumarhati
shlokas.12:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yathaivAtmA tathA putraH putreNa duhitA samA |
tasyAmAtmani tiShThantyAM kathamanyo dhanaM haret
shlokas.13:
mAtushcha yautakaM yatsyAtkumArIbhAga eva saH |
dauhitra eva vA rikthamaputrasya piturharet
shlokas.14:
dadAti hi sa piNDaM vai piturmAtAmahasya cha |
putradauhitrayorneha visheSho dharmataH smRRitaH
shlokas.15:
anyatra jAtayA sA hi prajayA putra Ihate |
duhitAnyatra jAtena putreNApi vishiShyate
