shlokas.16:
dauhitrakeNa dharmeNa nAtra pashyAmi kAraNam |
vikrItAsu cha ye putrA bhavanti pitureva te
shlokas.17:
asUyavastvadharmiShThAH parasvAdAyinaH shaThAH |
AsurAdadhisambhUtA dharmAdviShamavRRittayaH
shlokas.18:
atra gAthA yamodgItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH |
dharmaj~nA dharmashAstreShu nibaddhA dharmasetuShu
shlokas.19:
yo manuShyaH svakaM putraM vikrIya dhanamichChati |
kanyAM vA jIvitArthAya yaH shulkena prayachChati
shlokas.20:
saptAvare mahAghore niraye kAlasAhvaye |
svedaM mUtraM purIShaM cha tasminpreta upAshnute
shlokas.21:
ArShe gomithunaM shulkaM kechidAhurmRRiShaiva tat |
alpaM vA bahu vA rAjanvikrayastAvadeva saH
shlokas.22:
yadyapyAcharitaH kaishchinnaiSha dharmaH katha~nchana |
anyeShAmapi dRRishyante lobhataH sampravRRittayaH
shlokas.23:
vashyAM kumArIM vihitAM ye cha tAmupabhu~njate |
ete pApasya kartArastamasyandhe.atha sherate
shlokas.24:
anyo.apyatha na vikreyo manuShyaH kiM punaH prajAH |
adharmamUlairhi dhanairna tairartho.asti kashchana

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
prAchetasasya vachanaM kIrtayanti purAvidaH |
yasyAH ki~nchinnAdadate j~nAtayo na sa vikrayaH
shlokas.2:
arhaNaM tatkumArINAmAnRRisha.nsyatamaM cha tat |
sarvaM cha pratideyaM syAtkanyAyai tadasheShataH
shlokas.3:
pitRRibhirbhrAtRRibhishchaiva shvashurairatha devaraiH |
pUjyA lAlayitavyAshcha bahukalyANamIpsubhiH
shlokas.4:
yadi vai strI na rocheta pumA.nsaM na pramodayet |
amodanAtpunaH pu.nsaH prajanaM na pravardhate
shlokas.5:
pUjyA lAlayitavyAshcha striyo nityaM janAdhipa |
apUjitAshcha yatraitAH sarvAstatrAphalAH kriyAH
tadaiva tatkulaM nAsti yadA shochanti jAmayaH
shlokas.6:
jAmIshaptAni gehAni nikRRittAnIva kRRityayA |
naiva bhAnti na vardhante shriyA hInAni pArthiva
shlokas.7:
striyaH pu.nsAM paridade manurjigamiShurdivam |
abalAH svalpakaupInAH suhRRidaH satyajiShNavaH
shlokas.8:
IrShyavo mAnakAmAshcha chaNDA asuhRRido.abudhAH |
striyo mAnanamarhanti tA mAnayata mAnavAH
shlokas.9:
strIpratyayo hi vo dharmo ratibhogAshcha kevalAH |
paricharyAnnasa.nskArAstadAyattA bhavantu vaH
shlokas.10:
utpAdanamapatyasya jAtasya paripAlanam |
prItyarthaM lokayAtrA cha pashyata strInibandhanam
shlokas.11:
saMmAnyamAnAshchaitAbhiH sarvakAryANyavApsyatha |
videharAjaduhitA chAtra shlokamagAyata
shlokas.12:
nAsti yaj~naH striyaH kashchinna shrAddhaM nopavAsakam |
dharmastu bhartRRishushrUShA tayA svargaM jayatyuta
shlokas.13:
pitA rakShati kaumAre bhartA rakShati yauvane |
putrAstu sthavirIbhAve na strI svAtantryamarhati
shlokas.14:
shriya etAH striyo nAma satkAryA bhUtimichChatA |
lAlitA nigRRihItA cha strI shrIrbhavati bhArata

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sarvashAstravidhAnaj~na rAjadharmArthavittama |
atIva sa.nshayachChettA bhavAnvai prathitaH kShitau
shlokas.2:
kashchittu sa.nshayo me.asti tanme brUhi pitAmaha |
asyAmApadi kaShTAyAmanyaM pRRichChAma kaM vayam
shlokas.3:
yathA nareNa kartavyaM yashcha dharmaH sanAtanaH |
etatsarvaM mahAbAho bhavAnvyAkhyAtumarhati
shlokas.4:
chatasro vihitA bhAryA brAhmaNasya pitAmaha |
brAhmaNI kShatriyA vaishyA shUdrA cha ratimichChataH
shlokas.5:
tatra jAteShu putreShu sarvAsAM kurusattama |
AnupUrvyeNa kasteShAM pitryaM dAyAdyamarhati
shlokas.6:
kena vA kiM tato hAryaM pitRRivittAtpitAmaha |
etadichChAmi kathitaM vibhAgasteShu yaH smRRitaH
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
brAhmaNaH kShatriyo vaishyastrayo varNA dvijAtayaH |
eteShu vihito dharmo brAhmaNasya yudhiShThira
shlokas.8:
vaiShamyAdatha vA lobhAtkAmAdvApi parantapa |
brAhmaNasya bhavechChUdrA na tu dRRiShTAntataH smRRitA
shlokas.9:
shUdrAM shayanamAropya brAhmaNaH pIDito bhavet |
prAyashchittIyate chApi vidhidRRiShTena hetunA
shlokas.10:
tatra jAteShvapatyeShu dviguNaM syAdyudhiShThira |
ataste niyamaM vitte sampravakShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.11:
lakShaNyo govRRiSho yAnaM yatpradhAnatamaM bhavet |
brAhmaNyAstaddharetputra ekA.nshaM vai piturdhanAt
shlokas.12:
sheShaM tu dashadhA kAryaM brAhmaNasvaM yudhiShThira |
tatra tenaiva hartavyAshchatvAroM.ashAH piturdhanAt
shlokas.13:
kShatriyAyAstu yaH putro brAhmaNaH so.apyasa.nshayaH |
sa tu mAtRRivisheSheNa trIna.nshAnhartumarhati
shlokas.14:
varNe tRRitIye jAtastu vaishyAyAM brAhmaNAdapi |
dvira.nshastena hartavyo brAhmaNasvAdyudhiShThira
shlokas.15:
shUdrAyAM brAhmaNAjjAto nityAdeyadhanaH smRRitaH |
alpaM vApi pradAtavyaM shUdrAputrAya bhArata
shlokas.16:
dashadhA pravibhaktasya dhanasyaiSha bhavetkramaH |
savarNAsu tu jAtAnAM samAnbhAgAnprakalpayet
shlokas.17:
abrAhmaNaM tu manyante shUdrAputramanaipuNAt |
triShu varNeShu jAto hi brAhmaNAdbrAhmaNo bhavet
shlokas.18:
smRRitA varNAshcha chatvAraH pa~nchamo nAdhigamyate |
harettu dashamaM bhAgaM shUdrAputraH piturdhanAt
shlokas.19:
tattu dattaM haretpitrA nAdattaM hartumarhati |
avashyaM hi dhanaM deyaM shUdrAputrAya bhArata
shlokas.20:
AnRRisha.nsyaM paro dharma iti tasmai pradIyate |
yatra tatra samutpanno guNAyaivopakalpate
shlokas.21:
yadi vApyekaputraH syAdaputro yadi vA bhavet |
nAdhikaM dashamAddadyAchChUdrAputrAya bhArata
shlokas.22:
traivArShikAdyadA bhaktAdadhikaM syAddvijasya tu |
yajeta tena dravyeNa na vRRithA sAdhayeddhanam
shlokas.23:
trisAhasraparo dAyaH striyo deyo dhanasya vai |
tachcha bhartrA dhanaM dattaM nAdattaM bhoktumarhati
shlokas.24:
strINAM tu patidAyAdyamupabhogaphalaM smRRitam |
nApahAraM striyaH kuryuH pativittAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.25:
striyAstu yadbhavedvittaM pitrA dattaM yudhiShThira |
brAhmaNyAstaddharetkanyA yathA putrastathA hi sA
sA hi putrasamA rAjanvihitA kurunandana
shlokas.26:
evametatsamuddiShTaM dharmeShu bharatarShabha |
etaddharmamanusmRRitya na vRRithA sAdhayeddhanam
shlokas.27:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shUdrAyAM brAhmaNAjjAto yadyadeyadhanaH smRRitaH |
kena prativisheSheNa dashamo.apyasya dIyate
shlokas.28:
brAhmaNyAM brAhmaNAjjAto brAhmaNaH syAnna sa.nshayaH |
kShatriyAyAM tathaiva syAdvaishyAyAmapi chaiva hi
shlokas.29:
kasmAtte viShamaM bhAgaM bhajerannRRipasattama |
yadA sarve trayo varNAstvayoktA brAhmaNA iti
shlokas.30:
bhIShma uvAcha||
dArA ityuchyate loke nAmnaikena parantapa |
proktena chaikanAmnAyaM visheShaH sumahAnbhavet
shlokas.31:
tisraH kRRitvA puro bhAryAH pashchAdvindeta brAhmaNIm |
sA jyeShThA sA cha pUjyA syAtsA cha tAbhyo garIyasI
shlokas.32:
snAnaM prasAdhanaM bharturdantadhAvanama~njanam |
havyaM kavyaM cha yachchAnyaddharmayuktaM bhavedgRRihe
shlokas.33:
na tasyAM jAtu tiShThantyAmanyA tatkartumarhati |
brAhmaNI tveva tatkuryAdbrAhmaNasya yudhiShThira
shlokas.34:
annaM pAnaM cha mAlyaM cha vAsA.nsyAbharaNAni cha |
brAhmaNyai tAni deyAni bhartuH sA hi garIyasI
shlokas.35:
manunAbhihitaM shAstraM yachchApi kurunandana |
tatrApyeSha mahArAja dRRiShTo dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.36:
atha chedanyathA kuryAdyadi kAmAdyudhiShThira |
yathA brAhmaNachaNDAlaH pUrvadRRiShTastathaiva saH
shlokas.37:
brAhmaNyAH sadRRishaH putraH kShatriyAyAshcha yo bhavet |
rAjanvisheSho nAstyatra varNayorubhayorapi
shlokas.38:
na tu jAtyA samA loke brAhmaNyAH kShatriyA bhavet |
brAhmaNyAH prathamaH putro bhUyAnsyAdrAjasattama
bhUyo.api bhUyasA hAryaM pitRRivittAdyudhiShThira
shlokas.39:
yathA na sadRRishI jAtu brAhmaNyAH kShatriyA bhavet |
kShatriyAyAstathA vaishyA na jAtu sadRRishI bhavet
shlokas.40:
shrIshcha rAjyaM cha koshashcha kShatriyANAM yudhiShThira |
vihitaM dRRishyate rAjansAgarAntA cha medinI
shlokas.41:
kShatriyo hi svadharmeNa shriyaM prApnoti bhUyasIm |
rAjA daNDadharo rAjanrakShA nAnyatra kShatriyAt
shlokas.42:
brAhmaNA hi mahAbhAgA devAnAmapi devatAH |
teShu rAjA pravarteta pUjayA vidhipUrvakam
shlokas.43:
praNItamRRiShibhirj~nAtvA dharmaM shAshvatamavyayam |
lupyamAnAH svadharmeNa kShatriyo rakShati prajAH
shlokas.44:
dasyubhirhriyamANaM cha dhanaM dArAshcha sarvashaH |
sarveShAmeva varNAnAM trAtA bhavati pArthivaH
shlokas.45:
bhUyAnsyAtkShatriyAputro vaishyAputrAnna sa.nshayaH |
bhUyastenApi hartavyaM pitRRivittAdyudhiShThira
shlokas.46:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
uktaM te vidhivadrAjanbrAhmaNasve pitAmaha |
itareShAM tu varNAnAM kathaM viniyamo bhavet
shlokas.47:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kShatriyasyApi bhArye dve vihite kurunandana |
tRRitIyA cha bhavechChUdrA na tu dRRiShTAntataH smRRitA
shlokas.48:
eSha eva kramo hi syAtkShatriyANAM yudhiShThira |
aShTadhA tu bhavetkAryaM kShatriyasvaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.49:
kShatriyAyA haretputrashchaturoM.ashAnpiturdhanAt |
yuddhAvahArikaM yachcha pituH syAtsa harechcha tat
shlokas.50:
vaishyAputrastu bhAgA.nstrInshUdrAputrastathAShTamam |
so.api dattaM haretpitrA nAdattaM hartumarhati
shlokas.51:
ekaiva hi bhavedbhAryA vaishyasya kurunandana |
dvitIyA vA bhavechChUdrA na tu dRRiShTAntataH smRRitA
shlokas.52:
vaishyasya vartamAnasya vaishyAyAM bharatarShabha |
shUdrAyAM chaiva kaunteya tayorviniyamaH smRRitaH
shlokas.53:
pa~nchadhA tu bhavetkAryaM vaishyasvaM bharatarShabha |
tayorapatye vakShyAmi vibhAgaM cha janAdhipa
shlokas.54:
vaishyAputreNa hartavyAshchatvAroM.ashAH piturdhanAt |
pa~nchamastu bhavedbhAgaH shUdrAputrAya bhArata
shlokas.55:
so.api dattaM haretpitrA nAdattaM hartumarhati |
tribhirvarNaistathA jAtaH shUdro deyadhano bhavet
shlokas.56:
shUdrasya syAtsavarNaiva bhAryA nAnyA katha~nchana |
shUdrasya samabhAgaH syAdyadi putrashataM bhavet
shlokas.57:
jAtAnAM samavarNAsu putrANAmavisheShataH |
sarveShAmeva varNAnAM samabhAgo dhane smRRitaH
shlokas.58:
jyeShThasya bhAgo jyeShThaH syAdekA.nsho yaH pradhAnataH |
eSha dAyavidhiH pArtha pUrvamuktaH svayambhuvA
shlokas.59:
samavarNAsu jAtAnAM visheSho.astyaparo nRRipa |
vivAhavaisheShyakRRitaH pUrvaH pUrvo vishiShyate
shlokas.60:
harejjyeShThaH pradhAnA.nshamekaM tulyAsuteShvapi |
madhyamo madhyamaM chaiva kanIyA.nstu kanIyasam
shlokas.61:
evaM jAtiShu sarvAsu savarNAH shreShThatAM gatAH |
maharShirapi chaitadvai mArIchaH kAshyapo.abravIt

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
arthAshrayAdvA kAmAdvA varNAnAM vApyanishchayAt |
aj~nAnAdvApi varNAnAM jAyate varNasa~NkaraH
shlokas.2:
teShAmetena vidhinA jAtAnAM varNasa~Nkare |
ko dharmaH kAni karmANi tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
chAturvarNyasya karmANi chAturvarNyaM cha kevalam |
asRRijatsa ha yaj~nArthe pUrvameva prajApatiH
shlokas.4:
bhAryAshchatasro viprasya dvayorAtmAsya jAyate |
AnupUrvyAddvayorhInau mAtRRijAtyau prasUyataH
shlokas.5:
paraM shavAdbrAhmaNasyaiSha putraH; shUdrAputraM pArashavaM tamAhuH |
shushrUShakaH svasya kulasya sa syA;tsvaM chAritraM nityamatho na jahyAt
shlokas.6:
sarvAnupAyAnapi sampradhArya; samuddharetsvasya kulasya tantum |
jyeShTho yavIyAnapi yo dvijasya; shushrUShavAndAnaparAyaNaH syAt
shlokas.7:
tisraH kShatriyasambandhAddvayorAtmAsya jAyate |
hInavarNastRRitIyAyAM shUdra ugra iti smRRitaH
shlokas.8:
dve chApi bhArye vaishyasya dvayorAtmAsya jAyate |
shUdrA shUdrasya chApyekA shUdrameva prajAyate
shlokas.9:
ato vishiShTastvadhamo gurudArapradharShakaH |
bAhyaM varNaM janayati chAturvarNyavigarhitam
shlokas.10:
ayAjyaM kShatriyo vrAtyaM sUtaM stomakriyAparam |
vaishyo vaidehakaM chApi maudgalyamapavarjitam
shlokas.11:
shUdrashchaNDAlamatyugraM vadhyaghnaM bAhyavAsinam |
brAhmaNyAM samprajAyanta ityete kulapA.nsanAH
ete matimatAM shreShTha varNasa~NkarajAH prabho
shlokas.12:
bandI tu jAyate vaishyAnmAgadho vAkyajIvanaH |
shUdrAnniShAdo matsyaghnaH kShatriyAyAM vyatikramAt
shlokas.13:
shUdrAdAyogavashchApi vaishyAyAM grAmadharmiNaH |
brAhmaNairapratigrAhyastakShA sa vanajIvanaH
shlokas.14:
ete.api sadRRishaM varNaM janayanti svayoniShu |
mAtRRijAtyAM prasUyante pravarA hInayoniShu
shlokas.15:
yathA chaturShu varNeShu dvayorAtmAsya jAyate |
AnantaryAttu jAyante tathA bAhyAH pradhAnataH
shlokas.16:
te chApi sadRRishaM varNaM janayanti svayoniShu |
parasparasya vartanto janayanti vigarhitAn
shlokas.17:
yathA cha shUdro brAhmaNyAM jantuM bAhyaM prasUyate |
evaM bAhyatarAdbAhyashchAturvarNyAtprasUyate
shlokas.18:
pratilomaM tu vartanto bAhyAdbAhyataraM punaH |
hInA hInAtprasUyante varNAH pa~nchadashaiva te
shlokas.19:
agamyAgamanAchchaiva vartate varNasa~NkaraH |
vrAtyAnAmatra jAyante sairandhrA mAgadheShu cha
prasAdhanopachAraj~namadAsaM dAsajIvanam
shlokas.20:
atashchAyogavaM sUte vAgurAvanajIvanam |
maireyakaM cha vaidehaH samprasUte.atha mAdhukam
shlokas.21:
niShAdo mudgaraM sUte dAshaM nAvopajIvinam |
mRRitapaM chApi chaNDAlaH shvapAkamatikutsitam
shlokas.22:
chaturo mAgadhI sUte krUrAnmAyopajIvinaH |
mA.nsasvAdukaraM sUdaM saugandhamiti sa~nj~nitam
shlokas.23:
vaidehakAchcha pApiShThaM krUraM bhAryopajIvinam |
niShAdAnmadranAbhaM cha kharayAnaprayAyinam
shlokas.24:
chaNDAlAtpulkasaM chApi kharAshvagajabhojinam |
mRRitachelapratichChannaM bhinnabhAjanabhojinam
shlokas.25:
AyogavIShu jAyante hInavarNAsu te trayaH |
kShudro vaidehakAdandhro bahirgrAmapratishrayaH
shlokas.26:
kArAvaro niShAdyAM tu charmakArAtprajAyate |
chaNDAlAtpANDusaupAkastvaksAravyavahAravAn
shlokas.27:
AhiNDiko niShAdena vaidehyAM samprajAyate |
chaNDAlena tu saupAko maudgalyasamavRRittimAn
shlokas.28:
niShAdI chApi chaNDAlAtputramantAvasAyinam |
shmashAnagocharaM sUte bAhyairapi bahiShkRRitam
shlokas.29:
ityetAH sa~Nkare jAtyaH pitRRimAtRRivyatikramAt |
prachChannA vA prakAshA vA veditavyAH svakarmabhiH
shlokas.30:
chaturNAmeva varNAnAM dharmo nAnyasya vidyate |
varNAnAM dharmahIneShu sa~nj~nA nAstIha kasyachit
shlokas.31:
yadRRichChayopasampannairyaj~nasAdhubahiShkRRitaiH |
bAhyA bAhyaistu jAyante yathAvRRitti yathAshrayam
shlokas.32:
chatuShpathashmashAnAni shailA.nshchAnyAnvanaspatIn |
yu~njante chApyala~NkArA.nstathopakaraNAni cha
shlokas.33:
gobrAhmaNArthe sAhAyyaM kurvANA vai na sa.nshayaH |
AnRRisha.nsyamanukroshaH satyavAkyamatha kShamA
shlokas.34:
svasharIraiH paritrANaM bAhyAnAM siddhikArakam |
manujavyAghra bhavati tatra me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.35:
yathopadeshaM parikIrtitAsu; naraH prajAyeta vichArya buddhimAn |
vihInayonirhi suto.avasAdaye;ttitIrShamANaM salile yathopalam
shlokas.36:
avidvA.nsamalaM loke vidvA.nsamapi vA punaH |
nayante hyutpathaM nAryaH kAmakrodhavashAnugam
shlokas.37:
svabhAvashchaiva nArINAM narANAmiha dUShaNam |
ityarthaM na prasajjante pramadAsu vipashchitaH
shlokas.38:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
varNApetamavij~nAtaM naraM kaluShayonijam |
AryarUpamivAnAryaM kathaM vidyAmahe nRRipa
shlokas.39:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yonisa~NkaluShe jAtaM nAnAchArasamAhitam |
karmabhiH sajjanAchIrNairvij~neyA yonishuddhatA
shlokas.40:
anAryatvamanAchAraH krUratvaM niShkriyAtmatA |
puruShaM vya~njayantIha loke kaluShayonijam
shlokas.41:
pitryaM vA bhajate shIlaM mAtRRijaM vA tathobhayam |
na katha~nchana sa~NkIrNaH prakRRitiM svAM niyachChati
shlokas.42:
yathaiva sadRRisho rUpe mAtApitrorhi jAyate |
vyAghrashchitraistathA yoniM puruShaH svAM niyachChati
shlokas.43:
kulasrotasi sa~nChanne yasya syAdyonisa~NkaraH |
sa.nshrayatyeva tachChIlaM naro.alpamapi vA bahu
shlokas.44:
AryarUpasamAchAraM charantaM kRRitake pathi |
svavarNamanyavarNaM vA svashIlaM shAsti nishchaye
shlokas.45:
nAnAvRRitteShu bhUteShu nAnAkarmarateShu cha |
janmavRRittasamaM loke sushliShTaM na virajyate
shlokas.46:
sharIramiha sattvena narasya parikRRiShyate |
jyeShThamadhyAvaraM sattvaM tulyasattvaM pramodate
shlokas.47:
jyAyA.nsamapi shIlena vihInaM naiva pUjayet |
api shUdraM tu sadvRRittaM dharmaj~namabhipUjayet
shlokas.48:
AtmAnamAkhyAti hi karmabhirnaraH; svashIlachAritrakRRitaiH shubhAshubhaiH |
pranaShTamapyAtmakulaM tathA naraH; punaH prakAshaM kurute svakarmabhiH
shlokas.49:
yoniShvetAsu sarvAsu sa~NkIrNAsvitarAsu cha |
yatrAtmAnaM na janayedbudhastAH parivarjayet

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
brUhi putrAnkurushreShTha varNAnAM tvaM pRRithakpRRithak |
kIdRRishyAM kIdRRishAshchApi putrAH kasya cha ke cha te
shlokas.2:
vipravAdAH subahushaH shrUyante putrakAritAH |
atra no muhyatAM rAjansa.nshayaM Chettumarhasi
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
AtmA putrastu vij~neyastasyAnantarajashcha yaH |
niyuktajashcha vij~neyaH sutaH prasRRitajastathA
shlokas.4:
patitasya cha bhAryAyAM bhartrA susamavetayA |
tathA dattakRRitau putrAvadhyUDhashcha tathAparaH
shlokas.5:
ShaDapadhva.nsajAshchApi kAnInApasadAstathA |
ityete te samAkhyAtAstAnvijAnIhi bhArata
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ShaDapadhva.nsajAH ke syuH ke vApyapasadAstathA |
etatsarvaM yathAtattvaM vyAkhyAtuM me tvamarhasi
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
triShu varNeShu ye putrA brAhmaNasya yudhiShThira |
varNayoshcha dvayoH syAtAM yau rAjanyasya bhArata
shlokas.8:
eko dvivarNa evAtha tathAtraivopalakShitaH |
ShaDapadhva.nsajAste hi tathaivApasadA~nshRRiNu
shlokas.9:
chaNDAlo vrAtyavenau cha brAhmaNyAM kShatriyAsu cha |
vaishyAyAM chaiva shUdrasya lakShyante.apasadAstrayaH
shlokas.10:
mAgadho vAmakashchaiva dvau vaishyasyopalakShitau |
brAhmaNyAM kShatriyAyAM cha kShatriyasyaika eva tu
shlokas.11:
brAhmaNyAM lakShyate sUta ityete.apasadAH smRRitAH |
putrareto na shakyaM hi mithyA kartuM narAdhipa
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kShetrajaM kechidevAhuH sutaM kechittu shukrajam |
tulyAvetau sutau kasya tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
retajo vA bhavetputrastyakto vA kShetrajo bhavet |
adhyUDhaH samayaM bhittvetyetadeva nibodha me
shlokas.14:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
retojaM vidma vai putraM kShetrajasyAgamaH katham |
adhyUDhaM vidma vai putraM hitvA cha samayaM katham
shlokas.15:
bhIShma uvAcha||
AtmajaM putramutpAdya yastyajetkAraNAntare |
na tatra kAraNaM retaH sa kShetrasvAmino bhavet
shlokas.16:
putrakAmo hi putrArthe yAM vRRiNIte vishAM pate |
tatra kShetraM pramANaM syAnna vai tatrAtmajaH sutaH
shlokas.17:
anyatra kShetrajaH putro lakShyate bharatarShabha |
na hyAtmA shakyate hantuM dRRiShTAntopagato hyasau
shlokas.18:
kashchichcha kRRitakaH putraH sa~NgrahAdeva lakShyate |
na tatra retaH kShetraM vA pramANaM syAdyudhiShThira
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kIdRRishaH kRRitakaH putraH sa~NgrahAdeva lakShyate |
shukraM kShetraM pramANaM vA yatra lakShyeta bhArata
shlokas.20:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mAtApitRRibhyAM santyaktaM pathi yaM tu pralakShayet |
na chAsya mAtApitarau j~nAyete sa hi kRRitrimaH
shlokas.21:
asvAmikasya svAmitvaM yasminsampratilakShayet |
savarNastaM cha poSheta savarNastasya jAyate
shlokas.22:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathamasya prayoktavyaH sa.nskAraH kasya vA katham |
deyA kanyA kathaM cheti tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.24:
bhIShma uvAcha||
Atmavattasya kurvIta sa.nskAraM svAmivattathA |
tyakto mAtApitRRibhyAM yaH savarNaM pratipadyate |
tadgotravarNatastasya kuryAtsa.nskAramachyuta
shlokas.25:
atha deyA tu kanyA syAttadvarNena yudhiShThira |
sa.nskartuM mAtRRigotraM cha mAtRRivarNavinishchaye
shlokas.26:
kAnInAdhyUDhajau chApi vij~neyau putrakilbiShau |
tAvapi svAviva sutau sa.nskAryAviti nishchayaH
shlokas.27:
kShetrajo vApyapasado ye.adhyUDhAsteShu chApyatha |
Atmavadvai prayu~njIransa.nskAraM brAhmaNAdayaH
shlokas.28:
dharmashAstreShu varNAnAM nishchayo.ayaM pradRRishyate |
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
darshane kIdRRishaH snehaH sa.nvAse cha pitAmaha |
mahAbhAgyaM gavAM chaiva tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi purAvRRittaM mahAdyute |
nahuShasya cha sa.nvAdaM maharSheshchyavanasya cha
shlokas.3:
purA maharShishchyavano bhArgavo bharatarShabha |
udavAsakRRitArambho babhUva sumahAvrataH
shlokas.4:
nihatya mAnaM krodhaM cha praharShaM shokameva cha |
varShANi dvAdasha munirjalavAse dhRRitavrataH
shlokas.5:
AdadhatsarvabhUteShu visrambhaM paramaM shubham |
jalechareShu sattveShu shItarashmiriva prabhuH
shlokas.6:
sthANubhUtaH shuchirbhUtvA daivatebhyaH praNamya cha |
ga~NgAyamunayormadhye jalaM sampravivesha ha
shlokas.7:
ga~NgAyamunayorvegaM subhImaM bhImaniHsvanam |
pratijagrAha shirasA vAtavegasamaM jave
shlokas.8:
ga~NgA cha yamunA chaiva saritashchAnugAstayoH |
pradakShiNamRRiShiM chakrurna chainaM paryapIDayan
shlokas.9:
antarjale sa suShvApa kAShThabhUto mahAmuniH |
tatashchordhvasthito dhImAnabhavadbharatarShabha
shlokas.10:
jalaukasAM sa sattvAnAM babhUva priyadarshanaH |
upAjighranta cha tadA matsyAstaM hRRiShTamAnasAH
tatra tasyAsataH kAlaH samatIto.abhavanmahAn
shlokas.11:
tataH kadAchitsamaye kasmi.nshchinmatsyajIvinaH |
taM deshaM samupAjagmurjAlahastA mahAdyute
shlokas.12:
niShAdA bahavastatra matsyoddharaNanishchitAH |
vyAyatA balinaH shUrAH salileShvanivartinaH
abhyAyayushcha taM deshaM nishchitA jAlakarmaNi
shlokas.13:
jAlaM cha yojayAmAsurvisheSheNa janAdhipa |
matsyodakaM samAsAdya tadA bharatasattama
shlokas.14:
tataste bahubhiryogaiH kaivartA matsyakA~NkShiNaH |
ga~NgAyamunayorvAri jAlairabhyakira.nstataH
shlokas.15:
jAlaM suvitataM teShAM navasUtrakRRitaM tathA |
vistArAyAmasampannaM yattatra salile kShamam
shlokas.16:
tataste sumahachchaiva balavachcha suvartitam |
prakIrya sarvataH sarve jAlaM chakRRiShire tadA
shlokas.17:
abhItarUpAH saMhRRiShTAste.anyonyavashavartinaH |
babandhustatra matsyA.nshcha tathAnyA~njalachAriNaH
shlokas.18:
tathA matsyaiH parivRRitaM chyavanaM bhRRigunandanam |
AkarShanta mahArAja jAlenAtha yadRRichChayA
shlokas.19:
nadIshaivaladigdhA~NgaM harishmashrujaTAdharam |
lagnaiH sha~NkhagaNairgAtraiH koShThaishchitrairivAvRRitam
shlokas.20:
taM jAlenoddhRRitaM dRRiShTvA te tadA vedapAragam |
sarve prA~njalayo dAshAH shirobhiH prApatanbhuvi
shlokas.21:
parikhedaparitrAsAjjAlasyAkarShaNena cha |
matsyA babhUvurvyApannAH sthalasa~NkarShaNena cha
shlokas.22:
sa munistattadA dRRiShTvA matsyAnAM kadanaM kRRitam |
babhUva kRRipayAviShTo niHshvasa.nshcha punaH punaH
shlokas.23:
niShAdA UchuH||
aj~nAnAdyatkRRitaM pApaM prasAdaM tatra naH kuru |
karavAma priyaM kiM te tanno brUhi mahAmune
shlokas.24:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityukto matsyamadhyasthashchyavano vAkyamabravIt |
yo me.adya paramaH kAmastaM shRRiNudhvaM samAhitAH
shlokas.25:
prANotsargaM vikrayaM vA matsyairyAsyAmyahaM saha |
sa.nvAsAnnotsahe tyaktuM salilAdhyuShitAnimAn
shlokas.26:
ityuktAste niShAdAstu subhRRishaM bhayakampitAH |
sarve viShaNNavadanA nahuShAya nyavedayan

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nahuShastu tataH shrutvA chyavanaM taM tathAgatam |
tvaritaH prayayau tatra sahAmAtyapurohitaH
shlokas.2:
shauchaM kRRitvA yathAnyAyaM prA~njaliH prayato nRRipaH |
AtmAnamAchachakShe cha chyavanAya mahAtmane
shlokas.3:
archayAmAsa taM chApi tasya rAj~naH purohitaH |
satyavrataM mahAbhAgaM devakalpaM vishAM pate
shlokas.4:
nahuSha uvAcha||
karavANi priyaM kiM te tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi |
sarvaM kartAsmi bhagavanyadyapi syAtsuduShkaram
shlokas.5:
chyavana uvAcha||
shrameNa mahatA yuktAH kaivartA matsyajIvinaH |
mama mUlyaM prayachChaibhyo matsyAnAM vikrayaiH saha
shlokas.6:
nahuSha uvAcha||
sahasraM dIyatAM mUlyaM niShAdebhyaH purohita |
niShkrayArthaM bhagavato yathAha bhRRigunandanaH
shlokas.7:
chyavana uvAcha||
sahasraM nAhamarhAmi kiM vA tvaM manyase nRRipa |
sadRRishaM dIyatAM mUlyaM svabuddhyA nishchayaM kuru
shlokas.8:
nahuSha uvAcha||
sahasrANAM shataM kShipraM niShAdebhyaH pradIyatAm |
syAdetattu bhavenmUlyaM kiM vAnyanmanyate bhavAn
shlokas.9:
chyavana uvAcha||
nAhaM shatasahasreNa nimeyaH pArthivarShabha |
dIyatAM sadRRishaM mUlyamamAtyaiH saha chintaya
shlokas.10:
nahuSha uvAcha||
koTiH pradIyatAM mUlyaM niShAdebhyaH purohita |
yadetadapi naupamyamato bhUyaH pradIyatAm
shlokas.11:
chyavana uvAcha||
rAjannArhAmyahaM koTiM bhUyo vApi mahAdyute |
sadRRishaM dIyatAM mUlyaM brAhmaNaiH saha chintaya
shlokas.12:
nahuSha uvAcha||
ardharAjyaM samagraM vA niShAdebhyaH pradIyatAm |
etanmUlyamahaM manye kiM vAnyanmanyase dvija
shlokas.13:
chyavana uvAcha||
ardharAjyaM samagraM vA nAhamarhAmi pArthiva |
sadRRishaM dIyatAM mUlyamRRiShibhiH saha chintyatAm
shlokas.14:
bhIShma uvAcha||
maharShervachanaM shrutvA nahuSho duHkhakarshitaH |
sa chintayAmAsa tadA sahAmAtyapurohitaH
shlokas.15:
tatra tvanyo vanacharaH kashchinmUlaphalAshanaH |
nahuShasya samIpastho gavijAto.abhavanmuniH
shlokas.16:
sa samAbhAShya rAjAnamabravIddvijasattamaH |
toShayiShyAmyahaM vipraM yathA tuShTo bhaviShyati
shlokas.17:
nAhaM mithyAvacho brUyAM svaireShvapi kuto.anyathA |
bhavato yadahaM brUyAM tatkAryamavisha~NkayA
shlokas.18:
nahuSha uvAcha||
bravItu bhagavAnmUlyaM maharSheH sadRRishaM bhRRigoH |
paritrAyasva mAmasmAdviShayaM cha kulaM cha me
shlokas.19:
hanyAddhi bhagavAnkruddhastrailokyamapi kevalam |
kiM punarmAM tapohInaM bAhuvIryaparAyaNam
shlokas.20:
agAdhe.ambhasi magnasya sAmAtyasya sahartvijaH |
plavo bhava maharShe tvaM kuru mUlyavinishchayam
shlokas.21:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nahuShasya vachaH shrutvA gavijAtaH pratApavAn |
uvAcha harShayansarvAnamAtyAnpArthivaM cha tam
shlokas.22:
anargheyA mahArAja dvijA varNamahattamAH |
gAvashcha pRRithivIpAla gaurmUlyaM parikalpyatAm
shlokas.23:
nahuShastu tataH shrutvA maharShervachanaM nRRipa |
harSheNa mahatA yuktaH sahAmAtyapurohitaH
shlokas.24:
abhigamya bhRRigoH putraM chyavanaM sa.nshitavratam |
idaM provAcha nRRipate vAchA santarpayanniva
shlokas.25:
uttiShThottiShTha viprarShe gavA krIto.asi bhArgava |
etanmUlyamahaM manye tava dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.26:
chyavana uvAcha||
uttiShThAmyeSha rAjendra samyakkrIto.asmi te.anagha |
gobhistulyaM na pashyAmi dhanaM ki~nchidihAchyuta
shlokas.27:
kIrtanaM shravaNaM dAnaM darshanaM chApi pArthiva |
gavAM prashasyate vIra sarvapApaharaM shivam
shlokas.28:
gAvo lakShmyAH sadA mUlaM goShu pApmA na vidyate |
annameva sadA gAvo devAnAM paramaM haviH
shlokas.29:
svAhAkAravaShaTkArau goShu nityaM pratiShThitau |
gAvo yaj~napraNetryo vai tathA yaj~nasya tA mukham
shlokas.30:
amRRitaM hyakShayaM divyaM kSharanti cha vahanti cha |
amRRitAyatanaM chaitAH sarvalokanamaskRRitAH
shlokas.31:
tejasA vapuShA chaiva gAvo vahnisamA bhuvi |
gAvo hi sumahattejaH prANinAM cha sukhapradAH
shlokas.32:
niviShTaM gokulaM yatra shvAsaM mu~nchati nirbhayam |
virAjayati taM deshaM pApmAnaM chApakarShati
shlokas.33:
gAvaH svargasya sopAnaM gAvaH svarge.api pUjitAH |
gAvaH kAmadughA devyo nAnyatki~nchitparaM smRRitam
shlokas.34:
ityetadgoShu me proktaM mAhAtmyaM pArthivarShabha |
guNaikadeshavachanaM shakyaM pArAyaNaM na tu
shlokas.35:
niShAdA UchuH||
darshanaM kathanaM chaiva sahAsmAbhiH kRRitaM mune |
satAM saptapadaM mitraM prasAdaM naH kuru prabho
shlokas.36:
havIMShi sarvANi yathA hyupabhu~Nkte hutAshanaH |
evaM tvamapi dharmAtmanpuruShAgniH pratApavAn
shlokas.37:
prasAdayAmahe vidvanbhavantaM praNatA vayam |
anugrahArthamasmAkamiyaM gauH pratigRRihyatAm
shlokas.38:
chyavana uvAcha||
kRRipaNasya cha yachchakShurmunerAshIviShasya cha |
naraM samUlaM dahati kakShamagniriva jvalan
shlokas.39:
pratigRRihNAmi vo dhenuM kaivartA muktakilbiShAH |
divaM gachChata vai kShipraM matsyairjAloddhRRitaiH saha
shlokas.40:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatastasya prasAdAtte maharSherbhAvitAtmanaH |
niShAdAstena vAkyena saha matsyairdivaM yayuH
shlokas.41:
tataH sa rAjA nahuSho vismitaH prekShya dhIvarAn |
ArohamANA.nstridivaM matsyA.nshcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.42:
tatastau gavijashchaiva chyavanashcha bhRRigUdvahaH |
varAbhyAmanurUpAbhyAM ChandayAmAsaturnRRipam
shlokas.43:
tato rAjA mahAvIryo nahuShaH pRRithivIpatiH |
paramityabravItprItastadA bharatasattama
shlokas.44:
tato jagrAha dharme sa sthitimindranibho nRRipaH |
tatheti choditaH prItastAvRRiShI pratyapUjayat
shlokas.45:
samAptadIkShashchyavanastato.agachChatsvamAshramam |
gavijashcha mahAtejAH svamAshramapadaM yayau
shlokas.46:
niShAdAshcha divaM jagmuste cha matsyA janAdhipa |
nahuSho.api varaM labdhvA pravivesha puraM svakam
shlokas.47:
etatte kathitaM tAta yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
darshane yAdRRishaH snehaH sa.nvAse cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.48:
mahAbhAgyaM gavAM chaiva tathA dharmavinishchayam |
kiM bhUyaH kathyatAM vIra kiM te hRRidi vivakShitam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sa.nshayo me mahAprAj~na sumahAnsAgaropamaH |
tanme shRRiNu mahAbAho shrutvA chAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.2:
kautUhalaM me sumahajjAmadagnyaM prati prabho |
rAmaM dharmabhRRitAM shreShThaM tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.3:
kathameSha samutpanno rAmaH satyaparAkramaH |
kathaM brahmarShiva.nshe cha kShatradharmA vyajAyata
shlokas.4:
tadasya sambhavaM rAjannikhilenAnukIrtaya |
kaushikAchcha kathaM va.nshAtkShatrAdvai brAhmaNo.abhavat
shlokas.5:
aho prabhAvaH sumahAnAsIdvai sumahAtmanoH |
rAmasya cha naravyAghra vishvAmitrasya chaiva ha
shlokas.6:
kathaM putrAnatikramya teShAM naptRRiShvathAbhavat |
eSha doShaH sutAnhitvA tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
chyavanasya cha sa.nvAdaM kushikasya cha bhArata
shlokas.8:
etaM doShaM purA dRRiShTvA bhArgavashchyavanastadA |
AgAminaM mahAbuddhiH svava.nshe munipu~NgavaH
shlokas.9:
sa~nchintya manasA sarvaM guNadoShabalAbalam |
dagdhukAmaH kulaM sarvaM kushikAnAM tapodhanaH
shlokas.10:
chyavanastamanuprApya kushikaM vAkyamabravIt |
vastumichChA samutpannA tvayA saha mamAnagha
shlokas.11:
kushika uvAcha||
bhagavansahadharmo.ayaM paNDitairiha dhAryate |
pradAnakAle kanyAnAmuchyate cha sadA budhaiH
shlokas.12:
yattu tAvadatikrAntaM dharmadvAraM tapodhana |
tatkAryaM prakariShyAmi tadanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
athAsanamupAdAya chyavanasya mahAmuneH |
kushiko bhAryayA sArdhamAjagAma yato muniH
shlokas.14:
pragRRihya rAjA bhRRi~NgAraM pAdyamasmai nyavedayat |
kArayAmAsa sarvAshcha kriyAstasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
tataH sa rAjA chyavanaM madhuparkaM yathAvidhi |
pratyagrAhayadavyagro mahAtmA niyatavrataH
shlokas.16:
satkRRitya sa tathA vipramidaM vachanamabravIt |
bhagavanparavantau svo brUhi kiM karavAvahe
shlokas.17:
yadi rAjyaM yadi dhanaM yadi gAH sa.nshitavrata |
yaj~nadAnAni cha tathA brUhi sarvaM dadAmi te
shlokas.18:
idaM gRRihamidaM rAjyamidaM dharmAsanaM cha te |
rAjA tvamasi shAdhyurvIM bhRRityo.ahaM paravA.nstvayi
shlokas.19:
evamukte tato vAkye chyavano bhArgavastadA |
kushikaM pratyuvAchedaM mudA paramayA yutaH
shlokas.20:
na rAjyaM kAmaye rAjanna dhanaM na cha yoShitaH |
na cha gA na cha te deshAnna yaj~nA~nshrUyatAmidam
shlokas.21:
niyamaM ka~nchidArapsye yuvayoryadi rochate |
paricharyo.asmi yattAbhyAM yuvAbhyAmavisha~NkayA
shlokas.22:
evamukte tadA tena dampatI tau jaharShatuH |
pratyabrUtAM cha tamRRiShimevamastviti bhArata
shlokas.23:
atha taM kushiko hRRiShTaH prAveshayadanuttamam |
gRRihoddeshaM tatastatra darshanIyamadarshayat
shlokas.24:
iyaM shayyA bhagavato yathAkAmamihoShyatAm |
prayatiShyAvahe prItimAhartuM te tapodhana
shlokas.25:
atha sUryo.atichakrAma teShAM sa.nvadatAM tathA |
atharShishchodayAmAsa pAnamannaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.26:
tamapRRichChattato rAjA kushikaH praNatastadA |
kimannajAtamiShTaM te kimupasthApayAmyaham
shlokas.27:
tataH sa parayA prItyA pratyuvAcha janAdhipam |
aupapattikamAhAraM prayachChasveti bhArata
shlokas.28:
tadvachaH pUjayitvA tu tathetyAha sa pArthivaH |
yathopapannaM chAhAraM tasmai prAdAjjanAdhipaH
shlokas.29:
tataH sa bhagavAnbhuktvA dampatI prAha dharmavit |
svaptumichChAmyahaM nidrA bAdhate mAmiti prabho
shlokas.30:
tataH shayyAgRRihaM prApya bhagavAnRRiShisattamaH |
sa.nvivesha narendrastu sapatnIkaH sthito.abhavat
shlokas.31:
na prabodhyo.asmi sa.nsupta ityuvAchAtha bhArgavaH |
sa.nvAhitavyau pAdau me jAgartavyaM cha vAM nishi
shlokas.32:
avisha~Nkashcha kushikastathetyAha sa dharmavit |
na prabodhayatAM taM cha tau tadA rajanIkShaye
shlokas.33:
yathAdeshaM maharShestu shushrUShAparamau tadA |
babhUvaturmahArAja prayatAvatha dampatI
shlokas.34:
tataH sa bhagavAnvipraH samAdishya narAdhipam |
suShvApaikena pArshvena divasAnekavi.nshatim
shlokas.35:
sa tu rAjA nirAhAraH sabhAryaH kurunandana |
paryupAsata taM hRRiShTashchyavanArAdhane rataH
shlokas.36:
bhArgavastu samuttasthau svayameva tapodhanaH |
aki~nchiduktvA tu gRRihAnnishchakrAma mahAtapAH
shlokas.37:
tamanvagachChatAM tau tu kShudhitau shramakarshitau |
bhAryApatI munishreShTho na cha tAvavalokayat
shlokas.38:
tayostu prekShatoreva bhArgavANAM kulodvahaH |
antarhito.abhUdrAjendra tato rAjApatatkShitau
shlokas.39:
sa muhUrtaM samAshvasya saha devyA mahAdyutiH |
punaranveShaNe yatnamakarotparamaM tadA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tasminnantarhite vipre rAjA kimakarottadA |
bhAryA chAsya mahAbhAgA tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
adRRiShTvA sa mahIpAlastamRRiShiM saha bhAryayA |
parishrAnto nivavRRite vrIDito naShTachetanaH
shlokas.3:
sa pravishya purIM dIno nAbhyabhAShata ki~nchana |
tadeva chintayAmAsa chyavanasya vicheShTitam
shlokas.4:
atha shUnyena manasA pravivesha gRRihaM nRRipaH |
dadarsha shayane tasmi~nshayAnaM bhRRigunandanam
shlokas.5:
vismitau tau tu dRRiShTvA taM tadAshcharyaM vichintya cha |
darshanAttasya cha munervishrAntau sambabhUvatuH
shlokas.6:
yathAsthAnaM tu tau sthitvA bhUyastaM sa.nvavAhatuH |
athApareNa pArshvena suShvApa sa mahAmuniH
shlokas.7:
tenaiva cha sa kAlena pratyabudhyata vIryavAn |
na cha tau chakratuH ki~nchidvikAraM bhayasha~Nkitau
shlokas.8:
pratibuddhastu sa munistau provAcha vishAM pate |
tailAbhya~Ngo dIyatAM me snAsye.ahamiti bhArata
shlokas.9:
tatheti tau pratishrutya kShudhitau shramakarshitau |
shatapAkena tailena mahArheNopatasthatuH
shlokas.10:
tataH sukhAsInamRRiShiM vAgyatau sa.nvavAhatuH |
na cha paryAptamityAha bhArgavaH sumahAtapAH
shlokas.11:
yadA tau nirvikArau tu lakShayAmAsa bhArgavaH |
tata utthAya sahasA snAnashAlAM vivesha ha
kL^iptameva tu tatrAsItsnAnIyaM pArthivochitam
shlokas.12:
asatkRRitya tu tatsarvaM tatraivAntaradhIyata |
sa muniH punarevAtha nRRipateH pashyatastadA
nAsUyAM chakratustau cha dampatI bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
atha snAtaH sa bhagavAnsiMhAsanagataH prabhuH |
darshayAmAsa kushikaM sabhAryaM bhRRigunandanaH
shlokas.14:
saMhRRiShTavadano rAjA sabhAryaH kushiko munim |
siddhamannamiti prahvo nirvikAro nyavedayat
shlokas.15:
AnIyatAmiti munistaM chovAcha narAdhipam |
rAjA cha samupAjahre tadannaM saha bhAryayA
shlokas.16:
mA.nsaprakArAnvividhA~nshAkAni vividhAni cha |
vesavAravikArA.nshcha pAnakAni laghUni cha
shlokas.17:
rasAlApUpakA.nshchitrAnmodakAnatha ShADavAn |
rasAnnAnAprakArA.nshcha vanyaM cha munibhojanam
shlokas.18:
phalAni cha vichitrANi tathA bhojyAni bhUrishaH |
badare~NgudakAshmaryabhallAtakavaTAni cha
shlokas.19:
gRRihasthAnAM cha yadbhojyaM yachchApi vanavAsinAm |
sarvamAhArayAmAsa rAjA shApabhayAnmuneH
shlokas.20:
atha sarvamupanyastamagratashchyavanasya tat |
tataH sarvaM samAnIya tachcha shayyAsanaM muniH
shlokas.21:
vastraiH shubhairavachChAdya bhojanopaskaraiH saha |
sarvamAdIpayAmAsa chyavano bhRRigunandanaH
shlokas.22:
na cha tau chakratuH kopaM dampatI sumahAvratau |
tayoH samprekShatoreva punarantarhito.abhavat
shlokas.23:
tatraiva cha sa rAjarShistasthau tAM rajanIM tadA |
sabhAryo vAgyataH shrImAnna cha taM kopa Avishat
shlokas.24:
nityaM sa.nskRRitamannaM tu vividhaM rAjaveshmani |
shayanAni cha mukhyAni pariShekAshcha puShkalAH
shlokas.25:
vastraM cha vividhAkAramabhavatsamupArjitam |
na shashAka tato draShTumantaraM chyavanastadA
shlokas.26:
punareva cha viprarShiH provAcha kushikaM nRRipam |
sabhAryo mAM rathenAshu vaha yatra bravImyaham
shlokas.27:
tatheti cha prAha nRRipo nirvisha~Nkastapodhanam |
krIDAratho.astu bhagavannuta sA~NgrAmiko rathaH
shlokas.28:
ityuktaH sa munistena rAj~nA hRRiShTena tadvachaH |
chyavanaH pratyuvAchedaM hRRiShTaH parapura~njayam
shlokas.29:
sajjIkuru rathaM kShipraM yaste sA~NgrAmiko mataH |
sAyudhaH sapatAkashcha sashaktiH kaNayaShTimAn
shlokas.30:
ki~NkiNIshatanirghoSho yuktastomarakalpanaiH |
gadAkhaDganibaddhashcha parameShushatAnvitaH
shlokas.31:
tataH sa taM tathetyuktvA kalpayitvA mahAratham |
bhAryAM vAme dhuri tadA chAtmAnaM dakShiNe tathA
shlokas.32:
tridaMShTraM vajrasUchyagraM pratodaM tatra chAdadhat |
sarvametattato dattvA nRRipo vAkyamathAbravIt
shlokas.33:
bhagavankva ratho yAtu bravItu bhRRigunandanaH |
yatra vakShyasi viprarShe tatra yAsyati te rathaH
shlokas.34:
evamuktastu bhagavAnpratyuvAchAtha taM nRRipam |
itaHprabhRRiti yAtavyaM padakaM padakaM shanaiH
shlokas.35:
shramo mama yathA na syAttathA me ChandachAriNau |
sukhaM chaivAsmi voDhavyo janaH sarvashcha pashyatu
shlokas.36:
notsAryaH pathikaH kashchittebhyo dAsyAmyahaM vasu |
brAhmaNebhyashcha ye kAmAnarthayiShyanti mAM pathi
shlokas.37:
sarvaM dAsyAmyasheSheNa dhanaM ratnAni chaiva hi |
kriyatAM nikhilenaitanmA vichAraya pArthiva
shlokas.38:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA rAjA bhRRityAnathAbravIt |
yadyadbrUyAnmunistattatsarvaM deyamasha~NkitaiH
shlokas.39:
tato ratnAnyanekAni striyo yugyamajAvikam |
kRRitAkRRitaM cha kanakaM gajendrAshchAchalopamAH
shlokas.40:
anvagachChanta tamRRiShiM rAjAmAtyAshcha sarvashaH |
hAhAbhUtaM cha tatsarvamAsInnagaramArtimat
shlokas.41:
tau tIkShNAgreNa sahasA pratodena prachoditau |
pRRiShThe viddhau kaTe chaiva nirvikArau tamUhatuH
shlokas.42:
vepamAnau virAhArau pa~nchAshadrAtrakarshitau |
katha~nchidUhaturvIrau dampatI taM rathottamam
shlokas.43:
bahusho bhRRishaviddhau tau kSharamANau kShatodbhavam |
dadRRishAte mahArAja puShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.44:
tau dRRiShTvA pauravargastu bhRRishaM shokaparAyaNaH |
abhishApabhayAttrasto na cha ki~nchiduvAcha ha
shlokas.45:
dvandvashashchAbruvansarve pashyadhvaM tapaso balam |
kruddhA api munishreShThaM vIkShituM naiva shaknumaH
shlokas.46:
aho bhagavato vIryaM maharSherbhAvitAtmanaH |
rAj~nashchApi sabhAryasya dhairyaM pashyata yAdRRisham
shlokas.47:
shrAntAvapi hi kRRichChreNa rathametaM samUhatuH |
na chaitayorvikAraM vai dadarsha bhRRigunandanaH
shlokas.48:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH sa nirvikArau tau dRRiShTvA bhRRigukulodvahaH |
vasu vishrANayAmAsa yathA vaishravaNastathA
shlokas.49:
tatrApi rAjA prItAtmA yathAj~naptamathAkarot |
tato.asya bhagavAnprIto babhUva munisattamaH
shlokas.50:
avatIrya rathashreShThAddampatI tau mumocha ha |
vimochya chaitau vidhivattato vAkyamuvAcha ha
shlokas.51:
snigdhagambhIrayA vAchA bhArgavaH suprasannayA |
dadAni vAM varaM shreShThaM tadbrUtAmiti bhArata
shlokas.52:
sukumArau cha tau vidvAnkarAbhyAM munisattamaH |
pasparshAmRRitakalpAbhyAM snehAdbharatasattama
shlokas.53:
athAbravInnRRipo vAkyaM shramo nAstyAvayoriha |
vishrAntau svaH prabhAvAtte dhyAnenaiveti bhArgava
shlokas.54:
atha tau bhagavAnprAha prahRRiShTashchyavanastadA |
na vRRithA vyAhRRitaM pUrvaM yanmayA tadbhaviShyati
shlokas.55:
ramaNIyaH samuddesho ga~NgAtIramidaM shubham |
ka~nchitkAlaM vrataparo nivatsyAmIha pArthiva
shlokas.56:
gamyatAM svapuraM putra vishrAntaH punareShyasi |
ihasthaM mAM sabhAryastvaM draShTAsi shvo narAdhipa
shlokas.57:
na cha manyustvayA kAryaH shreyaste samupasthitam |
yatkA~NkShitaM hRRidisthaM te tatsarvaM sambhaviShyati
shlokas.58:
ityevamuktaH kushikaH prahRRiShTenAntarAtmanA |
provAcha munishArdUlamidaM vachanamarthavat
shlokas.59:
na me manyurmahAbhAga pUto.asmi bhagava.nstvayA |
sa.nvRRittau yauvanasthau svo vapuShmantau balAnvitau
shlokas.60:
pratodena vraNA ye me sabhAryasya kRRitAstvayA |
tAnna pashyAmi gAtreShu svastho.asmi saha bhAryayA
shlokas.61:
imAM cha devIM pashyAmi mune divyApsaropamAm |
shriyA paramayA yuktAM yathAdRRiShTAM mayA purA
shlokas.62:
tava prasAdAtsa.nvRRittamidaM sarvaM mahAmune |
naitachchitraM tu bhagava.nstvayi satyaparAkrama
shlokas.63:
ityuktaH pratyuvAchedaM chyavanaH kushikaM tadA |
AgachChethAH sabhAryashcha tvamiheti narAdhipa
shlokas.64:
ityuktaH samanuj~nAto rAjarShirabhivAdya tam |
prayayau vapuShA yukto nagaraM devarAjavat
shlokas.65:
tata enamupAjagmuramAtyAH sapurohitAH |
balasthA gaNikAyuktAH sarvAH prakRRitayastathA
shlokas.66:
tairvRRitaH kushiko rAjA shriyA paramayA jvalan |
pravivesha puraM hRRiShTaH pUjyamAno.atha bandibhiH
shlokas.67:
tataH pravishya nagaraM kRRitvA sarvAhNikakriyAH |
bhuktvA sabhAryo rajanImuvAsa sa mahIpatiH
shlokas.68:
tatastu tau navamabhivIkShya yauvanaM; parasparaM vigatajarAvivAmarau |
nanandatuH shayanagatau vapurdharau; shriyA yutau dvijavaradattayA tayA
shlokas.69:
sa chApyRRiShirbhRRigukulakIrtivardhana;stapodhano vanamabhirAmamRRiddhimat |
manIShayA bahuvidharatnabhUShitaM; sasarja yannAsti shatakratorapi

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH sa rAjA rAtryante pratibuddho mahAmanAH |
kRRitapUrvAhNikaH prAyAtsabhAryastadvanaM prati
shlokas.2:
tato dadarsha nRRipatiH prAsAdaM sarvakA~nchanam |
maNistambhasahasrADhyaM gandharvanagaropamam
tatra divyAnabhiprAyAndadarsha kushikastadA
shlokas.3:
parvatAnramyasAnU.nshcha nalinIshcha sapa~NkajAH |
chitrashAlAshcha vividhAstoraNAni cha bhArata
shAdvalopachitAM bhUmiM tathA kA~nchanakuTTimAm
shlokas.4:
sahakArAnpraphullA.nshcha ketakoddAlakAndhavAn |
ashokAnmuchukundA.nshcha phullA.nshchaivAtimuktakAn
shlokas.5:
champakA.nstilakAnbhavyAnpanasAnva~njulAnapi |
puShpitAnkarNikArA.nshcha tatra tatra dadarsha ha
shlokas.6:
shyAmAM vAraNapuShpIM cha tathAShTApadikAM latAm |
tatra tatra parikL^iptA dadarsha sa mahIpatiH
shlokas.7:
vRRikShAnpadmotpaladharAnsarvartukusumA.nstathA |
vimAnachChandakA.nshchApi prAsAdAnpadmasaMnibhAn
shlokas.8:
shItalAni cha toyAni kvachiduShNAni bhArata |
AsanAni vichitrANi shayanapravarANi cha
shlokas.9:
parya~NkAnsarvasauvarNAnparArdhyAstaraNAstRRitAn |
bhakShyabhojyamanantaM cha tatra tatropakalpitam
shlokas.10:
vANIvAdA~nChukA.nshchApi shArikAbhRRi~NgarAjakAn |
kokilA~nChatapatrA.nshcha koyaShTimakakukkuTAn
shlokas.11:
mayUrAnkukkuTA.nshchApi putrakA~njIvajIvakAn |
chakorAnvAnarAnha.nsAnsArasA.nshchakrasAhvayAn
shlokas.12:
samantataH praNaditAndadarsha sumanoharAn |
kvachidapsarasAM sa~NghAngandharvANAM cha pArthiva
shlokas.13:
kAntAbhiraparA.nstatra pariShvaktAndadarsha ha |
na dadarsha cha tAnbhUyo dadarsha cha punarnRRipaH
shlokas.14:
gItadhvaniM sumadhuraM tathaivAdhyayanadhvanim |
ha.nsAnsumadhurA.nshchApi tatra shushrAva pArthivaH
shlokas.15:
taM dRRiShTvAtyadbhutaM rAjA manasAchintayattadA |
svapno.ayaM chittavibhra.nsha utAho satyameva tu
shlokas.16:
aho saha sharIreNa prApto.asmi paramAM gatim |
uttarAnvA kurUnpuNyAnatha vApyamarAvatIm
shlokas.17:
kiM tvidaM mahadAshcharyaM sampashyAmItyachintayat |
evaM sa~nchintayanneva dadarsha munipu~Ngavam
shlokas.18:
tasminvimAne sauvarNe maNistambhasamAkule |
mahArhe shayane divye shayAnaM bhRRigunandanam
shlokas.19:
tamabhyayAtpraharSheNa narendraH saha bhAryayA |
antarhitastato bhUyashchyavanaH shayanaM cha tat
shlokas.20:
tato.anyasminvanoddeshe punareva dadarsha tam |
kaushyAM bRRisyAM samAsInaM japamAnaM mahAvratam
evaM yogabalAdvipro mohayAmAsa pArthivam
shlokas.21:
kShaNena tadvanaM chaiva te chaivApsarasAM gaNAH |
gandharvAH pAdapAshchaiva sarvamantaradhIyata
shlokas.22:
niHshabdamabhavachchApi ga~NgAkUlaM punarnRRipa |
kushavalmIkabhUyiShThaM babhUva cha yathA purA
shlokas.23:
tataH sa rAjA kushikaH sabhAryastena karmaNA |
vismayaM paramaM prAptastaddRRiShTvA mahadadbhutam
shlokas.24:
tataH provAcha kushiko bhAryAM harShasamanvitaH |
pashya bhadre yathA bhAvAshchitrA dRRiShTAH sudurlabhAH
shlokas.25:
prasAdAdbhRRigumukhyasya kimanyatra tapobalAt |
tapasA tadavApyaM hi yanna shakyaM manorathaiH
shlokas.26:
trailokyarAjyAdapi hi tapa eva vishiShyate |
tapasA hi sutaptena krIDatyeSha tapodhanaH
shlokas.27:
aho prabhAvo brahmarSheshchyavanasya mahAtmanaH |
ichChanneSha tapovIryAdanyA.NllokAnsRRijedapi
shlokas.28:
brAhmaNA eva jAyeranpuNyavAgbuddhikarmaNaH |
utsahediha kartuM hi ko.anyo vai chyavanAdRRite
shlokas.29:
brAhmaNyaM durlabhaM loke rAjyaM hi sulabhaM naraiH |
brAhmaNyasya prabhAvAddhi rathe yuktau svadhuryavat
shlokas.30:
ityevaM chintayAnaH sa viditashchyavanasya vai |
samprekShyovAcha sa nRRipaM kShipramAgamyatAmiti
shlokas.31:
ityuktaH sahabhAryastamabhyagachChanmahAmunim |
shirasA vandanIyaM tamavandata sa pArthivaH
shlokas.32:
tasyAshiShaH prayujyAtha sa munistaM narAdhipam |
niShIdetyabravIddhImAnsAntvayanpuruSharShabha
shlokas.33:
tataH prakRRitimApanno bhArgavo nRRipate nRRipam |
uvAcha shlakShNayA vAchA tarpayanniva bhArata
shlokas.34:
rAjansamyagjitAnIha pa~ncha pa~nchasu yattvayA |
manaHShaShThAnIndriyANi kRRichChrAnmukto.asi tena vai
shlokas.35:
samyagArAdhitaH putra tvayAhaM vadatAM vara |
na hi te vRRijinaM ki~nchitsusUkShmamapi vidyate
shlokas.36:
anujAnIhi mAM rAjangamiShyAmi yathAgatam |
prIto.asmi tava rAjendra varashcha pratigRRihyatAm
shlokas.37:
kushika uvAcha||
agnimadhyagatenedaM bhagavansaMnidhau mayA |
vartitaM bhRRigushArdUla yanna dagdho.asmi tadbahu
shlokas.38:
eSha eva varo mukhyaH prApto me bhRRigunandana |
yatprIto.asi samAchArAtkulaM pUtaM mamAnagha
shlokas.39:
eSha me.anugraho vipra jIvite cha prayojanam |
etadrAjyaphalaM chaiva tapashchaitatparaM mama
shlokas.40:
yadi tu prItimAnvipra mayi tvaM bhRRigunandana |
asti me sa.nshayaH kashchittanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi

shlokas.1:
chyavana uvAcha||
varashcha gRRihyatAM matto yashcha te sa.nshayo hRRidi |
taM cha brUhi narashreShTha sarvaM sampAdayAmi te
shlokas.2:
kushika uvAcha||
yadi prIto.asi bhagava.nstato me vada bhArgava |
kAraNaM shrotumichChAmi madgRRihe vAsakAritam
shlokas.3:
shayanaM chaikapArshvena divasAnekavi.nshatim |
aki~nchiduktvA gamanaM bahishcha munipu~Ngava
shlokas.4:
antardhAnamakasmAchcha punareva cha darshanam |
punashcha shayanaM vipra divasAnekavi.nshatim
shlokas.5:
tailAbhyaktasya gamanaM bhojanaM cha gRRihe mama |
samupAnIya vividhaM yaddagdhaM jAtavedasA
niryANaM cha rathenAshu sahasA yatkRRitaM tvayA
shlokas.6:
dhanAnAM cha visargasya vanasyApi cha darshanam |
prAsAdAnAM bahUnAM cha kA~nchanAnAM mahAmune
shlokas.7:
maNividrumapAdAnAM parya~NkAnAM cha darshanam |
punashchAdarshanaM tasya shrotumichChAmi kAraNam
shlokas.8:
atIva hyatra muhyAmi chintayAno divAnisham |
na chaivAtrAdhigachChAmi sarvasyAsya vinishchayam
etadichChAmi kArtsnyena satyaM shrotuM tapodhana
shlokas.9:
chyavana uvAcha||
shRRiNu sarvamasheSheNa yadidaM yena hetunA |
na hi shakyamanAkhyAtumevaM pRRiShTena pArthiva
shlokas.10:
pitAmahasya vadataH purA devasamAgame |
shrutavAnasmi yadrAja.nstanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.11:
brahmakShatravirodhena bhavitA kulasa~NkaraH |
pautraste bhavitA rAja.nstejovIryasamanvitaH
shlokas.12:
tataH svakularakShArthamahaM tvA samupAgamam |
chikIrShankushikochChedaM sa.ndidhakShuH kulaM tava
shlokas.13:
tato.ahamAgamya purA tvAmavochaM mahIpate |
niyamaM ka~nchidArapsye shushrUShA kriyatAmiti
shlokas.14:
na cha te duShkRRitaM ki~nchidahamAsAdayaM gRRihe |
tena jIvasi rAjarShe na bhavethAstato.anyathA
shlokas.15:
etAM buddhiM samAsthAya divasAnekavi.nshatim |
supto.asmi yadi mAM kashchidbodhayediti pArthiva
shlokas.16:
yadA tvayA sabhAryeNa sa.nsupto na prabodhitaH |
ahaM tadaiva te prIto manasA rAjasattama
shlokas.17:
utthAya chAsmi niShkrAnto yadi mAM tvaM mahIpate |
pRRichCheH kva yAsyasItyevaM shapeyaM tvAmiti prabho
shlokas.18:
antarhitashchAsmi punaH punareva cha te gRRihe |
yogamAsthAya sa.nviShTo divasAnekavi.nshatim
shlokas.19:
kShudhito mAmasUyethAH shramAdveti narAdhipa |
etAM buddhiM samAsthAya karshitau vAM mayA kShudhA
shlokas.20:
na cha te.abhUtsusUkShmo.api manyurmanasi pArthiva |
sabhAryasya narashreShTha tena te prItimAnaham
shlokas.21:
bhojanaM cha samAnAyya yattadAdIpitaM mayA |
krudhyethA yadi mAtsaryAditi tanmarShitaM cha te
shlokas.22:
tato.ahaM rathamAruhya tvAmavochaM narAdhipa |
sabhAryo mAM vahasveti tachcha tvaM kRRitavA.nstathA
shlokas.23:
avisha~Nko narapate prIto.ahaM chApi tena te |
dhanotsarge.api cha kRRite na tvAM krodhaH pradharShayat
shlokas.24:
tataH prItena te rAjanpunaretatkRRitaM tava |
sabhAryasya vanaM bhUyastadviddhi manujAdhipa
shlokas.25:
prItyarthaM tava chaitanme svargasa.ndarshanaM kRRitam |
yatte vane.asminnRRipate dRRiShTaM divyaM nidarshanam
shlokas.26:
svargoddeshastvayA rAjansasharIreNa pArthiva |
muhUrtamanubhUto.asau sabhAryeNa nRRipottama
shlokas.27:
nidarshanArthaM tapaso dharmasya cha narAdhipa |
tatra yAsItspRRihA rAja.nstachchApi viditaM mama
shlokas.28:
brAhmaNyaM kA~NkShase hi tvaM tapashcha pRRithivIpate |
avamanya narendratvaM devendratvaM cha pArthiva
shlokas.29:
evametadyathAttha tvaM brAhmaNyaM tAta durlabham |
brAhmaNye sati charShitvamRRiShitve cha tapasvitA
shlokas.30:
bhaviShyatyeSha te kAmaH kushikAtkaushiko dvijaH |
tRRitIyaM puruShaM prApya brAhmaNatvaM gamiShyati
shlokas.31:
va.nshaste pArthivashreShTha bhRRigUNAmeva tejasA |
pautraste bhavitA vipra tapasvI pAvakadyutiH
shlokas.32:
yaH sa devamanuShyANAM bhayamutpAdayiShyati |
trayANAM chaiva lokAnAM satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.33:
varaM gRRihANa rAjarShe yaste manasi vartate |
tIrthayAtrAM gamiShyAmi purA kAlo.ativartate
shlokas.34:
kushika uvAcha||
eSha eva varo me.adya yattvaM prIto mahAmune |
bhavatvetadyathAttha tvaM tapaH pautre mamAnagha
brAhmaNyaM me kulasyAstu bhagavanneSha me varaH
shlokas.35:
punashchAkhyAtumichChAmi bhagavanvistareNa vai |
kathameShyati vipratvaM kulaM me bhRRigunandana
kashchAsau bhavitA bandhurmama kashchApi saMmataH

shlokas.1:
chyavana uvAcha||
avashyaM kathanIyaM me tavaitannarapu~Ngava |
yadarthaM tvAhamuchChettuM samprApto manujAdhipa
shlokas.2:
bhRRigUNAM kShatriyA yAjyA nityameva janAdhipa |
te cha bhedaM gamiShyanti daivayuktena hetunA
shlokas.3:
kShatriyAshcha bhRRigUnsarvAnvadhiShyanti narAdhipa |
A garbhAdanukRRintanto daivadaNDanipIDitAH
shlokas.4:
tata utpatsyate.asmAkaM kule gotravivardhanaH |
aurvo nAma mahAtejA jvalanArkasamadyutiH
shlokas.5:
sa trailokyavinAshAya kopAgniM janayiShyati |
mahIM saparvatavanAM yaH kariShyati bhasmasAt
shlokas.6:
ka~nchitkAlaM tu taM vahniM sa eva shamayiShyati |
samudre vaDavAvaktre prakShipya munisattamaH
shlokas.7:
putraM tasya mahAbhAgamRRichIkaM bhRRigunandanam |
sAkShAtkRRitsno dhanurvedaH samupasthAsyate.anagha
shlokas.8:
kShatriyANAmabhAvAya daivayuktena hetunA |
sa tu taM pratigRRihyaiva putre sa~NkrAmayiShyati
shlokas.9:
jamadagnau mahAbhAge tapasA bhAvitAtmani |
sa chApi bhRRigushArdUlastaM vedaM dhArayiShyati
shlokas.10:
kulAttu tava dharmAtmankanyAM so.adhigamiShyati |
udbhAvanArthaM bhavato va.nshasya nRRipasattama
shlokas.11:
gAdherduhitaraM prApya pautrIM tava mahAtapAH |
brAhmaNaM kShatradharmANaM rAmamutpAdayiShyati
shlokas.12:
kShatriyaM viprakarmANaM bRRihaspatimivaujasA |
vishvAmitraM tava kule gAdheH putraM sudhArmikam
tapasA mahatA yuktaM pradAsyati mahAdyute
shlokas.13:
striyau tu kAraNaM tatra parivarte bhaviShyataH |
pitAmahaniyogAdvai nAnyathaitadbhaviShyati
shlokas.14:
tRRitIye puruShe tubhyaM brAhmaNatvamupaiShyati |
bhavitA tvaM cha sambandhI bhRRigUNAM bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.15:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kushikastu munervAkyaM chyavanasya mahAtmanaH |
shrutvA hRRiShTo.abhavadrAjA vAkyaM chedamuvAcha ha
evamastviti dharmAtmA tadA bharatasattama
shlokas.16:
chyavanastu mahAtejAH punareva narAdhipam |
varArthaM chodayAmAsa tamuvAcha sa pArthivaH
shlokas.17:
bADhamevaM grahIShyAmi kAmaM tvatto mahAmune |
brahmabhUtaM kulaM me.astu dharme chAsya mano bhavet
shlokas.18:
evamuktastathetyevaM pratyuktvA chyavano muniH |
abhyanuj~nAya nRRipatiM tIrthayAtrAM yayau tadA
shlokas.19:
etatte kathitaM sarvamasheSheNa mayA nRRipa |
bhRRigUNAM kushikAnAM cha prati sambandhakAraNam
shlokas.20:
yathoktaM muninA chApi tathA tadabhavannRRipa |
janma rAmasya cha munervishvAmitrasya chaiva ha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
muhyAmIva nishamyAdya chintayAnaH punaH punaH |
hInAM pArthivasa~NghAtaiH shrImadbhiH pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.2:
prApya rAjyAni shatasho mahIM jitvApi bhArata |
koTishaH puruShAnhatvA paritapye pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
kA nu tAsAM varastrINAmavasthAdya bhaviShyati |
yA hInAH patibhiH putrairmAtulairbhrAtRRibhistathA
shlokas.4:
vayaM hi tAngurUnhatvA j~nAtI.nshcha suhRRido.api cha |
avAkShIrShAH patiShyAmo narake nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.5:
sharIraM yoktumichChAmi tapasogreNa bhArata |
upadiShTamihechChAmi tattvato.ahaM vishAM pate
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yudhiShThirasya tadvAkyaM shrutvA bhIShmo mahAmanAH |
parIkShya nipuNaM buddhyA yudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.7:
rahasyamadbhutaM chaiva shRRiNu vakShyAmi yattvayi |
yA gatiH prApyate yena pretyabhAveShu bhArata
shlokas.8:
tapasA prApyate svargastapasA prApyate yashaH |
AyuHprakarSho bhogAshcha labhyante tapasA vibho
shlokas.9:
j~nAnaM vij~nAnamArogyaM rUpaM sampattathaiva cha |
saubhAgyaM chaiva tapasA prApyate bharatarShabha
shlokas.10:
dhanaM prApnoti tapasA maunaM j~nAnaM prayachChati |
upabhogA.nstu dAnena brahmacharyeNa jIvitam
shlokas.11:
ahi.nsAyAH phalaM rUpaM dIkShAyA janma vai kule |
phalamUlAshinAM rAjyaM svargaH parNAshinAM bhavet
shlokas.12:
payobhakSho divaM yAti snAnena draviNAdhikaH |
gurushushrUShayA vidyA nityashrAddhena santatiH
shlokas.13:
gavADhyaH shAkadIkShAbhiH svargamAhustRRiNAshanAt |
striyastriShavaNasnAnAdvAyuM pItvA kratuM labhet
shlokas.14:
nityasnAyI bhaveddakShaH sandhye tu dve japandvijaH |
maruM sAdhayato rAjyaM nAkapRRiShThamanAshake
shlokas.15:
sthaNDile shayamAnAnAM gRRihANi shayanAni cha |
chIravalkalavAsobhirvAsA.nsyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.16:
shayyAsanAni yAnAni yogayukte tapodhane |
agnipraveshe niyataM brahmaloko vidhIyate
shlokas.17:
rasAnAM pratisaMhArAtsaubhAgyamiha vindati |
AmiShapratisaMhArAtprajAsyAyuShmatI bhavet
shlokas.18:
udavAsaM vasedyastu sa narAdhipatirbhavet |
satyavAdI narashreShTha daivataiH saha modate
shlokas.19:
kIrtirbhavati dAnena tathArogyamahi.nsayA |
dvijashushrUShayA rAjyaM dvijatvaM vApi puShkalam
shlokas.20:
pAnIyasya pradAnena kIrtirbhavati shAshvatI |
annapAnapradAnena tRRipyate kAmabhogataH
shlokas.21:
sAntvadaH sarvabhUtAnAM sarvashokairvimuchyate |
devashushrUShayA rAjyaM divyaM rUpaM niyachChati
shlokas.22:
dIpAlokapradAnena chakShuShmAnbhavate naraH |
prekShaNIyapradAnena smRRitiM medhAM cha vindati
shlokas.23:
gandhamAlyanivRRittyA tu kIrtirbhavati puShkalA |
keshashmashrUndhArayatAmagryA bhavati santatiH
shlokas.24:
upavAsaM cha dIkShAM cha abhiShekaM cha pArthiva |
kRRitvA dvAdasha varShANi vIrasthAnAdvishiShyate
shlokas.25:
dAsIdAsamala~NkArAnkShetrANi cha gRRihANi cha |
brahmadeyAM sutAM dattvA prApnoti manujarShabha
shlokas.26:
kratubhishchopavAsaishcha tridivaM yAti bhArata |
labhate cha chiraM sthAnaM balipuShpaprado naraH
shlokas.27:
suvarNashRRi~Ngaistu vibhUShitAnAM; gavAM sahasrasya naraH pradAtA |
prApnoti puNyaM divi devaloka;mityevamAhurmunidevasa~NghAH
shlokas.28:
prayachChate yaH kapilAM sachailAM; kA.nsyopadohAM kanakAgrashRRi~NgIm |
taistairguNaiH kAmadughAsya bhUtvA; naraM pradAtAramupaiti sA gauH
shlokas.29:
yAvanti lomAni bhavanti dhenvA;stAvatphalaM prApnute gopradAtA |
putrA.nshcha pautrA.nshcha kulaM cha sarva;mAsaptamaM tArayate paratra
shlokas.30:
sadakShiNAM kA~nchanachArushRRi~NgIM; kA.nsyopadohAM draviNottarIyAm |
dhenuM tilAnAM dadato dvijAya; lokA vasUnAM sulabhA bhavanti
shlokas.31:
svakarmabhirmAnavaM saMnibaddhaM; tIvrAndhakAre narake patantam |
mahArNave nauriva vAyuyuktA; dAnaM gavAM tArayate paratra
shlokas.32:
yo brahmadeyAM tu dadAti kanyAM; bhUmipradAnaM cha karoti vipre |
dadAti chAnnaM vidhivachcha yashcha; sa lokamApnoti pura.ndarasya
shlokas.33:
naiveshikaM sarvaguNopapannaM; dadAti vai yastu naro dvijAya |
svAdhyAyachAritraguNAnvitAya; tasyApi lokAH kuruShUttareShu
shlokas.34:
dhuryapradAnena gavAM tathAshvai;rlokAnavApnoti naro vasUnAm |
svargAya chAhurhi hiraNyadAnaM; tato vishiShTaM kanakapradAnam
shlokas.35:
ChatrapradAnena gRRihaM variShThaM; yAnaM tathopAnahasampradAne |
vastrapradAnena phalaM surUpaM; gandhapradAne surabhirnaraH syAt
shlokas.36:
puShpopagaM vAtha phalopagaM vA; yaH pAdapaM sparshayate dvijAya |
sa strIsamRRiddhaM bahuratnapUrNaM; labhatyayatnopagataM gRRihaM vai
shlokas.37:
bhakShAnnapAnIyarasapradAtA; sarvAnavApnoti rasAnprakAmam |
pratishrayAchChAdanasampradAtA; prApnoti tAneva na sa.nshayo.atra
shlokas.38:
sragdhUpagandhAnyanulepanAni; snAnAni mAlyAni cha mAnavo yaH |
dadyAddvijebhyaH sa bhavedaroga;stathAbhirUpashcha narendraloke
shlokas.39:
bIjairashUnyaM shayanairupetaM; dadyAdgRRihaM yaH puruSho dvijAya |
puNyAbhirAmaM bahuratnapUrNaM; labhatyadhiShThAnavaraM sa rAjan
shlokas.40:
sugandhachitrAstaraNopapannaM; dadyAnnaro yaH shayanaM dvijAya |
rUpAnvitAM pakShavatIM manoj~nAM; bhAryAmayatnopagatAM labhetsaH
shlokas.41:
pitAmahasyAnucharo vIrashAyI bhavennaraH |
nAdhikaM vidyate tasmAdityAhuH paramarShayaH
shlokas.42:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA prItAtmA kurunandanaH |
nAshrame.arochayadvAsaM vIramArgAbhikA~NkShayA
shlokas.43:
tato yudhiShThiraH prAha pANDavAnbharatarShabha |
pitAmahasya yadvAkyaM tadvo rochatviti prabhuH
shlokas.44:
tatastu pANDavAH sarve draupadI cha yashasvinI |
yudhiShThirasya tadvAkyaM bADhamityabhyapUjayan

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yAnImAni bahirvedyAM dAnAni parichakShate |
tebhyo vishiShTaM kiM dAnaM mataM te kurupu~Ngava
shlokas.2:
kautUhalaM hi paramaM tatra me vartate prabho |
dAtAraM dattamanveti yaddAnaM tatprachakShva me
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyo vyasane chApyanugraham |
yachchAbhilaShitaM dadyAttRRiShitAyAbhiyAchate
shlokas.4:
dattaM manyeta yaddattvA taddAnaM shreShThamuchyate |
dattaM dAtAramanveti yaddAnaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.5:
hiraNyadAnaM godAnaM pRRithivIdAnameva cha |
etAni vai pavitrANi tArayantyapi duShkRRitam
shlokas.6:
etAni puruShavyAghra sAdhubhyo dehi nityadA |
dAnAni hi naraM pApAnmokShayanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.7:
yadyadiShTatamaM loke yachchAsya dayitaM gRRihe |
tattadguNavate deyaM tadevAkShayamichChatA
shlokas.8:
priyANi labhate loke priyadaH priyakRRittathA |
priyo bhavati bhUtAnAmiha chaiva paratra cha
shlokas.9:
yAchamAnamabhImAnAdAshAvantamaki~nchanam |
yo nArchati yathAshakti sa nRRisha.nso yudhiShThira
shlokas.10:
amitramapi cheddInaM sharaNaiShiNamAgatam |
vyasane yo.anugRRihNAti sa vai puruShasattamaH
shlokas.11:
kRRishAya hrImate tAta vRRittikShINAya sIdate |
apahanyAtkShudhaM yastu na tena puruShaH samaH
shlokas.12:
hriyA tu niyatAnsAdhUnputradAraishcha karshitAn |
ayAchamAnAnkaunteya sarvopAyairnimantraya
shlokas.13:
AshiShaM ye na deveShu na martyeShu cha kurvate |
arhanto nityasattvasthA yathAlabdhopajIvinaH
shlokas.14:
AshIviShasamebhyashcha tebhyo rakShasva bhArata |
tAnyuktairupajij~nAsya tathA dvijavarottamAn
shlokas.15:
kRRitairAvasathairnityaM sapreShyaiH saparichChadaiH |
nimantrayethAH kauravya sarvakAmasukhAvahaiH
shlokas.16:
yadi te pratigRRihNIyuH shraddhApUtaM yudhiShThira |
kAryamityeva manvAnA dhArmikAH puNyakarmiNaH
shlokas.17:
vidyAsnAtA vratasnAtA ye vyapAshrityajIvinaH |
gUDhasvAdhyAyatapaso brAhmaNAH sa.nshitavratAH
shlokas.18:
teShu shuddheShu dAnteShu svadAranirateShu cha |
yatkariShyasi kalyANaM tattvA lokeShu dhAsyati
shlokas.19:
yathAgnihotraM suhutaM sAyaM prAtardvijAtinA |
tathA bhavati dattaM vai dvijebhyo.atha kRRitAtmanA
shlokas.20:
eSha te vitato yaj~naH shraddhApUtaH sadakShiNaH |
vishiShTaH sarvayaj~nebhyo dadatastAta vartatAm
shlokas.21:
nivApo dAnasadRRishastAdRRisheShu yudhiShThira |
nivapanpUjaya.nshchaiva teShvAnRRiNyaM nigachChati
shlokas.22:
ya eva no na kupyanti na lubhyanti tRRiNeShvapi |
ta eva naH pUjyatamA ye chAnye priyavAdinaH
shlokas.23:
ye no na bahu manyante na pravartanti chApare |
putravatparipAlyAste namastebhyastathAbhayam
shlokas.24:
RRitvikpurohitAchAryA mRRidubrahmadharA hi te |
kShatreNApi hi sa.nsRRiShTaM tejaH shAmyati vai dvije
shlokas.25:
asti me balavAnasmi rAjAsmIti yudhiShThira |
brAhmaNAnmA sma paryashnIrvAsobhirashanena cha
shlokas.26:
yachChobhArthaM balArthaM vA vittamasti tavAnagha |
tena te brAhmaNAH pUjyAH svadharmamanutiShThatA
shlokas.27:
namaskAryAstvayA viprA vartamAnA yathAtatham |
yathAsukhaM yathotsAhaM lalantu tvayi putravat
shlokas.28:
ko hyanyaH suprasAdAnAM suhRRidAmalpatoShiNAm |
vRRittimarhatyupakSheptuM tvadanyaH kurusattama
shlokas.29:
yathA patyAshrayo dharmaH strINAM loke sanAtanaH |
sa devaH sA gatirnAnyA tathAsmAkaM dvijAtayaH
shlokas.30:
yadi no brAhmaNAstAta santyajeyurapUjitAH |
pashyanto dAruNaM karma satataM kShatriye sthitam
shlokas.31:
avedAnAmakIrtInAmalokAnAmayajvanAm |
ko.asmAkaM jIvitenArthastaddhi no brAhmaNAshrayam
shlokas.32:
atra te vartayiShyAmi yathA dharmaH sanAtanaH |
rAjanyo brAhmaNaM rAjanpurA parichachAra ha
vaishyo rAjanyamityeva shUdro vaishyamiti shrutiH
shlokas.33:
dUrAchChUdreNopacharyo brAhmaNo.agniriva jvalan |
sa.nsparshaparicharyastu vaishyena kShatriyeNa cha
shlokas.34:
mRRidubhAvAnsatyashIlAnsatyadharmAnupAlakAn |
AshIviShAniva kruddhA.nstAnupAcharata dvijAn
shlokas.35:
apareShAM pareShAM cha parebhyashchaiva ye pare |
kShatriyANAM pratapatAM tejasA cha balena cha
brAhmaNeShveva shAmyanti tejA.nsi cha tapA.nsi cha
shlokas.36:
na me pitA priyataro na tvaM tAta tathA priyaH |
na me pituH pitA rAjanna chAtmA na cha jIvitam
shlokas.37:
tvattashcha me priyataraH pRRithivyAM nAsti kashchana |
tvatto.api me priyatarA brAhmaNA bharatarShabha
shlokas.38:
bravImi satyametachcha yathAhaM pANDunandana |
tena satyena gachCheyaM lokAnyatra sa shantanuH
shlokas.39:
pashyeyaM cha satAM lokA~nChuchInbrahmapuraskRRitAn |
tatra me tAta gantavyamahnAya cha chirAya cha
shlokas.40:
so.ahametAdRRishA.NllokAndRRiShTvA bharatasattama |
yanme kRRitaM brAhmaNeShu na tapye tena pArthiva

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yau tu syAtAM charaNenopapannau; yau vidyayA sadRRishau janmanA cha |
tAbhyAM dAnaM katarasmai vishiShTa;mayAchamAnAya cha yAchate cha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shreyo vai yAchataH pArtha dattamAhurayAchate |
arhattamo vai dhRRitimAnkRRipaNAdadhRRitAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
kShatriyo rakShaNadhRRitirbrAhmaNo.anarthanAdhRRitiH |
brAhmaNo dhRRitimAnvidvAndevAnprINAti tuShTimAn
shlokas.4:
yAch~nAmAhuranIshasya abhihAraM cha bhArata |
udvejayati yAchanhi sadA bhUtAni dasyuvat
shlokas.5:
mriyate yAchamAno vai tamanu mriyate dadat |
dadatsa~njIvayatyenamAtmAnaM cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.6:
AnRRisha.nsyaM paro dharmo yAchate yatpradIyate |
ayAchataH sIdamAnAnsarvopAyairnimantraya
shlokas.7:
yadi vai tAdRRishA rAShTre vaseyuste dvijottamAH |
bhasmachChannAnivAgnI.nstAnbudhyethAstvaM prayatnataH
shlokas.8:
tapasA dIpyamAnAste daheyuH pRRithivImapi |
pUjyA hi j~nAnavij~nAnatapoyogasamanvitAH
shlokas.9:
tebhyaH pUjAM prayu~njIthA brAhmaNebhyaH parantapa |
dadadbahuvidhAndAyAnupachChandAnayAchatAm
shlokas.10:
yadagnihotre suhute sAyamprAtarbhavetphalam |
vidyAvedavratavati taddAnaphalamuchyate
shlokas.11:
vidyAvedavratasnAtAnavyapAshrayajIvinaH |
gUDhasvAdhyAyatapaso brAhmaNAnsa.nshitavratAn
shlokas.12:
kRRitairAvasathairhRRidyaiH sapreShyaiH saparichChadaiH |
nimantrayethAH kaunteya kAmaishchAnyairdvijottamAn
shlokas.13:
api te pratigRRihNIyuH shraddhApUtaM yudhiShThira |
kAryamityeva manvAnA dharmaj~nAH sUkShmadarshinaH
shlokas.14:
api te brAhmaNA bhuktvA gatAH soddharaNAngRRihAn |
yeShAM dArAH pratIkShante parjanyamiva karShakAH
shlokas.15:
annAni prAtaHsavane niyatA brahmachAriNaH |
brAhmaNAstAta bhu~njAnAstretAgnInprINayantu te
shlokas.16:
mAdhya.ndinaM te savanaM dadatastAta vartatAm |
gA hiraNyAni vAsA.nsi tenendraH prIyatAM tava
shlokas.17:
tRRitIyaM savanaM tatte vaishvadevaM yudhiShThira |
yaddevebhyaH pitRRibhyashcha viprebhyashcha prayachChasi
shlokas.18:
ahi.nsA sarvabhUtebhyaH sa.nvibhAgashcha sarvashaH |
damastyAgo dhRRitiH satyaM bhavatvavabhRRithAya te
shlokas.19:
eSha te vitato yaj~naH shraddhApUtaH sadakShiNaH |
vishiShTaH sarvayaj~nebhyo nityaM tAta pravartatAm

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dAnaM yaj~nakriyA cheha kiM svitpretya mahAphalam |
kasya jyAyaH phalaM proktaM kIdRRishebhyaH kathaM kadA
shlokas.2:
etadichChAmi vij~nAtuM yAthAtathyena bhArata |
vidva~njij~nAsamAnAya dAnadharmAnprachakShva me
shlokas.3:
antarvedyAM cha yaddattaM shraddhayA chAnRRisha.nsyataH |
kiM svinniHshreyasaM tAta tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
raudraM karma kShatriyasya satataM tAta vartate |
tasya vaitAnikaM karma dAnaM chaiveha pAvanam
shlokas.5:
na tu pApakRRitAM rAj~nAM pratigRRihNanti sAdhavaH |
etasmAtkAraNAdyaj~nairyajedrAjAptadakShiNaiH
shlokas.6:
atha chetpratigRRihNIyurdadyAdaharaharnRRipaH |
shraddhAmAsthAya paramAM pAvanaM hyetaduttamam
shlokas.7:
brAhmaNA.nstarpayeddravyaistato yaj~ne yatavrataH |
maitrAnsAdhUnvedavidaH shIlavRRittataponvitAn
shlokas.8:
yatte tena kariShyanti kRRitaM tena bhaviShyati |
yaj~nAnsAdhaya sAdhubhyaH svAdvannAndakShiNAvataH
shlokas.9:
iShTaM dattaM cha manyethA AtmAnaM dAnakarmaNA |
pUjayethA yAyajUkA.nstavApya.nsho bhavedyathA
shlokas.10:
prajAvato bharethAshcha brAhmaNAnbahubhAriNaH |
prajAvA.nstena bhavati yathA janayitA tathA
shlokas.11:
yAvato vai sAdhudharmAnsantaH sa.nvartayantyuta |
sarve te chApi bhartavyA narA ye bahubhAriNaH
shlokas.12:
samRRiddhaH samprayachChasva brAhmaNebhyo yudhiShThira |
dhenUranaDuho.annAni chChatraM vAsA.nsyupAnahau
shlokas.13:
AjyAni yajamAnebhyastathAnnAdyAni bhArata |
ashvavanti cha yAnAni veshmAni shayanAni cha
shlokas.14:
ete deyA vyuShTimanto laghUpAyAshcha bhArata |
ajugupsA.nshcha vij~nAya brAhmaNAnvRRittikarshitAn
shlokas.15:
upachChannaM prakAshaM vA vRRittyA tAnpratipAdaya |
rAjasUyAshvamedhAbhyAM shreyastatkShatriyAnprati
shlokas.16:
evaM pApairvimuktastvaM pUtaH svargamavApsyasi |
sra.nsayitvA punaH koshaM yadrAShTraM pAlayiShyasi
shlokas.17:
tatashcha brahmabhUyastvamavApsyasi dhanAni cha |
Atmanashcha pareShAM cha vRRittiM sa.nrakSha bhArata
shlokas.18:
putravachchApi bhRRityAnsvAnprajAshcha paripAlaya |
yogakShemashcha te nityaM brAhmaNeShvastu bhArata
shlokas.19:
arakShitAraM hartAraM viloptAramadAyakam |
taM sma rAjakaliM hanyuH prajAH sambhUya nirghRRiNam
shlokas.20:
ahaM vo rakShitetyuktvA yo na rakShati bhUmipaH |
sa saMhatya nihantavyaH shveva sonmAda AturaH
shlokas.21:
pApaM kurvanti yatki~nchitprajA rAj~nA hyarakShitAH |
chaturthaM tasya pApasya rAjA bhArata vindati
shlokas.22:
apyAhuH sarvameveti bhUyo.ardhamiti nishchayaH |
chaturthaM matamasmAkaM manoH shrutvAnushAsanam
shlokas.23:
shubhaM vA yatprakurvanti prajA rAj~nA surakShitAH |
chaturthaM tasya puNyasya rAjA chApnoti bhArata
shlokas.24:
jIvantaM tvAnujIvantu prajAH sarvA yudhiShThira |
parjanyamiva bhUtAni mahAdrumamiva dvijAH
shlokas.25:
kuberamiva rakShA.nsi shatakratumivAmarAH |
j~nAtayastvAnujIvantu suhRRidashcha parantapa

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
idaM deyamidaM deyamitIyaM shrutichodanA |
bahudeyAshcha rAjAnaH kiM sviddeyamanuttamam
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ati dAnAni sarvANi pRRithivIdAnamuchyate |
achalA hyakShayA bhUmirdogdhrI kAmAnanuttamAn
shlokas.3:
dogdhrI vAsA.nsi ratnAni pashUnvrIhiyavA.nstathA |
bhUmidaH sarvabhUteShu shAshvatIredhate samAH
shlokas.4:
yAvadbhUmerAyuriha tAvadbhUmida edhate |
na bhUmidAnAdastIha paraM ki~nchidyudhiShThira
shlokas.5:
apyalpaM pradaduH pUrve pRRithivyA iti naH shrutam |
bhUmimete daduH sarve ye bhUmiM bhu~njate janAH
shlokas.6:
svakarmaivopajIvanti narA iha paratra cha |
bhUmirbhUtirmahAdevI dAtAraM kurute priyam
shlokas.7:
ya etAM dakShiNAM dadyAdakShayAM pRRithivIpatiH |
punarnaratvaM samprApya bhavetsa pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.8:
yathA dAnaM tathA bhoga iti dharmeShu nishchayaH |
sa~NgrAme vA tanuM jahyAddadyAdvA pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.9:
ityetAM kShatrabandhUnAM vadanti paramAshiSham |
punAti dattA pRRithivI dAtAramiti shushruma
shlokas.10:
api pApasamAchAraM brahmaghnamapi vAnRRitam |
saiva pApaM pAvayati saiva pApAtpramochayet
shlokas.11:
api pApakRRitAM rAj~nAM pratigRRihNanti sAdhavaH |
pRRithivIM nAnyadichChanti pAvanaM jananI yathA
shlokas.12:
nAmAsyAH priyadatteti guhyaM devyAH sanAtanam |
dAnaM vApyatha vA j~nAnaM nAmno.asyAH paramaM priyam
tasmAtprApyaiva pRRithivIM dadyAdviprAya pArthivaH
shlokas.13:
nAbhUmipatinA bhUmiradhiShTheyA katha~nchana |
na vA pAtreNa vA gUhedantardhAnena vA charet
ye chAnye bhUmimichCheyuH kuryurevamasa.nshayam
shlokas.14:
yaH sAdhorbhUmimAdatte na bhUmiM vindate tu saH |
bhUmiM tu dattvA sAdhubhyo vindate bhUmimeva hi
pretyeha cha sa dharmAtmA samprApnoti mahadyashaH
shlokas.15:
yasya viprAnushAsanti sAdhorbhUmiM sadaiva hi |
na tasya shatravo rAjanprashAsanti vasundharAm
shlokas.16:
yatki~nchitpuruShaH pApaM kurute vRRittikarshitaH |
api gocharmamAtreNa bhUmidAnena pUyate
shlokas.17:
ye.api sa~NkIrNakarmANo rAjAno raudrakarmiNaH |
tebhyaH pavitramAkhyeyaM bhUmidAnamanuttamam
shlokas.18:
alpAntaramidaM shashvatpurANA menire janAH |
yo yajedashvamedhena dadyAdvA sAdhave mahIm
shlokas.19:
api chetsukRRitaM kRRitvA sha~Nkerannapi paNDitAH |
ashakyamekamevaitadbhUmidAnamanuttamam
shlokas.20:
suvarNaM rajataM vastraM maNimuktAvasUni cha |
sarvametanmahAprAj~na dadAti vasudhAM dadat
shlokas.21:
tapo yaj~naH shrutaM shIlamalobhaH satyasandhatA |
gurudaivatapUjA cha nAtivartanti bhUmidam
shlokas.22:
bharturniHshreyase yuktAstyaktAtmAno raNe hatAH |
brahmalokagatAH siddhA nAtikrAmanti bhUmidam
shlokas.23:
yathA janitrI kShIreNa svaputraM bharate sadA |
anugRRihNAti dAtAraM tathA sarvarasairmahI
shlokas.24:
mRRityorvai ki~Nkaro daNDastApo vahneH sudAruNaH |
ghorAshcha vAruNAH pAshA nopasarpanti bhUmidam
shlokas.25:
pitR^I.nshcha pitRRilokasthAndevaloke cha devatAH |
santarpayati shAntAtmA yo dadAti vasundharAm
shlokas.26:
kRRishAya mriyamANAya vRRittimlAnAya sIdate |
bhUmiM vRRittikarIM dattvA satrI bhavati mAnavaH
shlokas.27:
yathA dhAvati gaurvatsaM kShIramabhyutsRRijantyuta |
evameva mahAbhAga bhUmirbhavati bhUmidam
shlokas.28:
halakRRiShTAM mahIM dattvA sabIjAM saphalAmapi |
udIrNaM vApi sharaNaM tathA bhavati kAmadaH
shlokas.29:
brAhmaNaM vRRittasampannamAhitAgniM shuchivratam |
naraH pratigrAhya mahIM na yAti yamasAdanam
shlokas.30:
yathA chandramaso vRRiddhirahanyahani jAyate |
tathA bhUmikRRitaM dAnaM sasye sasye vivardhate
shlokas.31:
atra gAthA bhUmigItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH |
yAH shrutvA jAmadagnyena dattA bhUH kAshyapAya vai
shlokas.32:
mAmevAdatta mAM datta mAM dattvA mAmavApsyatha |
asmi.Nlloke pare chaiva tatashchAjanane punaH
shlokas.33:
ya imAM vyAhRRitiM veda brAhmaNo brahmasa.nshritaH |
shrAddhasya hUyamAnasya brahmabhUyaM sa gachChati
shlokas.34:
kRRityAnAmabhishastAnAM duriShTashamanaM mahat |
prAyashchittamahaM kRRitvA punAtyubhayato dasha
shlokas.35:
punAti ya idaM veda veda chAhaM tathaiva cha |
prakRRitiH sarvabhUtAnAM bhUmirvai shAshvatI matA
shlokas.36:
abhiShichyaiva nRRipatiM shrAvayedimamAgamam |
yathA shrutvA mahIM dadyAnnAdadyAtsAdhutashcha tAm
shlokas.37:
so.ayaM kRRitsno brAhmaNArtho rAjArthashchApyasa.nshayam |
rAjA hi dharmakushalaH prathamaM bhUtilakShaNam
shlokas.38:
atha yeShAmadharmaj~no rAjA bhavati nAstikaH |
na te sukhaM prabudhyante na sukhaM prasvapanti cha
shlokas.39:
sadA bhavanti chodvignAstasya dushcharitairnarAH |
yogakShemA hi bahavo rAShTraM nAsyAvishanti tat
shlokas.40:
atha yeShAM punaH prAj~no rAjA bhavati dhArmikaH |
sukhaM te pratibudhyante susukhaM prasvapanti cha
shlokas.41:
tasya rAj~naH shubhairAryaiH karmabhirnirvRRitAH prajAH |
yogakShemeNa vRRiShTyA cha vivardhante svakarmabhiH
shlokas.42:
sa kulInaH sa puruShaH sa bandhuH sa cha puNyakRRit |
sa dAtA sa cha vikrAnto yo dadAti vasundharAm
shlokas.43:
AdityA iva dIpyante tejasA bhuvi mAnavAH |
dadanti vasudhAM sphItAM ye vedaviduShi dvije
shlokas.44:
yathA bIjAni rohanti prakIrNAni mahItale |
tathA kAmAH prarohanti bhUmidAnasamArjitAH
shlokas.45:
Adityo varuNo viShNurbrahmA somo hutAshanaH |
shUlapANishcha bhagavAnpratinandanti bhUmidam
shlokas.46:
bhUmau jAyanti puruShA bhUmau niShThAM vrajanti cha |
chaturvidho hi loko.ayaM yo.ayaM bhUmiguNAtmakaH
shlokas.47:
eShA mAtA pitA chaiva jagataH pRRithivIpate |
nAnayA sadRRishaM bhUtaM ki~nchidasti janAdhipa
shlokas.48:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
bRRihaspateshcha sa.nvAdamindrasya cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.49:
iShTvA kratushatenAtha mahatA dakShiNAvatA |
maghavA vAgvidAM shreShThaM paprachChedaM bRRihaspatim
shlokas.50:
bhagavankena dAnena svargataH sukhamedhate |
yadakShayaM mahArghaM cha tadbrUhi vadatAM vara
shlokas.51:
ityuktaH sa surendreNa tato devapurohitaH |
bRRihaspatirmahAtejAH pratyuvAcha shatakratum
shlokas.52:
suvarNadAnaM godAnaM bhUmidAnaM cha vRRitrahan |
dadadetAnmahAprAj~naH sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.53:
na bhUmidAnAddevendra paraM ki~nchiditi prabho |
vishiShTamiti manyAmi yathA prAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.54:
ye shUrA nihatA yuddhe svaryAtA dAnagRRiddhinaH |
sarve te vibudhashreShTha nAtikrAmanti bhUmidam
shlokas.55:
bharturniHshreyase yuktAstyaktAtmAno raNe hatAH |
brahmalokagatAH shUrA nAtikrAmanti bhUmidam
shlokas.56:
pa~ncha pUrvAdipuruShAH ShaTcha ye vasudhAM gatAH |
ekAdasha dadadbhUmiM paritrAtIha mAnavaH
shlokas.57:
ratnopakIrNAM vasudhAM yo dadAti pura.ndara |
sa muktaH sarvakaluShaiH svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.58:
mahIM sphItAM dadadrAjA sarvakAmaguNAnvitAm |
rAjAdhirAjo bhavati taddhi dAnamanuttamam
shlokas.59:
sarvakAmasamAyuktAM kAshyapIM yaH prayachChati |
sarvabhUtAni manyante mAM dadAtIti vAsava
shlokas.60:
sarvakAmadughAM dhenuM sarvakAmapurogamAm |
dadAti yaH sahasrAkSha sa svargaM yAti mAnavaH
shlokas.61:
madhusarpiHpravAhinyaH payodadhivahAstathA |
saritastarpayantIha surendra vasudhApradam
shlokas.62:
bhUmipradAnAnnRRipatirmuchyate rAjakilbiShAt |
na hi bhUmipradAnena dAnamanyadvishiShyate
shlokas.63:
dadAti yaH samudrAntAM pRRithivIM shastranirjitAm |
taM janAH kathayantIha yAvaddharati gauriyam
shlokas.64:
puNyAmRRiddharasAM bhUmiM yo dadAti pura.ndara |
na tasya lokAH kShIyante bhUmidAnaguNArjitAH
shlokas.65:
sarvathA pArthiveneha satataM bhUtimichChatA |
bhUrdeyA vidhivachChakra pAtre sukhamabhIpsatA
shlokas.66:
api kRRitvA naraH pApaM bhUmiM dattvA dvijAtaye |
samutsRRijati tatpApaM jIrNAM tvachamivoragaH
shlokas.67:
sAgarAnsaritaH shailAnkAnanAni cha sarvashaH |
sarvametannaraH shakra dadAti vasudhAM dadat
shlokas.68:
taDAgAnyudapAnAni srotA.nsi cha sarA.nsi cha |
snehAnsarvarasA.nshchaiva dadAti vasudhAM dadat
shlokas.69:
oShadhIH kShIrasampannA nagAnpuShpaphalAnvitAn |
kAnanopalashailA.nshcha dadAti vasudhAM dadat
shlokas.70:
agniShTomaprabhRRitibhiriShTvA cha svAptadakShiNaiH |
na tatphalamavApnoti bhUmidAnAdyadashnute
shlokas.71:
dAtA dashAnugRRihNAti dasha hanti tathA kShipan |
pUrvadattAM haranbhUmiM narakAyopagachChati
shlokas.72:
na dadAti pratishrutya dattvA vA harate tu yaH |
sa baddho vAruNaiH pAshaistapyate mRRityushAsanAt
shlokas.73:
AhitAgniM sadAyaj~naM kRRishabhRRityaM priyAtithim |
ye bharanti dvijashreShThaM nopasarpanti te yamam
shlokas.74:
brAhmaNeShvRRiNabhUtaM syAtpArthivasya pura.ndara |
itareShAM tu varNAnAM tArayetkRRishadurbalAn
shlokas.75:
nAchChindyAtsparshitAM bhUmiM pareNa tridashAdhipa |
brAhmaNAya surashreShTha kRRishabhRRityAya kashchana
shlokas.76:
athAshru patitaM teShAM dInAnAmavasIdatAm |
brAhmaNAnAM hRRite kShetre hanyAttripuruShaM kulam
shlokas.77:
bhUmipAlaM chyutaM rAShTrAdyastu sa.nsthApayetpunaH |
tasya vAsaH sahasrAkSha nAkapRRiShThe mahIyate
shlokas.78:
ikShubhiH santatAM bhUmiM yavagodhUmasa~NkulAm |
goshvavAhanasampUrNAM bAhuvIryasamArjitAm
shlokas.79:
nidhigarbhAM dadadbhUmiM sarvaratnaparichChadAm |
akShayA.Nllabhate lokAnbhUmisatraM hi tasya tat
shlokas.80:
vidhUya kaluShaM sarvaM virajAH saMmataH satAm |
loke mahIyate sadbhiryo dadAti vasundharAm
shlokas.81:
yathApsu patitaH shakra tailabindurvisarpati |
tathA bhUmikRRitaM dAnaM sasye sasye visarpati
shlokas.82:
ye raNAgre mahIpAlAH shUrAH samitishobhanAH |
vadhyante.abhimukhAH shakra brahmalokaM vrajanti te
shlokas.83:
nRRityagItaparA nAryo divyamAlyavibhUShitAH |
upatiShThanti devendra sadA bhUmipradaM divi
shlokas.84:
modate cha sukhaM svarge devagandharvapUjitaH |
yo dadAti mahIM samyagvidhineha dvijAtaye
shlokas.85:
shatamapsarasashchaiva divyamAlyavibhUShitAH |
upatiShThanti devendra sadA bhUmipradaM naram
shlokas.86:
sha~NkhaM bhadrAsanaM ChatraM varAshvA varavAraNAH |
bhUmipradAnAtpuShpANi hiraNyanichayAstathA
shlokas.87:
Aj~nA sadApratihatA jayashabdo bhavatyatha |
bhUmidAnasya puShpANi phalaM svargaH pura.ndara
shlokas.88:
hiraNyapuShpAshchauShadhyaH kushakA~nchanashADvalAH |
amRRitaprasavAM bhUmiM prApnoti puruSho dadat
shlokas.89:
nAsti bhUmisamaM dAnaM nAsti mAtRRisamo guruH |
nAsti satyasamo dharmo nAsti dAnasamo nidhiH
shlokas.90:
etadA~NgirasAchChrutvA vAsavo vasudhAmimAm |
vasuratnasamAkIrNAM dadAvA~Ngirase tadA
shlokas.91:
ya imaM shrAvayechChrAddhe bhUmidAnasya sa.nstavam |
na tasya rakShasAM bhAgo nAsurANAM bhavatyuta
shlokas.92:
akShayaM cha bhaveddattaM pitRRibhyastanna sa.nshayaH |
tasmAchChrAddheShvidaM vipro bhu~njataH shrAvayeddvijAn
shlokas.93:
ityetatsarvadAnAnAM shreShThamuktaM tavAnagha |
mayA bharatashArdUla kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kAni dAnAni loke.asmindAtukAmo mahIpatiH |
guNAdhikebhyo viprebhyo dadyAdbharatasattama
shlokas.2:
kena tuShyanti te sadyastuShTAH kiM pradishantyuta |
sha.nsa me tanmahAbAho phalaM puNyakRRitaM mahat
shlokas.3:
dattaM kiM phalavadrAjanniha loke paratra cha |
bhavataH shrotumichChAmi tanme vistarato vada
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
imamarthaM purA pRRiShTo nArado devadarshanaH |
yaduktavAnasau tanme gadataH shRRiNu bhArata
shlokas.5:
nArada uvAcha||
annameva prasha.nsanti devAH sarShigaNAH purA |
lokatantraM hi yaj~nAshcha sarvamanne pratiShThitam
shlokas.6:
annena sadRRishaM dAnaM na bhUtaM na bhaviShyati |
tasmAdannaM visheSheNa dAtumichChanti mAnavAH
shlokas.7:
annamUrjaskaraM loke prANAshchAnne pratiShThitAH |
annena dhAryate sarvaM vishvaM jagadidaM prabho
shlokas.8:
annAdgRRihasthA loke.asminbhikShavastata eva cha |
annAtprabhavati prANaH pratyakShaM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.9:
kuTumbaM pIDayitvApi brAhmaNAya mahAtmane |
dAtavyaM bhikShave chAnnamAtmano bhUtimichChatA
shlokas.10:
brAhmaNAyAbhirUpAya yo dadyAdannamarthine |
nidadhAti nidhiM shreShThaM pAralaukikamAtmanaH
shlokas.11:
shrAntamadhvani vartantaM vRRiddhamarhamupasthitam |
archayedbhUtimanvichChangRRihastho gRRihamAgatam
shlokas.12:
krodhamutpatitaM hitvA sushIlo vItamatsaraH |
annadaH prApnute rAjandivi cheha cha yatsukham
shlokas.13:
nAvamanyedabhigataM na praNudyAtkatha~nchana |
api shvapAke shuni vA na dAnaM vipraNashyati
shlokas.14:
yo dadyAdaparikliShTamannamadhvani vartate |
shrAntAyAdRRiShTapUrvAya sa mahaddharmamApnuyAt
shlokas.15:
pitR^IndevAnRRiShInviprAnatithI.nshcha janAdhipa |
yo naraH prINayatyannaistasya puNyaphalaM mahat
shlokas.16:
kRRitvApi pApakaM karma yo dadyAdannamarthine |
brAhmaNAya visheSheNa na sa pApena yujyate
shlokas.17:
brAhmaNeShvakShayaM dAnamannaM shUdre mahAphalam |
annadAnaM cha shUdre cha brAhmaNe cha vishiShyate
shlokas.18:
na pRRichChedgotracharaNaM svAdhyAyaM deshameva vA |
bhikShito brAhmaNeneha janma vAnnaM prayAchitaH
shlokas.19:
annadasyAnnavRRikShAshcha sarvakAmaphalAnvitAH |
bhavantIhAtha vAmutra nRRipate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.20:
Asha.nsante hi pitaraH suvRRiShTimiva karShakAH |
asmAkamapi putro vA pautro vAnnaM pradAsyati
shlokas.21:
brAhmaNo hi mahadbhUtaM svayaM dehIti yAchate |
akAmo vA sakAmo vA dattvA puNyamavApnuyAt
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNaH sarvabhUtAnAmatithiH prasRRitAgrabhuk |
viprA yamabhigachChanti bhikShamANA gRRihaM sadA
shlokas.23:
satkRRitAshcha nivartante tadatIva pravardhate |
mahAbhoge kule janma pretya prApnoti bhArata
shlokas.24:
dattvA tvannaM naro loke tathA sthAnamanuttamam |
mRRiShTamRRiShTAnnadAyI tu svarge vasati satkRRitaH
shlokas.25:
annaM prANA narANAM hi sarvamanne pratiShThitam |
annadaH pashumAnputrI dhanavAnbhogavAnapi
shlokas.26:
prANavA.nshchApi bhavati rUpavA.nshcha tathA nRRipa |
annadaH prANado loke sarvadaH prochyate tu saH
shlokas.27:
annaM hi dattvAtithaye brAhmaNAya yathAvidhi |
pradAtA sukhamApnoti devaishchApyabhipUjyate
shlokas.28:
brAhmaNo hi mahadbhUtaM kShetraM charati pAdavat |
upyate tatra yadbIjaM taddhi puNyaphalaM mahat
shlokas.29:
pratyakShaM prItijananaM bhoktRRidAtrorbhavatyuta |
sarvANyanyAni dAnAni parokShaphalavantyuta
shlokas.30:
annAddhi prasavaM viddhi ratimannAddhi bhArata |
dharmArthAvannato viddhi roganAshaM tathAnnataH
shlokas.31:
annaM hyamRRitamityAha purAkalpe prajApatiH |
annaM bhuvaM divaM khaM cha sarvamanne pratiShThitam
shlokas.32:
annapraNAshe bhidyante sharIre pa~ncha dhAtavaH |
balaM balavato.apIha praNashyatyannahAnitaH
shlokas.33:
AvAhAshcha vivAhAshcha yaj~nAshchAnnamRRite tathA |
na vartante narashreShTha brahma chAtra pralIyate
shlokas.34:
annataH sarvametaddhi yatki~nchitsthANu ja~Ngamam |
triShu lokeShu dharmArthamannaM deyamato budhaiH
shlokas.35:
annadasya manuShyasya balamojo yashaH sukham |
kIrtishcha vardhate shashvattriShu lokeShu pArthiva
shlokas.36:
megheShvambhaH saMnidhatte prANAnAM pavanaH shivaH |
tachcha meghagataM vAri shakro varShati bhArata
shlokas.37:
Adatte cha rasaM bhaumamAdityaH svagabhastibhiH |
vAyurAdityatastA.nshcha rasAndevaH prajApatiH
shlokas.38:
tadyadA meghato vAri patitaM bhavati kShitau |
tadA vasumatI devI snigdhA bhavati bhArata
shlokas.39:
tataH sasyAni rohanti yena vartayate jagat |
mA.nsamedosthishukrANAM prAdurbhAvastataH punaH
shlokas.40:
sambhavanti tataH shukrAtprANinaH pRRithivIpate |
agnIShomau hi tachChukraM prajanaH puShyatashcha ha
shlokas.41:
evamannaM cha sUryashcha pavanaH shukrameva cha |
eka eva smRRito rAshiryato bhUtAni jaj~nire
shlokas.42:
prANAndadAti bhUtAnAM tejashcha bharatarShabha |
gRRihamabhyAgatAyAshu yo dadyAdannamarthine
shlokas.43:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nAradenaivamukto.ahamadAmannaM sadA nRRipa |
anasUyustvamapyannaM tasmAddehi gatajvaraH
shlokas.44:
dattvAnnaM vidhivadrAjanviprebhyastvamapi prabho |
yathAvadanurUpebhyastataH svargamavApsyasi
shlokas.45:
annadAnAM hi ye lokAstA.nstvaM shRRiNu narAdhipa |
bhavanAni prakAshante divi teShAM mahAtmanAm
nAnAsa.nsthAnarUpANi nAnAstambhAnvitAni cha
shlokas.46:
chandramaNDalashubhrANi ki~NkiNIjAlavanti cha |
taruNAdityavarNAni sthAvarANi charANi cha
shlokas.47:
anekashatabhaumAni sAntarjalavanAni cha |
vaiDUryArkaprakAshAni raupyarukmamayAni cha
shlokas.48:
sarvakAmaphalAshchApi vRRikShA bhavanasa.nsthitAH |
vApyo vIthyaH sabhAH kUpA dIrghikAshchaiva sarvashaH
shlokas.49:
ghoShavanti cha yAnAni yuktAnyatha sahasrashaH |
bhakShyabhojyamayAH shailA vAsA.nsyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.50:
