kShIraM sravantyaH saritastathA chaivAnnaparvatAH |
prAsAdAH pANDurAbhrAbhAH shayyAshcha kanakojjvalAH
tAnannadAH prapadyante tasmAdannaprado bhava
shlokas.51:
ete lokAH puNyakRRitAmannadAnAM mahAtmanAm |
tasmAdannaM visheSheNa dAtavyaM mAnavairbhuvi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrutaM me bhavato vAkyamannadAnasya yo vidhiH |
nakShatrayogasyedAnIM dAnakalpaM bravIhi me
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
devakyAshchaiva sa.nvAdaM devarShernAradasya cha
shlokas.3:
dvArakAmanusamprAptaM nAradaM devadarshanam |
paprachChainaM tataH prashnaM devakI dharmadarshinI
shlokas.4:
tasyAH sampRRichChamAnAyA devarShirnAradastadA |
AchaShTa vidhivatsarvaM yattachChRRiNu vishAM pate
shlokas.5:
nArada uvAcha||
kRRittikAsu mahAbhAge pAyasena sasarpiShA |
santarpya brAhmaNAnsAdhU.NllokAnApnotyanuttamAn
shlokas.6:
rohiNyAM prathitairmA.nsairmAShairannena sarpiShA |
payo.anupAnaM dAtavyamAnRRiNyArthaM dvijAtaye
shlokas.7:
dogdhrIM dattvA savatsAM tu nakShatre somadaivate |
gachChanti mAnuShAllokAtsvargalokamanuttamam
shlokas.8:
ArdrAyAM kRRisaraM dattvA tailamishramupoShitaH |
narastarati durgANi kShuradhArA.nshcha parvatAn
shlokas.9:
apUpAnpunarvasau dattvA tathaivAnnAni shobhane |
yashasvI rUpasampanno bahvanne jAyate kule
shlokas.10:
puShye tu kanakaM dattvA kRRitaM chAkRRitameva cha |
anAlokeShu lokeShu somavatsa virAjate
shlokas.11:
AshleShAyAM tu yo rUpyamRRiShabhaM vA prayachChati |
sa sarvabhayanirmuktaH shAtravAnadhitiShThati
shlokas.12:
maghAsu tilapUrNAni vardhamAnAni mAnavaH |
pradAya putrapashumAniha pretya cha modate
shlokas.13:
phalgunIpUrvasamaye brAhmaNAnAmupoShitaH |
bhakShAnphANitasa.nyuktAndattvA saubhAgyamRRichChati
shlokas.14:
ghRRitakShIrasamAyuktaM vidhivatShaShTikaudanam |
uttarAviShaye dattvA svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.15:
yadyatpradIyate dAnamuttarAviShaye naraiH |
mahAphalamanantaM cha bhavatIti vinishchayaH
shlokas.16:
haste hastirathaM dattvA chaturyuktamupoShitaH |
prApnoti paramA.NllokAnpuNyakAmasamanvitAn
shlokas.17:
chitrAyAmRRiShabhaM dattvA puNyAngandhA.nshcha bhArata |
charatyapsarasAM loke ramate nandane tathA
shlokas.18:
svAtAvatha dhanaM dattvA yadiShTatamamAtmanaH |
prApnoti lokAnsa shubhAniha chaiva mahadyashaH
shlokas.19:
vishAkhAyAmanaDvAhaM dhenuM dattvA cha dugdhadAm |
saprAsa~NgaM cha shakaTaM sadhAnyaM vastrasa.nyutam
shlokas.20:
pitR^IndevA.nshcha prINAti pretya chAnantyamashnute |
na cha durgANyavApnoti svargalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.21:
dattvA yathoktaM viprebhyo vRRittimiShTAM sa vindati |
narakAdI.nshcha sa~NkleshAnnApnotIti vinishchayaH
shlokas.22:
anurAdhAsu prAvAraM vastrAntaramupoShitaH |
dattvA yugashataM chApi naraH svarge mahIyate
shlokas.23:
kAlashAkaM tu viprebhyo dattvA martyaH samUlakam |
jyeShThAyAmRRiddhimiShTAM vai gatimiShTAM cha vindati
shlokas.24:
mUle mUlaphalaM dattvA brAhmaNebhyaH samAhitaH |
pitR^InprINayate chApi gatimiShTAM cha gachChati
shlokas.25:
atha pUrvAsvaShADhAsu dadhipAtrANyupoShitaH |
kulavRRittopasampanne brAhmaNe vedapArage
pradAya jAyate pretya kule subahugokule
shlokas.26:
udamanthaM sasarpiShkaM prabhUtamadhuphANitam |
dattvottarAsvaShADhAsu sarvakAmAnavApnuyAt
shlokas.27:
dugdhaM tvabhijite yoge dattvA madhughRRitAplutam |
dharmanityo manIShibhyaH svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.28:
shravaNe kambalaM dattvA vastrAntaritameva cha |
shvetena yAti yAnena sarvalokAnasa.nvRRitAn
shlokas.29:
goprayuktaM dhaniShThAsu yAnaM dattvA samAhitaH |
vastrarashmidharaM sadyaH pretya rAjyaM prapadyate
shlokas.30:
gandhA~nshatabhiShagyoge dattvA sAguruchandanAn |
prApnotyapsarasAM lokAnpretya gandhA.nshcha shAshvatAn
shlokas.31:
pUrvabhAdrapadAyoge rAjamAShAnpradAya tu |
sarvabhakShaphalopetaH sa vai pretya sukhI bhavet
shlokas.32:
aurabhramuttarAyoge yastu mA.nsaM prayachChati |
sa pitR^InprINayati vai pretya chAnantyamashnute
shlokas.33:
kA.nsyopadohanAM dhenuM revatyAM yaH prayachChati |
sA pretya kAmAnAdAya dAtAramupatiShThati
shlokas.34:
rathamashvasamAyuktaM dattvAshvinyAM narottamaH |
hastyashvarathasampanne varchasvI jAyate kule
shlokas.35:
bharaNIShu dvijAtibhyastiladhenuM pradAya vai |
gAH suprabhUtAH prApnoti naraH pretya yashastathA
shlokas.36:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityeSha lakShaNoddeshaH prokto nakShatrayogataH |
devakyA nAradeneha sA snuShAbhyo.abravIdidam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sarvAnkAmAnprayachChanti ye prayachChanti kA~nchanam |
ityevaM bhagavAnatriH pitAmahasuto.abravIt
shlokas.2:
pavitraM shuchyathAyuShyaM pitR^INAmakShayaM cha tat |
suvarNaM manujendreNa harishchandreNa kIrtitam
shlokas.3:
pAnIyadAnaM paramaM dAnAnAM manurabravIt |
tasmAdvApIshcha kUpA.nshcha taDAgAni cha khAnayet
shlokas.4:
ardhaM pApasya harati puruShasyeha karmaNaH |
kUpaH pravRRittapAnIyaH supravRRittashcha nityashaH
shlokas.5:
sarvaM tArayate va.nshaM yasya khAte jalAshaye |
gAvaH pibanti viprAshcha sAdhavashcha narAH sadA
shlokas.6:
nidAghakAle pAnIyaM yasya tiShThatyavAritam |
sa durgaM viShamaM kRRichChraM na kadAchidavApnute
shlokas.7:
bRRihaspaterbhagavataH pUShNashchaiva bhagasya cha |
ashvinoshchaiva vahneshcha prItirbhavati sarpiShA
shlokas.8:
paramaM bheShajaM hyetadyaj~nAnAmetaduttamam |
rasAnAmuttamaM chaitatphalAnAM chaitaduttamam
shlokas.9:
phalakAmo yashaskAmaH puShTikAmashcha nityadA |
ghRRitaM dadyAddvijAtibhyaH puruShaH shuchirAtmavAn
shlokas.10:
ghRRitaM mAse Ashvayuji viprebhyo yaH prayachChati |
tasmai prayachChato rUpaM prItau devAvihAshvinau
shlokas.11:
pAyasaM sarpiShA mishraM dvijebhyo yaH prayachChati |
gRRihaM tasya na rakShA.nsi dharShayanti kadAchana
shlokas.12:
pipAsayA na mriyate sopachChandashcha dRRishyate |
na prApnuyAchcha vyasanaM karakAnyaH prayachChati
shlokas.13:
prayato brAhmaNAgrebhyaH shraddhayA parayA yutaH |
upasparshanaShaDbhAgaM labhate puruShaH sadA
shlokas.14:
yaH sAdhanArthaM kAShThAni brAhmaNebhyaH prayachChati |
pratApArthaM cha rAjendra vRRittavadbhyaH sadA naraH
shlokas.15:
sidhyantyarthAH sadA tasya kAryANi vividhAni cha |
uparyupari shatrUNAM vapuShA dIpyate cha saH
shlokas.16:
bhagavA.nshchAsya suprIto vahnirbhavati nityashaH |
na taM tyajante pashavaH sa~NgrAme cha jayatyapi
shlokas.17:
putrA~nChriyaM cha labhate yashChatraM samprayachChati |
chakShurvyAdhiM na labhate yaj~nabhAgamathAshnute
shlokas.18:
nidAghakAle varShe vA yashChatraM samprayachChati |
nAsya kashchinmanodAhaH kadAchidapi jAyate
kRRichChrAtsa viShamAchchaiva vipra mokShamavApnute
shlokas.19:
pradAnaM sarvadAnAnAM shakaTasya vishiShyate |
evamAha mahAbhAgaH shANDilyo bhagavAnRRiShiH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dahyamAnAya viprAya yaH prayachChatyupAnahau |
yatphalaM tasya bhavati tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
upAnahau prayachChedyo brAhmaNebhyaH samAhitaH |
mardate kaNTakAnsarvAnviShamAnnistaratyapi
sa shatrUNAmupari cha santiShThati yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
yAnaM chAshvatarIyuktaM tasya shubhraM vishAM pate |
upatiShThati kaunteya rUpyakA~nchanabhUShaNam
shakaTaM damyasa.nyuktaM dattaM bhavati chaiva hi
shlokas.4:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yatphalaM tiladAne cha bhUmidAne cha kIrtitam |
gopradAne.annadAne cha bhUyastadbrUhi kaurava
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNuShva mama kaunteya tiladAnasya yatphalam |
nishamya cha yathAnyAyaM prayachCha kurusattama
shlokas.6:
pitR^INAM prathamaM bhojyaM tilAH sRRiShTAH svayambhuvA |
tiladAnena vai tasmAtpitRRipakShaH pramodate
shlokas.7:
mAghamAse tilAnyastu brAhmaNebhyaH prayachChati |
sarvasattvasamAkIrNaM narakaM sa na pashyati
shlokas.8:
sarvakAmaiH sa yajate yastilairyajate pitR^In |
na chAkAmena dAtavyaM tilashrAddhaM katha~nchana
shlokas.9:
maharSheH kashyapasyaite gAtrebhyaH prasRRitAstilAH |
tato divyaM gatA bhAvaM pradAneShu tilAH prabho
shlokas.10:
pauShTikA rUpadAshchaiva tathA pApavinAshanAH |
tasmAtsarvapradAnebhyastiladAnaM vishiShyate
shlokas.11:
Apastambashcha medhAvI sha~Nkhashcha likhitastathA |
maharShirgautamashchApi tiladAnairdivaM gatAH
shlokas.12:
tilahomaparA viprAH sarve sa.nyatamaithunAH |
samA gavyena haviShA pravRRittiShu cha sa.nsthitAH
shlokas.13:
sarveShAmeva dAnAnAM tiladAnaM paraM smRRitam |
akShayaM sarvadAnAnAM tiladAnamihochyate
shlokas.14:
utpanne cha purA havye kushikarShiH parantapa |
tilairagnitrayaM hutvA prAptavAngatimuttamAm
shlokas.15:
iti proktaM kurushreShTha tiladAnamanuttamam |
vidhAnaM yena vidhinA tilAnAmiha shasyate
shlokas.16:
ata UrdhvaM nibodhedaM devAnAM yaShTumichChatAm |
samAgamaM mahArAja brahmaNA vai svayambhuvA
shlokas.17:
devAH sametya brahmANaM bhUmibhAgaM yiyakShavaH |
shubhaM deshamayAchanta yajema iti pArthiva
shlokas.18:
devA UchuH||
bhagava.nstvaM prabhurbhUmeH sarvasya tridivasya cha |
yajemahi mahAbhAga yaj~naM bhavadanuj~nayA
nAnanuj~nAtabhUmirhi yaj~nasya phalamashnute
shlokas.19:
tvaM hi sarvasya jagataH sthAvarasya charasya cha |
prabhurbhavasi tasmAttvaM samanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.20:
brahmovAcha||
dadAmi medinIbhAgaM bhavadbhyo.ahaM surarShabhAH |
yasmindeshe kariShyadhvaM yaj~naM kAshyapanandanAH
shlokas.21:
devA UchuH||
bhagavankRRitakAmAH smo yakShyAmastvAptadakShiNaiH |
imaM tu deshaM munayaH paryupAsanta nityadA
shlokas.22:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato.agastyashcha kaNvashcha bhRRiguratrirvRRiShAkapiH |
asito devalashchaiva devayaj~namupAgaman
shlokas.23:
tato devA mahAtmAna Ijire yaj~namachyuta |
tathA samApayAmAsuryathAkAlaM surarShabhAH
shlokas.24:
ta iShTayaj~nAstridashA himavatyachalottame |
ShaShThama.nshaM kratostasya bhUmidAnaM prachakrire
shlokas.25:
prAdeshamAtraM bhUmestu yo dadyAdanupaskRRitam |
na sIdati sa kRRichChreShu na cha durgANyavApnute
shlokas.26:
shItavAtAtapasahAM gRRihabhUmiM susa.nskRRitAm |
pradAya suralokasthaH puNyAnte.api na chAlyate
shlokas.27:
mudito vasate prAj~naH shakreNa saha pArthiva |
pratishrayapradAtA cha so.api svarge mahIyate
shlokas.28:
adhyApakakule jAtaH shrotriyo niyatendriyaH |
gRRihe yasya vasettuShTaH pradhAnaM lokamashnute
shlokas.29:
tathA gavArthe sharaNaM shItavarShasahaM mahat |
AsaptamaM tArayati kulaM bharatasattama
shlokas.30:
kShetrabhUmiM dadalloke putra shriyamavApnuyAt |
ratnabhUmiM pradattvA tu kulava.nshaM vivardhayet
shlokas.31:
na choSharAM na nirdagdhAM mahIM dadyAtkatha~nchana |
na shmashAnaparItAM cha na cha pApaniShevitAm
shlokas.32:
pArakye bhUmideshe tu pitR^INAM nirvapettu yaH |
tadbhUmisvAmipitRRibhiH shrAddhakarma vihanyate
shlokas.33:
tasmAtkrItvA mahIM dadyAtsvalpAmapi vichakShaNaH |
piNDaH pitRRibhyo datto vai tasyAM bhavati shAshvataH
shlokas.34:
aTavIparvatAshchaiva nadItIrthAni yAni cha |
sarvANyasvAmikAnyAhurna hi tatra parigrahaH
shlokas.35:
ityetadbhUmidAnasya phalamuktaM vishAM pate |
ataH paraM tu godAnaM kIrtayiShyAmi te.anagha
shlokas.36:
gAvo.adhikAstapasvibhyo yasmAtsarvebhya eva cha |
tasmAnmaheshvaro devastapastAbhiH samAsthitaH
shlokas.37:
brahmaloke vasantyetAH somena saha bhArata |
AsAM brahmarShayaH siddhAH prArthayanti parAM gatim
shlokas.38:
payasA haviShA dadhnA shakRRitApyatha charmaNA |
asthibhishchopakurvanti shRRi~NgairvAlaishcha bhArata
shlokas.39:
nAsAM shItAtapau syAtAM sadaitAH karma kurvate |
na varShaM viShamaM vApi duHkhamAsAM bhavatyuta
shlokas.40:
brAhmaNaiH sahitA yAnti tasmAtparataraM padam |
ekaM gobrAhmaNaM tasmAtpravadanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.41:
rantidevasya yaj~ne tAH pashutvenopakalpitAH |
tatashcharmaNvatI rAjangocharmabhyaH pravartitA
shlokas.42:
pashutvAchcha vinirmuktAH pradAnAyopakalpitAH |
tA imA vipramukhyebhyo yo dadAti mahIpate
nistaredApadaM kRRichChrAM viShamastho.api pArthiva
shlokas.43:
gavAM sahasradaH pretya narakaM na prapashyati |
sarvatra vijayaM chApi labhate manujAdhipa
shlokas.44:
amRRitaM vai gavAM kShIramityAha tridashAdhipaH |
tasmAddadAti yo dhenumamRRitaM sa prayachChati
shlokas.45:
agnInAmavyayaM hyetaddhaumyaM vedavido viduH |
tasmAddadAti yo dhenuM sa haumyaM samprayachChati
shlokas.46:
svargo vai mUrtimAneSha vRRiShabhaM yo gavAM patim |
vipre guNayute dadyAtsa vai svarge mahIyate
shlokas.47:
prANA vai prANinAmete prochyante bharatarShabha |
tasmAddadAti yo dhenuM prANAnvai sa prayachChati
shlokas.48:
gAvaH sharaNyA bhUtAnAmiti vedavido viduH |
tasmAddadAti yo dhenuM sharaNaM samprayachChati
shlokas.49:
na vadhArthaM pradAtavyA na kInAshe na nAstike |
gojIvine na dAtavyA tathA gauH puruSharShabha
shlokas.50:
dadAti tAdRRishAnAM vai naro gAH pApakarmaNAm |
akShayaM narakaM yAtItyevamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.51:
na kRRishAM pApavatsAM vA vandhyAM rogAnvitAM tathA |
na vya~NgAM na parishrAntAM dadyAdgAM brAhmaNAya vai
shlokas.52:
dashagosahasradaH samyakShakreNa saha modate |
akShayA.Nllabhate lokAnnaraH shatasahasradaH
shlokas.53:
ityetadgopradAnaM cha tiladAnaM cha kIrtitam |
tathA bhUmipradAnaM cha shRRiNuShvAnne cha bhArata
shlokas.54:
annadAnaM pradhAnaM hi kaunteya parichakShate |
annasya hi pradAnena rantidevo divaM gataH
shlokas.55:
shrAntAya kShudhitAyAnnaM yaH prayachChati bhUmipa |
svAyambhuvaM mahAbhAgaM sa pashyati narAdhipa
shlokas.56:
na hiraNyairna vAsobhirnAshvadAnena bhArata |
prApnuvanti narAH shreyo yathehAnnapradAH prabho
shlokas.57:
annaM vai paramaM dravyamannaM shrIshcha parA matA |
annAtprANaH prabhavati tejo vIryaM balaM tathA
shlokas.58:
sadbhyo dadAti yashchAnnaM sadaikAgramanA naraH |
na sa durgANyavApnotItyevamAha parAsharaH
shlokas.59:
archayitvA yathAnyAyaM devebhyo.annaM nivedayet |
yadanno hi naro rAja.nstadannAstasya devatAH
shlokas.60:
kaumudyAM shuklapakShe tu yo.annadAnaM karotyuta |
sa santarati durgANi pretya chAnantyamashnute
shlokas.61:
abhuktvAtithaye chAnnaM prayachChedyaH samAhitaH |
sa vai brahmavidAM lokAnprApnuyAdbharatarShabha
shlokas.62:
sukRRichChrAmApadaM prAptashchAnnadaH puruShastaret |
pApaM tarati chaiveha duShkRRitaM chApakarShati
shlokas.63:
ityetadannadAnasya tiladAnasya chaiva ha |
bhUmidAnasya cha phalaM godAnasya cha kIrtitam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrutaM dAnaphalaM tAta yattvayA parikIrtitam |
annaM tu te visheSheNa prashastamiha bhArata
shlokas.2:
pAnIyadAnaM paramaM kathaM cheha mahAphalam |
ityetachChrotumichChAmi vistareNa pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
hanta te vartayiShyAmi yathAvadbharatarShabha |
gadatastanmamAdyeha shRRiNu satyaparAkrama
pAnIyadAnAtprabhRRiti sarvaM vakShyAmi te.anagha
shlokas.4:
yadannaM yachcha pAnIyaM sampradAyAshnute naraH |
na tasmAtparamaM dAnaM ki~nchidastIti me matiH
shlokas.5:
annAtprANabhRRitastAta pravartante hi sarvashaH |
tasmAdannaM paraM loke sarvadAneShu kathyate
shlokas.6:
annAdbalaM cha tejashcha prANinAM vardhate sadA |
annadAnamatastasmAchChreShThamAha prajApatiH
shlokas.7:
sAvitryA hyapi kaunteya shrutaM te vachanaM shubham |
yatashchaitadyathA chaitaddevasatre mahAmate
shlokas.8:
anne datte nareNeha prANA dattA bhavantyuta |
prANadAnAddhi paramaM na dAnamiha vidyate
shlokas.9:
shrutaM hi te mahAbAho lomashasyApi tadvachaH |
prANAndattvA kapotAya yatprAptaM shibinA purA
shlokas.10:
tAM gatiM labhate dattvA dvijasyAnnaM vishAM pate |
gatiM vishiShTAM gachChanti prANadA iti naH shrutam
shlokas.11:
annaM chApi prabhavati pAnIyAtkurusattama |
nIrajAtena hi vinA na ki~nchitsampravartate
shlokas.12:
nIrajAtashcha bhagavAnsomo grahagaNeshvaraH |
amRRitaM cha sudhA chaiva svAhA chaiva vaShaTtathA
shlokas.13:
annauShadhyo mahArAja vIrudhashcha jalodbhavAH |
yataH prANabhRRitAM prANAH sambhavanti vishAM pate
shlokas.14:
devAnAmamRRitaM chAnnaM nAgAnAM cha sudhA tathA |
pitR^INAM cha svadhA proktA pashUnAM chApi vIrudhaH
shlokas.15:
annameva manuShyANAM prANAnAhurmanIShiNaH |
tachcha sarvaM naravyAghra pAnIyAtsampravartate
shlokas.16:
tasmAtpAnIyadAnAdvai na paraM vidyate kvachit |
tachcha dadyAnnaro nityaM ya ichChedbhUtimAtmanaH
shlokas.17:
dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM jaladAnaM vishAM pate |
shatrU.nshchApyadhi kaunteya sadA tiShThati toyadaH
shlokas.18:
sarvakAmAnavApnoti kIrtiM chaiveha shAshvatIm |
pretya chAnantyamApnoti pApebhyashcha pramuchyate
shlokas.19:
toyado manujavyAghra svargaM gatvA mahAdyute |
akShayAnsamavApnoti lokAnityabravInmanuH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tilAnAM kIdRRishaM dAnamatha dIpasya chaiva ha |
annAnAM vAsasAM chaiva bhUya eva bravIhi me
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
brAhmaNasya cha sa.nvAdaM yamasya cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
madhyadeshe mahAngrAmo brAhmaNAnAM babhUva ha |
ga~NgAyamunayormadhye yAmunasya gireradhaH
shlokas.4:
parNashAleti vikhyAto ramaNIyo narAdhipa |
vidvA.nsastatra bhUyiShThA brAhmaNAshchAvasa.nstadA
shlokas.5:
atha prAha yamaH ka~nchitpuruShaM kRRiShNavAsasam |
raktAkShamUrdhvaromANaM kAkaja~NghAkShinAsikam
shlokas.6:
gachCha tvaM brAhmaNagrAmaM tato gatvA tamAnaya |
agastyaM gotratashchApi nAmatashchApi sharmiNam
shlokas.7:
shame niviShTaM vidvA.nsamadhyApakamanAdRRitam |
mA chAnyamAnayethAstvaM sagotraM tasya pArshvataH
shlokas.8:
sa hi tAdRRigguNastena tulyo.adhyayanajanmanA |
apatyeShu tathA vRRitte samastenaiva dhImatA
tamAnaya yathoddiShTaM pUjA kAryA hi tasya me
shlokas.9:
sa gatvA pratikUlaM tachchakAra yamashAsanam |
tamAkramyAnayAmAsa pratiShiddho yamena yaH
shlokas.10:
tasmai yamaH samutthAya pUjAM kRRitvA cha vIryavAn |
provAcha nIyatAmeSha so.anya AnIyatAmiti
shlokas.11:
evamukte tu vachane dharmarAjena sa dvijaH |
uvAcha dharmarAjAnaM nirviNNo.adhyayanena vai
yo me kAlo bhavechCheShastaM vaseyamihAchyuta
shlokas.12:
yama uvAcha||
nAhaM kAlasya vihitaM prApnomIha katha~nchana |
yo hi dharmaM charati vai taM tu jAnAmi kevalam
shlokas.13:
gachCha vipra tvamadyaiva AlayaM svaM mahAdyute |
brUhi vA tvaM yathA svairaM karavANi kimityuta
shlokas.14:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
yattatra kRRitvA sumahatpuNyaM syAttadbravIhi me |
sarvasya hi pramANaM tvaM trailokyasyApi sattama
shlokas.15:
yama uvAcha||
shRRiNu tattvena viprarShe pradAnavidhimuttamam |
tilAH paramakaM dAnaM puNyaM chaiveha shAshvatam
shlokas.16:
tilAshcha sampradAtavyA yathAshakti dvijarShabha |
nityadAnAtsarvakAmA.nstilA nirvartayantyuta
shlokas.17:
tilA~nshrAddhe prasha.nsanti dAnametaddhyanuttamam |
tAnprayachChasva viprebhyo vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.18:
tilA bhakShayitavyAshcha sadA tvAlabhanaM cha taiH |
kAryaM satatamichChadbhiH shreyaH sarvAtmanA gRRihe
shlokas.19:
tathApaH sarvadA deyAH peyAshchaiva na sa.nshayaH |
puShkariNyastaDAgAni kUpA.nshchaivAtra khAnayet
shlokas.20:
etatsudurlabhataramiha loke dvijottama |
Apo nityaM pradeyAste puNyaM hyetadanuttamam
shlokas.21:
prapAshcha kAryAH pAnArthaM nityaM te dvijasattama |
bhukte.apyatha pradeyaM te pAnIyaM vai visheShataH
shlokas.22:
ityukte sa tadA tena yamadUtena vai gRRihAn |
nItashchakAra cha tathA sarvaM tadyamashAsanam
shlokas.23:
nItvA taM yamadUto.api gRRihItvA sharmiNaM tadA |
yayau sa dharmarAjAya nyavedayata chApi tam
shlokas.24:
taM dharmarAjo dharmaj~naM pUjayitvA pratApavAn |
kRRitvA cha sa.nvidaM tena visasarja yathAgatam
shlokas.25:
tasyApi cha yamaH sarvamupadeshaM chakAra ha |
pratyetya cha sa tatsarvaM chakAroktaM yamena tat
shlokas.26:
tathA prasha.nsate dIpAnyamaH pitRRihitepsayA |
tasmAddIpaprado nityaM santArayati vai pitR^In
shlokas.27:
dAtavyAH satataM dIpAstasmAdbharatasattama |
devAnAM cha pitR^INAM cha chakShuShyAste matAH prabho
shlokas.28:
ratnadAnaM cha sumahatpuNyamuktaM janAdhipa |
tAni vikrIya yajate brAhmaNo hyabhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.29:
yadvai dadAti viprebhyo brAhmaNaH pratigRRihya vai |
ubhayoH syAttadakShayyaM dAturAdAtureva cha
shlokas.30:
yo dadAti sthitaH sthityAM tAdRRishAya pratigraham |
ubhayorakShayaM dharmaM taM manuH prAha dharmavit
shlokas.31:
vAsasAM tu pradAnena svadAranirato naraH |
suvastrashcha suveShashcha bhavatItyanushushruma
shlokas.32:
gAvaH suvarNaM cha tathA tilAshchaivAnuvarNitAH |
bahushaH puruShavyAghra vedaprAmANyadarshanAt
shlokas.33:
vivAhA.nshchaiva kurvIta putrAnutpAdayeta cha |
putralAbho hi kauravya sarvalAbhAdvishiShyate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhUya eva kurushreShTha dAnAnAM vidhimuttamam |
kathayasva mahAprAj~na bhUmidAnaM visheShataH
shlokas.2:
pRRithivIM kShatriyo dadyAdbrAhmaNastAM svakarmaNA |
vidhivatpratigRRihNIyAnna tvanyo dAtumarhati
shlokas.3:
sarvavarNaistu yachChakyaM pradAtuM phalakA~NkShibhiH |
vede vA yatsamAmnAtaM tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tulyanAmAni deyAni trINi tulyaphalAni cha |
sarvakAmaphalAnIha gAvaH pRRithvI sarasvatI
shlokas.5:
yo brUyAchchApi shiShyAya dharmyAM brAhmIM sarasvatIm |
pRRithivIgopradAnAbhyAM sa tulyaM phalamashnute
shlokas.6:
tathaiva gAH prasha.nsanti na cha deyaM tataH param |
saMnikRRiShTaphalAstA hi laghvarthAshcha yudhiShThira
mAtaraH sarvabhUtAnAM gAvaH sarvasukhapradAH
shlokas.7:
vRRiddhimAkA~NkShatA nityaM gAvaH kAryAH pradakShiNAH |
ma~NgalAyatanaM devyastasmAtpUjyAH sadaiva hi
shlokas.8:
prachodanaM devakRRitaM gavAM karmasu vartatAm |
pUrvamevAkSharaM nAnyadabhidheyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.9:
prachAre vA nipAne vA budho nodvejayeta gAH |
tRRiShitA hyabhivIkShantyo naraM hanyuH sabAndhavam
shlokas.10:
pitRRisadmAni satataM devatAyatanAni cha |
pUyante shakRRitA yAsAM pUtaM kimadhikaM tataH
shlokas.11:
grAsamuShTiM paragave dadyAtsa.nvatsaraM tu yaH |
akRRitvA svayamAhAraM vrataM tatsArvakAmikam
shlokas.12:
sa hi putrAnyashorthaM cha shriyaM chApyadhigachChati |
nAshayatyashubhaM chaiva duHsvapnaM cha vyapohati
shlokas.13:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
deyAH ki.nlakShaNA gAvaH kAshchApi parivarjayet |
kIdRRishAya pradAtavyA na deyAH kIdRRishAya cha
shlokas.14:
bhIShma uvAcha||
asadvRRittAya pApAya lubdhAyAnRRitavAdine |
havyakavyavyapetAya na deyA gauH katha~nchana
shlokas.15:
bhikShave bahuputrAya shrotriyAyAhitAgnaye |
dattvA dashagavAM dAtA lokAnApnotyanuttamAn
shlokas.16:
yaM chaiva dharmaM kurute tasya puNyaphalaM cha yat |
sarvasyaivA.nshabhAgdAtA tannimittaM pravRRittayaH
shlokas.17:
yashchainamutpAdayati yashchainaM trAyate bhayAt |
yashchAsya kurute vRRittiM sarve te pitarastrayaH
shlokas.18:
kalmaShaM gurushushrUShA hanti mAno mahadyashaH |
aputratAM trayaH putrA avRRittiM dasha dhenavaH
shlokas.19:
vedAntaniShThasya bahushrutasya; praj~nAnatRRiptasya jitendriyasya |
shiShTasya dAntasya yatasya chaiva; bhUteShu nityaM priyavAdinashcha
shlokas.20:
yaH kShudbhayAdvai na vikarma kuryA;nmRRidurdAntashchAtitheyashcha nityam |
vRRittiM viprAyAtisRRijeta tasmai; yastulyashIlashcha saputradAraH
shlokas.21:
shubhe pAtre ye guNA gopradAne; tAvAndoSho brAhmaNasvApahAre |
sarvAvasthaM brAhmaNasvApahAro; dArAshchaiShAM dUrato varjanIyAH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atraiva kIrtyate sadbhirbrAhmaNasvAbhimarshane |
nRRigeNa sumahatkRRichChraM yadavAptaM kurUdvaha
shlokas.2:
nivishantyAM purA pArtha dvAravatyAmiti shrutiH |
adRRishyata mahAkUpastRRiNavIrutsamAvRRitaH
shlokas.3:
prayatnaM tatra kurvANAstasmAtkUpAjjalArthinaH |
shrameNa mahatA yuktAstasmi.nstoye susa.nvRRite
shlokas.4:
dadRRishuste mahAkAyaM kRRikalAsamavasthitam |
tasya choddharaNe yatnamakurva.nste sahasrashaH
shlokas.5:
pragrahaishcharmapaTTaishcha taM baddhvA parvatopamam |
nAshaknuvansamuddhartuM tato jagmurjanArdanam
shlokas.6:
khamAvRRityodapAnasya kRRikalAsaH sthito mahAn |
tasya nAsti samuddhartetyatha kRRiShNe nyavedayan
shlokas.7:
sa vAsudevena samuddhRRitashcha; pRRiShTashcha kAmAnnijagAda rAjA |
nRRigastadAtmAnamatho nyavedaya;tpurAtanaM yaj~nasahasrayAjinam
shlokas.8:
tathA bruvANaM tu tamAha mAdhavaH; shubhaM tvayA karma kRRitaM na pApakam |
kathaM bhavAndurgatimIdRRishIM gato; narendra tadbrUhi kimetadIdRRisham
shlokas.9:
shataM sahasrANi shataM gavAM punaH; punaH shatAnyaShTa shatAyutAni |
tvayA purA dattamitIha shushruma; nRRipa dvijebhyaH kva nu tadgataM tava
shlokas.10:
nRRigastato.abravItkRRiShNaM brAhmaNasyAgnihotriNaH |
proShitasya paribhraShTA gaurekA mama godhane
shlokas.11:
gavAM sahasre sa~NkhyAtA tadA sA pashupairmama |
sA brAhmaNAya me dattA pretyArthamabhikA~NkShatA
shlokas.12:
apashyatparimArga.nshcha tAM yAM paragRRihe dvijaH |
mameyamiti chovAcha brAhmaNo yasya sAbhavat
shlokas.13:
tAvubhau samanuprAptau vivadantau bhRRishajvarau |
bhavAndAtA bhavAnhartetyatha tau mAM tadochatuH
shlokas.14:
shatena shatasa~Nkhyena gavAM vinimayena vai |
yAche pratigrahItAraM sa tu mAmabravIdidam
shlokas.15:
deshakAlopasampannA dogdhrI kShAntAtivatsalA |
svAdukShIrapradA dhanyA mama nityaM niveshane
shlokas.16:
kRRishaM cha bharate yA gaurmama putramapastanam |
na sA shakyA mayA hAtumityuktvA sa jagAma ha
shlokas.17:
tatastamaparaM vipraM yAche vinimayena vai |
gavAM shatasahasraM vai tatkRRite gRRihyatAmiti
shlokas.18:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
na rAj~nAM pratigRRihNAmi shakto.ahaM svasya mArgaNe |
saiva gaurdIyatAM shIghraM mameti madhusUdana
shlokas.19:
rukmamashvA.nshcha dadato rajataM syandanA.nstathA |
na jagrAha yayau chApi tadA sa brAhmaNarShabhaH
shlokas.20:
etasminneva kAle tu choditaH kAladharmaNA |
pitRRilokamahaM prApya dharmarAjamupAgamam
shlokas.21:
yamastu pUjayitvA mAM tato vachanamabravIt |
nAntaH sa~NkhyAyate rAja.nstava puNyasya karmaNaH
shlokas.22:
asti chaiva kRRitaM pApamaj~nAnAttadapi tvayA |
charasva pApaM pashchAdvA pUrvaM vA tvaM yathechChasi
shlokas.23:
rakShitAsmIti choktaM te pratij~nA chAnRRitA tava |
brAhmaNasvasya chAdAnaM trividhaste vyatikramaH
shlokas.24:
pUrvaM kRRichChraM chariShye.ahaM pashchAchChubhamiti prabho |
dharmarAjaM bruvannevaM patito.asmi mahItale
shlokas.25:
ashrauShaM prachyutashchAhaM yamasyochchaiH prabhAShataH |
vAsudevaH samuddhartA bhavitA te janArdanaH
shlokas.26:
pUrNe varShasahasrAnte kShINe karmaNi duShkRRite |
prApsyase shAshvatA.NllokA~njitAnsvenaiva karmaNA
shlokas.27:
kUpe.a.atmAnamadhaHshIrShamapashyaM patitaM cha ha |
tiryagyonimanuprAptaM na tu mAmajahAtsmRRitiH
shlokas.28:
tvayA tu tArito.asmyadya kimanyatra tapobalAt |
anujAnIhi mAM kRRiShNa gachCheyaM divamadya vai
shlokas.29:
anuj~nAtaH sa kRRiShNena namaskRRitya janArdanam |
vimAnaM divyamAsthAya yayau divamari.ndama
shlokas.30:
tatastasmindivaM prApte nRRige bharatasattama |
vAsudeva imaM shlokaM jagAda kurunandana
shlokas.31:
brAhmaNasvaM na hartavyaM puruSheNa vijAnatA |
brAhmaNasvaM hRRitaM hanti nRRigaM brAhmaNagauriva
shlokas.32:
satAM samAgamaH sadbhirnAphalaH pArtha vidyate |
vimuktaM narakAtpashya nRRigaM sAdhusamAgamAt
shlokas.33:
pradAnaM phalavattatra drohastatra tathAphalaH |
apachAraM gavAM tasmAdvarjayeta yudhiShThira

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dattAnAM phalasamprAptiM gavAM prabrUhi me.anagha |
vistareNa mahAbAho na hi tRRipyAmi kathyatAm
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
RRiSheruddAlakervAkyaM nAchiketasya chobhayoH
shlokas.3:
RRiShiruddAlakirdIkShAmupagamya tataH sutam |
tvaM mAmupacharasveti nAchiketamabhAShata
samApte niyame tasminmaharShiH putramabravIt
shlokas.4:
upasparshanasaktasya svAdhyAyaniratasya cha |
idhmA darbhAH sumanasaH kalashashchAbhito jalam
vismRRitaM me tadAdAya nadItIrAdihAvraja
shlokas.5:
gatvAnavApya tatsarvaM nadIvegasamAplutam |
na pashyAmi tadityevaM pitaraM so.abravInmuniH
shlokas.6:
kShutpipAsAshramAviShTo muniruddAlakistadA |
yamaM pashyeti taM putramashapatsa mahAtapAH
shlokas.7:
tathA sa pitrAbhihato vAgvajreNa kRRitA~njaliH |
prasIdeti bruvanneva gatasattvo.apatadbhuvi
shlokas.8:
nAchiketaM pitA dRRiShTvA patitaM duHkhamUrChitaH |
kiM mayA kRRitamityuktvA nipapAta mahItale
shlokas.9:
tasya duHkhaparItasya svaM putramupagUhataH |
vyatItaM tadahaHsheShaM sA chogrA tatra sharvarI
shlokas.10:
pitryeNAshruprapAtena nAchiketaH kurUdvaha |
prAspandachChayane kaushye vRRiShTyA sasyamivAplutam
shlokas.11:
sa paryapRRichChattaM putraM shlAghyaM pratyAgataM punaH |
divyairgandhaiH samAdigdhaM kShINasvapnamivotthitam
shlokas.12:
api putra jitA lokAH shubhAste svena karmaNA |
diShTyA chAsi punaH prApto na hi te mAnuShaM vapuH
shlokas.13:
pratyakShadarshI sarvasya pitrA pRRiShTo mahAtmanA |
anvarthaM taM piturmadhye maharShINAM nyavedayat
shlokas.14:
kurvanbhavachChAsanamAshu yAto; hyahaM vishAlAM ruchiraprabhAvAm |
vaivasvatIM prApya sabhAmapashyaM; sahasrasho yojanahaimabhaumAm
shlokas.15:
dRRiShTvaiva mAmabhimukhamApatantaM; gRRihaM nivedyAsanamAdidesha |
vaivasvato.arghyAdibhirarhaNaishcha; bhavatkRRite pUjayAmAsa mAM saH
shlokas.16:
tatastvahaM taM shanakairavochaM; vRRitaM sadasyairabhipUjyamAnam |
prApto.asmi te viShayaM dharmarAja; lokAnarhe yAnsma tAnme vidhatsva
shlokas.17:
yamo.abravInmAM na mRRito.asi saumya; yamaM pashyetyAha tu tvAM tapasvI |
pitA pradIptAgnisamAnatejA; na tachChakyamanRRitaM vipra kartum
shlokas.18:
dRRiShTaste.ahaM pratigachChasva tAta; shochatyasau tava dehasya kartA |
dadAmi kiM chApi manaHpraNItaM; priyAtithe tava kAmAnvRRiNIShva
shlokas.19:
tenaivamuktastamahaM pratyavochaM; prApto.asmi te viShayaM durnivartyam |
ichChAmyahaM puNyakRRitAM samRRiddhA.N;llokAndraShTuM yadi te.ahaM varArhaH
shlokas.20:
yAnaM samAropya tu mAM sa devo; vAhairyuktaM suprabhaM bhAnumantam |
sa.ndarshayAmAsa tadA sma lokA;nsarvA.nstadA puNyakRRitAM dvijendra
shlokas.21:
apashyaM tatra veshmAni taijasAni kRRitAtmanAm |
nAnAsa.nsthAnarUpANi sarvaratnamayAni cha
shlokas.22:
chandramaNDalashubhrANi ki~NkiNIjAlavanti cha |
anekashatabhaumAni sAntarjalavanAni cha
shlokas.23:
vaiDUryArkaprakAshAni rUpyarukmamayAni cha |
taruNAdityavarNAni sthAvarANi charANi cha
shlokas.24:
bhakShyabhojyamayA~nshailAnvAsA.nsi shayanAni cha |
sarvakAmaphalA.nshchaiva vRRikShAnbhavanasa.nsthitAn
shlokas.25:
nadyo vIthyaH sabhA vApI dIrghikAshchaiva sarvashaH |
ghoShavanti cha yAnAni yuktAnyeva sahasrashaH
shlokas.26:
kShIrasravA vai sarito girI.nshcha; sarpistathA vimalaM chApi toyam |
vaivasvatasyAnumatA.nshcha deshA;nadRRiShTapUrvAnsubahUnapashyam
shlokas.27:
sarvaM dRRiShTvA tadahaM dharmarAja;mavochaM vai prabhaviShNuM purANam |
kShIrasyaitAH sarpiShashchaiva nadyaH; shashvatsrotAH kasya bhojyAH pradiShTAH
shlokas.28:
yamo.abravIdviddhi bhojyAstvametA; ye dAtAraH sAdhavo gorasAnAm |
anye lokAH shAshvatA vItashokAH; samAkIrNA gopradAne ratAnAm
shlokas.29:
na tvevAsAM dAnamAtraM prashastaM; pAtraM kAlo govisheSho vidhishcha |
j~nAtvA deyA vipra gavAntaraM hi; duHkhaM j~nAtuM pAvakAdityabhUtam
shlokas.30:
svAdhyAyADhyo yo.atimAtraM tapasvI; vaitAnastho brAhmaNaH pAtramAsAm |
kRRichChrotsRRiShTAH poShaNAbhyAgatAshcha; dvArairetairgovisheShAH prashastAH
shlokas.31:
tisro rAtrIradbhirupoShya bhUmau; tRRiptA gAvastarpitebhyaH pradeyAH |
vatsaiH prItAH suprajAH sopachArA;stryahaM dattvA gorasairvartitavyam
shlokas.32:
dattvA dhenuM suvratAM kA.nsyadohAM; kalyANavatsAmapalAyinIM cha |
yAvanti lomAni bhavanti tasyA;stAvadvarShANyashnute svargalokam
shlokas.33:
tathAnaDvAhaM brAhmaNAya pradAya; dAntaM dhuryaM balavantaM yuvAnam |
kulAnujIvaM vIryavantaM bRRihantaM; bhu~Nkte lokAnsaMmitAndhenudasya
shlokas.34:
goShu kShAntaM gosharaNyaM kRRitaj~naM; vRRittiglAnaM tAdRRishaM pAtramAhuH |
vRRittiglAne sambhrame vA mahArthe; kRRiShyarthe vA homahetoH prasUtyAm
shlokas.35:
gurvarthe vA bAlapuShTyAbhiSha~NgA;dgAvo dAtuM deshakAlo.avishiShTaH |
antarjAtAH sukrayaj~nAnalabdhAH; prANakrItA nirjitAshchaudakAshcha
shlokas.36:
nAchiketa uvAcha||
shrutvA vaivasvatavachastamahaM punarabruvam |
agomI gopradAtR^INAM kathaM lokAnnigachChati
shlokas.37:
tato yamo.abravIddhImAngopradAne parAM gatim |
gopradAnAnukalpaM tu gAmRRite santi gopradAH
shlokas.38:
alAbhe yo gavAM dadyAdghRRitadhenuM yatavrataH |
tasyaitA ghRRitavAhinyaH kSharante vatsalA iva
shlokas.39:
ghRRitAlAbhe cha yo dadyAttiladhenuM yatavrataH |
sa durgAttArito dhenvA kShIranadyAM pramodate
shlokas.40:
tilAlAbhe cha yo dadyAjjaladhenuM yatavrataH |
sa kAmapravahAM shItAM nadImetAmupAshnute
shlokas.41:
evamAdIni me tatra dharmarAjo nyadarshayat |
dRRiShTvA cha paramaM harShamavApamahamachyuta
shlokas.42:
nivedaye chApi priyaM bhavatsu; kraturmahAnalpadhanaprachAraH |
prApto mayA tAta sa matprasUtaH; prapatsyate vedavidhipravRRittaH
shlokas.43:
shApo hyayaM bhavato.anugrahAya; prApto mayA yatra dRRiShTo yamo me |
dAnavyuShTiM tatra dRRiShTvA mahArthAM; niHsa.ndigdhaM dAnadharmA.nshchariShye
shlokas.44:
idaM cha mAmabravIddharmarAjaH; punaH punaH samprahRRiShTo dvijarShe |
dAnena tAta prayato.abhUH sadaiva; visheShato gopradAnaM cha kuryAH
shlokas.45:
shuddho hyartho nAvamanyaH svadharmA;tpAtre deyaM deshakAlopapanne |
tasmAdgAvaste nityameva pradeyA; mA bhUchcha te sa.nshayaH kashchidatra
shlokas.46:
etAH purA adadannityameva; shAntAtmAno dAnapathe niviShTAH |
tapA.nsyugrANyapratisha~NkamAnA;ste vai dAnaM pradadushchApi shaktyA
shlokas.47:
kAle shaktyA matsaraM varjayitvA; shuddhAtmAnaH shraddhinaH puNyashIlAH |
dattvA taptvA lokamamuM prapannA; dedIpyante puNyashIlAshcha nAke
shlokas.48:
etaddAnaM nyAyalabdhaM dvijebhyaH; pAtre dattaM prApaNIyaM parIkShya |
kAmyAShTamyAM vartitavyaM dashAhaM; rasairgavAM shakRRitA prasnavairvA
shlokas.49:
vedavratI syAdvRRiShabhapradAtA; vedAvAptirgoyugasya pradAne |
tIrthAvAptirgoprayuktapradAne; pApotsargaH kapilAyAH pradAne
shlokas.50:
gAmapyekAM kapilAM sampradAya; nyAyopetAM kalmaShAdvipramuchyet |
gavAM rasAtparamaM nAsti kiM chi;dgavAM dAnaM sumahattadvadanti
shlokas.51:
gAvo lokAndhArayanti kSharantyo; gAvashchAnnaM sa~njanayanti loke |
yastajjAnanna gavAM hArdameti; sa vai gantA nirayaM pApachetAH
shlokas.52:
yatte dAtuM gosahasraM shataM vA; shatArdhaM vA dasha vA sAdhuvatsAH |
apyekAM vA sAdhave brAhmaNAya; sAsyAmuShminpuNyatIrthA nadI vai
shlokas.53:
prAptyA puShTyA lokasa.nrakShaNena; gAvastulyAH sUryapAdaiH pRRithivyAm |
shabdashchaikaH santatishchopabhoga;stasmAdgodaH sUrya ivAbhibhAti
shlokas.54:
guruM shiShyo varayedgopradAne; sa vai vaktA niyataM svargadAtA |
vidhij~nAnAM sumahAneSha dharmo; vidhiM hyAdyaM vidhayaH sa.nshrayanti
shlokas.55:
etaddAnaM nyAyalabdhaM dvijebhyaH; pAtre dattvA prApayethAH parIkShya |
tvayyAsha.nsantyamarA mAnavAshcha; vayaM chApi prasRRite puNyashIlAH
shlokas.56:
ityukto.ahaM dharmarAj~nA maharShe; dharmAtmAnaM shirasAbhipraNamya |
anuj~nAtastena vaivasvatena; pratyAgamaM bhagavatpAdamUlam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
uktaM vai gopradAnaM te nAchiketamRRiShiM prati |
mAhAtmyamapi chaivoktamuddeshena gavAM prabho
shlokas.2:
nRRigeNa cha yathA duHkhamanubhUtaM mahAtmanA |
ekAparAdhAdaj~nAnAtpitAmaha mahAmate
shlokas.3:
dvAravatyAM yathA chAsau nivishantyAM samuddhRRitaH |
mokShaheturabhUtkRRiShNastadapyavadhRRitaM mayA
shlokas.4:
kiM tvasti mama sa.ndeho gavAM lokaM prati prabho |
tattvataH shrotumichChAmi godA yatra vishantyuta
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
yathApRRichChatpadmayonimetadeva shatakratuH
shlokas.6:
shakra uvAcha||
svarlokavAsinAM lakShmImabhibhUya svayA tviShA |
golokavAsinaH pashye vrajataH sa.nshayo.atra me
shlokas.7:
kIdRRishA bhagava.NllokA gavAM tadbrUhi me.anagha |
yAnAvasanti dAtAra etadichChAmi veditum
shlokas.8:
kIdRRishAH kimphalAH kaH svitparamastatra vai guNaH |
kathaM cha puruShAstatra gachChanti vigatajvarAH
shlokas.9:
kiyatkAlaM pradAnasya dAtA cha phalamashnute |
kathaM bahuvidhaM dAnaM syAdalpamapi vA katham
shlokas.10:
bahvInAM kIdRRishaM dAnamalpAnAM vApi kIdRRisham |
adattvA gopradAH santi kena vA tachcha sha.nsa me
shlokas.11:
kathaM cha bahudAtA syAdalpadAtrA samaH prabho |
alpapradAtA bahudaH kathaM cha syAdiheshvara
shlokas.12:
kIdRRishI dakShiNA chaiva gopradAne vishiShyate |
etattathyena bhagavanmama sha.nsitumarhasi

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
yo.ayaM prashnastvayA pRRiShTo gopradAnAdhikAravAn |
nAsya praShTAsti loke.asmi.nstvatto.anyo hi shatakrato
shlokas.2:
santi nAnAvidhA lokA yA.nstvaM shakra na pashyasi |
pashyAmi yAnahaM lokAnekapatnyashcha yAH striyaH
shlokas.3:
karmabhishchApi sushubhaiH suvratA RRiShayastathA |
sasharIrA hi tAnyAnti brAhmaNAH shubhavRRittayaH
shlokas.4:
sharIranyAsamokSheNa manasA nirmalena cha |
svapnabhUtA.nshcha tA.NllokAnpashyantIhApi suvratAH
shlokas.5:
te tu lokAH sahasrAkSha shRRiNu yAdRRigguNAnvitAH |
na tatra kramate kAlo na jarA na cha pApakam
tathAnyannAshubhaM ki~nchinna vyAdhistatra na klamaH
shlokas.6:
yadyachcha gAvo manasA tasminvA~nChanti vAsava |
tatsarvaM prApayanti sma mama pratyakShadarshanAt
kAmagAH kAmachAriNyaH kAmAtkAmA.nshcha bhu~njate
shlokas.7:
vApyaH sarA.nsi sarito vividhAni vanAni cha |
gRRihANi parvatAshchaiva yAvaddravyaM cha ki~nchana
shlokas.8:
manoj~naM sarvabhUtebhyaH sarvaM tatra pradRRishyate |
IdRRishAnviddhi tA.NllokAnnAsti lokastato.adhikaH
shlokas.9:
tatra sarvasahAH kShAntA vatsalA guruvartinaH |
aha~NkArairvirahitA yAnti shakra narottamAH
shlokas.10:
yaH sarvamA.nsAni na bhakShayIta; pumAnsadA yAvadantAya yuktaH |
mAtApitrorarchitA satyayuktaH; shushrUShitA brAhmaNAnAmanindyaH
shlokas.11:
akrodhano goShu tathA dvijeShu; dharme rato gurushushrUShakashcha |
yAvajjIvaM satyavRRitte ratashcha; dAne rato yaH kShamI chAparAdhe
shlokas.12:
mRRidurdAnto devaparAyaNashcha; sarvAtithishchApi tathA dayAvAn |
IdRRigguNo mAnavaH samprayAti; lokaM gavAM shAshvataM chAvyayaM cha
shlokas.13:
na pAradArI pashyati lokamenaM; na vai gurughno na mRRiShApralApI |
sadApavAdI brAhmaNaH shAntavedo; doShairanyairyashcha yukto durAtmA
shlokas.14:
na mitradhru~NnaikRRitikaH kRRitaghnaH; shaTho.anRRijurdharmavidveShakashcha |
na brahmahA manasApi prapashye;dgavAM lokaM puNyakRRitAM nivAsam
shlokas.15:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM naipuNena sureshvara |
gopradAnaratAnAM tu phalaM shRRiNu shatakrato
shlokas.16:
dAyAdyalabdhairarthairyo gAH krItvA samprayachChati |
dharmArjitadhanakrItAnsa lokAnashnute.akShayAn
shlokas.17:
yo vai dyUte dhanaM jitvA gAH krItvA samprayachChati |
sa divyamayutaM shakra varShANAM phalamashnute
shlokas.18:
dAyAdyA yasya vai gAvo nyAyapUrvairupArjitAH |
pradattAstAH pradAtR^INAM sambhavantyakShayA dhruvAH
shlokas.19:
pratigRRihya cha yo dadyAdgAH sushuddhena chetasA |
tasyApIhAkShayA.NllokAndhruvAnviddhi shachIpate
shlokas.20:
janmaprabhRRiti satyaM cha yo brUyAnniyatendriyaH |
gurudvijasahaH kShAntastasya gobhiH samA gatiH
shlokas.21:
na jAtu brAhmaNo vAchyo yadavAchyaM shachIpate |
manasA goShu na druhyedgovRRittirgonukampakaH
shlokas.22:
satye dharme cha niratastasya shakra phalaM shRRiNu |
gosahasreNa samitA tasya dhenurbhavatyuta
shlokas.23:
kShatriyasya guNairebhiranvitasya phalaM shRRiNu |
tasyApi shatatulyA gaurbhavatIti vinishchayaH
shlokas.24:
vaishyasyaite yadi guNAstasya pa~nchAshataM bhavet |
shUdrasyApi vinItasya chaturbhAgaphalaM smRRitam
shlokas.25:
etachchaivaM yo.anutiShTheta yuktaH; satyena yukto gurushushrUShayA cha |
dAntaH kShAnto devatArchI prashAntaH; shuchirbuddho dharmashIlo.anaha.nvAk
shlokas.26:
mahatphalaM prApnute sa dvijAya; dattvA dogdhrIM vidhinAnena dhenum |
nityaM dadyAdekabhaktaH sadA cha; satye sthito gurushushrUShitA cha
shlokas.27:
vedAdhyAyI goShu yo bhaktimA.nshcha; nityaM dRRiShTvA yo.abhinandeta gAshcha |
A jAtito yashcha gavAM nameta; idaM phalaM shakra nibodha tasya
shlokas.28:
yatsyAdiShTvA rAjasUye phalaM tu; yatsyAdiShTvA bahunA kA~nchanena |
etattulyaM phalamasyAhuragryaM; sarve santastvRRiShayo ye cha siddhAH
shlokas.29:
yo.agraM bhaktAnki~nchidaprAshya dadyA;dgobhyo nityaM govratI satyavAdI |
shAnto buddho gosahasrasya puNyaM; sa.nvatsareNApnuyAtpuNyashIlaH
shlokas.30:
ya ekaM bhaktamashnIyAddadyAdekaM gavAM cha yat |
dasha varShANyanantAni govratI gonukampakaH
shlokas.31:
ekenaiva cha bhaktena yaH krItvA gAM prayachChati |
yAvanti tasya proktAni divasAni shatakrato
tAvachChatAnAM sa gavAM phalamApnoti shAshvatam
shlokas.32:
brAhmaNasya phalaM hIdaM kShatriye.abhihitaM shRRiNu |
pa~nchavArShikametattu kShatriyasya phalaM smRRitam
tato.ardhena tu vaishyasya shUdro vaishyArdhataH smRRitaH
shlokas.33:
yashchAtmavikrayaM kRRitvA gAH krItvA samprayachChati |
yAvatIH sparshayedgA vai tAvattu phalamashnute
lomni lomni mahAbhAga lokAshchAsyAkShayAH smRRitAH
shlokas.34:
sa~NgrAmeShvarjayitvA tu yo vai gAH samprayachChati |
AtmavikrayatulyAstAH shAshvatA viddhi kaushika
shlokas.35:
alAbhe yo gavAM dadyAttiladhenuM yatavrataH |
durgAtsa tArito dhenvA kShIranadyAM pramodate
shlokas.36:
na tvevAsAM dAnamAtraM prashastaM; pAtraM kAlo govisheSho vidhishcha |
kAlaj~nAnaM vipra gavAntaraM hi; duHkhaM j~nAtuM pAvakAdityabhUtam
shlokas.37:
svAdhyAyADhyaM shuddhayoniM prashAntaM; vaitAnasthaM pApabhIruM kRRitaj~nam |
goShu kShAntaM nAtitIkShNaM sharaNyaM; vRRittiglAnaM tAdRRishaM pAtramAhuH
shlokas.38:
vRRittiglAne sIdati chAtimAtraM; kRRiShyarthaM vA homahetoH prasUtyAm |
gurvarthaM vA bAlasa.nvRRiddhaye vA; dhenuM dadyAddeshakAle vishiShTe
shlokas.39:
antarjAtAH sukrayaj~nAnalabdhAH; prANakrItA nirjitAshchaukajAshcha |
kRRichChrotsRRiShTAH poShaNAbhyAgatAshcha; dvArairetairgovisheShAH prashastAH
shlokas.40:
balAnvitAH shIlavayopapannAH; sarvAH prasha.nsanti sugandhavatyaH |
yathA hi ga~NgA saritAM variShThA; tathArjunInAM kapilA variShThA
shlokas.41:
tisro rAtrIstvadbhirupoShya bhUmau; tRRiptA gAvastarpitebhyaH pradeyAH |
vatsaiH puShTaiH kShIrapaiH suprachArA;stryahaM dattvA gorasairvartitavyam
shlokas.42:
dattvA dhenuM suvratAM sAdhuvatsAM; kalyANavRRittAmapalAyinIM cha |
yAvanti lomAni bhavanti tasyA;stAvanti varShANi vasatyamutra
shlokas.43:
tathAnaDvAhaM brAhmaNAyAtha dhuryaM; dattvA yuvAnaM balinaM vinItam |
halasya voDhAramanantavIryaM; prApnoti lokAndashadhenudasya
shlokas.44:
kAntAre brAhmaNAngAshcha yaH paritrAti kaushika |
kShemeNa cha vimuchyeta tasya puNyaphalaM shRRiNu
ashvamedhakratostulyaM phalaM bhavati shAshvatam
shlokas.45:
mRRityukAle sahasrAkSha yAM vRRittimanukA~NkShate |
lokAnbahuvidhAndivyAnyadvAsya hRRidi vartate
shlokas.46:
tatsarvaM samavApnoti karmaNA tena mAnavaH |
gobhishcha samanuj~nAtaH sarvatra sa mahIyate
shlokas.47:
yastvetenaiva vidhinA gAM vaneShvanugachChati |
tRRiNagomayaparNAshI niHspRRiho niyataH shuchiH
shlokas.48:
akAmaM tena vastavyaM muditena shatakrato |
mama loke suraiH sArdhaM loke yatrApi chechChati

shlokas.1:
indra uvAcha||
jAnanyo gAmapaharedvikrIyAdvArthakAraNAt |
etadvij~nAtumichChAmi kA nu tasya gatirbhavet
shlokas.2:
brahmovAcha||
bhakShArthaM vikrayArthaM vA ye.apahAraM hi kurvate |
dAnArthaM vA brAhmaNAya tatredaM shrUyatAM phalam
shlokas.3:
vikrayArthaM hi yo hi.nsyAdbhakShayedvA nira~NkushaH |
ghAtayAnaM hi puruShaM ye.anumanyeyurarthinaH
shlokas.4:
ghAtakaH khAdako vApi tathA yashchAnumanyate |
yAvanti tasyA lomAni tAvadvarShANi majjati
shlokas.5:
ye doShA yAdRRishAshchaiva dvijayaj~nopaghAtake |
vikraye chApahAre cha te doShA vai smRRitAH prabho
shlokas.6:
apahRRitya tu yo gAM vai brAhmaNAya prayachChati |
yAvaddAne phalaM tasyAstAvannirayamRRichChati
shlokas.7:
suvarNaM dakShiNAmAhurgopradAne mahAdyute |
suvarNaM paramaM hyuktaM dakShiNArthamasa.nshayam
shlokas.8:
gopradAnaM tArayate sapta pUrvA.nstathA parAn |
suvarNaM dakShiNAM dattvA tAvaddviguNamuchyate
shlokas.9:
suvarNaM paramaM dAnaM suvarNaM dakShiNA parA |
suvarNaM pAvanaM shakra pAvanAnAM paraM smRRitam
shlokas.10:
kulAnAM pAvanaM prAhurjAtarUpaM shatakrato |
eShA me dakShiNA proktA samAsena mahAdyute
shlokas.11:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etatpitAmahenoktamindrAya bharatarShabha |
indro dasharathAyAha rAmAyAha pitA tathA
shlokas.12:
rAghavo.api priyabhrAtre lakShmaNAya yashasvine |
RRiShibhyo lakShmaNenoktamaraNye vasatA vibho
shlokas.13:
pAramparyAgataM chedamRRiShayaH sa.nshitavratAH |
durdharaM dhArayAmAsU rAjAnashchaiva dhArmikAH
upAdhyAyena gaditaM mama chedaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.14:
ya idaM brAhmaNo nityaM vadedbrAhmaNasa.nsadi |
yaj~neShu gopradAneShu dvayorapi samAgame
shlokas.15:
tasya lokAH kilAkShayyA daivataiH saha nityadA |
iti brahmA sa bhagavAnuvAcha parameshvaraH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
visrambhito.ahaM bhavatA dharmAnpravadatA vibho |
pravakShyAmi tu sa.ndehaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
vratAnAM kiM phalaM proktaM kIdRRishaM vA mahAdyute |
niyamAnAM phalaM kiM cha svadhItasya cha kiM phalam
shlokas.3:
damasyeha phalaM kiM cha vedAnAM dhAraNe cha kim |
adhyApane phalaM kiM cha sarvamichChAmi veditum
shlokas.4:
apratigrAhake kiM cha phalaM loke pitAmaha |
tasya kiM cha phalaM dRRiShTaM shrutaM yaH samprayachChati
shlokas.5:
svakarmaniratAnAM cha shUrANAM chApi kiM phalam |
satye cha kiM phalaM proktaM brahmacharye cha kiM phalam
shlokas.6:
pitRRishushrUShaNe kiM cha mAtRRishushrUShaNe tathA |
AchAryagurushushrUShAsvanukroshAnukampane
shlokas.7:
etatsarvamasheSheNa pitAmaha yathAtatham |
vettumichChAmi dharmaj~na paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.8:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yo vrataM vai yathoddiShTaM tathA sampratipadyate |
akhaNDaM samyagArabdhaM tasya lokAH sanAtanAH
shlokas.9:
niyamAnAM phalaM rAjanpratyakShamiha dRRishyate |
niyamAnAM kratUnAM cha tvayAvAptamidaM phalam
shlokas.10:
svadhItasyApi cha phalaM dRRishyate.amutra cheha cha |
ihaloke.arthavAnnityaM brahmaloke cha modate
shlokas.11:
damasya tu phalaM rAja~nshRRiNu tvaM vistareNa me |
dAntAH sarvatra sukhino dAntAH sarvatra nirvRRitAH
shlokas.12:
yatrechChAgAmino dAntAH sarvashatruniShUdanAH |
prArthayanti cha yaddAntA labhante tanna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.13:
yujyante sarvakAmairhi dAntAH sarvatra pANDava |
svarge tathA pramodante tapasA vikrameNa cha
shlokas.14:
dAnairyaj~naishcha vividhairyathA dAntAH kShamAnvitAH |
dAtA kupyati no dAntastasmAddAnAtparo damaH
shlokas.15:
yastu dadyAdakupyanhi tasya lokAH sanAtanAH |
krodho hanti hi yaddAnaM tasmAddAnAtparo damaH
shlokas.16:
adRRishyAni mahArAja sthAnAnyayutasho divi |
RRiShINAM sarvalokeShu yAnIto yAnti devatAH
shlokas.17:
damena yAni nRRipate gachChanti paramarShayaH |
kAmayAnA mahatsthAnaM tasmAddAnAtparo damaH
shlokas.18:
adhyApakaH parikleshAdakShayaM phalamashnute |
vidhivatpAvakaM hutvA brahmaloke narAdhipa
shlokas.19:
adhItyApi hi yo vedAnnyAyavidbhyaH prayachChati |
gurukarmaprasha.nsI cha so.api svarge mahIyate
shlokas.20:
kShatriyo.adhyayane yukto yajane dAnakarmaNi |
yuddhe yashcha paritrAtA so.api svarge mahIyate
shlokas.21:
vaishyaH svakarmanirataH pradAnAllabhate mahat |
shUdraH svakarmanirataH svargaM shushrUShayArchChati
shlokas.22:
shUrA bahuvidhAH proktAsteShAmarthA.nshcha me shRRiNu |
shUrAnvayAnAM nirdiShTaM phalaM shUrasya chaiva ha
shlokas.23:
yaj~nashUrA dame shUrAH satyashUrAstathApare |
yuddhashUrAstathaivoktA dAnashUrAshcha mAnavAH
shlokas.24:
buddhishUrAstathaivAnye kShamAshUrAstathApare |
Arjave cha tathA shUrAH shame vartanti mAnavAH
shlokas.25:
taistaistu niyamaiH shUrA bahavaH santi chApare |
vedAdhyayanashUrAshcha shUrAshchAdhyApane ratAH
shlokas.26:
gurushushrUShayA shUrAH pitRRishushrUShayApare |
mAtRRishushrUShayA shUrA bhaikShyashUrAstathApare
shlokas.27:
sA~NkhyashUrAshcha bahavo yogashUrAstathApare |
araNye gRRihavAse cha shUrAshchAtithipUjane
sarve yAnti parA.NllokAnsvakarmaphalanirjitAn
shlokas.28:
dhAraNaM sarvavedAnAM sarvatIrthAvagAhanam |
satyaM cha bruvato nityaM samaM vA syAnna vA samam
shlokas.29:
ashvamedhasahasraM cha satyaM cha tulayA dhRRitam |
ashvamedhasahasrAddhi satyameva vishiShyate
shlokas.30:
satyena sUryastapati satyenAgniH pradIpyate |
satyena mAruto vAti sarvaM satye pratiShThitam
shlokas.31:
satyena devAnprINAti pitR^Invai brAhmaNA.nstathA |
satyamAhuH paraM dharmaM tasmAtsatyaM na la~Nghayet
shlokas.32:
munayaH satyaniratA munayaH satyavikramAH |
munayaH satyashapathAstasmAtsatyaM vishiShyate
satyavantaH svargaloke modante bharatarShabha
shlokas.33:
damaH satyaphalAvAptiruktA sarvAtmanA mayA |
asa.nshayaM vinItAtmA sarvaH svarge mahIyate
shlokas.34:
brahmacharyasya tu guNA~nshRRiNu me vasudhAdhipa |
A janmamaraNAdyastu brahmachArI bhavediha
na tasya ki~nchidaprApyamiti viddhi janAdhipa
shlokas.35:
bahvyaH koTyastvRRiShINAM tu brahmaloke vasantyuta |
satye ratAnAM satataM dAntAnAmUrdhvaretasAm
shlokas.36:
brahmacharyaM dahedrAjansarvapApAnyupAsitam |
brAhmaNena visheSheNa brAhmaNo hyagniruchyate
shlokas.37:
pratyakShaM cha tavApyetadbrAhmaNeShu tapasviShu |
bibheti hi yathA shakro brahmachAripradharShitaH
tadbrahmacharyasya phalamRRiShINAmiha dRRishyate
shlokas.38:
mAtApitroH pUjane yo dharmastamapi me shRRiNu |
shushrUShate yaH pitaraM na chAsUyetkatha~nchana
mAtaraM vAnaha.nvAdI gurumAchAryameva cha
shlokas.39:
tasya rAjanphalaM viddhi svarloke sthAnamuttamam |
na cha pashyeta narakaM gurushushrUShurAtmavAn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vidhiM gavAM paramahaM shrotumichChAmi tattvataH |
yena tA~nshAshvatA.NllokAnakhilAnashnuvImahi
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
na godAnAtparaM ki~nchidvidyate vasudhAdhipa |
gaurhi nyAyAgatA dattA sadyastArayate kulam
shlokas.3:
satAmarthe samyagutpAdito yaH; sa vai kL^iptaH samyagiShTaH prajAbhyaH |
tasmAtpUrvaM hyAdikAle pravRRittaM; gavAM dAne shRRiNu rAjanvidhiM me
shlokas.4:
purA goShUpanItAsu goShu sa.ndigdhadarshinA |
mAndhAtrA prakRRitaM prashnaM bRRihaspatirabhAShata
shlokas.5:
dvijAtimabhisatkRRitya shvaH kAlamabhivedya cha |
pradAnArthe niyu~njIta rohiNIM niyatavrataH
shlokas.6:
AhvAnaM cha prayu~njIta sama~Nge bahuleti cha |
pravishya cha gavAM madhyamimAM shrutimudAharet
shlokas.7:
gaurme mAtA govRRiShabhaH pitA me; divaM sharma jagatI me pratiShThA |
prapadyaivaM sharvarImuShya goShu; munirvANImutsRRijedgopradAne
shlokas.8:
sa tAmekAM nishAM gobhiH samasakhyaH samavrataH |
aikAtmyagamanAtsadyaH kalmaShAdvipramuchyate
shlokas.9:
utsRRiShTavRRiShavatsA hi pradeyA sUryadarshane |
trividhaM pratipattavyamarthavAdAshiShaH stavAH
shlokas.10:
Urjasvinya UrjamedhAshcha yaj~no; garbho.amRRitasya jagatashcha pratiShThA |
kShitau rAdhaHprabhavaH shashvadeva; prAjApatyAH sarvamityarthavAdaH
shlokas.11:
gAvo mamainaH praNudantu sauryA;stathA saumyAH svargayAnAya santu |
AmnAtA me dadatIrAshrayaM tu; tathAnuktAH santu sarvAshiSho me
shlokas.12:
sheShotsarge karmabhirdehamokShe; sarasvatyaH shreyasi sampravRRittAH |
yUyaM nityaM puNyakarmopavAhyA; dishadhvaM me gatimiShTAM prapannAH
shlokas.13:
yA vai yUyaM so.ahamadyaikabhAvo; yuShmAndattvA chAhamAtmapradAtA |
manashchyutA manaevopapannAH; sandhukShadhvaM saumyarUpograrUpAH
shlokas.14:
evaM tasyAgre pUrvamardhaM vadeta; gavAM dAtA vidhivatpUrvadRRiShTam |
pratibrUyAchCheShamardhaM dvijAtiH; pratigRRihNanvai gopradAne vidhij~naH
shlokas.15:
gAM dadAnIti vaktavyamarghyavastravasupradaH |
UdhasyA bharitavyA cha vaiShNavIti cha chodayet
shlokas.16:
nAma sa~NkIrtayettasyA yathAsa~NkhyottaraM sa vai |
phalaM ShaDvi.nshadaShTau cha sahasrANi cha vi.nshatiH
shlokas.17:
evametAnguNAnvRRiddhAngavAdInAM yathAkramam |
gopradAtA samApnoti samastAnaShTame krame
shlokas.18:
godaH shIlI nirbhayashchArghadAtA; na syAdduHkhI vasudAtA cha kAmI |
UdhasyoDhA bhArata yashcha vidvA;nvyAkhyAtAste vaiShNavAshchandralokAH
shlokas.19:
gA vai dattvA govratI syAttrirAtraM; nishAM chaikAM sa.nvaseteha tAbhiH |
kAmyAShTamyAM vartitavyaM trirAtraM; rasairvA goH shakRRitA prasnavairvA
shlokas.20:
vedavratI syAdvRRiShabhapradAtA; vedAvAptirgoyugasya pradAne |
tathA gavAM vidhimAsAdya yajvA; lokAnagryAnvindate nAvidhij~naH
shlokas.21:
kAmAnsarvAnpArthivAnekasa.nsthA;nyo vai dadyAtkAmadughAM cha dhenum |
samyaktAH syurhavyakavyaughavatya;stAsAmukShNAM jyAyasAM sampradAnam
shlokas.22:
na chAshiShyAyAvratAyopakuryA;nnAshraddadhAnAya na vakrabuddhaye |
guhyo hyayaM sarvalokasya dharmo; nemaM dharmaM yatra tatra prajalpet
shlokas.23:
santi loke shraddadhAnA manuShyAH; santi kShudrA rAkShasA mAnuSheShu |
yeShAM dAnaM dIyamAnaM hyaniShTaM; nAstikyaM chApyAshrayante hyapuNyAH
shlokas.24:
bArhaspatyaM vAkyametannishamya; ye rAjAno gopradAnAni kRRitvA |
lokAnprAptAH puNyashIlAH suvRRittA;stAnme rAjankIrtyamAnAnnibodha
shlokas.25:
ushInaro viShvagashvo nRRigashcha; bhagIratho vishruto yauvanAshvaH |
mAndhAtA vai muchukundashcha rAjA; bhUridyumno naiShadhaH somakashcha
shlokas.26:
purUravA bharatashchakravartI; yasyAnvaye bhAratAH sarva eva |
tathA vIro dAsharathishcha rAmo; ye chApyanye vishrutAH kIrtimantaH
shlokas.27:
tathA rAjA pRRithukarmA dilIpo; divaM prApto gopradAne vidhij~naH |
yaj~nairdAnaistapasA rAjadharmai;rmAndhAtAbhUdgopradAnaishcha yuktaH
shlokas.28:
tasmAtpArtha tvamapImAM mayoktAM; bArhaspatIM bhAratIM dhArayasva |
dvijAgryebhyaH samprayachCha pratIto; gAH puNyA vai prApya rAjyaM kurUNAm
shlokas.29:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA sarvaM kRRitavAndharmarAjo; bhIShmeNokto vidhivadgopradAne |
sa mAndhAturdevadevopadiShTaM; samyagdharmaM dhArayAmAsa rAjA
shlokas.30:
iti nRRipa satataM gavAM pradAne; yavashakalAnsaha gomayaiH pibAnaH |
kShititalashayanaH shikhI yatAtmA; vRRiSha iva rAjavRRiShastadA babhUva
shlokas.31:
sa nRRipatirabhavatsadaiva tAbhyaH; prayatamanA hyabhisa.nstuva.nshcha gA vai |
nRRipadhuri cha na gAmayu~Nkta bhUya;sturagavarairagamachcha yatra tatra

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA bhUyaH shAntanavaM nRRipa |
godAne vistaraM dhImAnpaprachCha vinayAnvitaH
shlokas.2:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
gopradAne guNAnsamyakpunaH prabrUhi bhArata |
na hi tRRipyAmyahaM vIra shRRiNvAno.amRRitamIdRRisham
shlokas.3:
ityukto dharmarAjena tadA shAntanavo nRRipa |
samyagAha guNA.nstasmai gopradAnasya kevalAn
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vatsalAM guNasampannAM taruNIM vastrasa.nvRRitAm |
dattvedRRishIM gAM viprAya sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.5:
asuryA nAma te lokA gAM dattvA tatra gachChati |
pItodakAM jagdhatRRiNAM naShTadugdhAM nirindriyAm
shlokas.6:
jarogrAmupayuktArthAM jIrNAM kUpamivAjalam |
dattvA tamaH pravishati dvijaM kleshena yojayet
shlokas.7:
duShTA ruShTA vyAdhitA durbalA vA; na dAtavyA yAshcha mUlyairadattaiH |
kleshairvipraM yo.aphalaiH sa.nyunakti; tasyAvIryAshchAphalAshchaiva lokAH
shlokas.8:
balAnvitAH shIlavayopapannAH; sarvAH prasha.nsanti sugandhavatyaH |
yathA hi ga~NgA saritAM variShThA; tathArjunInAM kapilA variShThA
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kasmAtsamAne bahulApradAne; sadbhiH prashastaM kapilApradAnam |
visheShamichChAmi mahAnubhAva; shrotuM samartho hi bhavAnpravaktum
shlokas.10:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vRRiddhAnAM bruvatAM tAta shrutaM me yatprabhAShase |
vakShyAmi tadasheSheNa rohiNyo nirmitA yathA
shlokas.11:
prajAH sRRijeti vyAdiShTaH pUrvaM dakShaH svayambhuvA |
asRRijadvRRittimevAgre prajAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.12:
yathA hyamRRitamAshritya vartayanti divaukasaH |
tathA vRRittiM samAshritya vartayanti prajA vibho
shlokas.13:
acharebhyashcha bhUtebhyashcharAH shreShThAstato narAH |
brAhmaNAshcha tataH shreShThAsteShu yaj~nAH pratiShThitAH
shlokas.14:
yaj~nairApyAyate somaH sa cha goShu pratiShThitaH |
sarve devAH pramodante pUrvavRRittAstataH prajAH
shlokas.15:
etAnyeva tu bhUtAni prAkroshanvRRittikA~NkShayA |
vRRittidaM chAnvapadyanta tRRiShitAH pitRRimAtRRivat
shlokas.16:
itIdaM manasA gatvA prajAsargArthamAtmanaH |
prajApatirbalAdhAnamamRRitaM prApibattadA
shlokas.17:
sa gatastasya tRRiptiM tu gandhaM surabhimudgiran |
dadarshodgArasa.nvRRittAM surabhiM mukhajAM sutAm
shlokas.18:
sAsRRijatsaurabheyIstu surabhirlokamAtaraH |
suvarNavarNAH kapilAH prajAnAM vRRittidhenavaH
shlokas.19:
tAsAmamRRitavarNAnAM kSharantInAM samantataH |
babhUvAmRRitajaH phenaH sravantInAmivormijaH
shlokas.20:
sa vatsamukhavibhraShTo bhavasya bhuvi tiShThataH |
shirasyavApa tatkruddhaH sa tadodaikShata prabhuH
lalATaprabhavenAkShNA rohiNIH pradahanniva
shlokas.21:
tattejastu tato raudraM kapilA gA vishAM pate |
nAnAvarNatvamanayanmeghAniva divAkaraH
shlokas.22:
yAstu tasmAdapakramya somamevAbhisa.nshritAH |
yathotpannAH svavarNasthAstA nItA nAnyavarNatAm
shlokas.23:
atha kruddhaM mahAdevaM prajApatirabhAShata |
amRRitenAvasiktastvaM nochChiShTaM vidyate gavAm
shlokas.24:
yathA hyamRRitamAdAya somo viShyandate punaH |
tathA kShIraM kSharantyetA rohiNyo.amRRitasambhavAH
shlokas.25:
na duShyatyanilo nAgnirna suvarNaM na chodadhiH |
nAmRRitenAmRRitaM pItaM vatsapItA na vatsalA
shlokas.26:
imA.NllokAnbhariShyanti haviShA prasnavena cha |
AsAmaishvaryamashnIhi sarvAmRRitamayaM shubham
shlokas.27:
vRRiShabhaM cha dadau tasmai saha tAbhiH prajApatiH |
prasAdayAmAsa manastena rudrasya bhArata
shlokas.28:
prItashchApi mahAdevashchakAra vRRiShabhaM tadA |
dhvajaM cha vAhanaM chaiva tasmAtsa vRRiShabhadhvajaH
shlokas.29:
tato devairmahAdevastadA pashupatiH kRRitaH |
IshvaraH sa gavAM madhye vRRiShA~Nka iti chochyate
shlokas.30:
evamavyagravarNAnAM kapilAnAM mahaujasAm |
pradAne prathamaH kalpaH sarvAsAmeva kIrtitaH
shlokas.31:
lokajyeShThA lokavRRittipravRRittA; rudropetAH somaviShyandabhUtAH |
saumyAH puNyAH kAmadAH prANadAshcha; gA vai dattvA sarvakAmapradaH syAt
shlokas.32:
imaM gavAM prabhavavidhAnamuttamaM; paThansadA shuchiratima~NgalapriyaH |
vimuchyate kalikaluSheNa mAnavaH; priyaM sutAnpashudhanamApnuyAttathA
shlokas.33:
havyaM kavyaM tarpaNaM shAntikarma; yAnaM vAso vRRiddhabAlasya puShTim |
etAnsarvAngopradAne guNAnvai; dAtA rAjannApnuyAdvai sadaiva
shlokas.34:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pitAmahasyAtha nishamya vAkyaM; rAjA saha bhrAtRRibhirAjamIDhaH |
sauvarNakA.nsyopaduhAstato gAH; pArtho dadau brAhmaNasattamebhyaH
shlokas.35:
tathaiva tebhyo.abhidadau dvijebhyo; gavAM sahasrANi shatAni chaiva |
yaj~nAnsamuddishya cha dakShiNArthe; lokAnvijetuM paramAM cha kIrtim

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etasminneva kAle tu vasiShThamRRiShisattamam |
ikShvAkuva.nshajo rAjA saudAso dadatAM varaH
shlokas.2:
sarvalokacharaM siddhaM brahmakoshaM sanAtanam |
purohitamidaM praShTumabhivAdyopachakrame
shlokas.3:
saudAsa uvAcha||
trailokye bhagavankiM svitpavitraM kathyate.anagha |
yatkIrtayansadA martyaH prApnuyAtpuNyamuttamam
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tasmai provAcha vachanaM praNatAya hitaM tadA |
gavAmupaniShadvidvAnnamaskRRitya gavAM shuchiH
shlokas.5:
gAvaH surabhigandhinyastathA guggulugandhikAH |
gAvaH pratiShThA bhUtAnAM gAvaH svastyayanaM mahat
shlokas.6:
gAvo bhUtaM bhaviShyachcha gAvaH puShTiH sanAtanI |
gAvo lakShmyAstathA mUlaM goShu dattaM na nashyati
annaM hi satataM gAvo devAnAM paramaM haviH
shlokas.7:
svAhAkAravaShaTkArau goShu nityaM pratiShThitau |
gAvo yaj~nasya hi phalaM goShu yaj~nAH pratiShThitAH
shlokas.8:
sAyaM prAtashcha satataM homakAle mahAmate |
gAvo dadati vai homyamRRiShibhyaH puruSharShabha
shlokas.9:
kAnichidyAni durgANi duShkRRitAni kRRitAni cha |
taranti chaiva pApmAnaM dhenuM ye dadati prabho
shlokas.10:
ekAM cha dashagurdadyAddasha dadyAchcha goshatI |
shataM sahasragurdadyAtsarve tulyaphalA hi te
shlokas.11:
anAhitAgniH shatagurayajvA cha sahasraguH |
samRRiddho yashcha kInAsho nArghyamarhanti te trayaH
shlokas.12:
kapilAM ye prayachChanti savatsAM kA.nsyadohanAm |
suvratAM vastrasa.nvItAmubhau lokau jayanti te
shlokas.13:
yuvAnamindriyopetaM shatena saha yUthapam |
gavendraM brAhmaNendrAya bhUrishRRi~Ngamala~NkRRitam
shlokas.14:
vRRiShabhaM ye prayachChanti shrotriyAya parantapa |
aishvaryaM te.abhijAyante jAyamAnAH punaH punaH
shlokas.15:
nAkIrtayitvA gAH supyAnnAsmRRitya punarutpatet |
sAyaM prAtarnamasyechcha gAstataH puShTimApnuyAt
shlokas.16:
gavAM mUtrapurIShasya nodvijeta kadAchana |
na chAsAM mA.nsamashnIyAdgavAM vyuShTiM tathAshnute
shlokas.17:
gAshcha sa~NkIrtayennityaM nAvamanyeta gAstathA |
aniShTaM svapnamAlakShya gAM naraH samprakIrtayet
shlokas.18:
gomayena sadA snAyAdgokarIShe cha sa.nvishet |
shleShmamUtrapurIShANi pratighAtaM cha varjayet
shlokas.19:
sArdracharmaNi bhu~njIta nirIkShanvAruNIM disham |
vAgyataH sarpiShA bhUmau gavAM vyuShTiM tathAshnute
shlokas.20:
ghRRitena juhuyAdagniM ghRRitena svasti vAchayet |
ghRRitaM dadyAdghRRitaM prAshedgavAM vyuShTiM tathAshnute
shlokas.21:
gomatyA vidyayA dhenuM tilAnAmabhimantrya yaH |
rasaratnamayIM dadyAnna sa shochetkRRitAkRRite
shlokas.22:
gAvo mAmupatiShThantu hemashRRi~NgAH payomuchaH |
surabhyaH saurabheyAshcha saritaH sAgaraM yathA
shlokas.23:
gAvaH pashyantu mAM nityaM gAvaH pashyAmyahaM tadA |
gAvo.asmAkaM vayaM tAsAM yato gAvastato vayam
shlokas.24:
evaM rAtrau divA chaiva sameShu viShameShu cha |
mahAbhayeShu cha naraH kIrtayanmuchyate bhayAt

shlokas.1:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
shataM varShasahasrANAM tapastaptaM sudushcharam |
gobhiH pUrvavisRRiShTAbhirgachChema shreShThatAmiti
shlokas.2:
loke.asmindakShiNAnAM cha sarvAsAM vayamuttamAH |
bhavema na cha lipyema doSheNeti parantapa
shlokas.3:
sa eva chetasA tena hato lipyeta sarvadA |
shakRRitA cha pavitrArthaM kurvIrandevamAnuShAH
shlokas.4:
tathA sarvANi bhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha |
pradAtArashcha golokAngachCheyuriti mAnada
shlokas.5:
tAbhyo varaM dadau brahmA tapaso.ante svayaM prabhuH |
evaM bhavatviti vibhurlokA.nstArayateti cha
shlokas.6:
uttasthuH siddhikAmAstA bhUtabhavyasya mAtaraH |
tapaso.ante mahArAja gAvo lokaparAyaNAH
shlokas.7:
tasmAdgAvo mahAbhAgAH pavitraM paramuchyate |
tathaiva sarvabhUtAnAM gAvastiShThanti mUrdhani
shlokas.8:
samAnavatsAM kapilAM dhenuM dattvA payasvinIm |
suvratAM vastrasa.nvItAM brahmaloke mahIyate
shlokas.9:
rohiNIM tulyavatsAM tu dhenuM dattvA payasvinIm |
suvratAM vastrasa.nvItAM sUryaloke mahIyate
shlokas.10:
samAnavatsAM shabalAM dhenuM dattvA payasvinIm |
suvratAM vastrasa.nvItAM somaloke mahIyate
shlokas.11:
samAnavatsAM shvetAM tu dhenuM dattvA payasvinIm |
suvratAM vastrasa.nvItAmindraloke mahIyate
shlokas.12:
samAnavatsAM kRRiShNAM tu dhenuM dattvA payasvinIm |
suvratAM vastrasa.nvItAmagniloke mahIyate
shlokas.13:
samAnavatsAM dhUmrAM tu dhenuM dattvA payasvinIm |
suvratAM vastrasa.nvItAM yAmyaloke mahIyate
shlokas.14:
apAM phenasavarNAM tu savatsAM kA.nsyadohanAm |
pradAya vastrasa.nvItAM vAruNaM lokamashnute
shlokas.15:
vAtareNusavarNAM tu savatsAM kA.nsyadohanAm |
pradAya vastrasa.nvItAM vAyuloke mahIyate
shlokas.16:
hiraNyavarNAM pi~NgAkShIM savatsAM kA.nsyadohanAm |
pradAya vastrasa.nvItAM kauberaM lokamashnute
shlokas.17:
palAladhUmravarNAM tu savatsAM kA.nsyadohanAm |
pradAya vastrasa.nvItAM pitRRiloke mahIyate
shlokas.18:
savatsAM pIvarIM dattvA shitikaNThAmala~NkRRitAm |
vaishvadevamasambAdhaM sthAnaM shreShThaM prapadyate
shlokas.19:
samAnavatsAM gaurIM tu dhenuM dattvA payasvinIm |
suvratAM vastrasa.nvItAM vasUnAM lokamashnute
shlokas.20:
pANDukambalavarNAM tu savatsAM kA.nsyadohanAm |
pradAya vastrasa.nvItAM sAdhyAnAM lokamashnute
shlokas.21:
vairATapRRiShThamukShANaM sarvaratnairala~NkRRitam |
pradAya marutAM lokAnajarAnpratipadyate
shlokas.22:
vatsopapannAM nIlA~NgAM sarvaratnasamanvitAm |
gandharvApsarasAM lokAndattvA prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.23:
shitikaNThamanaDvAhaM sarvaratnairala~NkRRitam |
dattvA prajApaterlokAnvishokaH pratipadyate
shlokas.24:
gopradAnarato yAti bhittvA jaladasa~nchayAn |
vimAnenArkavarNena divi rAjanvirAjatA
shlokas.25:
taM chAruveShAH sushroNyaH sahasraM varayoShitaH |
ramayanti narashreShTha gopradAnarataM naram
shlokas.26:
vINAnAM vallakInAM cha nUpurANAM cha shi~njitaiH |
hAsaishcha hariNAkShINAM prasuptaH pratibodhyate
shlokas.27:
yAvanti lomAni bhavanti dhenvA;stAvanti varShANi mahIyate saH |
svargAchchyutashchApi tato nRRiloke; kule samutpatsyati gominAM saH

shlokas.1:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
ghRRitakShIrapradA gAvo ghRRitayonyo ghRRitodbhavAH |
ghRRitanadyo ghRRitAvartAstA me santu sadA gRRihe
shlokas.2:
ghRRitaM me hRRidaye nityaM ghRRitaM nAbhyAM pratiShThitam |
ghRRitaM sarveShu gAtreShu ghRRitaM me manasi sthitam
shlokas.3:
gAvo mamAgrato nityaM gAvaH pRRiShThata eva cha |
gAvo me sarvatashchaiva gavAM madhye vasAmyaham
shlokas.4:
ityAchamya japetsAyaM prAtashcha puruShaH sadA |
yadahnA kurute pApaM tasmAtsa parimuchyate
shlokas.5:
prAsAdA yatra sauvarNA vasordhArA cha yatra sA |
gandharvApsaraso yatra tatra yAnti sahasradAH
shlokas.6:
navanItapa~NkAH kShIrodA dadhishaivalasa~NkulAH |
vahanti yatra nadyo vai tatra yAnti sahasradAH
shlokas.7:
gavAM shatasahasraM tu yaH prayachChedyathAvidhi |
parAmRRiddhimavApyAtha sa goloke mahIyate
shlokas.8:
dasha chobhayataH pretya mAtApitroH pitAmahAn |
dadhAti sukRRitA.NllokAnpunAti cha kulaM naraH
shlokas.9:
dhenvAH pramANena samapramANAM; dhenuM tilAnAmapi cha pradAya |
pAnIyadAtA cha yamasya loke; na yAtanAM kA~nchidupaiti tatra
shlokas.10:
pavitramagryaM jagataH pratiShThA; divaukasAM mAtaro.athAprameyAH |
anvAlabheddakShiNato vrajechcha; dadyAchcha pAtre prasamIkShya kAlam
shlokas.11:
dhenuM savatsAM kapilAM bhUrishRRi~NgAM; kA.nsyopadohAM vasanottarIyAm |
pradAya tAM gAhati durvigAhyAM; yAmyAM sabhAM vItabhayo manuShyaH
shlokas.12:
surUpA bahurUpAshcha vishvarUpAshcha mAtaraH |
gAvo mAmupatiShThantAmiti nityaM prakIrtayet
shlokas.13:
nAtaH puNyataraM dAnaM nAtaH puNyataraM phalam |
nAto vishiShTaM lokeShu bhUtaM bhavitumarhati
shlokas.14:
tvachA lomnAtha shRRi~Ngaishcha vAlaiH kShIreNa medasA |
yaj~naM vahanti sambhUya kimastyabhyadhikaM tataH
shlokas.15:
yayA sarvamidaM vyAptaM jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam |
tAM dhenuM shirasA vande bhUtabhavyasya mAtaram
shlokas.16:
guNavachanasamuchchayaikadesho; nRRivara mayaiSha gavAM prakIrtitaste |
na hi paramiha dAnamasti gobhyo; bhavanti na chApi parAyaNaM tathAnyat
shlokas.17:
bhIShma uvAcha||
paramidamiti bhUmipo vichintya; pravaramRRiShervachanaM tato mahAtmA |
vyasRRijata niyatAtmavAndvijebhyaH; subahu cha godhanamAptavA.nshcha lokAn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pavitrANAM pavitraM yachChreShThaM loke cha yadbhavet |
pAvanaM paramaM chaiva tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
gAvo mahArthAH puNyAshcha tArayanti cha mAnavAn |
dhArayanti prajAshchemAH payasA haviShA tathA
shlokas.3:
na hi puNyatamaM ki~nchidgobhyo bharatasattama |
etAH pavitrAH puNyAshcha triShu lokeShvanuttamAH
shlokas.4:
devAnAmupariShTAchcha gAvaH prativasanti vai |
dattvA chaitA narapate yAnti svargaM manIShiNaH
shlokas.5:
mAndhAtA yauvanAshvashcha yayAtirnahuShastathA |
gAvo dadantaH satataM sahasrashatasaMmitAH
gatAH paramakaM sthAnaM devairapi sudurlabham
shlokas.7:
api chAtra purAvRRittaM kathayiShyAmi te.anagha |
RRiShINAmuttamaM dhImAnkRRiShNadvaipAyanaM shukaH |
abhivAdyAhnikaM kRRitvA shuchiH prayatamAnasaH
pitaraM paripaprachCha dRRiShTalokaparAvaram
shlokas.8:
ko yaj~naH sarvayaj~nAnAM variShTha upalakShyate |
kiM cha kRRitvA paraM svargaM prApnuvanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.9:
kena devAH pavitreNa svargamashnanti vA vibho |
kiM cha yaj~nasya yaj~natvaM kva cha yaj~naH pratiShThitaH
shlokas.10:
dAnAnAmuttamaM kiM cha kiM cha satramataH param |
pavitrANAM pavitraM cha yattadbrUhi mamAnagha
shlokas.11:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM vyAsaH paramadharmavit |
putrAyAkathayatsarvaM tattvena bharatarShabha
shlokas.12:
vyAsa uvAcha||
gAvaH pratiShThA bhUtAnAM tathA gAvaH parAyaNam |
gAvaH puNyAH pavitrAshcha pAvanaM dharma eva cha
shlokas.13:
pUrvamAsannashRRi~NgA vai gAva ityanushushrumaH |
shRRi~NgArthe samupAsanta tAH kila prabhumavyayam
shlokas.14:
tato brahmA tu gAH prAyamupaviShTAH samIkShya ha |
IpsitaM pradadau tAbhyo gobhyaH pratyekashaH prabhuH
shlokas.15:
tAsAM shRRi~NgANyajAyanta yasyA yAdRRi~Nmanogatam |
nAnAvarNAH shRRi~NgavantyastA vyarochanta putraka
shlokas.16:
brahmaNA varadattAstA havyakavyapradAH shubhAH |
puNyAH pavitrAH subhagA divyasa.nsthAnalakShaNAH
gAvastejo mahaddivyaM gavAM dAnaM prashasyate
shlokas.17:
ye chaitAH samprayachChanti sAdhavo vItamatsarAH |
te vai sukRRitinaH proktAH sarvadAnapradAshcha te
gavAM lokaM tathA puNyamApnuvanti cha te.anagha
shlokas.18:
yatra vRRikShA madhuphalA divyapuShpaphalopagAH |
puShpANi cha sugandhIni divyAni dvijasattama
shlokas.19:
sarvA maNimayI bhUmiH sUkShmakA~nchanavAlukA |
sarvatra sukhasa.nsparshA niShpa~NkA nIrajA shubhA
shlokas.20:
raktotpalavanaishchaiva maNidaNDairhiraNmayaiH |
taruNAdityasa~NkAshairbhAnti tatra jalAshayAH
shlokas.21:
mahArhamaNipatraishcha kA~nchanaprabhakesaraiH |
nIlotpalavimishraishcha sarobhirbahupa~NkajaiH
shlokas.22:
karavIravanaiH phullaiH sahasrAvartasa.nvRRitaiH |
santAnakavanaiH phullairvRRikShaishcha samala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.23:
nirmalAbhishcha muktAbhirmaNibhishcha mahAdhanaiH |
uddhUtapulinAstatra jAtarUpaishcha nimnagAH
shlokas.24:
sarvaratnamayaishchitrairavagADhA nagottamaiH |
jAtarUpamayaishchAnyairhutAshanasamaprabhaiH
shlokas.25:
sauvarNagirayastatra maNiratnashilochchayAH |
sarvaratnamayairbhAnti shRRi~NgaishchArubhiruchChritaiH
shlokas.26:
nityapuShpaphalAstatra nagAH patrarathAkulAH |
divyagandharasaiH puShpaiH phalaishcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.27:
ramante puNyakarmANastatra nityaM yudhiShThira |
sarvakAmasamRRiddhArthA niHshokA gatamanyavaH
shlokas.28:
vimAneShu vichitreShu ramaNIyeShu bhArata |
modante puNyakarmANo viharanto yashasvinaH
shlokas.29:
upakrIDanti tAnrAja~nshubhAshchApsarasAM gaNAH |
etA.NllokAnavApnoti gAM dattvA vai yudhiShThira
shlokas.30:
yAsAmadhipatiH pUShA mAruto balavAnbalI |
aishvarye varuNo rAjA tA mAM pAntu yugandharAH
shlokas.31:
surUpA bahurUpAshcha vishvarUpAshcha mAtaraH |
prAjApatyA iti brahma~njapennityaM yatavrataH
shlokas.32:
gAstu shushrUShate yashcha samanveti cha sarvashaH |
tasmai tuShTAH prayachChanti varAnapi sudurlabhAn
shlokas.33:
na druhyenmanasA chApi goShu tA hi sukhapradAH |
archayeta sadA chaiva namaskAraishcha pUjayet
dAntaH prItamanA nityaM gavAM vyuShTiM tathAshnute
shlokas.34:
yena devAH pavitreNa bhu~njate lokamuttamam |
yatpavitraM pavitrANAM tadghRRitaM shirasA vahet
shlokas.35:
ghRRitena juhuyAdagniM ghRRitena svasti vAchayet |
ghRRitaM prAshedghRRitaM dadyAdgavAM vyuShTiM tathAshnute
shlokas.36:
tryahamuShNaM pibenmUtraM tryahamuShNaM pibetpayaH |
gavAmuShNaM payaH pItvA tryahamuShNaM ghRRitaM pibet
tryahamuShNaM ghRRitaM pItvA vAyubhakSho bhavettryaham
shlokas.37:
nirhRRitaishcha yavairgobhirmAsaM prasRRitayAvakaH |
brahmahatyAsamaM pApaM sarvametena shudhyati
shlokas.38:
parAbhavArthaM daityAnAM devaiH shauchamidaM kRRitam |
devatvamapi cha prAptAH sa.nsiddhAshcha mahAbalAH
shlokas.39:
gAvaH pavitrAH puNyAshcha pAvanaM paramaM mahat |
tAshcha dattvA dvijAtibhyo naraH svargamupAshnute
shlokas.40:
gavAM madhye shuchirbhUtvA gomatIM manasA japet |
pUtAbhiradbhirAchamya shuchirbhavati nirmalaH
shlokas.41:
agnimadhye gavAM madhye brAhmaNAnAM cha sa.nsadi |
vidyAvedavratasnAtA brAhmaNAH puNyakarmiNaH
shlokas.42:
adhyApayera~nshiShyAnvai gomatIM yaj~nasaMmitAm |
trirAtropoShitaH shrutvA gomatIM labhate varam
shlokas.43:
putrakAmashcha labhate putraM dhanamathApi cha |
patikAmA cha bhartAraM sarvakAmA.nshcha mAnavaH
gAvastuShTAH prayachChanti sevitA vai na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.44:
evametA mahAbhAgA yaj~niyAH sarvakAmadAH |
rohiNya iti jAnIhi naitAbhyo vidyate param
shlokas.45:
ityuktaH sa mahAtejAH shukaH pitrA mahAtmanA |
pUjayAmAsa gA nityaM tasmAttvamapi pUjaya

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mayA gavAM purIShaM vai shriyA juShTamiti shrutam |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM sa.nshayo.atra hi me mahAn
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
gobhirnRRipeha sa.nvAdaM shriyA bharatasattama
shlokas.3:
shrIH kRRitveha vapuH kAntaM gomadhyaM pravivesha ha |
gAvo.atha vismitAstasyA dRRiShTvA rUpasya sampadam
shlokas.4:
gAva UchuH||
kAsi devi kuto vA tvaM rUpeNApratimA bhuvi |
vismitAH sma mahAbhAge tava rUpasya sampadA
shlokas.5:
ichChAmastvAM vayaM j~nAtuM kA tvaM kva cha gamiShyasi |
tattvena cha suvarNAbhe sarvametadbravIhi naH
shlokas.6:
shrIruvAcha||
lokakAntAsmi bhadraM vaH shrIrnAmneha parishrutA |
mayA daityAH parityaktA vinaShTAH shAshvatIH samAH
shlokas.7:
indro vivasvAnsomashcha viShNurApo.agnireva cha |
mayAbhipannA RRidhyante RRiShayo devatAstathA
shlokas.8:
yA.nshcha dviShAmyahaM gAvaste vinashyanti sarvashaH |
dharmArthakAmahInAshcha te bhavantyasukhAnvitAH
shlokas.9:
evamprabhAvAM mAM gAvo vijAnIta sukhapradAm |
ichChAmi chApi yuShmAsu vastuM sarvAsu nityadA
AgatA prArthayAnAhaM shrIjuShTA bhavatAnaghAH
shlokas.10:
gAva UchuH||
adhruvAM cha~nchalAM cha tvAM sAmAnyAM bahubhiH saha |
na tvAmichChAmi bhadraM te gamyatAM yatra rochate
shlokas.11:
vapuShmantyo vayaM sarvAH kimasmAkaM tvayAdya vai |
yatreShTaM gamyatAM tatra kRRitakAryA vayaM tvayA
shlokas.12:
shrIruvAcha||
kimetadvaH kShamaM gAvo yanmAM nehAbhyanandatha |
na mAM samprati gRRihNItha kasmAdvai durlabhAM satIm
shlokas.13:
satyashcha lokavAdo.ayaM loke charati suvratAH |
svayaM prApte paribhavo bhavatIti vinishchayaH
shlokas.14:
mahadugraM tapaH kRRitvA mAM niShevanti mAnavAH |
devadAnavagandharvAH pishAchoragarAkShasAH
shlokas.15:
kShamametaddhi vo gAvaH pratigRRihNIta mAmiha |
nAvamanyA hyahaM saumyAstrailokye sacharAchare
shlokas.16:
gAva UchuH||
nAvamanyAmahe devi na tvAM paribhavAmahe |
adhruvA chalachittAsi tatastvAM varjayAmahe
shlokas.17:
bahunAtra kimuktena gamyatAM yatra vA~nChasi |
vapuShmatyo vayaM sarvAH kimasmAkaM tvayAnaghe
shlokas.18:
shrIruvAcha||
avaj~nAtA bhaviShyAmi sarvalokeShu mAnadAH |
pratyAkhyAnena yuShmAbhiH prasAdaH kriyatAmiti
shlokas.19:
mahAbhAgA bhavatyo vai sharaNyAH sharaNAgatAm |
paritrAyantu mAM nityaM bhajamAnAmaninditAm
mAnanAM tvahamichChAmi bhavatyaH satataM shubhAH
shlokas.20:
apyekA~Nge tu vo vastumichChAmi cha sukutsite |
na vo.asti kutsitaM ki~nchida~NgeShvAlakShyate.anaghAH
shlokas.21:
puNyAH pavitrAH subhagA mamAdeshaM prayachChata |
vaseyaM yatra chA~Nge.ahaM tanme vyAkhyAtumarhatha
shlokas.22:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktAstu tA gAvaH shubhAH karuNavatsalAH |
saMmantrya sahitAH sarvAH shriyamUchurnarAdhipa
shlokas.23:
avashyaM mAnanA kAryA tavAsmAbhiryashasvini |
shakRRinmUtre nivasa naH puNyametaddhi naH shubhe
shlokas.24:
shrIruvAcha||
diShTyA prasAdo yuShmAbhiH kRRito me.anugrahAtmakaH |
evaM bhavatu bhadraM vaH pUjitAsmi sukhapradAH
shlokas.25:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evaM kRRitvA tu samayaM shrIrgobhiH saha bhArata |
pashyantInAM tatastAsAM tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.26:
etadgoshakRRitaH putra mAhAtmyaM te.anuvarNitam |
mAhAtmyaM cha gavAM bhUyaH shrUyatAM gadato mama

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ye cha gAH samprayachChanti hutashiShTAshinashcha ye |
teShAM satrANi yaj~nAshcha nityameva yudhiShThira
shlokas.2:
RRite dadhighRRiteneha na yaj~naH sampravartate |
tena yaj~nasya yaj~natvamatomUlaM cha lakShyate
shlokas.3:
dAnAnAmapi sarveShAM gavAM dAnaM prashasyate |
gAvaH shreShThAH pavitrAshcha pAvanaM hyetaduttamam
shlokas.4:
puShTyarthametAH seveta shAntyarthamapi chaiva ha |
payo dadhi ghRRitaM yAsAM sarvapApapramochanam
shlokas.5:
gAvastejaH paraM proktamiha loke paratra cha |
na gobhyaH paramaM ki~nchitpavitraM puruSharShabha
shlokas.6:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
pitAmahasya sa.nvAdamindrasya cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.7:
parAbhUteShu daityeShu shakre tribhuvaneshvare |
prajAH samuditAH sarvAH satyadharmaparAyaNAH
shlokas.8:
atharShayaH sagandharvAH kiMnaroragarAkShasAH |
devAsurasuparNAshcha prajAnAM patayastathA
paryupAsanta kauravya kadAchidvai pitAmaham
shlokas.9:
nAradaH parvatashchaiva vishvAvasuhahAhuhU |
divyatAneShu gAyantaH paryupAsanta taM prabhum
shlokas.10:
tatra divyAni puShpANi prAvahatpavanastathA |
AjahrurRRitavashchApi sugandhIni pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.11:
tasmindevasamAvAye sarvabhUtasamAgame |
divyavAditrasa~NghuShTe divyastrIchAraNAvRRite
indraH paprachCha deveshamabhivAdya praNamya cha
shlokas.12:
devAnAM bhagavankasmAllokeshAnAM pitAmaha |
upariShTAdgavAM loka etadichChAmi veditum
shlokas.13:
kiM tapo brahmacharyaM vA gobhiH kRRitamiheshvara |
devAnAmupariShTAdyadvasantyarajasaH sukham
shlokas.14:
tataH provAcha taM brahmA shakraM balanisUdanam |
avaj~nAtAstvayA nityaM gAvo balanisUdana
shlokas.15:
tena tvamAsAM mAhAtmyaM na vettha shRRiNu tatprabho |
gavAM prabhAvaM paramaM mAhAtmyaM cha surarShabha
shlokas.16:
yaj~nA~NgaM kathitA gAvo yaj~na eva cha vAsava |
etAbhishchApyRRite yaj~no na pravartetkatha~nchana
shlokas.17:
dhArayanti prajAshchaiva payasA haviShA tathA |
etAsAM tanayAshchApi kRRiShiyogamupAsate
shlokas.18:
janayanti cha dhAnyAni bIjAni vividhAni cha |
tato yaj~nAH pravartante havyaM kavyaM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.19:
payo dadhi ghRRitaM chaiva puNyAshchaitAH surAdhipa |
vahanti vividhAnbhArAnkShuttRRiShNAparipIDitAH
shlokas.20:
munI.nshcha dhArayantIha prajAshchaivApi karmaNA |
vAsavAkUTavAhinyaH karmaNA sukRRitena cha
upariShTAttato.asmAkaM vasantyetAH sadaiva hi
shlokas.21:
etatte kAraNaM shakra nivAsakRRitamadya vai |
gavAM devopariShTAddhi samAkhyAtaM shatakrato
shlokas.22:
etA hi varadattAshcha varadAshchaiva vAsava |
saurabhyaH puNyakarmiNyaH pAvanAH shubhalakShaNAH
shlokas.23:
yadarthaM gA gatAshchaiva saurabhyaH surasattama |
tachcha me shRRiNu kArtsnyena vadato balasUdana
shlokas.24:
purA devayuge tAta daityendreShu mahAtmasu |
trI.NllokAnanushAsatsu viShNau garbhatvamAgate
shlokas.25:
adityAstapyamAnAyAstapo ghoraM sudushcharam |
putrArthamamarashreShTha pAdenaikena nityadA
shlokas.26:
tAM tu dRRiShTvA mahAdevIM tapyamAnAM mahattapaH |
dakShasya duhitA devI surabhirnAma nAmataH
shlokas.27:
atapyata tapo ghoraM hRRiShTA dharmaparAyaNA |
kailAsashikhare ramye devagandharvasevite
shlokas.28:
vyatiShThadekapAdena paramaM yogamAsthitA |
dasha varShasahasrANi dasha varShashatAni cha
shlokas.29:
santaptAstapasA tasyA devAH sarShimahoragAH |
tatra gatvA mayA sArdhaM paryupAsanta tAM shubhAm
shlokas.30:
athAhamabruvaM tatra devIM tAM tapasAnvitAm |
kimarthaM tapyate devi tapo ghoramanindite
shlokas.31:
prItaste.ahaM mahAbhAge tapasAnena shobhane |
varayasva varaM devi dAtAsmIti pura.ndara
shlokas.32:
surabhyuvAcha||
vareNa bhagavanmahyaM kRRitaM lokapitAmaha |
eSha eva varo me.adya yatprIto.asi mamAnagha
shlokas.33:
brahmovAcha||
tAmevaM bruvatIM devIM surabhIM tridasheshvara |
pratyabruvaM yaddevendra tannibodha shachIpate
shlokas.34:
alobhakAmyayA devi tapasA cha shubhena te |
prasanno.ahaM varaM tasmAdamaratvaM dadAni te
shlokas.35:
trayANAmapi lokAnAmupariShTAnnivatsyasi |
matprasAdAchcha vikhyAto golokaH sa bhaviShyati
shlokas.36:
mAnuSheShu cha kurvANAH prajAH karma sutAstava |
nivatsyanti mahAbhAge sarvA duhitarashcha te
shlokas.37:
manasA chintitA bhogAstvayA vai divyamAnuShAH |
yachcha svargasukhaM devi tatte sampatsyate shubhe
shlokas.38:
tasyA lokAH sahasrAkSha sarvakAmasamanvitAH |
na tatra kramate mRRityurna jarA na cha pAvakaH
na dainyaM nAshubhaM ki~nchidvidyate tatra vAsava
shlokas.39:
tatra divyAnyaraNyAni divyAni bhavanAni cha |
vimAnAni cha yuktAni kAmagAni cha vAsava
shlokas.40:
vrataishcha vividhaiH puNyaistathA tIrthAnusevanAt |
tapasA mahatA chaiva sukRRitena cha karmaNA
shakyaH samAsAdayituM golokaH puShkarekShaNa
shlokas.41:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM mayA shakrAnupRRichChate |
na te paribhavaH kAryo gavAmarinisUdana
shlokas.42:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etachChrutvA sahasrAkShaH pUjayAmAsa nityadA |
gAshchakre bahumAnaM cha tAsu nityaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.43:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM pAvanaM cha mahAdyute |
pavitraM paramaM chApi gavAM mAhAtmyamuttamam
kIrtitaM puruShavyAghra sarvapApavinAshanam
shlokas.44:
ya idaM kathayennityaM brAhmaNebhyaH samAhitaH |
havyakavyeShu yaj~neShu pitRRikAryeShu chaiva ha
sArvakAmikamakShayyaM pitR^I.nstasyopatiShThati
shlokas.45:
goShu bhaktashcha labhate yadyadichChati mAnavaH |
striyo.api bhaktA yA goShu tAshcha kAmAnavApnuyuH
shlokas.46:
putrArthI labhate putraM kanyA patimavApnuyAt |
dhanArthI labhate vittaM dharmArthI dharmamApnuyAt
shlokas.47:
vidyArthI prApnuyAdvidyAM sukhArthI prApnuyAtsukham |
na ki~nchiddurlabhaM chaiva gavAM bhaktasya bhArata

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
uktaM pitAmahenedaM gavAM dAnamanuttamam |
visheSheNa narendrANAmiti dharmamavekShatAm
shlokas.2:
rAjyaM hi satataM duHkhamAshramAshcha sudurvidAH |
parivAreNa vai duHkhaM durdharaM chAkRRitAtmabhiH
bhUyiShThaM cha narendrANAM vidyate na shubhA gatiH
shlokas.3:
pUyante te.atra niyataM prayachChanto vasundharAm |
pUrvaM cha kathitA dharmAstvayA me kurunandana
shlokas.4:
evameva gavAmuktaM pradAnaM te nRRigeNa ha |
RRiShiNA nAchiketena pUrvameva nidarshitam
shlokas.5:
vedopaniShade chaiva sarvakarmasu dakShiNA |
sarvakratuShu choddiShTaM bhUmirgAvo.atha kA~nchanam
shlokas.6:
tatra shrutistu paramA suvarNaM dakShiNeti vai |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM pitAmaha yathAtatham
shlokas.7:
kiM suvarNaM kathaM jAtaM kasminkAle kimAtmakam |
kiM dAnaM kiM phalaM chaiva kasmAchcha paramuchyate
shlokas.8:
kasmAddAnaM suvarNasya pUjayanti manIShiNaH |
kasmAchcha dakShiNArthaM tadyaj~nakarmasu shasyate
shlokas.9:
kasmAchcha pAvanaM shreShThaM bhUmergobhyashcha kA~nchanam |
paramaM dakShiNArthe cha tadbravIhi pitAmaha
shlokas.10:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjannavahito bahukAraNavistaram |
jAtarUpasamutpattimanubhUtaM cha yanmayA
shlokas.11:
pitA mama mahAtejAH shantanurnidhanaM gataH |
tasya ditsurahaM shrAddhaM ga~NgAdvAramupAgamam
shlokas.12:
tatrAgamya pituH putra shrAddhakarma samArabham |
mAtA me jAhnavI chaiva sAhAyyamakarottadA
shlokas.13:
tato.agratastapaHsiddhAnupaveshya bahUnRRiShIn |
toyapradAnAtprabhRRiti kAryANyahamathArabham
shlokas.14:
tatsamApya yathoddiShTaM pUrvakarma samAhitaH |
dAtuM nirvapaNaM samyagyathAvadahamArabham
shlokas.15:
tatastaM darbhavinyAsaM bhittvA suruchirA~NgadaH |
pralambAbharaNo bAhurudatiShThadvishAM pate
shlokas.16:
tamutthitamahaM dRRiShTvA paraM vismayamAgamam |
pratigrahItA sAkShAnme piteti bharatarShabha
shlokas.17:
tato me punarevAsItsa~nj~nA sa~nchintya shAstrataH |
nAyaM vedeShu vihito vidhirhasta iti prabho
piNDo deyo nareNeha tato matirabhUnmama
shlokas.18:
sAkShAnneha manuShyasya pitaro.antarhitAH kvachit |
gRRihNanti vihitaM tvevaM piNDo deyaH kusheShviti
shlokas.19:
tato.ahaM tadanAdRRitya piturhastanidarshanam |
shAstrapramANAtsUkShmaM tu vidhiM pArthiva sa.nsmaran
shlokas.20:
tato darbheShu tatsarvamadadaM bharatarShabha |
shAstramArgAnusAreNa tadviddhi manujarShabha
shlokas.21:
tataH so.antarhito bAhuH piturmama narAdhipa |
tato mAM darshayAmAsuH svapnAnte pitarastadA
shlokas.22:
prIyamANAstu mAmUchuH prItAH sma bharatarShabha |
vij~nAnena tavAnena yanna muhyasi dharmataH
shlokas.23:
tvayA hi kurvatA shAstraM pramANamiha pArthiva |
AtmA dharmaH shrutaM vedAH pitarashcha maharShibhiH
shlokas.24:
sAkShAtpitAmaho brahmA guravo.atha prajApatiH |
pramANamupanItA vai sthitishcha na vichAlitA
shlokas.25:
tadidaM samyagArabdhaM tvayAdya bharatarShabha |
kiM tu bhUmergavAM chArthe suvarNaM dIyatAmiti
shlokas.26:
evaM vayaM cha dharmashcha sarve chAsmatpitAmahAH |
