pAvitA vai bhaviShyanti pAvanaM paramaM hi tat
shlokas.27:
dasha pUrvAndasha parA.nstathA santArayanti te |
suvarNaM ye prayachChanti evaM me pitaro.abruvan
shlokas.28:
tato.ahaM vismito rAjanpratibuddho vishAM pate |
suvarNadAne.akaravaM matiM bharatasattama
shlokas.29:
itihAsamimaM chApi shRRiNu rAjanpurAtanam |
jAmadagnyaM prati vibho dhanyamAyuShyameva cha
shlokas.30:
jAmadagnyena rAmeNa tIvraroShAnvitena vai |
triHsaptakRRitvaH pRRithivI kRRitA niHkShatriyA purA
shlokas.31:
tato jitvA mahIM kRRitsnAM rAmo rAjIvalochanaH |
AjahAra kratuM vIro brahmakShatreNa pUjitam
shlokas.32:
vAjimedhaM mahArAja sarvakAmasamanvitam |
pAvanaM sarvabhUtAnAM tejodyutivivardhanam
shlokas.33:
vipApmApi sa tejasvI tena kratuphalena vai |
naivAtmano.atha laghutAM jAmadagnyo.abhyagachChata
shlokas.34:
sa tu kratuvareNeShTvA mahAtmA dakShiNAvatA |
paprachChAgamasampannAnRRiShIndevA.nshcha bhArgavaH
shlokas.35:
pAvanaM yatparaM nR^INAmugre karmaNi vartatAm |
taduchyatAM mahAbhAgA iti jAtaghRRiNo.abravIt
shlokas.36:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
devatAste prayachChanti suvarNaM ye dadatyuta |
agnirhi devatAH sarvAH suvarNaM cha tadAtmakam
shlokas.37:
tasmAtsuvarNaM dadatA dattAH sarvAshcha devatAH |
bhavanti puruShavyAghra na hyataH paramaM viduH
shlokas.38:
bhUya eva cha mAhAtmyaM suvarNasya nibodha me |
gadato mama viprarShe sarvashastrabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.39:
mayA shrutamidaM pUrvaM purANe bhRRigunandana |
prajApateH kathayato manoH svAyambhuvasya vai
shlokas.40:
shUlapANerbhagavato rudrasya cha mahAtmanaH |
girau himavati shreShThe tadA bhRRigukulodvaha
shlokas.41:
devyA vivAhe nirvRRitte rudrANyA bhRRigunandana |
samAgame bhagavato devyA saha mahAtmanaH
tataH sarve samudvignA bhagavantamupAgaman
shlokas.42:
te mahAdevamAsInaM devIM cha varadAmumAm |
prasAdya shirasA sarve rudramUchurbhRRigUdvaha
shlokas.43:
ayaM samAgamo deva devyA saha tavAnagha |
tapasvinastapasvinyA tejasvinyAtitejasaH
amoghatejAstvaM deva devI cheyamumA tathA
shlokas.44:
apatyaM yuvayordeva balavadbhavitA prabho |
tannUnaM triShu lokeShu na ki~nchichCheShayiShyati
shlokas.45:
tadebhyaH praNatebhyastvaM devebhyaH pRRithulochana |
varaM prayachCha lokesha trailokyahitakAmyayA
apatyArthaM nigRRihNIShva tejo jvalitamuttamam
shlokas.46:
iti teShAM kathayatAM bhagavAngovRRiShadhvajaH |
evamastviti devA.nstAnviprarShe pratyabhAShata
shlokas.47:
ityuktvA chordhvamanayattadreto vRRiShavAhanaH |
UrdhvaretAH samabhavattataHprabhRRiti chApi saH
shlokas.48:
rudrANI tu tataH kruddhA prajochChede tathA kRRite |
devAnathAbravIttatra strIbhAvAtparuShaM vachaH
shlokas.49:
yasmAdapatyakAmo vai bhartA me vinivartitaH |
tasmAtsarve surA yUyamanapatyA bhaviShyatha
shlokas.50:
prajochChedo mama kRRito yasmAdyuShmAbhiradya vai |
tasmAtprajA vaH khagamAH sarveShAM na bhaviShyati
shlokas.51:
pAvakastu na tatrAsIchChApakAle bhRRigUdvaha |
devA devyAstathA shApAdanapatyAstadAbhavan
shlokas.52:
rudrastu tejo.apratimaM dhArayAmAsa tattadA |
praskannaM tu tatastasmAtki~nchittatrApatadbhuvi
shlokas.53:
tatpapAta tadA chAgnau vavRRidhe chAdbhutopamam |
tejastejasi sampRRiktamekayonitvamAgatam
shlokas.54:
etasminneva kAle tu devAH shakrapurogamAH |
asurastArako nAma tena santApitA bhRRisham
shlokas.55:
AdityA vasavo rudrA maruto.athAshvinAvapi |
sAdhyAshcha sarve santrastA daiteyasya parAkramAt
shlokas.56:
sthAnAni devatAnAM hi vimAnAni purANi cha |
RRiShINAmAshramAshchaiva babhUvurasurairhRRitAH
shlokas.57:
te dInamanasaH sarve devAshcha RRiShayashcha ha |
prajagmuH sharaNaM devaM brahmANamajaraM prabhum

shlokas.1:
devA UchuH||
asurastArako nAma tvayA dattavaraH prabho |
surAnRRiShI.nshcha klishnAti vadhastasya vidhIyatAm
shlokas.2:
tasmAdbhayaM samutpannamasmAkaM vai pitAmaha |
paritrAyasva no deva na hyanyA gatirasti naH
shlokas.3:
brahmovAcha||
samo.ahaM sarvabhUtAnAmadharmaM neha rochaye |
hanyatAM tArakaH kShipraM surarShigaNabAdhakaH
shlokas.4:
vedA dharmAshcha notsAdaM gachCheyuH surasattamAH |
vihitaM pUrvamevAtra mayA vai vyetu vo jvaraH
shlokas.5:
devA UchuH||
varadAnAdbhagavato daiteyo balagarvitaH |
devairna shakyate hantuM sa kathaM prashamaM vrajet
shlokas.6:
sa hi naiva sma devAnAM nAsurANAM na rakShasAm |
vadhyaH syAmiti jagrAha varaM tvattaH pitAmaha
shlokas.7:
devAshcha shaptA rudrANyA prajochChede purA kRRite |
na bhaviShyati vo.apatyamiti sarvajagatpate
shlokas.8:
brahmovAcha||
hutAshano na tatrAsIchChApakAle surottamAH |
sa utpAdayitApatyaM vadhArthaM tridashadviShAm
shlokas.9:
tadvai sarvAnatikramya devadAnavarAkShasAn |
mAnuShAnatha gandharvAnnAgAnatha cha pakShiNaH
shlokas.10:
astreNAmoghapAtena shaktyA taM ghAtayiShyati |
yato vo bhayamutpannaM ye chAnye surashatravaH
shlokas.11:
sanAtano hi sa~NkalpaH kAma ityabhidhIyate |
rudrasya tejaH praskannamagnau nipatitaM cha tat
shlokas.12:
tattejo.agnirmahadbhUtaM dvitIyamiva pAvakam |
vadhArthaM devashatrUNAM ga~NgAyAM janayiShyati
shlokas.13:
sa tu nAvApa taM shApaM naShTaH sa hutabhuktadA |
tasmAdvo bhayahRRiddevAH samutpatsyati pAvakiH
shlokas.14:
anviShyatAM vai jvalanastathA chAdya niyujyatAm |
tArakasya vadhopAyaH kathito vai mayAnaghAH
shlokas.15:
na hi tejasvinAM shApAstejaHsu prabhavanti vai |
balAnyatibalaM prApya nabalAni bhavanti vai
shlokas.16:
hanyAdavadhyAnvaradAnapi chaiva tapasvinaH |
sa~NkalpAbhiruchiH kAmaH sanAtanatamo.analaH
shlokas.17:
jagatpatiranirdeshyaH sarvagaH sarvabhAvanaH |
hRRichChayaH sarvabhUtAnAM jyeShTho rudrAdapi prabhuH
shlokas.18:
anviShyatAM sa tu kShipraM tejorAshirhutAshanaH |
sa vo manogataM kAmaM devaH sampAdayiShyati
shlokas.19:
etadvAkyamupashrutya tato devA mahAtmanaH |
jagmuH sa.nsiddhasa~NkalpAH paryeShanto vibhAvasum
shlokas.20:
tatastrailokyamRRiShayo vyachinvanta suraiH saha |
kA~NkShanto darshanaM vahneH sarve tadgatamAnasAH
shlokas.21:
pareNa tapasA yuktAH shrImanto lokavishrutAH |
lokAnanvacharansiddhAH sarva eva bhRRigUdvaha
naShTamAtmani sa.nlInaM nAdhijagmurhutAshanam
shlokas.22:
tataH sa~njAtasantrAsAnagnerdarshanalAlasAn |
jalecharaH klAntamanAstejasAgneH pradIpitaH
uvAcha devAnmaNDUko rasAtalatalotthitaH
shlokas.23:
rasAtalatale devA vasatyagniriti prabho |
santApAdiha samprAptaH pAvakaprabhavAdaham
shlokas.24:
sa sa.nsupto jale devA bhagavAnhavyavAhanaH |
apaH sa.nsRRijya tejobhistena santApitA vayam
shlokas.25:
tasya darshanamiShTaM vo yadi devA vibhAvasoH |
tatrainamabhigachChadhvaM kAryaM vo yadi vahninA
shlokas.26:
gamyatAM sAdhayiShyAmo vayaM hyagnibhayAtsurAH |
etAvaduktvA maNDUkastvarito jalamAvishat
shlokas.27:
hutAshanastu bubudhe maNDUkasyAtha paishunam |
shashApa sa tamAsAdya na rasAnvetsyasIti vai
shlokas.28:
taM sa sa.nyujya shApena maNDUkaM pAvako yayau |
anyatra vAsAya vibhurna cha devAnadarshayat
shlokas.29:
devAstvanugrahaM chakrurmaNDUkAnAM bhRRigUdvaha |
yattachChRRiNu mahAbAho gadato mama sarvashaH
shlokas.30:
devA UchuH||
agnishApAdajihvApi rasaj~nAnabahiShkRRitAH |
sarasvatIM bahuvidhAM yUyamuchchArayiShyatha
shlokas.31:
bilavAsagatA.nshchaiva nirAdAnAnachetasaH |
gatAsUnapi vaH shuShkAnbhUmiH sandhArayiShyati
tamogatAyAmapi cha nishAyAM vichariShyatha
shlokas.32:
ityuktvA tA.nstato devAH punareva mahImimAm |
parIyurjvalanasyArthe na chAvindanhutAshanam
shlokas.33:
atha tAndviradaH kashchitsurendradviradopamaH |
ashvatthastho.agnirityevaM prAha devAnbhRRigUdvaha
shlokas.34:
shashApa jvalanaH sarvAndviradAnkrodhamUrChitaH |
pratIpA bhavatAM jihvA bhavitrIti bhRRigUdvaha
shlokas.35:
ityuktvA niHsRRito.ashvatthAdagnirvAraNasUchitaH |
pravivesha shamIgarbhamatha vahniH suShupsayA
shlokas.36:
anugrahaM tu nAgAnAM yaM chakruH shRRiNu taM prabho |
devA bhRRigukulashreShTha prItAH satyaparAkramAH
shlokas.37:
devA UchuH||
pratIpayA jihvayApi sarvAhArAnkariShyatha |
vAchaM chochchArayiShyadhvamuchchairavya~njitAkSharam
ityuktvA punarevAgnimanusasrurdivaukasaH
shlokas.38:
ashvatthAnniHsRRitashchAgniH shamIgarbhagatastadA |
shukena khyApito vipra taM devAH samupAdravan
shlokas.39:
shashApa shukamagnistu vAgvihIno bhaviShyasi |
jihvAM chAvartayAmAsa tasyApi hutabhuktadA
shlokas.40:
dRRiShTvA tu jvalanaM devAH shukamUchurdayAnvitAH |
bhavitA na tvamatyantaM shakune naShTavAgiti
shlokas.41:
AvRRittajihvasya sato vAkyaM kAntaM bhaviShyati |
bAlasyeva pravRRiddhasya kalamavyaktamadbhutam
shlokas.42:
ityuktvA taM shamIgarbhe vahnimAlakShya devatAH |
tadevAyatanaM chakruH puNyaM sarvakriyAsvapi
shlokas.43:
tataHprabhRRiti chApyagniH shamIgarbheShu dRRishyate |
utpAdane tathopAyamanujagmushcha mAnavAH
shlokas.44:
Apo rasAtale yAstu sa.nsRRiShTAshchitrabhAnunA |
tAH parvataprasravaNairUShmAM mu~nchanti bhArgava
pAvakenAdhishayatA santaptAstasya tejasA
shlokas.45:
tato.agnirdevatA dRRiShTvA babhUva vyathitastadA |
kimAgamanamityevaM tAnapRRichChata pAvakaH
shlokas.46:
tamUchurvibudhAH sarve te chaiva paramarShayaH |
tvAM niyokShyAmahe kArye tadbhavAnkartumarhati
kRRite cha tasminbhavitA tavApi sumahAnguNaH
shlokas.47:
agniruvAcha||
brUta yadbhavatAM kAryaM sarvaM kartAsmi tatsurAH |
bhavatAM hi niyojyo.ahaM mA vo.atrAstu vichAraNA
shlokas.48:
devA UchuH||
asurastArako nAma brahmaNo varadarpitaH |
asmAnprabAdhate vIryAdvadhastasya vidhIyatAm
shlokas.49:
imAndevagaNA.nstAta prajApatigaNA.nstathA |
RRiShI.nshchApi mahAbhAgAnparitrAyasva pAvaka
shlokas.50:
apatyaM tejasA yuktaM pravIraM janaya prabho |
yadbhayaM no.asurAttasmAnnAshayeddhavyavAhana
shlokas.51:
shaptAnAM no mahAdevyA nAnyadasti parAyaNam |
anyatra bhavato vIryaM tasmAttrAyasva nastataH
shlokas.52:
ityuktaH sa tathetyuktvA bhagavAnhavyakavyabhuk |
jagAmAtha durAdharSho ga~NgAM bhAgIrathIM prati
shlokas.53:
tayA chApyabhavanmishro garbhashchAsyAbhavattadA |
vavRRidhe sa tadA garbhaH kakShe kRRiShNagatiryathA
shlokas.54:
tejasA tasya garbhasya ga~NgA vihvalachetanA |
santApamagamattIvraM sA soDhuM na shashAka ha
shlokas.55:
Ahite jvalanenAtha garbhe tejaHsamanvite |
ga~NgAyAmasuraH kashchidbhairavaM nAdamutsRRijat
shlokas.56:
abuddhApatitenAtha nAdena vipulena sA |
vitrastodbhrAntanayanA ga~NgA viplutalochanA
visa~nj~nA nAshakadgarbhaM sandhArayitumAtmanA
shlokas.57:
sA tu tejaHparItA~NgI kampamAnA cha jAhnavI |
uvAcha vachanaM vipra tadA garbhabaloddhatA
na te shaktAsmi bhagava.nstejaso.asya vidhAraNe
shlokas.58:
vimUDhAsmi kRRitAnena tathAsvAsthyaM kRRitaM param |
vihvalA chAsmi bhagava.nstejo naShTaM cha me.anagha
shlokas.59:
dhAraNe nAsya shaktAhaM garbhasya tapatAM vara |
utsrakShye.ahamimaM duHkhAnna tu kAmAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.60:
na chetaso.asti sa.nsparsho mama deva vibhAvaso |
Apadarthe hi sambandhaH susUkShmo.api mahAdyute
shlokas.61:
yadatra guNasampannamitaraM vA hutAshana |
tvayyeva tadahaM manye dharmAdharmau cha kevalau
shlokas.62:
tAmuvAcha tato vahnirdhAryatAM dhAryatAmayam |
garbho mattejasA yukto mahAguNaphalodayaH
shlokas.63:
shaktA hyasi mahIM kRRitsnAM voDhuM dhArayituM tathA |
na hi te ki~nchidaprApyaM madretodhAraNAdRRite
shlokas.64:
sA vahninA vAryamANA devaishchApi saridvarA |
samutsasarja taM garbhaM merau girivare tadA
shlokas.65:
samarthA dhAraNe chApi rudratejaHpradharShitA |
nAshakattaM tadA garbhaM sandhArayitumojasA
shlokas.66:
sA samutsRRijya taM duHkhAddIptavaishvAnaraprabham |
darshayAmAsa chAgnistAM tadA ga~NgAM bhRRigUdvaha
paprachCha saritAM shreShThAM kachchidgarbhaH sukhodayaH
shlokas.67:
kIdRRigvarNo.api vA devi kIdRRigrUpashcha dRRishyate |
tejasA kena vA yuktaH sarvametadbravIhi me
shlokas.68:
ga~NgovAcha||
jAtarUpaH sa garbho vai tejasA tvamivAnala |
suvarNo vimalo dIptaH parvataM chAvabhAsayat
shlokas.69:
padmotpalavimishrANAM hradAnAmiva shItalaH |
gandho.asya sa kadambAnAM tulyo vai tapatAM vara
shlokas.70:
tejasA tasya garbhasya bhAskarasyeva rashmibhiH |
yaddravyaM parisa.nsRRiShTaM pRRithivyAM parvateShu vA
tatsarvaM kA~nchanIbhUtaM samantAtpratyadRRishyata
shlokas.71:
paryadhAvata shailA.nshcha nadIH prasravaNAni cha |
vyadIpayattejasA cha trailokyaM sacharAcharam
shlokas.72:
eva.nrUpaH sa bhagavAnputraste havyavAhana |
sUryavaishvAnarasamaH kAntyA soma ivAparaH
evamuktvA tu sA devI tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.73:
pAvakashchApi tejasvI kRRitvA kAryaM divaukasAm |
jagAmeShTaM tato deshaM tadA bhArgavanandana
shlokas.74:
etaiH karmaguNairloke nAmAgneH parigIyate |
hiraNyaretA iti vai RRiShibhirvibudhaistathA
pRRithivI cha tadA devI khyAtA vasumatIti vai
shlokas.75:
sa tu garbho mahAtejA gA~NgeyaH pAvakodbhavaH |
divyaM sharavaNaM prApya vavRRidhe.adbhutadarshanaH
shlokas.76:
dadRRishuH kRRittikAstaM tu bAlArkasadRRishadyutim |
jAtasnehAshcha taM bAlaM pupuShuH stanyavisravaiH
shlokas.77:
tataH sa kArttikeyatvamavApa paramadyutiH |
skannatvAtskandatAM chApi guhAvAsAdguho.abhavat
shlokas.78:
evaM suvarNamutpannamapatyaM jAtavedasaH |
tatra jAmbUnadaM shreShThaM devAnAmapi bhUShaNam
shlokas.79:
tataHprabhRRiti chApyetajjAtarUpamudAhRRitam |
yatsuvarNaM sa bhagavAnagnirIshaH prajApatiH
shlokas.80:
pavitrANAM pavitraM hi kanakaM dvijasattama |
agnIShomAtmakaM chaiva jAtarUpamudAhRRitam
shlokas.81:
ratnAnAmuttamaM ratnaM bhUShaNAnAM tathottamam |
pavitraM cha pavitrANAM ma~NgalAnAM cha ma~Ngalam

shlokas.1:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
api chedaM purA rAma shrutaM me brahmadarshanam |
pitAmahasya yadvRRittaM brahmaNaH paramAtmanaH
shlokas.2:
devasya mahatastAta vAruNIM bibhratastanum |
aishvarye vAruNe rAma rudrasyeshasya vai prabho
shlokas.3:
AjagmurmunayaH sarve devAshchAgnipurogamAH |
yaj~nA~NgAni cha sarvANi vaShaTkArashcha mUrtimAn
shlokas.4:
mUrtimanti cha sAmAni yajUMShi cha sahasrashaH |
RRigvedashchAgamattatra padakramavibhUShitaH
shlokas.5:
lakShaNAni svarAH stobhA niruktaM svarabhaktayaH |
o~NkArashchAvasannetre nigrahapragrahau tathA
shlokas.6:
vedAshcha sopaniShado vidyA sAvitryathApi cha |
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyachcha dadhAra bhagavA~nshivaH
juhvachchAtmanyathAtmAnaM svayameva tadA prabho
shlokas.7:
devapatnyashcha kanyAshcha devAnAM chaiva mAtaraH |
AjagmuH sahitAstatra tadA bhRRigukulodvaha
shlokas.8:
yaj~naM pashupateH prItA varuNasya mahAtmanaH |
svayambhuvastu tA dRRiShTvA retaH samapatadbhuvi
shlokas.9:
tasya shukrasya niShpandAtpA.nsUnsa~NgRRihya bhUmitaH |
prAsyatpUShA karAbhyAM vai tasminneva hutAshane
shlokas.10:
tatastasminsampravRRitte satre jvalitapAvake |
brahmaNo juhvatastatra prAdurbhAvo babhUva ha
shlokas.11:
skannamAtraM cha tachChukraM sruveNa pratigRRihya saH |
AjyavanmantravachchApi so.ajuhodbhRRigunandana
shlokas.12:
tataH sa~njanayAmAsa bhUtagrAmaM sa vIryavAn |
tatastu tejasastasmAjjaj~ne lokeShu taijasam
shlokas.13:
tamasastAmasA bhAvA vyApi sattvaM tathobhayam |
saguNastejaso nityaM tamasyAkAshameva cha
shlokas.14:
sarvabhUteShvatha tathA sattvaM tejastathA tamaH |
shukre hute.agnau tasmi.nstu prAdurAsa.nstrayaH prabho
shlokas.15:
puruShA vapuShA yuktA yuktAH prasavajairguNaiH |
bhRRigityeva bhRRiguH pUrvama~NgArebhyo.a~NgirAbhavat
shlokas.16:
a~NgArasa.nshrayAchchaiva kavirityaparo.abhavat |
saha jvAlAbhirutpanno bhRRigustasmAdbhRRiguH smRRitaH
shlokas.17:
marIchibhyo marIchistu mArIchaH kashyapo hyabhUt |
a~NgArebhyo.a~NgirAstAta vAlakhilyAH shilochchayAt
atraivAtreti cha vibho jAtamatriM vadantyapi
shlokas.18:
tathA bhasmavyapohebhyo brahmarShigaNasaMmitAH |
vaikhAnasAH samutpannAstapaHshrutaguNepsavaH
ashruto.asya samutpannAvashvinau rUpasaMmatau
shlokas.19:
sheShAH prajAnAM patayaH srotobhyastasya jaj~nire |
RRiShayo lomakUpebhyaH svedAchChando malAtmakam
shlokas.20:
etasmAtkAraNAdAhuragniM sarvAstu devatAH |
RRiShayaH shrutasampannA vedaprAmANyadarshanAt
shlokas.21:
yAni dArUNi te mAsA niryAsAH pakShasa~nj~nitAH |
ahorAtrA muhUrtAstu pittaM jyotishcha vAruNam
shlokas.22:
raudraM lohitamityAhurlohitAtkanakaM smRRitam |
tanmaitramiti vij~neyaM dhUmAchcha vasavaH smRRitAH
shlokas.23:
archiSho yAshcha te rudrAstathAdityA mahAprabhAH |
uddiShTAste tathA~NgArA ye dhiShNyeShu divi sthitAH
shlokas.24:
AdinAthashcha lokasya tatparaM brahma taddhruvam |
sarvakAmadamityAhustatra havyamudAvahat
shlokas.25:
tato.abravInmahAdevo varuNaH paramAtmakaH |
mama satramidaM divyamahaM gRRihapatistviha
shlokas.26:
trINi pUrvANyapatyAni mama tAni na sa.nshayaH |
iti jAnIta khagamA mama yaj~naphalaM hi tat
shlokas.27:
agniruvAcha||
mada~NgebhyaH prasUtAni madAshrayakRRitAni cha |
mamaiva tAnyapatyAni varuNo hyavashAtmakaH
shlokas.28:
athAbravIllokagururbrahmA lokapitAmahaH |
mamaiva tAnyapatyAni mama shukraM hutaM hi tat
shlokas.29:
ahaM vaktA cha mantrasya hotA shukrasya chaiva ha |
yasya bIjaM phalaM tasya shukraM chetkAraNaM matam
shlokas.30:
tato.abruvandevagaNAH pitAmahamupetya vai |
kRRitA~njalipuTAH sarve shirobhirabhivandya cha
shlokas.31:
vayaM cha bhagavansarve jagachcha sacharAcharam |
tavaiva prasavAH sarve tasmAdagnirvibhAvasuH
varuNashcheshvaro devo labhatAM kAmamIpsitam
shlokas.32:
nisargAdvaruNashchApi brahmaNo yAdasAM patiH |
jagrAha vai bhRRiguM pUrvamapatyaM sUryavarchasam
shlokas.33:
Ishvaro.a~NgirasaM chAgnerapatyArthe.abhyakalpayat |
pitAmahastvapatyaM vai kaviM jagrAha tattvavit
shlokas.34:
tadA sa vAruNaH khyAto bhRRiguH prasavakarmakRRit |
Agneyastva~NgirAH shrImAnkavirbrAhmo mahAyashAH
bhArgavA~Ngirasau loke lokasantAnalakShaNau
shlokas.35:
ete vipravarAH sarve prajAnAM patayastrayaH |
sarvaM santAnameteShAmidamityupadhAraya
shlokas.36:
bhRRigostu putrAstatrAsansapta tulyA bhRRigorguNaiH |
chyavano vajrashIrShashcha shuchiraurvastathaiva cha
shlokas.37:
shukro vareNyashcha vibhuH savanashcheti sapta te |
bhArgavA vAruNAH sarve yeShAM va.nshe bhavAnapi
shlokas.38:
aShTau chA~NgirasaH putrA vAruNAste.apyudAhRRitAH |
bRRihaspatirutathyashcha vayasyaH shAntireva cha
shlokas.39:
ghoro virUpaH sa.nvartaH sudhanvA chAShTamaH smRRitaH |
ete.aShTAvagnijAH sarve j~nAnaniShThA nirAmayAH
shlokas.40:
brAhmaNasya kaveH putrA vAruNAste.apyudAhRRitAH |
aShTau prasavajairyuktA guNairbrahmavidaH shubhAH
shlokas.41:
kaviH kAvyashcha viShNushcha buddhimAnushanAstathA |
bhRRigushcha virajAshchaiva kAshI chograshcha dharmavit
shlokas.42:
aShTau kavisutA hyete sarvamebhirjagattatam |
prajApataya ete hi prajAnAM yairimAH prajAH
shlokas.43:
evama~Ngirasashchaiva kaveshcha prasavAnvayaiH |
bhRRigoshcha bhRRigushArdUla va.nshajaiH satataM jagat
shlokas.44:
varuNashchAdito vipra jagrAha prabhurIshvaraH |
kaviM tAta bhRRiguM chaiva tasmAttau vAruNau smRRitau
shlokas.45:
jagrAhA~NgirasaM devaH shikhI tasmAddhutAshanaH |
tasmAda~Ngiraso j~neyAH sarva eva tadanvayAH
shlokas.46:
brahmA pitAmahaH pUrvaM devatAbhiH prasAditaH |
ime naH santariShyanti prajAbhirjagadIshvarAH
shlokas.47:
sarve prajAnAM patayaH sarve chAtitapasvinaH |
tvatprasAdAdimaM lokaM tArayiShyanti shAshvatam
shlokas.48:
tathaiva va.nshakartArastava tejovivardhanAH |
bhaveyurvedaviduShaH sarve vAkpatayastathA
shlokas.49:
devapakShadharAH saumyAH prAjApatyA maharShayaH |
Apnuvanti tapashchaiva brahmacharyaM paraM tathA
shlokas.50:
sarve hi vayamete cha tavaiva prasavaH prabho |
devAnAM brAhmaNAnAM cha tvaM hi kartA pitAmaha
shlokas.51:
marIchimAditaH kRRitvA sarve chaivAtha bhArgavAH |
apatyAnIti samprekShya kShamayAma pitAmaha
shlokas.52:
te tvanenaiva rUpeNa prajaniShyanti vai prajAH |
sthApayiShyanti chAtmAnaM yugAdinidhane tathA
shlokas.53:
evametatpurA vRRittaM tasya yaj~ne mahAtmanaH |
devashreShThasya lokAdau vAruNIM bibhratastanum
shlokas.54:
agnirbrahmA pashupatiH sharvo rudraH prajApatiH |
agnerapatyametadvai suvarNamiti dhAraNA
shlokas.55:
agnyabhAve cha kurvanti vahnisthAneShu kA~nchanam |
jAmadagnya pramANaj~nA vedashrutinidarshanAt
shlokas.56:
kushastambe juhotyagniM suvarNaM tatra sa.nsthitam |
hute prItikarImRRiddhiM bhagavA.nstatra manyate
shlokas.57:
tasmAdagniparAH sarvA devatA iti shushruma |
brahmaNo hi prasUto.agniragnerapi cha kA~nchanam
shlokas.58:
tasmAdye vai prayachChanti suvarNaM dharmadarshinaH |
devatAste prayachChanti samastA iti naH shrutam
shlokas.59:
tasya chAtamaso lokA gachChataH paramAM gatim |
svarloke rAjarAjyena so.abhiShichyeta bhArgava
shlokas.60:
Adityodayane prApte vidhimantrapuraskRRitam |
dadAti kA~nchanaM yo vai duHsvapnaM pratihanti saH
shlokas.61:
dadAtyuditamAtre yastasya pApmA vidhUyate |
madhyAhne dadato rukmaM hanti pApamanAgatam
shlokas.62:
dadAti pashchimAM sandhyAM yaH suvarNaM dhRRitavrataH |
brahmavAyvagnisomAnAM sAlokyamupayAti saH
shlokas.63:
sendreShu chaiva lokeShu pratiShThAM prApnute shubhAm |
iha loke yashaH prApya shAntapApmA pramodate
shlokas.64:
tataH sampadyate.anyeShu lokeShvapratimaH sadA |
anAvRRitagatishchaiva kAmachArI bhavatyuta
shlokas.65:
na cha kSharati tebhyaH sa shashvachchaivApnute mahat |
suvarNamakShayaM dattvA lokAnApnoti puShkalAn
shlokas.66:
yastu sa~njanayitvAgnimAdityodayanaM prati |
dadyAdvai vratamuddishya sarvAnkAmAnsamashnute
shlokas.67:
agnirityeva tatprAhuH pradAnaM vai sukhAvaham |
yatheShTaguNasampannaM pravartakamiti smRRitam
shlokas.68:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa vasiShThena jAmadagnyaH pratApavAn |
dadau suvarNaM viprebhyo vyamuchyata cha kilbiShAt
shlokas.69:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM suvarNasya mahIpate |
pradAnasya phalaM chaiva janma chAgnyamanuttamam
shlokas.70:
tasmAttvamapi viprebhyaH prayachCha kanakaM bahu |
dadatsuvarNaM nRRipate kilbiShAdvipramokShyasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
uktAH pitAmaheneha suvarNasya vidhAnataH |
vistareNa pradAnasya ye guNAH shrutilakShaNAH
shlokas.2:
yattu kAraNamutpatteH suvarNasyeha kIrtitam |
sa kathaM tArakaH prApto nidhanaM tadbravIhi me
shlokas.3:
uktaH sa devatAnAM hi avadhya iti pArthiva |
na cha tasyeha te mRRityurvistareNa prakIrtitaH
shlokas.4:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM tvattaH kurukulodvaha |
kArtsnyena tArakavadhaM paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vipannakRRityA rAjendra devatA RRiShayastathA |
kRRittikAshchodayAmAsurapatyabharaNAya vai
shlokas.6:
na devatAnAM kAchiddhi samarthA jAtavedasaH |
ekApi shaktA taM garbhaM sandhArayitumojasA
shlokas.7:
ShaNNAM tAsAM tataH prItaH pAvako garbhadhAraNAt |
svena tejovisargeNa vIryeNa parameNa cha
shlokas.8:
tAstu ShaTkRRittikA garbhaM pupuShurjAtavedasaH |
ShaTsu vartmasu tejo.agneH sakalaM nihitaM prabho
shlokas.9:
tatastA vardhamAnasya kumArasya mahAtmanaH |
tejasAbhiparItA~Ngyo na kvachichCharma lebhire
shlokas.10:
tatastejaHparItA~NgyaH sarvAH kAla upasthite |
samaM garbhaM suShuvire kRRittikAstA nararShabha
shlokas.11:
tatastaM ShaDadhiShThAnaM garbhamekatvamAgatam |
pRRithivI pratijagrAha kAntIpurasamIpataH
shlokas.12:
sa garbho divyasa.nsthAno dIptimAnpAvakaprabhaH |
divyaM sharavaNaM prApya vavRRidhe priyadarshanaH
shlokas.13:
dadRRishuH kRRittikAstaM tu bAlaM vahnisamadyutim |
jAtasnehAshcha sauhArdAtpupuShuH stanyavisravaiH
shlokas.14:
abhavatkArttikeyaH sa trailokye sacharAchare |
skannatvAtskandatAM chApa guhAvAsAdguho.abhavat
shlokas.15:
tato devAstrayastri.nshaddishashcha sadigIshvarAH |
rudro dhAtA cha viShNushcha yaj~naH pUShAryamA bhagaH
shlokas.16:
a.nsho mitrashcha sAdhyAshcha vasavo vAsavo.ashvinau |
Apo vAyurnabhashchandro nakShatrANi grahA raviH
shlokas.17:
pRRithagbhUtAni chAnyAni yAni devArpaNAni vai |
Ajagmustatra taM draShTuM kumAraM jvalanAtmajam
RRiShayastuShTuvushchaiva gandharvAshcha jagustathA
shlokas.18:
ShaDAnanaM kumAraM taM dviShaDakShaM dvijapriyam |
pInA.nsaM dvAdashabhujaM pAvakAdityavarchasam
shlokas.19:
shayAnaM sharagulmasthaM dRRiShTvA devAH saharShibhiH |
lebhire paramaM harShaM menire chAsuraM hatam
shlokas.20:
tato devAH priyANyasya sarva eva samAcharan |
krIDataH krIDanIyAni daduH pakShigaNA.nshcha ha
shlokas.21:
suparNo.asya dadau patraM mayUraM chitrabarhiNam |
rAkShasAshcha dadustasmai varAhamahiShAvubhau
shlokas.22:
kukkuTaM chAgnisa~NkAshaM pradadau varuNaH svayam |
chandramAH pradadau meShamAdityo ruchirAM prabhAm
shlokas.23:
gavAM mAtA cha gA devI dadau shatasahasrashaH |
ChAgamagnirguNopetamilA puShpaphalaM bahu
shlokas.24:
sudhanvA shakaTaM chaiva rathaM chAmitakUbaram |
varuNo vAruNAndivyAnbhuja~NgAnpradadau shubhAn
siMhAnsurendro vyAghrA.nshcha dvIpino.anyA.nshcha daMShTriNaH
shlokas.25:
shvApadA.nshcha bahUnghorA.nshChatrANi vividhAni cha |
rAkShasAsurasa~NghAshcha ye.anujagmustamIshvaram
shlokas.26:
vardhamAnaM tu taM dRRiShTvA prArthayAmAsa tArakaH |
upAyairbahubhirhantuM nAshakachchApi taM vibhum
shlokas.27:
senApatyena taM devAH pUjayitvA guhAlayam |
shasha.nsurviprakAraM taM tasmai tArakakAritam
shlokas.28:
sa vivRRiddho mahAvIryo devasenApatiH prabhuH |
jaghAnAmoghayA shaktyA dAnavaM tArakaM guhaH
shlokas.29:
tena tasminkumAreNa krIDatA nihate.asure |
surendraH sthApito rAjye devAnAM punarIshvaraH
shlokas.30:
sa senApatirevAtha babhau skandaH pratApavAn |
Isho goptA cha devAnAM priyakRRichCha~Nkarasya cha
shlokas.31:
hiraNyamUrtirbhagavAneSha eva cha pAvakiH |
sadA kumAro devAnAM senApatyamavAptavAn
shlokas.32:
tasmAtsuvarNaM ma~NgalyaM ratnamakShayyamuttamam |
sahajaM kArttikeyasya vahnestejaH paraM matam
shlokas.33:
evaM rAmAya kauravya vasiShTho.akathayatpurA |
tasmAtsuvarNadAnAya prayatasva narAdhipa
shlokas.34:
rAmaH suvarNaM dattvA hi vimuktaH sarvakilbiShaiH |
triviShTape mahatsthAnamavApAsulabhaM naraiH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
chAturvarNyasya dharmAtmandharmaH proktastvayAnagha |
tathaiva me shrAddhavidhiM kRRitsnaM prabrUhi pArthiva
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yudhiShThireNaivamukto bhIShmaH shAntanavastadA |
imaM shrAddhavidhiM kRRitsnaM pravaktumupachakrame
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNuShvAvahito rAja~nshrAddhakalpamimaM shubham |
dhanyaM yashasyaM putrIyaM pitRRiyaj~naM parantapa
shlokas.4:
devAsuramanuShyANAM gandharvoragarakShasAm |
pishAchakiMnarANAM cha pUjyA vai pitaraH sadA
shlokas.5:
pitR^InpUjyAditaH pashchAddevAnsantarpayanti vai |
tasmAtsarvaprayatnena puruShaH pUjayetsadA
shlokas.6:
anvAhAryaM mahArAja pitR^INAM shrAddhamuchyate |
tachchAmiSheNa vidhinA vidhiH prathamakalpitaH
shlokas.7:
sarveShvahaHsu prIyante kRRitaiH shrAddhaiH pitAmahAH |
pravakShyAmi tu te sarvA.nstithyAM tithyAM guNAguNAn
shlokas.8:
yeShvahaHsu kRRitaiH shrAddhairyatphalaM prApyate.anagha |
tatsarvaM kIrtayiShyAmi yathAvattannibodha me
shlokas.9:
pitR^Inarchya pratipadi prApnuyAtsvagRRihe striyaH |
abhirUpaprajAyinyo darshanIyA bahuprajAH
shlokas.10:
striyo dvitIyAM jAyante tRRitIyAyAM tu vandinaH |
chaturthyAM kShudrapashavo bhavanti bahavo gRRihe
shlokas.11:
pa~nchamyAM bahavaH putrA jAyante kurvatAM nRRipa |
kurvANAstu narAH ShaShThyAM bhavanti dyutibhAginaH
shlokas.12:
kRRiShibhAgI bhavechChrAddhaM kurvANaH saptamIM nRRipa |
aShTamyAM tu prakurvANo vANijye lAbhamApnuyAt
shlokas.13:
navamyAM kurvataH shrAddhaM bhavatyekashaphaM bahu |
vivardhante tu dashamIM gAvaH shrAddhAni kurvataH
shlokas.14:
kupyabhAgI bhavenmartyaH kurvannekAdashIM nRRipa |
brahmavarchasvinaH putrA jAyante tasya veshmani
shlokas.15:
dvAdashyAmIhamAnasya nityameva pradRRishyate |
rajataM bahu chitraM cha suvarNaM cha manoramam
shlokas.16:
j~nAtInAM tu bhavechChreShThaH kurva~nshrAddhaM trayodashIm |
avashyaM tu yuvAno.asya pramIyante narA gRRihe
shlokas.17:
yuddhabhAgI bhavenmartyaH shrAddhaM kurva.nshchaturdashIm |
amAvAsyAM tu nivapansarvAnkAmAnavApnuyAt
shlokas.18:
kRRiShNapakShe dashamyAdau varjayitvA chaturdashIm |
shrAddhakarmaNi tithyaH syuH prashastA na tathetarAH
shlokas.19:
yathA chaivAparaH pakShaH pUrvapakShAdvishiShyate |
tathA shrAddhasya pUrvAhNAdaparAhNo vishiShyate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM sviddattaM pitRRibhyo vai bhavatyakShayamIshvara |
kiM havishchirarAtrAya kimAnantyAya kalpate
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
havIMShi shrAddhakalpe tu yAni shrAddhavido viduH |
tAni me shRRiNu kAmyAni phalaM chaiShAM yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
tilairvrIhiyavairmAShairadbhirmUlaphalaistathA |
dattena mAsaM prIyante shrAddhena pitaro nRRipa
shlokas.4:
vardhamAnatilaM shrAddhamakShayaM manurabravIt |
sarveShveva tu bhojyeShu tilAH prAdhAnyataH smRRitAH
shlokas.5:
dvau mAsau tu bhavettRRiptirmatsyaiH pitRRigaNasya ha |
trInmAsAnAvikenAhushchAturmAsyaM shashena tu
shlokas.6:
Ajena mAsAnprIyante pa~nchaiva pitaro nRRipa |
vArAheNa tu ShaNmAsAnsapta vai shAkunena tu
shlokas.7:
mAsAnaShTau pArShatena rauraveNa navaiva tu |
gavayasya tu mA.nsena tRRiptiH syAddashamAsikI
shlokas.8:
mAsAnekAdasha prItiH pitR^INAM mAhiSheNa tu |
gavyena datte shrAddhe tu sa.nvatsaramihochyate
shlokas.9:
yathA gavyaM tathA yuktaM pAyasaM sarpiShA saha |
vAdhrINasasya mA.nsena tRRiptirdvAdashavArShikI
shlokas.10:
AnantyAya bhaveddattaM khaDgamA.nsaM pitRRikShaye |
kAlashAkaM cha lauhaM chApyAnantyaM ChAga uchyate
shlokas.11:
gAthAshchApyatra gAyanti pitRRigItA yudhiShThira |
sanatkumAro bhagavAnpurA mayyabhyabhAShata
shlokas.12:
api naH sa kule jAyAdyo no dadyAttrayodashIm |
maghAsu sarpiShA yuktaM pAyasaM dakShiNAyane
shlokas.13:
Ajena vApi lauhena maghAsveva yatavrataH |
hastichChAyAsu vidhivatkarNavyajanavIjitam
shlokas.14:
eShTavyA bahavaH putrA yadyeko.api gayAM vrajet |
yatrAsau prathito lokeShvakShayyakaraNo vaTaH
shlokas.15:
Apo mUlaM phalaM mA.nsamannaM vApi pitRRikShaye |
yatki~nchinmadhusaMmishraM tadAnantyAya kalpate

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yamastu yAni shrAddhAni provAcha shashabindave |
tAni me shRRiNu kAmyAni nakShatreShu pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.2:
shrAddhaM yaH kRRittikAyoge kurvIta satataM naraH |
agnInAdhAya sApatyo yajeta vigatajvaraH
shlokas.3:
apatyakAmo rohiNyAmojaskAmo mRRigottame |
krUrakarmA dadachChrAddhamArdrAyAM mAnavo bhavet
shlokas.4:
kRRiShibhAgI bhavenmartyaH kurva~nshrAddhaM punarvasau |
puShTikAmo.atha puShyeNa shrAddhamIheta mAnavaH
shlokas.5:
AshleShAyAM dadachChrAddhaM vIrAnputrAnprajAyate |
j~nAtInAM tu bhavechChreShTho maghAsu shrAddhamAvapan
shlokas.6:
phalgunIShu dadachChrAddhaM subhagaH shrAddhado bhavet |
apatyabhAguttarAsu hastena phalabhAgbhavet
shlokas.7:
chitrAyAM tu dadachChrAddhaM labhedrUpavataH sutAn |
svAtiyoge pitR^Inarchya vANijyamupajIvati
shlokas.8:
bahuputro vishAkhAsu pitryamIhanbhavennaraH |
anurAdhAsu kurvANo rAjachakraM pravartayet
shlokas.9:
AdipatyaM vrajenmartyo jyeShThAyAmapavarjayan |
naraH kurukulashreShTha shraddhAdamapuraHsaraH
shlokas.10:
mUle tvArogyamarchCheta yasho.aShADhAsvanuttamam |
uttarAsu tvaShADhAsu vItashokashcharenmahIm
shlokas.11:
shrAddhaM tvabhijitA kurvanvidyAM shreShThAmavApnuyAt |
shravaNe tu dadachChrAddhaM pretya gachChetparAM gatim
shlokas.12:
rAjyabhAgI dhaniShThAyAM prApnuyAnnApadaM naraH |
nakShatre vAruNe kurvanbhiShaksiddhimavApnuyAt
shlokas.13:
pUrvaproShThapadAH kurvanbahu vindedajAvikam |
uttarAsvatha kurvANo vindate gAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.14:
bahurUpyakRRitaM vittaM vindate revatIM shritaH |
ashvA.nshchAshvayuje vetti bharaNIShvAyuruttamam
shlokas.15:
imaM shrAddhavidhiM shrutvA shashabindustathAkarot |
akleshenAjayachchApi mahIM so.anushashAsa ha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kIdRRishebhyaH pradAtavyaM bhavechChrAddhaM pitAmaha |
dvijebhyaH kurushArdUla tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
brAhmaNAnna parIkSheta kShatriyo dAnadharmavit |
daive karmaNi pitrye tu nyAyyamAhuH parIkShaNam
shlokas.3:
devatAH pUjayantIha daivenaiveha tejasA |
upetya tasmAddevebhyaH sarvebhyo dApayennaraH
shlokas.4:
shrAddhe tvatha mahArAja parIkShedbrAhmaNAnbudhaH |
kulashIlavayorUpairvidyayAbhijanena cha
shlokas.5:
eShAmanye pa~NktidUShAstathAnye pa~NktipAvanAH |
apA~NkteyAstu ye rAjankIrtayiShyAmi tA~nshRRiNu
shlokas.6:
kitavo bhrUNahA yakShmI pashupAlo nirAkRRitiH |
grAmapreShyo vArdhuShiko gAyanaH sarvavikrayI
shlokas.7:
agAradAhI garadaH kuNDAshI somavikrayI |
sAmudriko rAjabhRRityastailikaH kUTakArakaH
shlokas.8:
pitrA vivadamAnashcha yasya chopapatirgRRihe |
abhishastastathA stenaH shilpaM yashchopajIvati
shlokas.9:
parvakArashcha sUchI cha mitradhrukpAradArikaH |
avratAnAmupAdhyAyaH kANDapRRiShThastathaiva cha
shlokas.10:
shvabhiryashcha parikrAmedyaH shunA daShTa eva cha |
parivittishcha yashcha syAddushcharmA gurutalpagaH
kushIlavo devalako nakShatrairyashcha jIvati
shlokas.11:
etAniha vijAnIyAdapA~NkteyAndvijAdhamAn |
shUdrANAmupadeshaM cha ye kurvantyalpachetasaH
shlokas.12:
ShaShTiM kANaH shataM ShaNDhaH shvitrI yAvatprapashyati |
pa~NktyAM samupaviShTAyAM tAvaddUShayate nRRipa
shlokas.13:
yadveShTitashirA bhu~Nkte yadbhu~Nkte dakShiNAmukhaH |
sopAnatkashcha yadbhu~Nkte sarvaM vidyAttadAsuram
shlokas.14:
asUyatA cha yaddattaM yachcha shraddhAvivarjitam |
sarvaM tadasurendrAya brahmA bhAgamakalpayat
shlokas.15:
shvAnashcha pa~NktidUShAshcha nAvekSherankatha~nchana |
tasmAtparivRRite dadyAttilA.nshchAnvavakIrayet
shlokas.16:
tilAdAne cha kravyAdA ye cha krodhavashA gaNAH |
yAtudhAnAH pishAchAshcha vipralumpanti taddhaviH
shlokas.17:
yAvaddhyapa~NktyaH pa~NktyAM vai bhu~njAnAnanupashyati |
tAvatphalAdbhra.nshayati dAtAraM tasya bAlisham
shlokas.18:
ime tu bharatashreShTha vij~neyAH pa~NktipAvanAH |
ye tvatastAnpravakShyAmi parIkShasveha tAndvijAn
shlokas.19:
vedavidyAvratasnAtA brAhmaNAH sarva eva hi |
pA~NkteyAnyA.nstu vakShyAmi j~neyAste pa~NktipAvanAH
shlokas.20:
triNAchiketaH pa~nchAgnistrisuparNaH ShaDa~Ngavit |
brahmadeyAnusantAnashChandogo jyeShThasAmagaH
shlokas.21:
mAtApitroryashcha vashyaH shrotriyo dashapUruShaH |
RRitukAlAbhigAmI cha dharmapatnIShu yaH sadA
vedavidyAvratasnAto vipraH pa~NktiM punAtyuta
shlokas.22:
atharvashiraso.adhyetA brahmachArI yatavrataH |
satyavAdI dharmashIlaH svakarmaniratashcha yaH
shlokas.23:
ye cha puNyeShu tIrtheShu abhiShekakRRitashramAH |
makheShu cha samantreShu bhavantyavabhRRithAplutAH
shlokas.24:
akrodhanA achapalAH kShAntA dAntA jitendriyAH |
sarvabhUtahitA ye cha shrAddheShvetAnnimantrayet
eteShu dattamakShayyamete vai pa~NktipAvanAH
shlokas.25:
ime pare mahArAja vij~neyAH pa~NktipAvanAH |
yatayo mokShadharmaj~nA yogAH sucharitavratAH
shlokas.26:
ye chetihAsaM prayatAH shrAvayanti dvijottamAn |
ye cha bhAShyavidaH kechidye cha vyAkaraNe ratAH
shlokas.27:
adhIyate purANaM ye dharmashAstrANyathApi cha |
adhItya cha yathAnyAyaM vidhivattasya kAriNaH
shlokas.28:
upapanno gurukule satyavAdI sahasradaH |
agryaH sarveShu vedeShu sarvapravachaneShu cha
shlokas.29:
yAvadete prapashyanti pa~NktyAstAvatpunantyuta |
tato hi pAvanAtpa~NktyAH pa~NktipAvana uchyate
shlokas.30:
kroshAdardhatRRitIyAttu pAvayedeka eva hi |
brahmadeyAnusantAna iti brahmavido viduH
shlokas.31:
anRRitviganupAdhyAyaH sa chedagrAsanaM vrajet |
RRitvigbhirananuj~nAtaH pa~NktyA harati duShkRRitam
shlokas.32:
atha chedvedavitsarvaiH pa~NktidoShairvivarjitaH |
na cha syAtpatito rAjanpa~NktipAvana eva saH
shlokas.33:
tasmAtsarvaprayatnena parIkShyAmantrayeddvijAn |
svakarmaniratAndAntAnkule jAtAnbahushrutAn
shlokas.34:
yasya mitrapradhAnAni shrAddhAni cha havIMShi cha |
na prINAti pitR^IndevAnsvargaM cha na sa gachChati
shlokas.35:
yashcha shrAddhe kurute sa~NgatAni; na devayAnena pathA sa yAti |
sa vai muktaH pippalaM bandhanAdvA; svargAllokAchchyavate shrAddhamitraH
shlokas.36:
tasmAnmitraM shrAddhakRRinnAdriyeta; dadyAnmitrebhyaH sa~NgrahArthaM dhanAni |
yaM manyate naiva shatruM na mitraM; taM madhyasthaM bhojayeddhavyakavye
shlokas.37:
yathoShare bIjamuptaM na rohe;nna chAsyoptA prApnuyAdbIjabhAgam |
evaM shrAddhaM bhuktamanarhamANai;rna cheha nAmutra phalaM dadAti
shlokas.38:
brAhmaNo hyanadhIyAnastRRiNAgniriva shAmyati |
tasmai shrAddhaM na dAtavyaM na hi bhasmani hUyate
shlokas.39:
sambhojanI nAma pishAchadakShiNA; sA naiva devAnna pitR^Inupaiti |
ihaiva sA bhrAmyati kShINapuNyA; shAlAntare gauriva naShTavatsA
shlokas.40:
yathAgnau shAnte ghRRitamAjuhoti; tannaiva devAnna pitR^Inupaiti |
tathA dattaM nartane gAyane cha; yAM chAnRRiche dakShiNAmAvRRiNoti
shlokas.41:
ubhau hinasti na bhunakti chaiShA; yA chAnRRiche dakShiNA dIyate vai |
AghAtanI garhitaiShA patantI; teShAM pretAnpAtayeddevayAnAt
shlokas.42:
RRiShINAM samayaM nityaM ye charanti yudhiShThira |
nishchitAH sarvadharmaj~nAstAndevA brAhmaNAnviduH
shlokas.43:
svAdhyAyaniShThA RRiShayo j~nAnaniShThAstathaiva cha |
taponiShThAshcha boddhavyAH karmaniShThAshcha bhArata
shlokas.44:
kavyAni j~nAnaniShThebhyaH pratiShThApyAni bhArata |
tatra ye brAhmaNAH kechinna nindati hi te varAH
shlokas.45:
ye tu nindanti jalpeShu na tA~nshrAddheShu bhojayet |
brAhmaNA ninditA rAjanhanyustripuruShaM kulam
shlokas.46:
vaikhAnasAnAM vachanamRRiShINAM shrUyate nRRipa |
dUrAdeva parIkSheta brAhmaNAnvedapAragAn
priyAnvA yadi vA dveShyA.nsteShu tachChrAddhamAvapet
shlokas.47:
yaH sahasraM sahasrANAM bhojayedanRRichAM naraH |
ekastAnmantravitprItaH sarvAnarhati bhArata

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kena sa~NkalpitaM shrAddhaM kasminkAle kimAtmakam |
bhRRigva~Ngirasake kAle muninA katareNa vA
shlokas.2:
kAni shrAddheShu varjyAni tathA mUlaphalAni cha |
dhAnyajAtishcha kA varjyA tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yathA shrAddhaM sampravRRittaM yasminkAle yadAtmakam |
yena sa~NkalpitaM chaiva tanme shRRiNu janAdhipa
shlokas.4:
svAyambhuvo.atriH kauravya paramarShiH pratApavAn |
tasya va.nshe mahArAja dattAtreya iti smRRitaH
shlokas.5:
dattAtreyasya putro.abhUnnimirnAma tapodhanaH |
nimeshchApyabhavatputraH shrImAnnAma shriyA vRRitaH
shlokas.6:
pUrNe varShasahasrAnte sa kRRitvA duShkaraM tapaH |
kAladharmaparItAtmA nidhanaM samupAgataH
shlokas.7:
nimistu kRRitvA shauchAni vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA |
santApamagamattIvraM putrashokaparAyaNaH
shlokas.8:
atha kRRitvopahAryANi chaturdashyAM mahAmatiH |
tameva gaNaya~nshokaM virAtre pratyabudhyata
shlokas.9:
tasyAsItpratibuddhasya shokena pihitAtmanaH |
manaH saMhRRitya viShaye buddhirvistaragAminI
shlokas.10:
tataH sa~nchintayAmAsa shrAddhakalpaM samAhitaH |
yAni tasyaiva bhojyAni mUlAni cha phalAni cha
shlokas.11:
uktAni yAni chAnyAni yAni cheShTAni tasya ha |
tAni sarvANi manasA vinishchitya tapodhanaH
shlokas.12:
amAvAsyAM mahAprAj~na viprAnAnAyya pUjitAn |
dakShiNAvartikAH sarvA bRRisIH svayamathAkarot
shlokas.13:
sapta viprA.nstato bhojye yugapatsamupAnayat |
RRite cha lavaNaM bhojyaM shyAmAkAnnaM dadau prabhuH
shlokas.14:
dakShiNAgrAstato darbhA viShTareShu niveshitAH |
pAdayoshchaiva viprANAM ye tvannamupabhu~njate
shlokas.15:
kRRitvA cha dakShiNAgrAnvai darbhAnsuprayataH shuchiH |
pradadau shrImate piNDaM nAmagotramudAharan
shlokas.16:
tatkRRitvA sa munishreShTho dharmasa~NkaramAtmanaH |
pashchAttApena mahatA tapyamAno.abhyachintayat
shlokas.17:
akRRitaM munibhiH pUrvaM kiM mayaitadanuShThitam |
kathaM nu shApena na mAM daheyurbrAhmaNA iti
shlokas.18:
tataH sa~nchintayAmAsa va.nshakartAramAtmanaH |
dhyAtamAtrastathA chAtrirAjagAma tapodhanaH
shlokas.19:
athAtristaM tathA dRRiShTvA putrashokena karshitam |
bhRRishamAshvAsayAmAsa vAgbhiriShTAbhiravyayaH
shlokas.20:
nime sa~Nkalpitaste.ayaM pitRRiyaj~nastapodhanaH |
mA te bhUdbhIH pUrvadRRiShTo dharmo.ayaM brahmaNA svayam
shlokas.21:
so.ayaM svayambhuvihito dharmaH sa~NkalpitastvayA |
RRite svayambhuvaH ko.anyaH shrAddheyaM vidhimAharet
shlokas.22:
AkhyAsyAmi cha te bhUyaH shrAddheyaM vidhimuttamam |
svayambhuvihitaM putra tatkuruShva nibodha me
shlokas.23:
kRRitvAgnikaraNaM pUrvaM mantrapUrvaM tapodhana |
tato.aryamNe cha somAya varuNAya cha nityashaH
shlokas.24:
vishvedevAshcha ye nityaM pitRRibhiH saha gocharAH |
tebhyaH sa~NkalpitA bhAgAH svayameva svayambhuvA
shlokas.25:
stotavyA cheha pRRithivI nivApasyeha dhAriNI |
vaiShNavI kAshyapI cheti tathaivehAkShayeti cha
shlokas.26:
udakAnayane chaiva stotavyo varuNo vibhuH |
tato.agnishchaiva somashcha ApyAyyAviha te.anagha
shlokas.27:
devAstu pitaro nAma nirmitA vai svayambhuvA |
UShmapAH sumahAbhAgAsteShAM bhAgAH prakalpitAH
shlokas.28:
te shrAddhenArchyamAnA vai vimuchyante ha kilbiShAt |
saptakaH pitRRiva.nshastu pUrvadRRiShTaH svayambhuvA
shlokas.29:
vishve chAgnimukhA devAH sa~NkhyAtAH pUrvameva te |
teShAM nAmAni vakShyAmi bhAgArhANAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.30:
sahaH kRRitirvipApmA cha puNyakRRitpAvanastathA |
grAmniH kShemaH samUhashcha divyasAnustathaiva cha
shlokas.31:
vivasvAnvIryavAnhrImAnkIrtimAnkRRita eva cha |
vipUrvaH somapUrvashcha sUryashrIshcheti nAmataH
shlokas.32:
somapaH sUryasAvitro dattAtmA puShkarIyakaH |
uShNInAbho nabhodashcha vishvAyurdIptireva cha
shlokas.33:
chamUharaH suveShashcha vyomAriH sha~Nkaro bhavaH |
IshaH kartA kRRitirdakSho bhuvano divyakarmakRRit
shlokas.34:
gaNitaH pa~nchavIryashcha Adityo rashmimA.nstathA |
saptakRRitsomavarchAshcha vishvakRRitkavireva cha
shlokas.35:
anugoptA sugoptA cha naptA cheshvara eva cha |
jitAtmA munivIryashcha dIptalomA bhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.36:
atikarmA pratItashcha pradAtA chA.nshumA.nstathA |
shailAbhaH paramakrodhI dhIroShNI bhUpatistathA
shlokas.37:
srajI vajrI varI chaiva vishvedevAH sanAtanAH |
kIrtitAste mahAbhAgAH kAlasya gatigocharAH
shlokas.38:
ashrAddheyAni dhAnyAni kodravAH pulakAstathA |
hi~Ngu dravyeShu shAkeShu palANDuM lashunaM tathA
shlokas.39:
palANDuH saubha~njanakastathA gRRi~njanakAdayaH |
kUShmANDajAtyalAbuM cha kRRiShNaM lavaNameva cha
shlokas.40:
grAmyaM vArAhamA.nsaM cha yachchaivAprokShitaM bhavet |
kRRiShNAjAjI viDashchaiva shItapAkI tathaiva cha
a~NkurAdyAstathA varjyA iha shRRi~NgATakAni cha
shlokas.41:
varjayellavaNaM sarvaM tathA jambUphalAni cha |
avakShutAvaruditaM tathA shrAddheShu varjayet
shlokas.42:
nivApe havyakavye vA garhitaM cha shvadarshanam |
pitarashchaiva devAshcha nAbhinandanti taddhaviH
shlokas.43:
chaNDAlashvapachau varjyau nivApe samupasthite |
kAShAyavAsI kuShThI vA patito brahmahApi vA
shlokas.44:
sa~NkIrNayonirviprashcha sambandhI patitashcha yaH |
varjanIyA budhairete nivApe samupasthite
shlokas.45:
ityevamuktvA bhagavAnsvava.nshajamRRiShiM purA |
pitAmahasabhAM divyAM jagAmAtristapodhanaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tathA vidhau pravRRitte tu sarva eva maharShayaH |
pitRRiyaj~nAnakurvanta vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.2:
RRiShayo dharmanityAstu kRRitvA nivapanAnyuta |
tarpaNaM chApyakurvanta tIrthAmbhobhiryatavratAH
shlokas.3:
nivApairdIyamAnaishcha chAturvarNyena bhArata |
tarpitAH pitaro devAste nAnnaM jarayanti vai
shlokas.4:
ajIrNenAbhihanyante te devAH pitRRibhiH saha |
somamevAbhyapadyanta nivApAnnAbhipIDitAH
shlokas.5:
te.abruvansomamAsAdya pitaro.ajIrNapIDitAH |
nivApAnnena pIDyAmaH shreyo no.atra vidhIyatAm
shlokas.6:
tAnsomaH pratyuvAchAtha shreyashchedIpsitaM surAH |
svayambhUsadanaM yAta sa vaH shreyo vidhAsyati
shlokas.7:
te somavachanAddevAH pitRRibhiH saha bhArata |
merushRRi~Nge samAsInaM pitAmahamupAgaman
shlokas.8:
pitara UchuH||
nivApAnnena bhagavanbhRRishaM pIDyAmahe vayam |
prasAdaM kuru no deva shreyo naH sa.nvidhIyatAm
shlokas.9:
iti teShAM vachaH shrutvA svayambhUridamabravIt |
eSha me pArshvato vahniryuShmachChreyo vidhAsyati
shlokas.10:
agniruvAcha||
sahitAstAta bhokShyAmo nivApe samupasthite |
jarayiShyatha chApyannaM mayA sArdhaM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.11:
etachChrutvA tu pitarastataste vijvarAbhavan |
etasmAtkAraNAchchAgneH prAktanaM dIyate nRRipa
shlokas.12:
nivapte chAgnipUrve vai nivApe puruSharShabha |
na brahmarAkShasAstaM vai nivApaM dharShayantyuta
rakShA.nsi chApavartante sthite deve vibhAvasau
shlokas.13:
pUrvaM piNDaM piturdadyAttato dadyAtpitAmahe |
prapitAmahAya cha tata eSha shrAddhavidhiH smRRitaH
shlokas.14:
brUyAchChrAddhe cha sAvitrIM piNDe piNDe samAhitaH |
somAyeti cha vaktavyaM tathA pitRRimateti cha
shlokas.15:
rajasvalA cha yA nArI vya~NgitA karNayoshcha yA |
nivApe nopatiShTheta sa~NgrAhyA nAnyava.nshajAH
shlokas.16:
jalaM prataramANashcha kIrtayeta pitAmahAn |
nadImAsAdya kurvIta pitR^INAM piNDatarpaNam
shlokas.17:
pUrvaM svava.nshajAnAM tu kRRitvAdbhistarpaNaM punaH |
suhRRitsambandhivargANAM tato dadyAjjalA~njalim
shlokas.18:
kalmAShagoyugenAtha yuktena tarato jalam |
pitaro.abhilaShante vai nAvaM chApyadhirohataH
sadA nAvi jalaM tajj~nAH prayachChanti samAhitAH
shlokas.19:
mAsArdhe kRRiShNapakShasya kuryAnnivapanAni vai |
puShTirAyustathA vIryaM shrIshchaiva pitRRivartinaH
shlokas.20:
pitAmahaH pulastyashcha vasiShThaH pulahastathA |
a~NgirAshcha kratushchaiva kashyapashcha mahAnRRiShiH
ete kurukulashreShTha mahAyogeshvarAH smRRitAH
shlokas.21:
ete cha pitaro rAjanneSha shrAddhavidhiH paraH |
pretAstu piNDasambandhAnmuchyante tena karmaNA
shlokas.22:
ityeShA puruShashreShTha shrAddhotpattiryathAgamam |
khyApitA pUrvanirdiShTA dAnaM vakShyAmyataH param

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dvijAtayo vratopetA haviste yadi bhu~njate |
annaM brAhmaNakAmAya kathametatpitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
avedoktavratAshchaiva bhu~njAnAH kAryakAriNaH |
vedokteShu tu bhu~njAnA vrataluptA yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadidaM tapa ityAhurupavAsaM pRRithagjanAH |
tapaH syAdetadiha vai tapo.anyadvApi kiM bhavet
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mAsArdhamAsau nopavasedyattapo manyate janaH |
AtmatantropaghAtI yo na tapasvI na dharmavit
shlokas.5:
tyAgasyApi cha sampattiH shiShyate tapa uttamam |
sadopavAsI cha bhavedbrahmachArI tathaiva cha
shlokas.6:
munishcha syAtsadA vipro devA.nshchaiva sadA yajet |
kuTumbiko dharmakAmaH sadAsvapnashcha bhArata
shlokas.7:
amRRitAshI sadA cha syAtpavitrI cha sadA bhavet |
RRitavAdI sadA cha syAnniyatashcha sadA bhavet
shlokas.8:
vighasAshI sadA cha syAtsadA chaivAtithipriyaH |
amA.nsAshI sadA cha syAtpavitrI cha sadA bhavet
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM sadopavAsI syAdbrahmachArI cha pArthiva |
vighasAshI kathaM cha syAtkathaM chaivAtithipriyaH
shlokas.10:
bhIShma uvAcha||
antarA sAyamAshaM cha prAtarAshaM tathaiva cha |
sadopavAsI bhavati yo na bhu~Nkte.antarA punaH
shlokas.11:
bhAryAM gachChanbrahmachArI sadA bhavati chaiva ha |
RRitavAdI sadA cha syAddAnashIlashcha mAnavaH
shlokas.12:
abhakShayanvRRithA mA.nsamamA.nsAshI bhavatyuta |
dAnaM dadatpavitrI syAdasvapnashcha divAsvapan
shlokas.13:
bhRRityAtithiShu yo bhu~Nkte bhuktavatsu naraH sadA |
amRRitaM kevalaM bhu~Nkte iti viddhi yudhiShThira
shlokas.14:
abhuktavatsu nAshnAti brAhmaNeShu tu yo naraH |
abhojanena tenAsya jitaH svargo bhavatyuta
shlokas.15:
devebhyashcha pitRRibhyashcha bhRRityebhyo.atithibhiH saha |
avashiShTAni yo bhu~Nkte tamAhurvighasAshinam
shlokas.16:
teShAM lokA hyaparyantAH sadane brahmaNaH smRRitAH |
upasthitA hyapsarobhirgandharvaishcha janAdhipa
shlokas.17:
devatAtithibhiH sArdhaM pitRRibhishchopabhu~njate |
ramante putrapautraishcha teShAM gatiranuttamA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
brAhmaNebhyaH prayachChanti dAnAni vividhAni cha |
dAtRRipratigrahItrorvA ko visheShaH pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sAdhoryaH pratigRRihNIyAttathaivAsAdhuto dvijaH |
guNavatyalpadoShaH syAnnirguNe tu nimajjati
shlokas.3:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
vRRiShAdarbheshcha sa.nvAdaM saptarShINAM cha bhArata
shlokas.4:
kashyapo.atrirvasiShThashcha bharadvAjo.atha gautamaH |
vishvAmitro jamadagniH sAdhvI chaivApyarundhatI
shlokas.5:
sarveShAmatha teShAM tu gaNDAbhUtkarmakArikA |
shUdraH pashusakhashchaiva bhartA chAsyA babhUva ha
shlokas.6:
te vai sarve tapasyantaH purA cherurmahImimAm |
samAdhinopashikShanto brahmalokaM sanAtanam
shlokas.7:
athAbhavadanAvRRiShTirmahatI kurunandana |
kRRichChraprANo.abhavadyatra loko.ayaM vai kShudhAnvitaH
shlokas.8:
kasmi.nshchichcha purA yaj~ne yAjyena shibisUnunA |
dakShiNArthe.atha RRitvigbhyo dattaH putro nijaH kila
shlokas.9:
tasminkAle.atha so.alpAyurdiShTAntamagamatprabho |
te taM kShudhAbhisantaptAH parivAryopatasthire
shlokas.10:
yAjyAtmajamatho dRRiShTvA gatAsumRRiShisattamAH |
apachanta tadA sthAlyAM kShudhArtAH kila bhArata
shlokas.11:
nirAdye martyaloke.asminnAtmAnaM te parIpsavaH |
kRRichChrAmApedire vRRittimannahetostapasvinaH
shlokas.12:
aTamAno.atha tAnmArge pachamAnAnmahIpatiH |
rAjA shaibyo vRRiShAdarbhiH klishyamAnAndadarsha ha
shlokas.13:
vRRiShAdarbhiruvAcha||
pratigrahastArayati puShTirvai pratigRRihNatAm |
mayi yadvidyate vittaM tachChRRiNudhvaM tapodhanAH
shlokas.14:
priyo hi me brAhmaNo yAchamAno; dadyAmahaM vo.ashvatarIsahasram |
ekaikashaH savRRiShAH samprasUtAH; sarveShAM vai shIghragAH shvetalomAH
shlokas.15:
kulambharAnanaDuhaH shata.nshatA;ndhuryA~nshubhAnsarvasho.ahaM dadAni |
pRRithvIvAhAnpIvarA.nshchaiva tAva;dagryA gRRiShTyo dhenavaH suvratAshcha
shlokas.16:
varAngrAmAnvrIhiyavaM rasA.nshcha; ratnaM chAnyaddurlabhaM kiM dadAni |
mA smAbhakShye bhAvamevaM kurudhvaM; puShTyarthaM vai kiM prayachChAmyahaM vaH
shlokas.17:
RRiShaya UchuH||
rAjanpratigraho rAj~no madhvAsvAdo viShopamaH |
tajjAnamAnaH kasmAttvaM kuruShe naH pralobhanam
shlokas.18:
kShatraM hi daivatamiva brAhmaNaM samupAshritam |
amalo hyeSha tapasA prItaH prINAti devatAH
shlokas.19:
ahnApIha tapo jAtu brAhmaNasyopajAyate |
taddAva iva nirdahyAtprApto rAjapratigrahaH
shlokas.20:
kushalaM saha dAnena rAjannastu sadA tava |
arthibhyo dIyatAM sarvamityuktvA te tato yayuH
shlokas.21:
apakvameva tanmA.nsamabhUtteShAM cha dhImatAm |
atha hitvA yayuH sarve vanamAhArakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.22:
tataH prachoditA rAj~nA vanaM gatvAsya mantriNaH |
prachIyodumbarANi sma dAnaM dAtuM prachakramuH
shlokas.23:
udumbarANyathAnyAni hemagarbhANyupAharan |
bhRRityAsteShAM tatastAni pragrAhitumupAdravan
shlokas.24:
gurUNIti viditvAtha na grAhyANyatrirabravIt |
na sma he mUDhavij~nAnA na sma he mandabuddhayaH
haimAnImAni jAnImaH pratibuddhAH sma jAgRRimaH
shlokas.25:
iha hyetadupAdattaM pretya syAtkaTukodayam |
apratigrAhyamevaitatpretya cheha sukhepsunA
shlokas.26:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
shatena niShkaM gaNitaM sahasreNa cha saMmitam |
yathA bahu pratIchChanhi pApiShThAM labhate gatim
shlokas.27:
kashyapa uvAcha||
yatpRRithivyAM vrIhiyavaM hiraNyaM pashavaH striyaH |
sarvaM tannAlamekasya tasmAdvidvA~nshamaM vrajet
shlokas.28:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
utpannasya ruroH shRRi~NgaM vardhamAnasya vardhate |
prArthanA puruShasyeva tasya mAtrA na vidyate
shlokas.29:
gautama uvAcha||
na talloke dravyamasti yallokaM pratipUrayet |
samudrakalpaH puruSho na kadAchana pUryate
shlokas.30:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
kAmaM kAmayamAnasya yadA kAmaH samRRidhyate |
athainamaparaH kAmastRRiShNA vidhyati bANavat
shlokas.31:
jamadagniruvAcha||
pratigrahe sa.nyamo vai tapo dhArayate dhruvam |
taddhanaM brAhmaNasyeha lubhyamAnasya visravet
shlokas.32:
arundhatyuvAcha||
dharmArthaM sa~nchayo yo vai dravyANAM pakShasaMmataH |
tapaHsa~nchaya eveha vishiShTo dravyasa~nchayAt
shlokas.33:
gaNDovAcha||
ugrAdito bhayAdyasmAdbibhyatIme mameshvarAH |
balIyA.nso durbalavadbibhemyahamataH param
shlokas.34:
pashusakha uvAcha||
yadvai dharme paraM nAsti brAhmaNAstaddhanaM viduH |
vinayArthaM suvidvA.nsamupAseyaM yathAtatham
shlokas.35:
RRiShaya UchuH||
kushalaM saha dAnAya tasmai yasya prajA imAH |
phalAnyupadhiyuktAni ya evaM naH prayachChasi
shlokas.36:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktvA hemagarbhANi hitvA tAni phalAni te |
RRiShayo jagmuranyatra sarva eva dhRRitavratAH
shlokas.37:
mantriNaH UchuH||
upadhiM sha~NkamAnAste hitvemAni phalAni vai |
tato.anyenaiva gachChanti viditaM te.astu pArthiva
shlokas.38:
ityuktaH sa tu bhRRityaistairvRRiShAdarbhishchukopa ha |
teShAM sampratikartuM cha sarveShAmagamadgRRiham
shlokas.39:
sa gatvAhavanIye.agnau tIvraM niyamamAsthitaH |
juhAva sa.nskRRitAM mantrairekaikAmAhutiM nRRipaH
shlokas.40:
tasmAdagneH samuttasthau kRRityA lokabhaya~NkarI |
tasyA nAma vRRiShAdarbhiryAtudhAnItyathAkarot
shlokas.41:
sA kRRityA kAlarAtrIva kRRitA~njalirupasthitA |
vRRiShAdarbhiM narapatiM kiM karomIti chAbravIt
shlokas.42:
vRRiShAdarbhiruvAcha||
RRiShINAM gachCha saptAnAmarundhatyAstathaiva cha |
dAsIbhartushcha dAsyAshcha manasA nAma dhAraya
shlokas.43:
j~nAtvA nAmAni chaiteShAM sarvAnetAnvinAshaya |
vinaShTeShu yathA svairaM gachCha yatrepsitaM tava
shlokas.44:
sA tatheti pratishrutya yAtudhAnI svarUpiNI |
jagAma tadvanaM yatra vicheruste maharShayaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
athAtripramukhA rAjanvane tasminmaharShayaH |
vyacharanbhakShayanto vai mUlAni cha phalAni cha
shlokas.2:
athApashyansupInA.nsapANipAdamukhodaram |
parivrajantaM sthUlA~NgaM parivrAjaM shunaHsakham
shlokas.3:
arundhatI tu taM dRRiShTvA sarvA~NgopachitaM shubhA |
bhavitAro bhavanto vai naivamityabravIdRRiShIn
shlokas.4:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
naitasyeha yathAsmAkamagnihotramanirhutam |
sAyaM prAtashcha hotavyaM tena pIvA~nshunaHsakhaH
shlokas.5:
atriruvAcha||
naitasyeha yathAsmAkaM kShudhA vIryaM samAhatam |
kRRichChrAdhItaM pranaShTaM cha tena pIvA~nshunaHsakhaH
shlokas.6:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
naitasyeha yathAsmAkaM shashvachChAstraM jaradgavaH |
alasaH kShutparo mUrkhastena pIvA~nshunaHsakhaH
shlokas.7:
jamadagniruvAcha||
naitasyeha yathAsmAkaM bhaktamindhanameva cha |
sa~nchintya vArShikaM ki~nchittena pIvA~nshunaHsakhaH
shlokas.8:
kashyapa uvAcha||
naitasyeha yathAsmAkaM chatvArashcha sahodarAH |
dehi dehIti bhikShanti tena pIvA~nshunaHsakhaH
shlokas.9:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
naitasyeha yathAsmAkaM brahmabandhorachetasaH |
shoko bhAryApavAdena tena pIvA~nshunaHsakhaH
shlokas.10:
gautama uvAcha||
naitasyeha yathAsmAkaM trikausheyaM hi rA~Nkavam |
ekaikaM vai trivArShIyaM tena pIvA~nshunaHsakhaH
shlokas.11:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atha dRRiShTvA parivrATsa tAnmaharShI~nshunaHsakhaH |
abhigamya yathAnyAyaM pANisparshamathAcharat
shlokas.12:
paricharyAM vane tAM tu kShutpratIghAtakArikAm |
anyonyena nivedyAtha prAtiShThanta sahaiva te
shlokas.13:
ekanishchayakAryAshcha vyacharanta vanAni te |
AdadAnAH samuddhRRitya mUlAni cha phalAni cha
shlokas.14:
kadAchidvicharantaste vRRikShairaviralairvRRitAm |
shuchivAriprasannodAM dadRRishuH padminIM shubhAm
shlokas.15:
bAlAdityavapuHprakhyaiH puShkarairupashobhitAm |
vaidUryavarNasadRRishaiH padmapatrairathAvRRitAm
shlokas.16:
nAnAvidhaishcha vihagairjalaprakarasevibhiH |
ekadvArAmanAdeyAM sUpatIrthAmakardamAm
shlokas.17:
vRRiShAdarbhiprayuktA tu kRRityA vikRRitadarshanA |
yAtudhAnIti vikhyAtA padminIM tAmarakShata
shlokas.18:
shunaHsakhasahAyAstu bisArthaM te maharShayaH |
padminImabhijagmuste sarve kRRityAbhirakShitAm
shlokas.19:
tataste yAtudhAnIM tAM dRRiShTvA vikRRitadarshanAm |
sthitAM kamalinItIre kRRityAmUchurmaharShayaH
shlokas.20:
ekA tiShThasi kA nu tvaM kasyArthe kiM prayojanam |
padminItIramAshritya brUhi tvaM kiM chikIrShasi
shlokas.21:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
yAsmi sAsmyanuyogo me na kartavyaH katha~nchana |
ArakShiNIM mAM padminyA vitta sarve tapodhanAH
shlokas.22:
RRiShaya UchuH||
sarva eva kShudhArtAH sma na chAnyatki~nchidasti naH |
bhavatyAH saMmate sarve gRRihNImahi bisAnyuta
shlokas.23:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
samayena bisAnIto gRRihNIdhvaM kAmakArataH |
ekaiko nAma me proktvA tato gRRihNIta mAchiram
shlokas.24:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vij~nAya yAtudhAnIM tAM kRRityAmRRiShivadhaiShiNIm |
atriH kShudhAparItAtmA tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.25:
arAtriratreH sA rAtriryAM nAdhIte triradya vai |
arAtriratrirityeva nAma me viddhi shobhane
shlokas.26:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
yathodAhRRitametatte mayi nAma mahAmune |
durdhAryametanmanasA gachChAvatara padminIm
shlokas.27:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
vasiShTho.asmi variShTho.asmi vase vAsaM gRRiheShvapi |
variShThatvAchcha vAsAchcha vasiShTha iti viddhi mAm
shlokas.28:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
nAmanairuktametatte duHkhavyAbhAShitAkSharam |
naitaddhArayituM shakyaM gachChAvatara padminIm
shlokas.29:
kashyapa uvAcha||
kulaM kulaM cha kupapaH kupayaH kashyapo dvijaH |
kAshyaH kAshanikAshatvAdetanme nAma dhAraya
shlokas.30:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
yathodAhRRitametatte mayi nAma mahAmune |
durdhAryametanmanasA gachChAvatara padminIm
shlokas.31:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
bhare sutAnbhare shiShyAnbhare devAnbhare dvijAn |
bhare bhAryAmanavyAjo bharadvAjo.asmi shobhane
shlokas.32:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
nAmanairuktametatte duHkhavyAbhAShitAkSharam |
naitaddhArayituM shakyaM gachChAvatara padminIm
shlokas.33:
gautama uvAcha||
godamo damago.adhUmo damo durdarshanashcha te |
viddhi mAM gautamaM kRRitye yAtudhAni nibodha me
shlokas.34:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
yathodAhRRitametatte mayi nAma mahAmune |
naitaddhArayituM shakyaM gachChAvatara padminIm
shlokas.35:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
vishvedevAshcha me mitraM mitramasmi gavAM tathA |
vishvAmitramiti khyAtaM yAtudhAni nibodha me
shlokas.36:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
nAmanairuktametatte duHkhavyAbhAShitAkSharam |
naitaddhArayituM shakyaM gachChAvatara padminIm
shlokas.37:
jamadagniruvAcha||
jAjamadyajajA nAma mRRijA mAha jijAyiShe |
jamadagniriti khyAtamato mAM viddhi shobhane
shlokas.38:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
yathodAhRRitametatte mayi nAma mahAmune |
naitaddhArayituM shakyaM gachChAvatara padminIm
shlokas.39:
arundhatyuvAcha||
dharAM dharitrIM vasudhAM bhartustiShThAmyanantaram |
mano.anurundhatI bharturiti mAM viddhyarundhatIm
shlokas.40:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
nAmanairuktametatte duHkhavyAbhAShitAkSharam |
naitaddhArayituM shakyaM gachChAvatara padminIm
shlokas.41:
gaNDovAcha||
gaNDaM gaNDaM gatavatI gaNDagaNDeti sa~nj~nitA |
gaNDagaNDeva gaNDeti viddhi mAnalasambhave
shlokas.42:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
nAmanairuktametatte duHkhavyAbhAShitAkSharam |
naitaddhArayituM shakyaM gachChAvatara padminIm
shlokas.43:
pashusakha uvAcha||
sakhA sakhe yaH sakhyeyaH pashUnAM cha sakhA sadA |
gauNaM pashusakhetyevaM viddhi mAmagnisambhave
shlokas.44:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
nAmanairuktametatte duHkhavyAbhAShitAkSharam |
naitaddhArayituM shakyaM gachChAvatara padminIm
shlokas.45:
shunaHsakha uvAcha||
ebhiruktaM yathA nAma nAhaM vaktumihotsahe |
shunaHsakhasakhAyaM mAM yAtudhAnyupadhAraya
shlokas.46:
yAtudhAnyuvAcha||
nAma te.avyaktamuktaM vai vAkyaM sa.ndigdhayA girA |
tasmAtsakRRididAnIM tvaM brUhi yannAma te dvija
shlokas.47:
shunaHsakha uvAcha||
sakRRiduktaM mayA nAma na gRRihItaM yadA tvayA |
tasmAttridaNDAbhihatA gachCha bhasmeti mAchiram
shlokas.48:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sA brahmadaNDakalpena tena mUrdhni hatA tadA |
kRRityA papAta medinyAM bhasmasAchcha jagAma ha
shlokas.49:
shunaHsakhashcha hatvA tAM yAtudhAnIM mahAbalAm |
bhuvi tridaNDaM viShTabhya shAdvale samupAvishat
shlokas.50:
tataste munayaH sarve puShkarANi bisAni cha |
yathAkAmamupAdAya samuttasthurmudAnvitAH
shlokas.51:
shrameNa mahatA yuktAste bisAni kalApashaH |
tIre nikShipya padminyAstarpaNaM chakrurambhasA
shlokas.52:
athotthAya jalAttasmAtsarve te vai samAgaman |
nApashya.nshchApi te tAni bisAni puruSharShabha
shlokas.53:
RRiShaya UchuH||
kena kShudhAbhibhUtAnAmasmAkaM pApakarmaNA |
nRRisha.nsenApanItAni bisAnyAhArakA~NkShiNAm
shlokas.54:
te sha~NkamAnAstvanyonyaM paprachChurdvijasattamAH |
ta UchuH shapathaM sarve kurma ityarikarshana
shlokas.55:
ta uktvA bADhamityeva sarva eva shunaHsakham |
kShudhArtAH suparishrAntAH shapathAyopachakramuH
shlokas.56:
atriruvAcha||
sa gAM spRRishatu pAdena sUryaM cha pratimehatu |
anadhyAyeShvadhIyIta bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.57:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
anadhyAyaparo loke shunaH sa parikarShatu |
parivrATkAmavRRitto.astu bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.58:
sharaNAgataM hantu mitraM svasutAM chopajIvatu |
arthAnkA~NkShatu kInAshAdbisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.59:
kashyapa uvAcha||
sarvatra sarvaM paNatu nyAsalopaM karotu cha |
kUTasAkShitvamabhyetu bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.60:
vRRithAmA.nsaM samashnAtu vRRithAdAnaM karotu cha |
yAtu striyaM divA chaiva bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.61:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
nRRisha.nsastyaktadharmAstu strIShu j~nAtiShu goShu cha |
brAhmaNaM chApi jayatAM bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.62:
upAdhyAyamadhaH kRRitvA RRicho.adhyetu yajUMShi cha |
juhotu cha sa kakShAgnau bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.63:
jamadagniruvAcha||
purIShamutsRRijatvapsu hantu gAM chApi dohinIm |
anRRitau maithunaM yAtu bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.64:
dveShyo bhAryopajIvI syAddUrabandhushcha vairavAn |
anyonyasyAtithishchAstu bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.65:
gautama uvAcha||
adhItya vedA.nstyajatu trInagnInapavidhyatu |
vikrINAtu tathA somaM bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.66:
udapAnaplave grAme brAhmaNo vRRiShalIpatiH |
tasya sAlokyatAM yAtu bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.67:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
jIvato vai gurUnbhRRityAnbharantvasya pare janAH |
agatirbahuputraH syAdbisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.68:
ashuchirbrahmakUTo.astu RRiddhyA chaivApyaha~NkRRitaH |
karShako matsarI chAstu bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.69:
varShAnkarotu bhRRitako rAj~nashchAstu purohitaH |
ayAjyasya bhavedRRitvigbisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.70:
arundhatyuvAcha||
nityaM parivadechChvashrUM bharturbhavatu durmanAH |
ekA svAdu samashnAtu bisastainyaM karoti yA
shlokas.71:
j~nAtInAM gRRihamadhyasthA saktUnattu dinakShaye |
abhAgyAvIrasUrastu bisastainyaM karoti yA
shlokas.72:
gaNDovAcha||
anRRitaM bhAShatu sadA sAdhubhishcha virudhyatu |
dadAtu kanyAM shulkena bisastainyaM karoti yA
shlokas.73:
sAdhayitvA svayaM prAsheddAsye jIvatu chaiva ha |
vikarmaNA pramIyeta bisastainyaM karoti yA
shlokas.74:
pashusakha uvAcha||
dAsya eva prajAyeta so.aprasUtiraki~nchanaH |
daivateShvanamaskAro bisastainyaM karoti yaH
shlokas.75:
shunaHsakha uvAcha||
adhvaryave duhitaraM dadAtu; chChandoge vA charitabrahmacharye |
AtharvaNaM vedamadhItya vipraH; snAyIta yo vai harate bisAni
shlokas.76:
RRiShaya UchuH||
iShTametaddvijAtInAM yo.ayaM te shapathaH kRRitaH |
tvayA kRRitaM bisastainyaM sarveShAM naH shunaHsakha
shlokas.77:
shunaHsakha uvAcha||
nyastamAdyamapashyadbhiryaduktaM kRRitakarmabhiH |
satyametanna mithyaitadbisastainyaM kRRitaM mayA
shlokas.78:
mayA hyantarhitAnIha bisAnImAni pashyata |
parIkShArthaM bhagavatAM kRRitametanmayAnaghAH
rakShaNArthaM cha sarveShAM bhavatAmahamAgataH
shlokas.79:
yAtudhAnI hyatikruddhA kRRityaiShA vo vadhaiShiNI |
vRRiShAdarbhiprayuktaiShA nihatA me tapodhanAH
shlokas.80:
duShTA hi.nsyAdiyaM pApA yuShmAnpratyagnisambhavA |
tasmAdasmyAgato viprA vAsavaM mAM nibodhata
shlokas.81:
alobhAdakShayA lokAH prAptA vaH sArvakAmikAH |
uttiShThadhvamitaH kShipraM tAnavApnuta vai dvijAH
shlokas.82:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato maharShayaH prItAstathetyuktvA pura.ndaram |
sahaiva tridashendreNa sarve jagmustriviShTapam
shlokas.83:
evamete mahAtmAno bhogairbahuvidhairapi |
kShudhA paramayA yuktAshChandyamAnA mahAtmabhiH
naiva lobhaM tadA chakrustataH svargamavApnuvan
shlokas.84:
tasmAtsarvAsvavasthAsu naro lobhaM vivarjayet |
eSha dharmaH paro rAjannalobha iti vishrutaH
shlokas.85:
idaM naraH sachcharitaM samavAyeShu kIrtayet |
sukhabhAgI cha bhavati na cha durgANyavApnute
shlokas.86:
prIyante pitarashchAsya RRiShayo devatAstathA |
yashodharmArthabhAgI cha bhavati pretya mAnavaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atraivodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
yadvRRittaM tIrthayAtrAyAM shapathaM prati tachChRRiNu
shlokas.2:
puShkarArthaM kRRitaM stainyaM purA bharatasattama |
rAjarShibhirmahArAja tathaiva cha dvijarShibhiH
shlokas.3:
RRiShayaH sametAH pashchime vai prabhAse; samAgatA mantramamantrayanta |
charAma sarve pRRithivIM puNyatIrthAM; tannaH kAryaM hanta gachChAma sarve
shlokas.4:
shukro.a~NgirAshchaiva kavishcha vidvAM;stathAgastyo nAradaparvatau cha |
bhRRigurvasiShThaH kashyapo gautamashcha; vishvAmitro jamadagnishcha rAjan
shlokas.5:
RRiShistathA gAlavo.athAShTakashcha; bharadvAjo.arundhatI vAlakhilyAH |
shibirdilIpo nahuSho.ambarISho; rAjA yayAtirdhundhumAro.atha pUruH
shlokas.6:
jagmuH puraskRRitya mahAnubhAvaM; shatakratuM vRRitrahaNaM narendra |
tIrthAni sarvANi parikramanto; mAghyAM yayuH kaushikIM puNyatIrthAm
shlokas.7:
sarveShu tIrtheShvatha dhUtapApA; jagmustato brahmasaraH supuNyam |
devasya tIrthe jalamagnikalpA; vigAhya te bhuktabisaprasUnAH
shlokas.8:
kechidbisAnyakhana.nstatra rAja;nnanye mRRiNAlAnyakhana.nstatra viprAH |
athApashyanpuShkaraM te hriyantaM; hradAdagastyena samuddhRRitaM vai
shlokas.9:
tAnAha sarvAnRRiShimukhyAnagastyaH; kenAdattaM puShkaraM me sujAtam |
yuShmA~nsha~Nke dIyatAM puShkaraM me; na vai bhavanto hartumarhanti padmam
shlokas.10:
shRRiNomi kAlo hi.nsate dharmavIryaM; seyaM prAptA vardhate dharmapIDA |
purAdharmo vardhate neha yAva;ttAvadgachChAmi paralokaM chirAya
shlokas.11:
purA vedAnbrAhmaNA grAmamadhye; ghuShTasvarA vRRiShalA~nshrAvayanti |
purA rAjA vyavahArAnadharmyA;npashyatyahaM paralokaM vrajAmi
shlokas.12:
purAvarAnpratyavarAngarIyaso; yAvannarA nAvama.nsyanti sarve |
tamottaraM yAvadidaM na vartate; tAvadvrajAmi paralokaM chirAya
shlokas.13:
purA prapashyAmi pareNa martyA;nbalIyasA durbalAnbhujyamAnAn |
tasmAdyAsyAmi paralokaM chirAya; na hyutsahe draShTumIdRRi~NnRRiloke
shlokas.14:
tamAhurArtA RRiShayo maharShiM; na te vayaM puShkaraM chorayAmaH |
mithyAbhiSha~Ngo bhavatA na kAryaH; shapAma tIkShNA~nshapathAnmaharShe
shlokas.15:
te nishchitAstatra maharShayastu; saMmanyanto dharmamevaM narendra |
tato.ashapa~nshapathAnparyayeNa; sahaiva te pArthiva putrapautraiH
shlokas.16:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
pratyAkroshedihAkruShTastADitaH pratitADayet |
khAdechcha pRRiShThamA.nsAni yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.17:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
asvAdhyAyaparo loke shvAnaM cha parikarShatu |
pure cha bhikShurbhavatu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.18:
kashyapa uvAcha||
sarvatra sarvaM paNatu nyAse lobhaM karotu cha |
kUTasAkShitvamabhyetu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.19:
gautama uvAcha||
jIvatvaha~NkRRito buddhyA vipaNatvadhamena saH |
karShako matsarI chAstu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.20:
a~NgirA uvAcha||
ashuchirbrahmakUTo.astu shvAnaM cha parikarShatu |
brahmahAnikRRitishchAstu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.21:
dhundhumAra uvAcha||
akRRitaj~no.astu mitrANAM shUdrAyAM tu prajAyatu |
ekaH sampannamashnAtu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.22:
pUruruvAcha||
chikitsAyAM pracharatu bhAryayA chaiva puShyatu |
shvashurAttasya vRRittiH syAdyaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.23:
dilIpa uvAcha||
udapAnaplave grAme brAhmaNo vRRiShalIpatiH |
tasya lokAnsa vrajatu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.24:
shukra uvAcha||
pRRiShThamA.nsaM samashnAtu divA gachChatu maithunam |
preShyo bhavatu rAj~nashcha yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.25:
jamadagniruvAcha||
anadhyAyeShvadhIyIta mitraM shrAddhe cha bhojayet |
shrAddhe shUdrasya chAshnIyAdyaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.26:
shibiruvAcha||
anAhitAgnirmriyatAM yaj~ne vighnaM karotu cha |
tapasvibhirvirudhyeta yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.27:
yayAtiruvAcha||
anRRitau jaTI vratinyAM vai bhAryAyAM samprajAyatu |
nirAkarotu vedA.nshcha yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.28:
nahuSha uvAcha||
atithiM gRRihastho nudatu kAmavRRitto.astu dIkShitaH |
vidyAM prayachChatu bhRRito yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.29:
ambarISha uvAcha||
nRRisha.nsastyaktadharmo.astu strIShu j~nAtiShu goShu cha |
brAhmaNaM chApi jahatu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.30:
nArada uvAcha||
gUDho.aj~nAnI bahiH shAstraM paThatAM visvaraM padam |
garIyaso.avajAnAtu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.31:
nAbhAga uvAcha||
anRRitaM bhAShatu sadA sadbhishchaiva virudhyatu |
shulkena kanyAM dadatu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.32:
kaviruvAcha||
padA sa gAM tADayatu sUryaM cha prati mehatu |
sharaNAgataM cha tyajatu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.33:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
karotu bhRRitako.avarShAM rAj~nashchAstu purohitaH |
RRitvigastu hyayAjyasya yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.34:
parvata uvAcha||
grAme chAdhikRRitaH so.astu kharayAnena gachChatu |
shunaH karShatu vRRittyarthe yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.35:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
sarvapApasamAdAnaM nRRisha.nse chAnRRite cha yat |
tattasyAstu sadA pApaM yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.36:
aShTaka uvAcha||
sa rAjAstvakRRitapraj~naH kAmavRRittishcha pApakRRit |
adharmeNAnushAstUrvIM yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.37:
gAlava uvAcha||
pApiShThebhyastvanarghArhaH sa naro.astu svapApakRRit |
dattvA dAnaM kIrtayatu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.38:
arundhatyuvAcha||
shvashrvApavAdaM vadatu bharturbhavatu durmanAH |
ekA svAdu samashnAtu yA te harati puShkaram
shlokas.39:
vAlakhilyA UchuH||
ekapAdena vRRittyarthaM grAmadvAre sa tiShThatu |
dharmaj~nastyaktadharmo.astu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.40:
pashusakha uvAcha||
agnihotramanAdRRitya sukhaM svapatu sa dvijaH |
parivrATkAmavRRitto.astu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.41:
surabhyuvAcha||
bAlvajena nidAnena kA.nsyaM bhavatu dohanam |
duhyeta paravatsena yA te harati puShkaram
shlokas.42:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatastu taiH shapathaiH shapyamAnai;rnAnAvidhairbahubhiH kauravendra |
sahasrAkSho devarATsamprahRRiShTaH; samIkShya taM kopanaM vipramukhyam
shlokas.43:
athAbravInmaghavA pratyayaM svaM; samAbhAShya tamRRiShiM jAtaroSham |
brahmarShidevarShinRRiparShimadhye; yattannibodheha mamAdya rAjan
shlokas.44:
shakra uvAcha||
adhvaryave duhitaraM dadAtu; chChandoge vA charitabrahmacharye |
AtharvaNaM vedamadhItya vipraH; snAyIta yaH puShkaramAdadAti
shlokas.45:
sarvAnvedAnadhIyIta puNyashIlo.astu dhArmikaH |
brahmaNaH sadanaM yAtu yaste harati puShkaram
shlokas.46:
agastya uvAcha||
AshIrvAdastvayA proktaH shapatho balasUdana |
dIyatAM puShkaraM mahyameSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.47:
indra uvAcha||
na mayA bhagava.NllobhAddhRRitaM puShkaramadya vai |
dharmaM tu shrotukAmena hRRitaM na kroddhumarhasi
shlokas.48:
dharmaH shrutisamutkarSho dharmaseturanAmayaH |
ArSho vai shAshvato nityamavyayo.ayaM mayA shrutaH
shlokas.49:
tadidaM gRRihyatAM vidvanpuShkaraM munisattama |
atikramaM me bhagavankShantumarhasyanindita
shlokas.50:
ityuktaH sa mahendreNa tapasvI kopano bhRRisham |
jagrAha puShkaraM dhImAnprasannashchAbhavanmuniH
shlokas.51:
prayayuste tato bhUyastIrthAni vanagocharAH |
puNyatIrtheShu cha tathA gAtrANyAplAvayanti te
shlokas.52:
AkhyAnaM ya idaM yuktaH paThetparvaNi parvaNi |
na mUrkhaM janayetputraM na bhavechcha nirAkRRitiH
shlokas.53:
na tamApatspRRishetkAchinna jvaro na rujashcha ha |
virajAH shreyasA yuktaH pretya svargamavApnuyAt
shlokas.54:
yashcha shAstramanudhyAyedRRiShibhiH paripAlitam |
sa gachChedbrahmaNo lokamavyayaM cha narottama

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadidaM shrAddhadharmeShu dIyate bharatarShabha |
ChatraM chopAnahau chaiva kenaitatsampravartitam
kathaM chaitatsamutpannaM kimarthaM cha pradIyate
shlokas.2:
na kevalaM shrAddhadharme puNyakeShvapi dIyate |
etadvistarato rAja~nshrotumichChAmi tattvataH
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjannavahitashChatropAnahavistaram |
yathaitatprathitaM loke yena chaitatpravartitam
shlokas.4:
yathA chAkShayyatAM prAptaM puNyatAM cha yathA gatam |
sarvametadasheSheNa pravakShyAmi janAdhipa
shlokas.5:
itihAsaM purAvRRittamimaM shRRiNu narAdhipa |
jamadagneshcha sa.nvAdaM sUryasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.6:
purA sa bhagavAnsAkShAddhanuShAkrIData prabho |
sandhAya sandhAya sharA.nshchikShepa kila bhArgavaH
shlokas.7:
tAnkShiptAnreNukA sarvA.nstasyeShUndIptatejasaH |
AnAyya sA tadA tasmai prAdAdasakRRidachyuta
shlokas.8:
atha tena sa shabdena jyAtalasya sharasya cha |
prahRRiShTaH samprachikShepa sA cha pratyAjahAra tAn
shlokas.9:
tato madhyAhnamArUDhe jyeShThAmUle divAkare |
sa sAyakAndvijo viddhvA reNukAmidamabravIt
shlokas.10:
gachChAnaya vishAlAkShi sharAnetAndhanushchyutAn |
yAvadetAnpunaH subhru kShipAmIti janAdhipa
shlokas.11:
sA gachChatyantarA ChAyAM vRRikShamAshritya bhAminI |
tasthau tasyA hi santaptaM shiraH pAdau tathaiva cha
shlokas.12:
sthitA sA tu muhUrtaM vai bhartuH shApabhayAchChubhA |
yayAvAnayituM bhUyaH sAyakAnasitekShaNA
pratyAjagAma cha sharA.nstAnAdAya yashasvinI
shlokas.13:
sA prasvinnA suchArva~NgI padbhyAM duHkhaM niyachChatI |
upAjagAma bhartAraM bhayAdbhartuH pravepatI
shlokas.14:
sa tAmRRiShistataH kruddho vAkyamAha shubhAnanAm |
reNuke kiM chireNa tvamAgateti punaH punaH
shlokas.15:
reNukovAcha||
shirastAvatpradIptaM me pAdau chaiva tapodhana |
sUryatejoniruddhAhaM vRRikShachChAyAmupAshritA
shlokas.16:
etasmAtkAraNAdbrahma.nshchirametatkRRitaM mayA |
etajj~nAtvA mama vibho mA krudhastvaM tapodhana
shlokas.17:
jamadagniruvAcha||
adyainaM dIptakiraNaM reNuke tava duHkhadam |
sharairnipAtayiShyAmi sUryamastrAgnitejasA
shlokas.18:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa visphArya dhanurdivyaM gRRihItvA cha bahU~nsharAn |
atiShThatsUryamabhito yato yAti tatomukhaH
shlokas.19:
atha taM prahariShyantaM sUryo.abhyetya vacho.abravIt |
dvijarUpeNa kaunteya kiM te sUryo.aparAdhyate
shlokas.20:
Adatte rashmibhiH sUryo divi vidva.nstatastataH |
rasaM sa taM vai varShAsu pravarShati divAkaraH
shlokas.21:
tato.annaM jAyate vipra manuShyANAM sukhAvaham |
annaM prANA iti yathA vedeShu paripaThyate
shlokas.22:
athAbhreShu nigUDhashcha rashmibhiH parivAritaH |
sapta dvIpAnimAnbrahmanvarSheNAbhipravarShati
shlokas.23:
tatastadauShadhInAM cha vIrudhAM patrapuShpajam |
sarvaM varShAbhinirvRRittamannaM sambhavati prabho
shlokas.24:
jAtakarmANi sarvANi vratopanayanAni cha |
godAnAni vivAhAshcha tathA yaj~nasamRRiddhayaH
shlokas.25:
satrANi dAnAni tathA sa.nyogA vittasa~nchayAH |
annataH sampravartante yathA tvaM vettha bhArgava
shlokas.26:
ramaNIyAni yAvanti yAvadArambhakANi cha |
sarvamannAtprabhavati viditaM kIrtayAmi te
shlokas.27:
sarvaM hi vettha vipra tvaM yadetatkIrtitaM mayA |
prasAdaye tvA viprarShe kiM te sUryo nipAtyate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evaM tadA prayAchantaM bhAskaraM munisattamaH |
jamadagnirmahAtejAH kiM kAryaM pratyapadyata
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tathA prayAchamAnasya muniragnisamaprabhaH |
jamadagniH shamaM naiva jagAma kurunandana
shlokas.3:
tataH sUryo madhurayA vAchA tamidamabravIt |
kRRitA~njalirviprarUpI praNamyedaM vishAM pate
shlokas.4:
chalaM nimittaM viprarShe sadA sUryasya gachChataH |
kathaM chalaM vetsyasi tvaM sadA yAntaM divAkaram
shlokas.5:
jamadagniruvAcha||
sthiraM vApi chalaM vApi jAne tvAM j~nAnachakShuShA |
avashyaM vinayAdhAnaM kAryamadya mayA tava
shlokas.6:
aparAhNe nimeShArdhaM tiShThasi tvaM divAkara |
tatra vetsyAmi sUrya tvAM na me.atrAsti vichAraNA
shlokas.7:
sUrya uvAcha||
asa.nshayaM mAM viprarShe vetsyase dhanvinAM vara |
apakAriNaM tu mAM viddhi bhagava~nsharaNAgatam
shlokas.8:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH prahasya bhagavA~njamadagniruvAcha tam |
na bhIH sUrya tvayA kAryA praNipAtagato hyasi
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNeShvArjavaM yachcha sthairyaM cha dharaNItale |
saumyatAM chaiva somasya gAmbhIryaM varuNasya cha
shlokas.10:
dIptimagneH prabhAM meroH pratApaM tapanasya cha |
etAnyatikramedyo vai sa hanyAchCharaNAgatam
shlokas.11:
bhavetsa gurutalpI cha brahmahA cha tathA bhavet |
surApAnaM cha kuryAtsa yo hanyAchCharaNAgatam
shlokas.12:
etasya tvapanItasya samAdhiM tAta chintaya |
yathA sukhagamaH panthA bhavettvadrashmitApitaH
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etAvaduktvA sa tadA tUShNImAsIdbhRRigUdvahaH |
atha sUryo dadau tasmai ChatropAnahamAshu vai
shlokas.14:
sUrya uvAcha||
maharShe shirasastrANaM ChatraM madrashmivAraNam |
pratigRRihNIShva padbhyAM cha trANArthaM charmapAduke
shlokas.15:
adyaprabhRRiti chaivaitalloke samprachariShyati |
puNyadAneShu sarveShu paramakShayyameva cha
shlokas.16:
bhIShma uvAcha||
upAnachChatrametadvai sUryeNeha pravartitam |
puNyametadabhikhyAtaM triShu lokeShu bhArata
shlokas.17:
tasmAtprayachCha viprebhyashChatropAnahamuttamam |
dharmaste sumahAnbhAvI na me.atrAsti vichAraNA
shlokas.18:
ChatraM hi bharatashreShTha yaH pradadyAddvijAtaye |
shubhraM shatashalAkaM vai sa pretya sukhamedhate
shlokas.19:
sa shakraloke vasati pUjyamAno dvijAtibhiH |
apsarobhishcha satataM devaishcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.20:
dahyamAnAya viprAya yaH prayachChatyupAnahau |
snAtakAya mahAbAho sa.nshitAya dvijAtaye
shlokas.21:
so.api lokAnavApnoti daivatairabhipUjitAn |
goloke sa mudA yukto vasati pretya bhArata
shlokas.22:
etatte bharatashreShTha mayA kArtsnyena kIrtitam |
ChatropAnahadAnasya phalaM bharatasattama

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ArAmANAM taDAgAnAM yatphalaM kurunandana |
tadahaM shrotumichChAmi tvatto.adya bharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
supradarshA vanavatI chitradhAtuvibhUShitA |
upetA sarvabIjaishcha shreShThA bhUmirihochyate
shlokas.3:
tasyAH kShetravisheShaM cha taDAgAnAM niveshanam |
audakAni cha sarvANi pravakShyAmyanupUrvashaH
shlokas.4:
taDAgAnAM cha vakShyAmi kRRitAnAM chApi ye guNAH |
triShu lokeShu sarvatra pUjito yastaDAgavAn
shlokas.5:
atha vA mitrasadanaM maitraM mitravivardhanam |
kIrtisa~njananaM shreShThaM taDAgAnAM niveshanam
shlokas.6:
dharmasyArthasya kAmasya phalamAhurmanIShiNaH |
taDAgaM sukRRitaM deshe kShetrameva mahAshrayam
shlokas.7:
chaturvidhAnAM bhUtAnAM taDAgamupalakShayet |
taDAgAni cha sarvANi dishanti shriyamuttamAm
shlokas.8:
devA manuShyA gandharvAH pitaroragarAkShasAH |
sthAvarANi cha bhUtAni sa.nshrayanti jalAshayam
shlokas.9:
tasmAttA.nste pravakShyAmi taDAge ye guNAH smRRitAH |
yA cha tatra phalAvAptirRRiShibhiH samudAhRRitA
shlokas.10:
varShamAtre taDAge tu salilaM yasya tiShThati |
agnihotraphalaM tasya phalamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.11:
sharatkAle tu salilaM taDAge yasya tiShThati |
gosahasrasya sa pretya labhate phalamuttamam
shlokas.12:
hemantakAle salilaM taDAge yasya tiShThati |
sa vai bahusuvarNasya yaj~nasya labhate phalam
shlokas.13:
yasya vai shaishire kAle taDAge salilaM bhavet |
agniShTomasya yaj~nasya phalamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.14:
taDAgaM sukRRitaM yasya vasante tu mahAshrayam |
atirAtrasya yaj~nasya phalaM sa samupAshnute
shlokas.15:
nidAghakAle pAnIyaM taDAge yasya tiShThati |
vAjapeyasamaM tasya phalaM vai munayo viduH
shlokas.16:
sa kulaM tArayetsarvaM yasya khAte jalAshaye |
gAvaH pibanti pAnIyaM sAdhavashcha narAH sadA
shlokas.17:
taDAge yasya gAvastu pibanti tRRiShitA jalam |
mRRigapakShimanuShyAshcha so.ashvamedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.18:
yatpibanti jalaM tatra snAyante vishramanti cha |
taDAgadasya tatsarvaM pretyAnantyAya kalpate
shlokas.19:
durlabhaM salilaM tAta visheSheNa paratra vai |
pAnIyasya pradAnena prItirbhavati shAshvatI
shlokas.20:
tilAndadata pAnIyaM dIpAndadata jAgrata |
j~nAtibhiH saha modadhvametatpreteShu durlabham
shlokas.21:
sarvadAnairgurutaraM sarvadAnairvishiShyate |
pAnIyaM narashArdUla tasmAddAtavyameva hi
shlokas.22:
evametattaDAgeShu kIrtitaM phalamuttamam |
ata UrdhvaM pravakShyAmi vRRikShANAmapi ropaNe
shlokas.23:
sthAvarANAM cha bhUtAnAM jAtayaH ShaTprakIrtitAH |
vRRikShagulmalatAvallyastvaksArAstRRiNajAtayaH
shlokas.24:
etA jAtyastu vRRikShANAM teShAM rope guNAstvime |
kIrtishcha mAnuShe loke pretya chaiva phalaM shubham
shlokas.25:
labhate nAma loke cha pitRRibhishcha mahIyate |
devalokagatasyApi nAma tasya na nashyati
shlokas.26:
atItAnAgate chobhe pitRRiva.nshaM cha bhArata |
tArayedvRRikSharopI cha tasmAdvRRikShAnpraropayet
shlokas.27:
tasya putrA bhavantyete pAdapA nAtra sa.nshayaH |
paralokagataH svargaM lokA.nshchApnoti so.avyayAn
shlokas.28:
puShpaiH suragaNAnvRRikShAH phalaishchApi tathA pitR^In |
ChAyayA chAtithI.nstAta pUjayanti mahIruhAH
shlokas.29:
kiMnaroragarakShA.nsi devagandharvamAnavAH |
tathA RRiShigaNAshchaiva sa.nshrayanti mahIruhAn
shlokas.30:
puShpitAH phalavantashcha tarpayantIha mAnavAn |
vRRikShadaM putravadvRRikShAstArayanti paratra cha
shlokas.31:
tasmAttaDAge vRRikShA vai ropyAH shreyorthinA sadA |
putravatparipAlyAshcha putrAste dharmataH smRRitAH
shlokas.32:
taDAgakRRidvRRikSharopI iShTayaj~nashcha yo dvijaH |
ete svarge mahIyante ye chAnye satyavAdinaH
shlokas.33:
tasmAttaDAgaM kurvIta ArAmA.nshchaiva ropayet |
yajechcha vividhairyaj~naiH satyaM cha satataM vadet

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
gArhasthyaM dharmamakhilaM prabrUhi bharatarShabha |
RRiddhimApnoti kiM kRRitvA manuShya iha pArthiva
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShyAmi purAvRRittaM janAdhipa |
vAsudevasya sa.nvAdaM pRRithivyAshchaiva bhArata
shlokas.3:
sa.nstUya pRRithivIM devIM vAsudevaH pratApavAn |
paprachCha bharatashreShTha yadetatpRRichChase.adya mAm
shlokas.4:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
gArhasthyaM dharmamAshritya mayA vA madvidhena vA |
kimavashyaM dhare kAryaM kiM vA kRRitvA sukhI bhavet
shlokas.5:
pRRithivyuvAcha||
RRiShayaH pitaro devA manuShyAshchaiva mAdhava |
ijyAshchaivArchanIyAshcha yathA chaivaM nibodha me
shlokas.6:
sadA yaj~nena devA.nshcha Atithyena cha mAnavAn |
Chandatashcha yathAnityamarhAnyu~njIta nityashaH
tena hyRRiShigaNAH prItA bhavanti madhusUdana
shlokas.7:
nityamagniM paricharedabhuktvA balikarma cha |
kuryAttathaiva devA vai prIyante madhusUdana
shlokas.8:
kuryAdaharahaH shrAddhamannAdyenodakena vA |
payomUlaphalairvApi pitR^INAM prItimAharan
shlokas.9:
siddhAnnAdvaishvadevaM vai kuryAdagnau yathAvidhi |
agnIShomaM vaishvadevaM dhAnvantaryamanantaram
shlokas.10:
prajAnAM pataye chaiva pRRithagghomo vidhIyate |
tathaiva chAnupUrvyeNa balikarma prayojayet
shlokas.11:
dakShiNAyAM yamAyeha pratIchyAM varuNAya cha |
somAya chApyudIchyAM vai vAstumadhye dvijAtaye
shlokas.12:
dhanvantareH prAgudIchyAM prAchyAM shakrAya mAdhava |
manorvai iti cha prAhurbaliM dvAre gRRihasya vai
marudbhyo devatAbhyashcha balimantargRRihe haret
shlokas.13:
tathaiva vishvedevebhyo balimAkAshato haret |
nishAcharebhyo bhUtebhyo baliM naktaM tathA haret
shlokas.14:
evaM kRRitvA baliM samyagdadyAdbhikShAM dvijAtaye |
alAbhe brAhmaNasyAgnAvagramutkShipya nikShipet
shlokas.15:
yadA shrAddhaM pitRRibhyashcha dAtumichCheta mAnavaH |
tadA pashchAtprakurvIta nivRRitte shrAddhakarmaNi
shlokas.16:
pitR^InsantarpayitvA tu baliM kuryAdvidhAnataH |
vaishvadevaM tataH kuryAtpashchAdbrAhmaNavAchanam
shlokas.17:
tato.annenAvasheSheNa bhojayedatithInapi |
archApUrvaM mahArAja tataH prINAti mAnuShAn
shlokas.19:
anityaM hi sthito yasmAttasmAdatithiruchyate |
AchAryasya pitushchaiva sakhyurAptasya chAtitheH |
idamasti gRRihe mahyamiti nityaM nivedayet
shlokas.20:
te yadvadeyustatkuryAditi dharmo vidhIyate |
gRRihasthaH puruShaH kRRiShNa shiShTAshI cha sadA bhavet
shlokas.21:
rAjartvijaM snAtakaM cha guruM shvashurameva cha |
archayenmadhuparkeNa parisa.nvatsaroShitAn
shlokas.22:
shvabhyashcha shvapachebhyashcha vayobhyashchAvapedbhuvi |
vaishvadevaM hi nAmaitatsAyamprAtarvidhIyate
shlokas.23:
etA.nstu dharmAngArhasthAnyaH kuryAdanasUyakaH |
sa iharddhiM parAM prApya pretya nAke mahIyate
shlokas.24:
bhIShma uvAcha||
iti bhUmervachaH shrutvA vAsudevaH pratApavAn |
tathA chakAra satataM tvamapyevaM samAchara
shlokas.25:
evaM gRRihasthadharmaM tvaM chetayAno narAdhipa |
ihaloke yashaH prApya pretya svargamavApsyasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AlokadAnaM nAmaitatkIdRRishaM bharatarShabha |
kathametatsamutpannaM phalaM chAtra bravIhi me
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
