atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
manoH prajApatervAdaM suvarNasya cha bhArata
shlokas.3:
tapasvI kashchidabhavatsuvarNo nAma nAmataH |
varNato hemavarNaH sa suvarNa iti paprathe
shlokas.4:
kulashIlaguNopetaH svAdhyAye cha paraM gataH |
bahUnsvava.nshaprabhavAnsamatItaH svakairguNaiH
shlokas.5:
sa kadAchinmanuM vipro dadarshopasasarpa cha |
kushalaprashnamanyonyaM tau cha tatra prachakratuH
shlokas.6:
tatastau siddhasa~Nkalpau merau kA~nchanaparvate |
ramaNIye shilApRRiShThe sahitau saMnyaShIdatAm
shlokas.7:
tatra tau kathayAmAstAM kathA nAnAvidhAshrayAH |
brahmarShidevadaityAnAM purANAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.8:
suvarNastvabravIdvAkyaM manuM svAyambhuvaM prabhum |
hitArthaM sarvabhUtAnAM prashnaM me vaktumarhasi
shlokas.9:
sumanobhiryadijyante daivatAni prajeshvara |
kimetatkathamutpannaM phalayogaM cha sha.nsa me
shlokas.10:
manuruvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
shukrasya cha baleshchaiva sa.nvAdaM vai samAgame
shlokas.11:
balervairochanasyeha trailokyamanushAsataH |
samIpamAjagAmAshu shukro bhRRigukulodvahaH
shlokas.12:
tamarghyAdibhirabhyarchya bhArgavaM so.asurAdhipaH |
niShasAdAsane pashchAdvidhivadbhUridakShiNaH
shlokas.13:
katheyamabhavattatra yA tvayA parikIrtitA |
sumanodhUpadIpAnAM sampradAne phalaM prati
shlokas.14:
tataH paprachCha daityendraH kavIndraM prashnamuttamam |
sumanodhUpadIpAnAM kiM phalaM brahmavittama
pradAnasya dvijashreShTha tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.15:
shukra uvAcha||
tapaH pUrvaM samutpannaM dharmastasmAdanantaram |
etasminnantare chaiva vIrudoShadhya eva cha
shlokas.16:
somasyAtmA cha bahudhA sambhUtaH pRRithivItale |
amRRitaM cha viShaM chaiva yAshchAnyAstulyajAtayaH
shlokas.17:
amRRitaM manasaH prItiM sadyaH puShTiM dadAti cha |
mano glapayate tIvraM viShaM gandhena sarvashaH
shlokas.18:
amRRitaM ma~NgalaM viddhi mahadviShamama~Ngalam |
oShadhyo hyamRRitaM sarvaM viShaM tejo.agnisambhavam
shlokas.19:
mano hlAdayate yasmAchChriyaM chApi dadhAti ha |
tasmAtsumanasaH proktA naraiH sukRRitakarmabhiH
shlokas.20:
devatAbhyaH sumanaso yo dadAti naraH shuchiH |
tasmAtsumanasaH proktA yasmAttuShyanti devatAH
shlokas.21:
yaM yamuddishya dIyerandevaM sumanasaH prabho |
ma~NgalArthaM sa tenAsya prIto bhavati daityapa
shlokas.22:
j~neyAstUgrAshcha saumyAshcha tejasvinyashcha tAH pRRithak |
oShadhyo bahuvIryAshcha bahurUpAstathaiva cha
shlokas.23:
yaj~niyAnAM cha vRRikShANAmayaj~niyAnnibodha me |
AsurANi cha mAlyAni daivatebhyo hitAni cha
shlokas.24:
rAkShasAnAM surANAM cha yakShANAM cha tathA priyAH |
pitR^INAM mAnuShANAM cha kAntA yAstvanupUrvashaH
shlokas.25:
vanyA grAmyAshcheha tathA kRRiShToptAH parvatAshrayAH |
akaNTakAH kaNTakinyo gandharUparasAnvitAH
shlokas.26:
dvividho hi smRRito gandha iShTo.aniShTashcha puShpajaH |
iShTagandhAni devAnAM puShpANIti vibhAvayet
shlokas.27:
akaNTakAnAM vRRikShANAM shvetaprAyAshcha varNataH |
teShAM puShpANi devAnAmiShTAni satataM prabho
shlokas.28:
jalajAni cha mAlyAni padmAdIni cha yAni cha |
gandharvanAgayakShebhyastAni dadyAdvichakShaNaH
shlokas.29:
oShadhyo raktapuShpAshcha kaTukAH kaNTakAnvitAH |
shatrUNAmabhichArArthamatharvasu nidarshitAH
shlokas.30:
tIkShNavIryAstu bhUtAnAM durAlambhAH sakaNTakAH |
raktabhUyiShThavarNAshcha kRRiShNAshchaivopahArayet
shlokas.31:
manohRRidayanandinyo vimarde madhurAshcha yAH |
chArurUpAH sumanaso mAnuShANAM smRRitA vibho
shlokas.32:
na tu shmashAnasambhUtA na devAyatanodbhavAH |
saMnayetpuShTiyukteShu vivAheShu rahaHsu cha
shlokas.33:
girisAnuruhAH saumyA devAnAmupapAdayet |
prokShitAbhyukShitAH saumyA yathAyogaM yathAsmRRiti
shlokas.34:
gandhena devAstuShyanti darshanAdyakSharAkShasAH |
nAgAH samupabhogena tribhiretaistu mAnuShAH
shlokas.35:
sadyaH prINAti devAnvai te prItA bhAvayantyuta |
sa~NkalpasiddhA martyAnAmIpsitaishcha manorathaiH
shlokas.36:
devAH prINanti satataM mAnitA mAnayanti cha |
avaj~nAtAvadhUtAshcha nirdahantyadhamAnnarAn
shlokas.37:
ataUrdhvaM pravakShyAmi dhUpadAnavidhau phalam |
dhUpA.nshcha vividhAnsAdhUnasAdhU.nshcha nibodha me
shlokas.38:
niryAsaH saralashchaiva kRRitrimashchaiva te trayaH |
iShTAniShTo bhavedgandhastanme vistarataH shRRiNu
shlokas.39:
niryAsAH sallakIvarjyA devAnAM dayitAstu te |
gugguluH pravarasteShAM sarveShAmiti nishchayaH
shlokas.40:
aguruH sAriNAM shreShTho yakSharAkShasabhoginAm |
daityAnAM sallakIjashcha kA~NkShito yashcha tadvidhaH
shlokas.41:
atha sarjarasAdInAM gandhaiH pArthivadAravaiH |
phANitAsavasa.nyuktairmanuShyANAM vidhIyate
shlokas.42:
devadAnavabhUtAnAM sadyastuShTikaraH smRRitaH |
ye.anye vaihArikAste tu mAnuShANAmiti smRRitAH
shlokas.43:
ya evoktAH sumanasAM pradAne guNahetavaH |
dhUpeShvapi parij~neyAsta eva prItivardhanAH
shlokas.44:
dIpadAne pravakShyAmi phalayogamanuttamam |
yathA yena yadA chaiva pradeyA yAdRRishAshcha te
shlokas.45:
jyotistejaH prakAshashchApyUrdhvagaM chApi varNyate |
pradAnaM tejasAM tasmAttejo vardhayate nRRiNAm
shlokas.46:
andhaM tamastamisraM cha dakShiNAyanameva cha |
uttarAyaNametasmAjjyotirdAnaM prashasyate
shlokas.47:
yasmAdUrdhvagametattu tamasashchaiva bheShajam |
tasmAdUrdhvagaterdAtA bhavediti vinishchayaH
shlokas.48:
devAstejasvino yasmAtprabhAvantaH prakAshakAH |
tAmasA rAkShasAshcheti tasmAddIpaH pradIyate
shlokas.49:
AlokadAnAchchakShuShmAnprabhAyukto bhavennaraH |
tAndattvA nopahi.nseta na harennopanAshayet
shlokas.50:
dIpahartA bhavedandhastamogatirasuprabhaH |
dIpapradaH svargaloke dIpamAlI virAjate
shlokas.51:
haviShA prathamaH kalpo dvitIyastvauShadhIrasaiH |
vasAmedosthiniryAsairna kAryaH puShTimichChatA
shlokas.52:
giriprapAte gahane chaityasthAne chatuShpathe |
dIpadAtA bhavennityaM ya ichChedbhUtimAtmanaH
shlokas.53:
kuloddyoto vishuddhAtmA prakAshatvaM cha gachChati |
jyotiShAM chaiva sAlokyaM dIpadAtA naraH sadA
shlokas.54:
balikarmasu vakShyAmi guNAnkarmaphalodayAn |
devayakShoraganRRiNAM bhUtAnAmatha rakShasAm
shlokas.55:
yeShAM nAgrabhujo viprA devatAtithibAlakAH |
rAkShasAneva tAnviddhi nirvaShaTkArama~NgalAn
shlokas.56:
tasmAdagraM prayachCheta devebhyaH pratipUjitam |
shirasA praNatashchApi haredbalimatandritaH
shlokas.57:
gRRihyA hi devatA nityamAsha.nsanti gRRihAtsadA |
bAhyAshchAgantavo ye.anye yakSharAkShasapannagAH
shlokas.58:
ito dattena jIvanti devatAH pitarastathA |
te prItAH prINayantyetAnAyuShA yashasA dhanaiH
shlokas.59:
balayaH saha puShpaistu devAnAmupahArayet |
dadhidrapsayutAH puNyAH sugandhAH priyadarshanAH
shlokas.60:
kAryA rudhiramA.nsADhyA balayo yakSharakShasAm |
surAsavapuraskArA lAjollepanabhUShitAH
shlokas.61:
nAgAnAM dayitA nityaM padmotpalavimishritAH |
tilAnguDasusampannAnbhUtAnAmupahArayet
shlokas.62:
agradAtAgrabhogI syAdbalavarNasamanvitaH |
tasmAdagraM prayachCheta devebhyaH pratipUjitam
shlokas.63:
jvalatyaharaho veshma yAshchAsya gRRihadevatAH |
tAH pUjyA bhUtikAmena prasRRitAgrapradAyinA
shlokas.64:
ityetadasurendrAya kAvyaH provAcha bhArgavaH |
suvarNAya manuH prAha suvarNo nAradAya cha
shlokas.65:
nArado.api mayi prAha guNAnetAnmahAdyute |
tvamapyetadviditveha sarvamAchara putraka

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrutaM me bharatashreShTha puShpadhUpapradAyinAm |
phalaM balividhAne cha tadbhUyo vaktumarhasi
shlokas.2:
dhUpapradAnasya phalaM pradIpasya tathaiva cha |
balayashcha kimarthaM vai kShipyante gRRihamedhibhiH
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
nahuShaM prati sa.nvAdamagastyasya bhRRigostathA
shlokas.4:
nahuSho hi mahArAja rAjarShiH sumahAtapAH |
devarAjyamanuprAptaH sukRRiteneha karmaNA
shlokas.5:
tatrApi prayato rAjannahuShastridive vasan |
mAnuShIshchaiva divyAshcha kurvANo vividhAH kriyAH
shlokas.6:
mAnuShyastatra sarvAH sma kriyAstasya mahAtmanaH |
pravRRittAstridive rAjandivyAshchaiva sanAtanAH
shlokas.7:
agnikAryANi samidhaH kushAH sumanasastathA |
balayashchAnnalAjAbhirdhUpanaM dIpakarma cha
shlokas.8:
sarvaM tasya gRRihe rAj~naH prAvartata mahAtmanaH |
japayaj~nAnmanoyaj~nA.nstridive.api chakAra saH
shlokas.9:
daivatAnyarchaya.nshchApi vidhivatsa sureshvaraH |
sarvANyeva yathAnyAyaM yathApUrvamari.ndama
shlokas.10:
athendrasya bhaviShyatvAdaha~NkArastamAvishat |
sarvAshchaiva kriyAstasya paryahIyanta bhUpate
shlokas.11:
sa RRiShInvAhayAmAsa varadAnamadAnvitaH |
parihInakriyashchApi durbalatvamupeyivAn
shlokas.12:
tasya vAhayataH kAlo munimukhyA.nstapodhanAn |
aha~NkArAbhibhUtasya sumahAnatyavartata
shlokas.13:
atha paryAyasha RRiShInvAhanAyopachakrame |
paryAyashchApyagastyasya samapadyata bhArata
shlokas.14:
athAgamya mahAtejA bhRRigurbrahmavidAM varaH |
agastyamAshramasthaM vai samupetyedamabravIt
shlokas.15:
evaM vayamasatkAraM devendrasyAsya durmateH |
nahuShasya kimarthaM vai marShayAma mahAmune
shlokas.16:
agastya uvAcha||
kathameSha mayA shakyaH shaptuM yasya mahAmune |
varadena varo datto bhavato viditashcha saH
shlokas.17:
yo me dRRiShTipathaM gachChetsa me vashyo bhavediti |
ityanena varo devAdyAchito gachChatA divam
shlokas.18:
evaM na dagdhaH sa mayA bhavatA cha na sa.nshayaH |
anyenApyRRiShimukhyena na shapto na cha pAtitaH
shlokas.19:
amRRitaM chaiva pAnAya dattamasmai purA vibho |
mahAtmane tadarthaM cha nAsmAbhirvinipAtyate
shlokas.20:
prAyachChata varaM devaH prajAnAM duHkhakArakam |
dvijeShvadharmayuktAni sa karoti narAdhamaH
shlokas.21:
atra yatprAptakAlaM nastadbrUhi vadatAM vara |
bhavA.nshchApi yathA brUyAtkurvImahi tathA vayam
shlokas.22:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
pitAmahaniyogena bhavantamahamAgataH |
pratikartuM balavati nahuShe darpamAsthite
shlokas.23:
adya hi tvA sudurbuddhI rathe yokShyati devarAT |
adyainamahamudvRRittaM kariShye.anindramojasA
shlokas.24:
adyendraM sthApayiShyAmi pashyataste shatakratum |
sa~nchAlya pApakarmANamindrasthAnAtsudurmatim
shlokas.25:
adya chAsau kudevendrastvAM padA dharShayiShyati |
daivopahatachittatvAdAtmanAshAya mandadhIH
shlokas.26:
vyutkrAntadharmaM tamahaM dharShaNAmarShito bhRRisham |
ahirbhavasveti ruShA shapsye pApaM dvijadruham
shlokas.27:
tata enaM sudurbuddhiM dhikShabdAbhihatatviSham |
dharaNyAM pAtayiShyAmi prekShataste mahAmune
shlokas.28:
nahuShaM pApakarmANamaishvaryabalamohitam |
yathA cha rochate tubhyaM tathA kartAsmyahaM mune
shlokas.29:
evamuktastu bhRRiguNA maitrAvaruNiravyayaH |
agastyaH paramaprIto babhUva vigatajvaraH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM sa vai vipannashcha kathaM vai pAtito bhuvi |
kathaM chAnindratAM prAptastadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evaM tayoH sa.nvadatoH kriyAstasya mahAtmanaH |
sarvA evAbhyavartanta yA divyA yAshcha mAnuShAH
shlokas.3:
tathaiva dIpadAnAni sarvopakaraNAni cha |
balikarma cha yachchAnyadutsekAshcha pRRithagvidhAH
sarvAstasya samutpannA devarAj~no mahAtmanaH
shlokas.4:
devaloke nRRiloke cha sadAchArA budhaiH smRRitAH |
te chedbhavanti rAjendra RRidhyante gRRihamedhinaH
dhUpapradAnairdIpaishcha namaskAraistathaiva cha
shlokas.5:
yathA siddhasya chAnnasya dvijAyAgraM pradIyate |
balayashcha gRRihoddeshe ataH prIyanti devatAH
shlokas.6:
yathA cha gRRihiNastoSho bhavedvai balikarmaNA |
tathA shataguNA prItirdevatAnAM sma jAyate
shlokas.7:
evaM dhUpapradAnaM cha dIpadAnaM cha sAdhavaH |
prasha.nsanti namaskArairyuktamAtmaguNAvaham
shlokas.8:
snAnenAdbhishcha yatkarma kriyate vai vipashchitA |
namaskAraprayuktena tena prIyanti devatAH
gRRihyAshcha devatAH sarvAH prIyante vidhinArchitAH
shlokas.9:
ityetAM buddhimAsthAya nahuShaH sa nareshvaraH |
surendratvaM mahatprApya kRRitavAnetadadbhutam
shlokas.10:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya bhAgyakShaya upasthite |
sarvametadavaj~nAya na chakAraitadIdRRisham
shlokas.11:
tataH sa parihINo.abhUtsurendro balikarmataH |
dhUpadIpodakavidhiM na yathAvachchakAra ha
tato.asya yaj~naviShayo rakShobhiH paryabAdhyata
shlokas.12:
athAgastyamRRiShishreShThaM vAhanAyAjuhAva ha |
drutaM sarasvatIkUlAtsmayanniva mahAbalaH
shlokas.13:
tato bhRRigurmahAtejA maitrAvaruNimabravIt |
nimIlayasva nayane jaTA yAvadvishAmi te
shlokas.14:
sthANubhUtasya tasyAtha jaTAH prAvishadachyutaH |
bhRRiguH sa sumahAtejAH pAtanAya nRRipasya ha
shlokas.15:
tataH sa devarATprAptastamRRiShiM vAhanAya vai |
tato.agastyaH surapatiM vAkyamAha vishAM pate
shlokas.16:
yojayasvendra mAM kShipraM kaM cha deshaM vahAmi te |
yatra vakShyasi tatra tvAM nayiShyAmi surAdhipa
shlokas.17:
ityukto nahuShastena yojayAmAsa taM munim |
bhRRigustasya jaTAsa.nstho babhUva hRRiShito bhRRisham
shlokas.18:
na chApi darshanaM tasya chakAra sa bhRRigustadA |
varadAnaprabhAvaj~no nahuShasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.19:
na chukopa sa chAgastyo yukto.api nahuSheNa vai |
taM tu rAjA pratodena chodayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.20:
na chukopa sa dharmAtmA tataH pAdena devarAT |
agastyasya tadA kruddho vAmenAbhyahanachChiraH
shlokas.21:
tasmi~nshirasyabhihate sa jaTAntargato bhRRiguH |
shashApa balavatkruddho nahuShaM pApachetasam
shlokas.22:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
yasmAtpadAhanaH krodhAchChirasImaM mahAmunim |
tasmAdAshu mahIM gachCha sarpo bhUtvA sudurmate
shlokas.23:
ityuktaH sa tadA tena sarpo bhUtvA papAta ha |
adRRiShTenAtha bhRRiguNA bhUtale bharatarShabha
shlokas.24:
bhRRiguM hi yadi so.adrAkShInnahuShaH pRRithivIpate |
na sa shakto.abhaviShyadvai pAtane tasya tejasA
shlokas.25:
sa tu taistaiH pradAnaishcha tapobhirniyamaistathA |
patito.api mahArAja bhUtale smRRitimAnabhUt
prasAdayAmAsa bhRRiguM shApAnto me bhavediti
shlokas.26:
tato.agastyaH kRRipAviShTaH prAsAdayata taM bhRRigum |
shApAntArthaM mahArAja sa cha prAdAtkRRipAnvitaH
shlokas.27:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
rAjA yudhiShThiro nAma bhaviShyati kurUdvahaH |
sa tvAM mokShayitA shApAdityuktvAntaradhIyata
shlokas.28:
agastyo.api mahAtejAH kRRitvA kAryaM shatakratoH |
svamAshramapadaM prAyAtpUjyamAno dvijAtibhiH
shlokas.29:
nahuSho.api tvayA rAja.nstasmAchChApAtsamuddhRRitaH |
jagAma brahmasadanaM pashyataste janAdhipa
shlokas.30:
tadA tu pAtayitvA taM nahuShaM bhUtale bhRRiguH |
jagAma brahmasadanaM brahmaNe cha nyavedayat
shlokas.31:
tataH shakraM samAnAyya devAnAha pitAmahaH |
varadAnAnmama surA nahuSho rAjyamAptavAn
sa chAgastyena kruddhena bhra.nshito bhUtalaM gataH
shlokas.32:
na cha shakyaM vinA rAj~nA surA vartayituM kvachit |
tasmAdayaM punaH shakro devarAjye.abhiShichyatAm
shlokas.33:
evaM sambhAShamANaM tu devAH pArtha pitAmaham |
evamastviti saMhRRiShTAH pratyUchuste pitAmaham
shlokas.34:
so.abhiShikto bhagavatA devarAjyena vAsavaH |
brahmaNA rAjashArdUla yathApUrvaM vyarochata
shlokas.35:
evametatpurAvRRittaM nahuShasya vyatikramAt |
sa cha taireva sa.nsiddho nahuShaH karmabhiH punaH
shlokas.36:
tasmAddIpAH pradAtavyAH sAyaM vai gRRihamedhibhiH |
divyaM chakShuravApnoti pretya dIpapradAyakaH
pUrNachandrapratIkAshA dIpadAshcha bhavantyuta
shlokas.37:
yAvadakShinimeShANi jvalate tAvatIH samAH |
rUpavAndhanavA.nshchApi naro bhavati dIpadaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
brAhmaNasvAni ye mandA haranti bharatarShabha |
nRRisha.nsakAriNo mUDhAH kva te gachChanti mAnavAH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
chaNDAlasya cha sa.nvAdaM kShatrabandhoshcha bhArata
shlokas.3:
rAjanya uvAcha||
vRRiddharUpo.asi chaNDAla bAlavachcha vicheShTase |
shvakharANAM rajaHsevI kasmAdudvijase gavAm
shlokas.4:
sAdhubhirgarhitaM karma chaNDAlasya vidhIyate |
kasmAdgorajasA dhvastamapAM kuNDe niShi~nchasi
shlokas.5:
chaNDAla uvAcha||
brAhmaNasya gavAM rAjanhriyatInAM rajaH purA |
somamuddhva.nsayAmAsa taM somaM ye.apibandvijAH
shlokas.6:
dIkShitashcha sa rAjApi kShipraM narakamAvishat |
saha tairyAjakaiH sarvairbrahmasvamupajIvya tat
shlokas.7:
ye.api tatrApibankShIraM ghRRitaM dadhi cha mAnavAH |
brAhmaNAH saharAjanyAH sarve narakamAvishan
shlokas.8:
jaghnustAH payasA putrA.nstathA pautrAnvidhunvatIH |
pashUnavekShamANAshcha sAdhuvRRittena dampatI
shlokas.9:
ahaM tatrAvasaM rAjanbrahmachArI jitendriyaH |
tAsAM me rajasA dhvastaM bhaikShamAsInnarAdhipa
shlokas.10:
chaNDAlo.ahaM tato rAjanbhuktvA tadabhavaM mRRitaH |
brahmasvahArI cha nRRipaH so.apratiShThAM gatiM yayau
shlokas.11:
tasmAddharenna viprasvaM kadAchidapi ki~nchana |
brahmasvarajasA dhvastaM bhuktvA mAM pashya yAdRRisham
shlokas.12:
tasmAtsomo.apyavikreyaH puruSheNa vipashchitA |
vikrayaM hIha somasya garhayanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.13:
ye chainaM krINate rAjanye cha vikrINate janAH |
te tu vaivasvataM prApya rauravaM yAnti sarvashaH
shlokas.14:
somaM tu rajasA dhvastaM vikrIyAdbuddhipUrvakam |
shrotriyo vArdhuShI bhUtvA chirarAtrAya nashyati
narakaM tri.nshataM prApya shvaviShThAmupajIvati
shlokas.15:
shvacharyAmatimAnaM cha sakhidAreShu viplavam |
tulayAdhArayaddharmo hyatimAno.atirichyate
shlokas.16:
shvAnaM vai pApinaM pashya vivarNaM hariNaM kRRisham |
atimAnena bhUtAnAmimAM gatimupAgatam
shlokas.17:
ahaM vai vipule jAtaH kule dhanasamanvite |
anyasmi~njanmani vibho j~nAnavij~nAnapAragaH
shlokas.18:
abhavaM tatra jAnAno hyetAndoShAnmadAttadA |
sa.nrabdha eva bhUtAnAM pRRiShThamA.nsAnyabhakShayam
shlokas.19:
so.ahaM tena cha vRRittena bhojanena cha tena vai |
imAmavasthAM samprAptaH pashya kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.20:
AdIptamiva chailAntaM bhramarairiva chArditam |
dhAvamAnaM susa.nrabdhaM pashya mAM rajasAnvitam
shlokas.21:
svAdhyAyaistu mahatpApaM taranti gRRihamedhinaH |
dAnaiH pRRithagvidhaishchApi yathA prAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.22:
tathA pApakRRitaM vipramAshramasthaM mahIpate |
sarvasa~NgavinirmuktaM ChandA.nsyuttArayantyuta
shlokas.23:
ahaM tu pApayonyAM vai prasUtaH kShatriyarShabha |
nishchayaM nAdhigachChAmi kathaM muchyeyamityuta
shlokas.24:
jAtismaratvaM tu mama kenachitpUrvakarmaNA |
shubhena yena mokShaM vai prAptumichChAmyahaM nRRipa
shlokas.25:
tvamimaM me prapannAya sa.nshayaM brUhi pRRichChate |
chaNDAlatvAtkathamahaM muchyeyamiti sattama
shlokas.26:
rAjanya uvAcha||
chaNDAla pratijAnIhi yena mokShamavApsyasi |
brAhmaNArthe tyajanprANAngatimiShTAmavApsyasi
shlokas.27:
dattvA sharIraM kravyAdbhyo raNAgnau dvijahetukam |
hutvA prANAnpramokShaste nAnyathA mokShamarhasi
shlokas.28:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tadA rAjanbrahmasvArthe parantapa |
hutvA raNamukhe prANAngatimiShTAmavApa ha
shlokas.29:
tasmAdrakShyaM tvayA putra brahmasvaM bharatarShabha |
yadIchChasi mahAbAho shAshvatIM gatimuttamAm

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
eko lokaH sukRRitinAM sarve tvAho pitAmaha |
uta tatrApi nAnAtvaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
karmabhiH pArtha nAnAtvaM lokAnAM yAnti mAnavAH |
puNyAnpuNyakRRito yAnti pApAnpApakRRito janAH
shlokas.3:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
gautamasya munestAta sa.nvAdaM vAsavasya cha
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNo gautamaH kashchinmRRidurdAnto jitendriyaH |
mahAvane hastishishuM paridyUnamamAtRRikam
shlokas.5:
taM dRRiShTvA jIvayAmAsa sAnukrosho dhRRitavrataH |
sa tu dIrgheNa kAlena babhUvAtibalo mahAn
shlokas.6:
taM prabhinnaM mahAnAgaM prasrutaM sarvato madam |
dhRRitarAShTrasya rUpeNa shakro jagrAha hastinam
shlokas.7:
hriyamANaM tu taM dRRiShTvA gautamaH sa.nshitavrataH |
abhyabhAShata rAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTraM mahAtapAH
shlokas.8:
mA me hArShIrhastinaM putramenaM; duHkhAtpuShTaM dhRRitarAShTrAkRRitaj~na |
mitraM satAM saptapadaM vadanti; mitradroho naiva rAjanspRRishettvAm
shlokas.9:
idhmodakapradAtAraM shUnyapAlakamAshrame |
vinItamAchAryakule suyuktaM gurukarmaNi
shlokas.10:
shiShTaM dAntaM kRRitaj~naM cha priyaM cha satataM mama |
na me vikroshato rAjanhartumarhasi ku~njaram
shlokas.11:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
gavAM sahasraM bhavate dadAmi; dAsIshataM niShkashatAni pa~ncha |
anyachcha vittaM vividhaM maharShe; kiM brAhmaNasyeha gajena kRRityam
shlokas.12:
gautama uvAcha||
tvAmeva gAvo.abhi bhavantu rAja;ndAsyaH saniShkA vividhaM cha ratnam |
anyachcha vittaM vividhaM narendra; kiM brAhmaNasyeha dhanena kRRityam
shlokas.13:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
brAhmaNAnAM hastibhirnAsti kRRityaM; rAjanyAnAM nAgakulAni vipra |
svaM vAhanaM nayato nAstyadharmo; nAgashreShThAdgautamAsmAnnivarta
shlokas.14:
gautama uvAcha||
yatra preto nandati puNyakarmA; yatra pretaH shochati pApakarmA |
vaivasvatasya sadane mahAtmana;statra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.15:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ye niShkriyA nAstikAH shraddadhAnAH; pApAtmAna indriyArthe niviShTAH |
yamasya te yAtanAM prApnuvanti; paraM gantA dhRRitarAShTro na tatra
shlokas.16:
gautama uvAcha||
vaivasvatI sa.nyamanI janAnAM; yatrAnRRitaM nochyate yatra satyam |
yatrAbalA balinaM yAtayanti; tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.17:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
jyeShThAM svasAraM pitaraM mAtaraM cha; guruM yathA mAnayantashcharanti |
tathAvidhAnAmeSha loko maharShe; paraM gantA dhRRitarAShTro na tatra
shlokas.18:
gautama uvAcha||
mandAkinI vaishravaNasya rAj~no; mahAbhogA bhogijanapraveshyA |
gandharvayakShairapsarobhishcha juShTA; tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.19:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
atithivratAH suvratA ye janA vai; pratishrayaM dadati brAhmaNebhyaH |
shiShTAshinaH sa.nvibhajyAshritA.nshcha; mandAkinIM te.api vibhUShayanti
shlokas.20:
gautama uvAcha||
meroragre yadvanaM bhAti ramyaM; supuShpitaM kiMnaragItajuShTam |
sudarshanA yatra jambUrvishAlA; tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.21:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ye brAhmaNA mRRidavaH satyashIlA; bahushrutAH sarvabhUtAbhirAmAH |
ye.adhIyante setihAsaM purANaM; madhvAhutyA juhvati cha dvijebhyaH
shlokas.22:
tathAvidhAnAmeSha loko maharShe; paraM gantA dhRRitarAShTro na tatra |
yadvidyate viditaM sthAnamasti; tadbrUhi tvaM tvarito hyeSha yAmi
shlokas.23:
gautama uvAcha||
supuShpitaM kiMnararAjajuShTaM; priyaM vanaM nandanaM nAradasya |
gandharvANAmapsarasAM cha sadma; tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.24:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ye nRRittagItakushalA janAH sadA; hyayAchamAnAH sahitAshcharanti |
tathAvidhAnAmeSha loko maharShe; paraM gantA dhRRitarAShTro na tatra
shlokas.25:
gautama uvAcha||
yatrottarAH kuravo bhAnti ramyA; devaiH sArdhaM modamAnA narendra |
yatrAgniyaunAshcha vasanti viprA; hyayonayaH parvatayonayashcha
shlokas.26:
yatra shakro varShati sarvakAmA;nyatra striyaH kAmachArAshcharanti |
yatra cherShyA nAsti nArInarANAM; tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.27:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ye sarvabhUteShu nivRRittakAmA; amA.nsAdA nyastadaNDAshcharanti |
na hi.nsanti sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM cha; bhUtAnAM ye sarvabhUtAtmabhUtAH
shlokas.28:
nirAshiSho nirmamA vItarAgA; lAbhAlAbhe tulyanindAprasha.nsAH |
tathAvidhAnAmeSha loko maharShe; paraM gantA dhRRitarAShTro na tatra
shlokas.29:
gautama uvAcha||
tataH paraM bhAnti lokAH sanAtanAH; supuNyagandhA nirmalA vItashokAH |
somasya rAj~naH sadane mahAtmana;statra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.30:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ye dAnashIlA na pratigRRihNate sadA; na chApyarthAnAdadate parebhyaH |
yeShAmadeyamarhate nAsti kiM chi;tsarvAtithyAH suprasAdA janAshcha
shlokas.31:
ye kShantAro nAbhijalpanti chAnyA;~nshaktA bhUtvA satataM puNyashIlAH |
tathAvidhAnAmeSha loko maharShe; paraM gantA dhRRitarAShTro na tatra
shlokas.32:
gautama uvAcha||
tataH paraM bhAnti lokAH sanAtanA; virajaso vitamaskA vishokAH |
Adityasya sumahAntaH suvRRittA;statra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.33:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
svAdhyAyashIlA gurushushrUShaNe ratA;stapasvinaH suvratAH satyasandhAH |
AchAryANAmapratikUlabhAShiNo; nityotthitA gurukarmasvachodyAH
shlokas.34:
tathAvidhAnAmeSha loko maharShe; vishuddhAnAM bhAvitavA~NmatInAm |
satye sthitAnAM vedavidAM mahAtmanAM; paraM gantA dhRRitarAShTro na tatra
shlokas.35:
gautama uvAcha||
tataH pare bhAnti lokAH sanAtanAH; supuNyagandhA virajA vishokAH |
varuNasya rAj~naH sadane mahAtmana;statra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.36:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
chAturmAsyairye yajante janAH sadA; tatheShTInAM dashashataM prApnuvanti |
ye chAgnihotraM juhvati shraddadhAnA; yathAnyAyaM trINi varShANi viprAH
shlokas.37:
svadAriNAM dharmadhure mahAtmanAM; yathochite vartmani susthitAnAm |
dharmAtmanAmudvahatAM gatiM tAM; paraM gantA dhRRitarAShTro na tatra
shlokas.38:
gautama uvAcha||
indrasya lokA virajA vishokA; duranvayAH kA~NkShitA mAnavAnAm |
tasyAhaM te bhavane bhUritejaso; rAjannimaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.39:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
shatavarShajIvI yashcha shUro manuShyo; vedAdhyAyI yashcha yajvApramattaH |
ete sarve shakralokaM vrajanti; paraM gantA dhRRitarAShTro na tatra
shlokas.40:
gautama uvAcha||
prAjApatyAH santi lokA mahAnto; nAkasya pRRiShThe puShkalA vItashokAH |
manIShitAH sarvalokodbhavAnAM; tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.41:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ye rAjAno rAjasUyAbhiShiktA; dharmAtmAno rakShitAraH prajAnAm |
ye chAshvamedhAvabhRRithAplutA~NgA;steShAM lokA dhRRitarAShTro na tatra
shlokas.42:
gautama uvAcha||
tataH paraM bhAnti lokAH sanAtanAH; supuNyagandhA virajA vItashokAH |
tasminnahaM durlabhe tvApradhRRiShye; gavAM loke hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.43:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yo gosahasrI shatadaH samAM samAM; yo goshatI dasha dadyAchcha shaktyA |
tathA dashabhyo yashcha dadyAdihaikAM; pa~nchabhyo vA dAnashIlastathaikAm
shlokas.44:
ye jIryante brahmacharyeNa viprA; brAhmIM vAchaM parirakShanti chaiva |
manasvinastIrthayAtrAparAyaNA;ste tatra modanti gavAM vimAne
shlokas.45:
prabhAsaM mAnasaM puNyaM puShkarANi mahatsaraH |
puNyaM cha naimiShaM tIrthaM bAhudAM karatoyinIm
shlokas.46:
gayAM gayashirashchaiva vipAshAM sthUlavAlukAm |
tUShNI~Nga~NgAM dashaga~NgAM mahAhradamathApi cha
shlokas.47:
gautamIM kaushikIM pAkAM mahAtmAno dhRRitavratAH |
sarasvatIdRRiShadvatyau yamunAM ye prayAnti cha
shlokas.48:
tatra te divyasa.nsthAnA divyamAlyadharAH shivAH |
prayAnti puNyagandhADhyA dhRRitarAShTro na tatra vai
shlokas.49:
gautama uvAcha||
yatra shItabhayaM nAsti na choShNabhayamaNvapi |
na kShutpipAse na glAnirna duHkhaM na sukhaM tathA
shlokas.50:
na dveShyo na priyaH kashchinna bandhurna ripustathA |
na jarAmaraNe vApi na puNyaM na cha pAtakam
shlokas.51:
tasminvirajasi sphIte praj~nAsattvavyavasthite |
svayambhubhavane puNye hastinaM me yatiShyati
shlokas.52:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
nirmuktAH sarvasa~Ngebhyo kRRitAtmAno yatavratAH |
adhyAtmayogasa.nsthAne yuktAH svargagatiM gatAH
shlokas.53:
te brahmabhavanaM puNyaM prApnuvantIha sAttvikAH |
na tatra dhRRitarAShTraste shakyo draShTuM mahAmune
shlokas.54:
gautama uvAcha||
rathantaraM yatra bRRihachcha gIyate; yatra vedI puNDarIkaiH stRRiNoti |
yatropayAti haribhiH somapIthI; tatra tvAhaM hastinaM yAtayiShye
shlokas.55:
budhyAmi tvAM vRRitrahaNaM shatakratuM; vyatikramantaM bhuvanAni vishvA |
kachchinna vAchA vRRijinaM kadA chi;dakArShaM te manaso.abhiSha~NgAt
shlokas.56:
shakra uvAcha||
yasmAdimaM lokapathaM prajAnA;manvAgamaM padavAde gajasya |
tasmAdbhavAnpraNataM mAnushAstu; bravIShi yattatkaravANi sarvam
shlokas.57:
gautama uvAcha||
shvetaM kareNuM mama putranAgaM; yaM me.ahArShIrdashavarShANi bAlam |
yo me vane vasato.abhUddvitIya;stameva me dehi surendra nAgam
shlokas.58:
shakra uvAcha||
ayaM sutaste dvijamukhya nAga;shchAghrAyate tvAmabhivIkShamANaH |
pAdau cha te nAsikayopajighrate; shreyo mama dhyAhi namashcha te.astu
shlokas.59:
gautama uvAcha||
shivaM sadaiveha surendra tubhyaM; dhyAyAmi pUjAM cha sadA prayu~nje |
mamApi tvaM shakra shivaM dadasva; tvayA dattaM pratigRRihNAmi nAgam
shlokas.60:
shakra uvAcha||
yeShAM vedA nihitA vai guhAyAM; manIShiNAM sattvavatAM mahAtmanAm |
teShAM tvayaikena mahAtmanAsmi; buddhastasmAtprItimA.nste.ahamadya
shlokas.61:
hantaihi brAhmaNa kShipraM saha putreNa hastinA |
prApnuhi tvaM shubhA.NllokAnahnAya cha chirAya cha
shlokas.62:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa gautamaM puraskRRitya saha putreNa hastinA |
divamAchakrame vajrI sadbhiH saha durAsadam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dAnaM bahuvidhAkAraM shAntiH satyamahi.nsatA |
svadAratuShTishchoktA te phalaM dAnasya chaiva yat
shlokas.2:
pitAmahasya viditaM kimanyatra tapobalAt |
tapaso yatparaM te.adya tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tapaH prachakShate yAvattAvallokA yudhiShThira |
mataM mama tu kaunteya tapo nAnashanAtparam
shlokas.4:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
bhagIrathasya sa.nvAdaM brahmaNashcha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.5:
atItya suralokaM cha gavAM lokaM cha bhArata |
RRiShilokaM cha so.agachChadbhagIratha iti shrutiH
shlokas.6:
taM dRRiShTvA sa vachaH prAha brahmA rAjanbhagIratham |
kathaM bhagIrathAgAstvamimaM deshaM durAsadam
shlokas.7:
na hi devA na gandharvA na manuShyA bhagIratha |
AyAntyataptatapasaH kathaM vai tvamihAgataH
shlokas.8:
bhagIratha uvAcha||
niHsha~NkamannamadadaM brAhmaNebhyaH; shataM sahasrANi sadaiva dAnam |
brAhmaM vrataM nityamAsthAya viddhi; na tvevAhaM tasya phalAdihAgAm
shlokas.9:
dashaikarAtrAndasha pa~ncharAtrA;nekAdashaikAdashakAnkratU.nshcha |
jyotiShTomAnAM cha shataM yadiShTaM; phalena tenApi cha nAgato.aham
shlokas.10:
yachchAvasaM jAhnavItIranityaH; shataM samAstapyamAnastapo.aham |
adAM cha tatrAshvatarIsahasraM; nArIpuraM na cha tenAhamAgAm
shlokas.11:
dashAyutAni chAshvAnAmayutAni cha vi.nshatim |
puShkareShu dvijAtibhyaH prAdAM gAshcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.12:
suvarNachandroDupadhAriNInAM; kanyottamAnAmadadaM sragviNInAm |
ShaShTiM sahasrANi vibhUShitAnAM; jAmbUnadairAbharaNairna tena
shlokas.13:
dashArbudAnyadadaM gosavejyA;svekaikasho dasha gA lokanAtha |
samAnavatsAH payasA samanvitAH; suvarNakA.nsyopaduhA na tena
shlokas.14:
aptoryAmeShu niyatamekaikasmindashAdadam |
gRRiShTInAM kShIradAtrINAM rohiNInAM na tena cha
shlokas.15:
dogdhrINAM vai gavAM chaiva prayutAni dashaiva ha |
prAdAM dashaguNaM brahmanna cha tenAhamAgataH
shlokas.16:
vAjinAM bAhlijAtAnAmayutAnyadadaM dasha |
karkANAM hemamAlAnAM na cha tenAhamAgataH
shlokas.17:
koTIshcha kA~nchanasyAShTau prAdAM brahmandasha tvaham |
ekaikasminkratau tena phalenAhaM na chAgataH
shlokas.18:
vAjinAM shyAmakarNAnAM haritAnAM pitAmaha |
prAdAM hemasrajAM brahmankoTIrdasha cha sapta cha
shlokas.19:
IShAdantAnmahAkAyAnkA~nchanasragvibhUShitAn |
patnImataH sahasrANi prAyachChaM dasha sapta cha
shlokas.20:
ala~NkRRitAnAM devesha divyaiH kanakabhUShaNaiH |
rathAnAM kA~nchanA~NgAnAM sahasrANyadadaM dasha
sapta chAnyAni yuktAni vAjibhiH samala~NkRRitaiH
shlokas.21:
dakShiNAvayavAH kechidvedairye samprakIrtitAH |
vAjapeyeShu dashasu prAdAM tenApi nApyaham
shlokas.22:
shakratulyaprabhAvAnAmijyayA vikrameNa cha |
sahasraM niShkakaNThAnAmadadaM dakShiNAmaham
shlokas.23:
vijitya nRRipatInsarvAnmakhairiShTvA pitAmaha |
aShTabhyo rAjasUyebhyo na cha tenAhamAgataH
shlokas.24:
srotashcha yAvadga~NgAyAshChannamAsIjjagatpate |
dakShiNAbhiH pravRRittAbhirmama nAgAM cha tatkRRite
shlokas.25:
vAjinAM cha sahasre dve suvarNashatabhUShite |
varaM grAmashataM chAhamekaikasya tridhAdadam
tapasvI niyatAhAraH shamamAsthAya vAgyataH
shlokas.26:
dIrghakAlaM himavati ga~NgAyAshcha durutsahAm |
mUrdhnA dhArAM mahAdevaH shirasA yAmadhArayat
na tenApyahamAgachChaM phaleneha pitAmaha
shlokas.27:
shamyAkShepairayajaM yachcha devA;nsadyaskAnAmayutaishchApi yattat |
trayodashadvAdashAhA.nshcha deva; sapauNDarIkAnna cha teShAM phalena
shlokas.28:
aShTau sahasrANi kakudminAmahaM; shuklarShabhANAmadadaM brAhmaNebhyaH |
ekaikaM vai kA~nchanaM shRRi~NgamebhyaH; patnIshchaiShAmadadaM niShkakaNThIH
shlokas.29:
hiraNyaratnanichitAnadadaM ratnaparvatAn |
dhanadhAnyasamRRiddhA.nshcha grAmA~nshatasahasrashaH
shlokas.30:
shataM shatAnAM gRRiShTInAmadadaM chApyatandritaH |
iShTvAnekairmahAyaj~nairbrAhmaNebhyo na tena cha
shlokas.31:
ekAdashAhairayajaM sadakShiNai;rdvirdvAdashAhairashvamedhaishcha deva |
ArkAyaNaiH ShoDashabhishcha brahmaM;steShAM phaleneha na chAgato.asmi
shlokas.32:
niShkaikakaNThamadadaM yojanAyataM; tadvistIrNaM kA~nchanapAdapAnAm |
vanaM chUtAnAM ratnavibhUShitAnAM; na chaiva teShAmAgato.ahaM phalena
shlokas.33:
turAyaNaM hi vratamapradhRRiShya;makrodhano.akaravaM tri.nshato.abdAn |
shataM gavAmaShTa shatAni chaiva; dine dine hyadadaM brAhmaNebhyaH
shlokas.34:
payasvinInAmatha rohiNInAM; tathaiva chApyanaDuhAM lokanAtha |
prAdAM nityaM brAhmaNebhyaH suresha; nehAgatastena phalena chAham
shlokas.35:
tri.nshadagnimahaM brahmannayajaM yachcha nityadA |
aShTAbhiH sarvamedhaishcha naramedhaishcha saptabhiH
shlokas.36:
dashabhirvishvajidbhishcha shatairaShTAdashottaraiH |
na chaiva teShAM devesha phalenAhamihAgataH
shlokas.37:
sarayvAM bAhudAyAM cha ga~NgAyAmatha naimiShe |
gavAM shatAnAmayutamadadaM na cha tena vai
shlokas.38:
indreNa guhyaM nihitaM vai guhAyAM; yadbhArgavastapasehAbhyavindat |
jAjvalyamAnamushanastejaseha; tatsAdhayAmAsa mahaM vareNyam
shlokas.39:
tato me brAhmaNAstuShTAstasminkarmaNi sAdhite |
sahasramRRiShayashchAsanye vai tatra samAgatAH
uktastairasmi gachCha tvaM brahmalokamiti prabho
shlokas.40:
prItenoktaH sahasreNa brAhmaNAnAmahaM prabho |
imaM lokamanuprApto mA bhUtte.atra vichAraNA
shlokas.41:
kAmaM yathAvadvihitaM vidhAtrA; pRRiShTena vAchyaM tu mayA yathAvat |
tapo hi nAnyachchAnashanAnmataM me; namo.astu te devavara prasIda
shlokas.42:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktavantaM taM brahmA rAjAnaM sma bhagIratham |
pUjayAmAsa pUjArhaM vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shatAyuruktaH puruShaH shatavIryashcha vaidike |
kasmAnmriyante puruShA bAlA api pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
AyuShmAnkena bhavati svalpAyurvApi mAnavaH |
kena vA labhate kIrtiM kena vA labhate shriyam
shlokas.3:
tapasA brahmacharyeNa japairhomaistathauShadhaiH |
janmanA yadi vAchArAttanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShyAmi yanmAM tvamanupRRichChasi |
alpAyuryena bhavati dIrghAyurvApi mAnavaH
shlokas.5:
yena vA labhate kIrtiM yena vA labhate shriyam |
yathA cha vartanpuruShaH shreyasA samprayujyate
shlokas.6:
AchArAllabhate hyAyurAchArAllabhate shriyam |
AchArAtkIrtimApnoti puruShaH pretya cheha cha
shlokas.7:
durAchAro hi puruSho nehAyurvindate mahat |
trasanti yasmAdbhUtAni tathA paribhavanti cha
shlokas.8:
tasmAtkuryAdihAchAraM ya ichChedbhUtimAtmanaH |
api pApasharIrasya AchAro hantyalakShaNam
shlokas.9:
AchAralakShaNo dharmaH santashchAchAralakShaNAH |
sAdhUnAM cha yathA vRRittametadAchAralakShaNam
shlokas.10:
apyadRRiShTaM shrutaM vApi puruShaM dharmachAriNam |
bhUtikarmANi kurvANaM taM janAH kurvate priyam
shlokas.11:
ye nAstikA niShkriyAshcha gurushAstrAtila~NghinaH |
adharmaj~nA durAchArAste bhavanti gatAyuShaH
shlokas.12:
vishIlA bhinnamaryAdA nityaM sa~NkIrNamaithunAH |
alpAyuSho bhavantIha narA nirayagAminaH
shlokas.13:
sarvalakShaNahIno.api samudAchAravAnnaraH |
shraddadhAno.anasUyashcha shataM varShANi jIvati
shlokas.14:
akrodhanaH satyavAdI bhUtAnAmavihi.nsakaH |
anasUyurajihmashcha shataM varShANi jIvati
shlokas.15:
loShTamardI tRRiNachChedI nakhakhAdI cha yo naraH |
nityochChiShTaH sa~Nkusuko nehAyurvindate mahat
shlokas.16:
brAhme muhUrte budhyeta dharmArthau chAnuchintayet |
utthAyAchamya tiShTheta pUrvAM sandhyAM kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.17:
evamevAparAM sandhyAM samupAsIta vAgyataH |
nekShetAdityamudyantaM nAstaM yAntaM kadAchana
shlokas.18:
RRiShayo dIrghasandhyatvAddIrghamAyuravApnuvan |
tasmAttiShThetsadA pUrvAM pashchimAM chaiva vAgyataH
shlokas.19:
ye cha pUrvAmupAsante dvijAH sandhyAM na pashchimAm |
sarvA.nstAndhArmiko rAjA shUdrakarmANi kArayet
shlokas.20:
paradArA na gantavyAH sarvavarNeShu karhichit |
na hIdRRishamanAyuShyaM loke ki~nchana vidyate
yAdRRishaM puruShasyeha paradAropasevanam
shlokas.21:
prasAdhanaM cha keshAnAma~njanaM dantadhAvanam |
pUrvAhNa eva kurvIta devatAnAM cha pUjanam
shlokas.22:
purIShamUtre nodIkShennAdhitiShThetkadAchana |
udakyayA cha sambhAShAM na kurvIta kadAchana
shlokas.23:
notsRRijeta purIShaM cha kShetre grAmasya chAntike |
ubhe mUtrapurIShe tu nApsu kuryAtkadAchana
shlokas.24:
prA~Nmukho nityamashnIyAdvAgyato.annamakutsayan |
praskandayechcha manasA bhuktvA chAgnimupaspRRishet
shlokas.25:
AyuShyaM prA~Nmukho bhu~Nkte yashasyaM dakShiNAmukhaH |
dhanyaM pashchAnmukho bhu~Nkte RRitaM bhu~Nkte uda~NmukhaH
shlokas.26:
nAdhitiShThettuShA~njAtu keshabhasmakapAlikAH |
anyasya chApyupasthAnaM dUrataH parivarjayet
shlokas.27:
shAntihomA.nshcha kurvIta sAvitrANi cha kArayet |
niShaNNashchApi khAdeta na tu gachChankatha~nchana
shlokas.29:
mUtraM na tiShThatA kAryaM na bhasmani na govraje |
ArdrapAdastu bhu~njIta nArdrapAdastu sa.nvishet |
ArdrapAdastu bhu~njAno varShANAM jIvate shatam
shlokas.30:
trINi tejA.nsi nochChiShTa Alabheta kadAchana |
agniM gAM brAhmaNaM chaiva tathAsyAyurna riShyate
shlokas.31:
trINi tejA.nsi nochChiShTa udIkSheta kadAchana |
sUryAchandramasau chaiva nakShatrANi cha sarvashaH
shlokas.32:
UrdhvaM prANA hyutkrAmanti yUnaH sthavira Ayati |
pratyutthAnAbhivAdAbhyAM punastAnpratipadyate
shlokas.33:
abhivAdayeta vRRiddhA.nshcha AsanaM chaiva dApayet |
kRRitA~njalirupAsIta gachChantaM pRRiShThato.anviyAt
shlokas.34:
na chAsItAsane bhinne bhinnaM kA.nsyaM cha varjayet |
naikavastreNa bhoktavyaM na nagnaH snAtumarhati
svaptavyaM naiva nagnena na chochChiShTo.api sa.nvishet
shlokas.35:
uchChiShTo na spRRishechChIrShaM sarve prANAstadAshrayAH |
keshagrahAnprahArA.nshcha shirasyetAnvivarjayet
shlokas.36:
na pANibhyAmubhAbhyAM cha kaNDUyejjAtu vai shiraH |
na chAbhIkShNaM shiraH snAyAttathAsyAyurna riShyate
shlokas.37:
shiraHsnAtashcha tailena nA~NgaM ki~nchidupaspRRishet |
tilapiShTaM na chAshnIyAttathAyurvindate mahat
shlokas.38:
nAdhyApayettathochChiShTo nAdhIyIta kadAchana |
vAte cha pUtigandhe cha manasApi na chintayet
shlokas.39:
atra gAthA yamodgItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH |
Ayurasya nikRRintAmi prajAmasyAdade tathA
shlokas.40:
ya uchChiShTaH pravadati svAdhyAyaM chAdhigachChati |
yashchAnadhyAyakAle.api mohAdabhyasyati dvijaH
tasmAdyukto.apyanadhyAye nAdhIyIta kadAchana
shlokas.41:
pratyAdityaM pratyanilaM prati gAM cha prati dvijAn |
ye mehanti cha panthAnaM te bhavanti gatAyuShaH
shlokas.42:
ubhe mUtrapurIShe tu divA kuryAduda~NmukhaH |
dakShiNAbhimukho rAtrau tathAsyAyurna riShyate
shlokas.43:
trInkRRishAnnAvajAnIyAddIrghamAyurjijIviShuH |
brAhmaNaM kShatriyaM sarpaM sarve hyAshIviShAstrayaH
shlokas.44:
dahatyAshIviShaH kruddho yAvatpashyati chakShuShA |
kShatriyo.api dahetkruddho yAvatspRRishati tejasA
shlokas.45:
brAhmaNastu kulaM hanyAddhyAnenAvekShitena cha |
tasmAdetattrayaM yatnAdupaseveta paNDitaH
shlokas.46:
guruNA vairanirbandho na kartavyaH kadAchana |
anumAnyaH prasAdyashcha guruH kruddho yudhiShThira
shlokas.47:
samya~NmithyApravRRitte.api vartitavyaM gurAviha |
gurunindA dahatyAyurmanuShyANAM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.48:
dUrAdAvasathAnmUtraM dUrAtpAdAvasechanam |
uchChiShTotsarjanaM chaiva dUre kAryaM hitaiShiNA
shlokas.49:
nAtikalpaM nAtisAyaM na cha madhya.ndine sthite |
nAj~nAtaiH saha gachCheta naiko na vRRiShalaiH saha
shlokas.50:
panthA deyo brAhmaNAya gobhyo rAjabhya eva cha |
vRRiddhAya bhArataptAya garbhiNyai durbalAya cha
shlokas.51:
pradakShiNaM cha kurvIta parij~nAtAnvanaspatIn |
chatuShpathAnprakurvIta sarvAneva pradakShiNAn
shlokas.52:
madhya.ndine nishAkAle madhyarAtre cha sarvadA |
chatuShpathAnna seveta ubhe sandhye tathaiva cha
shlokas.53:
upAnahau cha vastraM cha dhRRitamanyairna dhArayet |
brahmachArI cha nityaM syAtpAdaM pAdena nAkramet
shlokas.54:
amAvAsyAM paurNamAsyAM chaturdashyAM cha sarvashaH |
aShTamyAM sarvapakShANAM brahmachArI sadA bhavet
shlokas.55:
vRRithA mA.nsaM na khAdeta pRRiShThamA.nsaM tathaiva cha |
AkroshaM parivAdaM cha paishunyaM cha vivarjayet
shlokas.56:
nAruntudaH syAnna nRRisha.nsavAdI; na hInataH paramabhyAdadIta |
yayAsya vAchA para udvijeta; na tAM vadedrushatIM pApalokyAm
shlokas.57:
vAksAyakA vadanAnniShpatanti; yairAhataH shochati rAtryahAni |
parasya nAmarmasu te patanti; tAnpaNDito nAvasRRijetpareShu
shlokas.58:
rohate sAyakairviddhaM vanaM parashunA hatam |
vAchA duruktaM bIbhatsaM na sa.nrohati vAkkShatam
shlokas.59:
hInA~NgAnatiriktA~NgAnvidyAhInAnvayodhikAn |
rUpadraviNahInA.nshcha sattvahInA.nshcha nAkShipet
shlokas.60:
nAstikyaM vedanindAM cha devatAnAM cha kutsanam |
dveShastambhAbhimAnA.nshcha taikShNyaM cha parivarjayet
shlokas.61:
parasya daNDaM nodyachChetkroddho nainaM nipAtayet |
anyatra putrAchChiShyAdvA shikShArthaM tADanaM smRRitam
shlokas.62:
na brAhmaNAnparivadennakShatrANi na nirdishet |
tithiM pakShasya na brUyAttathAsyAyurna riShyate
shlokas.63:
kRRitvA mUtrapurIShe tu rathyAmAkramya vA punaH |
pAdaprakShAlanaM kuryAtsvAdhyAye bhojane tathA
shlokas.64:
trINi devAH pavitrANi brAhmaNAnAmakalpayan |
adRRiShTamadbhirnirNiktaM yachcha vAchA prashasyate
shlokas.65:
sa.nyAvaM kRRisaraM mA.nsaM shaShkulI pAyasaM tathA |
AtmArthaM na prakartavyaM devArthaM tu prakalpayet
shlokas.66:
nityamagniM paricharedbhikShAM dadyAchcha nityadA |
vAgyato dantakAShThaM cha nityameva samAcharet
na chAbhyuditashAyI syAtprAyashchittI tathA bhavet
shlokas.67:
mAtApitaramutthAya pUrvamevAbhivAdayet |
AchAryamatha vApyenaM tathAyurvindate mahat
shlokas.68:
varjayeddantakAShThAni varjanIyAni nityashaH |
bhakShayechChAstradRRiShTAni parvasvapi cha varjayet
shlokas.70:
uda~Nmukhashcha satataM shauchaM kuryAtsamAhitaH |
akRRitvA devatApUjAM nAnyaM gachChetkadAchana |
anyatra tu guruM vRRiddhaM dhArmikaM vA vichakShaNam
shlokas.71:
avalokyo na chAdarsho malino buddhimattaraiH |
na chAj~nAtAM striyaM gachChedgarbhiNIM vA kadAchana
shlokas.72:
udakShirA na svapeta tathA pratyakShirA na cha |
prAkShirAstu svapedvidvAnatha vA dakShiNAshirAH
shlokas.73:
na bhagne nAvadIrNe vA shayane prasvapeta cha |
nAntardhAne na sa.nyukte na cha tiryakkadAchana
shlokas.74:
na nagnaH karhichitsnAyAnna nishAyAM kadAchana |
snAtvA cha nAvamRRijyeta gAtrANi suvichakShaNaH
shlokas.75:
na chAnulimpedasnAtvA snAtvA vAso na nirdhunet |
Ardra eva tu vAsA.nsi nityaM seveta mAnavaH
srajashcha nAvakarSheta na bahirdhArayeta cha
shlokas.76:
raktamAlyaM na dhAryaM syAchChuklaM dhAryaM tu paNDitaiH |
varjayitvA tu kamalaM tathA kuvalayaM vibho
shlokas.77:
raktaM shirasi dhAryaM tu tathA vAneyamityapi |
kA~nchanI chaiva yA mAlA na sA duShyati karhichit
snAtasya varNakaM nityamArdraM dadyAdvishAM pate
shlokas.78:
viparyayaM na kurvIta vAsaso buddhimAnnaraH |
tathA nAnyadhRRitaM dhAryaM na chApadashameva cha
shlokas.79:
anyadeva bhavedvAsaH shayanIye narottama |
anyadrathyAsu devAnAmarchAyAmanyadeva hi
shlokas.80:
priya~NguchandanAbhyAM cha bilvena tagareNa cha |
pRRithagevAnulimpeta kesareNa cha buddhimAn
shlokas.81:
upavAsaM cha kurvIta snAtaH shuchirala~NkRRitaH |
parvakAleShu sarveShu brahmachArI sadA bhavet
shlokas.82:
nAlIDhayA parihataM bhakShayIta kadAchana |
tathA noddhRRitasArANi prekShatAM nApradAya cha
shlokas.83:
na saMnikRRiShTo medhAvI nAshuchirna cha satsu cha |
pratiShiddhAnna dharmeShu bhakShAnbhu~njIta pRRiShThataH
shlokas.84:
pippalaM cha vaTaM chaiva shaNashAkaM tathaiva cha |
udumbaraM na khAdechcha bhavArthI puruShottamaH
shlokas.85:
AjaM gavyaM cha yanmA.nsaM mAyUraM chaiva varjayet |
varjayechChuShkamA.nsaM cha tathA paryuShitaM cha yat
shlokas.86:
na pANau lavaNaM vidvAnprAshnIyAnna cha rAtriShu |
dadhisaktUnna bhu~njIta vRRithAmA.nsaM cha varjayet
shlokas.87:
vAlena tu na bhu~njIta parashrAddhaM tathaiva cha |
sAyaM prAtashcha bhu~njIta nAntarAle samAhitaH
shlokas.88:
vAgyato naikavastrashcha nAsa.nviShTaH kadAchana |
bhUmau sadaiva nAshnIyAnnAnAsIno na shabdavat
shlokas.89:
toyapUrvaM pradAyAnnamatithibhyo vishAM pate |
pashchAdbhu~njIta medhAvI na chApyanyamanA naraH
shlokas.90:
samAnamekapa~NktyAM tu bhojyamannaM nareshvara |
viShaM hAlAhalaM bhu~Nkte yo.apradAya suhRRijjane
shlokas.91:
pAnIyaM pAyasaM sarpirdadhisaktumadhUnyapi |
nirasya sheShameteShAM na pradeyaM tu kasyachit
shlokas.92:
bhu~njAno manujavyAghra naiva sha~NkAM samAcharet |
dadhi chApyanupAnaM vai na kartavyaM bhavArthinA
shlokas.93:
Achamya chaiva hastena parisrAvya tathodakam |
a~NguShThaM charaNasyAtha dakShiNasyAvasechayet
shlokas.94:
pANiM mUrdhni samAdhAya spRRiShTvA chAgniM samAhitaH |
j~nAtishraiShThyamavApnoti prayogakushalo naraH
shlokas.95:
adbhiH prANAnsamAlabhya nAbhiM pANitalena cha |
spRRisha.nshchaiva pratiShTheta na chApyArdreNa pANinA
shlokas.96:
a~NguShThasyAntarAle cha brAhmaM tIrthamudAhRRitam |
kaniShThikAyAH pashchAttu devatIrthamihochyate
shlokas.97:
a~NguShThasya cha yanmadhyaM pradeshinyAshcha bhArata |
tena pitryANi kurvIta spRRiShTvApo nyAyatastathA
shlokas.98:
parApavAdaM na brUyAnnApriyaM cha kadAchana |
na manyuH kashchidutpAdyaH puruSheNa bhavArthinA
shlokas.99:
patitaistu kathAM nechCheddarshanaM chApi varjayet |
sa.nsargaM cha na gachCheta tathAyurvindate mahat
shlokas.100:
na divA maithunaM gachChenna kanyAM na cha bandhakIm |
na chAsnAtAM striyaM gachChettathAyurvindate mahat
shlokas.101:
sve sve tIrthe samAchamya kArye samupakalpite |
triH pItvApo dviH pramRRijya kRRitashaucho bhavennaraH
shlokas.102:
indriyANi sakRRitspRRishya trirabhyukShya cha mAnavaH |
kurvIta pitryaM daivaM cha vedadRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.103:
brAhmaNArthe cha yachChauchaM tachcha me shRRiNu kaurava |
pravRRittaM cha hitaM choktvA bhojanAdyantayostathA
shlokas.104:
sarvashaucheShu brAhmeNa tIrthena samupaspRRishet |
niShThIvya tu tathA kShutvA spRRishyApo hi shuchirbhavet
shlokas.105:
vRRiddho j~nAtistathA mitraM daridro yo bhavedapi |
gRRihe vAsayitavyAste dhanyamAyuShyameva cha
shlokas.106:
gRRihe pArAvatA dhanyAH shukAshcha sahasArikAH |
gRRiheShvete na pApAya tathA vai tailapAyikAH
shlokas.107:
uddIpakAshcha gRRidhrAshcha kapotA bhramarAstathA |
nivisheyuryadA tatra shAntimeva tadAcharet
shlokas.108:
ama~NgalyAni chaitAni tathAkrosho mahAtmanAm |
mahAtmanAM cha guhyAni na vaktavyAni karhichit
shlokas.109:
agamyAshcha na gachCheta rAjapatnIH sakhIstathA |
vaidyAnAM bAlavRRiddhAnAM bhRRityAnAM cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.110:
bandhUnAM brAhmaNAnAM cha tathA shAraNikasya cha |
sambandhinAM cha rAjendra tathAyurvindate mahat
shlokas.111:
brAhmaNasthapatibhyAM cha nirmitaM yanniveshanam |
tadAvasetsadA prAj~no bhavArthI manujeshvara
shlokas.112:
sandhyAyAM na svapedrAjanvidyAM na cha samAcharet |
na bhu~njIta cha medhAvI tathAyurvindate mahat
shlokas.113:
naktaM na kuryAtpitryANi bhuktvA chaiva prasAdhanam |
pAnIyasya kriyA naktaM na kAryA bhUtimichChatA
shlokas.114:
varjanIyAshcha vai nityaM saktavo nishi bhArata |
sheShANi chAvadAtAni pAnIyaM chaiva bhojane
shlokas.115:
sauhityaM cha na kartavyaM rAtrau naiva samAcharet |
dvijachChedaM na kurvIta bhuktvA na cha samAcharet
shlokas.116:
mahAkulaprasUtAM cha prashastAM lakShaNaistathA |
vayaHsthAM cha mahAprAj~na kanyAmAvoDhumarhati
shlokas.117:
apatyamutpAdya tataH pratiShThApya kulaM tathA |
putrAH pradeyA j~nAneShu kuladharmeShu bhArata
shlokas.118:
kanyA chotpAdya dAtavyA kulaputrAya dhImate |
putrA niveshyAshcha kulAdbhRRityA labhyAshcha bhArata
shlokas.119:
shiraHsnAto.atha kurvIta daivaM pitryamathApi cha |
nakShatre na cha kurvIta yasmi~njAto bhavennaraH
na proShThapadayoH kAryaM tathAgneye cha bhArata
shlokas.120:
dAruNeShu cha sarveShu pratyahaM cha vivarjayet |
jyotiShe yAni choktAni tAni sarvANi varjayet
shlokas.121:
prA~NmukhaH shmashrukarmANi kArayeta samAhitaH |
uda~Nmukho vA rAjendra tathAyurvindate mahat
shlokas.122:
parivAdaM na cha brUyAtpareShAmAtmanastathA |
parivAdo na dharmAya prochyate bharatarShabha
shlokas.123:
varjayedvya~NginIM nArIM tathA kanyAM narottama |
samArShAM vya~NgitAM chaiva mAtuH svakulajAM tathA
shlokas.124:
vRRiddhAM pravrajitAM chaiva tathaiva cha pativratAm |
tathAtikRRiShNavarNAM cha varNotkRRiShTAM cha varjayet
shlokas.125:
ayoniM cha viyoniM cha na gachCheta vichakShaNaH |
pi~NgalAM kuShThinIM nArIM na tvamAvoDhumarhasi
shlokas.126:
apasmArikule jAtAM nihInAM chaiva varjayet |
shvitriNAM cha kule jAtAM trayANAM manujeshvara
shlokas.127:
lakShaNairanvitA yA cha prashastA yA cha lakShaNaiH |
manoj~nA darshanIyA cha tAM bhavAnvoDhumarhati
shlokas.128:
mahAkule niveShTavyaM sadRRishe vA yudhiShThira |
avarA patitA chaiva na grAhyA bhUtimichChatA
shlokas.129:
agnInutpAdya yatnena kriyAH suvihitAshcha yAH |
vedeShu brAhmaNaiH proktAstAshcha sarvAH samAcharet
shlokas.130:
na cherShyA strIShu kartavyA dArA rakShyAshcha sarvashaH |
anAyuShyA bhavedIrShyA tasmAdIrShyAM vivarjayet
shlokas.131:
anAyuShyo divAsvapnastathAbhyuditashAyitA |
prAtarnishAyAM cha tathA ye chochChiShTAH svapanti vai
shlokas.132:
pAradAryamanAyuShyaM nApitochChiShTatA tathA |
yatnato vai na kartavyamabhyAsashchaiva bhArata
shlokas.133:
sandhyAM na bhu~njenna snAyAnna purIShaM samutsRRijet |
prayatashcha bhavettasyAM na cha ki~nchitsamAcharet
shlokas.134:
brAhmaNAnpUjayechchApi tathA snAtvA narAdhipa |
devA.nshcha praNametsnAto gurU.nshchApyabhivAdayet
shlokas.135:
animantrito na gachCheta yaj~naM gachChettu darshakaH |
animantrite hyanAyuShyaM gamanaM tatra bhArata
shlokas.136:
na chaikena parivrAjyaM na gantavyaM tathA nishi |
anAgatAyAM sandhyAyAM pashchimAyAM gRRihe vaset
shlokas.137:
mAtuH piturgurUNAM cha kAryamevAnushAsanam |
hitaM vApyahitaM vApi na vichAryaM nararShabha
shlokas.138:
dhanurvede cha vede cha yatnaH kAryo narAdhipa |
hastipRRiShThe.ashvapRRiShThe cha rathacharyAsu chaiva ha
yatnavAnbhava rAjendra yatnavAnsukhamedhate
shlokas.139:
apradhRRiShyashcha shatrUNAM bhRRityAnAM svajanasya cha |
prajApAlanayuktashcha na kShatiM labhate kvachit
shlokas.140:
yuktishAstraM cha te j~neyaM shabdashAstraM cha bhArata |
gandharvashAstraM cha kalAH parij~neyA narAdhipa
shlokas.141:
purANamitihAsAshcha tathAkhyAnAni yAni cha |
mahAtmanAM cha charitaM shrotavyaM nityameva te
shlokas.142:
patnIM rajasvalAM chaiva nAbhigachChenna chAhvayet |
snAtAM chaturthe divase rAtrau gachChedvichakShaNaH
shlokas.143:
pa~nchame divase nArI ShaShThe.ahani pumAnbhavet |
etena vidhinA patnImupagachCheta paNDitaH
shlokas.144:
j~nAtisambandhimitrANi pUjanIyAni nityashaH |
yaShTavyaM cha yathAshakti yaj~nairvividhadakShiNaiH
ataUrdhvamaraNyaM cha sevitavyaM narAdhipa
shlokas.145:
eSha te lakShaNoddesha AyuShyANAM prakIrtitaH |
sheShastraividyavRRiddhebhyaH pratyAhAryo yudhiShThira
shlokas.146:
AchAro bhUtijanana AchAraH kIrtivardhanaH |
AchArAdvardhate hyAyurAchAro hantyalakShaNam
shlokas.147:
AgamAnAM hi sarveShAmAchAraH shreShTha uchyate |
AchAraprabhavo dharmo dharmAdAyurvivardhate
shlokas.148:
etadyashasyamAyuShyaM svargyaM svastyayanaM mahat |
anukampatA sarvavarNAnbrahmaNA samudAhRRitam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yathA jyeShThaH kaniShTheShu vartate bharatarShabha |
kaniShThAshcha yathA jyeShThe vartera.nstadbravIhi me
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
jyeShThavattAta vartasva jyeShTho hi satataM bhavAn |
gurorgarIyasI vRRittiryA chechChiShyasya bhArata
shlokas.3:
na gurAvakRRitapraj~ne shakyaM shiShyeNa vartitum |
gurorhi dIrghadarshitvaM yattachChiShyasya bhArata
shlokas.4:
andhaH syAdandhavelAyAM jaDaH syAdapi vA budhaH |
parihAreNa tadbrUyAdyasteShAM syAdvyatikramaH
shlokas.5:
pratyakShaM bhinnahRRidayA bhedayeyuH kRRitaM narAH |
shriyAbhitaptAH kaunteya bhedakAmAstathArayaH
shlokas.6:
jyeShThaH kulaM vardhayati vinAshayati vA punaH |
hanti sarvamapi jyeShThaH kulaM yatrAvajAyate
shlokas.7:
atha yo vinikurvIta jyeShTho bhrAtA yavIyasaH |
ajyeShThaH syAdabhAgashcha niyamyo rAjabhishcha saH
shlokas.8:
nikRRitI hi naro lokAnpApAngachChatyasa.nshayam |
vidulasyeva tatpuShpaM moghaM janayituH smRRitam
shlokas.9:
sarvAnarthaH kule yatra jAyate pApapUruShaH |
akIrtiM janayatyeva kIrtimantardadhAti cha
shlokas.10:
sarve chApi vikarmasthA bhAgaM nArhanti sodarAH |
nApradAya kaniShThebhyo jyeShThaH kurvIta yautakam
shlokas.11:
anujaM hi piturdAyo ja~NghAshramaphalo.adhvagaH |
svayamIhitalabdhaM tu nAkAmo dAtumarhati
shlokas.12:
bhrAtR^INAmavibhaktAnAmutthAnamapi chetsaha |
na putrabhAgaM viShamaM pitA dadyAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.13:
na jyeShThAnavamanyeta duShkRRitaH sukRRito.api vA |
yadi strI yadyavarajaH shreyaH pashyettathAcharet
dharmaM hi shreya ityAhuriti dharmavido viduH
shlokas.14:
dashAchAryAnupAdhyAya upAdhyAyAnpitA dasha |
dasha chaiva pitR^InmAtA sarvAM vA pRRithivImapi
shlokas.15:
gauraveNAbhibhavati nAsti mAtRRisamo guruH |
mAtA garIyasI yachcha tenaitAM manyate janaH
shlokas.16:
jyeShTho bhrAtA pitRRisamo mRRite pitari bhArata |
sa hyeShAM vRRittidAtA syAtsa chaitAnparipAlayet
shlokas.17:
kaniShThAstaM namasyeransarve ChandAnuvartinaH |
tameva chopajIveranyathaiva pitaraM tathA
shlokas.18:
sharIrametau sRRijataH pitA mAtA cha bhArata |
AchAryashAstA yA jAtiH sA satyA sAjarAmarA
shlokas.19:
jyeShThA mAtRRisamA chApi bhaginI bharatarShabha |
bhrAturbhAryA cha tadvatsyAdyasyA bAlye stanaM pibet

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sarveShAmeva varNAnAM mlechChAnAM cha pitAmaha |
upavAse matiriyaM kAraNaM cha na vidmahe
shlokas.2:
brahmakShatreNa niyamAshchartavyA iti naH shrutam |
upavAse kathaM teShAM kRRityamasti pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
niyamaM chopavAsAnAM sarveShAM brUhi pArthiva |
avApnoti gatiM kAM cha upavAsaparAyaNaH
shlokas.4:
upavAsaH paraM puNyamupavAsaH parAyaNam |
upoShyeha narashreShTha kiM phalaM pratipadyate
shlokas.5:
adharmAnmuchyate kena dharmamApnoti vai katham |
svargaM puNyaM cha labhate kathaM bharatasattama
shlokas.6:
upoShya chApi kiM tena pradeyaM syAnnarAdhipa |
dharmeNa cha sukhAnarthA.Nllabhedyena bravIhi tam
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM bruvANaM kaunteyaM dharmaj~naM dharmatattvavit |
dharmaputramidaM vAkyaM bhIShmaH shAntanavo.abravIt
shlokas.8:
idaM khalu mahArAja shrutamAsItpurAtanam |
upavAsavidhau shreShThA ye guNA bharatarShabha
shlokas.9:
prAjApatyaM hya~NgirasaM pRRiShTavAnasmi bhArata |
yathA mAM tvaM tathaivAhaM pRRiShTavA.nstaM tapodhanam
shlokas.10:
prashnametaM mayA pRRiShTo bhagavAnagnisambhavaH |
upavAsavidhiM puNyamAchaShTa bharatarShabha
shlokas.11:
a~NgirA uvAcha||
brahmakShatre trirAtraM tu vihitaM kurunandana |
dvistrirAtramathaivAtra nirdiShTaM puruSharShabha
shlokas.12:
vaishyashUdrau tu yau mohAdupavAsaM prakurvate |
trirAtraM dvistrirAtraM vA tayoH puShTirna vidyate
shlokas.13:
chaturthabhaktakShapaNaM vaishyashUdre vidhIyate |
trirAtraM na tu dharmaj~nairvihitaM brahmavAdibhiH
shlokas.14:
pa~nchamyAM chaiva ShaShThyAM cha paurNamAsyAM cha bhArata |
kShamAvAnrUpasampannaH shrutavA.nshchaiva jAyate
shlokas.15:
nAnapatyo bhavetprAj~no daridro vA kadAchana |
yajiShNuH pa~nchamIM ShaShThIM kShapedyo bhojayeddvijAn
shlokas.16:
aShTamImatha kaunteya shuklapakShe chaturdashIm |
upoShya vyAdhirahito vIryavAnabhijAyate
shlokas.17:
mArgashIrShaM tu yo mAsamekabhaktena sa~NkShipet |
bhojayechcha dvijAnbhaktyA sa muchyedvyAdhikilbiShaiH
shlokas.18:
sarvakalyANasampUrNaH sarvauShadhisamanvitaH |
kRRiShibhAgI bahudhano bahuputrashcha jAyate
shlokas.19:
pauShamAsaM tu kaunteya bhaktenaikena yaH kShapet |
subhago darshanIyashcha yashobhAgI cha jAyate
shlokas.20:
pitRRibhakto mAghamAsamekabhaktena yaH kShapet |
shrImatkule j~nAtimadhye sa mahattvaM prapadyate
shlokas.21:
bhagadaivaM tu yo mAsamekabhaktena yaH kShapet |
strIShu vallabhatAM yAti vashyAshchAsya bhavanti tAH
shlokas.22:
chaitraM tu niyato mAsamekabhaktena yaH kShapet |
suvarNamaNimuktADhye kule mahati jAyate
shlokas.23:
nistaredekabhaktena vaishAkhaM yo jitendriyaH |
naro vA yadi vA nArI j~nAtInAM shreShThatAM vrajet
shlokas.24:
jyeShThAmUlaM tu yo mAsamekabhaktena sa~NkShapet |
aishvaryamatulaM shreShThaM pumAnstrI vAbhijAyate
shlokas.25:
AShADhamekabhaktena sthitvA mAsamatandritaH |
bahudhAnyo bahudhano bahuputrashcha jAyate
shlokas.26:
shrAvaNaM niyato mAsamekabhaktena yaH kShapet |
yatra tatrAbhiShekeNa yujyate j~nAtivardhanaH
shlokas.27:
prauShThapadaM tu yo mAsamekAhAro bhavennaraH |
dhanADhyaM sphItamachalamaishvaryaM pratipadyate
shlokas.28:
tathaivAshvayujaM mAsamekabhaktena yaH kShapet |
prajAvAnvAhanADhyashcha bahuputrashcha jAyate
shlokas.29:
kArttikaM tu naro mAsaM yaH kuryAdekabhojanam |
shUrashcha bahubhAryashcha kIrtimA.nshchaiva jAyate
shlokas.30:
iti mAsA naravyAghra kShapatAM parikIrtitAH |
tithInAM niyamA ye tu shRRiNu tAnapi pArthiva
shlokas.31:
pakShe pakShe gate yastu bhaktamashnAti bhArata |
gavADhyo bahuputrashcha dIrghAyushcha sa jAyate
shlokas.32:
mAsi mAsi trirAtrANi kRRitvA varShANi dvAdasha |
gaNAdhipatyaM prApnoti niHsapatnamanAvilam
shlokas.33:
ete tu niyamAH sarve kartavyAH sharado dasha |
dve chAnye bharatashreShTha pravRRittimanuvartatA
shlokas.34:
yastu prAtastathA sAyaM bhu~njAno nAntarA pibet |
ahi.nsAnirato nityaM juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.35:
ShaDbhiH sa varShairnRRipate sidhyate nAtra sa.nshayaH |
agniShTomasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.36:
adhivAse so.apsarasAM nRRityagItavinAdite |
taptakA~nchanavarNAbhaM vimAnamadhirohati
shlokas.37:
pUrNaM varShasahasraM tu brahmaloke mahIyate |
tatkShayAdiha chAgamya mAhAtmyaM pratipadyate
shlokas.38:
yastu sa.nvatsaraM pUrNamekAhAro bhavennaraH |
atirAtrasya yaj~nasya sa phalaM samupAshnute
shlokas.39:
dashavarShasahasrANi svarge cha sa mahIyate |
tatkShayAdiha chAgamya mAhAtmyaM pratipadyate
shlokas.40:
yastu sa.nvatsaraM pUrNaM chaturthaM bhaktamashnute |
ahi.nsAnirato nityaM satyavA~NniyatendriyaH
shlokas.41:
vAjapeyasya yaj~nasya phalaM vai samupAshnute |
tri.nshadvarShasahasrANi svarge cha sa mahIyate
shlokas.42:
ShaShThe kAle tu kaunteya naraH sa.nvatsaraM kShapet |
ashvamedhasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.43:
chakravAkaprayuktena vimAnena sa gachChati |
chatvAri.nshatsahasrANi varShANAM divi modate
shlokas.44:
aShTamena tu bhaktena jIvansa.nvatsaraM nRRipa |
gavAmayasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.45:
ha.nsasArasayuktena vimAnena sa gachChati |
pa~nchAshataM sahasrANi varShANAM divi modate
shlokas.46:
pakShe pakShe gate rAjanyo.ashnIyAdvarShameva tu |
ShaNmAsAnashanaM tasya bhagavAna~NgirAbravIt
ShaShTiM varShasahasrANi divamAvasate cha saH
shlokas.47:
vINAnAM vallakInAM cha veNUnAM cha vishAM pate |
sughoShairmadhuraiH shabdaiH suptaH sa pratibodhyate
shlokas.48:
sa.nvatsaramihaikaM tu mAsi mAsi pibetpayaH |
phalaM vishvajitastAta prApnoti sa naro nRRipa
shlokas.49:
siMhavyAghraprayuktena vimAnena sa gachChati |
saptatiM cha sahasrANi varShANAM divi modate
shlokas.50:
mAsAdUrdhvaM naravyAghra nopavAso vidhIyate |
vidhiM tvanashanasyAhuH pArtha dharmavido janAH
shlokas.51:
anArto vyAdhirahito gachChedanashanaM tu yaH |
pade pade yaj~naphalaM sa prApnoti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.52:
divaM ha.nsaprayuktena vimAnena sa gachChati |
shataM chApsarasaH kanyA ramayantyapi taM naram
shlokas.53:
Arto vA vyAdhito vApi gachChedanashanaM tu yaH |
shataM varShasahasrANAM modate divi sa prabho
kA~nchInUpurashabdena suptashchaiva prabodhyate
shlokas.54:
sahasraha.nsasa.nyukte vimAne somavarchasi |
sa gatvA strIshatAkIrNe ramate bharatarShabha
shlokas.55:
kShINasyApyAyanaM dRRiShTaM kShatasya kShatarohaNam |
vyAdhitasyauShadhagrAmaH kruddhasya cha prasAdanam
shlokas.56:
duHkhitasyArthamAnAbhyAM dravyANAM pratipAdanam |
na chaite svargakAmasya rochante sukhamedhasaH
shlokas.57:
ataH sa kAmasa.nyukto vimAne hemasaMnibhe |
ramate strIshatAkIrNe puruSho.ala~NkRRitaH shubhe
shlokas.58:
svasthaH saphalasa~NkalpaH sukhI vigatakalmaShaH |
anashnandehamutsRRijya phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.59:
bAlasUryapratIkAshe vimAne hemavarchasi |
vaiDUryamuktAkhachite vINAmurajanAdite
shlokas.60:
patAkAdIpikAkIrNe divyaghaNTAninAdite |
strIsahasrAnucharite sa naraH sukhamedhate
shlokas.61:
yAvanti romakUpANi tasya gAtreShu pANDava |
tAvantyeva sahasrANi varShANAM divi modate
shlokas.62:
nAsti vedAtparaM shAstraM nAsti mAtRRisamo guruH |
na dharmAtparamo lAbhastapo nAnashanAtparam
shlokas.63:
brAhmaNebhyaH paraM nAsti pAvanaM divi cheha cha |
upavAsaistathA tulyaM tapaHkarma na vidyate
shlokas.64:
upoShya vidhivaddevAstridivaM pratipedire |
RRiShayashcha parAM siddhimupavAsairavApnuvan
shlokas.65:
divyaM varShasahasraM hi vishvAmitreNa dhImatA |
kShAntamekena bhaktena tena vipratvamAgataH
shlokas.66:
chyavano jamadagnishcha vasiShTho gautamo bhRRiguH |
sarva eva divaM prAptAH kShamAvanto maharShayaH
shlokas.67:
idama~NgirasA pUrvaM maharShibhyaH pradarshitam |
yaH pradarshayate nityaM na sa duHkhamavApnute
shlokas.68:
imaM tu kaunteya yathAkramaM vidhiM; pravartitaM hya~NgirasA maharShiNA |
paTheta yo vai shRRiNuyAchcha nityadA; na vidyate tasya narasya kilbiSham
shlokas.69:
vimuchyate chApi sa sarvasa~Nkarai;rna chAsya doShairabhibhUyate manaH |
viyonijAnAM cha vijAnate rutaM; dhruvAM cha kIrtiM labhate narottamaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmahena vidhivadyaj~nAH proktA mahAtmanA |
guNAshchaiShAM yathAtattvaM pretya cheha cha sarvashaH
shlokas.2:
na te shakyA daridreNa yaj~nAH prAptuM pitAmaha |
bahUpakaraNA yaj~nA nAnAsambhAravistarAH
shlokas.3:
pArthivai rAjaputrairvA shakyAH prAptuM pitAmaha |
nArthanyUnairavaguNairekAtmabhirasaMhataiH
shlokas.4:
yo daridrairapi vidhiH shakyaH prAptuM sadA bhavet |
tulyo yaj~naphalairetaistanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
idama~NgirasA proktamupavAsaphalAtmakam |
vidhiM yaj~naphalaistulyaM tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.6:
yastu kalyaM tathA sAyaM bhu~njAno nAntarA pibet |
ahi.nsAnirato nityaM juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.7:
ShaDbhireva tu varShaiH sa sidhyate nAtra sa.nshayaH |
taptakA~nchanavarNaM cha vimAnaM labhate naraH
shlokas.8:
devastrINAmadhIvAse nRRityagItaninAdite |
prAjApatye vasetpadmaM varShANAmagnisaMnibhe
shlokas.9:
trINi varShANi yaH prAshetsatataM tvekabhojanam |
dharmapatnIrato nityamagniShTomaphalaM labhet
shlokas.10:
dvitIye divase yastu prAshnIyAdekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdashamAsA.nstu juhvAno jAtavedasam
yaj~naM bahusuvarNaM vA vAsavapriyamAharet
shlokas.11:
satyavAgdAnashIlashcha brahmaNyashchAnasUyakaH |
kShAnto dAnto jitakrodhaH sa gachChati parAM gatim
shlokas.12:
pANDurAbhrapratIkAshe vimAne ha.nsalakShaNe |
dve samApte tataH padme so.apsarobhirvasetsaha
shlokas.13:
tRRitIye divase yastu prAshnIyAdekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdashamAsA.nstu juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.14:
atirAtrasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnotyanuttamam |
mayUraha.nsasa.nyuktaM vimAnaM labhate naraH
shlokas.15:
saptarShINAM sadA loke so.apsarobhirvasetsaha |
nivartanaM cha tatrAsya trINi padmAni vai viduH
shlokas.16:
divase yashchaturthe tu prAshnIyAdekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdashamAsAnvai juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.17:
vAjapeyasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnotyanuttamam |
indrakanyAbhirUDhaM cha vimAnaM labhate naraH
shlokas.18:
sAgarasya cha paryante vAsavaM lokamAvaset |
devarAjasya cha krIDAM nityakAlamavekShate
shlokas.19:
divase pa~nchame yastu prAshnIyAdekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdashamAsA.nstu juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.20:
alubdhaH satyavAdI cha brahmaNyashchAvihi.nsakaH |
anasUyurapApastho dvAdashAhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.21:
jAmbUnadamayaM divyaM vimAnaM ha.nsalakShaNam |
sUryamAlAsamAbhAsamArohetpANDuraM gRRiham
shlokas.22:
AvartanAni chatvAri tathA padmAni dvAdasha |
sharAgniparimANaM cha tatrAsau vasate sukham
shlokas.23:
divase yastu ShaShThe vai muniH prAsheta bhojanam |
sadA dvAdashamAsAnvai juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.24:
sadA triShavaNasnAyI brahmachAryanasUyakaH |
gavAmayasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnotyanuttamam
shlokas.25:
agnijvAlAsamAbhAsaM ha.nsabarhiNasevitam |
shAtakumbhamayaM yuktaM sAdhayedyAnamuttamam
shlokas.26:
tathaivApsarasAma~Nke prasuptaH pratibudhyate |
nUpurANAM ninAdena mekhalAnAM cha nisvanaiH
shlokas.27:
koTIsahasraM varShANAM trINi koTishatAni cha |
padmAnyaShTAdasha tathA patAke dve tathaiva cha
shlokas.28:
ayutAni cha pa~nchAshadRRikShacharmashatasya cha |
lomnAM pramANena samaM brahmaloke mahIyate
shlokas.29:
divase saptame yastu prAshnIyAdekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdashamAsAnvai juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.30:
sarasvatIM gopayAno brahmacharyaM samAcharan |
sumanovarNakaM chaiva madhumA.nsaM cha varjayet
shlokas.31:
puruSho marutAM lokamindralokaM cha gachChati |
tatra tatra cha siddhArtho devakanyAbhiruhyate
shlokas.32:
phalaM bahusuvarNasya yaj~nasya labhate naraH |
sa~NkhyAmatiguNAM chApi teShu lokeShu modate
shlokas.33:
yastu sa.nvatsaraM kShAnto bhu~Nkte.ahanyaShTame naraH |
devakAryaparo nityaM juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.34:
pauNDarIkasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnotyanuttamam |
padmavarNanibhaM chaiva vimAnamadhirohati
shlokas.35:
kRRiShNAH kanakagauryashcha nAryaH shyAmAstathAparAH |
vayorUpavilAsinyo labhate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.36:
yastu sa.nvatsaraM bhu~Nkte navame navame.ahani |
sadA dvAdashamAsAnvai juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.37:
ashvamedhasya yaj~nasya phalaM prApnoti mAnavaH |
puNDarIkaprakAshaM cha vimAnaM labhate naraH
shlokas.38:
dIptasUryAgnitejobhirdivyamAlAbhireva cha |
nIyate rudrakanyAbhiH so.antarikShaM sanAtanam
shlokas.39:
aShTAdashasahasrANi varShANAM kalpameva cha |
koTIshatasahasraM cha teShu lokeShu modate
shlokas.40:
yastu sa.nvatsaraM bhu~Nkte dashAhe vai gate gate |
sadA dvAdashamAsAnvai juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.41:
brahmakanyAniveshe cha sarvabhUtamanohare |
ashvamedhasahasrasya phalaM prApnotyanuttamam
shlokas.42:
rUpavatyashcha taM kanyA ramayanti sadA naram |
nIlotpalanibhairvarNai raktotpalanibhaistathA
shlokas.43:
vimAnaM maNDalAvartamAvartagahanAvRRitam |
sAgarormipratIkAshaM sAdhayedyAnamuttamam
shlokas.44:
vichitramaNimAlAbhirnAditaM sha~NkhapuShkaraiH |
sphATikairvajrasAraishcha stambhaiH sukRRitavedikam
Arohati mahadyAnaM ha.nsasArasavAhanam
shlokas.45:
ekAdashe tu divase yaH prApte prAshate haviH |
sadA dvAdashamAsAnvai juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.46:
parastriyo nAbhilaShedvAchAtha manasApi vA |
anRRitaM cha na bhASheta mAtApitroH kRRite.api vA
shlokas.47:
abhigachChenmahAdevaM vimAnasthaM mahAbalam |
svayambhuvaM cha pashyeta vimAnaM samupasthitam
shlokas.48:
kumAryaH kA~nchanAbhAsA rUpavatyo nayanti tam |
rudrANAM tamadhIvAsaM divi divyaM manoharam
shlokas.49:
varShANyaparimeyAni yugAntamapi chAvaset |
koTIshatasahasraM cha dasha koTishatAni cha
shlokas.50:
rudraM nityaM praNamate devadAnavasaMmatam |
sa tasmai darshanaM prApto divase divase bhavet
shlokas.51:
divase dvAdashe yastu prApte vai prAshate haviH |
sadA dvAdashamAsAnvai sarvamedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.52:
AdityairdvAdashaistasya vimAnaM sa.nvidhIyate |
maNimuktApravAlaishcha mahArhairupashobhitam
shlokas.53:
ha.nsamAlAparikShiptaM nAgavIthIsamAkulam |
mayUraishchakravAkaishcha kUjadbhirupashobhitam
shlokas.54:
aTTairmahadbhiH sa.nyuktaM brahmaloke pratiShThitam |
nityamAvasate rAjannaranArIsamAvRRitam
RRiShirevaM mahAbhAgastva~NgirAH prAha dharmavit
shlokas.55:
trayodashe tu divase yaH prApte prAshate haviH |
sadA dvAdasha mAsAnvai devasatraphalaM labhet
shlokas.56:
raktapadmodayaM nAma vimAnaM sAdhayennaraH |
jAtarUpaprayuktaM cha ratnasa~nchayabhUShitam
shlokas.57:
devakanyAbhirAkIrNaM divyAbharaNabhUShitam |
puNyagandhodayaM divyaM vAyavyairupashobhitam
shlokas.58:
tatra sha~NkupatAkaM cha yugAntaM kalpameva cha |
ayutAyutaM tathA padmaM samudraM cha tathA vaset
shlokas.59:
gItagandharvaghoShaishcha bherIpaNavanisvanaiH |
sadA pramuditastAbhirdevakanyAbhirIDyate
shlokas.60:
chaturdashe tu divase yaH pUrNe prAshate haviH |
sadA dvAdasha mAsAnvai mahAmedhaphalaM labhet
shlokas.61:
anirdeshyavayorUpA devakanyAH svala~NkRRitAH |
mRRiShTataptA~NgadadharA vimAnairanuyAnti tam
shlokas.62:
kalaha.nsavinirghoShairnUpurANAM cha nisvanaiH |
kA~nchInAM cha samutkarShaistatra tatra vibodhyate
shlokas.63:
devakanyAnivAse cha tasminvasati mAnavaH |
jAhnavIvAlukAkIrNe pUrNaM sa.nvatsaraM naraH
shlokas.64:
yastu pakShe gate bhu~Nkte ekabhaktaM jitendriyaH |
sadA dAdasha mAsA.nstu juhvAno jAtavedasam
rAjasUyasahasrasya phalaM prApnotyanuttamam
shlokas.65:
yAnamArohate nityaM ha.nsabarhiNasevitam |
maNimaNDalakaishchitraM jAtarUpasamAvRRitam
shlokas.66:
divyAbharaNashobhAbhirvarastrIbhirala~NkRRitam |
ekastambhaM chaturdvAraM saptabhaumaM suma~Ngalam
vaijayantIsahasraishcha shobhitaM gItanisvanaiH
shlokas.67:
divyaM divyaguNopetaM vimAnamadhirohati |
maNimuktApravAlaishcha bhUShitaM vaidyutaprabham
vasedyugasahasraM cha khaDgaku~njaravAhanaH
shlokas.68:
ShoDashe divase yastu samprApte prAshate haviH |
sadA dvAdasha mAsAnvai somayaj~naphalaM labhet
shlokas.70:
sudarshanAbhirnArIbhirmadhurAbhistathaiva cha |
archyate vai vimAnasthaH kAmabhogaishcha sevyate
shlokas.71:
phalaM padmashataprakhyaM mahAkalpaM dashAdhikam |
AvartanAni chatvAri sAgare yAtyasau naraH
shlokas.72:
divase saptadashame yaH prApte prAshate haviH |
sadA dvAdasha mAsAnvai juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.73:
sthAnaM vAruNamaindraM cha raudraM chaivAdhigachChati |
mArutaushanase chaiva brahmalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.74:
tatra daivatakanyAbhirAsanenopacharyate |
bhUrbhuvaM chApi devarShiM vishvarUpamavekShate
shlokas.75:
tatra devAdhidevasya kumAryo ramayanti tam |
dvAtri.nshadrUpadhAriNyo madhurAH samala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.76:
chandrAdityAvubhau yAvadgagane charataH prabho |
tAvachcharatyasau vIraH sudhAmRRitarasAshanaH
shlokas.77:
aShTAdashe tu divase prAshnIyAdekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsAnvai sapta lokAnsa pashyati
shlokas.78:
rathaiH sanandighoShaishcha pRRiShThataH so.anugamyate |
devakanyAdhirUDhaistu bhrAjamAnaiH svala~NkRRitaiH
shlokas.79:
vyAghrasiMhaprayuktaM cha meghasvananinAditam |
vimAnamuttamaM divyaM susukhI hyadhirohati
shlokas.80:
tatra kalpasahasraM sa kAntAbhiH saha modate |
sudhArasaM cha bhu~njIta amRRitopamamuttamam
shlokas.81:
ekonavi.nshe divase yo bhu~Nkte ekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsAnvai sapta lokAnsa pashyati
shlokas.82:
uttamaM labhate sthAnamapsarogaNasevitam |
gandharvairupagItaM cha vimAnaM sUryavarchasam
shlokas.83:
tatrAmaravarastrIbhirmodate vigatajvaraH |
divyAmbaradharaH shrImAnayutAnAM shataM samAH
shlokas.84:
pUrNe.atha divase vi.nshe yo bhu~Nkte hyekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsA.nstu satyavAdI dhRRitavrataH
shlokas.85:
amA.nsAshI brahmachArI sarvabhUtahite rataH |
sa lokAnvipulAndivyAnAdityAnAmupAshnute
shlokas.87:
ekavi.nshe tu divase yo bhu~Nkte hyekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsAnvai juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.88:
lokamaushanasaM divyaM shakralokaM cha gachChati |
ashvinormarutAM chaiva sukheShvabhirataH sadA
shlokas.89:
anabhij~nashcha duHkhAnAM vimAnavaramAsthitaH |
sevyamAno varastrIbhiH krIDatyamaravatprabhuH
shlokas.90:
dvAvi.nshe divase prApte yo bhu~Nkte hyekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsAnvai juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.93:
trayovi.nshe tu divase prAshedyastvekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsA.nstu mitAhAro jitendriyaH
shlokas.94:
vAyorushanasashchaiva rudralokaM cha gachChati |
kAmachArI kAmagamaH pUjyamAno.apsarogaNaiH
shlokas.96:
chaturvi.nshe tu divase yaH prAshedekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsAnvai juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.98:
vimAne kA~nchane divye ha.nsayukte manorame |
ramate devakanyAnAM sahasrairayutaistathA
shlokas.99:
pa~nchavi.nshe tu divase yaH prAshedekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsA.nstu puShkalaM yAnamAruhet
shlokas.100:
siMhavyAghraprayuktaishcha meghasvananinAditaiH |
rathaiH sanandighoShaishcha pRRiShThataH so.anugamyate
shlokas.101:
devakanyAsamArUDhai rAjatairvimalaiH shubhaiH |
vimAnamuttamaM divyamAsthAya sumanoharam
shlokas.102:
tatra kalpasahasraM vai vasate strIshatAvRRite |
sudhArasaM chopajIvannamRRitopamamuttamam
shlokas.103:
ShaDvi.nshe divase yastu prAshnIyAdekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsA.nstu niyato niyatAshanaH
shlokas.104:
jitendriyo vItarAgo juhvAno jAtavedasam |
sa prApnoti mahAbhAgaH pUjyamAno.apsarogaNaiH
shlokas.105:
saptAnAM marutAM lokAnvasUnAM chApi so.ashnute |
vimAne sphATike divye sarvaratnairala~NkRRite
shlokas.106:
gandharvairapsarobhishcha pUjyamAnaH pramodate |
dve yugAnAM sahasre tu divye divyena tejasA
shlokas.107:
saptavi.nshe tu divase yaH prAshedekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsA.nstu juhvAno jAtavedasam
shlokas.108:
phalaM prApnoti vipulaM devaloke cha pUjyate |
amRRitAshI vasa.nstatra sa vitRRiptaH pramodate
shlokas.110:
strIbhirmanobhirAmAbhI ramamANo madotkaTaH |
yugakalpasahasrANi trINyAvasati vai sukham
shlokas.111:
yo.aShTAvi.nshe tu divase prAshnIyAdekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsA.nstu jitAtmA vijitendriyaH
shlokas.112:
phalaM devarShicharitaM vipulaM samupAshnute |
bhogavA.nstejasA bhAti sahasrA.nshurivAmalaH
shlokas.113:
sukumAryashcha nAryastaM ramamANAH suvarchasaH |
pInastanorujaghanA divyAbharaNabhUShitAH
shlokas.114:
ramayanti manaH kAntA vimAne sUryasaMnibhe |
sarvakAmagame divye kalpAyutashataM samAH
shlokas.115:
ekonatri.nshe divase yaH prAshedekabhojanam |
sadA dvAdasha mAsAnvai satyavrataparAyaNaH
shlokas.116:
tasya lokAH shubhA divyA devarAjarShipUjitAH |
vimAnaM chandrashubhrAbhaM divyaM samadhigachChati
shlokas.118:
tatra chainaM shubhA nAryo divyAbharaNabhUShitAH |
manobhirAmA madhurA ramayanti madotkaTAH
shlokas.119:
bhogavA.nstejasA yukto vaishvAnarasamaprabhaH |
divyo divyena vapuShA bhrAjamAna ivAmaraH
shlokas.120:
vasUnAM marutAM chaiva sAdhyAnAmashvinostathA |
rudrANAM cha tathA lokAnbrahmalokaM cha gachChati
shlokas.121:
yastu mAse gate bhu~Nkte ekabhaktaM shamAtmakaH |
sadA dvAdasha mAsAnvai brahmalokamavApnuyAt
shlokas.122:
sudhArasakRRitAhAraH shrImAnsarvamanoharaH |
tejasA vapuShA lakShmyA bhrAjate rashmivAniva
shlokas.126:
vimAne nagarAkAre sUryavatsUryasaMnibhe |
pRRiShThataH somasa~NkAshe udakchaivAbhrasaMnibhe
shlokas.127:
dakShiNAyAM tu raktAbhe adhastAnnIlamaNDale |
UrdhvaM chitrAbhisa~NkAshe naiko vasati pUjitaH
shlokas.128:
yAvadvarShasahasraM tu jambUdvIpe pravarShati |
tAvatsa.nvatsarAH proktA brahmalokasya dhImataH
shlokas.129:
vipruShashchaiva yAvantyo nipatanti nabhastalAt |
varShAsu varShatastAvannivasatyamaraprabhaH
shlokas.130:
mAsopavAsI varShaistu dashabhiH svargamuttamam |
maharShitvamathAsAdya sasharIragatirbhavet
shlokas.131:
munirdAnto jitakrodho jitashishnodaraH sadA |
juhvannagnI.nshcha niyataH sandhyopAsanasevitA
shlokas.132:
bahubhirniyamairevaM mAsAnashnAti yo naraH |
abhrAvakAshashIlashcha tasya vAso niruchyate
shlokas.133:
divaM gatvA sharIreNa svena rAjanyathAmaraH |
svargaM puNyaM yathAkAmamupabhu~Nkte yathAvidhi
shlokas.134:
eSha te bharatashreShTha yaj~nAnAM vidhiruttamaH |
vyAkhyAto hyAnupUrvyeNa upavAsaphalAtmakaH
shlokas.135:
daridrairmanujaiH pArtha prApyaM yaj~naphalaM yathA |
upavAsamimaM kRRitvA gachChechcha paramAM gatim
devadvijAtipUjAyAM rato bharatasattama
shlokas.136:
upavAsavidhistveSha vistareNa prakIrtitaH |
niyateShvapramatteShu shauchavatsu mahAtmasu
shlokas.137:
dambhadrohanivRRitteShu kRRitabuddhiShu bhArata |
achaleShvaprakampeShu mA te bhUdatra sa.nshayaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadvaraM sarvatIrthAnAM tadbravIhi pitAmaha |
yatra vai paramaM shauchaM tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sarvANi khalu tIrthAni guNavanti manIShiNAm |
yattu tIrthaM cha shauchaM cha tanme shRRiNu samAhitaH
shlokas.3:
agAdhe vimale shuddhe satyatoye dhRRitihrade |
snAtavyaM mAnase tIrthe sattvamAlambya shAshvatam
shlokas.4:
tIrthashauchamanarthitvamArdavaM satyamArjavam |
ahi.nsA sarvabhUtAnAmAnRRisha.nsyaM damaH shamaH
shlokas.5:
nirmamA niraha~NkArA nirdva.ndvA niShparigrahAH |
shuchayastIrthabhUtAste ye bhaikShamupabhu~njate
shlokas.6:
tattvavittvanahambuddhistIrthaM paramamuchyate |
shauchalakShaNametatte sarvatraivAnvavekShaNam
shlokas.7:
rajastamaH sattvamatho yeShAM nirdhautamAtmanaH |
shauchAshauche na te saktAH svakAryaparimArgiNaH
shlokas.8:
sarvatyAgeShvabhiratAH sarvaj~nAH sarvadarshinaH |
shauchena vRRittashauchArthAste tIrthAH shuchayashcha te
shlokas.9:
nodakaklinnagAtrastu snAta ityabhidhIyate |
sa snAto yo damasnAtaH sabAhyAbhyantaraH shuchiH
shlokas.10:
atIteShvanapekShA ye prApteShvartheShu nirmamAH |
shauchameva paraM teShAM yeShAM notpadyate spRRihA
shlokas.11:
praj~nAnaM shauchameveha sharIrasya visheShataH |
tathA niShki~nchanatvaM cha manasashcha prasannatA
shlokas.12:
vRRittashauchaM manaHshauchaM tIrthashauchaM paraM hitam |
j~nAnotpannaM cha yachChauchaM tachChauchaM paramaM matam
shlokas.13:
manasAtha pradIpena brahmaj~nAnabalena cha |
snAtA ye mAnase tIrthe tajj~nAH kShetraj~nadarshinaH
shlokas.14:
samAropitashauchastu nityaM bhAvasamanvitaH |
kevalaM guNasampannaH shuchireva naraH sadA
shlokas.15:
sharIrasthAni tIrthAni proktAnyetAni bhArata |
pRRithivyAM yAni tIrthAni puNyAni shRRiNu tAnyapi
shlokas.16:
yathA sharIrasyoddeshAH shuchayaH parinirmitAH |
tathA pRRithivyA bhAgAshcha puNyAni salilAni cha
shlokas.17:
prArthanAchchaiva tIrthasya snAnAchcha pitRRitarpaNAt |
dhunanti pApaM tIrtheShu pUtA yAnti divaM sukham
shlokas.18:
parigrahAchcha sAdhUnAM pRRithivyAshchaiva tejasA |
atIva puNyAste bhAgAH salilasya cha tejasA
shlokas.19:
manasashcha pRRithivyAshcha puNyatIrthAstathApare |
ubhayoreva yaH snAtaH sa siddhiM shIghramApnuyAt
shlokas.20:
yathA balaM kriyAhInaM kriyA vA balavarjitA |
neha sAdhayate kAryaM samAyuktastu sidhyati
shlokas.21:
evaM sharIrashauchena tIrthashauchena chAnvitaH |
tataH siddhimavApnoti dvividhaM shauchamuttamam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmaha mahAbAho sarvashAstravishArada |
shrotumichChAmi martyAnAM sa.nsAravidhimuttamam
shlokas.2:
kena vRRittena rAjendra vartamAnA narA yudhi |
prApnuvantyuttamaM svargaM kathaM cha narakaM nRRipa
shlokas.3:
mRRitaM sharIramutsRRijya kAShThaloShTasamaM janAH |
prayAntyamuM lokamitaH ko vai tAnanugachChati
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
asAvAyAti bhagavAnbRRihaspatirudAradhIH |
pRRichChainaM sumahAbhAgametadguhyaM sanAtanam
shlokas.5:
naitadanyena shakyaM hi vaktuM kenachidadya vai |
vaktA bRRihaspatisamo na hyanyo vidyate kvachit
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tayoH sa.nvadatorevaM pArthagA~NgeyayostadA |
AjagAma vishuddhAtmA bhagavAnsa bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.7:
tato rAjA samutthAya dhRRitarAShTrapurogamaH |
pUjAmanupamAM chakre sarve te cha sabhAsadaH
shlokas.8:
tato dharmasuto rAjA bhagavantaM bRRihaspatim |
upagamya yathAnyAyaM prashnaM paprachCha suvrataH
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhagavansarvadharmaj~na sarvashAstravishArada |
martyasya kaH sahAyo vai pitA mAtA suto guruH
shlokas.10:
mRRitaM sharIramutsRRijya kAShThaloShTasamaM janAH |
gachChantyamutralokaM vai ka enamanugachChati
shlokas.11:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
ekaH prasUto rAjendra jantureko vinashyati |
ekastarati durgANi gachChatyekashcha durgatim
shlokas.12:
asahAyaH pitA mAtA tathA bhrAtA suto guruH |
j~nAtisambandhivargashcha mitravargastathaiva cha
shlokas.13:
mRRitaM sharIramutsRRijya kAShThaloShTasamaM janAH |
muhUrtamupatiShThanti tato yAnti parA~NmukhAH
taistachCharIramutsRRiShTaM dharma eko.anugachChati
shlokas.14:
tasmAddharmaH sahAyArthe sevitavyaH sadA nRRibhiH |
prANI dharmasamAyukto gachChate svargatiM parAm
tathaivAdharmasa.nyukto narakAyopapadyate
shlokas.15:
tasmAnnyAyAgatairarthairdharmaM seveta paNDitaH |
dharma eko manuShyANAM sahAyaH pAralaukikaH
shlokas.16:
lobhAnmohAdanukroshAdbhayAdvApyabahushrutaH |
naraH karotyakAryANi parArthe lobhamohitaH
shlokas.17:
dharmashchArthashcha kAmashcha tritayaM jIvite phalam |
etattrayamavAptavyamadharmaparivarjitam
shlokas.18:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrutaM bhagavato vAkyaM dharmayuktaM paraM hitam |
sharIravichayaM j~nAtuM buddhistu mama jAyate
shlokas.19:
mRRitaM sharIrarahitaM sUkShmamavyaktatAM gatam |
achakShurviShayaM prAptaM kathaM dharmo.anugachChati
shlokas.20:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
pRRithivI vAyurAkAshamApo jyotishcha pa~nchamam |
buddhirAtmA cha sahitA dharmaM pashyanti nityadA
shlokas.21:
prANinAmiha sarveShAM sAkShibhUtAni chAnisham |
etaishcha sa ha dharmo.api taM jIvamanugachChati
shlokas.22:
tvagasthimA.nsaM shukraM cha shoNitaM cha mahAmate |
sharIraM varjayantyete jIvitena vivarjitam
shlokas.23:
tato dharmasamAyuktaH sa jIvaH sukhamedhate |
iha loke pare chaiva kiM bhUyaH kathayAmi te
shlokas.24:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
anudarshitaM bhagavatA yathA dharmo.anugachChati |
etattu j~nAtumichChAmi kathaM retaH pravartate
shlokas.25:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
annamashnanti ye devAH sharIrasthA nareshvara |
pRRithivI vAyurAkAshamApo jyotirmanastathA
shlokas.26:
tatastRRipteShu rAjendra teShu bhUteShu pa~nchasu |
manaHShaShTheShu shuddhAtmanretaH sampadyate mahat
shlokas.27:
tato garbhaH sambhavati strIpu.nsoH pArtha sa~Ngame |
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi
shlokas.28:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AkhyAtametadbhavatA garbhaH sa~njAyate yathA |
yathA jAtastu puruShaH prapadyati taduchyatAm
shlokas.29:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
AsannamAtraH satataM tairbhUtairabhibhUyate |
vipramuktashcha tairbhUtaiH punaryAtyaparAM gatim
sa tu bhUtasamAyuktaH prApnute jIva eva ha
shlokas.30:
tato.asya karma pashyanti shubhaM vA yadi vAshubham |
devatAH pa~nchabhUtasthAH kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi
shlokas.31:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tvagasthimA.nsamutsRRijya taishcha bhUtairvivarjitaH |
jIvaH sa bhagavankvasthaH sukhaduHkhe samashnute
shlokas.32:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
jIvo dharmasamAyuktaH shIghraM retastvamAgataH |
strINAM puShpaM samAsAdya sUte kAlena bhArata
shlokas.33:
yamasya puruShaiH kleshaM yamasya puruShairvadham |
duHkhaM sa.nsArachakraM cha naraH kleshaM cha vindati
shlokas.34:
ihaloke cha sa prANI janmaprabhRRiti pArthiva |
svakRRitaM karma vai bhu~Nkte dharmasya phalamAshritaH
shlokas.35:
yadi dharmaM yathAshakti janmaprabhRRiti sevate |
tataH sa puruSho bhUtvA sevate nityadA sukham
shlokas.36:
athAntarA tu dharmasya adharmamupasevate |
sukhasyAnantaraM duHkhaM sa jIvo.apyadhigachChati
shlokas.37:
adharmeNa samAyukto yamasya viShayaM gataH |
mahadduHkhaM samAsAdya tiryagyonau prajAyate
shlokas.38:
karmaNA yena yeneha yasyAM yonau prajAyate |
jIvo mohasamAyuktastanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.39:
yadetaduchyate shAstre setihAse sachChandasi |
yamasya viShayaM ghoraM martyo lokaH prapadyate
shlokas.40:
adhItya chaturo vedAndvijo mohasamanvitaH |
patitAtpratigRRihyAtha kharayonau prajAyate
shlokas.41:
kharo jIvati varShANi dasha pa~ncha cha bhArata |
kharo mRRito balIvardaH sapta varShANi jIvati
shlokas.42:
balIvardo mRRitashchApi jAyate brahmarAkShasaH |
brahmarakShastu trInmAsA.nstato jAyati brAhmaNaH
shlokas.43:
patitaM yAjayitvA tu kRRimiyonau prajAyate |
tatra jIvati varShANi dasha pa~ncha cha bhArata
shlokas.44:
kRRimibhAvAtpramuktastu tato jAyati gardabhaH |
gardabhaH pa~ncha varShANi pa~ncha varShANi sUkaraH
shvA varShamekaM bhavati tato jAyati mAnavaH
shlokas.45:
