upAdhyAyasya yaH pApaM shiShyaH kuryAdabuddhimAn |
sa jIva iha sa.nsArA.nstrInApnoti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.46:
prAkShvA bhavati rAjendra tataH kravyAttataH kharaH |
tataH pretaH parikliShTaH pashchAjjAyati brAhmaNaH
shlokas.47:
manasApi gurorbhAryAM yaH shiShyo yAti pApakRRit |
so.adhamAnyAti sa.nsArAnadharmeNeha chetasA
shlokas.48:
shvayonau tu sa sambhUtastrINi varShANi jIvati |
tatrApi nidhanaM prAptaH kRRimiyonau prajAyate
shlokas.49:
kRRimibhAvamanuprApto varShamekaM sa jIvati |
tatastu nidhanaM prApya brahmayonau prajAyate
shlokas.50:
yadi putrasamaM shiShyaM gururhanyAdakAraNe |
AtmanaH kAmakAreNa so.api ha.nsaH prajAyate
shlokas.51:
pitaraM mAtaraM vApi yastu putro.avamanyate |
so.api rAjanmRRito jantuH pUrvaM jAyati gardabhaH
shlokas.52:
kharo jIvati mAsA.nstu dasha shvA cha chaturdasha |
biDAlaH sapta mAsA.nstu tato jAyati mAnavaH
shlokas.53:
mAtApitaramAkrushya sArikaH samprajAyate |
tADayitvA tu tAveva jAyate kachChapo nRRipa
shlokas.54:
kachChapo dasha varShANi trINi varShANi shalyakaH |
vyAlo bhUtvA tu ShaNmAsA.nstato jAyati mAnuShaH
shlokas.55:
bhartRRipiNDamupAshnanyo rAjadviShTAni sevate |
so.api mohasamApanno mRRito jAyati vAnaraH
shlokas.56:
vAnaro dasha varShANi trINi varShANi mUShakaH |
shvA bhUtvA chAtha ShaNmAsA.nstato jAyati mAnuShaH
shlokas.57:
nyAsApahartA tu naro yamasya viShayaM gataH |
sa.nsArANAM shataM gatvA kRRimiyonau prajAyate
shlokas.58:
tatra jIvati varShANi dasha pa~ncha cha bhArata |
duShkRRitasya kShayaM gatvA tato jAyati mAnuShaH
shlokas.59:
asUyako narashchApi mRRito jAyati shAr~NgakaH |
vishvAsahartA tu naro mIno jAyati durmatiH
shlokas.60:
bhUtvA mIno.aShTa varShANi mRRigo jAyati bhArata |
mRRigastu chaturo mAsA.nstatashChAgaH prajAyate
shlokas.61:
ChAgastu nidhanaM prApya pUrNe sa.nvatsare tataH |
kITaH sa~njAyate jantustato jAyati mAnuShaH
shlokas.62:
dhAnyAnyavA.nstilAnmAShAnkulatthAnsarShapA.nshchaNAn |
kalAyAnatha mudgA.nshcha godhUmAnatasIstathA
shlokas.63:
sasyasyAnyasya hartA cha mohAjjanturachetanaH |
sa jAyate mahArAja mUShako nirapatrapaH
shlokas.64:
tataH pretya mahArAja punarjAyati sUkaraH |
sUkaro jAtamAtrastu rogeNa mriyate nRRipa
shlokas.65:
shvA tato jAyate mUDhaH karmaNA tena pArthiva |
shvA bhUtvA pa~ncha varShANi tato jAyati mAnuShaH
shlokas.66:
paradArAbhimarshaM tu kRRitvA jAyati vai vRRikaH |
shvA sRRigAlastato gRRidhro vyAlaH ka~Nko bakastathA
shlokas.67:
bhrAturbhAryAM tu durbuddhiryo dharShayati mohitaH |
pu.nskokilatvamApnoti so.api sa.nvatsaraM nRRipa
shlokas.68:
sakhibhAryAM gurorbhAryAM rAjabhAryAM tathaiva cha |
pradharShayitvA kAmAdyo mRRito jAyati sUkaraH
shlokas.69:
sUkaraH pa~ncha varShANi pa~ncha varShANi shvAvidhaH |
pipIlakastu ShaNmAsAnkITaH syAnmAsameva cha
etAnAsAdya sa.nsArAnkRRimiyonau prajAyate
shlokas.70:
tatra jIvati mAsA.nstu kRRimiyonau trayodasha |
tato.adharmakShayaM kRRitvA punarjAyati mAnuShaH
shlokas.71:
upasthite vivAhe tu dAne yaj~ne.api vAbhibho |
mohAtkaroti yo vighnaM sa mRRito jAyate kRRimiH
shlokas.72:
kRRimirjIvati varShANi dasha pa~ncha cha bhArata |
adharmasya kShayaM kRRitvA tato jAyati mAnuShaH
shlokas.73:
pUrvaM dattvA tu yaH kanyAM dvitIye samprayachChati |
so.api rAjanmRRito jantuH kRRimiyonau prajAyate
shlokas.74:
tatra jIvati varShANi trayodasha yudhiShThira |
adharmasa~NkShaye yuktastato jAyati mAnuShaH
shlokas.75:
devakAryamupAkRRitya pitRRikAryamathApi cha |
anirvApya samashnanvai tato jAyati vAyasaH
shlokas.76:
vAyaso dasha varShANi tato jAyati kukkuTaH |
jAyate lavakashchApi mAsaM tasmAttu mAnuShaH
shlokas.77:
jyeShThaM pitRRisamaM chApi bhrAtaraM yo.avamanyate |
so.api mRRityumupAgamya krau~nchayonau prajAyate
shlokas.78:
krau~ncho jIvati mAsA.nstu dasha dvau sapta pa~ncha cha |
tato nidhanamApanno mAnuShatvamupAshnute
shlokas.79:
vRRiShalo brAhmaNIM gatvA kRRimiyonau prajAyate |
tatrApatyaM samutpAdya tato jAyati mUShakaH
shlokas.80:
kRRitaghnastu mRRito rAjanyamasya viShayaM gataH |
yamasya viShaye kruddhairvadhaM prApnoti dAruNam
shlokas.81:
paTTisaM mudgaraM shUlamagnikumbhaM cha dAruNam |
asipatravanaM ghoraM vAlukAM kUTashAlmalIm
shlokas.82:
etAshchAnyAshcha bahvIH sa yamasya viShayaM gataH |
yAtanAH prApya tatrogrAstato vadhyati bhArata
shlokas.83:
sa.nsArachakramAsAdya kRRimiyonau prajAyate |
kRRimirbhavati varShANi dasha pa~ncha cha bhArata
tato garbhaM samAsAdya tatraiva mriyate shishuH
shlokas.84:
tato garbhashatairjanturbahubhiH samprajAyate |
sa.nsArA.nshcha bahUngatvA tatastiryakprajAyate
shlokas.85:
mRRito duHkhamanuprApya bahuvarShagaNAniha |
apunarbhAvasa.nyuktastataH kUrmaH prajAyate
shlokas.86:
ashastraM puruShaM hatvA sashastraH puruShAdhamaH |
arthArthI yadi vA vairI sa mRRito jAyate kharaH
shlokas.87:
kharo jIvati varShe dve tataH shastreNa vadhyate |
sa mRRito mRRigayonau tu nityodvigno.abhijAyate
shlokas.88:
mRRigo vadhyati shastreNa gate sa.nvatsare tu saH |
hato mRRigastato mInaH so.api jAlena badhyate
shlokas.89:
mAse chaturthe samprApte shvApadaH samprajAyate |
shvApado dasha varShANi dvIpI varShANi pa~ncha cha
shlokas.90:
tatastu nidhanaM prAptaH kAlaparyAyachoditaH |
adharmasya kShayaM kRRitvA tato jAyati mAnuShaH
shlokas.91:
striyaM hatvA tu durbuddhiryamasya viShayaM gataH |
bahUnkleshAnsamAsAdya sa.nsArA.nshchaiva vi.nshatim
shlokas.92:
tataH pashchAnmahArAja kRRimiyonau prajAyate |
kRRimirvi.nshativarShANi bhUtvA jAyati mAnuShaH
shlokas.93:
bhojanaM chorayitvA tu makShikA jAyate naraH |
makShikAsa~Nghavashago bahUnmAsAnbhavatyuta
tataH pApakShayaM kRRitvA mAnuShatvamavApnute
shlokas.94:
vAdyaM hRRitvA tu puruSho mashakaH samprajAyate |
tathA piNyAkasaMmishramashanaM chorayennaraH
sa jAyate babhrusamo dAruNo mUShako naraH
shlokas.95:
lavaNaM chorayitvA tu chIrIvAkaH prajAyate |
dadhi hRRitvA bakashchApi plavo matsyAnasa.nskRRitAn
shlokas.96:
chorayitvA payashchApi balAkA samprajAyate |
yastu chorayate tailaM tailapAyI prajAyate
chorayitvA tu durbuddhirmadhu da.nshaH prajAyate
shlokas.97:
ayo hRRitvA tu durbuddhirvAyaso jAyate naraH |
pAyasaM chorayitvA tu tittiritvamavApnute
shlokas.98:
hRRitvA paiShTamapUpaM cha kumbholUkaH prajAyate |
phalaM vA mUlakaM hRRitvA apUpaM vA pipIlikaH
shlokas.99:
kA.nsyaM hRRitvA tu durbuddhirhArIto jAyate naraH |
rAjataM bhAjanaM hRRitvA kapotaH samprajAyate
shlokas.100:
hRRitvA tu kA~nchanaM bhANDaM kRRimiyonau prajAyate |
krau~nchaH kArpAsikaM hRRitvA mRRito jAyati mAnavaH
shlokas.101:
chorayitvA naraH paTTaM tvAvikaM vApi bhArata |
kShaumaM cha vastramAdAya shasho jantuH prajAyate
shlokas.102:
varNAnhRRitvA tu puruSho mRRito jAyati barhiNaH |
hRRitvA raktAni vastrANi jAyate jIvajIvakaH
shlokas.103:
varNakAdI.nstathA gandhA.nshchorayitvA tu mAnavaH |
ChuchChundaritvamApnoti rAja.NllobhaparAyaNaH
shlokas.104:
vishvAsena tu nikShiptaM yo nihnavati mAnavaH |
sa gatAsurnarastAdRRi~Nmatsyayonau prajAyate
shlokas.105:
matsyayonimanuprApya mRRito jAyati mAnuShaH |
mAnuShatvamanuprApya kShINAyurupapadyate
shlokas.106:
pApAni tu naraH kRRitvA tiryagjAyati bhArata |
na chAtmanaH pramANaM te dharmaM jAnanti ki~nchana
shlokas.107:
ye pApAni narAH kRRitvA nirasyanti vrataiH sadA |
sukhaduHkhasamAyuktA vyAdhitAste bhavantyuta
shlokas.108:
asa.nvAsAH prajAyante mlechChAshchApi na sa.nshayaH |
narAH pApasamAchArA lobhamohasamanvitAH
shlokas.109:
varjayanti cha pApAni janmaprabhRRiti ye narAH |
arogA rUpavantaste dhaninashcha bhavantyuta
shlokas.110:
striyo.apyetena kalpena kRRitvA pApamavApnuyuH |
eteShAmeva jantUnAM patnItvamupayAnti tAH
shlokas.111:
parasvaharaNe doShAH sarva eva prakIrtitAH |
etadvai leshamAtreNa kathitaM te mayAnagha
aparasminkathAyoge bhUyaH shroShyasi bhArata
shlokas.112:
etanmayA mahArAja brahmaNo vadataH purA |
surarShINAM shrutaM madhye pRRiShTashchApi yathAtatham
shlokas.113:
mayApi tava kArtsnyena yathAvadanuvarNitam |
etachChrutvA mahArAja dharme kuru manaH sadA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
adharmasya gatirbrahmankathitA me tvayAnagha |
dharmasya tu gatiM shrotumichChAmi vadatAM vara
kRRitvA karmANi pApAni kathaM yAnti shubhAM gatim
shlokas.2:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
kRRitvA pApAni karmANi adharmavashamAgataH |
manasA viparItena nirayaM pratipadyate
shlokas.3:
mohAdadharmaM yaH kRRitvA punaH samanutapyate |
manaHsamAdhisa.nyukto na sa seveta duShkRRitam
shlokas.4:
yathA yathA naraH samyagadharmamanubhAShate |
samAhitena manasA vimuchyati tathA tathA
bhuja~Nga iva nirmokAtpUrvabhuktAjjarAnvitAt
shlokas.5:
adattvApi pradAnAni vividhAni samAhitaH |
manaHsamAdhisa.nyuktaH sugatiM pratipadyate
shlokas.6:
pradAnAni tu vakShyAmi yAni dattvA yudhiShThira |
naraH kRRitvApyakAryANi tadA dharmeNa yujyate
shlokas.7:
sarveShAmeva dAnAnAmannaM shreShThamudAhRRitam |
pUrvamannaM pradAtavyamRRijunA dharmamichChatA
shlokas.8:
prANA hyannaM manuShyANAM tasmAjjantushcha jAyate |
anne pratiShThitA lokAstasmAdannaM prakAshate
shlokas.9:
annameva prasha.nsanti devarShipitRRimAnavAH |
annasya hi pradAnena svargamApnoti kaushikaH
shlokas.10:
nyAyalabdhaM pradAtavyaM dvijebhyo hyannamuttamam |
svAdhyAyasamupetebhyaH prahRRiShTenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.11:
yasya hyannamupAshnanti brAhmaNAnAM shatA dasha |
hRRiShTena manasA dattaM na sa tiryaggatirbhavet
shlokas.12:
brAhmaNAnAM sahasrANi dasha bhojya nararShabha |
naro.adharmAtpramuchyeta pApeShvabhirataH sadA
shlokas.13:
bhaikSheNAnnaM samAhRRitya vipro vedapuraskRRitaH |
svAdhyAyanirate vipre dattveha sukhamedhate
shlokas.14:
ahi.nsanbrAhmaNaM nityaM nyAyena paripAlya cha |
kShatriyastarasA prAptamannaM yo vai prayachChati
shlokas.15:
dvijebhyo vedavRRiddhebhyaH prayataH susamAhitaH |
tenApohati dharmAtmA duShkRRitaM karma pANDava
shlokas.16:
ShaDbhAgaparishuddhaM cha kRRiSherbhAgamupArjitam |
vaishyo dadaddvijAtibhyaH pApebhyaH parimuchyate
shlokas.17:
avApya prANasa.ndehaM kArkashyena samArjitam |
annaM dattvA dvijAtibhyaH shUdraH pApAtpramuchyate
shlokas.18:
aurasena balenAnnamarjayitvAvihi.nsakaH |
yaH prayachChati viprebhyo na sa durgANi sevate
shlokas.19:
nyAyenAvAptamannaM tu naro lobhavivarjitaH |
dvijebhyo vedavRRiddhebhyo dattvA pApAtpramuchyate
shlokas.20:
annamUrjaskaraM loke dattvorjasvI bhavennaraH |
satAM panthAnamAshritya sarvapApAtpramuchyate
shlokas.21:
dAnakRRidbhiH kRRitaH panthA yena yAnti manIShiNaH |
te sma prANasya dAtArastebhyo dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.22:
sarvAvasthaM manuShyeNa nyAyenAnnamupArjitam |
kAryaM pAtragataM nityamannaM hi paramA gatiH
shlokas.23:
annasya hi pradAnena naro durgaM na sevate |
tasmAdannaM pradAtavyamanyAyaparivarjitam
shlokas.24:
yatedbrAhmaNapUrvaM hi bhoktumannaM gRRihI sadA |
avandhyaM divasaM kuryAdannadAnena mAnavaH
shlokas.25:
bhojayitvA dashashataM naro vedavidAM nRRipa |
nyAyaviddharmaviduShAmitihAsavidAM tathA
shlokas.26:
na yAti narakaM ghoraM sa.nsArA.nshcha na sevate |
sarvakAmasamAyuktaH pretya chApyashnute phalam
shlokas.27:
evaM sukhasamAyukto ramate vigatajvaraH |
rUpavAnkIrtimA.nshchaiva dhanavA.nshchopapadyate
shlokas.28:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtamannadAnaphalaM mahat |
mUlametaddhi dharmANAM pradAnasya cha bhArata

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ahi.nsA vaidikaM karma dhyAnamindriyasa.nyamaH |
tapo.atha gurushushrUShA kiM shreyaH puruShaM prati
shlokas.2:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
sarvANyetAni dharmasya pRRithagdvArANi sarvashaH |
shRRiNu sa~NkIrtyamAnAni ShaDeva bharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
hanta niHshreyasaM jantorahaM vakShyAmyanuttamam |
ahi.nsApAshrayaM dharmaM yaH sAdhayati vai naraH
shlokas.4:
trIndoShAnsarvabhUteShu nidhAya puruShaH sadA |
kAmakrodhau cha sa.nyamya tataH siddhimavApnute
shlokas.5:
ahi.nsakAni bhUtAni daNDena vinihanti yaH |
AtmanaH sukhamanvichChanna sa pretya sukhI bhavet
shlokas.6:
Atmopamashcha bhUteShu yo vai bhavati pUruShaH |
nyastadaNDo jitakrodhaH sa pretya sukhamedhate
shlokas.7:
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtasya sarvabhUtAni pashyataH |
devApi mArge muhyanti apadasya padaiShiNaH
shlokas.8:
na tatparasya sa.ndadyAtpratikUlaM yadAtmanaH |
eSha sa~NkShepato dharmaH kAmAdanyaH pravartate
shlokas.9:
pratyAkhyAne cha dAne cha sukhaduHkhe priyApriye |
Atmaupamyena puruShaH samAdhimadhigachChati
shlokas.10:
yathA paraH prakramate.apareShu; tathAparaH prakramate parasmin |
eShaiva te.astUpamA jIvaloke; yathA dharmo naipuNenopadiShTaH
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA taM suragururdharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
divamAchakrame dhImAnpashyatAmeva nastadA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA sharatalpe pitAmaham |
punareva mahAtejAH paprachCha vadatAM varam
shlokas.2:
RRiShayo brAhmaNA devAH prasha.nsanti mahAmate |
ahi.nsAlakShaNaM dharmaM vedaprAmANyadarshanAt
shlokas.3:
karmaNA manujaH kurvanhi.nsAM pArthivasattama |
vAchA cha manasA chaiva kathaM duHkhAtpramuchyate
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
chaturvidheyaM nirdiShTA ahi.nsA brahmavAdibhiH |
eShaikato.api vibhraShTA na bhavatyarisUdana
shlokas.5:
yathA sarvashchatuShpAdastribhiH pAdairna tiShThati |
tathaiveyaM mahIpAla prochyate kAraNaistribhiH
shlokas.6:
yathA nAgapade.anyAni padAni padagAminAm |
sarvANyevApidhIyante padajAtAni kau~njare
evaM lokeShvahi.nsA tu nirdiShTA dharmataH parA
shlokas.8:
karmaNA lipyate janturvAchA cha manasaiva cha |
pUrvaM tu manasA tyaktvA tathA vAchAtha karmaNA |
trikAraNaM tu nirdiShTaM shrUyate brahmavAdibhiH
shlokas.9:
manovAchi tathAsvAde doShA hyeShu pratiShThitAH |
na bhakShayantyato mA.nsaM tapoyuktA manIShiNaH
shlokas.10:
doShA.nstu bhakShaNe rAjanmA.nsasyeha nibodha me |
putramA.nsopamaM jAnankhAdate yo vichetanaH
shlokas.11:
mAtApitRRisamAyoge putratvaM jAyate yathA |
rasaM cha prati jihvAyAH praj~nAnaM jAyate tathA
tathA shAstreShu niyataM rAgo hyAsvAditAdbhavet
shlokas.12:
asa.nskRRitAH sa.nskRRitAshcha lavaNAlavaNAstathA |
praj~nAyante yathA bhAvAstathA chittaM nirudhyate
shlokas.13:
bherIsha~NkhamRRida~NgAdyA.nstantrIshabdA.nshcha puShkalAn |
niSheviShyanti vai mandA mA.nsabhakShAH kathaM narAH
shlokas.14:
achintitamanuddiShTamasa~Nkalpitameva cha |
rasaM gRRiddhyAbhibhUtA vai prasha.nsanti phalArthinaH
prasha.nsA hyeva mA.nsasya doShakarmaphalAnvitA
shlokas.15:
jIvitaM hi parityajya bahavaH sAdhavo janAH |
svamA.nsaiH paramA.nsAni paripAlya divaM gatAH
shlokas.16:
evameShA mahArAja chaturbhiH kAraNairvRRitA |
ahi.nsA tava nirdiShTA sarvadharmArthasaMhitA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ahi.nsA paramo dharma ityuktaM bahushastvayA |
shrAddheShu cha bhavAnAha pitR^InAmiShakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.2:
mA.nsairbahuvidhaiH proktastvayA shrAddhavidhiH purA |
ahatvA cha kuto mA.nsamevametadvirudhyate
shlokas.3:
jAto naH sa.nshayo dharme mA.nsasya parivarjane |
doSho bhakShayataH kaH syAtkashchAbhakShayato guNaH
shlokas.4:
hatvA bhakShayato vApi pareNopahRRitasya vA |
hanyAdvA yaH parasyArthe krItvA vA bhakShayennaraH
shlokas.5:
etadichChAmi tattvena kathyamAnaM tvayAnagha |
nishchayena chikIrShAmi dharmametaM sanAtanam
shlokas.6:
kathamAyuravApnoti kathaM bhavati sattvavAn |
kathamavya~NgatAmeti lakShaNyo jAyate katham
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mA.nsasya bhakShaNe rAjanyo.adharmaH kurupu~Ngava |
taM me shRRiNu yathAtattvaM yashchAsya vidhiruttamaH
shlokas.8:
rUpamavya~NgatAmAyurbuddhiM sattvaM balaM smRRitim |
prAptukAmairnarairhi.nsA varjitA vai kRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.9:
RRiShINAmatra sa.nvAdo bahushaH kurupu~Ngava |
babhUva teShAM tu mataM yattachChRRiNu yudhiShThira
shlokas.10:
yo yajetAshvamedhena mAsi mAsi yatavrataH |
varjayenmadhu mA.nsaM cha samametadyudhiShThira
shlokas.11:
saptarShayo vAlakhilyAstathaiva cha marIchipAH |
amA.nsabhakShaNaM rAjanprasha.nsanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.12:
na bhakShayati yo mA.nsaM na hanyAnna cha ghAtayet |
taM mitraM sarvabhUtAnAM manuH svAyambhuvo.abravIt
shlokas.13:
adhRRiShyaH sarvabhUtAnAM vishvAsyaH sarvajantuShu |
sAdhUnAM saMmato nityaM bhavenmA.nsasya varjanAt
shlokas.14:
svamA.nsaM paramA.nsena yo vardhayitumichChati |
nAradaH prAha dharmAtmA niyataM so.avasIdati
shlokas.15:
dadAti yajate chApi tapasvI cha bhavatyapi |
madhumA.nsanivRRittyeti prAhaivaM sa bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.16:
mAsi mAsyashvamedhena yo yajeta shataM samAH |
na khAdati cha yo mA.nsaM samametanmataM mama
shlokas.17:
sadA yajati satreNa sadA dAnaM prayachChati |
sadA tapasvI bhavati madhumA.nsasya varjanAt
shlokas.18:
sarve vedA na tatkuryuH sarvayaj~nAshcha bhArata |
yo bhakShayitvA mA.nsAni pashchAdapi nivartate
shlokas.19:
duShkaraM hi rasaj~nena mA.nsasya parivarjanam |
chartuM vratamidaM shreShThaM sarvaprANyabhayapradam
shlokas.20:
sarvabhUteShu yo vidvAndadAtyabhayadakShiNAm |
dAtA bhavati loke sa prANAnAM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.21:
evaM vai paramaM dharmaM prasha.nsanti manIShiNaH |
prANA yathAtmano.abhIShTA bhUtAnAmapi te tathA
shlokas.22:
Atmaupamyena gantavyaM buddhimadbhirmahAtmabhiH |
mRRityuto bhayamastIti viduShAM bhUtimichChatAm
shlokas.23:
kiM punarhanyamAnAnAM tarasA jIvitArthinAm |
arogANAmapApAnAM pApairmA.nsopajIvibhiH
shlokas.24:
tasmAdviddhi mahArAja mA.nsasya parivarjanam |
dharmasyAyatanaM shreShThaM svargasya cha sukhasya cha
shlokas.25:
ahi.nsA paramo dharmastathAhi.nsA paraM tapaH |
ahi.nsA paramaM satyaM tato dharmaH pravartate
shlokas.26:
na hi mA.nsaM tRRiNAtkAShThAdupalAdvApi jAyate |
hatvA jantuM tato mA.nsaM tasmAddoSho.asya bhakShaNe
shlokas.27:
svAhAsvadhAmRRitabhujo devAH satyArjavapriyAH |
kravyAdAnrAkShasAnviddhi jihmAnRRitaparAyaNAn
shlokas.28:
kAntAreShvatha ghoreShu durgeShu gahaneShu cha |
rAtrAvahani sandhyAsu chatvareShu sabhAsu cha
amA.nsabhakShaNe rAjanbhayamante na gachChati
shlokas.29:
yadi chetkhAdako na syAnna tadA ghAtako bhavet |
ghAtakaH khAdakArthAya taM ghAtayati vai naraH
shlokas.30:
abhakShyametaditi vA iti hi.nsA nivartate |
khAdakArthamato hi.nsA mRRigAdInAM pravartate
shlokas.31:
yasmAdgrasati chaivAyurhi.nsakAnAM mahAdyute |
tasmAdvivarjayenmA.nsaM ya ichChedbhUtimAtmanaH
shlokas.32:
trAtAraM nAdhigachChanti raudrAH prANivihi.nsakAH |
udvejanIyA bhUtAnAM yathA vyAlamRRigAstathA
shlokas.33:
lobhAdvA buddhimohAdvA balavIryArthameva cha |
sa.nsargAdvAtha pApAnAmadharmaruchitA nRRiNAm
shlokas.34:
svamA.nsaM paramA.nsena yo vardhayitumichChati |
udvignavAse vasati yatratatrAbhijAyate
shlokas.35:
dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM svargyaM svastyayanaM mahat |
mA.nsasyAbhakShaNaM prAhurniyatAH paramarShayaH
shlokas.36:
idaM tu khalu kaunteya shrutamAsItpurA mayA |
mArkaNDeyasya vadato ye doShA mA.nsabhakShaNe
shlokas.37:
yo hi khAdati mA.nsAni prANinAM jIvitArthinAm |
hatAnAM vA mRRitAnAM vA yathA hantA tathaiva saH
shlokas.38:
dhanena krAyako hanti khAdakashchopabhogataH |
ghAtako vadhabandhAbhyAmityeSha trividho vadhaH
shlokas.39:
akhAdannanumoda.nshcha bhAvadoSheNa mAnavaH |
yo.anumanyeta hantavyaM so.api doSheNa lipyate
shlokas.40:
adhRRiShyaH sarvabhUtAnAmAyuShmAnnIrujaH sukhI |
bhavatyabhakShayanmA.nsaM dayAvAnprANinAmiha
shlokas.41:
hiraNyadAnairgodAnairbhUmidAnaishcha sarvashaH |
mA.nsasyAbhakShaNe dharmo vishiShTaH syAditi shrutiH
shlokas.42:
aprokShitaM vRRithAmA.nsaM vidhihInaM na bhakShayet |
bhakShayannirayaM yAti naro nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.43:
prokShitAbhyukShitaM mA.nsaM tathA brAhmaNakAmyayA |
alpadoShamiha j~neyaM viparIte tu lipyate
shlokas.44:
khAdakasya kRRite jantuM yo hanyAtpuruShAdhamaH |
mahAdoShakarastatra khAdako na tu ghAtakaH
shlokas.45:
ijyAyaj~nashrutikRRitairyo mArgairabudho janaH |
hanyAjjantuM mA.nsagRRiddhrI sa vai narakabhA~NnaraH
shlokas.46:
bhakShayitvA tu yo mA.nsaM pashchAdapi nivartate |
tasyApi sumahAndharmo yaH pApAdvinivartate
shlokas.47:
AhartA chAnumantA cha vishastA krayavikrayI |
sa.nskartA chopabhoktA cha ghAtakAH sarva eva te
shlokas.48:
idamanyattu vakShyAmi pramANaM vidhinirmitam |
purANamRRiShibhirjuShTaM vedeShu parinishchitam
shlokas.49:
pravRRittilakShaNe dharme phalArthibhirabhidrute |
yathoktaM rAjashArdUla na tu tanmokShakA~NkShiNAm
shlokas.50:
haviryatsa.nskRRitaM mantraiH prokShitAbhyukShitaM shuchi |
vedoktena pramANena pitR^INAM prakriyAsu cha
ato.anyathA vRRithAmA.nsamabhakShyaM manurabravIt
shlokas.51:
asvargyamayashasyaM cha rakShovadbharatarShabha |
vidhinA hi narAH pUrvaM mA.nsaM rAjannabhakShayan
shlokas.52:
ya ichChetpuruSho.atyantamAtmAnaM nirupadravam |
sa varjayeta mA.nsAni prANinAmiha sarvashaH
shlokas.53:
shrUyate hi purAkalpe nRRiNAM vrIhimayaH pashuH |
yenAyajanta yajvAnaH puNyalokaparAyaNAH
shlokas.54:
RRiShibhiH sa.nshayaM pRRiShTo vasushchedipatiH purA |
abhakShyamiti mA.nsaM sa prAha bhakShyamiti prabho
shlokas.55:
AkAshAnmedinIM prAptastataH sa pRRithivIpatiH |
etadeva punashchoktvA vivesha dharaNItalam
shlokas.56:
prajAnAM hitakAmena tvagastyena mahAtmanA |
AraNyAH sarvadaivatyAH prokShitAstapasA mRRigAH
shlokas.57:
kriyA hyevaM na hIyante pitRRidaivatasa.nshritAH |
prIyante pitarashchaiva nyAyato mA.nsatarpitAH
shlokas.58:
idaM tu shRRiNu rAjendra kIrtyamAnaM mayAnagha |
abhakShaNe sarvasukhaM mA.nsasya manujAdhipa
shlokas.59:
yastu varShashataM pUrNaM tapastapyetsudAruNam |
yashchaikaM varjayenmA.nsaM samametanmataM mama
shlokas.60:
kaumude tu visheSheNa shuklapakShe narAdhipa |
varjayetsarvamA.nsAni dharmo hyatra vidhIyate
shlokas.61:
chaturo vArShikAnmAsAnyo mA.nsaM parivarjayet |
chatvAri bhadrANyApnoti kIrtimAyuryasho balam
shlokas.62:
atha vA mAsamapyekaM sarvamA.nsAnyabhakShayan |
atItya sarvaduHkhAni sukhI jIvennirAmayaH
shlokas.63:
ye varjayanti mA.nsAni mAsashaH pakShasho.api vA |
teShAM hi.nsAnivRRittAnAM brahmaloko vidhIyate
shlokas.64:
mA.nsaM tu kaumudaM pakShaM varjitaM pArtha rAjabhiH |
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtaistairvij~nAtArthaparAvaraiH
shlokas.65:
nAbhAgenAmbarISheNa gayena cha mahAtmanA |
AyuShA chAnaraNyena dilIparaghupUrubhiH
shlokas.66:
kArtavIryAniruddhAbhyAM nahuSheNa yayAtinA |
nRRigeNa viShvagashvena tathaiva shashabindunA
yuvanAshvena cha tathA shibinaushInareNa cha
shlokas.67:
shyenachitreNa rAjendra somakena vRRikeNa cha |
raivatena rantidevena vasunA sRRi~njayena cha
shlokas.68:
duHShantena karUSheNa rAmAlarkanalaistathA |
virUpAshvena niminA janakena cha dhImatA
shlokas.69:
silena pRRithunA chaiva vIrasenena chaiva ha |
ikShvAkuNA shambhunA cha shvetena sagareNa cha
shlokas.70:
etaishchAnyaishcha rAjendra purA mA.nsaM na bhakShitam |
shAradaM kaumudaM mAsaM tataste svargamApnuvan
shlokas.71:
brahmaloke cha tiShThanti jvalamAnAH shriyAnvitAH |
upAsyamAnA gandharvaiH strIsahasrasamanvitAH
shlokas.72:
tadetaduttamaM dharmamahi.nsAlakShaNaM shubham |
ye charanti mahAtmAno nAkapRRiShThe vasanti te
shlokas.73:
madhu mA.nsaM cha ye nityaM varjayantIha dhArmikAH |
janmaprabhRRiti madyaM cha sarve te munayaH smRRitAH
vishiShTatAM j~nAtiShu cha labhante nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.74:
ApannashchApado muchyedbaddho muchyeta bandhanAt |
muchyettathAturo rogAdduHkhAnmuchyeta duHkhitaH
shlokas.75:
tiryagyoniM na gachCheta rUpavA.nshcha bhavennaraH |
buddhimAnvai kurushreShTha prApnuyAchcha mahadyashaH
shlokas.76:
etatte kathitaM rAjanmA.nsasya parivarjane |
pravRRittau cha nivRRittau cha vidhAnamRRiShinirmitam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ime vai mAnavA loke bhRRishaM mA.nsasya gRRiddhinaH |
visRRijya bhakShAnvividhAnyathA rakShogaNAstathA
shlokas.2:
nApUpAnvividhAkArA~nshAkAni vividhAni cha |
ShADavAnrasayogA.nshcha tathechChanti yathAmiSham
shlokas.3:
tatra me buddhiratraiva visarge parimuhyate |
na manye rasataH ki~nchinmA.nsato.astIha ki~nchana
shlokas.4:
tadichChAmi guNA~nshrotuM mA.nsasyAbhakShaNe.api vA |
bhakShaNe chaiva ye doShAstA.nshchaiva puruSharShabha
shlokas.5:
sarvaM tattvena dharmaj~na yathAvadiha dharmataH |
kiM vA bhakShyamabhakShyaM vA sarvametadvadasva me
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi bhArata |
na mA.nsAtparamatrAnyadrasato vidyate bhuvi
shlokas.7:
kShatakShINAbhitaptAnAM grAmyadharmaratAshcha ye |
adhvanA karshitAnAM cha na mA.nsAdvidyate param
shlokas.8:
sadyo vardhayati prANAnpuShTimagryAM dadAti cha |
na bhakSho.abhyadhikaH kashchinmA.nsAdasti parantapa
shlokas.9:
vivarjane tu bahavo guNAH kauravanandana |
ye bhavanti manuShyANAM tAnme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.10:
svamA.nsaM paramA.nsairyo vivardhayitumichChati |
nAsti kShudratarastasmAnna nRRisha.nsataro naraH
shlokas.11:
na hi prANAtpriyataraM loke ki~nchana vidyate |
tasmAddayAM naraH kuryAdyathAtmani tathA pare
shlokas.12:
shukrAchcha tAta sambhUtirmA.nsasyeha na sa.nshayaH |
bhakShaNe tu mahAndoSho vadhena saha kalpate
shlokas.13:
ahi.nsAlakShaNo dharma iti vedavido viduH |
yadahi.nsraM bhavetkarma tatkuryAdAtmavAnnaraH
shlokas.14:
pitRRidaivatayaj~neShu prokShitaM haviruchyate |
vidhinA vedadRRiShTena tadbhuktveha na duShyati
shlokas.15:
yaj~nArthe pashavaH sRRiShTA ityapi shrUyate shrutiH |
ato.anyathA pravRRittAnAM rAkShaso vidhiruchyate
shlokas.16:
kShatriyANAM tu yo dRRiShTo vidhistamapi me shRRiNu |
vIryeNopArjitaM mA.nsaM yathA khAdanna duShyati
shlokas.17:
AraNyAH sarvadaivatyAH prokShitAH sarvasho mRRigAH |
agastyena purA rAjanmRRigayA yena pUjyate
shlokas.18:
nAtmAnamaparityajya mRRigayA nAma vidyate |
samatAmupasa~Ngamya rUpaM hanyAnna vA nRRipa
shlokas.19:
ato rAjarShayaH sarve mRRigayAM yAnti bhArata |
lipyante na hi doSheNa na chaitatpAtakaM viduH
shlokas.20:
na hi tatparamaM ki~nchidiha loke paratra cha |
yatsarveShviha lokeShu dayA kauravanandana
shlokas.21:
na bhayaM vidyate jAtu narasyeha dayAvataH |
dayAvatAmime lokAH pare chApi tapasvinAm
shlokas.22:
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyo yo dadAti dayAparaH |
abhayaM tasya bhUtAni dadatItyanushushrumaH
shlokas.23:
kShataM cha skhalitaM chaiva patitaM kliShTamAhatam |
sarvabhUtAni rakShanti sameShu viShameShu cha
shlokas.24:
nainaM vyAlamRRigA ghnanti na pishAchA na rAkShasAH |
muchyante bhayakAleShu mokShayanti cha ye parAn
shlokas.25:
prANadAnAtparaM dAnaM na bhUtaM na bhaviShyati |
na hyAtmanaH priyataraH kashchidastIti nishchitam
shlokas.26:
aniShTaM sarvabhUtAnAM maraNaM nAma bhArata |
mRRityukAle hi bhUtAnAM sadyo jAyati vepathuH
shlokas.27:
jAtijanmajarAduHkhe nityaM sa.nsArasAgare |
jantavaH parivartante maraNAdudvijanti cha
shlokas.28:
garbhavAseShu pachyante kShArAmlakaTukai rasaiH |
mUtrashleShmapurIShANAM sparshaishcha bhRRishadAruNaiH
shlokas.29:
jAtAshchApyavashAstatra bhidyamAnAH punaH punaH |
pATyamAnAshcha dRRishyante vivashA mA.nsagRRiddhinaH
shlokas.30:
kumbhIpAke cha pachyante tAM tAM yonimupAgatAH |
Akramya mAryamANAshcha bhrAmyante vai punaH punaH
shlokas.31:
nAtmano.asti priyataraH pRRithivyAmanusRRitya ha |
tasmAtprANiShu sarveShu dayAvAnAtmavAnbhavet
shlokas.32:
sarvamA.nsAni yo rAjanyAvajjIvaM na bhakShayet |
svarge sa vipulaM sthAnaM prApnuyAnnAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.33:
ye bhakShayanti mA.nsAni bhUtAnAM jIvitaiShiNAm |
bhakShyante te.api tairbhUtairiti me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.34:
mAM sa bhakShayate yasmAdbhakShayiShye tamapyaham |
etanmA.nsasya mA.nsatvamato budhyasva bhArata
shlokas.35:
ghAtako vadhyate nityaM tathA vadhyeta bandhakaH |
AkroShTAkrushyate rAjandveShTA dveShyatvamApnute
shlokas.36:
yena yena sharIreNa yadyatkarma karoti yaH |
tena tena sharIreNa tattatphalamupAshnute
shlokas.37:
ahi.nsA paramo dharmastathAhi.nsA paro damaH |
ahi.nsA paramaM dAnamahi.nsA paramaM tapaH
shlokas.38:
ahi.nsA paramo yaj~nastathAhi.nsA paraM balam |
ahi.nsA paramaM mitramahi.nsA paramaM sukham
ahi.nsA paramaM satyamahi.nsA paramaM shrutam
shlokas.39:
sarvayaj~neShu vA dAnaM sarvatIrtheShu chAplutam |
sarvadAnaphalaM vApi naitattulyamahi.nsayA
shlokas.40:
ahi.nsrasya tapo.akShayyamahi.nsro yajate sadA |
ahi.nsraH sarvabhUtAnAM yathA mAtA yathA pitA
shlokas.41:
etatphalamahi.nsAyA bhUyashcha kurupu~Ngava |
na hi shakyA guNA vaktumiha varShashatairapi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
akAmAshcha sakAmAshcha hatA ye.asminmahAhave |
kAM yoniM pratipannAste tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
duHkhaM prANaparityAgaH puruShANAM mahAmRRidhe |
jAnAmi tattvaM dharmaj~na prANatyAgaM suduShkaram
shlokas.3:
samRRiddhe vAsamRRiddhe vA shubhe vA yadi vAshubhe |
kAraNaM tatra me brUhi sarvaj~no hyasi me mataH
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
samRRiddhe vAsamRRiddhe vA shubhe vA yadi vAshubhe |
sa.nsAre.asminsamAjAtAH prANinaH pRRithivIpate
shlokas.5:
niratA yena bhAvena tatra me shRRiNu kAraNam |
samyakchAyamanuprashnastvayoktashcha yudhiShThira
shlokas.6:
atra te vartayiShyAmi purAvRRittamidaM nRRipa |
dvaipAyanasya sa.nvAdaM kITasya cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.7:
brahmabhUtashcharanvipraH kRRiShNadvaipAyanaH purA |
dadarsha kITaM dhAvantaM shIghraM shakaTavartmani
shlokas.8:
gatij~naH sarvabhUtAnAM rutaj~nashcha sharIriNAm |
sarvaj~naH sarvato dRRiShTvA kITaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.9:
kITa santrastarUpo.asi tvaritashchaiva lakShyase |
kva dhAvasi tadAchakShva kutaste bhayamAgatam
shlokas.10:
kITa uvAcha||
shakaTasyAsya mahato ghoShaM shrutvA bhayaM mama |
AgataM vai mahAbuddhe svana eSha hi dAruNaH
shrUyate na sa mAM hanyAditi tasmAdapAkrame
shlokas.11:
shvasatAM cha shRRiNomyevaM goputrANAM prachodyatAm |
vahatAM sumahAbhAraM saMnikarShe svanaM prabho
nRRiNAM cha sa.nvAhayatAM shrUyate vividhaH svanaH
shlokas.12:
soDhumasmadvidhenaiSha na shakyaH kITayoninA |
tasmAdapakramAmyeSha bhayAdasmAtsudAruNAt
shlokas.13:
duHkhaM hi mRRityurbhUtAnAM jIvitaM cha sudurlabham |
ato bhItaH palAyAmi gachCheyaM nAsukhaM sukhAt
shlokas.14:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tu taM prAha kutaH kITa sukhaM tava |
maraNaM te sukhaM manye tiryagyonau hi vartase
shlokas.15:
shabdaM sparshaM rasaM gandhaM bhogA.nshchochchAvachAnbahUn |
nAbhijAnAsi kITa tvaM shreyo maraNameva te
shlokas.16:
kITa uvAcha||
sarvatra nirato jIva itIhApi sukhaM mama |
chetayAmi mahAprAj~na tasmAdichChAmi jIvitum
shlokas.17:
ihApi viShayaH sarvo yathAdehaM pravartitaH |
mAnuShAstiryagAshchaiva pRRithagbhogA visheShataH
shlokas.18:
ahamAsaM manuShyo vai shUdro bahudhanaH purA |
abrahmaNyo nRRisha.nsashcha kadaryo vRRiddhijIvanaH
shlokas.19:
vAktIkShNo nikRRitipraj~no moShTA vishvasya sarvashaH |
mithaHkRRito.apanidhanaH parasvaharaNe rataH
shlokas.20:
bhRRityAtithijanashchApi gRRihe paryuShito mayA |
mAtsaryAtsvAdukAmena nRRisha.nsena bubhUShatA
shlokas.21:
devArthaM pitRRiyaj~nArthamannaM shraddhAkRRitaM mayA |
na dattamarthakAmena deyamannaM punAti ha
shlokas.22:
guptaM sharaNamAshritya bhayeShu sharaNAgatAH |
akasmAnno bhayAttyaktA na cha trAtAbhayaiShiNaH
shlokas.23:
dhanaM dhAnyaM priyAndArAnyAnaM vAsastathAdbhutam |
shriyaM dRRiShTvA manuShyANAmasUyAmi nirarthakam
shlokas.24:
IrShyuH parasukhaM dRRiShTvA AtatAyyabubhUShakaH |
trivargahantA chAnyeShAmAtmakAmAnuvartakaH
shlokas.25:
nRRisha.nsaguNabhUyiShThaM purA karma kRRitaM mayA |
smRRitvA tadanutapye.ahaM tyaktvA priyamivAtmajam
shlokas.26:
shubhAnAmapi jAnAmi kRRitAnAM karmaNAM phalam |
mAtA cha pUjitA vRRiddhA brAhmaNashchArchito mayA
shlokas.27:
sakRRijjAtiguNopetaH sa~NgatyA gRRihamAgataH |
atithiH pUjito brahma.nstena mAM nAjahAtsmRRitiH
shlokas.28:
karmaNA tena chaivAhaM sukhAshAmiha lakShaye |
tachChrotumahamichChAmi tvattaH shreyastapodhana

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
shubhena karmaNA yadvai tiryagyonau na muhyase |
mamaiva kITa tatkarma yena tvaM na pramuhyase
shlokas.2:
ahaM hi darshanAdeva tArayAmi tapobalAt |
tapobalAddhi balavadbalamanyanna vidyate
shlokas.3:
jAnAmi pApaiH svakRRitairgataM tvAM kITa kITatAm |
avApsyasi paraM dharmaM dharmastho yadi manyase
shlokas.4:
karma bhUmikRRitaM devA bhu~njate tiryagAshcha ye |
dharmAdapi manuShyeShu kAmo.arthashcha yathA guNaiH
shlokas.5:
vAgbuddhipANipAdaishchApyupetasya vipashchitaH |
kiM hIyate manuShyasya mandasyApi hi jIvataH
shlokas.6:
jIvanhi kurute pUjAM viprAgryaH shashisUryayoH |
bruvannapi kathAM puNyAM tatra kITa tvameShyasi
shlokas.7:
guNabhUtAni bhUtAni tatra tvamupabhokShyase |
tatra te.ahaM vineShyAmi brahmatvaM yatra chechChasi
shlokas.8:
sa tatheti pratishrutya kITo vartmanyatiShThata |
tamRRiShiM draShTumagamatsarvAsvanyAsu yoniShu
shlokas.9:
shvAvidgodhAvarAhANAM tathaiva mRRigapakShiNAm |
shvapAkavaishyashUdrANAM kShatriyANAM cha yoniShu
shlokas.10:
sa kITetyevamAbhAShya RRiShiNA satyavAdinA |
pratismRRityAtha jagrAha pAdau mUrdhnA kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.11:
kITa uvAcha||
idaM tadatulaM sthAnamIpsitaM dashabhirguNaiH |
yadahaM prApya kITatvamAgato rAjaputratAm
shlokas.12:
vahanti mAmatibalAH ku~njarA hemamAlinaH |
syandaneShu cha kAmbojA yuktAH paramavAjinaH
shlokas.13:
uShTrAshvatarayuktAni yAnAni cha vahanti mAm |
sabAndhavaH sahAmAtyashchAshnAmi pishitaudanam
shlokas.14:
gRRiheShu sunivAseShu sukheShu shayaneShu cha |
parArdhyeShu mahAbhAga svapAmIha supUjitaH
shlokas.15:
sarveShvapararAtreShu sUtamAgadhabandinaH |
stuvanti mAM yathA devaM mahendraM priyavAdinaH
shlokas.16:
prasAdAtsatyasandhasya bhavato.amitatejasaH |
yadahaM kITatAM prApya samprApto rAjaputratAm
shlokas.17:
namaste.astu mahAprAj~na kiM karomi prashAdhi mAm |
tvattapobalanirdiShTamidaM hyadhigataM mayA
shlokas.18:
vyAsa uvAcha||
archito.ahaM tvayA rAjanvAgbhiradya yadRRichChayA |
adya te kITatAM prApya smRRitirjAtAjugupsitA
shlokas.19:
na tu nAsho.asti pApasya yattvayopachitaM purA |
shUdreNArthapradhAnena nRRisha.nsenAtatAyinA
shlokas.20:
mama te darshanaM prAptaM tachchaiva sukRRitaM purA |
tiryagyonau sma jAtena mama chApyarchanAttathA
shlokas.21:
itastvaM rAjaputratvAdbrAhmaNyaM samavApsyasi |
gobrAhmaNakRRite prANAnhutvAtmIyAnraNAjire
shlokas.22:
rAjaputrasukhaM prApya RRitU.nshchaivAptadakShiNAn |
atha modiShyase svarge brahmabhUto.avyayaH sukhI
shlokas.23:
tiryagyonyAH shUdratAmabhyupaiti; shUdro vaishyatvaM kShatriyatvaM cha vaishyaH |
vRRittashlAghI kShatriyo brAhmaNatvaM; svargaM puNyaM brAhmaNaH sAdhuvRRittaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kShatradharmamanuprAptaH smaranneva sa vIryavAn |
tyaktvA sa kITatAM rAja.nshchachAra vipulaM tapaH
shlokas.2:
tasya dharmArthaviduSho dRRiShTvA tadvipulaM tapaH |
AjagAma dvijashreShThaH kRRiShNadvaipAyanastadA
shlokas.3:
vyAsa uvAcha||
kShAtraM chaiva vrataM kITa bhUtAnAM paripAlanam |
kShAtraM chaiva vrataM dhyAya.nstato vipratvameShyasi
shlokas.4:
pAhi sarvAH prajAH samyakShubhAshubhavidAtmavAn |
shubhaiH sa.nvibhajankAmairashubhAnAM cha pAvanaiH
shlokas.5:
AtmavAnbhava suprItaH svadharmacharaNe rataH |
kShAtrIM tanuM samutsRRijya tato vipratvameShyasi
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
so.athAraNyamabhipretya punareva yudhiShThira |
maharShervachanaM shrutvA prajA dharmeNa pAlya cha
shlokas.7:
achireNaiva kAlena kITaH pArthivasattama |
prajApAlanadharmeNa pretya vipratvamAgataH
shlokas.8:
tatastaM brAhmaNaM dRRiShTvA punareva mahAyashAH |
AjagAma mahAprAj~naH kRRiShNadvaipAyanastadA
shlokas.9:
vyAsa uvAcha||
bho bho viprarShabha shrImanmA vyathiShThAH katha~nchana |
shubhakRRichChubhayonIShu pApakRRitpApayoniShu
upapadyati dharmaj~na yathAdharmaM yathAgamam
shlokas.10:
tasmAnmRRityubhayAtkITa mA vyathiShThAH katha~nchana |
dharmalopAdbhayaM te syAttasmAddharmaM charottamam
shlokas.11:
kITa uvAcha||
sukhAtsukhataraM prApto bhagava.nstvatkRRite hyaham |
dharmamUlAM shriyaM prApya pApmA naShTa ihAdya me
shlokas.12:
bhIShma uvAcha||
bhagavadvachanAtkITo brAhmaNyaM prApya durlabham |
akarotpRRithivIM rAjanyaj~nayUpashatA~NkitAm
tataH sAlokyamagamadbrahmaNo brahmavittamaH
shlokas.13:
avApa cha paraM kITaH pArtha brahma sanAtanam |
svakarmaphalanirvRRittaM vyAsasya vachanAttadA
shlokas.14:
te.api yasmAtsvabhAvena hatAH kShatriyapu~NgavAH |
samprAptAste gatiM puNyAM tasmAnmA shocha putraka

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vidyA tapashcha dAnaM cha kimeteShAM vishiShyate |
pRRichChAmi tvA satAM shreShTha tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
maitreyasya cha sa.nvAdaM kRRiShNadvaipAyanasya cha
shlokas.3:
kRRiShNadvaipAyano rAjannaj~nAtacharitaM charan |
vArANasyAmupAtiShThanmaitreyaM svairiNIkule
shlokas.4:
tamupasthitamAsInaM j~nAtvA sa munisattamam |
architvA bhojayAmAsa maitreyo.ashanamuttamam
shlokas.5:
tadannamuttamaM bhuktvA guNavatsArvakAmikam |
pratiShThamAno.asmayata prItaH kRRiShNo mahAmanAH
shlokas.6:
tamutsmayantaM samprekShya maitreyaH kRRiShNamabravIt |
kAraNaM brUhi dharmAtmanyo.asmayiShThAH kutashcha te
tapasvino dhRRitimataH pramodaH samupAgataH
shlokas.7:
etatpRRichChAmi te vidvannabhivAdya praNamya cha |
Atmanashcha tapobhAgyaM mahAbhAgyaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.8:
pRRithagAcharatastAta pRRithagAtmani chAtmanoH |
alpAntaramahaM manye vishiShTamapi vA tvayA
shlokas.9:
vyAsa uvAcha||
atichChedAtivAdAbhyAM smayo.ayaM samupAgataH |
asatyaM vedavachanaM kasmAdvedo.anRRitaM vadet
shlokas.10:
trINyeva tu padAnyAhuH puruShasyottamaM vratam |
na druhyechchaiva dadyAchcha satyaM chaiva paraM vadet
idAnIM chaiva naH kRRityaM purastAchcha paraM smRRitam
shlokas.11:
alpo.api tAdRRisho dAyo bhavatyuta mahAphalaH |
tRRiShitAya cha yaddattaM hRRidayenAnasUyatA
shlokas.12:
tRRiShitastRRiShitAya tvaM dattvaitadashanaM mama |
ajaiShIrmahato lokAnmahAyaj~nairivAbhibho
ato dAnapavitreNa prIto.asmi tapasaiva cha
shlokas.13:
puNyasyaiva hi te gandhaH puNyasyaiva cha darshanam |
puNyashcha vAti gandhaste manye karmavidhAnataH
shlokas.14:
adhikaM mArjanAttAta tathaivApyanulepanAt |
shubhaM sarvapavitrebhyo dAnameva paraM bhavet
shlokas.15:
yAnImAnyuttamAnIha vedoktAni prasha.nsasi |
teShAM shreShThatamaM dAnamiti me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.16:
dAnakRRidbhiH kRRitaH panthA yena yAnti manIShiNaH |
te hi prANasya dAtArasteShu dharmaH pratiShThitaH
shlokas.17:
yathA vedAH svadhItAshcha yathA chendriyasa.nyamaH |
sarvatyAgo yathA cheha tathA dAnamanuttamam
shlokas.18:
tvaM hi tAta sukhAdeva sukhameShyasi shobhanam |
sukhAtsukhataraprAptimApnute matimAnnaraH
shlokas.19:
tannaH pratyakShamevedamupalabdhamasa.nshayam |
shrImantamApnuvantyarthA dAnaM yaj~nastathA sukham
shlokas.20:
sukhAdeva paraM duHkhaM duHkhAdanyatparaM sukham |
dRRishyate hi mahAprAj~na niyataM vai svabhAvataH
shlokas.21:
trividhAnIha vRRittAni narasyAhurmanIShiNaH |
puNyamanyatpApamanyanna puNyaM na cha pApakam
shlokas.22:
na vRRittaM manyate.anyasya manyate.anyasya pApakam |
tathA svakarmanirvRRittaM na puNyaM na cha pApakam
shlokas.23:
ramasvaidhasva modasva dehi chaiva yajasva cha |
na tvAmabhibhaviShyanti vaidyA na cha tapasvinaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha maitreyaH karmapUjakaH |
atyantaM shrImati kule jAtaH prAj~no bahushrutaH
shlokas.2:
asa.nshayaM mahAprAj~na yathaivAttha tathaiva tat |
anuj~nAtastu bhavatA ki~nchidbrUyAmahaM vibho
shlokas.3:
vyAsa uvAcha||
yadyadichChasi maitreya yAvadyAvadyathA tathA |
brUhi tAvanmahAprAj~na shushrUShe vachanaM tava
shlokas.4:
maitreya uvAcha||
nirdoShaM nirmalaM chaiva vachanaM dAnasaMhitam |
vidyAtapobhyAM hi bhavAnbhAvitAtmA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.5:
bhavato bhAvitAtmatvAddAyo.ayaM sumahAnmama |
bhUyo buddhyAnupashyAmi susamRRiddhatapA iva
shlokas.6:
api me darshanAdeva bhavato.abhyudayo mahAn |
manye bhavatprasAdo.ayaM taddhi karma svabhAvataH
shlokas.7:
tapaH shrutaM cha yonishchApyetadbrAhmaNyakAraNam |
tribhirguNaiH samuditastato bhavati vai dvijaH
shlokas.8:
tasmi.nstRRipte cha tRRipyante pitaro daivatAni cha |
na hi shrutavatAM ki~nchidadhikaM brAhmaNAdRRite
shlokas.9:
yathA hi sukRRite kShetre phalaM vindati mAnavaH |
evaM dattvA shrutavati phalaM dAtA samashnute
shlokas.10:
brAhmaNashchenna vidyeta shrutavRRittopasaMhitaH |
pratigrahItA dAnasya moghaM syAddhaninAM dhanam
shlokas.11:
adanhyavidvAnhantyannamadyamAnaM cha hanti tam |
taM cha hanyati yasyAnnaM sa hatvA hanyate.abudhaH
shlokas.12:
prabhurhyannamadanvidvAnpunarjanayatIshvaraH |
sa chAnnAjjAyate tasmAtsUkShma eva vyatikramaH
shlokas.13:
yadeva dadataH puNyaM tadeva pratigRRihNataH |
na hyekachakraM varteta ityevamRRiShayo viduH
shlokas.14:
yatra vai brAhmaNAH santi shrutavRRittopasaMhitAH |
tatra dAnaphalaM puNyamiha chAmutra chAshnute
shlokas.15:
ye yonishuddhAH satataM tapasyabhiratA bhRRisham |
dAnAdhyayanasampannAste vai pUjyatamAH sadA
shlokas.16:
tairhi sadbhiH kRRitaH panthAshchetayAno na muhyate |
te hi svargasya netAro yaj~navAhAH sanAtanAH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa bhagavAnmaitreyaM pratyabhAShata |
diShTyaivaM tvaM vijAnAsi diShTyA te buddhirIdRRishI
loko hyayaM guNAneva bhUyiShThaM sma prasha.nsati
shlokas.2:
rUpamAnavayomAnashrImAnAshchApyasa.nshayam |
diShTyA nAbhibhavanti tvAM daivaste.ayamanugrahaH
yatte bhRRishataraM dAnAdvartayiShyAmi tachChRRiNu
shlokas.3:
yAnIhAgamashAstrANi yAshcha kAshchitpravRRittayaH |
tAni vedaM puraskRRitya pravRRittAni yathAkramam
shlokas.4:
ahaM dAnaM prasha.nsAmi bhavAnapi tapaHshrute |
tapaH pavitraM vedasya tapaH svargasya sAdhanam
shlokas.5:
tapasA mahadApnoti vidyayA cheti naH shrutam |
tapasaiva chApanudedyachchAnyadapi duShkRRitam
shlokas.6:
yadyaddhi ki~nchitsandhAya puruShastapyate tapaH |
sarvametadavApnoti brAhmaNo vedapAragaH
shlokas.7:
duranvayaM duShpradhRRiShyaM durApaM duratikramam |
sarvaM vai tapasAbhyeti tapo hi balavattaram
shlokas.8:
surApo.asaMmatAdAyI bhrUNahA gurutalpagaH |
tapasA tarate sarvamenasashcha pramuchyate
shlokas.9:
sarvavidyastu chakShuShmAnapi yAdRRishatAdRRishaH |
tapasvinau cha tAvAhustAbhyAM kAryaM sadA namaH
shlokas.10:
sarve pUjyAH shrutadhanAstathaiva cha tapasvinaH |
dAnapradAH sukhaM pretya prApnuvantIha cha shriyam
shlokas.11:
imaM cha brahmalokaM cha lokaM cha balavattaram |
annadAnaiH sukRRitinaH pratipadyanti laukikAH
shlokas.12:
pUjitAH pUjayantyetAnmAnitA mAnayanti cha |
adAtA yatra yatraiti sarvataH sampraNudyate
shlokas.13:
akartA chaiva kartA cha labhate yasya yAdRRisham |
yadyevordhvaM yadyavAkcha tvaM lokamabhiyAsyasi
shlokas.14:
prApsyase tvannapAnAni yAni dAsyasi kAnichit |
medhAvyasi kule jAtaH shrutavAnanRRisha.nsavAn
shlokas.15:
kaumAradAravratavAnmaitreya nirato bhava |
etadgRRihANa prathamaM prashastaM gRRihamedhinAm
shlokas.16:
yo bhartA vAsitAtuShTo bhartustuShTA cha vAsitA |
yasminnevaM kule sarvaM kalyANaM tatra vartate
shlokas.17:
adbhirgAtrAnmalamiva tamo.agniprabhayA yathA |
dAnena tapasA chaiva sarvapApamapohyate
shlokas.18:
svasti prApnuhi maitreya gRRihAnsAdhu vrajAmyaham |
etanmanasi kartavyaM shreya evaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.19:
taM praNamyAtha maitreyaH kRRitvA chAbhipradakShiNam |
svasti prApnotu bhagavAnityuvAcha kRRitA~njaliH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
satstrINAM samudAchAraM sarvadharmabhRRitAM vara |
shrotumichChAmyahaM tvattastaM me brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sarvaj~nAM sarvadharmaj~nAM devaloke manasvinIm |
kaikeyI sumanA nAma shANDilIM paryapRRichChata
shlokas.3:
kena vRRittena kalyANi samAchAreNa kena vA |
vidhUya sarvapApAni devalokaM tvamAgatA
shlokas.4:
hutAshanashikheva tvaM jvalamAnA svatejasA |
sutA tArAdhipasyeva prabhayA divamAgatA
shlokas.5:
arajA.nsi cha vastrANi dhArayantI gataklamA |
vimAnasthA shubhe bhAsi sahasraguNamojasA
shlokas.6:
na tvamalpena tapasA dAnena niyamena vA |
imaM lokamanuprAptA tasmAttattvaM vadasva me
shlokas.7:
iti pRRiShTA sumanayA madhuraM chAruhAsinI |
shANDilI nibhRRitaM vAkyaM sumanAmidamabravIt
shlokas.8:
nAhaM kAShAyavasanA nApi valkaladhAriNI |
na cha muNDA na jaTilA bhUtvA devatvamAgatA
shlokas.9:
ahitAni cha vAkyAni sarvANi paruShANi cha |
apramattA cha bhartAraM kadAchinnAhamabruvam
shlokas.10:
devatAnAM pitR^INAM cha brAhmaNAnAM cha pUjane |
apramattA sadAyuktA shvashrUshvashuravartinI
shlokas.11:
paishunye na pravartAmi na mamaitanmanogatam |
advAre na cha tiShThAmi chiraM na kathayAmi cha
shlokas.12:
asadvA hasitaM ki~nchidahitaM vApi karmaNA |
rahasyamarahasyaM vA na pravartAmi sarvathA
shlokas.13:
kAryArthe nirgataM chApi bhartAraM gRRihamAgatam |
Asanenopasa.nyojya pUjayAmi samAhitA
shlokas.14:
yadyachcha nAbhijAnAti yadbhojyaM nAbhinandati |
bhakShyaM vApyatha vA lehyaM tatsarvaM varjayAmyaham
shlokas.15:
kuTumbArthe samAnItaM yatki~nchitkAryameva tu |
prAtarutthAya tatsarvaM kArayAmi karomi cha
shlokas.16:
pravAsaM yadi me bhartA yAti kAryeNa kenachit |
ma~NgalairbahubhiryuktA bhavAmi niyatA sadA
shlokas.17:
a~njanaM rochanAM chaiva snAnaM mAlyAnulepanam |
prasAdhanaM cha niShkrAnte nAbhinandAmi bhartari
shlokas.18:
notthApayAmi bhartAraM sukhasuptamahaM sadA |
AtureShvapi kAryeShu tena tuShyati me manaH
shlokas.19:
nAyAsayAmi bhartAraM kuTumbArthe cha sarvadA |
guptaguhyA sadA chAsmi susaMmRRiShTaniveshanA
shlokas.20:
imaM dharmapathaM nArI pAlayantI samAhitA |
arundhatIva nArINAM svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.21:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etadAkhyAya sA devI sumanAyai tapasvinI |
patidharmaM mahAbhAgA jagAmAdarshanaM tadA
shlokas.22:
yashchedaM pANDavAkhyAnaM paThetparvaNi parvaNi |
sa devalokaM samprApya nandane susukhaM vaset

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sAmnA vApi pradAne vA jyAyaH kiM bhavato matam |
prabrUhi bharatashreShTha yadatra vyatirichyate
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sAmnA prasAdyate kashchiddAnena cha tathAparaH |
puruShaH prakRRitiM j~nAtvA tayorekataraM bhajet
shlokas.3:
guNA.nstu shRRiNu me rAjansAntvasya bharatarShabha |
dAruNAnyapi bhUtAni sAntvenArAdhayedyathA
shlokas.4:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
gRRihItvA rakShasA mukto dvijAtiH kAnane yathA
shlokas.5:
kashchittu buddhisampanno brAhmaNo vijane vane |
gRRihItaH kRRichChramApanno rakShasA bhakShayiShyatA
shlokas.6:
sa buddhishrutasampannastaM dRRiShTvAtIva bhIShaNam |
sAmaivAsminprayuyuje na mumoha na vivyathe
shlokas.7:
rakShastu vAchA sampUjya prashnaM paprachCha taM dvijam |
mokShyase brUhi me prashnaM kenAsmi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.8:
muhUrtamatha sa~nchintya brAhmaNastasya rakShasaH |
AbhirgAthAbhiravyagraH prashnaM pratijagAda ha
shlokas.9:
videshastho vilokastho vinA nUnaM suhRRijjanaiH |
viShayAnatulAnbhu~NkShe tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.10:
nUnaM mitrANi te rakShaH sAdhUpacharitAnyapi |
svadoShAdaparajyante tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.11:
dhanaishvaryAdhikAH stabdhAstvadguNaiH paramAvarAH |
avajAnanti nUnaM tvAM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.12:
guNavAnviguNAnanyAnnUnaM pashyasi satkRRitAn |
prAj~no.aprAj~nAnvinItAtmA tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.13:
avRRittyA klishyamAno.api vRRittyupAyAnvigarhayan |
mAhAtmyAdvyathase nUnaM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.14:
sampIDyAtmAnamAryatvAttvayA kashchidupaskRRitaH |
jitaM tvAM manyate sAdho tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.15:
klishyamAnAnvimArgeShu kAmakrodhAvRRitAtmanaH |
manye nu dhyAyasi janA.nstenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.16:
prAj~naiH sambhAvito nUnaM naprAj~nairupasaMhitaH |
hrImAnamarShI durvRRittaistenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.17:
nUnaM mitramukhaH shatruH kashchidAryavadAcharan |
va~nchayitvA gatastvAM vai tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.18:
prakAshArthagatirnUnaM rahasyakushalaH kRRitI |
tajj~nairna pUjyase nUnaM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.19:
asatsvabhiniviShTeShu bruvato muktasa.nshayam |
guNAste na virAjante tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.20:
dhanabuddhishrutairhInaH kevalaM tejasAnvitaH |
mahatprArthayase nUnaM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.21:
tapaHpraNihitAtmAnaM manye tvAraNyakA~NkShiNam |
bandhuvargo na gRRihNAti tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.22:
nUnamarthavatAM madhye tava vAkyamanuttamam |
na bhAti kAle.abhihitaM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.23:
dRRiDhapUrvashrutaM mUrkhaM kupitaM hRRidayapriyam |
anunetuM na shaknoShi tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.24:
nUnamAsa~njayitvA te kRRitye kasmi.nshchidIpsite |
kashchidarthayate.atyarthaM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.25:
nUnaM tvA svaguNApekShaM pUjayAnaM suhRRiddhruvam |
mayArtha iti jAnAti tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.26:
antargatamabhiprAyaM na nUnaM lajjayechChasi |
vivaktuM prAptishaithilyAttenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.27:
nAnAbuddhiruchI.Nlloke manuShyAnnUnamichChasi |
grahItuM svaguNaiH sarvA.nstenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.28:
avidvAnbhIruralpArtho vidyAvikramadAnajam |
yashaH prArthayase nUnaM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.29:
chirAbhilaShitaM ki~nchitphalamaprAptameva te |
kRRitamanyairapahRRitaM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.30:
nUnamAtmakRRitaM doShamapashyanki~nchidAtmani |
akAraNe.abhishasto.asi tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.31:
suhRRidAmapramattAnAmapramokShyArthahAnijam |
duHkhamarthaguNairhInaM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.32:
sAdhUngRRihasthAndRRiShTvA cha tathAsAdhUnvanecharAn |
muktA.nshchAvasathe saktA.nstenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.33:
dharmyamarthaM cha kAle cha deshe chAbhihitaM vachaH |
na pratiShThati te nUnaM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.34:
dattAnakushalairarthAnmanIShI sa~njijIviShuH |
prApya vartayase nUnaM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.35:
pApAnvivardhato dRRiShTvA kalyANA.nshchAvasIdataH |
dhruvaM mRRigayase yogyaM tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.36:
parasparaviruddhAnAM priyaM nUnaM chikIrShasi |
suhRRidAmavirodhena tenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.37:
shrotriyA.nshcha vikarmasthAnprAj~nA.nshchApyajitendriyAn |
manye.anudhyAyasi janA.nstenAsi hariNaH kRRishaH
shlokas.38:
evaM sampUjitaM rakSho vipraM taM pratyapUjayat |
sakhAyamakarochchainaM sa.nyojyArthairmumocha ha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmaha mahAprAj~na sarvashAstravishArada |
AgamairbahubhiH sphIto bhavAnnaH prathitaH kule
shlokas.2:
tvatto dharmArthasa.nyuktamAyatyAM cha sukhodayam |
AshcharyabhUtaM lokasya shrotumichChAmyari.ndama
shlokas.3:
ayaM cha kAlaH samprApto durlabhaj~nAtibAndhavaH |
shAstA cha na hi naH kashchittvAmRRite bharatarShabha
shlokas.4:
yadi te.ahamanugrAhyo bhrAtRRibhiH sahito.anagha |
vaktumarhasi naH prashnaM yattvAM pRRichChAmi pArthiva
shlokas.5:
ayaM nArAyaNaH shrImAnsarvapArthivasaMmataH |
bhavantaM bahumAnena prashrayeNa cha sevate
shlokas.6:
asya chaiva samakShaM tvaM pArthivAnAM cha sarvashaH |
bhrAtR^INAM cha priyArthaM me snehAdbhAShitumarhasi
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA snehAdAgatasambhramaH |
bhIShmo bhAgIrathIputra idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.8:
hanta te kathayiShyAmi kathAmatimanoramAm |
asya viShNoH purA rAjanprabhAvo.ayaM mayA shrutaH
shlokas.9:
yashcha govRRiShabhA~Nkasya prabhAvastaM cha me shRRiNu |
rudrANyAH sa.nshayo yashcha dampatyostaM cha me shRRiNu
shlokas.10:
vrataM chachAra dharmAtmA kRRiShNo dvAdashavArShikam |
dIkShitaM chAgatau draShTumubhau nAradaparvatau
shlokas.11:
kRRiShNadvaipAyanashchaiva dhaumyashcha japatAM varaH |
devalaH kAshyapashchaiva hastikAshyapa eva cha
shlokas.12:
apare RRiShayaH santo dIkShAdamasamanvitAH |
shiShyairanugatAH sarve devakalpaistapodhanaiH
shlokas.13:
teShAmatithisatkAramarchanIyaM kulochitam |
devakItanayaH prIto devakalpamakalpayat
shlokas.14:
hariteShu suvarNeShu barhiShkeShu naveShu cha |
upopavivishuH prItA viShTareShu maharShayaH
shlokas.15:
kathAshchakrustataste tu madhurA dharmasaMhitAH |
rAjarShINAM surANAM cha ye vasanti tapodhanAH
shlokas.16:
tato nArAyaNaM tejo vratacharyendhanotthitam |
vaktrAnniHsRRitya kRRiShNasya vahniradbhutakarmaNaH
shlokas.17:
so.agnirdadAha taM shailaM sadrumaM salatAkShupam |
sapakShimRRigasa~NghAtaM sashvApadasarIsRRipam
shlokas.18:
mRRigaishcha vividhAkArairhAhAbhUtamachetanam |
shikharaM tasya shailasya mathitaM dIptadarshanam
shlokas.19:
sa tu vahnirmahAjvAlo dagdhvA sarvamasheShataH |
viShNoH samIpamAgamya pAdau shiShyavadaspRRishat
shlokas.20:
tato viShNurvanaM dRRiShTvA nirdagdhamarikarshanaH |
saumyairdRRiShTinipAtaistatpunaH prakRRitimAnayat
shlokas.21:
tathaiva sa girirbhUyaH prapuShpitalatAdrumaH |
sapakShigaNasa~NghuShTaH sashvApadasarIsRRipaH
shlokas.22:
tadadbhutamachintyaM cha dRRiShTvA munigaNastadA |
vismito hRRiShTalomA cha babhUvAsrAvilekShaNaH
shlokas.23:
tato nArAyaNo dRRiShTvA tAnRRiShInvismayAnvitAn |
prashritaM madhuraM snigdhaM paprachCha vadatAM varaH
shlokas.24:
kimasya RRiShipUgasya tyaktasa~Ngasya nityashaH |
nirmamasyAgamavato vismayaH samupAgataH
shlokas.25:
etaM me sa.nshayaM sarvaM yAthAtathyamaninditAH |
RRiShayo vaktumarhanti nishchitArthaM tapodhanAH
shlokas.26:
RRiShaya UchuH||
bhavAnvisRRijate lokAnbhavAnsaMharate punaH |
bhavA~nshItaM bhavAnuShNaM bhavAneva pravarShati
shlokas.27:
pRRithivyAM yAni bhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha |
teShAM pitA tvaM mAtA cha prabhuH prabhava eva cha
shlokas.28:
etanno vismayakaraM prasha.nsa madhusUdana |
tvamevArhasi kalyANa vaktuM vahnervinirgamam
shlokas.29:
tato vigatasantrAsA vayamapyarikarshana |
yachChrutaM yachcha dRRiShTaM nastatpravakShyAmahe hare
shlokas.30:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
etattadvaiShNavaM tejo mama vaktrAdviniHsRRitam |
kRRiShNavartmA yugAntAbho yenAyaM mathito giriH
shlokas.31:
RRiShayashchArtimApannA jitakrodhA jitendriyAH |
bhavanto vyathitAshchAsandevakalpAstapodhanAH
shlokas.32:
vratacharyAparItasya tapasvivratasevayA |
mama vahniH samudbhUto na vai vyathitumarhatha
shlokas.33:
vrataM chartumihAyAtastvahaM girimimaM shubham |
putraM chAtmasamaM vIrye tapasA sraShTumAgataH
shlokas.34:
tato mamAtmA yo dehe so.agnirbhUtvA viniHsRRitaH |
gatashcha varadaM draShTuM sarvalokapitAmaham
shlokas.35:
tena chAtmAnushiShTo me putratve munisattamAH |
tejaso.ardhena putraste bhaviteti vRRiShadhvajaH
shlokas.36:
so.ayaM vahnirupAgamya pAdamUle mamAntikam |
shiShyavatparicharyAtha shAntaH prakRRitimAgataH
shlokas.37:
etadasya rahasyaM vaH padmanAbhasya dhImataH |
mayA premNA samAkhyAtaM na bhIH kAryA tapodhanAH
shlokas.38:
sarvatra gatiravyagrA bhavatAM dIrghadarshanAH |
tapasvivratasa.ndIptA j~nAnavij~nAnashobhitAH
shlokas.39:
yachChrutaM yachcha vo dRRiShTaM divi vA yadi vA bhuvi |
AshcharyaM paramaM ki~nchittadbhavanto bruvantu me
shlokas.40:
tasyAmRRitanikAshasya vA~Nmadhorasti me spRRihA |
bhavadbhiH kathitasyeha tapovananivAsibhiH
shlokas.41:
yadyapyahamadRRiShTaM vA divyamadbhutadarshanam |
divi vA bhuvi vA ki~nchitpashyAmyamaladarshanAH
shlokas.42:
prakRRitiH sA mama parA na kvachitpratihanyate |
na chAtmagatamaishvaryamAshcharyaM pratibhAti me
shlokas.43:
shraddheyaH kathito hyarthaH sajjanashravaNaM gataH |
chiraM tiShThati medinyAM shaile lekhyamivArpitam
shlokas.44:
tadahaM sajjanamukhAnniHsRRitaM tatsamAgame |
kathayiShyAmyaharaharbuddhidIpakaraM nRRiNAm
shlokas.45:
tato munigaNAH sarve prashritAH kRRiShNasaMnidhau |
netraiH padmadalaprakhyairapashyanta janArdanam
shlokas.46:
vardhayantastathaivAnye pUjayantastathApare |
vAgbhirRRigbhUShitArthAbhiH stuvanto madhusUdanam
shlokas.47:
tato munigaNAH sarve nAradaM devadarshanam |
tadA niyojayAmAsurvachane vAkyakovidam
shlokas.48:
yadAshcharyamachintyaM cha girau himavati prabho |
anubhUtaM munigaNaistIrthayAtrAparAyaNaiH
shlokas.49:
tadbhavAnRRiShisa~Nghasya hitArthaM sarvachoditaH |
yathAdRRiShTaM hRRiShIkeshe sarvamAkhyAtumarhati
shlokas.50:
evamuktaH sa munibhirnArado bhagavAnRRiShiH |
kathayAmAsa devarShiH pUrvavRRittAM kathAM shubhAm

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato nArAyaNasuhRRinnArado bhagavAnRRiShiH |
sha~NkarasyomayA sArdhaM sa.nvAdaM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.2:
tapashchachAra dharmAtmA vRRiShabhA~NkaH sureshvaraH |
puNye girau himavati siddhachAraNasevite
shlokas.3:
nAnauShadhiyute ramye nAnApuShpasamAkule |
apsarogaNasa~NkIrNe bhUtasa~NghaniShevite
shlokas.4:
tatra devo mudA yukto bhUtasa~NghashatairvRRitaH |
nAnArUpairvirUpaishcha divyairadbhutadarshanaiH
shlokas.5:
siMhavyAghragajaprakhyaiH sarvajAtisamanvitaiH |
kroShTukadvIpivadanairRRikSharShabhamukhaistathA
shlokas.6:
ulUkavadanairbhImaiH shyenabhAsamukhaistathA |
nAnAvarNamRRigaprakhyaiH sarvajAtisamanvayaiH
kiMnarairdevagandharvairyakShabhUtagaNaistathA
shlokas.7:
divyapuShpasamAkIrNaM divyamAlAvibhUShitam |
divyachandanasa.nyuktaM divyadhUpena dhUpitam
tatsado vRRiShabhA~Nkasya divyavAditranAditam
shlokas.8:
mRRida~NgapaNavodghuShTaM sha~NkhabherIninAditam |
nRRityadbhirbhUtasa~Nghaishcha barhiNaishcha samantataH
shlokas.9:
pranRRittApsarasaM divyaM divyastrIgaNasevitam |
dRRiShTikAntamanirdeshyaM divyamadbhutadarshanam
shlokas.11:
sa giristapasA tasya bhUteshasya vyarochata |
svAdhyAyaparamairviprairbrahmaghoShairvinAditaH |
ShaTpadairupagItaishcha mAdhavApratimo giriH
shlokas.12:
taM mahotsavasa~NkAshaM bhImarUpadharaM punaH |
dRRiShTvA munigaNasyAsItparA prItirjanArdana
shlokas.13:
munayashcha mahAbhAgAH siddhAshchaivordhvaretasaH |
maruto vasavaH sAdhyA vishvedevAH sanAtanAH
shlokas.14:
yakShA nAgAH pishAchAshcha lokapAlA hutAshanAH |
bhAvAshcha sarve nyagbhUtAstatraivAsansamAgatAH
shlokas.15:
RRitavaH sarvapuShpaishcha vyakiranta mahAdbhutaiH |
oShadhyo jvalamAnAshcha dyotayanti sma tadvanam
shlokas.16:
vihagAshcha mudA yuktAH prAnRRityanvyanada.nshcha ha |
giripRRiShTheShu ramyeShu vyAharanto janapriyAH
shlokas.17:
tatra devo giritaTe divyadhAtuvibhUShite |
parya~Nka iva vibhrAjannupaviShTo mahAmanAH
shlokas.18:
vyAghracharmAmbaradharaH siMhacharmottarachChadaH |
vyAlayaj~nopavItI cha lohitA~NgadabhUShaNaH
shlokas.19:
harishmashrurjaTI bhImo bhayakartA suradviShAm |
abhayaH sarvabhUtAnAM bhaktAnAM vRRiShabhadhvajaH
shlokas.20:
dRRiShTvA tamRRiShayaH sarve shirobhiravanIM gatAH |
vimuktAH sarvapApebhyaH kShAntA vigatakalmaShAH
shlokas.21:
tasya bhUtapateH sthAnaM bhImarUpadharaM babhau |
apradhRRiShyataraM chaiva mahoragasamAkulam
shlokas.22:
kShaNenaivAbhavatsarvamadbhutaM madhusUdana |
tatsado vRRiShabhA~Nkasya bhImarUpadharaM babhau
shlokas.23:
tamabhyayAchChailasutA bhUtastrIgaNasa.nvRRitA |
haratulyAmbaradharA samAnavratachAriNI
shlokas.24:
bibhratI kalashaM raukmaM sarvatIrthajalodbhavam |
girisravAbhiH puNyAbhiH sarvato.anugatA shubhA
shlokas.25:
puShpavRRiShTyAbhivarShantI gandhairbahuvidhaistathA |
sevantI himavatpArshvaM harapArshvamupAgamat
shlokas.26:
tataH smayantI pANibhyAM narmArthaM chArudarshanA |
haranetre shubhe devI sahasA sA samAvRRiNot
shlokas.27:
sa.nvRRitAbhyAM tu netrAbhyAM tamobhUtamachetanam |
nirhomaM nirvaShaTkAraM tatsadaH sahasAbhavat
shlokas.28:
janashcha vimanAH sarvo bhayatrAsasamanvitaH |
nimIlite bhUtapatau naShTasUrya ivAbhavat
shlokas.29:
tato vitimiro lokaH kShaNena samapadyata |
jvAlA cha mahatI dIptA lalATAttasya niHsRRitA
shlokas.30:
tRRitIyaM chAsya sambhUtaM netramAdityasaMnibham |
yugAntasadRRishaM dIptaM yenAsau mathito giriH
shlokas.31:
tato girisutA dRRiShTvA dIptAgnisadRRishekShaNam |
haraM praNamya shirasA dadarshAyatalochanA
shlokas.32:
dahyamAne vane tasminsashAlasaraladrume |
sachandanavane ramye divyauShadhividIpite
shlokas.33:
mRRigayUthairdrutairbhItairharapArshvamupAgataiH |
sharaNaM chApyavindadbhistatsadaH sa~NkulaM babhau
shlokas.34:
tato nabhaHspRRishajvAlo vidyullolArchirujjvalaH |
dvAdashAdityasadRRisho yugAntAgnirivAparaH
shlokas.35:
kShaNena tena dagdhaH sa himavAnabhavannagaH |
sadhAtushikharAbhogo dInadagdhavanauShadhiH
shlokas.36:
taM dRRiShTvA mathitaM shailaM shailarAjasutA tataH |
bhagavantaM prapannA sA sA~njalipragrahA sthitA
shlokas.37:
umAM sharvastadA dRRiShTvA strIbhAvAgatamArdavAm |
piturdainyamanichChantIM prItyApashyattato girim
shlokas.38:
tato.abhavatpunaH sarvaH prakRRitisthaH sudarshanaH |
prahRRiShTavihagashchaiva prapuShpitavanadrumaH
shlokas.39:
prakRRitisthaM giriM dRRiShTvA prItA devI maheshvaram |
uvAcha sarvabhUtAnAM patiM patimaninditA
shlokas.40:
bhagavansarvabhUtesha shUlapANe mahAvrata |
sa.nshayo me mahA~njAtastaM me vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.41:
kimarthaM te lalATe vai tRRitIyaM netramutthitam |
kimarthaM cha girirdagdhaH sapakShigaNakAnanaH
shlokas.42:
kimarthaM cha punardeva prakRRitisthaH kShaNAtkRRitaH |
tathaiva drumasa~nChannaH kRRito.ayaM te maheshvara
shlokas.43:
maheshvara uvAcha||
netre me sa.nvRRite devi tvayA bAlyAdanindite |
naShTAlokastato lokaH kShaNena samapadyata
shlokas.44:
naShTAditye tathA loke tamobhUte nagAtmaje |
tRRitIyaM lochanaM dIptaM sRRiShTaM te rakShatA prajAH
shlokas.45:
tasya chAkShNo mahattejo yenAyaM mathito giriH |
tvatpriyArthaM cha me devi prakRRitisthaH kShaNAtkRRitaH
shlokas.46:
umovAcha||
bhagavankena te vaktraM chandravatpriyadarshanam |
pUrvaM tathaiva shrIkAntamuttaraM pashchimaM tathA
shlokas.47:
dakShiNaM cha mukhaM raudraM kenordhvaM kapilA jaTAH |
kena kaNThashcha te nIlo barhibarhanibhaH kRRitaH
shlokas.48:
haste chaitatpinAkaM te satataM kena tiShThati |
jaTilo brahmachArI cha kimarthamasi nityadA
shlokas.49:
etaM me sa.nshayaM sarvaM vada bhUtapate.anagha |
sadharmachAriNI chAhaM bhaktA cheti vRRiShadhvaja
shlokas.50:
evamuktaH sa bhagavA~nshailaputryA pinAkadhRRik |
tasyA vRRittyA cha buddhyA cha prItimAnabhavatprabhuH
shlokas.51:
tatastAmabravIddevaH subhage shrUyatAmiti |
hetubhiryairmamaitAni rUpANi ruchirAnane

shlokas.1:
maheshvara uvAcha||
tilottamA nAma purA brahmaNA yoShiduttamA |
tilaM tilaM samuddhRRitya ratnAnAM nirmitA shubhA
shlokas.2:
sAbhyagachChata mAM devi rUpeNApratimA bhuvi |
pradakShiNaM lobhayantI mAM shubhe ruchirAnanA
shlokas.3:
yato yataH sA sudatI mAmupAdhAvadantike |
tatastato mukhaM chAru mama devi vinirgatam
shlokas.4:
tAM didRRikShurahaM yogAchchaturmUrtitvamAgataH |
chaturmukhashcha sa.nvRRitto darshayanyogamAtmanaH
shlokas.5:
pUrveNa vadanenAhamindratvamanushAsmi ha |
uttareNa tvayA sArdhaM ramAmyahamanindite
shlokas.6:
pashchimaM me mukhaM saumyaM sarvaprANisukhAvaham |
dakShiNaM bhImasa~NkAshaM raudraM saMharati prajAH
shlokas.7:
jaTilo brahmachArI cha lokAnAM hitakAmyayA |
devakAryArthasiddhyarthaM pinAkaM me kare sthitam
shlokas.8:
indreNa cha purA vajraM kShiptaM shrIkA~NkShiNA mama |
dagdhvA kaNThaM tu tadyAtaM tena shrIkaNThatA mama
shlokas.9:
umovAcha||
vAhaneShu prabhUteShu shrImatsvanyeShu satsu te |
kathaM govRRiShabho deva vAhanatvamupAgataH
shlokas.10:
maheshvara uvAcha||
surabhIM sasRRije brahmAmRRitadhenuM payomucham |
sA sRRiShTA bahudhA jAtA kSharamANA payo.amRRitam
shlokas.11:
tasyA vatsamukhotsRRiShTaH pheno madgAtramAgataH |
tato dagdhA mayA gAvo nAnAvarNatvamAgatAH
shlokas.12:
tato.ahaM lokaguruNA shamaM nIto.arthavedinA |
vRRiShaM chemaM dhvajArthaM me dadau vAhanameva cha
shlokas.13:
umovAcha||
nivAsA bahurUpAste vishvarUpaguNAnvitAH |
tA.nshcha santyajya bhagava~nshmashAne ramase katham
shlokas.14:
keshAsthikalile bhIme kapAlaghaTasa~Nkule |
gRRidhragomAyukalile chitAgnishatasa~Nkule
shlokas.15:
ashuchau mA.nsakalile vasAshoNitakardame |
vinikIrNAmiShachaye shivAnAdavinAdite
shlokas.16:
maheshvara uvAcha||
medhyAnveShI mahIM kRRitsnAM vicharAmi nishAsvaham |
na cha medhyataraM ki~nchichChmashAnAdiha vidyate
shlokas.17:
tena me sarvavAsAnAM shmashAne ramate manaH |
nyagrodhashAkhAsa~nChanne nirbhuktasragvibhUShite
shlokas.18:
tatra chaiva ramante me bhUtasa~NghAH shubhAnane |
na cha bhUtagaNairdevi vinAhaM vastumutsahe
shlokas.19:
eSha vAso hi me medhyaH svargIyashcha mato hi me |
puNyaH paramakashchaiva medhyakAmairupAsyate
shlokas.20:
umovAcha||
bhagavansarvabhUtesha sarvadharmabhRRitAM vara |
pinAkapANe varada sa.nshayo me mahAnayam
shlokas.21:
ayaM munigaNaH sarvastapastapa iti prabho |
taponveShakaro loke bhramate vividhAkRRitiH
shlokas.22:
asya chaivarShisa~Nghasya mama cha priyakAmyayA |
etaM mameha sa.ndehaM vaktumarhasyari.ndama
shlokas.23:
dharmaH ki.nlakShaNaH proktaH kathaM vAcharituM naraiH |
shakyo dharmamavindadbhirdharmaj~na vada me prabho
shlokas.24:
nArada uvAcha||
tato munigaNaH sarvastAM devIM pratyapUjayat |
vAgbhirRRigbhUShitArthAbhiH stavaishchArthavidAM vara
shlokas.25:
maheshvara uvAcha||
ahi.nsA satyavachanaM sarvabhUtAnukampanam |
shamo dAnaM yathAshakti gArhasthyo dharma uttamaH
shlokas.26:
paradAreShvasa~Nkalpo nyAsastrIparirakShaNam |
adattAdAnaviramo madhumA.nsasya varjanam
shlokas.27:
eSha pa~nchavidho dharmo bahushAkhaH sukhodayaH |
dehibhirdharmaparamaiH kartavyo dharmasa~nchayaH
shlokas.28:
umovAcha||
bhagavansa.nshayaM pRRiShTastaM me vyAkhyAtumarhasi |
chAturvarNyasya yo dharmaH sve sve varNe guNAvahaH
shlokas.29:
brAhmaNe kIdRRisho dharmaH kShatriye kIdRRisho bhavet |
vaishye ki.nlakShaNo dharmaH shUdre ki.nlakShaNo bhavet
shlokas.30:
maheshvara uvAcha||
nyAyataste mahAbhAge sa.nshayaH samudIritaH |
bhUmidevA mahAbhAgAH sadA loke dvijAtayaH
shlokas.31:
upavAsaH sadA dharmo brAhmaNasya na sa.nshayaH |
sa hi dharmArthamutpanno brahmabhUyAya kalpate
shlokas.32:
tasya dharmakriyA devi vratacharyA cha nyAyataH |
tathopanayanaM chaiva dvijAyaivopapadyate
shlokas.33:
gurudaivatapUjArthaM svAdhyAyAbhyasanAtmakaH |
dehibhirdharmaparamaishchartavyo dharmasambhavaH
shlokas.34:
umovAcha||
bhagavansa.nshayo me.atra taM me vyAkhyAtumarhasi |
chAturvarNyasya dharmaM hi naipuNyena prakIrtaya
shlokas.35:
maheshvara uvAcha||
rahasyashravaNaM dharmo vedavrataniShevaNam |
vratacharyAparo dharmo gurupAdaprasAdanam
shlokas.36:
bhaikShacharyAparo dharmo dharmo nityopavAsitA |
nityasvAdhyAyitA dharmo brahmacharyAshramastathA
shlokas.37:
guruNA tvabhyanuj~nAtaH samAvarteta vai dvijaH |
vindetAnantaraM bhAryAmanurUpAM yathAvidhi
shlokas.38:
shUdrAnnavarjanaM dharmastathA satpathasevanam |
dharmo nityopavAsitvaM brahmacharyaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.39:
AhitAgniradhIyAno juhvAnaH sa.nyatendriyaH |
vighasAshI yatAhAro gRRihasthaH satyavAkShuchiH
shlokas.40:
atithivratatA dharmo dharmastretAgnidhAraNam |
iShTIshcha pashubandhA.nshcha vidhipUrvaM samAcharet
shlokas.41:
yaj~nashcha paramo dharmastathAhi.nsA cha dehiShu |
apUrvabhojanaM dharmo vighasAshitvameva cha
shlokas.42:
bhukte parijane pashchAdbhojanaM dharma uchyate |
brAhmaNasya gRRihasthasya shrotriyasya visheShataH
shlokas.43:
dampatyoH samashIlatvaM dharmashcha gRRihamedhinAm |
gRRihyANAM chaiva devAnAM nityaM puShpabalikriyA
shlokas.44:
nityopalepanaM dharmastathA nityopavAsitA |
susaMmRRiShTopalipte cha sAjyadhUmodgame gRRihe
shlokas.45:
eSha dvijajane dharmo gArhasthyo lokadhAraNaH |
dvijAtInAM satAM nityaM sadaivaiSha pravartate
shlokas.46:
yastu kShatragato devi tvayA dharma udIritaH |
tamahaM te pravakShyAmi taM me shRRiNu samAhitA
shlokas.47:
kShatriyasya smRRito dharmaH prajApAlanamAditaH |
nirdiShTaphalabhoktA hi rAjA dharmeNa yujyate
shlokas.48:
prajAH pAlayate yo hi dharmeNa manujAdhipaH |
tasya dharmArjitA lokAH prajApAlanasa~nchitAH
shlokas.49:
tatra rAj~naH paro dharmo damaH svAdhyAya eva cha |
agnihotraparispando dAnAdhyayanameva cha
shlokas.50:
yaj~nopavItadhAraNaM yaj~no dharmakriyAstathA |
bhRRityAnAM bharaNaM dharmaH kRRite karmaNyamoghatA
shlokas.51:
samyagdaNDe sthitirdharmo dharmo vedakratukriyAH |
vyavahArasthitirdharmaH satyavAkyaratistathA
shlokas.52:
Artahastaprado rAjA pretya cheha mahIyate |
gobrAhmaNArthe vikrAntaH sa~NgrAme nidhanaM gataH
ashvamedhajitA.NllokAnprApnoti tridivAlaye
shlokas.53:
vaishyasya satataM dharmaH pAshupAlyaM kRRiShistathA |
agnihotraparispando dAnAdhyayanameva cha
shlokas.54:
vANijyaM satpathasthAnamAtithyaM prashamo damaH |
viprANAM svAgataM tyAgo vaishyadharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.55:
tilAngandhAnrasA.nshchaiva na vikrINIta vai kvachit |
vaNikpathamupAsIno vaishyaH satpathamAshritaH
shlokas.56:
sarvAtithyaM trivargasya yathAshakti yathArhataH |
shUdradharmaH paro nityaM shushrUShA cha dvijAtiShu
shlokas.57:
sa shUdraH sa.nshitatapAH satyasandho jitendriyaH |
shushrUShannatithiM prAptaM tapaH sa~nchinute mahat
shlokas.58:
tyaktahi.nsaH shubhAchAro devatAdvijapUjakaH |
shUdro dharmaphalairiShTaiH samprayujyeta buddhimAn
shlokas.59:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM chAturvarNyasya shobhane |
ekaikasyeha subhage kimanyachChrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
umovAcha||
uktAstvayA pRRithagdharmAshchAturvarNyahitAH shubhAH |
sarvavyApI tu yo dharmo bhagava.nstaM bravIhi me
shlokas.2:
maheshvara uvAcha||
brAhmaNA lokasAreNa sRRiShTA dhAtrA guNArthinA |
lokA.nstArayituM kRRitsnAnmartyeShu kShitidevatAH
shlokas.3:
teShAmimaM pravakShyAmi dharmakarmaphalodayam |
brAhmaNeShu hi yo dharmaH sa dharmaH paramo mataH
shlokas.4:
ime tu lokadharmArthaM trayaH sRRiShTAH svayambhuvA |
pRRithivyAH sarjane nityaM sRRiShTAstAnapi me shRRiNu
shlokas.5:
vedoktaH paramo dharmaH smRRitishAstragato.aparaH |
shiShTAchIrNaH paraH proktastrayo dharmAH sanAtanAH
shlokas.6:
traividyo brAhmaNo vidvAnna chAdhyayanajIvanaH |
trikarmA triparikrAnto maitra eSha smRRito dvijaH
shlokas.7:
ShaDimAni tu karmANi provAcha bhuvaneshvaraH |
vRRittyarthaM brAhmaNAnAM vai shRRiNu tAni samAhitA
shlokas.8:
yajanaM yAjanaM chaiva tathA dAnapratigrahau |
adhyApanamadhItaM cha ShaTkarmA dharmabhAgdvijaH
shlokas.9:
nityasvAdhyAyatA dharmo dharmo yaj~naH sanAtanaH |
dAnaM prashasyate chAsya yathAshakti yathAvidhi
shlokas.10:
ayaM tu paramo dharmaH pravRRittaH satsu nityashaH |
gRRihasthatA vishuddhAnAM dharmasya nichayo mahAn
shlokas.11:
pa~nchayaj~navishuddhAtmA satyavAganasUyakaH |
dAtA brAhmaNasatkartA susaMmRRiShTaniveshanaH
shlokas.12:
amAnI cha sadAjihmaH snigdhavANIpradastathA |
atithyabhyAgataratiH sheShAnnakRRitabhojanaH
shlokas.13:
pAdyamarghyaM yathAnyAyamAsanaM shayanaM tathA |
dIpaM pratishrayaM chApi yo dadAti sa dhArmikaH
shlokas.14:
prAtarutthAya chAchamya bhojanenopamantrya cha |
satkRRityAnuvrajedyashcha tasya dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.15:
sarvAtithyaM trivargasya yathAshakti divAnisham |
shUdradharmaH samAkhyAtastrivarNaparichAraNam
shlokas.16:
pravRRittilakShaNo dharmo gRRihastheShu vidhIyate |
tamahaM kIrtayiShyAmi sarvabhUtahitaM shubham
shlokas.17:
dAtavyamasakRRichChaktyA yaShTavyamasakRRittathA |
puShTikarmavidhAnaM cha kartavyaM bhUtimichChatA
shlokas.18:
dharmeNArthaH samAhAryo dharmalabdhaM tridhA dhanam |
kartavyaM dharmaparamaM mAnavena prayatnataH
shlokas.19:
ekenA.nshena dharmArthashchartavyo bhUtimichChatA |
ekenA.nshena kAmArtha ekama.nshaM vivardhayet
shlokas.20:
nivRRittilakShaNastvanyo dharmo mokSha iti smRRitaH |
tasya vRRittiM pravakShyAmi shRRiNu me devi tattvataH
shlokas.21:
sarvabhUtadayA dharmo na chaikagrAmavAsitA |
AshApAshavimokShashcha shasyate mokShakA~NkShiNAm
shlokas.22:
na kuNDyAM nodake sa~Ngo na vAsasi na chAsane |
na tridaNDe na shayane nAgnau na sharaNAlaye
shlokas.23:
adhyAtmagatachitto yastanmanAstatparAyaNaH |
yukto yogaM prati sadA pratisa~NkhyAnameva cha
shlokas.24:
vRRikShamUlashayo nityaM shUnyAgAraniveshanaH |
nadIpulinashAyI cha nadItIraratishcha yaH
shlokas.25:
vimuktaH sarvasa~NgeShu snehabandheShu cha dvijaH |
AtmanyevAtmano bhAvaM samAsajyATati dvijaH
shlokas.26:
sthANubhUto nirAhAro mokShadRRiShTena karmaNA |
parivrajati yo yuktastasya dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.27:
na chaikatra chirAsakto na chaikagrAmagocharaH |
yukto hyaTati nirmukto na chaikapulineshayaH
shlokas.28:
eSha mokShavidAM dharmo vedoktaH satpathaH satAm |
yo mArgamanuyAtImaM padaM tasya na vidyate
shlokas.29:
chaturvidhA bhikShavaste kuTIcharakRRitodakaH |
ha.nsaH paramaha.nsashcha yo yaH pashchAtsa uttamaH
shlokas.30:
ataH parataraM nAsti nAdharaM na tiro.agrataH |
aduHkhamasukhaM saumyamajarAmaramavyayam
shlokas.31:
umovAcha||
gArhasthyo mokShadharmashcha sajjanAcharitastvayA |
bhAShito martyalokasya mArgaH shreyaskaro mahAn
shlokas.32:
RRiShidharmaM tu dharmaj~na shrotumichChAmyanuttamam |
spRRihA bhavati me nityaM tapovananivAsiShu
shlokas.33:
AjyadhUmodbhavo gandho ruNaddhIva tapovanam |
taM dRRiShTvA me manaH prItaM maheshvara sadA bhavet
shlokas.34:
etaM me sa.nshayaM deva munidharmakRRitaM vibho |
sarvadharmArthatattvaj~na devadeva vadasva me
nikhilena mayA pRRiShTaM mahAdeva yathAtatham
shlokas.35:
maheshvara uvAcha||
hanta te.ahaM pravakShyAmi munidharmamanuttamam |
yaM kRRitvA munayo yAnti siddhiM svatapasA shubhe
shlokas.36:
phenapAnAmRRiShINAM yo dharmo dharmavidAM sadA |
taM me shRRiNu mahAbhAge dharmaj~ne dharmamAditaH
shlokas.37:
u~nChanti satataM tasminbrAhmaM phenotkaraM shubham |
amRRitaM brahmaNA pItaM madhuraM prasRRitaM divi
shlokas.38:
eSha teShAM vishuddhAnAM phenapAnAM tapodhane |
dharmacharyAkRRito mArgo vAlakhilyagaNe shRRiNu
shlokas.39:
vAlakhilyAstapaHsiddhA munayaH sUryamaNDale |
u~nChamu~nChanti dharmaj~nAH shAkunIM vRRittimAsthitAH
shlokas.40:
mRRiganirmokavasanAshchIravalkalavAsasaH |
nirdva.ndvAH satpathaM prAptA vAlakhilyAstapodhanAH
shlokas.41:
a~NguShThaparvamAtrAste sveShva~NgeShu vyavasthitAH |
tapashcharaNamIhante teShAM dharmaphalaM mahat
shlokas.42:
te suraiH samatAM yAnti surakAryArthasiddhaye |
dyotayanto dishaH sarvAstapasA dagdhakilbiShAH
shlokas.43:
ye tvanye shuddhamanaso dayAdharmaparAyaNAH |
santashchakracharAH puNyAH somalokacharAshcha ye
shlokas.44:
pitRRilokasamIpasthAsta u~nChanti yathAvidhi |
samprakShAlAshmakuTTAshcha dantolUkhalinastathA
shlokas.45:
somapAnAM cha devAnAmUShmapANAM tathaiva cha |
u~nChanti ye samIpasthAH svabhAvaniyatendriyAH
shlokas.46:
teShAmagnipariShyandaH pitRRidevArchanaM tathA |
yaj~nAnAM chApi pa~nchAnAM yajanaM dharma uchyate
shlokas.47:
eSha chakracharairdevi devalokacharairdvijaiH |
RRiShidharmaH sadA chIrNo yo.anyastamapi me shRRiNu
shlokas.48:
sarveShvevarShidharmeShu jeya AtmA jitendriyaH |
kAmakrodhau tataH pashchAjjetavyAviti me matiH
shlokas.49:
agnihotraparispando dharmarAtrisamAsanam |
somayaj~nAbhyanuj~nAnaM pa~nchamI yaj~nadakShiNA
shlokas.50:
nityaM yaj~nakriyA dharmaH pitRRidevArchane ratiH |
sarvAtithyaM cha kartavyamanneno~nChArjitena vai
shlokas.51:
nivRRittirupabhogasya gorasAnAM cha vai ratiH |
sthaNDile shayanaM yogaH shAkaparNaniShevaNam
shlokas.52:
phalamUlAshanaM vAyurApaH shaivalabhakShaNam |
RRiShINAM niyamA hyete yairjayantyajitAM gatim
shlokas.53:
vidhUme nyastamusale vya~NgAre bhuktavajjane |
atItapAtrasa~nchAre kAle vigatabhaikShake
shlokas.54:
atithiM kA~NkShamANo vai sheShAnnakRRitabhojanaH |
satyadharmaratiH kShAnto munidharmeNa yujyate
shlokas.55:
na stambhI na cha mAnI yo na pramatto na vismitaH |
mitrAmitrasamo maitro yaH sa dharmaviduttamaH

shlokas.1:
umovAcha||
desheShu ramaNIyeShu girINAM nirjhareShu cha |
sravantInAM cha ku~njeShu parvatopavaneShu cha
shlokas.2:
desheShu cha vichitreShu phalavatsu samAhitAH |
mUlavatsu cha desheShu vasanti niyatavratAH
shlokas.3:
teShAmapi vidhiM puNyaM shrotumichChAmi sha~Nkara |
vAnaprastheShu devesha svasharIropajIviShu
shlokas.4:
maheshvara uvAcha||
vAnaprastheShu yo dharmastaM me shRRiNu samAhitA |
shrutvA chaikamanA devi dharmabuddhiparA bhava
shlokas.5:
sa.nsiddhairniyataiH sadbhirvanavAsamupAgataiH |
vAnaprasthairidaM karma kartavyaM shRRiNu yAdRRisham
shlokas.6:
trikAlamabhiShekArthaH pitRRidevArchanaM kriyA |
agnihotraparispanda iShTihomavidhistathA
shlokas.7:
nIvAragrahaNaM chaiva phalamUlaniShevaNam |
i~NgudairaNDatailAnAM snehArthaM cha niShevaNam
shlokas.8:
yogacharyAkRRitaiH siddhaiH kAmakrodhavivarjanam |
vIrashayyAmupAsadbhirvIrasthAnopasevibhiH
shlokas.9:
yuktairyogavahaiH sadbhirgrIShme pa~nchatapaistathA |
maNDUkayoganiyatairyathAnyAyaniShevibhiH
shlokas.10:
vIrAsanagatairnityaM sthaNDile shayanaistathA |
shItayogo.agniyogashcha chartavyo dharmabuddhibhiH
shlokas.11:
abbhakShairvAyubhakShaishcha shaivAlottarabhojanaiH |
ashmakuTTaistathA dAntaiH samprakShAlaistathAparaiH
shlokas.12:
chIravalkalasa.nvItairmRRigacharmanivAsibhiH |
kAryA yAtrA yathAkAlaM yathAdharmaM yathAvidhi
shlokas.13:
vananityairvanacharairvanapairvanagocharaiH |
vanaM gurumivAsAdya vastavyaM vanajIvibhiH
shlokas.14:
teShAM homakriyA dharmaH pa~nchayaj~naniShevaNam |
nAgapa~nchamayaj~nasya vedoktasyAnupAlanam
shlokas.15:
aShTamIyaj~naparatA chAturmAsyaniShevaNam |
paurNamAsyAM tu yo yaj~no nityayaj~nastathaiva cha
shlokas.16:
vimuktA dArasa.nyogairvimuktAH sarvasa~NkaraiH |
vimuktAH sarvapApaishcha charanti munayo vane
shlokas.17:
srugbhANDaparamA nityaM tretAgnisharaNAH sadA |
santaH satpathanityA ye te yAnti paramAM gatim
shlokas.18:
brahmalokaM mahApuNyaM somalokaM cha shAshvatam |
gachChanti munayaH siddhA RRiShidharmavyapAshrayAt
shlokas.19:
eSha dharmo mayA devi vAnaprasthAshritaH shubhaH |
vistareNArthasampanno yathAsthUlamudAhRRitaH
shlokas.20:
umovAcha||
bhagavandevadevesha sarvabhUtanamaskRRita |
yo dharmo munisa~Nghasya siddhivAdeShu taM vada
shlokas.21:
siddhivAdeShu sa.nsiddhAstathA vananivAsinaH |
svairiNo dArasa.nyuktAsteShAM dharmaH kathaM smRRitaH
shlokas.22:
maheshvara uvAcha||
svairiNastApasA devi sarve dAravihAriNaH |
teShAM mauNDyaM kaShAyashcha vAsarAtrishcha kAraNam
shlokas.23:
trikAlamabhiShekashcha hotraM tvRRiShikRRitaM mahat |
samAdhiH satpathasthAnaM yathoditaniShevaNam
shlokas.24:
ye cha te pUrvakathitA dharmA vananivAsinAm |
yadi sevanti dharmA.nstAnApnuvanti tapaHphalam
shlokas.25:
ye cha dampatidharmANaH svadAraniyatendriyAH |
charanti vidhidRRiShTaM tadRRitukAlAbhigAminaH
shlokas.26:
teShAmRRiShikRRito dharmo dharmiNAmupapadyate |
na kAmakArAtkAmo.anyaH sa.nsevyo dharmadarshibhiH
shlokas.27:
sarvabhUteShu yaH samyagdadAtyabhayadakShiNAm |
hi.nsAroShavimuktAtmA sa vai dharmeNa yujyate
shlokas.28:
sarvabhUtAnukampI yaH sarvabhUtArjavavrataH |
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtashcha sa vai dharmeNa yujyate
shlokas.29:
sarvavedeShu vA snAnaM sarvabhUteShu chArjavam |
ubhe ete same syAtAmArjavaM vA vishiShyate
shlokas.30:
ArjavaM dharma ityAhuradharmo jihma uchyate |
Arjaveneha sa.nyukto naro dharmeNa yujyate
shlokas.31:
Arjavo bhuvane nityaM vasatyamarasaMnidhau |
tasmAdArjavanityaH syAdya ichCheddharmamAtmanaH
shlokas.32:
kShAnto dAnto jitakrodho dharmabhUto.avihi.nsakaH |
dharme ratamanA nityaM naro dharmeNa yujyate
shlokas.33:
vyapetatandro dharmAtmA shakyA satpathamAshritaH |
chAritraparamo buddho brahmabhUyAya kalpate
shlokas.34:
umovAcha||
AshramAbhiratA deva tApasA ye tapodhanAH |
dIptimantaH kayA chaiva charyayAtha bhavanti te
shlokas.35:
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha nirdhanA vA mahAdhanAH |
karmaNA kena bhagavanprApnuvanti mahAphalam
shlokas.36:
nityaM sthAnamupAgamya divyachandanarUShitAH |
kena vA karmaNA deva bhavanti vanagocharAH
shlokas.37:
etaM me sa.nshayaM deva tapashcharyAgataM shubham |
sha.nsa sarvamasheSheNa tryakSha tripuranAshana
shlokas.38:
maheshvara uvAcha||
upavAsavratairdAntA ahi.nsrAH satyavAdinaH |
sa.nsiddhAH pretya gandharvaiH saha modantyanAmayAH
shlokas.39:
maNDUkayogashayano yathAsthAnaM yathAvidhi |
dIkShAM charati dharmAtmA sa nAgaiH saha modate
shlokas.40:
shaShpaM mRRigamukhotsRRiShTaM yo mRRigaiH saha sevate |
dIkShito vai mudA yuktaH sa gachChatyamarAvatIm
shlokas.41:
shaivAlaM shIrNaparNaM vA tadvrato yo niShevate |
shItayogavaho nityaM sa gachChetparamAM gatim
shlokas.42:
vAyubhakSho.ambubhakSho vA phalamUlAshano.api vA |
yakSheShvaishvaryamAdhAya modate.apsarasAM gaNaiH
shlokas.43:
agniyogavaho grIShme vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA |
chIrtvA dvAdasha varShANi rAjA bhavati pArthivaH
shlokas.44:
AhAraniyamaM kRRitvA munirdvAdashavArShikam |
maruM sa.nsAdhya yatnena rAjA bhavati pArthivaH
shlokas.45:
sthaNDile shuddhamAkAshaM parigRRihya samantataH |
pravishya cha mudA yukto dIkShAM dvAdashavArShikIm
shlokas.46:
sthaNDilasya phalAnyAhuryAnAni shayanAni cha |
gRRihANi cha mahArhANi chandrashubhrANi bhAmini
shlokas.47:
AtmAnamupajIvanyo niyato niyatAshanaH |
dehaM vAnashane tyaktvA sa svargaM samupAshnute
shlokas.48:
AtmAnamupajIvanyo dIkShAM dvAdashavArShikIm |
tyaktvA mahArNave dehaM vAruNaM lokamashnute
shlokas.49:
AtmAnamupajIvanyo dIkShAM dvAdashavArShikIm |
ashmanA charaNau bhittvA guhyakeShu sa modate
shlokas.50:
sAdhayitvAtmanAtmAnaM nirdva.ndvo niShparigrahaH |
chIrtvA dvAdasha varShANi dIkShAmekAM manogatAm
svargalokamavApnoti devaishcha saha modate
shlokas.51:
AtmAnamupajIvanyo dIkShAM dvAdashavArShikIm |
hutvAgnau dehamutsRRijya vahniloke mahIyate
shlokas.52:
yastu devi yathAnyAyaM dIkShito niyato dvijaH |
AtmanyAtmAnamAdhAya nirdva.ndvo niShparigrahaH
shlokas.53:
chIrtvA dvAdasha varShANi dIkShAmekAM manogatAm |
araNIsahitaM skandhe baddhvA gachChatyanAvRRitaH
shlokas.54:
vIrAdhvAnamanA nityaM vIrAsanaratastathA |
vIrasthAyI cha satataM sa vIragatimApnuyAt
shlokas.55:
sa shakralokago nityaM sarvakAmapuraskRRitaH |
divyapuShpasamAkIrNo divyachandanabhUShitaH
sukhaM vasati dharmAtmA divi devagaNaiH saha
shlokas.56:
vIralokagato vIro vIrayogavahaH sadA |
sattvasthaH sarvamutsRRijya dIkShito niyataH shuchiH
vIrAdhvAnaM prapadyedyastasya lokAH sanAtanAH
shlokas.57:
kAmagena vimAnena sa vai charati chChandataH |
shakralokagataH shrImAnmodate cha nirAmayaH

shlokas.1:
umovAcha||
bhagavanbhaganetraghna pUShNo dashanapAtana |
dakShakratuhara tryakSha sa.nshayo me mahAnayam
shlokas.2:
chAturvarNyaM bhagavatA pUrvaM sRRiShTaM svayambhuvA |
kena karmavipAkena vaishyo gachChati shUdratAm
shlokas.3:
vaishyo vA kShatriyaH kena dvijo vA kShatriyo bhavet |
pratilomaH kathaM deva shakyo dharmo niShevitum
shlokas.4:
kena vA karmaNA vipraH shUdrayonau prajAyate |
kShatriyaH shUdratAmeti kena vA karmaNA vibho
shlokas.5:
etaM me sa.nshayaM deva vada bhUtapate.anagha |
trayo varNAH prakRRityeha kathaM brAhmaNyamApnuyuH
shlokas.6:
maheshvara uvAcha||
brAhmaNyaM devi duShprApaM nisargAdbrAhmaNaH shubhe |
kShatriyo vaishyashUdrau vA nisargAditi me matiH
shlokas.7:
karmaNA duShkRRiteneha sthAnAdbhrashyati vai dvijaH |
jyeShThaM varNamanuprApya tasmAdrakSheta vai dvijaH
shlokas.8:
sthito brAhmaNadharmeNa brAhmaNyamupajIvati |
kShatriyo vAtha vaishyo vA brahmabhUyAya gachChati
shlokas.9:
yastu vipratvamutsRRijya kShAtraM dharmaM niShevate |
brAhmaNyAtsa paribhraShTaH kShatrayonau prajAyate
shlokas.10:
vaishyakarma cha yo vipro lobhamohavyapAshrayaH |
brAhmaNyaM durlabhaM prApya karotyalpamatiH sadA
shlokas.11:
sa dvijo vaishyatAmeti vaishyo vA shUdratAmiyAt |
svadharmAtprachyuto viprastataH shUdratvamApnute
shlokas.12:
tatrAsau nirayaM prApto varNabhraShTo bahiShkRRitaH |
brahmalokaparibhraShTaH shUdraH samupajAyate
shlokas.13:
kShatriyo vA mahAbhAge vaishyo vA dharmachAriNi |
svAni karmANyapAhAya shUdrakarmANi sevate
shlokas.14:
svasthAnAtsa paribhraShTo varNasa~NkaratAM gataH |
brAhmaNaH kShatriyo vaishyaH shUdratvaM yAti tAdRRishaH
shlokas.15:
yastu shuddhaH svadharmeNa j~nAnavij~nAnavA~nshuchiH |
dharmaj~no dharmanirataH sa dharmaphalamashnute
shlokas.16:
idaM chaivAparaM devi brahmaNA samudIritam |
adhyAtmaM naiShThikaM sadbhirdharmakAmairniShevyate
shlokas.17:
ugrAnnaM garhitaM devi gaNAnnaM shrAddhasUtakam |
ghuShTAnnaM naiva bhoktavyaM shUdrAnnaM naiva karhichit
shlokas.18:
shUdrAnnaM garhitaM devi devadevairmahAtmabhiH |
pitAmahamukhotsRRiShTaM pramANamiti me matiH
shlokas.19:
shUdrAnnenAvasheSheNa jaThare yo mriyeta vai |
AhitAgnistathA yajvA sa shUdragatibhAgbhavet
shlokas.20:
