tena shUdrAnnasheSheNa brahmasthAnAdapAkRRitaH |
brAhmaNaH shUdratAmeti nAsti tatra vichAraNA
shlokas.21:
yasyAnnenAvasheSheNa jaThare yo mriyeta vai |
tAM tAM yoniM vrajedvipro yasyAnnamupajIvati
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNatvaM shubhaM prApya durlabhaM yo.avamanyate |
abhojyAnnAni chAshnAti sa dvijatvAtpateta vai
shlokas.23:
surApo brahmahA kShudrashchauro bhagnavrato.ashuchiH |
svAdhyAyavarjitaH pApo lubdho naikRRitikaH shaThaH
shlokas.24:
avratI vRRiShalIbhartA kuNDAshI somavikrayI |
nihInasevI vipro hi patati brahmayonitaH
shlokas.25:
gurutalpI gurudveShI gurukutsAratishcha yaH |
brahmadviTchApi patati brAhmaNo brahmayonitaH
shlokas.26:
ebhistu karmabhirdevi shubhairAcharitaistathA |
shUdro brAhmaNatAM gachChedvaishyaH kShatriyatAM vrajet
shlokas.27:
shUdrakarmANi sarvANi yathAnyAyaM yathAvidhi |
shushrUShAM paricharyAM cha jyeShThe varNe prayatnataH
kuryAdavimanAH shUdraH satataM satpathe sthitaH
shlokas.28:
daivatadvijasatkartA sarvAtithyakRRitavrataH |
RRitukAlAbhigAmI cha niyato niyatAshanaH
shlokas.29:
chaukShashchaukShajanAnveShI sheShAnnakRRitabhojanaH |
vRRithAmA.nsAnyabhu~njAnaH shUdro vaishyatvamRRichChati
shlokas.30:
RRitavAganaha.nvAdI nirdva.ndvaH shamakovidaH |
yajate nityayaj~naishcha svAdhyAyaparamaH shuchiH
shlokas.31:
dAnto brAhmaNasatkartA sarvavarNabubhUShakaH |
gRRihasthavratamAtiShThandvikAlakRRitabhojanaH
shlokas.32:
sheShAshI vijitAhAro niShkAmo niraha.nvadaH |
agnihotramupAsa.nshcha juhvAnashcha yathAvidhi
shlokas.33:
sarvAtithyamupAtiShTha~nsheShAnnakRRitabhojanaH |
tretAgnimantravihito vaishyo bhavati vai yadi
sa vaishyaH kShatriyakule shuchau mahati jAyate
shlokas.34:
sa vaishyaH kShatriyo jAto janmaprabhRRiti sa.nskRRitaH |
upanIto vrataparo dvijo bhavati satkRRitaH
shlokas.35:
dadAti yajate yaj~naiH sa.nskRRitairAptadakShiNaiH |
adhIte svargamanvichCha.nstretAgnisharaNaH sadA
shlokas.36:
Artahastaprado nityaM prajA dharmeNa pAlayan |
satyaH satyAni kurute nityaM yaH sukhadarshanaH
shlokas.37:
dharmadaNDo na nirdaNDo dharmakAryAnushAsakaH |
yantritaH kAryakaraNe ShaDbhAgakRRitalakShaNaH
shlokas.38:
grAmyadharmAnna seveta svachChandenArthakovidaH |
RRitukAle tu dharmAtmA patnIM seveta nityadA
shlokas.39:
sarvopavAsI niyataH svAdhyAyaparamaH shuchiH |
barhiShkAntarite nityaM shayAno.agnigRRihe sadA
shlokas.40:
sarvAtithyaM trivargasya kurvANaH sumanAH sadA |
shUdrANAM chAnnakAmAnAM nityaM siddhamiti bruvan
shlokas.41:
svArthAdvA yadi vA kAmAnna ki~nchidupalakShayet |
pitRRidevAtithikRRite sAdhanaM kurute cha yaH
shlokas.42:
svaveshmani yathAnyAyamupAste bhaikShameva cha |
trikAlamagnihotraM cha juhvAno vai yathAvidhi
shlokas.43:
gobrAhmaNahitArthAya raNe chAbhimukho hataH |
tretAgnimantrapUtaM vA samAvishya dvijo bhavet
shlokas.44:
j~nAnavij~nAnasampannaH sa.nskRRito vedapAragaH |
vipro bhavati dharmAtmA kShatriyaH svena karmaNA
shlokas.45:
etaiH karmaphalairdevi nyUnajAtikulodbhavaH |
shUdro.apyAgamasampanno dvijo bhavati sa.nskRRitaH
shlokas.46:
brAhmaNo vApyasadvRRittaH sarvasa~NkarabhojanaH |
brAhmaNyaM puNyamutsRRijya shUdro bhavati tAdRRishaH
shlokas.47:
karmabhiH shuchibhirdevi shuddhAtmA vijitendriyaH |
shUdro.api dvijavatsevya iti brahmAbravItsvayam
shlokas.48:
svabhAvakarma cha shubhaM yatra shUdre.api tiShThati |
vishuddhaH sa dvijAtirvai vij~neya iti me matiH
shlokas.49:
na yonirnApi sa.nskAro na shrutaM na cha saMnatiH |
kAraNAni dvijatvasya vRRittameva tu kAraNam
shlokas.50:
sarvo.ayaM brAhmaNo loke vRRittena tu vidhIyate |
vRRitte sthitashcha sushroNi brAhmaNatvaM nigachChati
shlokas.51:
brAhmaH svabhAvaH kalyANi samaH sarvatra me matiH |
nirguNaM nirmalaM brahma yatra tiShThati sa dvijaH
shlokas.52:
ete yoniphalA devi sthAnabhAganidarshakAH |
svayaM cha varadenoktA brahmaNA sRRijatA prajAH
shlokas.53:
brAhmaNo hi mahatkShetraM loke charati pAdavat |
yattatra bIjaM vapati sA kRRiShiH pAralaukikI
shlokas.54:
mitAshinA sadA bhAvyaM satpathAlambinA sadA |
brAhmamArgamatikramya vartitavyaM bubhUShatA
shlokas.55:
saMhitAdhyAyinA bhAvyaM gRRihe vai gRRihamedhinA |
nityaM svAdhyAyayuktena dAnAdhyayanajIvinA
shlokas.56:
evambhUto hi yo vipraH satataM satpathe sthitaH |
AhitAgniradhIyAno brahmabhUyAya kalpate
shlokas.57:
brAhmaNyameva samprApya rakShitavyaM yatAtmabhiH |
yonipratigrahAdAnaiH karmabhishcha shuchismite
shlokas.58:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yathA shUdro bhaveddvijaH |
brAhmaNo vA chyuto dharmAdyathA shUdratvamApnute

shlokas.1:
umovAcha||
bhagavansarvabhUtesha surAsuranamaskRRita |
dharmAdharme nRRiNAM deva brUhi me sa.nshayaM vibho
shlokas.2:
karmaNA manasA vAchA trividhaM hi naraH sadA |
badhyate bandhanaiH pAshairmuchyate.apyatha vA punaH
shlokas.3:
kena shIlena vA deva karmaNA kIdRRishena vA |
samAchArairguNairvAkyaiH svargaM yAntIha mAnavAH
shlokas.4:
maheshvara uvAcha||
devi dharmArthatattvaj~ne satyanitye dame rate |
sarvaprANihitaH prashnaH shrUyatAM buddhivardhanaH
shlokas.5:
satyadharmaratAH santaH sarvalipsAvivarjitAH |
nAdharmeNa na dharmeNa badhyante Chinnasa.nshayAH
shlokas.6:
pralayotpattitattvaj~nAH sarvaj~nAH samadarshinaH |
vItarAgA vimuchyante puruShAH sarvabandhanaiH
shlokas.7:
karmaNA manasA vAchA ye na hi.nsanti ki~nchana |
ye na sajjanti kasmi.nshchidbadhyante te na karmabhiH
shlokas.8:
prANAtipAtAdviratAH shIlavanto dayAnvitAH |
tulyadveShyapriyA dAntA muchyante karmabandhanaiH
shlokas.9:
sarvabhUtadayAvanto vishvAsyAH sarvajantuShu |
tyaktahi.nsAsamAchArAste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.10:
parasve nirmamA nityaM paradAravivarjakAH |
dharmalabdhArthabhoktAraste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.11:
mAtRRivatsvasRRivachchaiva nityaM duhitRRivachcha ye |
paradAreShu vartante te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.12:
stainyAnnivRRittAH satataM santuShTAH svadhanena cha |
svabhAgyAnyupajIvanti te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.13:
svadAraniratA ye cha RRitukAlAbhigAminaH |
agrAmyasukhabhogAshcha te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.14:
paradAreShu ye nityaM chAritrAvRRitalochanAH |
yatendriyAH shIlaparAste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.15:
eSha devakRRito mArgaH sevitavyaH sadA naraiH |
akaShAyakRRitashchaiva mArgaH sevyaH sadA budhaiH
shlokas.16:
dAnadharmatapoyuktaH shIlashauchadayAtmakaH |
vRRittyarthaM dharmahetorvA sevitavyaH sadA naraiH
svargavAsamabhIpsadbhirna sevyastvata uttaraH
shlokas.17:
umovAcha||
vAchAtha badhyate yena muchyate.apyatha vA punaH |
tAni karmANi me deva vada bhUtapate.anagha
shlokas.18:
maheshvara uvAcha||
AtmahetoH parArthe vA narmahAsyAshrayAttathA |
ye mRRiShA na vadantIha te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.19:
vRRittyarthaM dharmahetorvA kAmakArAttathaiva cha |
anRRitaM ye na bhAShante te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.20:
shlakShNAM vANIM nirAbAdhAM madhurAM pApavarjitAm |
svAgatenAbhibhAShante te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.21:
kaTukAM ye na bhAShante paruShAM niShThurAM giram |
apaishunyaratAH santaste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.22:
pishunAM ye na bhAShante mitrabhedakarIM giram |
RRitAM maitrIM prabhAShante te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.23:
varjayanti sadA sUchyaM paradrohaM cha mAnavAH |
sarvabhUtasamA dAntAste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.24:
shaThapralApAdviratA viruddhaparivarjakAH |
saumyapralApino nityaM te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.25:
na kopAdvyAharante ye vAchaM hRRidayadAraNIm |
sAntvaM vadanti kruddhApi te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.26:
eSha vANIkRRito devi dharmaH sevyaH sadA naraiH |
shubhaH satyaguNo nityaM varjanIyA mRRiShA budhaiH
shlokas.27:
umovAcha||
manasA badhyate yena karmaNA puruShaH sadA |
tanme brUhi mahAbhAga devadeva pinAkadhRRik
shlokas.28:
maheshvara uvAcha||
mAnaseneha dharmeNa sa.nyuktAH puruShAH sadA |
svargaM gachChanti kalyANi tanme kIrtayataH shRRiNu
shlokas.29:
duShpraNItena manasA duShpraNItatarAkRRitiH |
badhyate mAnavo yena shRRiNu chAnyachChubhAnane
shlokas.30:
araNye vijane nyastaM parasvaM vIkShya ye narAH |
manasApi na hi.nsanti te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.31:
grAme gRRihe vA yaddravyaM pArakyaM vijane sthitam |
nAbhinandanti vai nityaM te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.32:
tathaiva paradArAnye kAmavRRittAnrahogatAn |
manasApi na hi.nsanti te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.33:
shatruM mitraM cha ye nityaM tulyena manasA narAH |
bhajanti maitrAH sa~Ngamya te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.34:
shrutavanto dayAvantaH shuchayaH satyasa~NgarAH |
svairarthaiH parisantuShTAste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.35:
avairA ye tvanAyAsA maitrachittaparAH sadA |
sarvabhUtadayAvantaste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.36:
shraddhAvanto dayAvantashchokShAshchokShajanapriyAH |
dharmAdharmavido nityaM te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.37:
shubhAnAmashubhAnAM cha karmaNAM phalasa~nchaye |
vipAkaj~nAshcha ye devi te narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.38:
nyAyopetA guNopetA devadvijaparAH sadA |
samatAM samanuprAptAste narAH svargagAminaH
shlokas.39:
shubhaiH karmaphalairdevi mayaite parikIrtitAH |
svargamArgopagA bhUyaH kimanyachChrotumichChasi
shlokas.40:
umovAcha||
mahAnme sa.nshayaH kashchinmartyAnprati maheshvara |
tasmAttaM naipuNenAdya mamAkhyAtuM tvamarhasi
shlokas.41:
kenAyurlabhate dIrghaM karmaNA puruShaH prabho |
tapasA vApi devesha kenAyurlabhate mahat
shlokas.42:
kShINAyuH kena bhavati karmaNA bhuvi mAnavaH |
vipAkaM karmaNAM deva vaktumarhasyanindita
shlokas.43:
apare cha mahAbhogA mandabhogAstathApare |
akulInAstathA chAnye kulInAshcha tathApare
shlokas.44:
durdarshAH kechidAbhAnti narAH kAShThamayA iva |
priyadarshAstathA chAnye darshanAdeva mAnavAH
shlokas.45:
duShpraj~nAH kechidAbhAnti kechidAbhAnti paNDitAH |
mahApraj~nAstathaivAnye j~nAnavij~nAnadarshinaH
shlokas.46:
alpAbAdhAstathA kechinmahAbAdhAstathApare |
dRRishyante puruShA deva tanme sha.nsitumarhasi
shlokas.47:
maheshvara uvAcha||
hanta te.ahaM pravakShyAmi devi karmaphalodayam |
martyaloke narAH sarve yena svaM bhu~njate phalam
shlokas.48:
prANAtipAtI yo raudro daNDahastodyatastathA |
nityamudyatadaNDashcha hanti bhUtagaNAnnaraH
shlokas.49:
nirdayaH sarvabhUtAnAM nityamudvegakArakaH |
api kITapipIlAnAmasharaNyaH sunirghRRiNaH
shlokas.50:
evambhUto naro devi nirayaM pratipadyate |
viparItastu dharmAtmA rUpavAnabhijAyate
shlokas.51:
nirayaM yAti hi.nsAtmA yAti svargamahi.nsakaH |
yAtanAM niraye raudrAM sa kRRichChrAM labhate naraH
shlokas.52:
atha chennirayAttasmAtsamuttarati karhichit |
mAnuShyaM labhate chApi hInAyustatra jAyate
shlokas.53:
pApena karmaNA devi baddho hi.nsAratirnaraH |
apriyaH sarvabhUtAnAM hInAyurupajAyate
shlokas.54:
yastu shuklAbhijAtIyaH prANighAtavivarjakaH |
nikShiptadaNDo nirdaNDo na hinasti kadAchana
shlokas.55:
na ghAtayati no hanti ghnantaM naivAnumodate |
sarvabhUteShu sasneho yathAtmani tathApare
shlokas.56:
IdRRishaH puruShotkarSho devi devatvamashnute |
upapannAnsukhAnbhogAnupAshnAti mudA yutaH
shlokas.57:
atha chenmAnuShe loke kadAchidupapadyate |
tatra dIrghAyurutpannaH sa naraH sukhamedhate
shlokas.58:
evaM dIrghAyuShAM mArgaH suvRRittAnAM sukarmaNAm |
prANihi.nsAvimokSheNa brahmaNA samudIritaH

shlokas.1:
umovAcha||
ki.nshIlAH ki.nsamAchArAH puruShAH kaishcha karmabhiH |
svargaM samabhipadyante sampradAnena kena vA
shlokas.2:
maheshvara uvAcha||
dAtA brAhmaNasatkartA dInAndhakRRipaNAdiShu |
bhakShyabhojyAnnapAnAnAM vAsasAM cha pradAyakaH
shlokas.3:
pratishrayAnsabhAH kUpAnprapAH puShkariNIstathA |
naityakAni cha sarvANi kimichChakamatIva cha
shlokas.4:
AsanaM shayanaM yAnaM dhanaM ratnaM gRRihA.nstathA |
sasyajAtAni sarvANi gAH kShetrANyatha yoShitaH
shlokas.5:
supratItamanA nityaM yaH prayachChati mAnavaH |
evambhUto mRRito devi devaloke.abhijAyate
shlokas.6:
tatroShya suchiraM kAlaM bhuktvA bhogAnanuttamAn |
sahApsarobhirmudito ramitvA nandanAdiShu
shlokas.7:
tasmAtsvargAchchyuto lokAnmAnuSheShUpajAyate |
mahAbhoge kule devi dhanadhAnyasamAchite
shlokas.8:
tatra kAmaguNaiH sarvaiH samupeto mudA yutaH |
mahAbhogo mahAkosho dhanI bhavati mAnavaH
shlokas.9:
ete devi mahAbhogAH prANino dAnashIlinaH |
brahmaNA vai purA proktAH sarvasya priyadarshanAH
shlokas.10:
apare mAnavA devi pradAnakRRipaNA dvijaiH |
yAchitA na prayachChanti vidyamAne.apyabuddhayaH
shlokas.11:
dInAndhakRRipaNAndRRiShTvA bhikShukAnatithInapi |
yAchyamAnA nivartante jihvAlobhasamanvitAH
shlokas.12:
na dhanAni na vAsA.nsi na bhogAnna cha kA~nchanam |
na gAvo nAnnavikRRitiM prayachChanti kadAchana
shlokas.13:
apravRRittAstu ye lubdhA nAstikA dAnavarjitAH |
evambhUtA narA devi nirayaM yAntyabuddhayaH
shlokas.14:
te chenmanuShyatAM yAnti yadA kAlasya paryayAt |
dhanarikte kule janma labhante svalpabuddhayaH
shlokas.15:
kShutpipAsAparItAshcha sarvabhogabahiShkRRitAH |
nirAshAH sarvabhogebhyo jIvantyadhamajIvikAm
shlokas.16:
alpabhogakule jAtA alpabhogaratA narAH |
anena karmaNA devi bhavantyadhanino narAH
shlokas.17:
apare stambhino nityaM mAninaH pApato ratAH |
AsanArhasya ye pIThaM na prayachChantyachetasaH
shlokas.18:
mArgArhasya cha ye mArgaM na yachChantyalpabuddhayaH |
pAdyArhasya cha ye pAdyaM na dadatyalpabuddhayaH
shlokas.19:
arghArhAnna cha satkArairarchayanti yathAvidhi |
arghyamAchamanIyaM vA na yachChantyalpabuddhayaH
shlokas.20:
guruM chAbhigataM premNA guruvanna bubhUShate |
abhimAnapravRRittena lobhena samavasthitAH
shlokas.21:
saMmAnyA.nshchAvamanyante vRRiddhAnparibhavanti cha |
eva.nvidhA narA devi sarve nirayagAminaH
shlokas.22:
te vai yadi narAstasmAnnirayAduttaranti vai |
varShapUgaistato janma labhante kutsite kule
shlokas.23:
shvapAkapulkasAdInAM kutsitAnAmachetasAm |
kuleShu teShu jAyante guruvRRiddhApachAyinaH
shlokas.24:
na stambhI na cha mAnI yo devatAdvijapUjakaH |
lokapUjyo namaskartA prashrito madhuraM vadan
shlokas.25:
sarvavarNapriyakaraH sarvabhUtahitaH sadA |
adveShI sumukhaH shlakShNaH snigdhavANIpradaH sadA
shlokas.26:
svAgatenaiva sarveShAM bhUtAnAmavihi.nsakaH |
yathArhasatkriyApUrvamarchayannupatiShThati
shlokas.27:
mArgArhAya dadanmArgaM guruM guruvadarchayan |
atithipragraharatastathAbhyAgatapUjakaH
shlokas.28:
evambhUto naro devi svargatiM pratipadyate |
tato mAnuShatAM prApya vishiShTakulajo bhavet
shlokas.29:
tatrAsau vipulairbhogaiH sarvaratnasamAyutaH |
yathArhadAtA chArheShu dharmacharyAparo bhavet
shlokas.30:
saMmataH sarvabhUtAnAM sarvalokanamaskRRitaH |
svakarmaphalamApnoti svayameva naraH sadA
shlokas.31:
udAttakulajAtIya udAttAbhijanaH sadA |
eSha dharmo mayA prokto vidhAtrA svayamIritaH
shlokas.32:
yastu raudrasamAchAraH sarvasattvabhaya~NkaraH |
hastAbhyAM yadi vA padbhyAM rajjvA daNDena vA punaH
shlokas.33:
loShTaiH stambhairupAyairvA jantUnbAdhati shobhane |
hi.nsArthaM nikRRitipraj~naH prodvejayati chaiva ha
shlokas.34:
upakrAmati jantU.nshcha udvegajananaH sadA |
eva.nshIlasamAchAro nirayaM pratipadyate
shlokas.35:
sa chenmAnuShatAM gachChedyadi kAlasya paryayAt |
bahvAbAdhaparikliShTe so.adhame jAyate kule
shlokas.36:
lokadveShyo.adhamaH pu.nsAM svayaM karmakRRitaiH phalaiH |
eSha devi manuShyeShu boddhavyo j~nAtibandhuShu
shlokas.37:
aparaH sarvabhUtAni dayAvAnanupashyati |
maitradRRiShTiH pitRRisamo nirvairo niyatendriyaH
shlokas.38:
nodvejayati bhUtAni na vihi.nsayate tathA |
hastapAdaiH suniyatairvishvAsyaH sarvajantuShu
shlokas.39:
na rajjvA na cha daNDena na loShTairnAyudhena cha |
udvejayati bhUtAni shlakShNakarmA dayAparaH
shlokas.40:
eva.nshIlasamAchAraH svarge samupajAyate |
tatrAsau bhavane divye mudA vasati devavat
shlokas.41:
sa chetkarmakShayAnmartyo manuShyeShUpajAyate |
alpAbAdho nirItIkaH sa jAtaH sukhamedhate
shlokas.42:
sukhabhAgI nirAyAso nirudvegaH sadA naraH |
eSha devi satAM mArgo bAdhA yatra na vidyate
shlokas.43:
umovAcha||
ime manuShyA dRRishyante UhApohavishAradAH |
j~nAnavij~nAnasampannAH praj~nAvanto.arthakovidAH
duShpraj~nAshchApare deva j~nAnavij~nAnavarjitAH
shlokas.44:
kena karmavipAkena praj~nAvAnpuruSho bhavet |
alpapraj~no virUpAkSha kathaM bhavati mAnavaH
etaM me sa.nshayaM Chinddhi sarvadharmavidAM vara
shlokas.45:
jAtyandhAshchApare deva rogArtAshchApare tathA |
narAH klIbAshcha dRRishyante kAraNaM brUhi tatra vai
shlokas.46:
maheshvara uvAcha||
brAhmaNAnvedaviduShaH siddhAndharmavidastathA |
paripRRichChantyaharahaH kushalAkushalaM tathA
shlokas.47:
varjayantyashubhaM karma sevamAnAH shubhaM tathA |
labhante svargatiM nityamiha loke sukhaM tathA
shlokas.48:
sa chenmAnuShatAM yAti medhAvI tatra jAyate |
shrutaM praj~nAnugaM chAsya kalyANamupajAyate
shlokas.49:
paradAreShu ye mUDhAshchakShurduShTaM prayu~njate |
tena duShTasvabhAvena jAtyandhAste bhavanti ha
shlokas.50:
manasA tu praduShTena nagnAM pashyanti ye striyam |
rogArtAste bhavantIha narA duShkRRitakarmiNaH
shlokas.51:
ye tu mUDhA durAchArA viyonau maithune ratAH |
puruSheShu suduShpraj~nAH klIbatvamupayAnti te
shlokas.52:
pashU.nshcha ye bandhayanti ye chaiva gurutalpagAH |
prakIrNamaithunA ye cha klIbA jAyanti te narAH
shlokas.53:
umovAcha||
sAvadyaM kiM nu vai karma niravadyaM tathaiva cha |
shreyaH kurvannavApnoti mAnavo devasattama
shlokas.54:
maheshvara uvAcha||
shreyA.nsaM mArgamAtiShThansadA yaH pRRichChate dvijAn |
dharmAnveShI guNAkA~NkShI sa svargaM samupAshnute
shlokas.55:
yadi mAnuShatAM devi kadAchitsa nigachChati |
medhAvI dhAraNAyuktaH prAj~nastatrAbhijAyate
shlokas.56:
eSha devi satAM dharmo mantavyo bhUtikArakaH |
nRRiNAM hitArthAya tava mayA vai samudAhRRitaH
shlokas.57:
umovAcha||
apare svalpavij~nAnA dharmavidveShiNo narAH |
brAhmaNAnvedaviduSho nechChanti parisarpitum
shlokas.58:
vratavanto narAH kechichChraddhAdamaparAyaNAH |
avratA bhraShTaniyamAstathAnye rAkShasopamAH
shlokas.59:
yajvAnashcha tathaivAnye nirhomAshcha tathApare |
kena karmavipAkena bhavantIha vadasva me
shlokas.60:
maheshvara uvAcha||
AgamAllokadharmANAM maryAdAH pUrvanirmitAH |
prAmANyenAnuvartante dRRishyante hi dRRiDhavratAH
shlokas.61:
adharmaM dharmamityAhurye cha mohavashaM gatAH |
avratA naShTamaryAdAste proktA brahmarAkShasAH
shlokas.62:
te chetkAlakRRitodyogAtsambhavantIha mAnuShAH |
nirhomA nirvaShaTkArAste bhavanti narAdhamAH
shlokas.63:
eSha devi mayA sarvaH sa.nshayachChedanAya te |
kushalAkushalo nR^INAM vyAkhyAto dharmasAgaraH

shlokas.1:
maheshvara uvAcha||
parAvaraj~ne dharmaj~ne tapovananivAsini |
sAdhvi subhru sukeshAnte himavatparvatAtmaje
shlokas.2:
dakShe shamadamopete nirmame dharmachAriNi |
pRRichChAmi tvAM varArohe pRRiShTA vada mamepsitam
shlokas.3:
sAvitrI brahmaNaH sAdhvI kaushikasya shachI satI |
mArtaNDajasya dhUmorNA RRiddhirvaishravaNasya cha
shlokas.4:
varuNasya tato gaurI sUryasya cha suvarchalA |
rohiNI shashinaH sAdhvI svAhA chaiva vibhAvasoH
shlokas.5:
aditiH kashyapasyAtha sarvAstAH patidevatAH |
pRRiShTAshchopAsitAshchaiva tAstvayA devi nityashaH
shlokas.6:
tena tvAM paripRRichChAmi dharmaj~ne dharmavAdini |
strIdharmaM shrotumichChAmi tvayodAhRRitamAditaH
shlokas.7:
sahadharmacharI me tvaM samashIlA samavratA |
samAnasAravIryA cha tapastIvraM kRRitaM cha te
tvayA hyukto visheSheNa pramANatvamupaiShyati
shlokas.8:
striyashchaiva visheSheNa strIjanasya gatiH sadA |
gaurgAM gachChati sushroNi lokeShveShA sthitiH sadA
shlokas.9:
mama chArdhaM sharIrasya mama chArdhAdviniHsRRitA |
surakAryakarI cha tvaM lokasantAnakAriNI
shlokas.10:
tava sarvaH suviditaH strIdharmaH shAshvataH shubhe |
tasmAdasheShato brUhi strIdharmaM vistareNa me
shlokas.11:
umovAcha||
bhagavansarvabhUtesha bhUtabhavyabhavodbhava |
tvatprabhAvAdiyaM deva vAkchaiva pratibhAti me
shlokas.12:
imAstu nadyo devesha sarvatIrthodakairyutAH |
upasparshanahetostvA samIpasthA upAsate
shlokas.13:
etAbhiH saha saMmantrya pravakShyAmyanupUrvashaH |
prabhavanyo.anaha.nvAdI sa vai puruSha uchyate
shlokas.14:
strI cha bhUtesha satataM striyamevAnudhAvati |
mayA saMmAnitAshchaiva bhaviShyanti saridvarAH
shlokas.15:
eShA sarasvatI puNyA nadInAmuttamA nadI |
prathamA sarvasaritAM nadI sAgaragAminI
shlokas.16:
vipAshA cha vitastA cha chandrabhAgA irAvatI |
shatadrurdevikA sindhuH kaushikI gomatI tathA
shlokas.17:
tathA devanadI cheyaM sarvatIrthAbhisa.nvRRitA |
gaganAdgAM gatA devI ga~NgA sarvasaridvarA
shlokas.18:
ityuktvA devadevasya patnI dharmabhRRitAM varA |
smitapUrvamivAbhAShya sarvAstAH saritastadA
shlokas.19:
apRRichChaddevamahiShI strIdharmaM dharmavatsalA |
strIdharmakushalAstA vai ga~NgAdyAH saritAM varAH
shlokas.20:
ayaM bhagavatA dattaH prashnaH strIdharmasa.nshritaH |
taM tu saMmantrya yuShmAbhirvaktumichChAmi sha~Nkare
shlokas.21:
na chaikasAdhyaM pashyAmi vij~nAnaM bhuvi kasyachit |
divi vA sAgaragamAstena vo mAnayAmyaham
shlokas.22:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evaM sarvAH sarichChreShThAH pRRiShTAH puNyatamAH shivAH |
tato devanadI ga~NgA niyuktA pratipUjya tAm
shlokas.23:
bahvIbhirbuddhibhiH sphItA strIdharmaj~nA shuchismitA |
shailarAjasutAM devIM puNyA pApApahAM shivAm
shlokas.24:
buddhyA vinayasampannA sarvaj~nAnavishAradA |
sasmitaM bahubuddhyADhyA ga~NgA vachanamabravIt
shlokas.25:
dhanyAH smo.anugRRihItAH smo devi dharmaparAyaNA |
yA tvaM sarvajaganmAnyA nadIrmAnayase.anaghe
shlokas.26:
prabhavanpRRichChate yo hi saMmAnayati vA punaH |
nUnaM janamaduShTAtmA paNDitAkhyAM sa gachChati
shlokas.27:
j~nAnavij~nAnasampannAnUhApohavishAradAn |
pravaktR^InpRRichChate yo.anyAnsa vai nA padamarchChati
shlokas.28:
anyathA bahubuddhyADhyo vAkyaM vadati sa.nsadi |
anyathaiva hyahaMmAnI durbalaM vadate vachaH
shlokas.29:
divyaj~nAne divi shreShThe divyapuNye sadotthite |
tvamevArhasi no devi strIdharmamanushAsitum
shlokas.30:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH sArAdhitA devI ga~NgayA bahubhirguNaiH |
prAha sarvamasheSheNa strIdharmaM surasundarI
shlokas.31:
strIdharmo mAM prati yathA pratibhAti yathAvidhi |
tamahaM kIrtayiShyAmi tathaiva prathito bhavet
shlokas.32:
strIdharmaH pUrva evAyaM vivAhe bandhubhiH kRRitaH |
sahadharmacharI bharturbhavatyagnisamIpataH
shlokas.33:
susvabhAvA suvachanA suvRRittA sukhadarshanA |
ananyachittA sumukhI bhartuH sA dharmachAriNI
shlokas.34:
sA bhaveddharmaparamA sA bhaveddharmabhAginI |
devavatsatataM sAdhvI yA bhartAraM prapashyati
shlokas.35:
shushrUShAM parichAraM cha devavadyA karoti cha |
nAnyabhAvA hyavimanAH suvratA sukhadarshanA
shlokas.36:
putravaktramivAbhIkShNaM bharturvadanamIkShate |
yA sAdhvI niyatAchArA sA bhaveddharmachAriNI
shlokas.37:
shrutvA dampatidharmaM vai sahadharmakRRitaM shubham |
ananyachittA sumukhI bhartuH sA dharmachAriNI
shlokas.38:
paruShANyapi choktA yA dRRiShTA vA krUrachakShuShA |
suprasannamukhI bharturyA nArI sA pativratA
shlokas.39:
na chandrasUryau na taruM puMnAmno yA nirIkShate |
bhartRRivarjaM varArohA sA bhaveddharmachAriNI
shlokas.40:
daridraM vyAdhitaM dInamadhvanA parikarshitam |
patiM putramivopAste sA nArI dharmabhAginI
shlokas.41:
yA nArI prayatA dakShA yA nArI putriNI bhavet |
patipriyA patiprANA sA nArI dharmabhAginI
shlokas.42:
shushrUShAM paricharyAM cha karotyavimanAH sadA |
supratItA vinItA cha sA nArI dharmabhAginI
shlokas.43:
na kAmeShu na bhogeShu naishvarye na sukhe tathA |
spRRihA yasyA yathA patyau sA nArI dharmabhAginI
shlokas.44:
kalyotthAnaratA nityaM gurushushrUShaNe ratA |
susaMmRRiShTakShayA chaiva goshakRRitkRRitalepanA
shlokas.45:
agnikAryaparA nityaM sadA puShpabalipradA |
devatAtithibhRRityAnAM nirupya patinA saha
shlokas.46:
sheShAnnamupabhu~njAnA yathAnyAyaM yathAvidhi |
tuShTapuShTajanA nityaM nArI dharmeNa yujyate
shlokas.47:
shvashrUshvashurayoH pAdau toShayantI guNAnvitA |
mAtApitRRiparA nityaM yA nArI sA tapodhanA
shlokas.48:
brAhmaNAndurbalAnAthAndInAndhakRRipaNA.nstathA |
bibhartyannena yA nArI sA pativratabhAginI
shlokas.49:
vrataM charati yA nityaM dushcharaM laghusattvayA |
patichittA patihitA sA pativratabhAginI
shlokas.50:
puNyametattapashchaiva svargashchaiSha sanAtanaH |
yA nArI bhartRRiparamA bhavedbhartRRivratA shivA
shlokas.51:
patirhi devo nArINAM patirbandhuH patirgatiH |
patyA samA gatirnAsti daivataM vA yathA patiH
shlokas.52:
patiprasAdaH svargo vA tulyo nAryA na vA bhavet |
ahaM svargaM na hIchCheyaM tvayyaprIte maheshvara
shlokas.53:
yadyakAryamadharmaM vA yadi vA prANanAshanam |
patirbrUyAddaridro vA vyAdhito vA katha~nchana
shlokas.54:
Apanno ripusa.nstho vA brahmashApArdito.api vA |
ApaddharmAnanuprekShya tatkAryamavisha~NkayA
shlokas.55:
eSha deva mayA proktaH strIdharmo vachanAttava |
yA tvevambhAvinI nArI sA bhaveddharmabhAginI
shlokas.56:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tu deveshaH pratipUjya gireH sutAm |
lokAnvisarjayAmAsa sarvairanucharaiH saha
shlokas.57:
tato yayurbhUtagaNAH saritashcha yathAgatam |
gandharvApsarasashchaiva praNamya shirasA bhavam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA dharmAnasheSheNa pAvanAni cha sarvashaH |
yudhiShThiraH shAntanavaM punarevAbhyabhAShata
shlokas.2:
kimekaM daivataM loke kiM vApyekaM parAyaNam |
stuvantaH kaM kamarchantaH prApnuyurmAnavAH shubham
shlokas.3:
ko dharmaH sarvadharmANAM bhavataH paramo mataH |
kiM japanmuchyate janturjanmasa.nsArabandhanAt
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
jagatprabhuM devadevamanantaM puruShottamam |
stuvannAmasahasreNa puruShaH satatotthitaH
shlokas.5:
tameva chArchayannityaM bhaktyA puruShamavyayam |
dhyAyanstuvannamasya.nshcha yajamAnastameva cha
shlokas.6:
anAdinidhanaM viShNuM sarvalokamaheshvaram |
lokAdhyakShaM stuvannityaM sarvaduHkhAtigo bhavet
shlokas.7:
brahmaNyaM sarvadharmaj~naM lokAnAM kIrtivardhanam |
lokanAthaM mahadbhUtaM sarvabhUtabhavodbhavam
shlokas.8:
eSha me sarvadharmANAM dharmo.adhikatamo mataH |
yadbhaktyA puNDarIkAkShaM stavairarchennaraH sadA
shlokas.9:
paramaM yo mahattejaH paramaM yo mahattapaH |
paramaM yo mahadbrahma paramaM yaH parAyaNam
shlokas.10:
pavitrANAM pavitraM yo ma~NgalAnAM cha ma~Ngalam |
daivataM devatAnAM cha bhUtAnAM yo.avyayaH pitA
shlokas.11:
yataH sarvANi bhUtAni bhavantyAdiyugAgame |
yasmi.nshcha pralayaM yAnti punareva yugakShaye
shlokas.12:
tasya lokapradhAnasya jagannAthasya bhUpate |
viShNornAmasahasraM me shRRiNu pApabhayApaham
shlokas.13:
yAni nAmAni gauNAni vikhyAtAni mahAtmanaH |
RRiShibhiH parigItAni tAni vakShyAmi bhUtaye
shlokas.14:
vishvaM viShNurvaShaTkAro bhUtabhavyabhavatprabhuH |
bhUtakRRidbhUtabhRRidbhAvo bhUtAtmA bhUtabhAvanaH
shlokas.15:
pUtAtmA paramAtmA cha muktAnAM paramA gatiH |
avyayaH puruShaH sAkShI kShetraj~no.akShara eva cha
shlokas.16:
yogo yogavidAM netA pradhAnapuruSheshvaraH |
nArasiMhavapuH shrImAnkeshavaH puruShottamaH
shlokas.17:
sarvaH sharvaH shivaH sthANurbhUtAdirnidhiravyayaH |
sambhavo bhAvano bhartA prabhavaH prabhurIshvaraH
shlokas.18:
svayambhUH shambhurAdityaH puShkarAkSho mahAsvanaH |
anAdinidhano dhAtA vidhAtA dhAturuttamaH
shlokas.19:
aprameyo hRRiShIkeshaH padmanAbho.amaraprabhuH |
vishvakarmA manustvaShTA sthaviShThaH sthaviro dhruvaH
shlokas.20:
agrAhyaH shAshvataH kRRiShNo lohitAkShaH pratardanaH |
prabhUtastrikakubdhAma pavitraM ma~NgalaM param
shlokas.21:
IshAnaH prANadaH prANo jyeShThaH shreShThaH prajApatiH |
hiraNyagarbho bhUgarbho mAdhavo madhusUdanaH
shlokas.22:
Ishvaro vikramI dhanvI medhAvI vikramaH kramaH |
anuttamo durAdharShaH kRRitaj~naH kRRitirAtmavAn
shlokas.23:
sureshaH sharaNaM sharma vishvaretAH prajAbhavaH |
ahaH sa.nvatsaro vyAlaH pratyayaH sarvadarshanaH
shlokas.24:
ajaH sarveshvaraH siddhaH siddhiH sarvAdirachyutaH |
vRRiShAkapirameyAtmA sarvayogaviniHsRRitaH
shlokas.25:
vasurvasumanAH satyaH samAtmA saMmitaH samaH |
amoghaH puNDarIkAkSho vRRiShakarmA vRRiShAkRRitiH
shlokas.26:
rudro bahushirA babhrurvishvayoniH shuchishravAH |
amRRitaH shAshvataH sthANurvarAroho mahAtapAH
shlokas.27:
sarvagaH sarvavidbhAnurviShvakseno janArdanaH |
vedo vedavidavya~Ngo vedA~Ngo vedavitkaviH
shlokas.28:
lokAdhyakShaH surAdhyakSho dharmAdhyakShaH kRRitAkRRitaH |
chaturAtmA chaturvyUhashchaturdaMShTrashchaturbhujaH
shlokas.29:
bhrAjiShNurbhojanaM bhoktA sahiShNurjagadAdijaH |
anagho vijayo jetA vishvayoniH punarvasuH
shlokas.30:
upendro vAmanaH prA.nshuramoghaH shuchirUrjitaH |
atIndraH sa~NgrahaH sargo dhRRitAtmA niyamo yamaH
shlokas.31:
vedyo vaidyaH sadAyogI vIrahA mAdhavo madhuH |
atIndriyo mahAmAyo mahotsAho mahAbalaH
shlokas.32:
mahAbuddhirmahAvIryo mahAshaktirmahAdyutiH |
anirdeshyavapuH shrImAnameyAtmA mahAdridhRRik
shlokas.33:
maheShvAso mahIbhartA shrInivAsaH satAM gatiH |
aniruddhaH surAnando govindo govidAM patiH
shlokas.34:
marIchirdamano ha.nsaH suparNo bhujagottamaH |
hiraNyanAbhaH sutapAH padmanAbhaH prajApatiH
shlokas.35:
amRRityuH sarvadRRiksiMhaH sandhAtA sandhimAnsthiraH |
ajo durmarShaNaH shAstA vishrutAtmA surArihA
shlokas.36:
gururgurutamo dhAma satyaH satyaparAkramaH |
nimiSho.animiShaH sragvI vAchaspatirudAradhIH
shlokas.37:
agraNIrgrAmaNIH shrImAnnyAyo netA samIraNaH |
sahasramUrdhA vishvAtmA sahasrAkShaH sahasrapAt
shlokas.38:
Avartano nivRRittAtmA sa.nvRRitaH sampramardanaH |
ahaH sa.nvartako vahniranilo dharaNIdharaH
shlokas.39:
suprasAdaH prasannAtmA vishvadhRRigvishvabhugvibhuH |
satkartA satkRRitaH sAdhurjahnurnArAyaNo naraH
shlokas.40:
asa~Nkhyeyo.aprameyAtmA vishiShTaH shiShTakRRichChuchiH |
siddhArthaH siddhasa~NkalpaH siddhidaH siddhisAdhanaH
shlokas.41:
vRRiShAhI vRRiShabho viShNurvRRiShaparvA vRRiShodaraH |
vardhano vardhamAnashcha viviktaH shrutisAgaraH
shlokas.42:
subhujo durdharo vAgmI mahendro vasudo vasuH |
naikarUpo bRRihadrUpaH shipiviShTaH prakAshanaH
shlokas.43:
ojastejo dyutidharaH prakAshAtmA pratApanaH |
RRiddhaH spaShTAkSharo mantrashchandrA.nshurbhAskaradyutiH
shlokas.44:
amRRitA.nshUdbhavo bhAnuH shashabinduH sureshvaraH |
auShadhaM jagataH setuH satyadharmaparAkramaH
shlokas.45:
bhUtabhavyabhavannAthaH pavanaH pAvano.anilaH |
kAmahA kAmakRRitkAntaH kAmaH kAmapradaH prabhuH
shlokas.46:
yugAdikRRidyugAvarto naikamAyo mahAshanaH |
adRRishyo vyaktarUpashcha sahasrajidanantajit
shlokas.47:
iShTo vishiShTaH shiShTeShTaH shikhaNDI nahuSho vRRiShaH |
krodhahA krodhakRRitkartA vishvabAhurmahIdharaH
shlokas.48:
achyutaH prathitaH prANaH prANado vAsavAnujaH |
apAM nidhiradhiShThAnamapramattaH pratiShThitaH
shlokas.49:
skandaH skandadharo dhuryo varado vAyuvAhanaH |
vAsudevo bRRihadbhAnurAdidevaH pura.ndaraH
shlokas.50:
ashokastAraNastAraH shUraH shaurirjaneshvaraH |
anukUlaH shatAvartaH padmI padmanibhekShaNaH
shlokas.51:
padmanAbho.aravindAkShaH padmagarbhaH sharIrabhRRit |
maharddhirRRiddho vRRiddhAtmA mahAkSho garuDadhvajaH
shlokas.52:
atulaH sharabho bhImaH samayaj~no havirhariH |
sarvalakShaNalakShaNyo lakShmIvAnsamiti~njayaH
shlokas.53:
vikSharo rohito mArgo heturdAmodaraH sahaH |
mahIdharo mahAbhAgo vegavAnamitAshanaH
shlokas.54:
udbhavaH kShobhaNo devaH shrIgarbhaH parameshvaraH |
karaNaM kAraNaM kartA vikartA gahano guhaH
shlokas.55:
vyavasAyo vyavasthAnaH sa.nsthAnaH sthAnado dhruvaH |
pararddhiH paramaH spaShTastuShTaH puShTaH shubhekShaNaH
shlokas.56:
rAmo virAmo virato mArgo neyo nayo.anayaH |
vIraH shaktimatAM shreShTho dharmo dharmaviduttamaH
shlokas.57:
vaikuNThaH puruShaH prANaH prANadaH praNavaH pRRithuH |
hiraNyagarbhaH shatrughno vyApto vAyuradhokShajaH
shlokas.58:
RRituH sudarshanaH kAlaH parameShThI parigrahaH |
ugraH sa.nvatsaro dakSho vishrAmo vishvadakShiNaH
shlokas.59:
vistAraH sthAvaraH sthANuH pramANaM bIjamavyayam |
artho.anartho mahAkosho mahAbhogo mahAdhanaH
shlokas.60:
anirviNNaH sthaviShTho bhUrdharmayUpo mahAmakhaH |
nakShatranemirnakShatrI kShamaH kShAmaH samIhanaH
shlokas.61:
yaj~na ijyo mahejyashcha kratuH satraM satAM gatiH |
sarvadarshI vimuktAtmA sarvaj~no j~nAnamuttamam
shlokas.62:
suvrataH sumukhaH sUkShmaH sughoShaH sukhadaH suhRRit |
manoharo jitakrodho vIrabAhurvidAraNaH
shlokas.63:
svApanaH svavasho vyApI naikAtmA naikakarmakRRit |
vatsaro vatsalo vatsI ratnagarbho dhaneshvaraH
shlokas.64:
dharmagubdharmakRRiddharmI sadasatkSharamakSharam |
avij~nAtA sahasrA.nshurvidhAtA kRRitalakShaNaH
shlokas.65:
gabhastinemiH sattvasthaH siMho bhUtamaheshvaraH |
Adidevo mahAdevo devesho devabhRRidguruH
shlokas.66:
uttaro gopatirgoptA j~nAnagamyaH purAtanaH |
sharIrabhUtabhRRidbhoktA kapIndro bhUridakShiNaH
shlokas.67:
somapo.amRRitapaH somaH purujitpurusattamaH |
vinayo jayaH satyasandho dAshArhaH sAtvatAM patiH
shlokas.68:
jIvo vinayitA sAkShI mukundo.amitavikramaH |
ambhonidhiranantAtmA mahodadhishayo.antakaH
shlokas.69:
ajo mahArhaH svAbhAvyo jitAmitraH pramodanaH |
Anando nandano nandaH satyadharmA trivikramaH
shlokas.70:
maharShiH kapilAchAryaH kRRitaj~no medinIpatiH |
tripadastridashAdhyakSho mahAshRRi~NgaH kRRitAntakRRit
shlokas.71:
mahAvarAho govindaH suSheNaH kanakA~NgadI |
guhyo gabhIro gahano guptashchakragadAdharaH
shlokas.72:
vedhAH svA~Ngo.ajitaH kRRiShNo dRRiDhaH sa~NkarShaNo.achyutaH |
varuNo vAruNo vRRikShaH puShkarAkSho mahAmanAH
shlokas.73:
bhagavAnbhagahA nandI vanamAlI halAyudhaH |
Adityo jyotirAdityaH sahiShNurgatisattamaH
shlokas.75:
trisAmA sAmagaH sAma nirvANaM bheShajaM bhiShak |
saMnyAsakRRichChamaH shAnto niShThA shAntiH parAyaNam
shlokas.76:
shubhA~NgaH shAntidaH sraShTA kumudaH kuvaleshayaH |
gohito gopatirgoptA vRRiShabhAkSho vRRiShapriyaH
shlokas.77:
anivartI nivRRittAtmA sa~NkSheptA kShemakRRichChivaH |
shrIvatsavakShAH shrIvAsaH shrIpatiH shrImatAM varaH
shlokas.78:
shrIdaH shrIshaH shrInivAsaH shrInidhiH shrIvibhAvanaH |
shrIdharaH shrIkaraH shreyaH shrImA.NllokatrayAshrayaH
shlokas.79:
svakShaH sva~NgaH shatAnando nandirjyotirgaNeshvaraH |
vijitAtmA vidheyAtmA satkIrtishChinnasa.nshayaH
shlokas.80:
udIrNaH sarvatashchakShuranIshaH shAshvataH sthiraH |
bhUshayo bhUShaNo bhUtirvishokaH shokanAshanaH
shlokas.81:
archiShmAnarchitaH kumbho vishuddhAtmA vishodhanaH |
aniruddho.apratirathaH pradyumno.amitavikramaH
shlokas.82:
kAlaneminihA vIraH shUraH shaurirjaneshvaraH |
trilokAtmA trilokeshaH keshavaH keshihA hariH
shlokas.83:
kAmadevaH kAmapAlaH kAmI kAntaH kRRitAgamaH |
anirdeshyavapurviShNurvIro.ananto dhana~njayaH
shlokas.84:
brahmaNyo brahmakRRidbrahmA brahma brahmavivardhanaH |
brahmavidbrAhmaNo brahmI brahmaj~no brAhmaNapriyaH
shlokas.85:
mahAkramo mahAkarmA mahAtejA mahoragaH |
mahAkraturmahAyajvA mahAyaj~no mahAhaviH
shlokas.86:
stavyaH stavapriyaH stotraM stutiH stotA raNapriyaH |
pUrNaH pUrayitA puNyaH puNyakIrtiranAmayaH
shlokas.87:
manojavastIrthakaro vasuretA vasupradaH |
vasuprado vAsudevo vasurvasumanA haviH
shlokas.88:
sadgatiH satkRRitiH sattA sadbhUtiH satparAyaNaH |
shUraseno yadushreShThaH sannivAsaH suyAmunaH
shlokas.89:
bhUtAvAso vAsudevo sarvAsunilayo.analaH |
darpahA darpado dRRipto durdharo.athAparAjitaH
shlokas.91:
eko naikaH savaH kaH kiM yattatpadamanuttamam |
lokabandhurlokanAtho mAdhavo bhaktavatsalaH
shlokas.92:
suvarNavarNo hemA~Ngo varA~NgashchandanA~NgadI |
vIrahA viShamaH shUnyo ghRRitAshIrachalashchalaH
shlokas.93:
amAnI mAnado mAnyo lokasvAmI trilokadhRRik |
sumedhA medhajo dhanyaH satyamedhA dharAdharaH
shlokas.94:
tejo vRRiSho dyutidharaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
pragraho nigraho.avyagro naikashRRi~Ngo gadAgrajaH
shlokas.96:
samAvarto nivRRittAtmA durjayo duratikramaH |
durlabho durgamo durgo durAvAso durArihA
shlokas.97:
shubhA~Ngo lokasAra~NgaH sutantustantuvardhanaH |
indrakarmA mahAkarmA kRRitakarmA kRRitAgamaH
shlokas.98:
udbhavaH sundaraH sundo ratnanAbhaH sulochanaH |
arko vAjasanaH shRRi~NgI jayantaH sarvavijjayI
shlokas.99:
suvarNabindurakShobhyaH sarvavAgIshvareshvaraH |
mahAhrado mahAgarto mahAbhUto mahAnidhiH
shlokas.100:
kumudaH ku.ndaraH kundaH parjanyaH pavano.anilaH |
amRRitA.nsho.amRRitavapuH sarvaj~naH sarvatomukhaH
shlokas.102:
sahasrArchiH saptajihvaH saptaidhAH saptavAhanaH |
amUrtiranagho.achintyo bhayakRRidbhayanAshanaH
shlokas.103:
aNurbRRihatkRRishaH sthUlo guNabhRRinnirguNo mahAn |
adhRRitaH svadhRRitaH svAsyaH prAgva.nsho va.nshavardhanaH
shlokas.104:
bhArabhRRitkathito yogI yogIshaH sarvakAmadaH |
AshramaH shramaNaH kShAmaH suparNo vAyuvAhanaH
shlokas.105:
dhanurdharo dhanurvedo daNDo damayitA damaH |
aparAjitaH sarvasaho niyantA niyamo yamaH
shlokas.106:
sattvavAnsAttvikaH satyaH satyadharmaparAyaNaH |
abhiprAyaH priyArho.arhaH priyakRRitprItivardhanaH
shlokas.107:
vihAyasagatirjyotiH suruchirhutabhugvibhuH |
ravirvirochanaH sUryaH savitA ravilochanaH
shlokas.108:
ananto hutabhugbhoktA sukhado naikado.agrajaH |
anirviNNaH sadAmarShI lokAdhiShThAnamadbhutam
shlokas.109:
sanAtsanAtanatamaH kapilaH kapiravyayaH |
svastidaH svastikRRitsvasti svastibhuksvastidakShiNaH
shlokas.110:
araudraH kuNDalI chakrI vikramyUrjitashAsanaH |
shabdAtigaH shabdasahaH shishiraH sharvarIkaraH
shlokas.111:
akrUraH peshalo dakSho dakShiNaH kShamiNAM varaH |
vidvattamo vItabhayaH puNyashravaNakIrtanaH
shlokas.112:
uttAraNo duShkRRitihA puNyo duHsvapnanAshanaH |
vIrahA rakShaNaH santo jIvanaH paryavasthitaH
shlokas.114:
anAdirbhUrbhuvo lakShmIH suvIro ruchirA~NgadaH |
janano janajanmAdirbhImo bhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.115:
AdhAranilayo dhAtA puShpahAsaH prajAgaraH |
UrdhvagaH satpathAchAraH prANadaH praNavaH paNaH
shlokas.116:
pramANaM prANanilayaH prANakRRitprANajIvanaH |
tattvaM tattvavidekAtmA janmamRRityujarAtigaH
shlokas.117:
bhUrbhuvaH svastarustAraH savitA prapitAmahaH |
yaj~no yaj~napatiryajvA yaj~nA~Ngo yaj~navAhanaH
shlokas.119:
AtmayoniH svaya~njAto vaikhAnaH sAmagAyanaH |
devakInandanaH sraShTA kShitIshaH pApanAshanaH
shlokas.120:
sha~NkhabhRRinnandakI chakrI shAr~NgadhanvA gadAdharaH |
rathA~NgapANirakShobhyaH sarvapraharaNAyudhaH
shlokas.121:
itIdaM kIrtanIyasya keshavasya mahAtmanaH |
nAmnAM sahasraM divyAnAmasheSheNa prakIrtitam
shlokas.122:
ya idaM shRRiNuyAnnityaM yashchApi parikIrtayet |
nAshubhaM prApnuyAtki~nchitso.amutreha cha mAnavaH
shlokas.123:
vedAntago brAhmaNaH syAtkShatriyo vijayI bhavet |
vaishyo dhanasamRRiddhaH syAchChUdraH sukhamavApnuyAt
shlokas.124:
dharmArthI prApnuyAddharmamarthArthI chArthamApnuyAt |
kAmAnavApnuyAtkAmI prajArthI chApnuyAtprajAH
shlokas.125:
bhaktimAnyaH sadotthAya shuchistadgatamAnasaH |
sahasraM vAsudevasya nAmnAmetatprakIrtayet
shlokas.126:
yashaH prApnoti vipulaM j~nAtiprAdhAnyameva cha |
achalAM shriyamApnoti shreyashchApnotyanuttamam
shlokas.127:
na bhayaM kvachidApnoti vIryaM tejashcha vindati |
bhavatyarogo dyutimAnbalarUpaguNAnvitaH
shlokas.128:
rogArto muchyate rogAdbaddho muchyeta bandhanAt |
bhayAnmuchyeta bhItashcha muchyetApanna ApadaH
shlokas.129:
durgANyatitaratyAshu puruShaH puruShottamam |
stuvannAmasahasreNa nityaM bhaktisamanvitaH
shlokas.130:
vAsudevAshrayo martyo vAsudevaparAyaNaH |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA yAti brahma sanAtanam
shlokas.131:
na vAsudevabhaktAnAmashubhaM vidyate kvachit |
janmamRRityujarAvyAdhibhayaM vApyupajAyate
shlokas.133:
na krodho na cha mAtsaryaM na lobho nAshubhA matiH |
bhavanti kRRitapuNyAnAM bhaktAnAM puruShottame
shlokas.134:
dyauH sachandrArkanakShatrA khaM disho bhUrmahodadhiH |
vAsudevasya vIryeNa vidhRRitAni mahAtmanaH
shlokas.135:
sasurAsuragandharvaM sayakShoragarAkShasam |
jagadvashe vartatedaM kRRiShNasya sacharAcharam
shlokas.136:
indriyANi mano buddhiH sattvaM tejo balaM dhRRitiH |
vAsudevAtmakAnyAhuH kShetraM kShetraj~na eva cha
shlokas.137:
sarvAgamAnAmAchAraH prathamaM parikalpyate |
AchAraprabhavo dharmo dharmasya prabhurachyutaH
shlokas.138:
RRiShayaH pitaro devA mahAbhUtAni dhAtavaH |
ja~NgamAja~NgamaM chedaM jagannArAyaNodbhavam
shlokas.139:
yogo j~nAnaM tathA sA~NkhyaM vidyAH shilpAni karma cha |
vedAH shAstrANi vij~nAnametatsarvaM janArdanAt
shlokas.140:
eko viShNurmahadbhUtaM pRRithagbhUtAnyanekashaH |
trI.NllokAnvyApya bhUtAtmA bhu~Nkte vishvabhugavyayaH
shlokas.141:
imaM stavaM bhagavato viShNorvyAsena kIrtitam |
paThedya ichChetpuruShaH shreyaH prAptuM sukhAni cha
shlokas.142:
vishveshvaramajaM devaM jagataH prabhavApyayam |
bhajanti ye puShkarAkShaM na te yAnti parAbhavam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ke pUjyAH ke namaskAryAH kathaM varteta keShu cha |
kimAchAraH kIdRRisheShu pitAmaha na riShyate
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
brAhmaNAnAM paribhavaH sAdayedapi devatAH |
brAhmaNAnAM namaskartA yudhiShThira na riShyate
shlokas.3:
te pUjyAste namaskAryA vartethAsteShu putravat |
te hi lokAnimAnsarvAndhArayanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNAH sarvalokAnAM mahAnto dharmasetavaH |
dhanatyAgAbhirAmAshcha vAksa.nyamaratAshcha ye
shlokas.5:
ramaNIyAshcha bhUtAnAM nidhAnaM cha dhRRitavratAH |
praNetArashcha lokAnAM shAstrANAM cha yashasvinaH
shlokas.6:
tapo yeShAM dhanaM nityaM vAkchaiva vipulaM balam |
prabhavashchApi dharmANAM dharmaj~nAH sUkShmadarshinaH
shlokas.7:
dharmakAmAH sthitA dharme sukRRitairdharmasetavaH |
yAnupAshritya jIvanti prajAH sarvAshchaturvidhAH
shlokas.8:
panthAnaH sarvanetAro yaj~navAhAH sanAtanAH |
pitRRipaitAmahIM gurvImudvahanti dhuraM sadA
shlokas.9:
dhuri ye nAvasIdanti viShame sadgavA iva |
pitRRidevAtithimukhA havyakavyAgrabhojinaH
shlokas.10:
bhojanAdeva ye lokA.nstrAyante mahato bhayAt |
dIpAH sarvasya lokasya chakShushchakShuShmatAmapi
shlokas.11:
sarvashilpAdinidhayo nipuNAH sUkShmadarshinaH |
gatij~nAH sarvabhUtAnAmadhyAtmagatichintakAH
shlokas.12:
AdimadhyAvasAnAnAM j~nAtArashChinnasa.nshayAH |
parAvaravisheShaj~nA gantAraH paramAM gatim
shlokas.13:
vimuktA dhutapApmAno nirdva.ndvA niShparigrahAH |
mAnArhA mAnitA nityaM j~nAnavidbhirmahAtmabhiH
shlokas.14:
chandane malapa~Nke cha bhojane.abhojane samAH |
samaM yeShAM dukUlaM cha shANakShaumAjinAni cha
shlokas.15:
tiShTheyurapyabhu~njAnA bahUni divasAnyapi |
shoShayeyushcha gAtrANi svAdhyAyaiH sa.nyatendriyAH
shlokas.16:
adaivaM daivataM kuryurdaivataM chApyadaivatam |
lokAnanyAnsRRijeyushcha lokapAlA.nshcha kopitAH
shlokas.17:
apeyaH sAgaro yeShAmabhishApAnmahAtmanAm |
yeShAM kopAgniradyApi daNDake nopashAmyati
shlokas.18:
devAnAmapi ye devAH kAraNaM kAraNasya cha |
pramANasya pramANaM cha kastAnabhibhavedbudhaH
shlokas.19:
yeShAM vRRiddhashcha bAlashcha sarvaH saMmAnamarhati |
tapovidyAvisheShAttu mAnayanti parasparam
shlokas.20:
avidvAnbrAhmaNo devaH pAtraM vai pAvanaM mahat |
vidvAnbhUyastaro devaH pUrNasAgarasaMnibhaH
shlokas.21:
avidvA.nshchaiva vidvA.nshcha brAhmaNo daivataM mahat |
praNItashchApraNItashcha yathAgnirdaivataM mahat
shlokas.22:
shmashAne hyapi tejasvI pAvako naiva duShyati |
haviryaj~neShu cha vahanbhUya evAbhishobhate
shlokas.23:
evaM yadyapyaniShTeShu vartate sarvakarmasu |
sarvathA brAhmaNo mAnyo daivataM viddhi tatparam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kAM tu brAhmaNapUjAyAM vyuShTiM dRRiShTvA janAdhipa |
kaM vA karmodayaM matvA tAnarchasi mahAmate
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
pavanasya cha sa.nvAdamarjunasya cha bhArata
shlokas.3:
sahasrabhujabhRRichChrImAnkArtavIryo.abhavatprabhuH |
asya lokasya sarvasya mAhiShmatyAM mahAbalaH
shlokas.4:
sa tu ratnAkaravatIM sadvIpAM sAgarAmbarAm |
shashAsa sarvAM pRRithivIM haihayaH satyavikramaH
shlokas.5:
svavittaM tena dattaM tu dattAtreyAya kAraNe |
kShatradharmaM puraskRRitya vinayaM shrutameva cha
shlokas.6:
ArAdhayAmAsa cha taM kRRitavIryAtmajo munim |
nyamantrayata saMhRRiShTaH sa dvijashcha varaistribhiH
shlokas.7:
sa varaishChanditastena nRRipo vachanamabravIt |
sahasrabAhurbhUyAM vai chamUmadhye gRRihe.anyathA
shlokas.8:
mama bAhusahasraM tu pashyantAM sainikA raNe |
vikrameNa mahIM kRRitsnAM jayeyaM vipulavrata
tAM cha dharmeNa samprApya pAlayeyamatandritaH
shlokas.9:
chaturthaM tu varaM yAche tvAmahaM dvijasattama |
taM mamAnugrahakRRite dAtumarhasyanindita
anushAsantu mAM santo mithyAvRRittaM tadAshrayam
shlokas.10:
ityuktaH sa dvijaH prAha tathAstviti narAdhipam |
evaM samabhava.nstasya varAste dIptatejasaH
shlokas.11:
tataH sa rathamAsthAya jvalanArkasamadyutiH |
abravIdvIryasaMmohAtko nvasti sadRRisho mayA
vIryadhairyayashaHshauchairvikrameNaujasApi vA
shlokas.12:
tadvAkyAnte chAntarikShe vAguvAchAsharIriNI |
na tvaM mUDha vijAnIShe brAhmaNaM kShatriyAdvaram
sahito brAhmaNeneha kShatriyo rakShati prajAH
shlokas.13:
arjuna uvAcha||
kuryAM bhUtAni tuShTo.ahaM kruddho nAshaM tathA naye |
karmaNA manasA vAchA na matto.asti varo dvijaH
shlokas.14:
pUrvo brahmottaro vAdo dvitIyaH kShatriyottaraH |
tvayoktau yau tu tau hetU visheShastvatra dRRishyate
shlokas.15:
brAhmaNAH sa.nshritAH kShatraM na kShatraM brAhmaNAshritam |
shritAnbrahmopadhA viprAH khAdanti kShatriyAnbhuvi
shlokas.16:
kShatriyeShvAshrito dharmaH prajAnAM paripAlanam |
kShatrAdvRRittirbrAhmaNAnAM taiH kathaM brAhmaNo varaH
shlokas.17:
sarvabhUtapradhAnA.nstAnbhaikShavRRittInahaM sadA |
AtmasambhAvitAnviprAnsthApayAmyAtmano vashe
shlokas.18:
kathitaM hyanayA satyaM gAyatryA kanyayA divi |
vijeShyAmyavashAnsarvAnbrAhmaNA.nshcharmavAsasaH
shlokas.19:
na cha mAM chyAvayedrAShTrAttriShu lokeShu kashchana |
devo vA mAnuSho vApi tasmAjjyeShTho dvijAdaham
shlokas.20:
adya brahmottaraM lokaM kariShye kShatriyottaram |
na hi me sa.nyuge kashchitsoDhumutsahate balam
shlokas.21:
arjunasya vachaH shrutvA vitrastAbhUnnishAcharI |
athainamantarikShasthastato vAyurabhAShata
shlokas.22:
tyajainaM kaluShaM bhAvaM brAhmaNebhyo namaskuru |
eteShAM kurvataH pApaM rAShTrakShobho hi te bhavet
shlokas.23:
atha vA tvAM mahIpAla shamayiShyanti vai dvijAH |
nirasiShyanti vA rAShTrAddhatotsAhaM mahAbalAH
shlokas.24:
taM rAjA kastvamityAha tatastaM prAha mArutaH |
vAyurvai devadUto.asmi hitaM tvAM prabravImyaham
shlokas.25:
arjuna uvAcha||
aho tvayAdya vipreShu bhaktirAgaH pradarshitaH |
yAdRRishaM pRRithivI bhUtaM tAdRRishaM brUhi vai dvijam
shlokas.26:
vAyorvA sadRRishaM ki~nchidbrUhi tvaM brAhmaNottamam |
apAM vai sadRRishaM brUhi sUryasya nabhaso.api vA

shlokas.1:
vAyuruvAcha||
shRRiNu mUDha guNAnkA.nshchidbrAhmaNAnAM mahAtmanAm |
ye tvayA kIrtitA rAja.nstebhyo.atha brAhmaNo varaH
shlokas.2:
tyaktvA mahItvaM bhUmistu spardhayA~NganRRipasya ha |
nAshaM jagAma tAM vipro vyaShTambhayata kashyapaH
shlokas.3:
akShayA brAhmaNA rAjandivi cheha cha nityadA |
apibattejasA hyApaH svayamevA~NgirAH purA
shlokas.4:
sa tAH pibankShIramiva nAtRRipyata mahAtapAH |
apUrayanmahaughena mahIM sarvAM cha pArthiva
shlokas.5:
tasminnahaM cha kruddhe vai jagattyaktvA tato gataH |
vyatiShThamagnihotre cha chirama~Ngiraso bhayAt
shlokas.6:
abhishaptashcha bhagavAngautamena pura.ndaraH |
ahalyAM kAmayAno vai dharmArthaM cha na hi.nsitaH
shlokas.7:
tathA samudro nRRipate pUrNo mRRiShTena vAriNA |
brAhmaNairabhishaptaH sa.NllavaNodaH kRRito vibho
shlokas.8:
suvarNavarNo nirdhUmaH saMhatordhvashikhaH kaviH |
kruddhenA~NgirasA shapto guNairetairvivarjitaH
shlokas.9:
marutashchUrNitAnpashya ye.ahasanta mahodadhim |
suvarNadhAriNA nityamavashaptA dvijAtinA
shlokas.10:
samo na tvaM dvijAtibhyaH shreShThaM viddhi narAdhipa |
garbhasthAnbrAhmaNAnsamya~Nnamasyati kila prabhuH
shlokas.11:
daNDakAnAM mahadrAjyaM brAhmaNena vinAshitam |
tAlaja~NghaM mahatkShatramaurveNaikena nAshitam
shlokas.12:
tvayA cha vipulaM rAjyaM balaM dharmaH shrutaM tathA |
dattAtreyaprasAdena prAptaM paramadurlabham
shlokas.13:
agniM tvaM yajase nityaM kasmAdarjuna brAhmaNam |
sa hi sarvasya lokasya havyavATkiM na vetsi tam
shlokas.14:
atha vA brAhmaNashreShThamanu bhUtAnupAlakam |
kartAraM jIvalokasya kasmAjjAnanvimuhyase
shlokas.15:
tathA prajApatirbrahmA avyaktaH prabhavApyayaH |
yenedaM nikhilaM vishvaM janitaM sthAvaraM charam
shlokas.16:
aNDajAtaM tu brahmANaM kechidichChantyapaNDitAH |
aNDAdbhinnAdbabhuH shailA disho.ambhaH pRRithivI divam
shlokas.17:
draShTavyaM naitadevaM hi kathaM jyAyastamo hi saH |
smRRitamAkAshamaNDaM tu tasmAjjAtaH pitAmahaH
shlokas.18:
tiShThetkathamiti brUhi na ki~nchiddhi tadA bhavet |
aha~NkAra iti proktaH sarvatejogataH prabhuH
shlokas.19:
nAstyaNDamasti tu brahmA sa rAja.NllokabhAvanaH |
ityuktaH sa tadA tUShNImabhUdvAyustamabravIt

shlokas.1:
vAyuruvAcha||
imAM bhUmiM brAhmaNebhyo ditsurvai dakShiNAM purA |
a~Ngo nAma nRRipo rAja.nstatashchintAM mahI yayau
shlokas.2:
dhAraNIM sarvabhUtAnAmayaM prApya varo nRRipaH |
kathamichChati mAM dAtuM dvijebhyo brahmaNaH sutAm
shlokas.3:
sAhaM tyaktvA gamiShyAmi bhUmitvaM brahmaNaH padam |
ayaM sarAShTro nRRipatirmA bhUditi tato.agamat
shlokas.4:
tatastAM kashyapo dRRiShTvA vrajantIM pRRithivIM tadA |
pravivesha mahIM sadyo muktvAtmAnaM samAhitaH
shlokas.5:
ruddhA sA sarvato jaj~ne tRRiNauShadhisamanvitA |
dharmottarA naShTabhayA bhUmirAsIttato nRRipa
shlokas.6:
evaM varShasahasrANi divyAni vipulavrataH |
tri.nshataM kashyapo rAjanbhUmirAsIdatandritaH
shlokas.7:
athAgamya mahArAja namaskRRitya cha kashyapam |
pRRithivI kAshyapI jaj~ne sutA tasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.8:
eSha rAjannIdRRisho vai brAhmaNaH kashyapo.abhavat |
anyaM prabrUhi vApi tvaM kashyapAtkShatriyaM varam
shlokas.9:
tUShNIM babhUva nRRipatiH pavanastvabravItpunaH |
shRRiNu rAjannutathyasya jAtasyA~Ngirase kule
shlokas.10:
bhadrA somasya duhitA rUpeNa paramA matA |
tasyAstulyaM patiM soma utathyaM samapashyata
shlokas.11:
sA cha tIvraM tapastepe mahAbhAgA yashasvinI |
utathyaM tu mahAbhAgaM tatkRRite.avarayattadA
shlokas.12:
tata AhUya sotathyaM dadAvatra yashasvinIm |
bhAryArthe sa cha jagrAha vidhivadbhUridakShiNa
shlokas.13:
tAM tvakAmayata shrImAnvaruNaH pUrvameva ha |
sa chAgamya vanaprasthaM yamunAyAM jahAra tAm
shlokas.14:
jaleshvarastu hRRitvA tAmanayatsvapuraM prati |
paramAdbhutasa~NkAshaM ShaTsahasrashatahradam
shlokas.15:
na hi ramyataraM ki~nchittasmAdanyatpurottamam |
prAsAdairapsarobhishcha divyaiH kAmaishcha shobhitam
tatra devastayA sArdhaM reme rAja~njaleshvaraH
shlokas.17:
athAkhyAtamutathyAya tataH patnyavamardanam |
tachChrutvA nAradAtsarvamutathyo nAradaM tadA |
provAcha gachCha brUhi tvaM varuNaM paruShaM vachaH
madvAkyAnmu~ncha me bhAryAM kasmAdvA hRRitavAnasi
shlokas.18:
lokapAlo.asi lokAnAM na lokasya vilopakaH |
somena dattA bhAryA me tvayA chApahRRitAdya vai
shlokas.19:
ityukto vachanAttasya nAradena jaleshvaraH |
mu~ncha bhAryAmutathyasyetyatha taM varuNo.abravIt
mamaiShA supriyA bhAryA nainAmutsraShTumutsahe
shlokas.20:
ityukto varuNenAtha nAradaH prApya taM munim |
utathyamabravIdvAkyaM nAtihRRiShTamanA iva
shlokas.21:
gale gRRihItvA kShipto.asmi varuNena mahAmune |
na prayachChati te bhAryAM yatte kAryaM kuruShva tat
shlokas.22:
nAradasya vachaH shrutvA kruddhaH prAjvalada~NgirAH |
apibattejasA vAri viShTabhya sumahAtapAH
shlokas.23:
pIyamAne cha sarvasmi.nstoye vai salileshvaraH |
suhRRidbhiH kShipyamANo.api naivAmu~nchata tAM tadA
shlokas.24:
tataH kruddho.abravIdbhUmimutathyo brAhmaNottamaH |
darshayasva sthalaM bhadre ShaTsahasrashatahradam
shlokas.25:
tatastadiriNaM jAtaM samudrashchApasarpitaH |
tasmAddeshAnnadIM chaiva provAchAsau dvijottamaH
shlokas.26:
adRRishyA gachCha bhIru tvaM sarasvati maruM prati |
apuNya eSha bhavatu deshastyaktastvayA shubhe
shlokas.27:
tasminsa~nchUrNite deshe bhadrAmAdAya vAripaH |
adadAchCharaNaM gatvA bhAryAmA~NgirasAya vai
shlokas.28:
pratigRRihya tu tAM bhAryAmutathyaH sumanAbhavat |
mumocha cha jagadduHkhAdvaruNaM chaiva haihaya
shlokas.29:
tataH sa labdhvA tAM bhAryAM varuNaM prAha dharmavit |
utathyaH sumahAtejA yattachChRRiNu narAdhipa
shlokas.30:
mayaiShA tapasA prAptA kroshataste jalAdhipa |
ityuktvA tAmupAdAya svameva bhavanaM yayau
shlokas.31:
eSha rAjannIdRRisho vai utathyo brAhmaNarShabhaH |
bravImyahaM brUhi vA tvamutathyAtkShatriyaM varam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tadA tUShNImabhUdvAyustato.abravIt |
shRRiNu rAjannagastyasya mAhAtmyaM brAhmaNasya ha
shlokas.2:
asurairnirjitA devA nirutsAhAshcha te kRRitAH |
yaj~nAshchaiShAM hRRitAH sarve pitRRibhyashcha svadhA tathA
shlokas.3:
karmejyA mAnavAnAM cha dAnavairhaihayarShabha |
bhraShTaishvaryAstato devAshcheruH pRRithvImiti shrutiH
shlokas.4:
tataH kadAchitte rAjandIptamAdityavarchasam |
dadRRishustejasA yuktamagastyaM vipulavratam
shlokas.5:
abhivAdya cha taM devA dRRiShTvA cha yashasA vRRitam |
idamUchurmahAtmAnaM vAkyaM kAle janAdhipa
shlokas.6:
dAnavairyudhi bhagnAH sma tathaishvaryAchcha bhra.nshitAH |
tadasmAnno bhayAttIvrAttrAhi tvaM munipu~Ngava
shlokas.7:
ityuktaH sa tadA devairagastyaH kupito.abhavat |
prajajvAla cha tejasvI kAlAgniriva sa~NkShaye
shlokas.8:
tena dIptA.nshujAlena nirdagdhA dAnavAstadA |
antarikShAnmahArAja nyapatanta sahasrashaH
shlokas.9:
dahyamAnAstu te daityAstasyAgastyasya tejasA |
ubhau lokau parityajya yayuH kAShThAM sma dakShiNAm
shlokas.10:
balistu yajate yaj~namashvamedhaM mahIM gataH |
ye.anye svasthA mahIsthAshcha te na dagdhA mahAsurAH
shlokas.11:
tato lokAH punaH prAptAH suraiH shAntaM cha tadrajaH |
athainamabruvandevA bhUmiShThAnasurA~njahi
shlokas.12:
ityukta Aha devAnsa na shaknomi mahIgatAn |
dagdhuM tapo hi kShIyenme dhakShyAmIti cha pArthiva
shlokas.13:
evaM dagdhA bhagavatA dAnavAH svena tejasA |
agastyena tadA rAja.nstapasA bhAvitAtmanA
shlokas.14:
IdRRishashchApyagastyo hi kathitaste mayAnagha |
bravImyahaM brUhi vA tvamagastyAtkShatriyaM varam
shlokas.15:
ityuktaH sa tadA tUShNImabhUdvAyustato.abravIt |
shRRiNu rAjanvasiShThasya mukhyaM karma yashasvinaH
shlokas.16:
AdityAH satramAsanta saro vai mAnasaM prati |
vasiShThaM manasA gatvA shrutvA tatrAsya gocharam
shlokas.17:
yajamAnA.nstu tAndRRiShTvA vyagrAndIkShAnukarshitAn |
hantumichChanti shailAbhAH khalino nAma dAnavAH
shlokas.18:
adUrAttu tatasteShAM brahmadattavaraM saraH |
hatA hatA vai te tatra jIvantyAplutya dAnavAH
shlokas.19:
te pragRRihya mahAghorAnparvatAnparighAndrumAn |
vikShobhayantaH salilamutthitAH shatayojanam
shlokas.20:
abhyadravanta devA.nste sahasrANi dashaiva ha |
tatastairarditA devAH sharaNaM vAsavaM yayuH
shlokas.21:
sa cha tairvyathitaH shakro vasiShThaM sharaNaM yayau |
tato.abhayaM dadau tebhyo vasiShTho bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.22:
tathA tAnduHkhitA~njAnannAnRRisha.nsyaparo muniH |
ayatnenAdahatsarvAnkhalinaH svena tejasA
shlokas.23:
kailAsaM prasthitAM chApi nadIM ga~NgAM mahAtapAH |
Anayattatsaro divyaM tayA bhinnaM cha tatsaraH
shlokas.24:
saro bhinnaM tayA nadyA sarayUH sA tato.abhavat |
hatAshcha khalino yatra sa deshaH khalino.abhavat
shlokas.25:
evaM sendrA vasiShThena rakShitAstridivaukasaH |
brahmadattavarAshchaiva hatA daityA mahAtmanA
shlokas.26:
etatkarma vasiShThasya kathitaM te mayAnagha |
bravImyahaM brUhi vA tvaM vasiShThAtkShatriyaM varam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktastvarjunastUShNImabhUdvAyustamabravIt |
shRRiNu me haihayashreShTha karmAtreH sumahAtmanaH
shlokas.2:
ghore tamasyayudhyanta sahitA devadAnavAH |
avidhyata sharaistatra svarbhAnuH somabhAskarau
shlokas.3:
atha te tamasA grastA nihanyante sma dAnavaiH |
devA nRRipatishArdUla sahaiva balibhistadA
shlokas.4:
asurairvadhyamAnAste kShINaprANA divaukasaH |
apashyanta tapasyantamatriM vipraM mahAvane
shlokas.5:
athainamabruvandevAH shAntakrodhaM jitendriyam |
asurairiShubhirviddhau chandrAdityAvimAvubhau
shlokas.6:
vayaM vadhyAmahe chApi shatrubhistamasAvRRite |
nAdhigachChAma shAntiM cha bhayAttrAyasva naH prabho
shlokas.7:
kathaM rakShAmi bhavataste.abruva.nshchandramA bhava |
timiraghnashcha savitA dasyuhA chaiva no bhava
shlokas.8:
evamuktastadAtristu tamonudabhavachChashI |
apashyatsaumyabhAvaM cha sUryasya pratidarshanam
shlokas.9:
dRRiShTvA nAtiprabhaM somaM tathA sUryaM cha pArthiva |
prakAshamakarodatristapasA svena sa.nyuge
shlokas.10:
jagadvitimiraM chApi pradIptamakarottadA |
vyajayachChatrusa~NghA.nshcha devAnAM svena tejasA
shlokas.11:
atriNA dahyamAnA.nstAndRRiShTvA devA mahAsurAn |
parAkramaiste.api tadA vyatyaghnannatrirakShitAH
shlokas.12:
udbhAsitashcha savitA devAstrAtA hatAsurAH |
atriNA tvatha somatvaM kRRitamuttamatejasA
shlokas.13:
advitIyena muninA japatA charmavAsasA |
phalabhakSheNa rAjarShe pashya karmAtriNA kRRitam
shlokas.14:
tasyApi vistareNoktaM karmAtreH sumahAtmanaH |
bravImyahaM brUhi vA tvamatritaH kShatriyaM varam
shlokas.15:
ityuktastvarjunastUShNImabhUdvAyustamabravIt |
shRRiNu rAjanmahatkarma chyavanasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.16:
ashvinoH pratisa.nshrutya chyavanaH pAkashAsanam |
provAcha sahitaM devaiH somapAvashvinau kuru
shlokas.17:
indra uvAcha||
asmAbhirvarjitAvetau bhavetAM somapau katham |
devairna saMmitAvetau tasmAnmaivaM vadasva naH
shlokas.18:
ashvibhyAM saha nechChAmaH pAtuM somaM mahAvrata |
pibantvanye yathAkAmaM nAhaM pAtumihotsahe
shlokas.19:
chyavana uvAcha||
na chetkariShyasi vacho mayoktaM balasUdana |
mayA pramathitaH sadyaH somaM pAsyasi vai makhe
shlokas.20:
tataH karma samArabdhaM hitAya sahasAshvinoH |
chyavanena tato mantrairabhibhUtAH surAbhavan
shlokas.21:
tattu karma samArabdhaM dRRiShTvendraH krodhamUrChitaH |
udyamya vipulaM shailaM chyavanaM samupAdravat
tathA vajreNa bhagavAnamarShAkulalochanaH
shlokas.22:
tamApatantaM dRRiShTvaiva chyavanastapasAnvitaH |
adbhiH siktvAstambhayattaM savajraM sahaparvatam
shlokas.23:
athendrasya mahAghoraM so.asRRijachChatrumeva ha |
madaM mantrAhutimayaM vyAditAsyaM mahAmuniH
shlokas.24:
tasya dantasahasraM tu babhUva shatayojanam |
dviyojanashatAstasya daMShTrAH paramadAruNAH
hanustasyAbhavadbhUmAvekashchAsyAspRRishaddivam
shlokas.25:
jihvAmUle sthitAstasya sarve devAH savAsavAH |
timerAsyamanuprAptA yathA matsyA mahArNave
shlokas.26:
te saMmantrya tato devA madasyAsyagatAstadA |
abruvansahitAH shakraM praNamAsmai dvijAtaye
ashvibhyAM saha somaM cha pibAmo vigatajvarAH
shlokas.27:
tataH sa praNataH shakrashchakAra chyavanasya tat |
chyavanaH kRRitavA.nstau chApyashvinau somapIthinau
shlokas.28:
tataH pratyAharatkarma madaM cha vyabhajanmuniH |
akSheShu mRRigayAyAM cha pAne strIShu cha vIryavAn
shlokas.29:
etairdoShairnaro rAjankShayaM yAti na sa.nshayaH |
tasmAdetAnnaro nityaM dUrataH parivarjayet
shlokas.30:
etatte chyavanasyApi karma rAjanprakIrtitam |
bravImyahaM brUhi vA tvaM chyavanAtkShatriyaM varam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tUShNImAsIdarjunastu pavanastvabravItpunaH |
shRRiNu me brAhmaNeShveva mukhyaM karma janAdhipa
shlokas.2:
madasyAsyamanuprAptA yadA sendrA divaukasaH |
tadeyaM chyavaneneha hRRitA teShAM vasundharA
shlokas.3:
ubhau lokau hRRitau matvA te devA duHkhitAbhavan |
shokArtAshcha mahAtmAnaM brahmANaM sharaNaM yayuH
shlokas.4:
devA UchuH||
madAsyavyatiShiktAnAmasmAkaM lokapUjita |
chyavanena hRRitA bhUmiH kapaishchApi divaM prabho
shlokas.5:
brahmovAcha||
gachChadhvaM sharaNaM viprAnAshu sendrA divaukasaH |
prasAdya tAnubhau lokAvavApsyatha yathA purA
shlokas.6:
te yayuH sharaNaM viprA.nsta UchuH kA~njayAmahe |
ityuktAste dvijAnprAhurjayateha kapAniti
bhUgatAnhi vijetAro vayamityeva pArthiva
shlokas.7:
tataH karma samArabdhaM brAhmaNaiH kapanAshanam |
tachChrutvA preShito dUto brAhmaNebhyo dhanI kapaiH
shlokas.8:
sa cha tAnbrAhmaNAnAha dhanI kapavacho yathA |
bhavadbhiH sadRRishAH sarve kapAH kimiha vartate
shlokas.9:
sarve vedavidaH prAj~nAH sarve cha kratuyAjinaH |
sarve satyavratAshchaiva sarve tulyA maharShibhiH
shlokas.10:
shrIshchaiva ramate teShu dhArayanti shriyaM cha te |
vRRithA dArAnna gachChanti vRRithAmA.nsaM na bhu~njate
shlokas.11:
dIptamagniM juhvati cha gurUNAM vachane sthitAH |
sarve cha niyatAtmAno bAlAnAM sa.nvibhAginaH
shlokas.12:
upetya shakaTairyAnti na sevanti rajasvalAm |
abhuktavatsu nAshnanti divA chaiva na sherate
shlokas.13:
etaishchAnyaishcha bahubhirguNairyuktAnkathaM kapAn |
vijeShyatha nivartadhvaM nivRRittAnAM shubhaM hi vaH
shlokas.14:
brAhmaNA UchuH||
kapAnvayaM vijeShyAmo ye devAste vayaM smRRitAH |
tasmAdvadhyAH kapAsmAkaM dhaninyAhi yathAgatam
shlokas.15:
dhanI gatvA kapAnAha na vo viprAH priya~NkarAH |
gRRihItvAstrANyatho viprAnkapAH sarve samAdravan
shlokas.16:
samudagradhvajAndRRiShTvA kapAnsarve dvijAtayaH |
vyasRRija~njvalitAnagnInkapAnAM prANanAshanAn
shlokas.17:
brahmasRRiShTA havyabhujaH kapAnbhuktvA sanAtanAH |
nabhasIva yathAbhrANi vyarAjanta narAdhipa
prashasha.nsurdvijA.nshchaiva brahmANaM cha yashasvinam
shlokas.18:
teShAM tejastathA vIryaM devAnAM vavRRidhe tataH |
avApnuva.nshchAmaratvaM triShu lokeShu pUjitam
shlokas.19:
ityuktavachanaM vAyumarjunaH pratyabhAShata |
pratipUjya mahAbAho yattachChRRiNu narAdhipa
shlokas.20:
jIvAmyahaM brAhmaNArthe sarvathA satataM prabho |
brahmaNe brAhmaNebhyashcha praNamAmi cha nityashaH
shlokas.21:
dattAtreyaprasAdAchcha mayA prAptamidaM yashaH |
loke cha paramA kIrtirdharmashcha charito mahAn
shlokas.22:
aho brAhmaNakarmANi yathA mAruta tattvataH |
tvayA proktAni kArtsnyena shrutAni prayatena ha
shlokas.23:
vAyuruvAcha||
brAhmaNAnkShatradharmeNa pAlayasvendriyANi cha |
bhRRigubhyaste bhayaM ghoraM tattu kAlAdbhaviShyati

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
brAhmaNAnarchase rAjansatataM sa.nshitavratAn |
kaM tu karmodayaM dRRiShTvA tAnarchasi narAdhipa
shlokas.2:
kAM vA brAhmaNapUjAyAM vyuShTiM dRRiShTvA mahAvrata |
tAnarchasi mahAbAho sarvametadvadasva me
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
eSha te keshavaH sarvamAkhyAsyati mahAmatiH |
vyuShTiM brAhmaNapUjAyAM dRRiShTavyuShTirmahAvrataH
shlokas.4:
balaM shrotre vA~NmanashchakShuShI cha; j~nAnaM tathA na vishuddhaM mamAdya |
dehanyAso nAtichirAnmato me; na chAtitUrNaM savitAdya yAti
shlokas.5:
uktA dharmA ye purANe mahAnto; brAhmaNAnAM kShatriyANAM vishAM cha |
paurANaM ye daNDamupAsate cha; sheShaM kRRiShNAdupashikShasva pArtha
shlokas.6:
ahaM hyenaM vedmi tattvena kRRiShNaM; yo.ayaM hi yachchAsya balaM purANam |
ameyAtmA keshavaH kauravendra; so.ayaM dharmaM vakShyati sa.nshayeShu
shlokas.7:
kRRiShNaH pRRithvImasRRijatkhaM divaM cha; varAho.ayaM bhImabalaH purANaH |
asya chAdho.athAntarikShaM divaM cha; dishashchatasraH pradishashchatasraH
sRRiShTistathaiveyamanuprasUtA; sa nirmame vishvamidaM purANam
shlokas.8:
asya nAbhyAM puShkaraM samprasUtaM; yatrotpannaH svayamevAmitaujAH |
yenAchChinnaM tattamaH pArtha ghoraM; yattattiShThatyarNavaM tarjayAnam
shlokas.9:
kRRite yuge dharma AsItsamagra;stretAkAle j~nAnamanuprapannaH |
balaM tvAsIddvApare pArtha kRRiShNaH; kalAvadharmaH kShitimAjagAma
shlokas.10:
sa pUrvadevo nijaghAna daityA;nsa pUrvadevashcha babhUva samrAT |
sa bhUtAnAM bhAvano bhUtabhavyaH; sa vishvasyAsya jagatashchApi goptA
shlokas.11:
yadA dharmo glAyati vai surANAM; tadA kRRiShNo jAyate mAnuSheShu |
dharme sthitvA sa tu vai bhAvitAtmA; parA.nshcha lokAnaparA.nshcha yAti
shlokas.12:
tyAjyA.nstyaktvAthAsurANAM vadhAya; kAryAkArye kAraNaM chaiva pArtha |
kRRitaM kariShyatkriyate cha devo; muhuH somaM viddhi cha shakrametam
shlokas.13:
sa vishvakarmA sa cha vishvarUpaH; sa vishvabhRRidvishvasRRigvishvajichcha |
sa shUlabhRRichChoNitabhRRitkarAla;staM karmabhirviditaM vai stuvanti
shlokas.14:
taM gandharvA apsarasashcha nitya;mupatiShThante vibudhAnAM shatAni |
taM rAkShasAshcha parisa.nvahante; rAyaspoShaH sa vijigIShurekaH
shlokas.15:
tamadhvare sha.nsitAraH stuvanti; rathantare sAmagAshcha stuvanti |
taM brAhmaNA brahmamantraiH stuvanti; tasmai haviradhvaryavaH kalpayanti
shlokas.16:
sa paurANIM brahmaguhAM praviShTo; mahIsatraM bhAratAgre dadarsha |
sa chaiva gAmuddadhArAgryakarmA; vikShobhya daityAnuragAndAnavA.nshcha
shlokas.17:
tasya bhakShAnvividhAnvedayanti; tamevAjau vAhanaM vedayanti |
tasyAntarikShaM pRRithivI divaM cha; sarvaM vashe tiShThati shAshvatasya
shlokas.18:
sa kumbharetAH sasRRije purANaM; yatrotpannamRRiShimAhurvasiShTham |
sa mAtarishvA vibhurashvavAjI; sa rashmimAnsavitA chAdidevaH
shlokas.19:
tenAsurA vijitAH sarva eva; tasya vikrAntairvijitAnIha trINi |
sa devAnAM mAnuShANAM pitR^INAM; tamevAhuryaj~navidAM vitAnam
shlokas.20:
sa eva kAlaM vibhajannudeti; tasyottaraM dakShiNaM chAyane dve |
tasyaivordhvaM tiryagadhashcharanti; gabhastayo medinIM tApayantaH
shlokas.21:
taM brAhmaNA vedavido juShanti; tasyAdityo bhAmupayujya bhAti |
sa mAsi mAsyadhvarakRRidvidhatte; tamadhvare vedavidaH paThanti
shlokas.22:
sa ekayukchakramidaM trinAbhi; saptAshvayuktaM vahate vai tridhAmA |
mahAtejAH sarvagaH sarvasiMhaH; kRRiShNo lokAndhArayate tathaikaH
ashnannanashna.nshcha tathaiva dhIraH; kRRiShNaM sadA pArtha kartAramehi
shlokas.23:
sa ekadA kakShagato mahAtmA; tRRipto vibhuH khANDave dhUmaketuH |
sa rAkShasAnuragA.nshchAvajitya; sarvatragaH sarvamagnau juhoti
shlokas.24:
sa evAshvaH shvetamashvaM prayachCha;tsa evAshvAnatha sarvA.nshchakAra |
trivandhurastasya rathastrichakra;strivRRichChirAshchaturasrashcha tasya
shlokas.25:
sa vihAyo vyadadhAtpa~nchanAbhiH; sa nirmame gAM divamantarikSham |
evaM ramyAnasRRijatparvatA.nshcha; hRRiShIkesho.amitadIptAgnitejAH
shlokas.26:
sa la~Nghayanvai sarito jighA.nsa;nsa taM vajraM praharantaM nirAsa |
sa mahendraH stUyate vai mahAdhvare; vipraireko RRiksahasraiH purANaiH
shlokas.27:
durvAsA vai tena nAnyena shakyo; gRRihe rAjanvAsayituM mahaujAH |
tamevAhurRRiShimekaM purANaM; sa vishvakRRidvidadhAtyAtmabhAvAn
shlokas.28:
vedA.nshcha yo vedayate.adhidevo; vidhI.nshcha yashchAshrayate purANAn |
kAme vede laukike yatphalaM cha; viShvaksene sarvametatpratIhi
shlokas.29:
jyotIMShi shuklAni cha sarvaloke; trayo lokA lokapAlAstrayashcha |
trayo.agnayo vyAhRRitayashcha tisraH; sarve devA devakIputra eva
shlokas.30:
sa.nvatsaraH sa RRituH so.ardhamAsaH; so.ahorAtraH sa kalA vai sa kAShThAH |
mAtrA muhUrtAshcha lavAH kShaNAshcha; viShvaksene sarvametatpratIhi
shlokas.31:
chandrAdityau grahanakShatratArAH; sarvANi darshAnyatha paurNamAsyaH |
nakShatrayogA RRitavashcha pArtha; viShvaksenAtsarvametatprasUtam
shlokas.32:
rudrAdityA vasavo.athAshvinau cha; sAdhyA vishve marutAM ShaDgaNAshcha |
prajApatirdevamAtAditishcha; sarve kRRiShNAdRRiShayashchaiva sapta
shlokas.33:
vAyurbhUtvA vikShipate cha vishva;magnirbhUtvA dahate vishvarUpaH |
Apo bhUtvA majjayate cha sarvaM; brahmA bhUtvA sRRijate vishvasa~NghAn
shlokas.34:
vedyaM cha yadvedayate cha vedA;nvidhishcha yashchAshrayate vidheyAn |
dharme cha vede cha bale cha sarvaM; charAcharaM keshavaM tvaM pratIhi
shlokas.35:
jyotirbhUtaH paramo.asau purastA;tprakAshayanprabhayA vishvarUpaH |
apaH sRRiShTvA hyAtmabhUrAtmayoniH; purAkarotsarvamevAtha vishvam
shlokas.36:
RRitUnutpAtAnvividhAnyadbhutAni; meghAnvidyutsarvamairAvataM cha |
sarvaM kRRiShNAtsthAvaraM ja~NgamaM cha; vishvAkhyAtAdviShNumenaM pratIhi
shlokas.37:
vishvAvAsaM nirguNaM vAsudevaM; sa~NkarShaNaM jIvabhUtaM vadanti |
tataH pradyumnamaniruddhaM chaturtha;mAj~nApayatyAtmayonirmahAtmA
shlokas.38:
sa pa~nchadhA pa~nchajanopapannaM; sa~nchodayanvishvamidaM sisRRikShuH |
tatashchakArAvanimArutau cha; khaM jyotirApashcha tathaiva pArtha
shlokas.39:
sa sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM chaivameta;chchaturvidhaM lokamimaM cha kRRitvA |
tato bhUmiM vyadadhAtpa~nchabIjAM; dyauH pRRithivyAM dhAsyati bhUri vAri
tena vishvaM kRRitametaddhi rAja;nsa jIvayatyAtmanaivAtmayoniH
shlokas.40:
tato devAnasurAnmAnuShA.nshcha; lokAnRRiShI.nshchAtha pitR^InprajAshcha |
samAsena vividhAnprANilokA;nsarvAnsadA bhUtapatiH sisRRikShuH
shlokas.41:
shubhAshubhaM sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM cha; viShvaksenAtsarvametatpratIhi |
yadvartate yachcha bhaviShyatIha; sarvametatkeshavaM tvaM pratIhi
shlokas.42:
mRRityushchaiva prANinAmantakAle; sAkShAtkRRiShNaH shAshvato dharmavAhaH |
bhUtaM cha yachcheha na vidma kiM chi;dviShvaksenAtsarvametatpratIhi
shlokas.43:
yatprashastaM cha lokeShu puNyaM yachcha shubhAshubham |
tatsarvaM keshavo.achintyo viparItamato bhavet
shlokas.44:
etAdRRishaH keshavo.ayaM svayambhU;rnArAyaNaH paramashchAvyayashcha |
madhyaM chAsya jagatastasthuShashcha; sarveShAM bhUtAnAM prabhavashchApyayashcha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
brUhi brAhmaNapUjAyAM vyuShTiM tvaM madhusUdana |
vettA tvamasya chArthasya veda tvAM hi pitAmahaH
shlokas.2:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
shRRiNuShvAvahito rAjandvijAnAM bharatarShabha |
yathAtattvena vadato guNAnme kurusattama
shlokas.3:
pradyumnaH paripaprachCha brAhmaNaiH parikopitaH |
kiM phalaM brAhmaNeShvasti pUjAyAM madhusUdana
Ishvarasya satastasya iha chaiva paratra cha
shlokas.4:
sadA dvijAtInsampUjya kiM phalaM tatra mAnada |
etadbrUhi pitaH sarvaM sumahAnsa.nshayo.atra me
shlokas.5:
ityuktavachanastena pradyumnena tadA tvaham |
pratyabruvaM mahArAja yattachChRRiNu samAhitaH
shlokas.6:
vyuShTiM brAhmaNapUjAyAM raukmiNeya nibodha me |
ete hi somarAjAna IshvarAH sukhaduHkhayoH
shlokas.7:
asmi.Nlloke raukmiNeya tathAmuShmi.nshcha putraka |
brAhmaNapramukhaM saukhyaM na me.atrAsti vichAraNA
shlokas.8:
brAhmaNapramukhaM vIryamAyuH kIrtiryasho balam |
lokA lokeshvarAshchaiva sarve brAhmaNapUrvakAH
shlokas.9:
tatkathaM nAdriyeyaM vai Ishvaro.asmIti putraka |
mA te manyurmahAbAho bhavatvatra dvijAnprati
shlokas.10:
brAhmaNo hi mahadbhUtamasmi.Nlloke paratra cha |
bhasma kuryurjagadidaM kruddhAH pratyakShadarshinaH
shlokas.11:
anyAnapi sRRijeyushcha lokA.NllokeshvarA.nstathA |
kathaM teShu na varteya samyagj~nAnAtsutejasaH
shlokas.12:
avasanmadgRRihe tAta brAhmaNo haripi~NgalaH |
chIravAsA bilvadaNDI dIrghashmashrunakhAdimAn
dIrghebhyashcha manuShyebhyaH pramANAdadhiko bhuvi
shlokas.13:
sa sma sa~ncharate lokAnye divyA ye cha mAnuShAH |
imA gAthA gAyamAnashchatvareShu sabhAsu cha
shlokas.14:
durvAsasaM vAsayetko brAhmaNaM satkRRitaM gRRihe |
paribhAShAM cha me shrutvA ko nu dadyAtpratishrayam
yo mAM kashchidvAsayeta na sa mAM kopayediha
shlokas.16:
taM sma nAdriyate kashchittato.ahaM tamavAsayam |
sa sma bhu~Nkte sahasrANAM bahUnAmannamekadA |
ekadA smAlpakaM bhu~Nkte na vaiti cha punargRRihAn
shlokas.17:
akasmAchcha prahasati tathAkasmAtpraroditi |
na chAsya vayasA tulyaH pRRithivyAmabhavattadA
shlokas.18:
so.asmadAvasathaM gatvA shayyAshchAstaraNAni cha |
kanyAshchAla~NkRRitA dagdhvA tato vyapagataH svayam
shlokas.19:
atha mAmabravIdbhUyaH sa muniH sa.nshitavrataH |
kRRiShNa pAyasamichChAmi bhoktumityeva satvaraH
shlokas.20:
sadaiva tu mayA tasya chittaj~nena gRRihe janaH |
sarvANyevAnnapAnAni bhakShyAshchochchAvachAstathA
bhavantu satkRRitAnIti pUrvameva prachoditaH
shlokas.21:
tato.ahaM jvalamAnaM vai pAyasaM pratyavedayam |
tadbhuktvaiva tu sa kShipraM tato vachanamabravIt
kShiprama~NgAni limpasva pAyaseneti sa sma ha
shlokas.22:
avimRRishyaiva cha tataH kRRitavAnasmi tattathA |
tenochChiShTena gAtrANi shirashchaivAbhyamRRikShayam
shlokas.23:
sa dadarsha tadAbhyAshe mAtaraM te shubhAnanAm |
tAmapi smayamAnaH sa pAyasenAbhyalepayat
shlokas.24:
muniH pAyasadigdhA~NgIM rathe tUrNamayojayat |
tamAruhya rathaM chaiva niryayau sa gRRihAnmama
shlokas.25:
agnivarNo jvalandhImAnsa dvijo rathadhuryavat |
pratodenAtudadbAlAM rukmiNIM mama pashyataH
shlokas.26:
na cha me stokamapyAsIdduHkhamIrShyAkRRitaM tadA |
tataH sa rAjamArgeNa mahatA niryayau bahiH
shlokas.27:
taddRRiShTvA mahadAshcharyaM dAshArhA jAtamanyavaH |
tatrAjalpanmithaH kechitsamAbhAShya parasparam
shlokas.28:
brAhmaNA eva jAyerannAnyo varNaH katha~nchana |
ko hyenaM rathamAsthAya jIvedanyaH pumAniha
shlokas.29:
AshIviShaviShaM tIkShNaM tatastIkShNataraM viSham |
brahmAshIviShadagdhasya nAsti kashchichchikitsakaH
shlokas.30:
tasminvrajati durdharShe prAskhaladrukmiNI pathi |
tAM nAmarShayata shrImA.nstatastUrNamachodayat
shlokas.31:
tataH paramasa~Nkruddho rathAtpraskandya sa dvijaH |
padAtirutpathenaiva prAdhAvaddakShiNAmukhaH
shlokas.32:
tamutpathena dhAvantamanvadhAvaM dvijottamam |
tathaiva pAyasAdigdhaH prasIda bhagavanniti
shlokas.33:
tato vilokya tejasvI brAhmaNo mAmuvAcha ha |
jitaH krodhastvayA kRRiShNa prakRRityaiva mahAbhuja
shlokas.34:
na te.aparAdhamiha vai dRRiShTavAnasmi suvrata |
prIto.asmi tava govinda vRRiNu kAmAnyathepsitAn
prasannasya cha me tAta pashya vyuShTiryathAvidhA
shlokas.35:
yAvadeva manuShyANAmanne bhAvo bhaviShyati |
yathaivAnne tathA teShAM tvayi bhAvo bhaviShyati
shlokas.36:
yAvachcha puNyA lokeShu tvayi kIrtirbhaviShyati |
triShu lokeShu tAvachcha vaishiShTyaM pratipatsyase
supriyaH sarvalokasya bhaviShyasi janArdana
shlokas.37:
yatte bhinnaM cha dagdhaM cha yachcha ki~nchidvinAshitam |
sarvaM tathaiva draShTAsi vishiShTaM vA janArdana
shlokas.38:
yAvadetatpraliptaM te gAtreShu madhusUdana |
ato mRRityubhayaM nAsti yAvadichChA tavAchyuta
shlokas.39:
na tu pAdatale lipte kasmAtte putrakAdya vai |
naitanme priyamityeva sa mAM prIto.abravIttadA
ityukto.ahaM sharIraM svamapashyaM shrIsamAyutam
shlokas.40:
rukmiNIM chAbravItprItaH sarvastrINAM varaM yashaH |
kIrtiM chAnuttamAM loke samavApsyasi shobhane
shlokas.41:
na tvAM jarA vA rogo vA vaivarNyaM chApi bhAmini |
sprakShyanti puNyagandhA cha kRRiShNamArAdhayiShyasi
shlokas.42:
ShoDashAnAM sahasrANAM vadhUnAM keshavasya ha |
variShThA sahalokyA cha keshavasya bhaviShyasi
shlokas.43:
tava mAtaramityuktvA tato mAM punarabravIt |
prasthitaH sumahAtejA durvAsA vahnivajjvalan
shlokas.44:
eShaiva te buddhirastu brAhmaNAnprati keshava |
ityuktvA sa tadA putra tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.45:
tasminnantarhite chAhamupA.nshuvratamAdisham |
yatki~nchidbrAhmaNo brUyAtsarvaM kuryAmiti prabho
shlokas.46:
etadvratamahaM kRRitvA mAtrA te saha putraka |
tataH paramahRRiShTAtmA prAvishaM gRRihameva cha
shlokas.47:
praviShTamAtrashcha gRRihe sarvaM pashyAmi tannavam |
yadbhinnaM yachcha vai dagdhaM tena vipreNa putraka
shlokas.48:
tato.ahaM vismayaM prAptaH sarvaM dRRiShTvA navaM dRRiDham |
apUjayaM cha manasA raukmiNeya dvijaM tadA
shlokas.49:
ityahaM raukmiNeyasya pRRichChato bharatarShabha |
mAhAtmyaM dvijamukhyasya sarvamAkhyAtavA.nstadA
shlokas.50:
tathA tvamapi kaunteya brAhmaNAnsatataM prabho |
pUjayasva mahAbhAgAnvAgbhirdAnaishcha nityadA
shlokas.51:
evaM vyuShTimahaM prApto brAhmaNAnAM prasAdajAm |
yachcha mAmAha bhIShmo.ayaM tatsatyaM bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
durvAsasaH prasAdAtte yattadA madhusUdana |
avAptamiha vij~nAnaM tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.2:
mahAbhAgyaM cha yattasya nAmAni cha mahAtmanaH |
tattvato j~nAtumichChAmi sarvaM matimatAM vara
shlokas.3:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi namaskRRitvA kapardine |
yadavAptaM mahArAja shreyo yachchArjitaM yashaH
shlokas.4:
prayataH prAtarutthAya yadadhIye vishAM pate |
prA~njaliH shatarudrIyaM tanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.5:
prajApatistatsasRRije tapaso.ante mahAtapAH |
sha~NkarastvasRRijattAta prajAH sthAvaraja~NgamAH
shlokas.6:
nAsti ki~nchitparaM bhUtaM mahAdevAdvishAM pate |
iha triShvapi lokeShu bhUtAnAM prabhavo hi saH
shlokas.7:
na chaivotsahate sthAtuM kashchidagre mahAtmanaH |
na hi bhUtaM samaM tena triShu lokeShu vidyate
shlokas.8:
gandhenApi hi sa~NgrAme tasya kruddhasya shatravaH |
visa~nj~nA hatabhUyiShThA vepanti cha patanti cha
shlokas.9:
ghoraM cha ninadaM tasya parjanyaninadopamam |
shrutvA vidIryeddhRRidayaM devAnAmapi sa.nyuge
shlokas.10:
yA.nshcha ghoreNa rUpeNa pashyetkruddhaH pinAkadhRRik |
na surA nAsurA loke na gandharvA na pannagAH
kupite sukhamedhante tasminnapi guhAgatAH
shlokas.11:
prajApateshcha dakShasya yajato vitate kratau |
vivyAdha kupito yaj~naM nirbhayastu bhavastadA
dhanuShA bANamutsRRijya saghoShaM vinanAda cha
shlokas.12:
te na sharma kutaH shAntiM viShAdaM lebhire surAH |
vidrute sahasA yaj~ne kupite cha maheshvare
shlokas.13:
tena jyAtalaghoSheNa sarve lokAH samAkulAH |
babhUvuravashAH pArtha viShedushcha surAsurAH
shlokas.14:
ApashchukShubhire chaiva chakampe cha vasundharA |
vyadravangirayashchApi dyauH paphAla cha sarvashaH
shlokas.15:
andhena tamasA lokAH prAvRRitA na chakAshire |
pranaShTA jyotiShAM bhAshcha saha sUryeNa bhArata
shlokas.16:
bhRRishaM bhItAstataH shAntiM chakruH svastyayanAni cha |
RRiShayaH sarvabhUtAnAmAtmanashcha hitaiShiNaH
shlokas.17:
tataH so.abhyadravaddevAnkruddho raudraparAkramaH |
bhagasya nayane kruddhaH prahAreNa vyashAtayat
shlokas.18:
pUShANaM chAbhidudrAva pareNa vapuShAnvitaH |
puroDAshaM bhakShayato dashanAnvai vyashAtayat
shlokas.19:
tataH praNemurdevAste vepamAnAH sma sha~Nkaram |
punashcha sa.ndadhe rudro dIptaM sunishitaM sharam
shlokas.20:
rudrasya vikramaM dRRiShTvA bhItA devAH saharShibhiH |
tataH prasAdayAmAsuH sharvaM te vibudhottamAH
shlokas.21:
jepushcha shatarudrIyaM devAH kRRitvA~njaliM tataH |
sa.nstUyamAnastridashaiH prasasAda maheshvaraH
shlokas.22:
rudrasya bhAgaM yaj~ne cha vishiShTaM te tvakalpayan |
bhayena tridashA rAja~nsharaNaM cha prapedire
shlokas.23:
tena chaivAtikopena sa yaj~naH sandhito.abhavat |
yadyachchApi hataM tatra tattathaiva pradIyate
shlokas.24:
asurANAM purANyAsa.nstrINi vIryavatAM divi |
AyasaM rAjataM chaiva sauvarNamaparaM tathA
shlokas.25:
nAshakattAni maghavA bhettuM sarvAyudhairapi |
atha sarve.amarA rudraM jagmuH sharaNamarditAH
shlokas.26:
tata UchurmahAtmAno devAH sarve samAgatAH |
rudra raudrA bhaviShyanti pashavaH sarvakarmasu
jahi daityAnsaha purairlokA.nstrAyasva mAnada
shlokas.27:
sa tathoktastathetyuktvA viShNuM kRRitvA sharottamam |
shalyamagniM tathA kRRitvA pu~NkhaM vaivasvataM yamam
vedAnkRRitvA dhanuH sarvA~njyAM cha sAvitrimuttamAm
shlokas.28:
devAnrathavaraM kRRitvA viniyujya cha sarvashaH |
triparvaNA trishalyena tena tAni bibheda saH
shlokas.29:
shareNAdityavarNena kAlAgnisamatejasA |
te.asurAH sapurAstatra dagdhA rudreNa bhArata
shlokas.30:
taM chaivA~NkagataM dRRiShTvA bAlaM pa~nchashikhaM punaH |
umA jij~nAsamAnA vai ko.ayamityabravIttadA
shlokas.31:
asUyatashcha shakrasya vajreNa prahariShyataH |
savajraM stambhayAmAsa taM bAhuM parighopamam
shlokas.32:
na sambubudhire chainaM devAstaM bhuvaneshvaram |
saprajApatayaH sarve tasminmumuhurIshvare
shlokas.33:
tato dhyAtvAtha bhagavAnbrahmA tamamitaujasam |
ayaM shreShTha iti j~nAtvA vavande tamumApatim
shlokas.34:
tataH prasAdayAmAsurumAM rudraM cha te surAH |
babhUva sa tadA bAhurbalahanturyathA purA
shlokas.35:
sa chApi brAhmaNo bhUtvA durvAsA nAma vIryavAn |
dvAravatyAM mama gRRihe chiraM kAlamupAvasat
shlokas.36:
viprakArAnprayu~Nkte sma subahUnmama veshmani |
tAnudAratayA chAhamakShamaM tasya duHsaham
shlokas.37:
sa devendrashcha vAyushcha so.ashvinau sa cha vidyutaH |
sa chandramAH sa cheshAnaH sa sUryo varuNashcha saH
shlokas.38:
sa kAlaH so.antako mRRityuH sa tamo rAtryahAni cha |
mAsArdhamAsA RRitavaH sandhye sa.nvatsarashcha saH
shlokas.39:
sa dhAtA sa vidhAtA cha vishvakarmA sa sarvavit |
nakShatrANi dishashchaiva pradisho.atha grahAstathA
vishvamUrtirameyAtmA bhagavAnamitadyutiH
shlokas.40:
ekadhA cha dvidhA chaiva bahudhA cha sa eva cha |
shatadhA sahasradhA chaiva tathA shatasahasradhA
shlokas.41:
IdRRishaH sa mahAdevo bhUyashcha bhagavAnataH |
na hi shakyA guNA vaktumapi varShashatairapi

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
yudhiShThira mahAbAho mahAbhAgyaM mahAtmanaH |
rudrAya bahurUpAya bahunAmne nibodha me
shlokas.2:
vadantyagniM mahAdevaM tathA sthANuM maheshvaram |
ekAkShaM tryambakaM chaiva vishvarUpaM shivaM tathA
shlokas.3:
dve tanU tasya devasya vedaj~nA brAhmaNA viduH |
ghorAmanyAM shivAmanyAM te tanU bahudhA punaH
shlokas.4:
ugrA ghorA tanUryAsya so.agnirvidyutsa bhAskaraH |
shivA saumyA cha yA tasya dharmastvApo.atha chandramAH
shlokas.5:
Atmano.ardhaM tu tasyAgniruchyate bharatarShabha |
brahmacharyaM charatyeSha shivA yAsya tanustathA
shlokas.6:
yAsya ghoratamA mUrtirjagatsaMharate tayA |
IshvaratvAnmahattvAchcha maheshvara iti smRRitaH
shlokas.7:
yannirdahati yattIkShNo yadugro yatpratApavAn |
mA.nsashoNitamajjAdo yattato rudra uchyate
shlokas.8:
devAnAM sumahAnyachcha yachchAsya viShayo mahAn |
yachcha vishvaM mahatpAti mahAdevastataH smRRitaH
shlokas.9:
samedhayati yannityaM sarvArthAnsarvakarmabhiH |
shivamichChanmanuShyANAM tasmAdeSha shivaH smRRitaH
shlokas.10:
dahatyUrdhvaM sthito yachcha prANotpattiH sthitishcha yat |
sthirali~Ngashcha yannityaM tasmAtsthANuriti smRRitaH
shlokas.11:
yadasya bahudhA rUpaM bhUtaM bhavyaM bhavattathA |
sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM chaiva bahurUpastataH smRRitaH
shlokas.12:
dhUmraM rUpaM cha yattasya dhUrjaTItyata uchyate |
vishve devAshcha yattasminvishvarUpastataH smRRitaH
shlokas.13:
sahasrAkSho.ayutAkSho vA sarvatokShimayo.api vA |
chakShuShaH prabhavastejo nAstyanto.athAsya chakShuShAm
shlokas.14:
sarvathA yatpashUnpAti taishcha yadramate punaH |
teShAmadhipatiryachcha tasmAtpashupatiH smRRitaH
shlokas.15:
nityena brahmacharyeNa li~Ngamasya yadA sthitam |
mahayantyasya lokAshcha maheshvara iti smRRitaH
shlokas.16:
vigrahaM pUjayedyo vai li~NgaM vApi mahAtmanaH |
li~NgaM pUjayitA nityaM mahatIM shriyamashnute
shlokas.17:
RRiShayashchApi devAshcha gandharvApsarasastathA |
li~NgamevArchayanti sma yattadUrdhvaM samAsthitam
shlokas.18:
pUjyamAne tatastasminmodate sa maheshvaraH |
sukhaM dadAti prItAtmA bhaktAnAM bhaktavatsalaH
shlokas.19:
eSha eva shmashAneShu devo vasati nityashaH |
yajante taM janAstatra vIrasthAnaniSheviNam
shlokas.20:
viShamasthaH sharIreShu sa mRRityuH prANinAmiha |
sa cha vAyuH sharIreShu prANo.apAnaH sharIriNAm
shlokas.21:
tasya ghorANi rUpANi dIptAni cha bahUni cha |
loke yAnyasya pUjyante viprAstAni vidurbudhAH
shlokas.22:
nAmadheyAni vedeShu bahUnyasya yathArthataH |
niruchyante mahattvAchcha vibhutvAtkarmabhistathA
shlokas.23:
vede chAsya vidurviprAH shatarudrIyamuttamam |
vyAsAdanantaraM yachchApyupasthAnaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.24:
pradAtA sarvalokAnAM vishvaM chApyuchyate mahat |
jyeShThabhUtaM vadantyenaM brAhmaNA RRiShayo.apare
shlokas.25:
prathamo hyeSha devAnAM mukhAdagnirajAyata |
grahairbahuvidhaiH prANAnsa.nruddhAnutsRRijatyapi
shlokas.26:
sa mochayati puNyAtmA sharaNyaH sharaNAgatAn |
AyurArogyamaishvaryaM vittaM kAmA.nshcha puShkalAn
shlokas.27:
sa dadAti manuShyebhyaH sa evAkShipate punaH |
shakrAdiShu cha deveShu tasya chaishvaryamuchyate
shlokas.28:
sa evAbhyadhiko nityaM trailokyasya shubhAshubhe |
aishvaryAchchaiva kAmAnAmIshvaraH punaruchyate
shlokas.29:
maheshvarashcha lokAnAM mahatAmIshvarashcha saH |
bahubhirvividhai rUpairvishvaM vyAptamidaM jagat
tasya devasya yadvaktraM samudre vaDavAmukham

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktavati vAkyaM tu kRRiShNe devakinandane |
bhIShmaM shAntanavaM bhUyaH paryapRRichChadyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
nirNaye vA mahAbuddhe sarvadharmabhRRitAM vara |
pratyakShamAgamo veti kiM tayoH kAraNaM bhavet
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nAstyatra sa.nshayaH kashchiditi me vartate matiH |
shRRiNu vakShyAmi te prAj~na samyaktvamanupRRichChasi
shlokas.4:
sa.nshayaH sugamo rAjannirNayastvatra durgamaH |
dRRiShTaM shrutamanantaM hi yatra sa.nshayadarshanam
shlokas.5:
pratyakShaM kAraNaM dRRiShTaM hetukAH prAj~namAninaH |
nAstItyevaM vyavasyanti satyaM sa.nshayameva cha
tadayuktaM vyavasyanti bAlAH paNDitamAninaH
shlokas.6:
atha chenmanyase chaikaM kAraNaM kiM bhavediti |
shakyaM dIrgheNa kAlena yuktenAtandritena cha
