prANayAtrAmanekAM cha kalpayAnena bhArata
shlokas.7:
tatpareNaiva nAnyena shakyaM hyetattu kAraNam |
hetUnAmantamAsAdya vipulaM j~nAnamuttamam
jyotiH sarvasya lokasya vipulaM pratipadyate
shlokas.8:
tattvenAgamanaM rAjanhetvantagamanaM tathA |
agrAhyamanibaddhaM cha vAchaH samparivarjanam
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pratyakShaM lokataH siddhaM lokAshchAgamapUrvakAH |
shiShTAchAro bahuvidho brUhi tanme pitAmaha
shlokas.10:
bhIShma uvAcha||
dharmasya hriyamANasya balavadbhirdurAtmabhiH |
sa.nsthA yatnairapi kRRitA kAlena paribhidyate
shlokas.11:
adharmA dharmarUpeNa tRRiNaiH kUpA ivAvRRitAH |
tatastairbhidyate vRRittaM shRRiNu chaiva yudhiShThira
shlokas.12:
avRRittyA ye cha bhindanti shrutatyAgaparAyaNAH |
dharmavidveShiNo mandA ityuktasteShu sa.nshayaH
shlokas.13:
atRRipyantastu sAdhUnAM ya evAgamabuddhayaH |
paramityeva santuShTAstAnupAssva cha pRRichCha cha
shlokas.14:
kAmArthau pRRiShThataH kRRitvA lobhamohAnusAriNau |
dharma ityeva sambuddhAstAnupAssva cha pRRichCha cha
shlokas.15:
na teShAM bhidyate vRRittaM yaj~nasvAdhyAyakarmabhiH |
AchAraH kAraNaM chaiva dharmashchaiva trayaM punaH
shlokas.16:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
punareveha me buddhiH sa.nshaye parimuhyate |
apAre mArgamANasya paraM tIramapashyataH
shlokas.17:
vedAH pratyakShamAchAraH pramANaM tattrayaM yadi |
pRRithaktvaM labhyate chaiShAM dharmashchaikastrayaM katham
shlokas.18:
bhIShma uvAcha||
dharmasya hriyamANasya balavadbhirdurAtmabhiH |
yadyevaM manyase rAja.nstridhA dharmavichAraNA
shlokas.19:
eka eveti jAnIhi tridhA tasya pradarshanam |
pRRithaktve chaiva me buddhistrayANAmapi vai tathA
shlokas.20:
ukto mArgastrayANAM cha tattathaiva samAchara |
jij~nAsA tu na kartavyA dharmasya paritarkaNAt
shlokas.21:
sadaiva bharatashreShTha mA te bhUdatra sa.nshayaH |
andho jaDa ivAsha~Nko yadbravImi tadAchara
shlokas.22:
ahi.nsA satyamakrodho dAnametachchatuShTayam |
ajAtashatro sevasva dharma eSha sanAtanaH
shlokas.23:
brAhmaNeShu cha vRRittiryA pitRRipaitAmahochitA |
tAmanvehi mahAbAho svargasyaite hi deshikAH
shlokas.24:
pramANamapramANaM vai yaH kuryAdabudho naraH |
na sa pramANatAmarho vivAdajanano hi saH
shlokas.25:
brAhmaNAneva sevasva satkRRitya bahumanya cha |
eteShveva tvime lokAH kRRitsnA iti nibodha tAn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ye cha dharmamasUyanti ye chainaM paryupAsate |
bravItu bhagavAnetatkva te gachChanti tAdRRishAH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rajasA tamasA chaiva samavastIrNachetasaH |
narakaM pratipadyante dharmavidveShiNo narAH
shlokas.3:
ye tu dharmaM mahArAja satataM paryupAsate |
satyArjavaparAH santaste vai svargabhujo narAH
shlokas.4:
dharma eva ratisteShAmAchAryopAsanAdbhavet |
devalokaM prapadyante ye dharmaM paryupAsate
shlokas.5:
manuShyA yadi vA devAH sharIramupatApya vai |
dharmiNaH sukhamedhante lobhadveShavivarjitAH
shlokas.6:
prathamaM brahmaNaH putraM dharmamAhurmanIShiNaH |
dharmiNaH paryupAsante phalaM pakvamivAshayaH
shlokas.7:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
asatAM kIdRRishaM rUpaM sAdhavaH kiM cha kurvate |
bravItu me bhavAnetatsanto.asantashcha kIdRRishAH
shlokas.8:
bhIShma uvAcha||
durAchArAshcha durdharShA durmukhAshchApyasAdhavaH |
sAdhavaH shIlasampannAH shiShTAchArasya lakShaNam
shlokas.9:
rAjamArge gavAM madhye goShThamadhye cha dharmiNaH |
nopasevanti rAjendra sargaM mUtrapurIShayoH
shlokas.10:
pa~nchAnAmashanaM dattvA sheShamashnanti sAdhavaH |
na jalpanti cha bhu~njAnA na nidrAntyArdrapANayaH
shlokas.11:
chitrabhAnumanaDvAhaM devaM goShThaM chatuShpatham |
brAhmaNaM dhArmikaM chaityaM te kurvanti pradakShiNam
shlokas.12:
vRRiddhAnAM bhArataptAnAM strINAM bAlAturasya cha |
brAhmaNAnAM gavAM rAj~nAM panthAnaM dadate cha te
shlokas.13:
atithInAM cha sarveShAM preShyANAM svajanasya cha |
tathA sharaNakAmAnAM goptA syAtsvAgatapradaH
shlokas.14:
sAyaM prAtarmanuShyANAmashanaM devanirmitam |
nAntarA bhojanaM dRRiShTamupavAsavidhirhi saH
shlokas.15:
homakAle yathA vahniH kAlameva pratIkShate |
RRitukAle tathA nArI RRitumeva pratIkShate
na chAnyAM gachChate yastu brahmacharyaM hi tatsmRRitam
shlokas.16:
amRRitaM brAhmaNA gAva ityetattrayamekataH |
tasmAdgobrAhmaNaM nityamarchayeta yathAvidhi
shlokas.17:
yajuShA sa.nskRRitaM mA.nsamupabhu~njanna duShyati |
pRRiShThamA.nsaM vRRithAmA.nsaM putramA.nsaM cha tatsamam
shlokas.18:
svadeshe paradeshe vApyatithiM nopavAsayet |
karma vai saphalaM kRRitvA gurUNAM pratipAdayet
shlokas.19:
gurubhya AsanaM deyamabhivAdyAbhipUjya cha |
gurUnabhyarchya vardhante AyuShA yashasA shriyA
shlokas.20:
vRRiddhAnnAtivadejjAtu na cha sampreShayedapi |
nAsInaH syAtsthiteShvevamAyurasya na riShyate
shlokas.21:
na nagnAmIkShate nArIM na vidvAnpuruShAnapi |
maithunaM satataM guptamAhAraM cha samAcharet
shlokas.22:
tIrthAnAM guravastIrthaM shuchInAM hRRidayaM shuchi |
darshanAnAM paraM j~nAnaM santoShaH paramaM sukham
shlokas.23:
sAyaM prAtashcha vRRiddhAnAM shRRiNuyAtpuShkalA giraH |
shrutamApnoti hi naraH satataM vRRiddhasevayA
shlokas.24:
svAdhyAye bhojane chaiva dakShiNaM pANimuddharet |
yachChedvA~NmanasI nityamindriyANAM cha vibhramam
shlokas.25:
sa.nskRRitaM pAyasaM nityaM yavAgUM kRRisaraM haviH |
aShTakAH pitRRidaivatyA vRRiddhAnAmabhipUjanam
shlokas.26:
shmashrukarmaNi ma~NgalyaM kShutAnAmabhinandanam |
vyAdhitAnAM cha sarveShAmAyuShaH pratinandanam
shlokas.27:
na jAtu tvamiti brUyAdApanno.api mahattaram |
tva~NkAro vA vadho veti vidvatsu na vishiShyate
avarANAM samAnAnAM shiShyANAM cha samAcharet
shlokas.28:
pApamAchakShate nityaM hRRidayaM pApakarmiNAm |
j~nAnapUrvaM vinashyanti gUhamAnA mahAjane
shlokas.29:
j~nAnapUrvaM kRRitaM karma chChAdayante hyasAdhavaH |
na mAM manuShyAH pashyanti na mAM pashyanti devatAH
pApenAbhihataH pApaH pApamevAbhijAyate
shlokas.30:
yathA vArdhuShiko vRRiddhiM dehabhede pratIkShate |
dharmeNApihitaM pApaM dharmamevAbhivardhayet
shlokas.31:
yathA lavaNamambhobhirAplutaM pravilIyate |
prAyashchittahataM pApaM tathA sadyaH praNashyati
shlokas.32:
tasmAtpApaM na gUheta gUhamAnaM vivardhate |
kRRitvA tu sAdhuShvAkhyeyaM te tatprashamayantyuta
shlokas.33:
AshayA sa~nchitaM dravyaM yatkAle nopabhujyate |
anye chaitatprapadyante viyoge tasya dehinaH
shlokas.34:
mAnasaM sarvabhUtAnAM dharmamAhurmanIShiNaH |
tasmAtsarvANi bhUtAni dharmameva samAsate
shlokas.35:
eka eva chareddharmaM na dharmadhvajiko bhavet |
dharmavANijakA hyete ye dharmamupabhu~njate
shlokas.36:
archeddevAnadambhena sevetAmAyayA gurUn |
nidhiM nidadhyAtpAratryaM yAtrArthaM dAnashabditam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
nAbhAgadheyaH prApnoti dhanaM subalavAnapi |
bhAgadheyAnvitastvarthAnkRRisho bAlashcha vindati
shlokas.2:
nAlAbhakAle labhate prayatne.api kRRite sati |
lAbhakAle.aprayatnena labhate vipulaM dhanam
kRRitayatnAphalAshchaiva dRRishyante shatasho narAH
shlokas.3:
yadi yatno bhavenmartyaH sa sarvaM phalamApnuyAt |
nAlabhyaM chopalabhyeta nRRiNAM bharatasattama
shlokas.4:
yadA prayatnaM kRRitavAndRRishyate hyaphalo naraH |
mArgannayashatairarthAnamArga.nshchAparaH sukhI
shlokas.5:
akAryamasakRRitkRRitvA dRRishyante hyadhanA narAH |
dhanayuktAstvadharmasthA dRRishyante chApare janAH
shlokas.6:
adhItya nItiM yasmAchcha nItiyukto na dRRishyate |
anabhij~nashcha sAchivyaM gamitaH kena hetunA
vidyAyukto hyavidyashcha dhanavAndurgatastathA
shlokas.7:
yadi vidyAmupAshritya naraH sukhamavApnuyAt |
na vidvAnvidyayA hInaM vRRittyarthamupasa.nshrayet
shlokas.8:
yathA pipAsAM jayati puruShaH prApya vai jalam |
dRRiShTArtho vidyayApyevamavidyAM prajahennaraH
shlokas.9:
nAprAptakAlo mriyate viddhaH sharashatairapi |
tRRiNAgreNApi sa.nspRRiShTaH prAptakAlo na jIvati
shlokas.10:
bhIShma uvAcha||
IhamAnaH samArambhAnyadi nAsAdayeddhanam |
ugraM tapaH samArohenna hyanuptaM prarohati
shlokas.11:
dAnena bhogI bhavati medhAvI vRRiddhasevayA |
ahi.nsayA cha dIrghAyuriti prAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.12:
tasmAddadyAnna yAcheta pUjayeddhArmikAnapi |
svAbhAShI priyakRRichChuddhaH sarvasattvAvihi.nsakaH
shlokas.13:
yadA pramANaprabhavaH svabhAvashcha sukhAsukhe |
mashakITapipIlAnAM sthiro bhava yudhiShThira

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kAryate yachcha kriyate sachchAsachcha kRRitaM tataH |
tatrAshvasIta satkRRitvA asatkRRitvA na vishvaset
shlokas.2:
kAla evAtra kAlena nigrahAnugrahau dadat |
buddhimAvishya bhUtAnAM dharmArtheShu pravartate
shlokas.3:
yadA tvasya bhavedbuddhirdharmyA chArthapradarshinI |
tadAshvasIta dharmAtmAdRRiDhabuddhirna vishvaset
shlokas.4:
etAvanmAtrametaddhi bhUtAnAM prAj~nalakShaNam |
kAlayukto.apyubhayavichCheShamarthaM samAcharet
shlokas.5:
yathA hyupasthitaishvaryAH pUjayante narA narAn |
evamevAtmanAtmAnaM pUjayantIha dhArmikAH
shlokas.6:
na hyadharmatayA dharmaM dadyAtkAlaH katha~nchana |
tasmAdvishuddhamAtmAnaM jAnIyAddharmachAriNam
shlokas.7:
spraShTumapyasamartho hi jvalantamiva pAvakam |
adharmaH satato dharmaM kAlena parirakShitam
shlokas.8:
kAryAvetau hi kAlena dharmo hi vijayAvahaH |
trayANAmapi lokAnAmAlokakaraNo bhavet
shlokas.9:
tatra kashchinnayetprAj~no gRRihItvaiva kare naram |
uhyamAnaH sa dharmeNa dharme bahubhayachChale

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM shreyaH puruShasyeha kiM kurvansukhamedhate |
vipApmA cha bhavetkena kiM vA kalmaShanAshanam
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ayaM daivatava.nsho vai RRiShiva.nshasamanvitaH |
dvisandhyaM paThitaH putra kalmaShApaharaH paraH
shlokas.3:
devAsuragururdevaH sarvabhUtanamaskRRitaH |
achintyo.athApyanirdeshyaH sarvaprANo hyayonijaH
shlokas.4:
pitAmaho jagannAthaH sAvitrI brahmaNaH satI |
vedabhUratha kartA cha viShNurnArAyaNaH prabhuH
shlokas.5:
umApatirvirUpAkShaH skandaH senApatistathA |
vishAkho hutabhugvAyushchandrAdityau prabhAkarau
shlokas.6:
shakraH shachIpatirdevo yamo dhUmorNayA saha |
varuNaH saha gauryA cha saha RRiddhyA dhaneshvaraH
shlokas.7:
saumyA gauH surabhirdevI vishravAshcha mahAnRRiShiH |
ShaTkAlaH sAgaro ga~NgA sravantyo.atha marudgaNAH
shlokas.8:
vAlakhilyAstapaHsiddhAH kRRiShNadvaipAyanastathA |
nAradaH parvatashchaiva vishvAvasurhahAhuhUH
shlokas.9:
tumbarushchitrasenashcha devadUtashcha vishrutaH |
devakanyA mahAbhAgA divyAshchApsarasAM gaNAH
shlokas.10:
urvashI menakA rambhA mishrakeshI alambuShA |
vishvAchI cha ghRRitAchI cha pa~nchachUDA tilottamA
shlokas.11:
AdityA vasavo rudrAH sAshvinaH pitaro.api cha |
dharmaH satyaM tapo dIkShA vyavasAyaH pitAmahaH
shlokas.12:
sharvaryo divasAshchaiva mArIchaH kashyapastathA |
shukro bRRihaspatirbhaumo budho rAhuH shanaishcharaH
shlokas.13:
nakShatrANyRRitavashchaiva mAsAH sandhyAH savatsarAH |
vainateyAH samudrAshcha kadrujAH pannagAstathA
shlokas.14:
shatadrUshcha vipAshA cha chandrabhAgA sarasvatI |
sindhushcha devikA chaiva puShkaraM tIrthameva cha
shlokas.15:
ga~NgA mahAnadI chaiva kapilA narmadA tathA |
kampunA cha vishalyA cha karatoyAmbuvAhinI
shlokas.16:
sarayUrgaNDakI chaiva lohityashcha mahAnadaH |
tAmrAruNA vetravatI parNAshA gautamI tathA
shlokas.17:
godAvarI cha veNNA cha kRRiShNaveNA tathAdrijA |
dRRiShadvatI cha kAverI va~NkShurmandAkinI tathA
shlokas.18:
prayAgaM cha prabhAsaM cha puNyaM naimiShameva cha |
tachcha vishveshvarasthAnaM yatra tadvimalaM saraH
shlokas.19:
puNyatIrthaishcha kalilaM kurukShetraM prakIrtitam |
sindhUttamaM tapodAnaM jambUmArgamathApi cha
shlokas.20:
hiraNvatI vitastA cha tathaivekShumatI nadI |
vedasmRRitirvaidasinI malavAsAshcha nadyapi
shlokas.21:
bhUmibhAgAstathA puNyA ga~NgAdvAramathApi cha |
RRiShikulyAstathA medhyA nadI chitrapathA tathA
shlokas.22:
kaushikI yamunA sItA tathA charmaNvatI nadI |
nadI bhImarathI chaiva bAhudA cha mahAnadI
mahendravANI tridivA nIlikA cha sarasvatI
shlokas.23:
nandA chAparanandA cha tathA tIrthaM mahAhradam |
gayAtha phalgutIrthaM cha dharmAraNyaM surairvRRitam
shlokas.24:
tathA devanadI puNyA sarashcha brahmanirmitam |
puNyaM trilokavikhyAtaM sarvapApaharaM shivam
shlokas.25:
himavAnparvatashchaiva divyauShadhisamanvitaH |
vindhyo dhAtuvichitrA~NgastIrthavAnauShadhAnvitaH
shlokas.26:
merurmahendro malayaH shvetashcha rajatAchitaH |
shRRi~NgavAnmandaro nIlo niShadho dardurastathA
shlokas.27:
chitrakUTo.a~njanAbhashcha parvato gandhamAdanaH |
puNyaH somagirishchaiva tathaivAnye mahIdharAH
dishashcha vidishashchaiva kShitiH sarve mahIruhAH
shlokas.28:
vishvedevA nabhashchaiva nakShatrANi grahAstathA |
pAntu vaH satataM devAH kIrtitAkIrtitA mayA
shlokas.29:
kIrtayAno naro hyetAnmuchyate sarvakilbiShaiH |
stuva.nshcha pratinanda.nshcha muchyate sarvato bhayAt
sarvasa~NkarapApebhyo devatAstavanandakaH
shlokas.30:
devatAnantaraM viprA.nstapaHsiddhA.nstapodhikAn |
kIrtitAnkIrtayiShyAmi sarvapApapramochanAn
shlokas.31:
yavakrIto.atha raibhyashcha kakShIvAnaushijastathA |
bhRRigva~NgirAstathA kaNvo medhAtithiratha prabhuH
barhI cha guNasampannaH prAchIM dishamupAshritAH
shlokas.32:
bhadrAM dishaM mahAbhAgA ulmuchuH pramuchustathA |
mumuchushcha mahAbhAgaH svastyAtreyashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.33:
mitrAvaruNayoH putrastathAgastyaH pratApavAn |
dRRiDhAyushchordhvabAhushcha vishrutAvRRiShisattamau
shlokas.34:
pashchimAM dishamAshritya ya edhante nibodha tAn |
uShadguH saha sodaryaiH parivyAdhashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.35:
RRiShirdIrghatamAshchaiva gautamaH kashyapastathA |
ekatashcha dvitashchaiva tritashchaiva maharShayaH
atreH putrashcha dharmAtmA tathA sArasvataH prabhuH
shlokas.36:
uttarAM dishamAshritya ya edhante nibodha tAn |
atrirvasiShThaH shaktishcha pArAsharyashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.37:
vishvAmitro bharadvAjo jamadagnistathaiva cha |
RRichIkapautro rAmashcha RRiShirauddAlakistathA
shlokas.38:
shvetaketuH kohalashcha vipulo devalastathA |
devasharmA cha dhaumyashcha hastikAshyapa eva cha
shlokas.39:
lomasho nAchiketashcha lomaharShaNa eva cha |
RRiShirugrashravAshchaiva bhArgavashchyavanastathA
shlokas.40:
eSha vai samavAyaste RRiShidevasamanvitaH |
AdyaH prakIrtito rAjansarvapApapramochanaH
shlokas.41:
nRRigo yayAtirnahuSho yaduH pUrushcha vIryavAn |
dhundhumAro dilIpashcha sagarashcha pratApavAn
shlokas.42:
kRRishAshvo yauvanAshvashcha chitrAshvaH satyavA.nstathA |
duHShanto bharatashchaiva chakravartI mahAyashAH
shlokas.43:
yavano janakashchaiva tathA dRRiDharatho nRRipaH |
raghurnaravarashchaiva tathA dasharatho nRRipaH
shlokas.44:
rAmo rAkShasahA vIraH shashabindurbhagIrathaH |
harishchandro maruttashcha jahnurjAhnavisevitA
shlokas.45:
mahodayo hyalarkashcha ailashchaiva narAdhipaH |
karandhamo narashreShThaH kadhmorashcha narAdhipaH
shlokas.46:
dakSho.ambarIShaH kukuro ravatashcha mahAyashAH |
muchukundashcha rAjarShirmitrabhAnuH priya~NkaraH
shlokas.47:
trasadasyustathA rAjA shveto rAjarShisattamaH |
mahAbhiShashcha vikhyAto nimirAjastathAShTakaH
shlokas.48:
AyuH kShupashcha rAjarShiH kakSheyushcha narAdhipaH |
shibiraushInarashchaiva gayashchaiva narAdhipaH
shlokas.49:
pratardano divodAsaH saudAsaH kosaleshvaraH |
ailo nalashcha rAjarShirmanushchaiva prajApatiH
shlokas.50:
havidhrashcha pRRiShadhrashcha pratIpaH shantanustathA |
kakShasenashcha rAjarShirye chAnye nAnukIrtitAH
shlokas.51:
mA vighnaM mA cha me pApaM mA cha me paripanthinaH |
dhruvo jayo me nityaM syAtparatra cha parA gatiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tUShNImbhUte tadA bhIShme paTe chitramivArpitam |
muhUrtamiva cha dhyAtvA vyAsaH satyavatIsutaH
nRRipaM shayAnaM gA~NgeyamidamAha vachastadA
shlokas.2:
rAjanprakRRitimApannaH kururAjo yudhiShThiraH |
sahito bhrAtRRibhiH sarvaiH pArthivaishchAnuyAyibhiH
shlokas.3:
upAste tvAM naravyAghra saha kRRiShNena dhImatA |
tamimaM purayAnAya tvamanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.4:
evamukto bhagavatA vyAsena pRRithivIpatiH |
yudhiShThiraM sahAmAtyamanujaj~ne nadIsutaH
shlokas.5:
uvAcha chainaM madhuraM tataH shAntanavo nRRipaH |
pravishasva puraM rAjanvyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.6:
yajasva vividhairyaj~nairbahvannaiH svAptadakShiNaiH |
yayAtiriva rAjendra shraddhAdamapuraHsaraH
shlokas.7:
kShatradharmarataH pArtha pitR^IndevA.nshcha tarpaya |
shreyasA yokShyase chaiva vyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.8:
ra~njayasva prajAH sarvAH prakRRitIH parisAntvaya |
suhRRidaH phalasatkArairabhyarchaya yathArhataH
shlokas.9:
anu tvAM tAta jIvantu mitrANi suhRRidastathA |
chaityasthAne sthitaM vRRikShaM phalavantamiva dvijAH
shlokas.10:
AgantavyaM cha bhavatA samaye mama pArthiva |
vinivRRitte dinakare pravRRitte chottarAyaNe
shlokas.11:
tathetyuktvA tu kaunteyaH so.abhivAdya pitAmaham |
prayayau saparIvAro nagaraM nAgasAhvayam
shlokas.12:
dhRRitarAShTraM puraskRRitya gAndhArIM cha pativratAm |
saha tairRRiShibhiH sarvairbhrAtRRibhiH keshavena cha
shlokas.13:
paurajAnapadaishchaiva mantrivRRiddhaishcha pArthivaH |
pravivesha kurushreShTha puraM vAraNasAhvayam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kuntIsuto rAjA paurajAnapadaM janam |
pUjayitvA yathAnyAyamanujaj~ne gRRihAnprati
shlokas.2:
sAntvayAmAsa nArIshcha hatavIrA hateshvarAH |
vipulairarthadAnaishcha tadA pANDusuto nRRipaH
shlokas.3:
so.abhiShikto mahAprAj~naH prApya rAjyaM yudhiShThiraH |
avasthApya narashreShThaH sarvAH svaprakRRitIstadA
shlokas.4:
dvijebhyo balamukhyebhyo naigamebhyashcha sarvashaH |
pratigRRihyAshiSho mukhyAstadA dharmabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.5:
uShitvA sharvarIH shrImAnpa~nchAshannagarottame |
samayaM kauravAgryasya sasmAra puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.6:
sa niryayau gajapurAdyAjakaiH parivAritaH |
dRRiShTvA nivRRittamAdityaM pravRRittaM chottarAyaNam
shlokas.7:
ghRRitaM mAlyaM cha gandhA.nshcha kShaumANi cha yudhiShThiraH |
chandanAgarumukhyAni tathA kAlAgarUNi cha
shlokas.8:
prasthApya pUrvaM kaunteyo bhIShmasa.nsAdhanAya vai |
mAlyAni cha mahArhANi ratnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.9:
dhRRitarAShTraM puraskRRitya gAndhArIM cha yashasvinIm |
mAtaraM cha pRRithAM dhImAnbhrAtR^I.nshcha puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.10:
janArdanenAnugato vidureNa cha dhImatA |
yuyutsunA cha kauravyo yuyudhAnena chAbhibho
shlokas.11:
mahatA rAjabhogyena paribarheNa sa.nvRRitaH |
stUyamAno mahArAja bhIShmasyAgnInanuvrajan
shlokas.12:
nishchakrAma purAttasmAdyathA devapatistathA |
AsasAda kurukShetre tataH shAntanavaM nRRipam
shlokas.13:
upAsyamAnaM vyAsena pArAsharyeNa dhImatA |
nAradena cha rAjarShe devalenAsitena cha
shlokas.14:
hatashiShTairnRRipaishchAnyairnAnAdeshasamAgataiH |
rakShibhishcha mahAtmAnaM rakShyamANaM samantataH
shlokas.15:
shayAnaM vIrashayane dadarsha nRRipatistataH |
tato rathAdavArohadbhrAtRRibhiH saha dharmarAT
shlokas.16:
abhivAdyAtha kaunteyaH pitAmahamari.ndamam |
dvaipAyanAdInviprA.nshcha taishcha pratyabhinanditaH
shlokas.17:
RRitvigbhirbrahmakalpaishcha bhrAtRRibhishcha sahAchyutaH |
AsAdya sharatalpasthamRRiShibhiH parivAritam
shlokas.18:
abravIdbharatashreShThaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtRRibhiH saha kauravya shayAnaM nimnagAsutam
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThiro.ahaM nRRipate namaste jAhnavIsuta |
shRRiNoShi chenmahAbAho brUhi kiM karavANi te
shlokas.20:
prApto.asmi samaye rAjannagnInAdAya te vibho |
AchAryA brAhmaNAshchaiva RRitvijo bhrAtarashcha me
shlokas.21:
putrashcha te mahAtejA dhRRitarAShTro janeshvaraH |
upasthitaH sahAmAtyo vAsudevashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.22:
hatashiShTAshcha rAjAnaH sarve cha kurujA~NgalAH |
tAnpashya kurushArdUla samunmIlaya lochane
shlokas.23:
yachcheha ki~nchitkartavyaM tatsarvaM prApitaM mayA |
yathoktaM bhavatA kAle sarvameva cha tatkRRitam
shlokas.24:
evamuktastu gA~NgeyaH kuntIputreNa dhImatA |
dadarsha bhAratAnsarvAnsthitAnsamparivArya tam
shlokas.25:
tatashchalavalirbhIShmaH pragRRihya vipulaM bhujam |
oghameghasvano vAgmI kAle vachanamabravIt
shlokas.26:
diShTyA prApto.asi kaunteya sahAmAtyo yudhiShThira |
parivRRitto hi bhagavAnsahasrA.nshurdivAkaraH
shlokas.27:
aShTapa~nchAshataM rAtryaH shayAnasyAdya me gatAH |
shareShu nishitAgreShu yathA varShashataM tathA
shlokas.28:
mAgho.ayaM samanuprApto mAsaH puNyo yudhiShThira |
tribhAgasheShaH pakSho.ayaM shuklo bhavitumarhati
shlokas.29:
evamuktvA tu gA~Ngeyo dharmaputraM yudhiShThiram |
dhRRitarAShTramathAmantrya kAle vachanamabravIt
shlokas.30:
rAjanviditadharmo.asi sunirNItArthasa.nshayaH |
bahushrutA hi te viprA bahavaH paryupAsitAH
shlokas.31:
vedashAstrANi sarvANi dharmA.nshcha manujeshvara |
vedA.nshcha chaturaH sA~NgAnnikhilenAvabudhyase
shlokas.32:
na shochitavyaM kauravya bhavitavyaM hi tattathA |
shrutaM devarahasyaM te kRRiShNadvaipAyanAdapi
shlokas.33:
yathA pANDoH sutA rAja.nstathaiva tava dharmataH |
tAnpAlaya sthito dharme gurushushrUShaNe ratAn
shlokas.34:
dharmarAjo hi shuddhAtmA nideshe sthAsyate tava |
AnRRisha.nsyaparaM hyenaM jAnAmi guruvatsalam
shlokas.35:
tava putrA durAtmAnaH krodhalobhaparAyaNAH |
IrShyAbhibhUtA durvRRittAstAnna shochitumarhasi
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etAvaduktvA vachanaM dhRRitarAShTraM manIShiNam |
vAsudevaM mahAbAhumabhyabhAShata kauravaH
shlokas.37:
bhagavandevadevesha surAsuranamaskRRita |
trivikrama namaste.astu sha~NkhachakragadAdhara
shlokas.38:
anujAnIhi mAM kRRiShNa vaikuNTha puruShottama |
rakShyAshcha te pANDaveyA bhavAnhyeShAM parAyaNam
shlokas.39:
uktavAnasmi durbuddhiM mandaM duryodhanaM purA |
yataH kRRiShNastato dharmo yato dharmastato jayaH
shlokas.40:
vAsudevena tIrthena putra sa.nshAmya pANDavaiH |
sandhAnasya paraH kAlastaveti cha punaH punaH
shlokas.41:
na cha me tadvacho mUDhaH kRRitavAnsa sumandadhIH |
ghAtayitveha pRRithivIM tataH sa nidhanaM gataH
shlokas.42:
tvAM cha jAnAmyahaM vIra purANamRRiShisattamam |
nareNa sahitaM devaM badaryAM suchiroShitam
shlokas.43:
tathA me nAradaH prAha vyAsashcha sumahAtapAH |
naranArAyaNAvetau sambhUtau manujeShviti
shlokas.44:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
anujAnAmi bhIShma tvAM vasUnApnuhi pArthiva |
na te.asti vRRijinaM ki~nchinmayA dRRiShTaM mahAdyute
shlokas.45:
pitRRibhakto.asi rAjarShe mArkaNDeya ivAparaH |
tena mRRityustava vashe sthito bhRRitya ivAnataH
shlokas.46:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu gA~NgeyaH pANDavAnidamabravIt |
dhRRitarAShTramukhA.nshchApi sarvAnsasuhRRidastathA
shlokas.47:
prANAnutsraShTumichChAmi tanmAnuj~nAtumarhatha |
satye prayatitavyaM vaH satyaM hi paramaM balam
shlokas.48:
AnRRisha.nsyaparairbhAvyaM sadaiva niyatAtmabhiH |
brahmaNyairdharmashIlaishcha taponItyaishcha bhArata
shlokas.49:
ityuktvA suhRRidaH sarvAnsampariShvajya chaiva ha |
punarevAbravIddhImAnyudhiShThiramidaM vachaH
shlokas.50:
brAhmaNAshchaiva te nityaM prAj~nAshchaiva visheShataH |
AchAryA RRitvijashchaiva pUjanIyA narAdhipa

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA kurUnsarvAnbhIShmaH shAntanavastadA |
tUShNIM babhUva kauravyaH sa muhUrtamari.ndama
shlokas.2:
dhArayAmAsa chAtmAnaM dhAraNAsu yathAkramam |
tasyordhvamagamanprANAH saMniruddhA mahAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
idamAshcharyamAsIchcha madhye teShAM mahAtmanAm |
yadyanmu~nchati gAtrANAM sa shantanusutastadA
tattadvishalyaM bhavati yogayuktasya tasya vai
shlokas.4:
kShaNena prekShatAM teShAM vishalyaH so.abhavattadA |
taM dRRiShTvA vismitAH sarve vAsudevapurogamAH
saha tairmunibhiH sarvaistadA vyAsAdibhirnRRipa
shlokas.5:
saMniruddhastu tenAtmA sarveShvAyataneShu vai |
jagAma bhittvA mUrdhAnaM divamabhyutpapAta cha
shlokas.6:
maholkeva cha bhIShmasya mUrdhadeshAjjanAdhipa |
niHsRRityAkAshamAvishya kShaNenAntaradhIyata
shlokas.7:
evaM sa nRRipashArdUla nRRipaH shAntanavastadA |
samayujyata lokaiH svairbharatAnAM kulodvahaH
shlokas.8:
tatastvAdAya dArUNi gandhA.nshcha vividhAnbahUn |
chitAM chakrurmahAtmAnaH pANDavA vidurastathA
yuyutsushchApi kauravyaH prekShakAstvitare.abhavan
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThirastu gA~NgeyaM vidurashcha mahAmatiH |
ChAdayAmAsaturubhau kShaumairmAlyaishcha kauravam
shlokas.10:
dhArayAmAsa tasyAtha yuyutsushChatramuttamam |
chAmaravyajane shubhre bhImasenArjunAvubhau
uShNIShe paryagRRihNItAM mAdrIputrAvubhau tadA
shlokas.11:
striyaH kauravanAthasya bhIShmaM kurukulodbhavam |
tAlavRRintAnyupAdAya paryavIjansamantataH
shlokas.12:
tato.asya vidhivachchakruH pitRRimedhaM mahAtmanaH |
yAjakA juhuvushchAgniM jaguH sAmAni sAmagAH
shlokas.13:
tatashchandanakAShThaishcha tathA kAleyakairapi |
kAlAgaruprabhRRitibhirgandhaishchochchAvachaistathA
shlokas.14:
samavachChAdya gA~NgeyaM prajvAlya cha hutAshanam |
apasavyamakurvanta dhRRitarAShTramukhA nRRipAH
shlokas.15:
sa.nskRRitya cha kurushreShThaM gA~NgeyaM kurusattamAH |
jagmurbhAgIrathItIramRRiShijuShTaM kurUdvahAH
shlokas.16:
anugamyamAnA vyAsena nAradenAsitena cha |
kRRiShNena bharatastrIbhirye cha paurAH samAgatAH
shlokas.17:
udakaM chakrire chaiva gA~Ngeyasya mahAtmanaH |
vidhivatkShatriyashreShThAH sa cha sarvo janastadA
shlokas.18:
tato bhAgIrathI devI tanayasyodake kRRite |
utthAya salilAttasmAdrudatI shokalAlasA
shlokas.19:
paridevayatI tatra kauravAnabhyabhAShata |
nibodhata yathAvRRittamuchyamAnaM mayAnaghAH
shlokas.20:
rAjavRRittena sampannaH praj~nayAbhijanena cha |
satkartA kuruvRRiddhAnAM pitRRibhakto dRRiDhavrataH
shlokas.21:
jAmadagnyena rAmeNa purA yo na parAjitaH |
divyairastrairmahAvIryaH sa hato.adya shikhaNDinA
shlokas.22:
ashmasAramayaM nUnaM hRRidayaM mama pArthivAH |
apashyantyAH priyaM putraM yatra dIryati me.adya vai
shlokas.23:
sametaM pArthivaM kShatraM kAshipuryAM svaya.nvare |
vijityaikarathenAjau kanyAstA yo jahAra ha
shlokas.24:
yasya nAsti bale tulyaH pRRithivyAmapi kashchana |
hataM shikhaNDinA shrutvA yanna dIryati me manaH
shlokas.25:
jAmadagnyaH kurukShetre yudhi yena mahAtmanA |
pIDito nAtiyatnena nihataH sa shikhaNDinA
shlokas.26:
eva.nvidhaM bahu tadA vilapantIM mahAnadIm |
AshvAsayAmAsa tadA sAmnA dAmodaro vibhuH
shlokas.27:
samAshvasihi bhadre tvaM mA shuchaH shubhadarshane |
gataH sa paramAM siddhiM tava putro na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.28:
vasureSha mahAtejAH shApadoSheNa shobhane |
manuShyatAmanuprApto nainaM shochitumarhasi
shlokas.29:
sa eSha kShatradharmeNa yudhyamAno raNAjire |
dhana~njayena nihato naiSha nunnaH shikhaNDinA
shlokas.30:
bhIShmaM hi kurushArdUlamudyateShuM mahAraNe |
na shaktaH sa.nyuge hantuM sAkShAdapi shatakratuH
shlokas.31:
svachChandena sutastubhyaM gataH svargaM shubhAnane |
na shaktAH syurnihantuM hi raNe taM sarvadevatAH
shlokas.32:
tasmAnmA tvaM sarichChreShThe shochasva kurunandanam |
vasUneSha gato devi putraste vijvarA bhava
shlokas.33:
ityuktA sA tu kRRiShNena vyAsena cha saridvarA |
tyaktvA shokaM mahArAja svaM vAryavatatAra ha
shlokas.34:
satkRRitya te tAM saritaM tataH kRRiShNamukhA nRRipAH |
anuj~nAtAstayA sarve nyavartanta janAdhipAH
